PVV MPs asked whether Arabic lessons in Dutch primary schools should be stopped, arguing the language is irrelevant and linked to radicalisation. The minister rejected these claims and stated that schools may offer Arabic as an extracurricular activity, while within school hours only English, German and French (plus Dutch and Frisian) are legally permitted.
Within school hours, primary schools are legally permitted to offer only English, German and French, alongside Dutch (and Frisian in Friesland).
Binnen de onderwijstijd is het in het basisonderwijs wettelijk alleen toegestaan de talen Engels, Duits en Frans aan te bieden, naast het Nederlands (en het Fries in Friesland).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over de onheuse bejegening van Israël in de geschiedenismethode ''Geschiedeniswerkplaats vmbo-kgt 4 examenboek'' van Noordhoff Uitgevers

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister and State Secretary of Education whether a Dutch vmbo history textbook presents Israel unfairly and fuels anti-Semitism. The State Secretary declined to judge the specific textbook, stating that publishers and teachers are responsible for balanced content, while noting that objections from Israel exist and that the Israeli education minister had raised concerns.
Nevertheless, it is not for me to assess a teaching method on its substance, and I will therefore neither approve nor disapprove of it.
Desalniettemin is het niet aan mij om een lesmethode inhoudelijk te beoordelen en ik ga deze dan ook niet goed- of afkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Beertema over de kosten van asielzoekers

PVV MPs Fritsma and Beertema asked for the total 2014 cost of asylum seekers, including IND, COA, DT&V, legal aid, subsidies and education for asylum-seeker children. The government answered with itemised figures from the Justice and Education budgets, totalling roughly 0.9 billion euro, and noted that data on children without residence rights is not available.
Specific data on children without residence rights are not available and therefore cannot be provided.
Specifieke gegevens over kinderen zonder verblijfsrecht zijn niet beschikbaar en kunnen dan ook niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over berichten ‘MEPs to raise monthly allowances’ en ‘Nog meer gratis graaigeld naar Europarlementariërs’

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about reports that MEPs would receive higher monthly expense allowances, and whether the government would act against this. The minister replied that the European Parliament sets its own budget within the multiannual financial framework and that the Council and the Netherlands have no influence over the size of the EP budget, while noting the government's efforts to restrain EU staff pay and reduce staff.
The cabinet or the Council, however, has no influence over the size of the EP budget.
Het kabinet of de Raad heeft echter geen invloed op de omvang van de EP-begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about a report that most secondary schools employ fewer teachers than funded while growing non-teaching staff, and whether funds are misallocated away from teaching. The state secretary acknowledged the growth in support staff, rejected a causal link to workload, and rejected a fixed 80/20 teacher-support ratio as a blueprint, leaving the allocation to schools.
No. The ratio within the funding functions as a calculation model and not as a blueprint for how the funds are spent.
Nee. De verhouding binnen de bekostiging functioneert als rekenmodel en niet als blauwdruk voor de besteding van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Halaleten voor elke scholier'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether a Christian school imposing halal food on all pupils, including non-Muslims, on a school trip is unacceptable and whether the proposal will be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that schools are free to make such choices within the law, parents can raise concerns with school leadership and through the works council, and the national government has no role in meal decisions.
Schools are free to make their own choices, within the limits of laws and regulations.
Scholen zijn vrij om, binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving, hun eigen keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Meer studenten voor omstreden Islamitische Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education about the Islamic University of Rotterdam: graduate numbers, student financing, foreign funding, and the rector's inflammatory statements about Turkish-Dutch EP candidates. The Minister said oversight was being tightened via the Inspectorate and NVAO, a bill on civic responsibility for unfunded institutions is planned, and the foreign-funding question is under a WODC study due in 2015.
My legal options to intervene are limited because it concerns unfunded institutions.
Mijn juridische mogelijkheden om in te grijpen zijn beperkt daar het gaat om een niet-bekostigde instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema over het bericht ‘Kritiek op royale vertrekpremie Van Rompuy’

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the Prime Minister whether he regretted honouring Van Rompuy and whether the former European Council President's roughly 630,000 euro departure payment was theft, and whether the honour should be reclaimed. Minister Koenders replied that the entitlement is a legal transitional allowance under EU rules, the actual net amount is about 349,000 euro over up to three years, no relocation allowance applies, and the Netherlands is examining further modernisation of EU political office-holder arrangements.
The amount of 630,000 euro mentioned in some media is therefore incorrect.
Het in sommige media genoemde bedrag van € 630.000 is derhalve onjuist.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat de omstreden wetenschapper Diederik Stapel, die in 2011 werd geschorst voor grootschalige wetenschapsfraude, weer werkt als docent bij Fontys Academy for Creat

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether Diederik Stapel, suspended in 2011 for large-scale fraud, was hired as a guest lecturer at Fontys Academy for Creative Industries, and whether the minister would act against it. The minister replied that Fontys is responsible for its own staffing, that Stapel was a freelance guest speaker with no curriculum role, and that no action by the minister is warranted.
The institutions are responsible for the content of their education, their personnel policy and their reputation.
De instellingen zijn verantwoordelijk voor de invulling van hun onderwijs, hun personeelsbeleid en reputatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat over de hele wereld onderwijsinstellingen voorzorgsmaatregelen nemen tegen ebola, in tegenstelling tot Nederland

An MP asked the Education Minister whether she was aware of concerns at Dutch schools about Ebola, whether she accepted responsibility for student welfare, and whether flights from affected areas should be halted and arriving pupils quarantined. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said she is in close contact with colleagues, and deferred to the health minister's Ebola policy letter, calling those measures adequate.
In my view, the measures set out therein are adequate and sufficient.
Naar mijn mening zijn de daarin vermelde maatregelen adequaat en afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat scholen de toestroom van asielkinderen nauwelijks aan kunnen

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Education how schools will cope with asylum-seeker children, including the extra costs for Den Helder and nationwide up to 2017, and whether the open-borders policy is disrupting education. The state secretary answered with cost estimates (about 630,000 euro for Den Helder; 22, 38 and 41 million euro nationally across three school years), said the schools are capable of providing education, and rejected closing the borders as a means to improve quality.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Madlener over het bericht 'Moldaviërs halen Roemenen in'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure about reports of Dutch transport firms 'flagging out', foreign drivers, lorry parking and the sale of passports and driving licences, and whether borders should be closed to Eastern European workers. The government answered that data on flagged-out firms and job losses is unavailable, that it cannot track non-EU nationality entitlements, that enforcement is being strengthened in cooperation with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that closing the labour market is not a realistic option.
It is not known how many Dutch lorry drivers have lost their jobs since the labour market was opened to Romanians, Bulgarians and Poles.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs sinds de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Roemenen, Bulgaren en Polen hun baan hebben verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over de vernieuwde islamitische gebedsruimte op de Vrije Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the VU's reopened Islamic prayer room, which they said enables gender segregation and undermines integration, should be grounds for cutting its funding. The Minister replied that universities decide their own diversity policy, that the VU bars gender segregation, that other religions are also accommodated, and that she sees no reason to end funding.
No. Whether and how a university gives shape to its diversity policy is a matter for the university itself. The government has no role in this.
Neen. Of en hoe een universiteit invulling geeft aan haar diversiteitsbeleid is een zaak van de universiteit zelf. De overheid heeft hier geen rol in.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het feit dat openbare school De Tweemaster in Duindorp (Scheveningen) leerlingen halalvoedsel heeft voorgeschoteld tijdens schoolkamp, zonder dat de oude

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they knew that a Scheveningen public school served halal food on a school camp without informing parents, which other Hague schools did the same, who initiated it, and whether the mayor would be urged to combat such practices. The government confirmed awareness, said it does not centrally register camp meals and that the school is responsible, explained the camp site offered one halal-compliant evening meal for practical reasons, and declined to direct the mayor, referring questions to the school.
I am not aware which schools spent their school camp in Vledder.
Het is mij niet bekend welke scholen hun schoolkamp in Vledder hebben doorgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Bosma over alinea's uit het AIVD-rapport "Transformatie van het jihadisme in Nederland"

MPs asked whether the government knows of AIVD passages describing a salafist preacher and others passing intolerant and jihadist views to children, and whether the preacher will be detained, expelled and his institution closed. The minister declined to name the preacher or the institution citing operational secrecy, said administrative detention is not deemed necessary given existing criminal and administrative tools, and pointed to an integrated action programme and the Agenda Integratie.
I cannot make public statements about operational matters.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over operationele aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en De Graaf over het bericht dat op de Amsterdamse islamitische basisscholen El Amien I en II een angstcultuur heerst

PVV MPs asked whether a press report of a climate of fear, misused education funds and suspiciously high Cito scores at Amsterdam Islamic primary schools El Amien I and II justifies action, and whether the minister now has the powers to intervene such as closure. The minister answered that the inspectorate found improper spending that will be recovered, found no evidence of breaches of democratic values, that governance is inadequate so the board was ordered to improve, and that a follow-up inspection in Q4 2014 will determine whether to intervene further.
The inspectorate is preparing the recovery of unlawfully spent amounts and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
De inspectie bereidt de terugvordering van onrechtmatig bestede bedragen voor en blijft nauwlettend toezien op de situatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder over het bericht dat de bewoners uit de Tarwewijk, Rotterdam-Zuid angstig zijn voor de vrijlaten van de 15-jarige Rotterdamse jongen die woensdag is aangehouden voor mis

MPs Beertema and Helder asked the education state secretary about a 15-year-old Rotterdam boy released after assaulting a bullied girl, the fear in the neighbourhood, the school's failure under its anti-bullying protocol, and the need to punish bullies quickly given social media. The state secretary said an inquiry by the Rotterdam youth consul is underway, outlined planned legislation making school safety and bullying prevention enforceable by the inspectorate, and stated bullying figures have not risen though cyberbullying has.
With the announced legislation, it will become possible for the inspectorate to effectively supervise the social safety of pupils at school.
Met de aangekondigde wetgeving wordt het voor de inspectie mogelijk om effectief toezicht te houden op de sociale veiligheid van de leerlingen op school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema inzake het bericht dat de Haagse Hogeschool maatregelen neemt bij tentamens naar aanleiding van de fraude die aan het licht kwam

The PVV MP Beertema asked the Minister of Education whether she knows of the Haagse Hogeschool measures after exam fraud, which fraud occurred, its consequences, who is responsible, whether students proctor exams, and whether the minister will ensure the investigations get to the bottom of it. The minister answers that investigations are ongoing, seven students were expelled for prior knowledge of exams, a complaint of exam theft was filed, exam processes will be redesigned, and the Inspectorate will monitor the recommendations.
The Inspectorate of Education will monitor compliance with the recommendations from the investigations.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs zal toezien op de naleving van de aanbevelingen uit de onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat de Vrije Universiteit (VU) onderzoek gaat doen naar mogelijke datafraude in wetenschappelijk werk van econome Karima Kourtit

An MP asked the minister whether the VU's handling of allegations of data fraud in econometrician Karima Kourtit's work, and her PhD defence going ahead, was acceptable, and whether raw data would be reviewed first. The minister answered that the VU conducted several internal inquiries, concluded the thesis was defensible, and that the university is autonomous, so the minister relied on those findings and did not intervene.
I point out that the university is fully autonomous in its decision-making.
Ik wijs er daarbij op dat de universiteit in haar besluitvorming volledig autonoom is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over de berichten «Islamists infiltrating schools in Hamburg» en «Engelse scholen in greep van moslimradicalen»

PVV MPs asked the government whether Dutch schools face Islamist infiltration like reported cases in Hamburg and England, and whether Islamic schools should be closed. The government answered that the Inspectorate has found no signs of such infiltration, that radicalisation incidents are monitored through the biennial social safety monitor, and that closing Islamic schools is not warranted beyond the legal grounds of public order.
The inspectorate has not received any indications that Dutch education currently faces the Islamic infiltration you cite.
Vanuit de inspectie zijn geen aanwijzingen gekomen dat er in het Nederlandse onderwijs op dit moment sprake is van de door u aangehaalde islamitische infiltratie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat een deel van de Nederlandse jihadstrijders in Syrië studiefinanciering ontvangt

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked whether the minister knows of reports that some Dutch jihadists in Syria receive student finance, and whether she will stop it by general administrative order. The minister confirmed the reports, said student finance is stopped immediately in concrete cases, and that the cases are now stopped, but declined to name any cases.
In the interest of the effectiveness of the approach, I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In het belang van de effectiviteit van de aanpak doe ik geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘In Nederland studerende Saoediër opgepakt in Kenia’

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands contributes to the education of students from Islamic countries such as Saudi Arabia, and whether such students should be barred or expelled after a Saudi student was arrested in Kenya. The minister answered that internationalisation policy does not distinguish by religion, declined to comment on the individual case, and refused to bar or expel students from Islamic countries.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder over het bericht dat jonge criminelen van 12 tot 23 jaar binnenkort als straf naar school gestuurd kunnen worden

PVV MPs asked whether the government accepts that compulsory education as a penalty for young offenders aged 12 to 23 undermines school safety and whether it is a real intervention. The minister said the bill, which is pending advice from the Council of State, gives a basis to bring such youths into education and that a full debate will follow after submission, without detailing the research basis.
On the justification of the bill and what is necessary for its proper implementation, we would be glad to hold the debate with you after it is submitted to your House.
Over de onderbouwing van het wetsvoorstel en hetgeen voor een goede uitvoering daarvan noodzakelijk is, voeren wij na indiening bij uw Kamer graag het debat met u.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over indoctrinatie door de islamitische Gülenbeweging (ingezonden 3 februari 2014).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Gülen movement is anti-Western and indoctrinates children in Gülen study houses, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that there is no evidence of Islamisation aims, could not confirm the 100-study-house figure, said parents may send children to such institutions provided they follow the law, and saw no need for measures.
I see no need to take measures.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om maatregelen te treffen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat er op het Ibn Ghaldoun sprake was van een losgeslagen cultuur, een incompetent bestuur en het mede schuldig zijn van ouders en docenten

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Education about reports of a lax culture, incompetent governance and complicit staff at Ibn Ghaldoun school, including how a teacher who was intimidated was handled, why no criminal complaint was filed, and whether the school was rescued despite known problems. The State Secretary answered that personnel matters belong to the school board, that criminal acts must be reported, that funding was ended after the inspectorate found no trust in the board, and that the inspectorate monitors the new school.
The inspectorate is keeping a close eye on this.
De inspectie houdt daarbij de vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de voortgaande islamisering van het universitaire onderwijs

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a VUmc workshop on treating patients of the other sex and related Islam-linked activities at a Dutch university are acceptable and whether measures will be taken against 'Islamisation' of higher education. The minister answered that the event is a legitimate diversity activity within institutional autonomy, that education remains accessible and lawful, and that she will take no measures.
I do not intend to take measures.
Ik ben niet voornemens maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat een leerling mogelijk is doodgepest op de Horeca Vakschool Rotterdam

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a 16-year-old may have been driven to suicide by bullying at a Rotterdam school, including the gap between the father's claims and the school's denial and whether anti-bullying protocols are applied in practice. The answers say an independent inquiry into the school is underway, a bill requiring anti-bullying programmes, a bullying coordinator and monitoring is planned, and bullies can already be punished under criminal law.
The school's board has announced it will commission an independent inquiry to see whether any signals were missed.
Het bestuur van de school heeft aangekondigd een onafhankelijk onderzoek uit te laten voeren om te kijken of er geen signalen zijn gemist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht “Hulp mentor bij studiekeus allochtone jongere”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Link2Work project for jongeren, which they described as aimed at allochtone youth, discriminates against autochthonous youth, and demanded an apology and its termination. Minister Asscher replied that Link2Work is open to all youth needing extra help in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, makes no distinction by ethnicity or origin, and that many participants are expected to have a migrant background due to the population of those cities.
No distinction is made on the basis of ethnicity or origin.
Er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar etniciteit of afkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jongeren vragen om meer klimaatonderwijs’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Beertema asked the State Secretary whether climate education promoted through youth representatives is appropriate, given the lack of proof of human influence and the parliamentary inquiry's call for schools to focus on core tasks. The State Secretary answered that the IPCC science is clear, climate education is already embedded in the curriculum, and schools decide how to organise it, without committing to any new action.
Subsequently, it is up to schools how they organise and shape education and which methods and teaching materials they wish to use.
Vervolgens is het aan scholen hoe zij het onderwijs inrichten en vormgeven en welke methoden en leermiddelen zij daarbij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat ROC's diploma's hebben verstrekt voor opleidingen die onder de maat zijn

An MP asked the education minister about reports that some regional vocational colleges (ROCs) issued diplomas for substandard courses, and whether supervision by boards had failed. The minister said several ROCs and private institutions were found deficient, that most institutions comply, that the Inspectorate has issued warnings and will enforce recovery of unlawfully received funding, and pointed to tightened rules and a planned subsidy scheme replacing the training tax relief.
Courses of insufficient quality are under intensified supervision by the Education Inspectorate.
Opleidingen van onvoldoende kwaliteit staan onder geïntensiveerd toezicht van de Onderwijsinspectie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over het plan van een imam-opleiding op het Ibn Ghaldoun

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Turkish-linked imam training programme at the Ibn Ghaldoun school, funded in part by the Diyanet network, should be allowed and whether public money is involved. The state secretary answered that the school is funded only for secondary education, that the imam training is paid for by a foundation and not public funds, that freedom of religion and educational choice apply, and that the inspectorate's investigation into the school's governance will determine its future.
Ibn Ghaldoun is funded by the national government for providing education within the meaning of the Secondary Education Act.
Het Ibn Ghaldoun wordt door het Rijk bekostigd voor het verzorgen van onderwijs in de zin van de Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het bericht dat de islamitische school Ibn Ghaldoun onder de christelijke paraplu zou vallen

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Education whether an Islamic school, Ibn Ghaldoun, could fall under a Protestant-Christian school umbrella, and whether the board should be ordered to drop the plan or lose its subsidy. The state secretary declined to speculate on the planned cooperation, pointed to ongoing police, prosecution and Inspectorate investigations, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.
I will await the outcomes of the investigations before drawing my conclusions.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken af voordat ik mijn conclusies trek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de anti-Westerse opvattingen binnen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether the Islamic University of Rotterdam receives state subsidies and whether its rector's and teachers' views, which they called incompatible with Western norms on gender, sexual orientation and apostasy, justify withdrawing accreditation and barring its graduates from government chaplaincy work. The minister answered that the university receives no state funding, that the cited statements date from over ten years ago and were personal, that the programmes are accredited with no reason to withdraw accreditation, and that she does not share the view that Islamic chaplains trained there should be barred from government service.
The relevant programmes at the IUR are accredited and I see no need to withdraw these accreditations.
De betreffende opleidingen aan de IUR zijn geaccrediteerd en ik zie geen noodzaak om deze accreditaties in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de eis dat Nederland betaalt voor Turkse les op school

MPs Van Klaveren and Beertema asked whether the government agrees that a migrant organisation demanding Turkish-language lessons in Dutch schools at taxpayers' expense is absurd, and whether it will urge members to speak Dutch at home and leave for Turkey if they want Turkish lessons. The State Secretary replied that OALT was abolished in 2004 and that the matter is before the court so he will not comment further, while stressing that Dutch-language skills matter and that the ministers will work with migrant organisations, including Turkish ones, on improving children's Dutch.
Since the matter is now before the court, I will refrain from further comment.
Aangezien het nu onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij verder van commentaar.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Beertema over de ziekmeldingen van islamitische leerlingen met carnaval

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic objections to carnival can justify children staying away from school, whether parents should be fined, and whether the Netherlands has a Judeo-Christian and humanist tradition excluding Islam. The minister answered that such objections are no legal ground for leave or exemption under the Compulsory Education Act, that prosecution is for the courts, and that he rejects excluding Islam from the national tradition.
Objections to carnival do not constitute grounds for which leave and/or an exemption from compulsory education can be granted.
Bezwaren tegen carnaval vormen geen grond waarvoor verlof en/of een vrijstelling van de leerplicht kan worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Beertema inzake het tekort bij basisscholen in Amsterdam Oost.

An MP asks the minister about a reported 10.8 million euro deficit at Amsterdam Oost primary schools, including whether the STAIJ board and supervisory body failed and whether the district council acting as supervisor is appropriate. The answers state that school boards are responsible for their finances, that the district council is the supervisor under the statutes, and that the municipality plans to revise supervision.
The municipality of Amsterdam intends to revise the supervisory role over public education, currently vested in the district councils.
De gemeente Amsterdam is voornemens om de toezichthoudende rol op het openbaar onderwijs- nu belegd bij de stadsdelen- te herzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Beertema inzake mbo-instellingen en derivaten

An MP from the PVV asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science whether vocational colleges (mbo) should avoid flexible-rate loans hedged with swaps, whether boards and supervisory boards failed, and how many schools used derivatives. The minister said banks now offer fixed-rate long-term loans less readily, that swaps are permitted under the Beleggen en Belenen rules, that the Inspectie van het Onderwijs is investigating the sector's financial position including derivatives, and that consequences will be considered if irresponsible risks are found.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the financial position of all publicly funded institutions in vocational education.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar de financiële positie van alle publiek bekostigde instellingen in het mbo.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het plan van de PvdA om scholen te ‘adopteren’

An MP asked the education minister whether a PvdA plan to 'adopt' schools and offer a structural two-year programme by party politicians crosses a line, and whether parties should stay at arm's length from school content. The minister replied that the plan no longer goes ahead, that adopting a school depends on what a party means by it, and that schools decide for themselves whether to accept guest lessons.
Moreover, the plan will no longer go ahead.
Overigens vindt het plan geen doorgang meer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat ons hoger onderwijs wordt overspoeld door Zuid-Europese crisisstudenten

PVV MP Beertema asked the state secretary whether around 16,000 crisis students from Southern Europe would enrol in Dutch higher education, and whether Dutch taxpayers would bear about 8,000 euro per student in tuition and grant costs. The state secretary answered that the 16,000 figure rests on website visitor statistics that cannot be verified, that actual Nuffic numbers from Portugal, Spain, Italy and Greece are small (2,030 rising to 3,765), that EU students pay the standard fee with state funding under EU rules, and that the government sees net fiscal benefits and will not change the arrangement.
Whether and to what extent these statistics give a realistic picture of actual enrolments cannot be assessed by me on the basis of the available data.
Of en in hoeverre deze statistieken een realistisch beeld schetsen van de daadwerkelijke inschrijvingen, is voor mij op basis van de beschikbare gegevens niet te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema over het ontslag van docent maatschappijleer/Leids raadslid naar aanleiding van tweets

PVV MPs Wilders and Beertema asked the education minister whether a Leiden teacher and councillor dismissed over anti-Islam tweets was rightly suspended, why a VU employee's tweet about shooting PVV members had no employment consequences, and whether the minister would press the school to reverse the contract termination. The minister answered that the ministry is not a party, that the school's competent authority and ultimately the cantonal judge decide such matters, and that she cannot intervene in an individual employment relationship.
The ministry of OCW is not a party in this matter.
Het ministerie van OCW is in deze geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak dat salafistische ouders thuisonderwijs mogen geven

Two PVV MPs asked the minister of Education whether a court ruling allowing Salafist parents to homeschool is absurd, whether she recognises the dangers of Salafist messages, and what measures she will take to make this form of homeschooling impossible. The minister said courts decide whether religious objections justify exemption from compulsory schooling, that she will not judge a court ruling, that inciting violence is inappropriate, and that she is preparing a bill to attach conditions to religious exemptions from school attendance.
I am preparing a bill aimed at attaching a number of conditions to exemption from compulsory schooling on grounds of religion or belief.

146 ) al aangekondigd dat ik bezig ben met de voorbereiding van een wetsvoorstel met het doel de vrijstelling van de leerplicht op grond van godsdienst of levensbeschouwing aan een aantal voorwaarden te verbinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van den Besselaar en Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam illegale buitenlandse jeugd stages aanbiedt

PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam offering internships to students without residence permits is acceptable and whether fines should apply per case. The minister referred to a letter of 25 June 2012 announcing an appeal against a court ruling, and to earlier answers, without substantively answering the questions.
For answering your question I refer to the letter sent to your House on 25 June 2012, in which the cabinet announces it will appeal a ruling of the Hague District Court.

Voor de beantwoording van uw vraag verwijs ik naar de brief die wij uw Kamer op 25 juni 2012 (Kamerstukken II 2011/12, 32 144, nr. 16 ) hebben toegezonden, waarin het kabinet aankondigt in hoger beroep te zullen gaan tegen een uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over een artikel waarin gesteld wordt dat geweld binnen scholen door schooldirecties nog niet altijd voldoende wordt aangepakt

An MP asks the education minister whether school boards bear final responsibility for safety, whether they sometimes avoid reporting violence to protect their school's reputation, and whether reporting should be mandatory. The minister confirms board responsibility, lists existing measures such as higher penalties and reporting guidance, but declines to make reporting mandatory for schools and promises a review of reporting willingness with other ministries.
Because there are signals that various factors influence willingness to report, it is currently being examined how willingness to report at schools can be improved.
Omdat er signalen zijn dat verschillende factoren de aangiftebereidheid beïnvloeden wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht hoe de aangiftebereidheid op scholen kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het bericht ‘Genade-zesjes voor studenten worden kwistig uitgedeeld’

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper report that university students are handing out lenient passing grades, and whether academic degree standards are under pressure and should be set at faculty level. The state secretary said the underlying student study was not published and was not scientific, that its survey offers no basis for conclusions about standards, and that recent policy measures like accreditation changes already address degree level, while deferring further discussion to a later debate.
The Inspectorate of Education has also requested the study. If the Inspectorate deems it necessary, further consultation will take place with the students concerned.
Ook de Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft het onderzoek opgevraagd. Indien de Inspectie dat nodig acht, zal nader overleg plaatsvinden met de betreffende studenten.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het bericht betreffende een compensatieregeling voor onvoldoendes op de faculteit der geesteswetenschappen van de Universiteit van Amsterdam

An MP asks the state secretary whether the University of Amsterdam's proposed compensation rule for failed courses (allowing a 5 to be offset by a 7 in the same cluster) lowers standards and causes diploma deflation, and what action will be taken. The secretary rejects the deflation claim, defends the rule as pedagogically motivated and part of a package to reduce dropout, sees no reason for special action, and states the funding system has shifted away from diploma-based financing.
I see no reason, based on the current UvA plans, to take steps to pay extra attention to the quality of education or the UvA's diplomas.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op basis van de huidige plannen van de UvA stappen te ondernemen om met extra aandacht te kijken naar de kwaliteit van het onderwijs of de diploma's van de UvA.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de 170 leerlingen van de failliete basisschool «De Regenboog» in Maarssen door de curator zonder pardon op straa

An MP asks the education minister whether the curator of the bankrupt Maarssen school may sell the municipally owned building while 170 pupils still attend, and what safeguards exist for staff, parents and pupils. The minister says she disagrees with the curator's view, is in talks with the municipality and curator, and has offered temporary financial support so pupils can continue in the same building after Christmas.
I do not share that view. I am in discussion about this with the municipality of Maarssen and with the curator.
Ik deel die mening niet. Ik ben hierover in gesprek met de gemeente Maarssen en met de curator.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aangenomen resolutie van de VO-raad die uitspreekt dat de Wet onderwijstijd niet uitgevoerd zal worden, ook niet als de Eerst

An MP asks the minister whether she is aware of a VO-raad resolution declaring that the Wet onderwijstijd will not be implemented even if the Eerste Kamer adopts it, and whether a sector council acting this way should be dissolved. The minister answers that she takes note of the resolution, expects the VO-raad to respect democratically enacted laws, and does not see reason to reconsider its status as government interlocutor.
Naturally, a sector council such as the VO-raad must also respect democratically enacted laws.
Uiteraard moet ook een Sectorraad als de VO-raad democratisch tot stand gekomen wetten eerbiedigen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders , Kortenoeven en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over apartheidsreizen naar Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Education and Foreign Affairs ministers about Hajj/Umrah trips to Saudi Arabia, which bar non-Muslims from Mecca and Medina, and whether schools organise such trips during school time. The government said religious access restrictions are a religious matter it does not normally comment on, that no Islamic schools are known to organise such trips, that absence is not recorded by religion, and that municipalities enforce compulsory schooling.
The government therefore cannot tell you whether, and if so how many, Islamic compulsory-education pupils were absent without leave during the past Hajj season.
De regering kan u dan ook niet melden of, en zo ja hoeveel islamitische leerplichtigen ongeoorloofd afwezig waren tijdens het afgelopen hadj-seizoen.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat een leerling mogelijk is dood gepest op het Hondsrug College te Emmen (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about reports that a pupil at Hondsrug College in Emmen may have been bullied to death, and whether the school acted adequately, whether the Inspectorate will investigate, whether school safety protocols are applied in practice, and whether extra attention to bullying is planned. The minister said the Inspectorate had no prior signals and will await the Public Prosecution Service's outcome before deciding on an investigation, pointed to school safety support bodies and a planned mandatory incident registration bill, and said talks with school sector councils on social safety are ongoing.

The Inspectorate of Education therefore did not conduct an investigation. Before assessing whether an investigation is warranted, the Inspectorate will await the outcome of the Public Prosecution Service's investigation.

De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft dan ook geen onderzoek verricht. Alvorens te beoordelen of onderzoek van belang is, wacht de Inspectie van het Onderwijs de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie af.

Vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat fraude op islamitische scholen niet wordt vervolgd (ingezonden

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked why fraud at Islamic schools (about EUR 4.6 million recovered, only one case prosecuted) was not prosecuted and whether recovered sums should be charged to individual board members with fines. The minister replied that recovery is administrative, that criminal reports were made in three cases and only one led to prosecution, that the prosecution service declined the others on evidentiary and opportunity grounds, and that the ministry lacks power to recover from individuals, though one board was pressed to pursue ex-board members.
The Ministry of OCW has no legal authority to recover unlawfully obtained or spent funding from individual board members or staff of an educational institution.
Het ministerie van OCW heeft geen juridische bevoegdheid om onrechtmatig verkregen of bestede bekostiging te verhalen op individuele bestuursleden of medewerkers van een onderwijsinstelling.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een in Madrid gearresteerde radicale moslim (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the minister whether it is acceptable that a Moroccan convicted as a jihadist terrorist worked as a lecturer at the Islamic University of Europe in Rotterdam, and whether such an institution should be closed. The state secretary said the institution is not recognised under Dutch higher education law and OCW has no involvement with it, that work permits do not require employers to check a worker's background, and that action would follow only if the institution breached Dutch legal rules, with a court able to ban an association acting against public order.
I cannot answer the first part of your question, because I have no involvement with the institution in question.
Ik kan het eerste deel van uw vraag niet beantwoorden, omdat ik geen bemoeienis heb met de onderhavige instelling.

Vragen van de leden Bosma en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over nieuwe gevallen van wetenschappelijke fraude aan het Nexus Instituut, gelieerd aan de Universiteit Tilburg (ing

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether the director of the Nexus Institute misquoted Menno ter Braak in a speech at Lowlands and whether this constitutes scientific fraude warranting an end to subsidy. The minister answered that government does not check the accuracy of quotations, that free expression and academic freedom apply, that no scientific fraud is apparent, and that ending subsidy is not at issue.
The government has no role in checking the accuracy of quotations.
De overheid heeft geen rol in het controleren van de juistheid van citaten.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Verzet bij Inholland» (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

Rep. Beertema (PVV) asked whether the Inholland supervisory board opposed the agreed recovery of improper expenses from former executives, and how the state secretary would respond if the agreement was not kept. State Secretary Zijlstra answered that the current executive board chair committed to recovering improper amounts where possible and that the state's only instrument is recovery from the institution itself, with no reason to doubt compliance.
I have made agreements with the current chair of the Executive Board to recover improperly granted declarations and expenses from the persons involved as far as possible.
Ik heb afspraken gemaakt met de huidige voorzitter van het College van Bestuur om ondoelmatig verstrekte declaraties en uitgaven zoveel mogelijk op de betrokken personen te verhalen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een aangekondigde islamitische conferentie aan de Univ

PVV MPs asked the ministers about a planned Leiden University conference on applying Sharia in the West, its links to Hizb ut-Tahrir, the ECFR and Al Qaradawi, and whether it signals Islamisation of education. The minister said the conference is an academic LUCIS activity, that no cooperation with the ECFR exists, that Hizb ut-Tahrir stays within the law, and did not see the event as a sign of Islamisation.
I have been informed by LUCIS that there is no cooperation between LUCIS and the ECFR.
Antwoord 3 Van de zijde van LUCIS is mij meegedeeld dat er geen sprake is van samenwerking tussen het LUCIS en de ECFR.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht op bndestem.nl van 31 mei 2011 over de aankondiging van het rapport van de Inspectie over de declaraties van bestuur

An MP asks the minister whether the former InHolland board chair's disclosure of his personal expense claims is known, and whether the Inspectorate's report will break down expense claims by individual board member. The state secretary confirms knowledge of the disclosure, says Dales's motives are unknown, and states that the report presents board expenditure overview and completely, without committing to a per-person breakdown.
I am of the view that the report has mapped the expenditures associated with the then Executive Board in a clear and complete manner.
Ik ben van mening dat in het rapport de uitgaven, samenhangend met het toenmalige College van Bestuur, overzichtelijk en volledig in kaart zijn gebracht.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een leerling die toegang tot de school is geweigerd vanwege het niet betalen van extra opleidingskosten (ingezonden 13 mei 2011)

An MP asks the education minister about a student refused school access for not paying extra training costs, and whether schools may demand such mandatory contributions. The minister answers that schools may only request voluntary contributions, that refusing access over unpaid contracted contributions is not allowed, that the inspectorate has intervened and the conflict is resolved, and that the sector service document will be updated.
The school may not refuse access to education because the student has not paid a voluntary non-statutory contribution.
De school mag de toegang tot het onderwijs niet weigeren omdat de student een vrijwillige niet-wettelijke bijdrage niet heeft betaald.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat drie bestuurders van de Hogeschool Van Hall Larenstein kapitalen verdienen voor nog geen drie uurtjes we

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is unacceptable that three board members of Hogeschool Van Hall Larenstein earn large salaries for very few working hours, and whether excess pay can be reclaimed and the supervisory board held to account. The government replied that the three institutions are managed jointly by one board, that pay is set by agreement and by the supervisory board, that the new pay cap applies only at reappointment, and that no further steps are planned while the motion's follow-up is awaited.
I will not take any further steps now because this will only play a role at reappointment.
Ik zal nu geen nadere stappen ondernemen omdat dit pas een rol gaat spelen bij een herbenoeming.

Vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «ROC Rijn IJssel treft schikking met OM» (ingezonden 22 april 2011)

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would dismiss or force a vocational school (ROC Rijn IJssel) to drop proceedings against a whistleblower, after the school settled with the public prosecutor over forgery and fraud, and whether whistleblowers should get statutory protection. The minister answered that the labour relationship is not for the government to intervene in, that settlement is an acceptable way to punish fraud and recover gains, and that since 2009 every mbo institution has a whistleblower protection scheme with no plans to change it.
Whistleblowers must be protected. Since 1 January 2009 every mbo institution has a scheme protecting whistleblowers.
Klokkenluiders moeten beschermd worden. Sinds 1 januari 2009 heeft iedere mbo-instelling een regeling die klokkenluiders beschermt.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «ROC achtervolgt klokkenluider» (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about a vocational college (ROC) allegedly fraudulently misusing ESF funds, its handling of a whistleblowing teacher, the prosecutor's and supervisory board's responses, and whether the governance model enables fraud. The minister answered that an independent Audit Service investigation led to reclaiming the ESF subsidy, a criminal settlement was reached with the college, the supervisory board's conduct is its own responsibility, and the governance model is designed to prevent misuse.
How the Supervisory Board carries out these statutory tasks is a matter for the board itself, and I cannot intervene in that.
Hoe de Raad van Toezicht deze wettelijke taken uitvoert behoort tot diens verantwoordelijkheid, daar kan ik niet in treden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wasruimte op een hogeschool (ingezonden 8 f

PVV MPs asked whether a ritual washing room for Muslims at a Christian university of applied sciences signals Islamisation of education and whether the government will oppose it. The minister rejected the Islamisation view, said the college board decides within equal-treatment law, noted complaints can go to the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling or the courts, and declined any measures.

The College of Governors is responsible for the running of a higher education institution and is therefore authorised to make decisions in this matter as well, within the generally applicable legal frameworks.

Het College van Bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de gang van zaken op een instelling van hoger onderwijs en mitsdien bevoegd om ook in dezen beslissingen te nemen binnen de algemeen geldende wettelijke kaders.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Hogeschool besteedt geld aan volstrekt verkeerde zaken» (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Dutch universities of applied sciences spend much of their budget on overhead rather than teaching, including housing costs and research funding. The secretary defended the research role, said overhead of about 25% is too high, promised to agree overhead reduction with institutions, and noted a motion asking the Court of Audit to investigate overhead.
I consider such an overhead percentage too high. Within the multi-year agreements I will make arrangements with the higher education institutions on how a reduction of overhead can be achieved.

Ik vind een dergelijk overheadpercentage te hoog. Met de ho-instellingen ga ik in het kader van de meerjarenafspraken afspraken maken over de wijze waarop een reductie van overhead gerealiseerd kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Hbo kan best zonder subsidie» (ingezonden 6 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a press report that Dutch universities of applied sciences could manage without subsidy, comparing funding of regular and unfunded private institutions, and whether regular institutions waste subsidy money on overhead. The secretary answered that the unfunded institution falls outside the accredited system, that overhead of about 25 percent is too high and will be addressed in multi-year agreements, and that the Court of Audit is to investigate overhead following a parliamentary motion.
This motion was adopted by the House of Representatives on Tuesday 28 March 2011.
Deze motie is dinsdag 28 maart 2011 door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Strijd tegen de bezuinigingen» (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the education minister whether the PO-Raad, an education employers' body funded indirectly by OCW, is obstructing government policy by lobbying opposition parties to deny the coalition a Senate majority, and whether it should be called to account. The minister answers that the PO-Raad is entitled to invite party representatives to schools, that this is not obstruction, but that she would call it to account if it obstructed adopted policy.
Should there be a situation in which the PO-Raad obstructs the implementation of adopted policy, I will certainly call the PO-Raad to account.
Mocht er sprake zijn van een situatie waarom de PO-Raad obstructie pleegt ten aanzien van de uitvoering van vastgesteld beleid, dan zal ik de PO-Raad zeker ter verantwoording roepen.
Vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over islamitische scholen die slechter scoren (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the education minister about Islamic schools scoring worse on inspection ratings, arguing they reject Western values and should be closed. The minister answered that low-quality schools of any denomination are a concern, noted improvement in Islamic primary schools, rejected the view that Islamic education does not fit the Netherlands, and said funding would not be withdrawn merely because a school is Islamic, though chronically weak schools face closure.
I have no intention of withdrawing funding from schools because they are Islamic.
Ik heb geen voornemens om de bekostiging van scholen in te trekken, omdat ze islamitisch zijn.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de islamisering van de omgangsvormen op de Hogeschool

PVV MPs asked whether the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences board's tolerance of a lecturer refusing to shake women's hands amounts to unacceptable sex discrimination and whether 'Islamisation' of education must be stopped. The ministers answered that the board is responsible and has decided to terminate the lecturer's contract, that gender equality and religious freedom are both fundamental, and that the school should discuss a policy, while declining to call it Islamisation and finding question 4 unclear.
The Executive Board is responsible for the running of the university and is therefore competent to take a decision in this matter.
Het College van Bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de gang van zaken op de Hogeschool en is mitsdien bevoegd in deze een beslissing te nemen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een mishandeling vanwege het niet dragen van e

MPs Van Klaveren, Beertema and Wilders asked whether a reported assault on a girl for not wearing a headscarf showed Islamic oppression, whether this made a school headscarf ban necessary, and what measures would remove and prosecute perpetrators. The minister rejected the oppression framing, said headscarf wearing played no role in the incident, saw no need for a ban, and said the central government lacked competence, pointing to the school's power to suspend and to criminal reporting.
None, the central government is not competent for this.
Geen, het Rijk is hiertoe niet bevoegd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wens van bijna 100 ouders na de zomer over te gaan op islamitisch thuisonderwijs in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she considers Islamic home schooling undesirable and what measures she will take to prevent it across the Netherlands, after nearly 100 Amsterdam parents wanted to switch to home education. The minister answered that home schooling is not a way to fulfil compulsory education but is permitted for exempted parents under the Leerplichtwet, that a religious objection exemption is available and judged by the courts where disputed, and that she will reconsider the exemption ground and report back in autumn.
I will therefore consider the desirability of this exemption ground and will inform you of the outcome this autumn.
Ik ga mij dan ook beraden op de opportuniteit van deze vrijstellingsgrond en zal u dit najaar over de uitkomst informeren.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het aan kinderen opdringen van een eenzijdige klimaattheor

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether schools are being pressed to teach a one-sided climate theory to children, citing the 'Warme Truiendag' campaign and a Youth News broadcast, and asked about related subsidies. The minister said schools choose their own teaching materials, declined to give a substantive view on indoctrination, and stated that the 'Warme Truiendag' campaign received no 2011 state subsidy while a related European youth project is partly funded by the Foreign Ministry.
It is up to the schools themselves which teaching materials they use.
Het is aan scholen zelf van welke leermiddelen zij gebruik maken.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat scholieren nog steeds zonder les of begeleiding worden opgehokt in studielokalen om het verplicht aantal lesuren

An MP asks the education minister about reports that secondary pupils are still confined to study rooms without teaching to meet mandatory lesson hours, and whether schools and the inspectorate should act more and whether 'lesson' should be defined more strictly. The minister says schools must take responsibility, points to the pending Wetsvoorstel onderwijstijd VO giving pupils and parents voice, rejects a harder lesson definition, and says the inspectorate will enforce against schools missing the hours norm.
Schools that do not meet the hours norm will of course be subject to enforcement action by the inspectorate.
Bij scholen die niet aan de urennorm voldoen zal de inspectie vanzelfsprekend handhavend optreden.
Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bosma en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een partijpolitieke email van een schooldirecteur (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

MPs Wilders, Bosma and Beertema asked the education minister about an internal email in which a primary school director expressed a party-political opinion, and whether he should be dismissed. The minister answered that expressing political views is outside the director's duties, but that the employer decides on any consequences under labour law and the constitutional freedom of education, so she declined to intervene.
This concerns a fundamental right laid down in Article 7 of the Constitution.
Het betreft hier een grondrecht dat is vastgelegd in artikel 7 van de Grondwet.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bosma, Van Klaveren, en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «WOII moet weer centrale plek krijgen» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Holocaust lessons are being adapted for Muslim pupils and to what extent. The minister said there is no national overview, that lesson design is teachers' professional responsibility, and that a survey indicated one in five history teachers in big cities had sometimes found it hard to raise the Holocaust, without this implying structural problems.
In essence this is the professional responsibility of teachers, in which the government has no involvement.
In essentie is dit de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van leraren waar de overheid geen bemoeienis mee heeft.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verbieden van een hoofddoek op school (ingezonden

Two PVV MPs asked whether schools may ban headscarves, whether such dress conflicts with emancipation, and whether the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling should be abolished. The minister said schools may impose conditions only where necessary for their founding principles and applied consistently, did not share the view that schools may always ban headscarves, declined to endorse the emancipation framing, and defended the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling as valuable.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, ik deel die visie niet.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over islamitische feestdagen op scholen (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An MP asked whether schools using study days to create de facto holidays for Islamic feast days undermines the official holiday tradition, and whether teachers take leave on those days and how that is compensated. The minister answered that schools have autonomy within the hour norm and works council rules, that leave is a matter between employer and employee, and that no Islamic feast day is being given official holiday status.
The possibilities and impossibilities regarding taking leave, or compensating for it, are a matter between employer and employee, whether or not collectively regulated.
De (on)mogelijkheden met betrekking tot het opnemen van verlof, dan wel het compenseren daarvan, is een zaak tussen de werkgever en werknemer onderling, al dan niet collectief geregeld.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu, de minister Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie o

PVV MPs asked why ministries co-funded a free Bosatlas set for all secondary schools, whether climate sceptics were involved, and whether children are being informed one-sidedly about climate change. The state secretary answered that schools choose their own teaching materials, that the atlas omits future temperature and sea-level scenarios due to uncertainty, and gave no commitment to change anything.
It is up to the schools themselves which teaching materials they use.
Het is aan de scholen zelf van welke leermiddelen zij gebruik maken.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel in de Volkskrant van zaterdag 10 juli 2010 over diplomafraude op hogeschool InHolland (ingezonden 13 juli 20

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about reports that InHolland issued diplomas to about 250 students who had not met the exam standard via a 'Theo-route' pilot, and whether this amounted to fraud, and demanded investigation, sanctions and revocation of diplomas. The Secretary said the Leers commission saw a laisser-faire climate rather than fraud, that the actual number was 147 students, that the Inspectorate is conducting follow-up research and will recover funding if diplomas were unlawfully issued, but that revoking diplomas is the institution's responsibility.
The inspectorate is currently conducting a follow-up investigation at InHolland.
Momenteel voert de inspectie een vervolgonderzoek uit bij InHolland.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Scholen gewaarschuwd voor dierenactivisme» (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the education minister whether she knew of reports that schools were warned about animal activism, what measures were taken after an AIVD warning, whether schools should refrain from animal-activist lessons, and whether public donations to such activists should be banned. The minister confirmed awareness, said the ministry informed school boards based on AIVD information, left the choice of speakers to school boards, and stated schools' public funding is not meant for donations to third parties.
The choice of whether or not to admit an organisation for an information session, and the conditions under which, is for the boards of educational institutions to decide.
De keuze van het wel of niet toelaten van een organisatie voor een voorlichtingsbijeenkomst en de voorwaarden waaronder, is ter beoordeling aan de besturen van onderwijsinstellingen.
Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over huisvesting van buitenlandse studenten in hotels (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

PVV MPs asked the housing minister about foreign students being housed in hotels in Wageningen at a low nightly rate, questioning whether this reflects a housing shortage and unequal treatment of Dutch students. The minister answered that the arrangement is a local initiative to add units, that allocation is by travel distance without nationality distinction, and that hotel rooms are not cheaper or more luxurious than regular furnished rooms.
It appears that the hotel rooms in Wageningen are not more luxurious or cheaper than regular furnished student rooms.
Het blijkt dat de hotelkamers in Wageningen niet luxer of goedkoper zijn dan reguliere gemeubileerde studentenkamers.

Changes the budget to distribute extra primary education funds via the earlier workload-funds method instead of a subsidy scheme; a spending allocation not bearing on executive checks.
via the method previously used for the workload funds instead of via a subsidy scheme
via de methode die eerder voor de werkdrukmiddelen is gebruikt in plaats van via een subsidieregeling

Asks the government to consult stakeholders on strengthening civic education about democracy and the rule of law in secondary schools and report by 1 April 2021.
requests the government to consult with relevant parties as soon as possible on this

Asks the government to support teachers in professionalising and training for citizenship education, including handling contested topics in class.
requests the government to structurally facilitate education in professionalising, training and supporting teachers

Motie van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rog over de burgerschapsopdracht ook op B4-scholen van toepassing verklaren
Asks the government to apply the citizenship duty to B4 international schools, with prior checks on new schools and recording in the designation regulation.
requests the government to make the citizenship duty also applicable to B4 schools
verzoekt de regering, om de burgerschapsopdracht ook op B4-scholen van toepassing te verklaren
Motie van de leden Rog en Bruins over de reikwijdte van het inspectietoezicht op de burgerschapsopdracht
Asks the cabinet to draw up a clear framework defining the scope of inspectorate supervision of the civic education duty in schools, showing restraint.
requests the cabinet, together with the education sector and the Inspectorate of Education, to draw up a clear framework setting out the scope of inspectorate supervision
verzoekt het kabinet, samen met het onderwijsveld en de Inspectie van het Onderwijs een duidelijk kader op te stellen waaruit de reikwijdte van het inspectietoezicht

Asks the cabinet to explore with the education sector and inspectorate how the school indicator on lower-secondary placement can avoid risk-averse behaviour and move to a new form of supervision.
requests the cabinet, in consultation with the education sector and the inspectorate, to explore how to prevent
verzoekt het kabinet, in overleg met de onderwijssector en de inspectie, te verkennen hoe voorkomen kan worden
Motie van het lid Rog over een structurele doelfinanciering voor scholen met relatief veel kinderen met een achterstand
Motion asking the cabinet to explore redirecting part of school lump-sum and subsidy funds into structural targeted funding for schools with many disadvantaged pupils and to inform the House.
Motie van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over het alsnog toekennen van aanvragen uit de lerarenbeurs
Asks the government to propose funding so that rejected teacher-grant applications from 2,400 teachers can be granted after early exhaustion of the budget.
requests the government to come up with proposals before 1 October to still grant the applications
verzoekt de regering, voor 1 oktober aanstaande met voorstellen te komen om de aanvragen alsnog toe te kennen
Amendement van de leden Rog en Van Meenen over een grondslag voor aanvullende bekostiging voor brede scholengemeenschappen

By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules may be set on providing supplementary funding
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld over het verstrekken van aanvullende bekostiging
Motie van de leden Rog en Van Meenen over het wegwerken van onderwijsachterstanden door lente-, zomer- en herfstonderwijs
Asks the government to quickly send the House plans for catching up on education delays caused by COVID-19, such as summer and autumn schooling.
requests the government to send plans to the House as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering, zo snel als mogelijk plannen naar de Kamer te sturen
Motie van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over verkrijgen van het vso-diploma op basis van reeds behaalde schoolresultaten
Asks the government to ensure that final-year students in special secondary education can obtain their diploma based on school results achieved so far.
requests the government to ensure that final-year candidates in special secondary education can obtain the diploma based on school results achieved so far

verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat eindexamenkandidaten in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs op basis van tot nu toe behaalde, of eventueel nog te behalen eigen schoolresultaten, het diploma kunnen verkrijgen
Motie van het lid Rog over een handelingsprotocol in geval van een (vermoeden van een) COVID-19-besmetting op scholen
Asks the cabinet to draw up a protocol for schools on handling suspected or confirmed COVID-19 infections before 11 May.
requests the cabinet to draw up, before 11 May, together with care and education professionals including the GGD, a protocol
verzoekt het kabinet, om voor 11 mei aanstaande samen met zorg- en onderwijsprofessionals, waaronder de GGD, een protocol op te stellen
Amendement van het lid Rog t.v.v. nr. 12 over afspraken over medezeggenschap in de samenwerkingsovereenkomst

This amendment therefore makes it possible in the cooperation agreement between the vmbo school and the mbo institution to make additional agreements on the participation regime
Dit amendement maakt het daarom mogelijk in de samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen de vmbo-school en de mbo-instelling naast het toepasselijke medezeggenschapsregime aanvullende afspraken te maken
Motie van het lid Kwint c.s. over een passende plek op vmbo of mbo niveau 2 voor leerlingen uit de geïntegreerde route
Asks the government, together with the MBO Raad, to guarantee students who drop out of the integrated vmbo basic vocational route a suitable place at vmbo or mbo level 2.

requests the government, together with the MBO Raad, to make agreements that if a pupil or student drops out of the integrated vmbo basic vocational route, they are always guaranteed a suitable place at vmbo or mbo level 2

verzoekt de regering, samen met de MBO Raad afspraken te maken dat in het geval een leerling of student afhaakt in de geïntegreerde route vmbo-basisberoepsopleiding, zij altijd gegarandeerd zijn van een passende plek op vmbo of mbo niveau 2
Motie van de leden Van den Berge en Rog over het burgerschapsonderwijs in het mbo
Asks the government to address teacher quality and alignment with vmbo civics in its evaluation of the mbo civic education agenda and inform the House.
requests the government, in the context of the evaluation of the Civic Education Agenda mbo 2017-2021, to pay specific attention to
verzoekt de regering, om in het kader van de evaluatie van de Burgerschapsagenda mbo 2017–2021 specifiek aandacht te besteden aan
Amendement van het lid Rog over afspraken over medezeggenschap in de samenwerkingsovereenkomst
Adds to the vmbo-mbo cooperation agreement a duty to settle which co-determination regime applies to pupils at each stage.
This amendment provides that the cooperation agreement between the vmbo school and the mbo institution must also include agreements on the co-determination regime applying to the pupil
Dit amendement regelt dat in de samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen de vmboschool en de mbo-instelling tevens afspraken moeten worden gemaakt over het medezeggenschapsregime
Motie van de leden Kuik en Rog over geen wettelijke doorstroomvoorwaarde voor de overstap van havo naar vwo

Asks the government not to make taking an extra subject a statutory progression requirement for the havo-to-vwo transition in the forthcoming AMvB, but to keep a mandatory summer progression programme.
requests the government, in the AMvB still to be drafted, not to include a statutory progression requirement for the havo-to-vwo transition
verzoekt de regering, in de nog op te stellen AMvB geen wettelijke doorstroomvoorwaarde voor de overstap van havo naar vwo op te nemen
Motie van de leden Kuik en Rog over de mogelijkheid om in de zomervakantie een doorstroomprogramma te volgen
Asks the government to agree with schools that pupils switching school track can always take a bridging programme in the summer holiday.
requests the government to make agreements with schools that this group of pupils is always offered the possibility
verzoekt de regering, afspraken te maken met scholen dat er voor deze groep leerlingen altijd de mogelijkheid wordt geboden
Amendement van het lid Bisschop c.s. t.v.v. nr. 8 over verduidelijking van het leerlingvolgsysteem
Amendment removes the requirement that schools use tests approved by an independent commission, leaves tests in the first two school years optional, and clarifies the student tracking system rules.
The obligation to work with standardised tests approved by an independent commission hinders the exercise of that responsibility and is therefore deleted.
De verplichting om te werken met door een onafhankelijke commissie goedgekeurde genormeerde toetsen belemmert het uitoefenen van die verantwoordelijkheid en wordt daarom geschrapt.
Amendement van het lid Rog c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over bij AMvB invullen van 'evident ondoelmatige besteding'

Adds a clause requiring an AMvB to set criteria for 'evident ondoelmatige besteding' before a school funding sanction can be imposed, and delays the draft AMvB until four weeks after it is laid before both chambers.
Without this general administrative order, enforcement on 'evident ondoelmatige besteding' is not possible.
Zonder deze algemene maatregel van bestuur is handhaving op «evident ondoelmatige besteding» niet mogelijk.
Amendement van de leden Rog en Bisschop over bij AMvB invullen van 'evident ondoelmatige besteding'

Requires a general administrative order (AMvB) defining 'evident ondoelmatige besteding' for school funding sanctions, and bars submitting it until four weeks after the draft is sent to both chambers.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under paragraph 4a shall not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Houses of the States General.
De voordracht voor een krachtens lid 4a vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rog t.v.v. nr. 10 over de vrijwillige eigen bijdrage op profielscholen
Exempts profile schools from the ban on compulsory parental contributions for activities outside core objectives.
The first paragraph does not apply to activities outside the core objectives that are offered long-term to pupils
Het eerste lid is niet van toepassing op activiteiten die buiten de kerndoelen, bedoeld in artikel 13, zevende lid, langdurig aan leerlingen worden aangeboden
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rog t.v.v. nr. 8 over de vrijwillige eigen bijdrage op profielscholen

Exempts intensive profile-school activities offered beyond core objectives from the ban on compulsory parental contributions in the school-fees initiative bill, allowing voluntary contributions for them.

Asks the government to promote that all profile schools adopt a code or scheme ensuring access for pupils whose parents cannot pay the extra contribution, and to report to the House.
and to inform the House about the outcome before summer 2020
