Amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rog over de vrijwillige eigen bijdrage op profielscholen
Exempts specialist school profile activities from the initiative bill's ban on compulsory parental contributions.
The first paragraph does not apply to activities directly related to the special organisation of education at a school.
Het eerste lid is niet van toepassing op activiteiten die rechtstreeks verband houden met de bijzondere inrichting van het onderwijs aan een school.
Amendement van de leden Peters en Rog over geld in het kader van de week van respect
Moves 1 million euros of budget from the unallocated wage and price reserve to the integration article to fund the week of respect, for two years under the Social Affairs ministry.
This amount is covered from undetermined LPO funds (wage and price adjustment), article 99.
Dit bedrag wordt gedekt uit onbestemde LPO-middelen (loon- en prijsbijstelling), artikel 99.
Motie van het lid Rog c.s. over aanpassen van de regelgeving voor de studievoucher
Asks the government to change student voucher rules so that existing recipients get a €2,000 debt reduction five years after graduation, with cash payout where no debt remains.
requests the government to amend the current rules so that students who could already claim a voucher no longer receive one
verzoekt de regering om de huidige regelgeving zo aan te passen dat studenten die al aanspraak konden maken op een voucher geen voucher meer ontvangen
Motie van de leden Rog en Van Meenen over onderzoek naar onderwijstijd van leerlingen en leraren in het funderend onderwijs

The minister confirmed the regulation prevails over sector protocols, said pupils need not wear masks in school transport, and announced a formal instruction to safety regions ending enforcement of the mask requirement for that transport.
This clarity is provided through an additional instruction to the chairs of the safety regions under the Public Health Act
Deze duidelijkheid wordt geboden door een aanvullende aanwijzing aan de voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio’s op grond van de Wet publieke gezondheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Rog en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Haast geboden met ventilatie op scholen’

Three CDA MPs asked ministers whether ventilation rules for schools were known before the school year, how many schools meet current Bouwbesluit ventilation standards, and what measures RIVM, the Belastingdienst and ministries took. The government answered that existing building code rules apply, that school boards are responsible and no data on school ventilation is collected, and that the answers to the questions were delayed.
No data are collected or kept on the ventilation of school buildings.
Er worden geen gegevens verzameld of bijgehouden over de ventilatie van schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Rog en Van Meenen over LVS-instrumenten

MPs Bisschop, Rog and Van Meenen asked the minister whether the Expert Group on Primary Education Tests can assess observation instruments in the student tracking system (LVS) given the legal basis, and why the rules, criteria and transparency of the assessment framework are as they are. The minister answered that observation instruments count as LVS tests, that a Toetsbesluit amendment is needed to limit kindergartners to observation instruments, that no separate framework is needed, and that the framework was briefly unavailable online due to a website error.
An amendment to the Toetsbesluit PO is needed so that for kindergartners only observation instruments can qualify for approval by the Expert Group.
Een wijziging van het Toetsbesluit PO is nodig, zodat voor kleuters alleen observatie-instrumenten in aanmerking kunnen komen voor goedkeuring door de Expertgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen, Kwint en Rog over de lerarenbeurs

MPs asked why the teacher grant (lerarenbeurs) budget was exhausted in 2020, how many applications were rejected, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The ministers answered that 2,416 initial applications were rejected after renewal applications were prioritised, and that budget cuts from parliamentary amendments reduced the budget from 78 to 49.6 million euros, communicated through several channels.
We could not inform you earlier because applications could be submitted until 30 June, and only afterwards was it clear how many renewal applications had been submitted.
Wij konden u niet eerder informeren omdat er tot en met 30 juni aanvragen ingediend konden worden en het pas daarna duidelijk was hoeveel herhaalaanvragen waren ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Rog over het onterecht innen van verplichte ouderbijdragen voor onderwijs aan hoogbegaafden

MPs Kwint and Rog asked whether schools illegally collected mandatory parental contributions for gifted-children education, how much was collected, whether parents were refunded and informed, and what sanctions apply. The minister answered that the school had stopped collecting, the inspectorate found no reason for specific investigation, refunds were made or reserved, letters were sent to schools, and sanctions are enforced by the inspectorate.
I will ask the board to bring this to the attention of all parents.
Ik zal het bestuur vragen dit onder de aandacht te brengen bij alle ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on criminal exploitation of Dutch pupils, including the number of awareness programmes run, schools' reluctance to be open about incidents, victim and perpetrator data, and monitoring of progress. The State Secretary answered that schools are being supported, that programme rollout is ongoing, that data-gathering with statistics bodies and the Rapporteur is being explored, and that the Chamber will be informed through progress letters.
Your House will be further informed in the progress letter of the programme Samen tegen mensenhandel about the outcomes of these discussions.
Uw Kamer wordt in de voortgangsbrief van het programma Samen tegen mensenhandel nader geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht over de sluiting van basisschool De Fontein te Lelystad

An MP asked the minister whether the planned closure of primary school De Fontein in Lelystad, due to failing the closure norm, should be postponed a year given the closure of the neighbouring school and the Covid-19 crisis, and whether the school could be funded for another year. The minister confirmed awareness of the local support for postponement but said the board has definitively decided to close the school on 1 August 2020, with the ministry, municipality and other boards now seeking placements for pupils, and refused to extend funding.
I have since learned from the board of De Fontein that they are definitively closing their school as of 1 August 2020.
Inmiddels heb ik van het bestuur van De Fontein vernomen dat zij hun school definitief sluiten per 1 augustus 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Van Meenen en Rog over het beoordelingskader voor LVS-instrumenten van de Expertgroep toetsen PO

MPs Bisschop, Van Meenen and Rog asked the minister why the Expert group on primary school tests applies its quality framework to observation instruments in early childhood (kleuters) and how that fits the legal basis and the pending bill removing mandatory normed tests. The minister answered that observation instruments tracking pupil growth must be approved by the Expert group, that the criteria are transparent, and that the Inspectorate will carry out an implementation check on the amendment before any change takes effect.
I therefore ask the Inspectorate to carry out an implementation check on the amendment, as is usual for regular legislative procedures.
Ik vraag de inspectie daarom een uitvoeringstoets uit te voeren op het amendement, zoals ook bij reguliere wetstrajecten gebruikelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het afleggen van examens in het buitenland

An MP from the CDA asked the education minister about the feasibility of foreign-based pupils taking Dutch state exams in the Netherlands during COVID-19 travel restrictions, and about the possibility of sitting exams at Dutch embassies. The minister answered that candidates abroad may request postponement, that the exam board will find solutions in exceptional cases, that Bonaire exams will be replaced by digital administration, and that embassy-based exams are not a general option.
Because the central written exam is cancelled this school year, the state exam consists only of the college exam.
Vanwege het vervallen van het centraal schriftelijk examen in dit schooljaar bestaat het staatsexamen alleen uit het college-examen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over de berichtgeving rondom het coronavirus COVID-19 via de sociale mediakanalen van de Rijksoverheid

MPs Van den Berg and Rog asked why ministry and inspectorate websites lacked school-specific COVID-19 guidance, whether schools were directly informed, and about contingency planning and school trip cancellations. The minister replied that information is centralised on rijksoverheid.nl with a school FAQ linked from the OCW and inspectorate sites, that a central contact point and daily dialogue with education sector bodies exist, and that schools closed until 6 April with contingency planning in place, while declining to provide figures on cancelled trips and referring travel refunds to schools and carriers.
No, I do not have those figures.
Nee, die cijfers heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht 'Dure zzp-er rukt op in scholen'

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that self-employed teachers (zzp-ers) are increasingly used in schools, including the rise in self-employed workers in education and the costs schools pay for flexible staff. The minister confirmed the rise in the CBS figures, said the scope of school-level data on flexible staff is limited, and pointed to a pilot to make such data mandatory for school boards.
From the available information I have almost no information about flexible non-employed staff (PNIL).
Uit de beschikbare informatie heb ik nagenoeg geen informatie over de PNIL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Rog en Bisschop over het bericht “Bijzonder onderwijs furieus over intieme vragen bij inspectiebezoek”

MPs Bruins, Rog and Bisschop asked the minister about inspectors allegedly asking intimate questions of pupils during unannounced visits to about eighty schools for a thematic study of teaching materials. The minister replied that the Inspectorate acts independently, that the study is thematic stelseltoezicht with a broad sample, that unannounced visits are a legitimate instrument, and that the Inspectorate denies that intimate or personal questions were asked, with no complaints received.
The Inspectorate does not recognise the picture painted in the article you cite.
De inspectie herkent het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het door u aangehaalde artikel niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Rog over de geplande opschaling van Respect Education Foundation

MPs Peters and Rog asked the government about the planned scaling-up of the Respect Education Foundation and what it had done on the earlier motion to support the RespectPact. The minister answered that the departments saw no financial room, that the foundation has not yet sent a proposal for immaterial support, and that the cabinet is willing to offer immaterial support once that proposal arrives.
The cabinet is willing to provide immaterial support for the REF's work, but is awaiting a proposal from the REF.
Het kabinet is bereid tot immateriële ondersteuning van het werk van het REF, maar is in afwachting van een voorstel van het REF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten van het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) voor het jaar 2020

An MP asked the minister for figures on the number of teachers and education staff receiving supplementary (bovenwettelijke) unemployment benefits in primary, secondary and vocational education, the total amounts spent, and the nature of these entitlements. The minister provided tables for 2017 and 2018 showing recipient counts and spending, and described the duration and calculation of WW and supplementary benefits set in collective agreements.
The WW benefit is, as in most sectors, fully topped up above the statutory level in the collective agreements of the education sectors shown.
De WW uitkering is, net als in de meeste sectoren, volledig bovenwettelijk gerepareerd in de cao's van de weergegeven onderwijssectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de voorgenomen verhuizing van SLO naar Amersfoort

An MP asked the minister whether SLO's planned move from Enschede to Amersfoort would cost jobs in Twente, why the minister would not urge SLO's board to reconsider, and whether replacement jobs would be pursued. The minister answered that the direct effect on regional jobs is nil, the indirect effect is minimal, that the board decides on its own housing, and that no replacement employment effort is needed.
I cannot and will not intervene in this.
Ik kan en wil hier niet op ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Slootweg over weeffout in de wet op financiering van het Passend Onderwijs

CDA MPs Rog and Slootweg asked about a funding flaw in the Passend Onderwijs law that leaves the Gelderse Vallei special-needs region bearing costs for pupils released from a secure youth institution, and what the government will do. Minister Slob answered that a residence-based funding issue is being addressed through transitional measures, with a letter to neighbouring regions and a policy review promised after summer.
I will send a letter to the surrounding cooperation associations asking for their cooperation given the specific situation in Deelen.
Ik zal een brief versturen aan de omliggende samenwerkingsverbanden waarin hen om medewerking wordt gevraagd gezien de specifieke situatie in Deelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Omtzigt, Bisschop en Stoffer over extra belastingdruk voor scholen die het lerarentekort proberen op te vangen middels een RTC

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether Dutch VAT rules penalise school boards that match teachers through regional transfer centres (RTCs) and whether the cooperation exemption applies. The government answered that matching is a different service from supplying staff, that the Tax Authority considers RTC matching outside the cooperation exemption, and that it will consult the PO-raad and RTC network on ways to avoid additional VAT burdens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over fors grotere voorziening groot onderhoud scholen

An MP asked whether the accounting rules for large maintenance provisions in schools are being interpreted more strictly, causing a large increase in required provisions, and what the minister would do to prevent negative effects. The minister confirmed the rule change from 2019, said the provision method is unchanged, and promised a study, a transition arrangement for 2018-2019, and communication with school boards.
In consultation with the accountants and the primary and secondary education sectors, it has been agreed that research will be carried out into the effects for school boards.
In overleg met de accountants en de sectoren primair en voortgezet onderwijs is afgesproken dat er een onderzoek wordt gedaan naar de effecten voor schoolbesturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Rog over het onderwijs in het Fries

MPs Van der Molen and Rog asked about the quality of Frisian-language education, the Inspectorate's thematic research, school exemptions and oversight powers. The minister replied that exemptions are provincially granted, earlier recommendations have been largely implemented, a new inspectorate study is planned, but transferring supervision to the province is not on the agenda.
Transferring supervision to the province of Fryslân is not on the table.
Overdracht van het toezicht aan de provincie Fryslân is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van der Molen over Confuciusinstituten in Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked whether Confucius Institutes in Dutch higher education, their secret contracts, influence on schools and Chinese-perspective teaching materials conflict with Dutch academic integrity and democratic values. The minister answered that institutions are autonomous, that the Leiden institute will not renew its agreement, that contracts are generally not confidential except where a partner has weighty reasons, and that schools and the inspectorate are responsible for teaching content.
The starting point is that agreements which the institutions conclude with third parties are not confidential.
Uitgangspunt is dat overeenkomsten die de betrokken instellingen sluiten met derden niet vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel 'Expertisecentrum SLO wil tóch weg uit Enschede'

An MP from the CDA asks whether the SLO curriculum institute's board is planning to move its headquarters out of Enschede, whether the works council has advised on it, and whether the minister will urge reconsideration as her predecessor did. The minister answers that SLO is a private-law body whose board decides on its own organisation and housing, that the formal works council advice is not yet complete, and that the minister will not intervene in the board's decision.
SLO is a private-law legal entity with statutory tasks. Its board therefore decides on its own organisation and internal affairs.
SLO is een privaatrechtelijke rechtspersoon met wettelijke taken. De bestuurder van SLO gaat daarom over haar eigen organisatie en huishouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Meenen en Rog over brieven waarin schoolleiders gewezen worden op de wettelijke verplichting om gegevens van leraren aan te leveren voor het Lerarenregister

MPs Bruins, Van Meenen and Rog asked whether letters pressing school leaders to supply teacher data for the teacher register, threatening inspection consequences, were unnecessary and whether the Inspectorate would enforce the obligation. The minister admitted the letter was incomplete and should not have been sent, promised corrective letters, and said he is discussing inspection oversight of professional development with the Inspectorate and will embed HRM policy in the law.
This letter should not have been sent in this form: the information it contains is incomplete.
Deze brief had niet in deze vorm verstuurd moeten worden: de informatie die er in staat is onvolledig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Rog over uitbreiding regeling Gratis VOG

Two CDA MPs asked why compulsory-VOG volunteers in schools, childcare and out-of-school care cannot use the free VOG scheme, and whether it could be extended to them. The minister answered that the scheme is only for organisations not already legally required to obtain a VOG, to stimulate voluntary integrity policy, and that no extension is planned, though communication will be intensified.
This is roughly in line with expectations.
Dit is bij benadering conform de verwachtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Rog over de maatschappelijke diensttijd en de status van het diplomasupplement na het vervullen hiervan

CDA MPs Slootweg and Rog asked the State Secretary for Health about the preference a diploma supplement might give youths who completed the civic service in government hiring, the use of certificates, and the involvement of education and defence in pilots. The State Secretary answered that the award form is still being designed, that diversity must be preserved, and that a certificate and a more compulsory variant will be explored in pilots.
I consider it too early at this time to indicate how this recognition can be given a good form by the government from an employer's perspective.
Ik vind het op dit moment te vroeg om aan te geven hoe deze waardering een goede invulling kan krijgen door de overheid vanuit het werkgeversperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Graaf Huyn College sluit bouwafdeling’

MP Rog (CDA) asked the minister whether the closure of the building trade department at Graaf Huyn College, due to declining pupil numbers, could be prevented, whether talks took place with the ministry, and what it means for regional provision. The minister answered that the school made a broad regional assessment, that a nearby school still offers building courses, that the EUR 100 million technical vmbo investment is tied to regional plans, and that closures remain necessary where pupil numbers fall.
Graaf Huyn College did not seek contact with the ministry about the planned closure and is not obliged to do so.
Het Graaf Huyn College heeft geen contact gezocht met het ministerie over de voorgenomen sluiting en is daartoe ook niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Termijn LVO voorzitter Postema na examdebacle met twee jaar verlengd’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether the supervisory board of Limburgs Voortgezet Onderwijs, while investigations into the school group and its chair Postema are ongoing, should extend his contract by two years, whether the minister was consulted, and whether she could use her instruction powers to reverse it. The minister answered that the board did not consult her, that she would have advised against the extension, that she has no insight into the chair's new salary, and that she will await Inspectorate reports before deciding on any binding instruction.
I am awaiting the reports of the Inspectorate of Education to see whether an instruction is appropriate.
Ik wacht de rapporten van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs af om te zien of een aanwijzing passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het niet publiceren van de namen van geslaagde leerlingen

An MP asks the minister whether the GDPR is being applied so strictly that schools can no longer publish the names of students who passed their final exams, and whether the Dutch data protection authority should refrain from fining such schools. The minister says the GDPR does not forbid publication but requires prior consent, that the regulator is independent so he will not intervene, and that the tradition can continue with consent.
It is therefore not appropriate for me to interfere with the supervision of the GDPR.
Het past mij daarom niet om me met het toezicht op de AVG te bemoeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Slootweg over een weeffout in de wet aangaande de financiering van het Passend Onderwijs (herdruk)

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister about a funding flaw in the special education financing law that makes the Gelderse Vallei partnership bear disproportionate costs for youths released from the Deelen closed youth institution. The minister answered that the problem stems only partly from the residence-principle, that the Variawet amendment only partly helps, that the Inspectorate is studying the issue, and that she is willing to explore improvements to the funding system.
I am willing to explore what options there are for refining and improving the funding system for education at a school attached to a residential institution.

Ik ben bereid te verkennen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om te komen tot een verfijning en verbetering van de systematiek van bekostiging van onderwijs op een school die verbonden is aan een residentiële instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Rog over de berichten 'Verus niet akkoord met nieuwe onderzoekskaders» en «Inspectie mag geen richting geven aan kwaliteit'

SGP and CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that Verus objected to new inspection frameworks and that the Inspectorate may not set quality direction, including concerns over mixing controlling and stimulating roles. The minister answered that consultation was held, Verus's concerns led to clarifications and removal of brackets, and the government intends to make the Inspectorate's power to correct funding for evident inefficient spending explicit in sector laws.
The brackets can indeed unintentionally cause confusion and have therefore been removed.
De haakjes kunnen inderdaad onbedoeld verwarring wekken en zijn daarom geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de klachten over het centraal eindexamen Frans

An MP asked the minister about complaints over the 2018 central exam in French for havo and vwo, including more texts than German, questions set in French, lack of teacher consultation and correction. The minister, relying on the CvTE, replied that the exam was carefully reviewed and corrected, that the CvTE is working to improve contact with teachers, and that the answers could not be given before the results were published.
The CvTE has promised to accept the texts on this forum as a means of contact with French teachers and to pass the posted texts on to the committee.
Het CvTE heeft beloofd de teksten op dit forum te accepteren als het middel van contact met docenten Frans
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Peters over het bericht 'Kindcentra krijgt ‘extra punten’ in Den Bosch'

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister whether a school admission point system in Den Bosch, which favoured children in certain childcare centres, unduly restricted parental school choice and the level playing field for childcare providers. The minister replied that the policy had already been revised after local debate, that schools may use admission criteria if applied consistently and transparently, and that he saw no reason to instruct school boards further.
I see no reason to do so, see the answers to questions 2, 3 and 4.
Hier zie ik geen aanleiding toe, zie het antwoord op vragen 2, 3 en 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Rog over basisscholen die dreigen te verdwijnen uit de Gelderse dorpen Spijk en Lathum

Two MPs asked the minister about primary schools in Spijk and Lathum falling below the municipal closure threshold, and whether the Verenigde Zelfstandige Dorpsscholen experiment could be extended to save them. The minister said the closure decisions rest with the school boards, found no reason to doubt their care, and declined extension because the experiment is for testing a teaching concept, not keeping schools open.
I have no reason to doubt the care taken in the decision-making.
Ik heb geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de zorgvuldigheid van de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het besluit van de Provincie Noord-Brabant om vanaf 2018 een half miljoen te bezuinigen op de philharmonie zuidnederland

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Noord-Brabant's decision to cut half a million euro from the Philharmonie zuidnederland from 2018, including whether the province contacted the minister on its own in April 2017 and how this fits with the Raad voor Cultuur's advice to coordinate policy. The minister says the shared funding responsibility makes the unilateral cut disappointing, confirms the April call concerned development of the orchestra and not a cut, and says she has invited all subsidy partners to a bestuurlijk overleg.
I therefore find it disappointing that one of the subsidy partners is implementing a cut at such short notice without administrative consultation with the other subsidy providers.
Ik vind het daarom teleurstellend dat één van de subsidiepartners zonder bestuurlijk overleg met de andere subsidiegevers op zo’n korte termijn een bezuiniging doorvoert.

Vragen van het lid Rog (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verkiezing van de afvaardiging deelnemersvergadering van de Onderwijscoöperatie (ingezonden 8 september 2017).

MP Rog (CDA) asks the state secretary about irregularities in the election of the 24-member delegate assembly of the Onderwijscoöperatie, including whether teachers without registration (such as course providers or those with a swimming certificate as proof of qualification) received voting codes. The secretary states that voting rights are correctly limited to those registered by 1 August 2017, that about 83,000 teachers are eligible, that no codes went to outsiders, and that OCW sees no direct role in the election.
I have no reason to doubt the process.
Ik heb geen reden om te twijfelen aan het proces.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Beckerman en Gijs van Dijk over werkbezoek aan de Reede van Texel waar historische scheepswrakken uit de 16e, 17e en 18e eeuw in de zeebodem dreigen te vergaan en over het congres ‘SO

MPs from CDA, SP and PvdA asked whether the government will act on the erosion of historic shipwrecks in Dutch coastal waters, including a programmatic approach requested by coastal provinces, a bigger role for volunteer divers, adjusted working-conditions rules for diving, and a national maritime archaeology museum. The minister acknowledged the erosion problem, said talks with the provinces aim for initial agreements by end 2017 and a proposal in spring 2018, committed to consulting amateur diving associations on an exemption, said the working-conditions rules will be examined with the Social Affairs minister, and argued that maritime heritage is already displayed across several museums.
We have agreed to reach initial agreements by the end of 2017.
We hebben afgesproken om voor het einde van 2017 tot eerste afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht Nederland moet ook Duitse diploma’s erkennen

Three CDA MPs asked the education minister about calls for mutual recognition of Dutch and German (NRW) diplomas, cross-border vocational programmes and Euregio schools. The minister said recognition in higher education is largely settled, that trust in vocational (mbo) diplomas is still lacking, that bilateral and Benelux talks continue, and that new cross-border mbo programmes would require legislative change only once internationalisation policy matures.
Our policy starting point is that mutual acceptance of diplomas in higher education is well arranged, through earlier EU and Benelux actions.
Ons beleidsuitgangspunt daarbij is dat de wederzijdse acceptatie van diploma's in het hoger onderwijs goed geregeld is, door eerdere acties van de EU en de Benelux.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van der Molen over taalgebruik op de lerarenopleidingen

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether teacher-training colleges tolerate poor Dutch-language skills among trainee teachers and whether schools in Rotterdam South have teachers without perfect Dutch. The minister answered that high language standards apply, that schools' boards are responsible for competent staff, and that she sees no reason to call colleges to account.
I have no reason to call the VH and the teacher-training colleges to account on this point.
Ik heb geen reden om de VH en de lerarenopleidingen op dit punt aan te spreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de stijging van de studieschuld

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that student debt has risen sharply since 2015, and about its link to social background, repayment rates and the state debt. The Minister says debt rose from 15.8 to 17.6 billion euro, that the 17.9 billion figure is an ISO estimate consistent with the ministry's budget, and promises updated monitor data in May.
I expect to be able to send you this report in May.
Ik verwacht u deze rapportage in mei te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Agnes Mulder over windenergie op zee en netwerken op zee

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether plans for an artificial North Sea island hub conflict with the planned offshore wind farms off the Dutch coast, and why wind farms are not sited further offshore. The minister replied that the island is a long-term idea beyond 2030, not an alternative to the 3,500 MW target for 2023, and that near-shore zones remain the cheapest to develop.
It is not an either-or, but a both-and.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht 'Sluiting dreigt voor snel groeiende school Het Dok'

An MP asked the education state secretary about a primary school at risk of closing because housing delays left it below the founding enrollment norm, and whether exceptions or extra transition time should apply. The answers say the school has options to continue (re-founding or a cooperation agreement) and that no general policy or discretionary exemption is needed, while the state secretary notes the lapse was largely outside the school's control.
The WPO contains no discretionary power and/or hardship clause for situations where a school does not meet the founding norm.
De WPO kent geen discretionaire bevoegdheid en/of hardheidsclausule voor situaties waarbij een school de stichtingsnorm niet haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that a junior UvA researcher on a jihad study had posted online statements praising jihadist fighters, and whether this warrants prosecution and a response from the university. The government condemned the statements, said the UvA disavowed them, declined to comment on individual prosecutions, and treated the methodological debate as a matter of academic freedom outside ministerial involvement.
As your House knows, the Minister of Security and Justice does not make statements about individual (criminal) cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet doet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie geen mededelingen over individuele (straf)zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘School lokt leerling met vliegreisje’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education whether public education funds should be spent on marketing such as a school's flight trip to attract pupils, and what role the ministry could play in sharing good practice like the Breda agreements. The State Secretary answered that schools may use funding for name recognition and pupil information, that the accountant and inspectorate supervise proportionality, and that the ministry is not the party to approve local initiatives but welcomes them and shared best-practice resources.
In cases where the spending of funding has no relation to education, the inspectorate acts as supervisor.
In gevallen waar bij de besteding van de bekostiging de relatie met het onderwijs niet aanwezig is, treedt de inspectie als toezichthouder op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht "Veel verborgen leed bij ex-AC-ers"

An MP asked the education minister about reports that gifted-education students from the closed Aloysius College in The Hague were left without adequate continuation, and whether the motion asking for quality to be preserved was honoured. The state secretary answered that about 90 percent of students got their first-choice school, that funding followed the students and an extra amount went to Zandvliet College, that the inspectorate raised no quality concerns, and that gifted education continues for grade 7 and 8 pupils.
As indicated earlier in this answer, there was no complete takeover of the gifted education department.
Zoals eerder in deze beantwoording aangegeven is er geen sprake geweest van een volledige overname van de afdeling «gifted education».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Rog en Van Helvert over de huisvesting van studenten in hotels

MPs from the CDA asked the minister whether The Student Hotel's rentals to students, often longer than six months, breach tenancy protection, whether the rents are acceptable, and whether such hotel rooms count toward student housing goals. The minister replied that the short-stay exception may apply, that tenants must go to the rent commission or court themselves, that the Rijk has no enforcement role, and that municipalities decide on hotel-based housing.
The central government has no enforcement role on this point.
Het Rijk heeft op dit punt geen handhavende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Rog over het bericht dat de TU Eindhoven religieuze studentenverenigingen weert

MPs Bruins and Rog asked the minister whether TU Eindhoven had excluded the religious student association Ichthus Eindhoven from a board grant on religious grounds, in conflict with equal-treatment law. The minister answered that the TU/e has reconsidered its initial plan, that Ichthus may apply for a grant assessed under the existing criteria, and that religious identity is not a ground for exclusion but also not a reason for support.
I am of the view that the criteria in the TU/e policy framework ensure equal treatment.
Ik ben van mening dat de criteria in het beleidskader van de TU/e een gelijke behandeling borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Amhaouch over het bericht dat TU Eindhoven zich nu ook genoodzaakt voelt om voor vier studies een numerus fixus in te stellen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about TU Eindhoven's plan to introduce numerus fixus for four programmes, and whether this, together with other technical programmes' caps, reflects funding problems and a shortage of technical graduates. The Minister said TU Eindhoven will only examine numerus fixus for 2018-2019, denied a tripling of caps, explained the funding model, rejected claims about per-student costs and falling budgets, and placed part of the responsibility for graduates' career choices on employers while agreeing to talks with universities and industry.
Question 11: Are you willing to hold talks with universities and representatives from the top sectors to seek a solution? Answer 11: Yes.
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om gesprekken aan te gaan met universiteiten en afgevaardigden vanuit de topsectoren om een oplossing te zoeken?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘FME: numerus fixus is omgekeerde wereld’

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister why technical universities are introducing a numerus fixus despite past extra funding and the Techniekpact goal of more technical students. The minister answered that quality comes first, that a temporary numerus fixus can be justified, that institutions are autonomous, and that she will keep talking with the technical universities.
This first of all fits with the autonomy of the institutions themselves to shape their own (financial) policy well.
Het past in de eerste plaats bij de autonomie van de instellingen zelf om hun eigen (financiële) beleid goed vorm te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Knops en Rog over de uitlatingen van de Turkse consul-generaal te Rotterdam over de Hizmet/Gülen-beweging en de invloed die Turkije uitoefent op burgers in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Knops and Rog asked the ministers about the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam's remarks on the Gülen movement, pressure on Turkish-Dutch citizens, threats and the effects of the post-coup crackdown in the Netherlands. The government condemned intimidation, said Turkish authorities must not interfere with Dutch citizens' choices, noted about 175 reports and ongoing investigations, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy and citing ongoing proceedings.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake Nijmegen wil eerste universitaire PABO starten

An MP asked the education minister about plans by Radboud University Nijmegen to launch a university teacher-training route for primary education, and whether the government supports it. The minister answered that she welcomes it as a complement to existing routes, that the programme is targeted for September 2017 subject to national approval tests, and that it aligns with the 2014-2020 sector agreement's goal of more academically trained teachers.
I am positive about the development of the university teacher-training programme.
Ik sta positief tegenover de ontwikkeling van de universitaire pabo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk en Rog over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in de financiële steun aan studenten met een beperking

MPs Bruins, Van Dijk and Rog asked the Minister of Education about reports of large differences in support for students with disabilities, including poor information provision and differences in municipal individual study allowances. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to information duties and a forthcoming letter to parliament, and said that municipal allowance differences reflect local policy freedom while deferring the allowance question to the state secretary of Social Affairs.
This autumn I will send a letter to the House in response to the motion by member Van Meenen et al.
Dit najaar stuur ik een brief aan de Kamer in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Rog over het bericht dat de Technische Universiteit (TU) Eindhoven religieuze studentenverenigingen weert

MPs Bruins and Rog asked whether TU Eindhoven withdrew support from the Christian student association Ichthus and whether this breaches equal treatment law. The minister replied that support criteria are based on a policy note with no religious criterion, that the university reconsidered after talks, and that equal treatment questions should go to the College voor de rechten van de mens.
It is for the TU Eindhoven to shape the policy for supporting student associations.
Het is aan de TUe om vorm te geven aan het beleid voor ondersteuning van studentenverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht “Ondanks onderhandelaarsakkoord cao PO blijft WWZ ongelijkheid”

An MP asks why the WWZ labour law reforms apply to private (bijzonder) primary schools but not public (openbaar) ones, and whether this conflicts with financial equality under the Constitution. The Secretary of State answers that the difference stems from the civil-law versus civil-service employment regimes, that the cao evaluation is planned for spring 2017, that she will not intervene in collective bargaining, and that a pending bill on normalising civil servants' legal status could resolve the gap.
I respect the freedom of negotiation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Rog over de het bericht dat Amsterdamse studenten te veel huur betalen

MPs Ronnes and Rog asked the minister whether it is true that 88 percent of Amsterdam students pay rent above the statutory point system limit, and what action will be taken. The minister answered that the figure refers to 265 students who checked their rent online, not all Amsterdam students, that tenants can appeal to the rent commission, and that affordability is on the Landelijk Platform Studentenhuisvesting agenda.
Contrary to what the headline of this report suggests, my conclusion is not that nearly 88 percent of Amsterdam students pay more rent than the statutory point system allows.

Anders dan de kop van dit bericht weergeeft is mijn conclusie niet dat bijna 88 procent van de Amsterdamse studenten een hogere huur betaalt dan volgens het wettelijk puntensysteem voor huurprijzen is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Rog over het ontzeggen van een tolkvoorziening aan een dove student aan een Hogeschool

MPs Heerma and Rog asked why a deaf unemployed student at Fontys was denied a Dutch Sign Language interpreter for having reached age 30, and whether the WOOS age limit should be dropped in line with the new student loan system. The government defends the age-30 limit as a shift of individual responsibility, points to UWV and municipal routes for interpreter funding, and promises a policy response with OCW and VWS by summer.
From age 30 there is a question of individual responsibility.
Vanaf 30 jaar is er sprake van een individuele verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Rog, Beertema en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'Leidse Greentower is in 2018 klaar

MPs asked the minister whether ROC Leiden's contribution to a bicycle parking garage near the Leiden square was capped, how it relates to earlier agreements on the square, and why the Chamber had not yet been informed. The minister answered that a 2014 agreement caps ROC Leiden's share at EUR 788,000 excluding VAT, with the municipality covering any excess, but that negotiations on the final amount are still ongoing and the Chamber will be informed once clarity exists.
At this moment the negotiations are still ongoing. As soon as I have clarity on this, I will inform you about it.
Op dit moment lopen de onderhandelingen nog. Zodra ik hier duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake het bericht 'Brandbrief met brede steun voor 't Klaverblad'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the discretionary power to keep small primary schools open could be used for OBS 't Klaverblad, a satellite branch whose pupil numbers are growing, and why the power does not apply to satellite branches. The state secretary answered that the discretionary power covers only independent schools, that satellite branches already have a three-year window under existing law, and that funding for the branch will end from 2016–2017 with pupils having to transfer.
A discretionary power does not exist for satellite branches.
Een discretionaire bevoegdheid bestaat niet voor nevenvestigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Rog over studenten in verzet tegen NS

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares unions' view that NS blames overcrowded trains on education and whether students are being consulted about off-peak travel plans. The government rejects the blame framing, says NS is responsible for capacity, that no negotiations exist but exploratory talks are ongoing, and that students will be involved in follow-up talks.
NS cannot and will not unilaterally refuse students in the peak hours.
NS kan niet en zal niet eenzijdig studenten weigeren in de spits.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Rog en Van Meenen inzake de sluiting van het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Siderius, Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about closing the boarding school for deaf pupils in Haren, arguing it would destroy capital and expertise and that clustered classes are not a realistic alternative. The state secretary replied that alternatives in regular education are being explored with the VO-raad and Siméa, that boarding costs were never structurally funded and will be phased out for new pupils from August 2017, and that the Guyotschool need not close.
The boarding school is not needed if appropriate education can be offered nearby for these pupils within regular or special secondary education.
Het internaat is niet nodig, als er thuisnabij ook voor deze leerlingen binnen het regulier of binnen het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs passend onderwijs kan worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over het artikel 'Groepsaansprakelijkheid bij onrechtmatige daad: Het blijft een bijzonder leerstuk'

MPs Duisenberg and Rog asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether damages from the Maagdenhuis and Bungehuis occupations can be recovered from the occupiers, citing an insurance trade article. The Minister answered that recovery is impractical because perpetrators cannot be identified without investigating innocent students and staff, that the UvA and insurer concluded recovery is unlikely, and that the insurer paid out in full, so no concrete further action is planned.
I do not have this information. Nor is it for me to disclose confidential business information of the insurer.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Het is ook niet aan mij om vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens van de verzekeraar openbaar te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over coffeeshops die in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

MPs Oskam and Rog asked the Minister of Justice and Security about coffeeshops resisting nearby schools, including the 250-metre distance agreement with the VNG, enforcement in Amsterdam, and whether the distance criterion should be written into the Aanwijzing Opiumwet. The minister replied that the distance rule is a local choice under local tailoring, that 84.5% of coffeeshop municipalities have a distance criterion (55% at 250 m or less), that Amsterdam's approach is a local matter, and that he sees no need to change the current policy.
Reducing the visibility of coffeeshops to pupils is local tailoring.
Het verkleinen van de zichtbaarheid van coffeeshops voor scholieren is lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het bericht dat coffeeshops in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

Two MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers about coffeeshops opposing nearby schools, including Amsterdam's refusal of a school location due to a nearby coffeeshop and whether closures or hour limits should follow. The minister answered that distance criteria and school housing are local matters, no overlap with him occurred, and gave no commitment to new action.
Because the location of coffeeshops near schools are local matters, no consultation has taken place with me about the cases mentioned.
Omdat de vestiging van coffeeshops in de buurt van scholen lokale aangelegenheden zijn, heeft er geen overleg met mij plaatsgevonden over genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake het bericht 'Stafmedewerker Haagse Hogeschool krijgt 4 ton mee'

An MP asked the Education Minister about reports that a staff member of The Hague University of Applied Sciences received a severance payment of 4 million euros. The minister said the inspectorate found no basis for enforcement under the WNT pay cap because the person was not a top official, though the payment conflicts with the spirit of the law, and the cabinet plans to extend the WNT to all employees.
From this information the inspectorate regrettably had to conclude that there is no reason for enforcement under the WNT, because this is not a top official within the meaning of the WNT.
Uit deze informatie heeft de inspectie helaas moeten concluderen dat er geen reden is voor handhaving op grond van de WNT, want het gaat niet om een topfunctionaris in de zin van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake het artikel Moslimrector opnieuw onder vuur, nu om haattweets

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether the Raad van Toezicht of the Islamic University of Rotterdam refuses to distance itself from the rector's statements and tweets, and about the board's role and the rector's voting advice to Turks in the Netherlands. The Minister answered that the board has not publicly disavowed the statements, that she finds the board's response inadequate, that the rector's voting advice is inappropriate, and that she has repeatedly urged the board to take measures.
The inspectorate and I have repeatedly urged the Raad van Toezicht to show that the IUR does subscribe to the principles of the Dutch rule of law by distancing itself from the rector's statements.

Ik en ook de inspectie hebben er bij de Raad van Toezicht meerdere malen op aangedrongen te laten zien dat de IUR de principes van de Nederlandse rechtsstaat wel degelijk onderschrijft door afstand te nemen van de uitspraken van de rector
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de artikelen 'Rijk in de fout met licentie voor Wijnbergschool' en 'Patstelling op De Berg'

An MP asked the state secretary why a special-education licence was granted to De Wijnberg in 2012 on apparently incomplete grounds, and how it led to the closure of a partner school's location and dispute over pupils. The state secretary answered that the application contained a capacity forecast, that DUO's 2014 review found the licence was not wrongly granted, and that the responsibility for providing capacity figures lay with the applicant school.
I am aware that school de Velddijk (Onderwijsgroep Buitengewoon) closed its location on the grounds of the Mutsaersstichting.
Het is mij bekend dat school de Velddijk (Onderwijsgroep Buitengewoon) de locatie op het terrein van de Mutsaersstichting heeft gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over de oproep om de slopers van het maagdenhuis aan te pakken

MPs Duisenberg and Rog asked the Minister of Education whether the damage from the Maagdenhuis occupation should be recovered from the vandals, including via group liability, and why the costs and deductible were handled as they were. The minister answered that the motion was considered executed, that group liability and tracing the perpetrators were judged unlikely to succeed and burdensome, and that she would not disclose the insurance contract details.
It is not for me to make confidential business information about the insurance agreement between the UvA and the insurer public.
Het is niet aan mij om vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens over de tussen de UvA en de verzekeraar afgesloten verzekeringsovereenkomst openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake de verhuizing van SLO van Enschede naar Utrecht

MPs Rog and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why SLO is moving its seat from Enschede to Utrecht, citing regional employment dispersal policy and a board letter claiming the ministry strongly favoured Utrecht. The minister answered that the move is SLO's own strategic decision, denied having expressed a preference for Utrecht beyond noting its logic, declined to intervene or write to SLO, and said no statutory-change approval basis exists to refuse.
I have not expressed a preference for Utrecht because, as previously answered on this subject, I am not responsible for it.
Ik heb geen voorkeur voor Utrecht uitgesproken omdat zoals eerder geantwoord over dit onderwerp, ik daar niet over ga.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake de berichten 'Rijk in de fout met licentie voor Wijnbergschool' en 'Patstelling op De Berg'

An MP from the CDA asked the Education Minister why a VSO (secondary special education) licence was granted to De Wijnberg despite an existing nearby school, and whether this created harmful competition and financial strain in North Limburg. The State Secretary answered that the WEC law obliges granting such expansions when capacity need is shown, that the regional situation is being addressed by a national project leader, and that the government will not cover the financial shortfall.
The WEC, however, offers no room to refuse on policy grounds.
De WEC biedt echter geen ruimte om op beleidsmatige gronden af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de berichten “Top Universiteit Utrecht knoeit met dienstauto” en ”Overtreedt Universiteit Utrecht de Balkenendenorm”?

An MP asked the minister whether Utrecht University's board chair received a company car with chauffeur used for private purposes and salary above the WNT pay cap, and about tax treatment and oversight. The minister answered that the 2014 WNT overshoot was recovered and repaid, a taxable benefit was settled for one member, and the inspectorate has been asked to investigate declaration behaviour in higher education.
In addition, I have meanwhile asked the inspectorate to conduct an investigation into the declaration behaviour of board members in higher education.
Daarnaast heb ik de inspectie inmiddels gevraagd om een onderzoek naar het declaratiegedrag van de bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de verhuizing van de Stichting Leerplanontwikkeling (SLO)

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education whether the government still pursues dispersal of government-funded jobs, whether SLO's move from Enschede to Utrecht is wise, and whether OCW has effectively endorsed the move and the use of SLO's equity built from subsidies. The minister answers that the move is a board decision with no legal grounds for OCW to refuse, that the reserves are lawfully built, and that the advisory request is an internal document not shared with parliament.
It is not a public document and I therefore cannot share it with the House.
Het is geen openbaar stuk en ik kan het dus niet met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht "Studenten lenen graag, alleen niet voor de studie"

Member Rog (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about a report that many students borrow from DUO to offset the loss of the basic grant, partly to save for later, and whether incentives in the loan system encourage excessive borrowing, its effect on the loan repayment rate and the budget, and whether conditions will be changed. The Minister acknowledged that students may borrow about two-thirds of the lost grant, argued that borrowing beyond need is not very advantageous, said leiding behaviour will be monitored and that action will be taken if signals warrant it, but declined to commit to changing loan conditions.
Should the government receive other signals, it will act according to the circumstances of the case.
Mocht de regering andere signalen krijgen, dan zal ze naar bevind van zaken handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog inzake het bericht 'Verplicht archeologisch onderzoek'

CDA MPs asked whether a fire victim in Alkmaar must pay about 60,000 euro for mandatory archaeological excavation before rebuilding, and whether the 'polluter pays' principle can be applied to victims. The minister confirmed the amounts (halved by the municipality from 120,000), explained that municipalities set conditions via the environmental permit, and said the RCE will report on insurers' practice by 31 December 2015.
I have asked the Cultural Heritage Agency to carry out an exploration of insurers' conduct in these cases and report to me by 31 December 2015.
Aan de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed heb ik gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de handelwijze van verzekeraars in deze gevallen en mij hier voor 31 december 2015 over te rapporteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Jasper van Dijk, Rog en Bisschop inzake de berekeningen van de VSNU dat het studievoorschot bij lange na geen 1 miljard euro oplevert en de komende tien jaar zelfs nauwelijks ext

MPs Schouten, Van Dijk, Rog and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education about VSNU calculations showing the student tuition-investment package yields far less than 1 billion euro and barely adds investment over ten years. The minister replied that up to 1 billion euro becomes available by 2026, that institutions will pre-invest 200 million euro yearly in 2015-2017, and that the investment will vary by institution, with details reported only at sector level.
I expect institutions to make the allocation of their pre-investments transparent and to discuss them well internally.
Ik verwacht van de instellingen dat zij de bestemming van de voorinvesteringen inzichtelijk maken en intern goed bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de voorgenomen verhuizing van de SLO naar Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Education and Economic Affairs ministers whether SLO's planned move of 120 staff from Enschede to Utrecht is acceptable, given its state funding and the Chamber's past preference for spreading government-funded jobs, and whether the minister would talk with SLO about staying in Enschede. The minister answered that the move has negligible regional employment effects, that SLO is a private-law body whose location decision requires only formal ministerial consent that the minister sees no grounds to withhold, and that she sees no reason to intervene.
A possible conversation with SLO about its location could arise within the subsidy relationship between OCW and SLO.
Een eventueel gesprek met SLO over haar vestigingsplaats zou aan de orde kunnen zijn in het kader van de subsidierelatie tussen OCW en SLO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel ‘Einde dreigt voor winkelcentrum bij school’

An MP asked whether the Tobacco Act should allow a vocational school's shopping centre to sell tobacco as part of student training, after fines and a sales ban. The state secretary answered that the shopping centre counts as part of the school under the Act, so tobacco sales are prohibited, and that no legal change is planned because the school can train students in retail without selling tobacco.
I see no need to amend the laws and regulations so that students at De Rooi Pannen can sell tobacco in this shopping centre as part of their training.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om de wet- en regelgeving zodanig aan te passen dat studenten op De Rooi Pannen in het kader van hun opleiding tabak kunnen verkopen in dit winkelcentrum

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over zijn voorgenomen besluit gebruik te maken van zijn aanwijzingsbevoegdheid om het bestuur van de Stichting Scholengemeenschap Bonaire tot aftreden te dwingen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether funds meant for education at the Stichting Scholengemeenschap Bonaire were spent on non-education items and whether the Inspectorate had found signals of this. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate found no concrete indications of unlawful spending, that the accountant will still review lawfulness, and that he would recover any unlawfully spent euro if it later emerged.
There are currently no concrete indications of unlawful spending. Should this later prove to be the case, it is my policy to recover every unlawfully spent euro from the board concerned.

Er zijn op dit moment geen concrete aanwijzingen dat sprake is van onrechtmatige bestedingen. Mocht dit later blijken, dan is het mijn beleid om iedere onrechtmatig bestede euro terug te vorderen van het bestuur in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel “Armeense genocide-ontkenner Justin McCarthy geeft lezing aan VU”

MP Rog (CDA) asked the Education Minister whether a university student association's invitation to genocide denier Justin McCarthy for a lecture on the Armenian genocide centenary was acceptable, and whether Turkish state funding was involved. The minister answered that the VU withdrew the room because the event was a one-sided lecture rather than a debate, that the organiser was responsible, that no proof of Turkish state funding was found, and that she saw no reason to intervene.
I consider this a matter for the university and the student association themselves.
Ik acht dit een zaak van de universiteit en de studentenvereniging zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over de bezorging van de centrale examens vo in mei 2015

Two MPs asked whether the Ministry's notice telling schools that closure on the exam-delivery day counts as not wishing to administer central exams was fair, and whether schools could receive redelivery. The State Secretary agreed with the substance to avoid theft risk, admitted the wording could have been clearer, but refused to guarantee redelivery except in cases of force majeure.
I regret that the notice on www.examenblad.nl led to irritation.
Ik betreur het dat de melding op www.examenblad.nl heeft geleid tot irritaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het ondersteunen van Jiddisch

An MP asked whether the Cheider Jewish school in Amsterdam receives state, provincial or municipal funding for teaching Yiddish, and whether the government meets its obligations under the European Charter for regional and minority languages. The state secretary answered that Cheider gets no specific funding for Yiddish but receives extra funding as an exception school, that the Charter imposes no financial obligations, and that only Frisian receives dedicated national support.
I have no insight into the spending of the province and the municipality.
Op de uitgaven van de provincie en de gemeente heb ik geen zicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de brief van het College voor Toetsen en Examens over de centrale eindtoets

An MP asks whether a November letter from the College voor Toetsen en Examens to school directors, carrying the government logo, wrongly suggests only the central end-of-primary test is allowed, and whether alternative test providers can get equal communication. The State Secretary denies any misleading impression, explains that the ministry informs schools about all permitted tests and subsidises alternative providers to communicate with schools.
The letter clearly stated that, besides the central end-of-primary test, other permitted end-of-primary tests may also be chosen.
In de brief is duidelijk aangegeven dat naast de centrale eindtoets, ook kan worden gekozen voor andere toegelaten eindtoetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rog over het bericht ‘UvA wil geesteswetenschappen radicaal omgooien’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that the University of Amsterdam plans a radical restructuring of its humanities, including the disappearance of several small language programmes, and about the link with new investments under the student loan system. The Minister answered that the faculty's plans are still under discussion, that small programmes should be weighed by the universities themselves, and that the cuts stem from falling student numbers rather than from the study-finance investments.
I therefore have no insight into how the sector agreement in higher education relates to the cut at the UvA Faculty of Humanities
Ik heb daarom geen inzicht hoe de sector afspraak in het wo zich verhoudt tot de bezuiniging bij de Faculteit der Geesteswetenschappen van de UvA
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Scholen spelen privégegevens leerlingen door naar uitgevers”

MPs Rog, Voordewind and Van Dijk asked whether schools pass non-anonymised pupil data to publishers without parental consent, and why a 2014 privacy audit was not sent to parliament. The state secretary answered that consent is not required under the school's task-based legal ground, that pseudonymisation is being developed, and that the audit was withheld as a limited, policy-confirming exploration later published online.
The report was therefore not sent to your House.
Het rapport is daarom niet aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over het bericht dat een docente de Tweede Kamer niet op de hoogte mocht stellen van fouten in rekentoetsen van het Cito

MPs Van Meenen and Rog asked whether teachers may be prevented from reporting alleged errors in Cito arithmetic tests to parliament, and whether the Wob refusal to disclose test items is justified. The Secretary of State answered that teachers may discuss errors but must not publish items online to protect reuse, that complaints go to the Examenloket, and that disclosure would harm the CvTE's statutory tasks; a fuller policy letter on access rights is promised for December.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Wetenschapsselectie van de NWO is ontmoedigende farce’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that NWO's research selection is a discouraging farce, including staffing and overhead, a liquidity problem leading to a change in payment schedules to universities, and the value of NWO. The State Secretary answered that the 470 FTE involved in selection is not overhead of 2700 FTE, that overhead is about 6.7% of spending, and that the payment rhythm change does not reduce funding or the number of grants.
The planned volume of grant allocations to researchers (and through them to universities) remains the same.
Het voorziene volume aan subsidietoekenningen aan de onderzoekers (en via hen aan de universiteiten) blijft gelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake naheffingen bij scholengemeenschappen

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked about Tax Authority back-tax assessments on school communities for lunch-supervision volunteer allowances, including whether they reach back five years and whether they fit the participation policy. The state secretary defended the volunteer exemption rules, said the Tax Authority can correct up to five years and may impose fines, and declined to intervene or ask for reduced penalties.
I cannot make further statements about individual cases in the context of these questions.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik in het kader van deze vragen geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Internationaal verdrag botst met leenstelsel’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether the government is breaching the UN International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights by making higher education more expensive rather than progressively free, and whether it will refrain from giving effect to the covenant or seek advice on it before abolishing the basic grant. The minister denied any breach while access is guaranteed, said the covenant has been in force for decades and is not up for debate, and justified the abolition of the basic grant as enabling a quality boost.
I see no reason, nor do I have any need, to call into question the operation of this covenant, which has been in force for many decades.
Ik zie geen enkele aanleiding noch heb ik enige behoefte de werking van dit verdrag dat reeds vele decennia in werking is ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht «Luchtkwaliteit scholen onvoldoende» van BNR Nieuwsradio

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a BNR report that school air quality is insufficient, including whether investments improved it, whether measurements are needed, and whether all primary schools have received a free CO2 meter. The state secretary answered that funds were largely spent, that schools bear responsibility for indoor climate with a stimulating role for government, that additional measurements are not necessary, and that CO2 meters have been or will be delivered to all schools that requested one.
It is expected that the meters will be delivered at the start of the new heating season (September–October).
Naar verwachting zullen bij de aanvang van het nieuwe stookseizoen (september–oktober) de meters worden uitgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de verkoop van knowhow door Cito BV welke deels is ontwikkeld binnen de Stichting Cito

An MP asked the State Secretary whether software and knowhow for the digital exam tool Facet, partly funded by taxpayers, is being commercially sold by Cito BV and Trifork. The State Secretary answered that Facet was built under open source licence with the College voor Examens as co-owner, that a Swiss partnership involves Cito-funded software, and that Stichting Cito did not develop the sold products.
The CvE is co-owner and can carry out further development of Facet without problems.
Het CvE is mede-eigenaar en kan de doorontwikkeling van Facet zonder problemen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het opheffen van ICIN (Netherlands Heart Institute) door de Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen (KNAW)

An MP asks how cardiovascular research would continue after ICIN is dissolved by the KNAW, and whether the dissolution followed due process (Awb consultation, works council advice, financial analysis, a transitional arrangement). The minister says research continues within the UMCs with some added coordination burden, deems long-term damage limited, and declines substantive answers on procedure and legality because the matter is before the courts.
Because the matter is before the court, we are very reticent in answering these questions.
Omdat de zaak onder de rechter is zijn wij zeer terughoudend in de beantwoording van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het ICIN

An MP asked the minister whether the KNAW's decision to close the ICIN Netherlands Heart Institute, as a way to meet a budget cut, was consistent with the ministry's earlier letter and whether the ministry would intervene by suspending the decision or funding a bridge amount. The minister answered that the KNAW is an autonomous body free to allocate its funds, that no suspension is warranted, and that the cardiology research continues in the academic hospitals.
The KNAW is however an autonomous organisation and the KNAW is in principle free to allocate the funds it receives from OCW, other than the specific subsidies, as it sees fit.
De KNAW is echter een autonome organisatie en het staat de KNAW in principe vrij de middelen die zij van OCW ontvangt, anders dan de specifieke subsidies, naar eigen inzicht te alloceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel ‘Cao in Onderwijs niet rechtsgeldig’

An MP asked whether the education sector collective labour agreements (cao) are legally valid, given doubts about the employer and union bodies signing them. The state secretary answered that education cao terms do flow into individual contracts via declaration, that the VO-raad acts within its statutory mandate, and that the Wet op de loonvorming may be revisited.

I will consult with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment to see whether the decentralisation of collective pay setting in education and developments in labour law give cause to adapt the Wage Formation Act to these developments.

Ik zal in overleg met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid bezien of de decentralisatie van de arbeidsvoorwaardenvorming die in het onderwijs heeft plaatsgevonden en de ontwikkelingen in het arbeidsrecht, aanleiding geven om de Wet op de loonvorming aan deze ontwikkelingen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Rog over het nakomen van afspraken over compensatiemaatregelen inzake de gasopslag Bergermeer

CDA MPs Mulder and Rog asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of compensation commitments tied to the Bergermeer gas storage, including a Alkmaar energy conference, the A9 Heiloo exit, a development company with a TAQA staff member, and TAQA's headquarters move. The minister answered that most commitments are progressing (energy region, conference planned for September 2014, Pallas project, A9 exit under discussion), that the convenants are between TAQA and municipalities rather than the ministry, and that TAQA is expected to keep its headquarters commitment.
As shown in my answers to questions 2 and 4, I am of the view that good progress is being made in realising the agreed commitments.
Zoals blijkt uit mijn antwoorden op de vragen 2 en 4 ben ik van mening dat goede voortgang wordt gemaakt met het realiseren van de gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de cao voor bestuurders in het voortgezet onderwijs

Rog (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Education why a separate collective agreement for secondary-education board members was created, whether their pay rises despite the zero-wage line for teachers, and whether supervisors can raise pay or exceed the topincome norm. The State Secretary answered that the agreement was requested to regulate executive pay, that salaries stay unchanged with a zero-indexation line, and that supervisors cannot raise pay above the sectoral ceiling of 184,549 euros.
The request from a former OCW minister to regulate the remuneration of board members.
Het verzoek van voormalige bewindspersoon van OCW om de beloningen van bestuurders te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht “French parliament says free software is a priority in education”

MP Rog (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether open source software is used exclusively in education in Spain, Portugal and Iceland, whether lessons can be drawn for the Netherlands from France, and how open standards and platform-independence rules are complied with. The minister replied that open source is used but not exclusively, that schools are primarily responsible for procurement given freedom of education, that open-standards 'comply-or-explain' rules could be applied better, and that she will talk with stakeholders and may consult other ministers if accessibility does not improve.
I will engage in discussions with various parties over the coming months to examine whether and what opportunities the use of open source offers in this changing context.
Ik zal de komende maanden met verschillende partijen het gesprek aangaan om te kijken of en welke kansen de inzet van open source biedt in deze veranderende context.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht dat scholen niet klaar zijn voor passend onderwijs

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education whether schools and samenwerkingsverbanden are ready for inclusive 'passend onderwijs', citing a Nieuwsuur report and an ECPO call, and how parents and children will be protected from falling between the cracks.
