The State Secretary acknowledged that many teachers and parents do not yet know what to expect, pointed to the responsibility of the samenwerkingsverbanden, and announced an extra implementation impulse together with education organisations, with more detail in a letter on the third progress report.
I am giving an extra impulse to the passend onderwijs implementation programme in cooperation with the education organisations.
Ik geef een extra impuls aan het invoeringsprogramma passend onderwijs in samenwerking met de onderwijsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Meenen over de Amsterdamse inspectie

MPs Rog and Van Meenen asked whether Amsterdam's municipal Kwaliteitsbureau, which inspects school quality alongside the national inspectorate, is an unwelcome extra layer and a limit on school freedom. The Secretary of State replied that participation is voluntary, the bureau is independent, the inspectorate's judgement remains decisive, and the bureau costs about EUR 600,000 a year, to be evaluated after four years.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Hijum over de Oranjeschool in Zalk

MPs Rog and Van Hijum asked whether the Oranjeschool in Zalk faces closure because Kampen did not split its municipal territory for the closing-norm, whether the 5 km rule and discretionary powers can help, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that the municipality decided in 2001 not to split, retroactive splitting is not permitted, the 5 km exception cannot be waived, the discretionary power does not apply, and the school board should explore cooperation or merger options.
The Primary Education Act does not provide the possibility to permit a split with retroactive effect.
De Wet op het primair onderwijs biedt niet de mogelijkheid om met terugwerkende kracht een splitsing toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake de berichten over de afbakening van publieke taken bij Stichting CITO in relatie tot de marktactiviteiten bij CITO BV

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that CITO's public foundation could cover losses of its commercial subsidiary CITO BV, and about the separation of public and commercial tasks and intellectual property. The state secretary denied that private losses can be shifted onto public tasks, sent an audit report and new governance agreements strengthening the separation, and said IP rights over statutory tasks will pass to the minister.
Stichting CITO makes products and research results produced with public funds available to CITO BV under the same conditions as to other test providers.
Stichting CITO met publieke middelen vervaardigde producten en onderzoeksresultaten onder dezelfde voorwaarden aan CITO BV ter beschikking als aan andere toetsaanbieders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht “DUO niet goed beveiligd”

An MP asked the Minister of Education about Auditdienst Rijk findings that DUO's information security plan was incomplete and that DUO faces ongoing risks, including the lack of a business continuity plan and weak tactical security management. The minister replied that security management is operational, that the audit advice is being followed through a task force, and that the audit body will assess progress in its 2013 report.
The ADR advice concerns improving tactical security management and drawing up a business continuity plan (BCP).
Het ADR-advies betreft de verbetering van het tactisch securitymanagement en het opstellen van een bedrijfscontinuïteitsplan (BCP).
Antwoord vragen Rog inzake het artikel 'OCW schendt Techniekpact'

An MP asked the education minister whether budget cuts to subsidies undermine the Techniekpact, including Centres of Expertise and innovation centres, and why these were cut. The minister denied that the Techniekpact is violated, said technology priorities were spared, and pointed to her earlier letter on the subsidy cuts.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Gemeenten houden geld voor onderwijsachterstanden in portemonnee’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether municipalities leave funds for educational disadvantage unspent, and why around €40 million is recovered to the state treasury instead of being reinvested in education. The state secretary answered that the funds may only be used for school classes and pre-school education, that €37.5 million was reclaimed from 155 municipalities for 2006–2010, that municipalities cited start-up problems and strict criteria, and that under budget rules the recovered sums flow back to the treasury and cannot be reallocated in 2013.
Municipalities that did not spend the funds on educational disadvantage have since been subject to a recovery of the money.
Bij gemeenten die de middelen niet hebben besteed aan onderwijsachterstanden heeft inmiddels een terugvordering plaats gevonden.
Antwoord vragen leden Rog en Van Meenen over het belang van Nederlandse taal- en cultuurscholen in het buitenland

MPs Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about the closure of state subsidy for Dutch language and culture schools abroad, and whether this threatens access and creates later language gaps for returning children. The state secretary replied that parents and employers should bear the cost, that the subsidy cut will be absorbed by school boards and parents, and that he will talk to employers and consider a role for the Inspectorate.
The cabinet chose, in filling the spending target, to spare education at schools as much as possible.
Het kabinet heeft er bij de invulling van de taakstelling voor gekozen het onderwijs op scholen zoveel mogelijk te ontzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over de radio-uitzending ‘Trauma’s in de schoolbank’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Education about a radio report on traumatised asylum-seeker children in AZC schools, asking whether they need extra support, smaller classes, structural funding for therapists and social workers, and cluster 4 special-needs funding. The state secretary said extra costs are being inventoried with a possible financial solution to be implemented from the new school year, pointed to existing weighting and special funding that schools can use, and rejected cluster 4 funding because these are regular primary schools.
An inventory is currently being made of the costs that the pupil population of an AZC school linked to a family reception location entails.
Er wordt momenteel geïnventariseerd welke kosten de leerlingpopulatie van een AZC-school die is verbonden aan een Gezinsopvang locatie met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Geurts over de inhoud van het examen Nederlands voor havo

MPs Rog and Geurts asked why an opinion piece by professor Roos Vonk, reprimanded for improper conduct and linked to fabricated research, was used in the havo Dutch exam, and whether a note or the College voor Examens should have been consulted. The state secretary replied that the text was chosen for reading and argumentation skills, that it is an opinion piece without cited research, that no source note is required for opinion texts, and that he sees no need to discuss the choice with the College voor Examens.
The piece contains the personal opinion of Ms Vonk on a publicly known theme, but no references to research by Ms Vonk or Mr Stapel.

Het Centraal Eindexamen Nederlands ... Het stuk bevat de persoonlijke mening van mevrouw Vonk op een maatschappelijk bekend thema, maar geen verwijzingen naar onderzoek van mevrouw Vonk of de heer Stapel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Geurts over het bericht “Signaal onderwijsminister onjuist”

MPs Rog and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether her figures on unemployment among graduates of the animal care vocational programme were accurate, and whether her portrayal misrepresented career prospects after the course. The minister defended her use of ROA data, acknowledged the CBS pilot and planned improvements, and said she would look forward to more reliable CBS figures on labour-market position.
I did not want to use these CBS data, because the CBS establishes the labour-market position fairly shortly after graduation and only on an annual basis.
Ik heb deze gegevens van het CBS niet willen gebruiken, omdat het CBS vrij kort na diplomering en alleen op jaarbasis de arbeidsmarktpositie vaststelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de plannen voor kleine scholen

An MP asked the state secretary of Education about reported plans to abolish the small-schools allowance in favour of a cooperation bonus, and about the uncertainty this creates for staff and parents. The state secretary said measures would be set out in a letter to parliament in May, that the outcome depends on conditions not yet decided, and that a debate would follow.
In the last week of May I will send your House a letter clarifying what my measures entail.
In de laatste week van mei stuur ik uw Kamer een brief waarin ik duidelijk maak wat mijn maatregelen inhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Rog over de verplichte taaltoets voor hbo-ers

MPs Heerma and Rog asked why higher-vocational (hbo) graduates must also pass the Dutch language test for pre- and early-school education (VVE) and whether municipalities may dismiss staff who refuse it. The state secretary answered that the test covers all VVE staff in the G37 cities regardless of qualification, that the test is needed to assess actual language levels, and that municipalities set subsidy conditions while employers decide on dismissal.
For all these reasons, it was chosen to test all pedagogical staff regardless of their prior education.
Om al die redenen is ervoor gekozen om alle pedagogisch medewerkers te toetsen ongeacht de vooropleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Lanterfanten is gezond’

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that Amsterdam schools test kindergarteners, whether municipalities can mandate such tests, and about publishing CITO test results. The secretary replies that the tests are voluntary local agreements compatible with play-based learning, that the national test-result publication is a Wob-based decision, and promises a letter on early childhood policy by end of April.
I will send a letter to the House of Representatives at the end of April addressing the state of affairs regarding early childhood education.
Ik kom eind april met een brief aan de TK waarin ik inga op de stand van zaken rondom VVE.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het blowverbod op scholen in Amsterdam

MPs Oskam and Rog asked whether the government supports a legal basis for a cannabis-smoking ban around schools in Amsterdam, how it squares with the Council of State ruling on municipal bans, and what enforcement tools municipalities have. The minister answered that the government is exploring stricter school rules, that municipalities can set coffee shop distances and local bans through the Opium Act enforcement guideline, and that court cases on the Amsterdam ban are pending.
The ministries involved are cooperating to strengthen a healthy school environment and are exploring the possibilities to tighten the rules.
De betrokken ministeries trekken samen op om een gezonde schoolomgeving te versterken en verkennen de mogelijkheden om de regels aan te scherpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het uitlekken van opgaven uit de Citotoets

An MP asked the state secretary about exam questions from the Cito test being offered for sale online, and what responsibility the ministry bears for preventing leaks. The state secretary answered that the government is not currently a party, that Cito considers the test may proceed, and that responsibility for security would shift to the state if the bill on a central final test is passed.
In that case, the organisation surrounding the administration of the central final test, including security and administration conditions, becomes a task of the central government.
In dat geval wordt de organisatie rondom de afname van de centrale eindtoets, waaronder de beveiliging en de afnamecondities, een taak van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog betreffende leraren die amper over gedragsproblemen leren

An MP asked the state secretary of Education about teacher training that gives little attention to behavioural problems, the use of a generic knowledge base for teacher training, the limited powers of education consultants in placing truant pupils, and the lack of an absence-reduction ambition in the coalition agreement. The state secretary denied that teacher training ignores learning and behaviour problems, pointed to accreditation and planned regional action plans, argued consultants' role is advisory and that the new appeals committee will handle impasses, and said the ambition on truancy will be set regionally after better absence registration.
I believe teacher training colleges and regional schools should make better agreements with each other on training teachers as well as possible in line with schools' needs.
Ik vind dat lerarenopleidingen en scholen in de regio met elkaar betere afspraken moeten maken over het zo goed mogelijk opleiden van leraren in aansluiting op de behoeften van scholen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rog over het onderzoek in de affaire Jansen Steur

Three CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers whether the scientific work of neurologist Jansen Steur should be examined, why no body had reviewed it earlier, and about his publications and drug-trial involvement. The minister agreed the reasoning on unreliable research is sound, explained that the IGZ halted its probe after the criminal investigation was dropped, and promised to consult Medisch Spectrum Twente and the KNAW on reviewing the publications.
I will first consult with the former employer of Mr Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, on the design and results of the study into publications set up by that institution.

Er zal door mij eerst met de voormalige werkgever van de heer Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, overlegd worden over opzet en resultaten van het door deze instelling opgezette onderzoek naar publicaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Heerma over een tekort aan stageplaatsen in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo)

MPs Rog and Heerma (CDA) asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about the shortage of internship places in vocational education (mbo), including the causes, the proposal of a tax benefit for employers, the link to the labour market and youth unemployment. The minister answers that the economic crisis is the main cause, that the tax deduction will be converted into a better-targeted subsidy, that SBB will launch an internship offensive, and that the government will monitor youth unemployment and consider further measures.
The cabinet closely monitors the development of youth unemployment and is entering into discussions with social partners to see whether additional measures are needed.
Het kabinet houdt de ontwikkeling van de jeugdwerkloosheid nauwgezet in de gaten en treedt in gesprek met sociale partners om te bezien of aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt over derivaten in het onderwijs

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked the education minister about the value of derivatives used by education institutions, whether a 270 million euro loss was taken from education funds, and whether such use should be banned, as well as sanctions for open positions and a ROC West-Brabant criticism. The minister answered that swaps hedge interest risk at lower cost given Basel III, that the negative value is not a realised loss, that she will not ban derivatives but will tighten rules, and that the inspectorate's report was accurate though nuanced by ROC West-Brabant.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en De Rouwe over het persbericht ‘Studenten onredelijk behandeld bij defecte OV-chipkaart’

Two CDA MPs asked why students cannot receive a temporary replacement for a defective OV-chipkaart as other travellers can, and whether DUO, RSR and TLS exchange enough information. The minister explains that student privacy rules (privacy by design) prevent carriers from verifying students, that no exception is planned, and that only efforts to speed up replacement will be explored.
The privacy provisions will not be changed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog inzake het bericht “Conciërges vogelvrij”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education about a CNV union study reporting widespread verbal and physical aggression against school support staff, comparing it with government safety figures, and asked for registration of incidents and an action plan. The State Secretary answered that the government's own monitor shows 7% of staff feel unsafe, that a joint approach with sector bodies and unions is planned, and that sentencing data for aggression against public-service workers is being tracked.
Together with the sector organisations and unions I will soon sit down to reach agreements on a joint approach to aggression and violence in education for the coming period.

Samen met de sectororganisaties en de vakbonden zal ik binnenkort om de tafel gaan om tot afspraken over een gezamenlijke aanpak tegen agressie en geweld in het onderwijs te komen voor de komende periode.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog inzake pestgedrag op basisscholen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education about bullying in primary schools, including teacher training, citizenship education and the Vreedzame School programme. The minister answered that teacher training already covers bullying under the competence requirements, that respectful behaviour is a school task to be addressed later by the next cabinet, and that schools may choose from available programmes.
I therefore assume that teacher training programmes devote sufficient attention to recognising bullying and learning to change a negative group dynamic.
Ik ga er dan ook van uit dat lerarenopleidingen voldoende aandacht besteden aan het herkennen van pestgedrag en het leren veranderen van een negatieve groepsdynamiek.

m: Motie Van der Burg en Kamp over een consequent lik-op-stukbeleid voor ontspoorde jongeren in probleemwijken
Asks the government to apply consistent tough-on-crime action to wayward youths in problem neighbourhoods and to study new punitive sanctions.
requests the government to have police and justice adopt consistent tough enforcement for wayward youths in problem neighbourhoods
verzoekt de regering om politie en justitie in de probleemwijken voor deze ontspoorde jongeren te laten overgaan op een consequent lik-op-stuk-beleid
Motie Van der Burg en Kamp over het aanstellen van één begeleider voor ieder probleemgezin
Motion asking the government to appoint one supervisor with binding authority for each problem family, coordinating police, justice, municipality and other agencies.
invites the government to arrange that each problem family has one supervisor with binding authority
nodigt de regering uit te regelen dat voor ieder probleemgezin één begeleider met doorzettingsmacht wordt aangesteld
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Heinen over ‘Defensie-industrie vangt vaker bot bij banken die reputatieschade vrezen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Heinen asked why banks refuse defence-industry firms accounts over reputational risk, whether the government will talk to banks and industry, whether firms can be exempted from ESG rules, and whether the EU has discussed clashes between sustainability and defence capacity. The minister says banks set their own client policy, the government will first meet the defence sector and then the Dutch Banking Association, has no data on closed accounts, will push for ambitious EU sustainability standards while noting the special position of defence, and reports EU discussion of the issue.
Enquiries with the NVB show that it does not have these figures at its disposal.
Navraag bij de NVB leert dat zij deze cijfers niet tot hun beschikking hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eppink over het bericht van 1 december 2021 in het NRC dat ‘bij defensie duizenden boosterprikkers klaarstaan’

Two JA21 MPs asked the health minister, on behalf of defence, about reports that thousands of military staff were available to administer COVID booster shots, and about the pace of the booster campaign. The minister answered that the campaign had been accelerated, that 2,000 military personnel were made available for support tasks, and that the GGD and GP involvement was being arranged, but largely restated the campaign's objectives and did not give a full account of why the military capacity was not used sooner.
Unfortunately, that was not possible due to pressure of work.
Dat is helaas door drukte niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over het door Shell georganiseerde festival Generation Discover 2017

Two MPs asked whether Defence and the national police, through paid stands and programme roles at Shell's Generation Discover festival, should withdraw support given Shell's fossil-fuel messaging to children. The Justice minister replied that no state subsidy was given, the stands were rented at market rates, and the government sees the partnerships as technology and cybercrime outreach, with no intention to withdraw.
There is no question of financial state support in the form of, for example, a subsidy.
Er is geen sprake van financiële rijkssteun in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het mogelijke baanverlies bij Tata Steel

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about job losses and the independence of Tata Steel Nederland after its planned merger with ThyssenKrupp, including whether the merger should be blocked if it involves forced layoffs. The minister said the government supported a strong IJmuiden position and would monitor developments closely, but would not block the merger, relying on a workforce pact and natural attrition to limit layoffs.
Banning the merger is not on the table, but I will bring Dutch interests to the attention of the Tata Group management where necessary.
De fusie verbieden is niet aan de orde, maar ik zal waar nodig de Nederlandse belangen onder de aandacht brengen van de directie van Tata Group.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de opkoopregeling van Groningse huizen niet eerlijk is verlopen

MP Van Veldhoven asked whether the Minister recognises the National Ombudsman's finding that the Groningen home buy-out scheme was not handled fairly, and what will be done about unclear complaint handling and communication. The Minister said he takes the Ombudsman's recommendation seriously but does not share the conclusion on complaint handling, points to a TU Delft evaluation of the pilot, and says the recommendations will be incorporated into the follow-up buy-out scheme.
I take his recommendation very seriously and will ensure there is sufficient clarity for residents in any follow-up.
Ik neem zijn aanbeveling dan ook zeer serieus zal er op toezien dat er bij een vervolg voldoende helderheid is voor bewoners.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het Rapport 'de evacuatie uit Afghanistan' d.d. 12 december 2021 door Crisisplan

An MP asks the ministers of Defence, Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Crisisplan report on the Afghanistan evacuation, covering implementation of recommendations, the decision-making structure, the reduction of the evacuee list from 60 to 3, the role of the IND and the expanded definition of family members. The government answers that ministries have started implementing recommendations, that the reduction to 3 was an indicative order of magnitude, that all 58 extended family members were ultimately evacuated, and that it will report on implementation before summer.
Before the coming summer, the House will be informed about the implementation of the recommendations.
Voor de aankomende zomer zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de implementatie van de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Palland over het misbruik van militaire uniformen bij de coronademonstratie in Amsterdam van 2 januari jl.

CDA MPs asked whether soldiers and veterans in uniform at a 2 January 2022 Amsterdam COVID demonstration, including a violent attack on a police officer, breached rules, and asked for stronger enforcement of uniform misuse laws. The ministers said uniform rules apply, that Defence has instructed commanders that demonstrating in uniform is a disciplinary offence, and that existing criminal provisions are not shown to be causing enforcement problems, though enforcement is discussed with prosecutors and police.
The Commander of the Armed Forces instructed his subordinate commanders in writing in December 2021 on how to act when military personnel in uniform take part in protests or demonstrations.
De Commandant der Strijdkrachten heeft in december 2021 zijn ondercommandanten schriftelijk geïnstrueerd hoe zij kunnen handelen als militairen in uniform meedoen aan protesten/betogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mogelijke scenario’s voor een evacuatie uit Oekraïne

An MP from BBB asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about possible evacuation scenarios for Dutch citizens in Ukraine amid Russian troop build-up, including escalation risks, travel advice, consular registration, and EU/NATO coordination. The minister answered that evacuation is only considered in exceptional circumstances, there is currently no reason to organise one, travel advice will be updated when developments warrant, and some questions were answered jointly.
At this moment there is no question of an imminent threat to Dutch nationals.
Op dit moment is er geen sprake van een dreigende situatie voor Nederlanders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij luchtaanvallen.

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister why answers to earlier questions on Dutch involvement in airstrikes took over four months, and asked about casualties, Dutch PED intelligence contributions to foreign airstrikes, and any refusals. The minister cited the Afghanistan crisis for the delay, said Dutch involvement in the disputed Iraq strike was not Dutch action and that no civilian-casualty concern was known, and declined to give counts of how often PED products contributed to strikes, citing the coalition's targeting process.
The cabinet can therefore only make statements about weapons deployment that the Netherlands itself carried out, since the Netherlands bears responsibility for those attacks.
Het kabinet kan daarom enkel uitspraken doen over wapeninzet die Nederland zelf heeft uitgevoerd, aangezien Nederland voor die aanvallen de verantwoordelijkheid draagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse verantwoordelijkheid voor burgerslachtoffers in de oorlog tegen IS

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands was responsible for specific coalition airstrikes against IS that the New York Times linked to civilian deaths, and whether it was responsible for any listed as non-credible. The minister confirmed four known cases of possible Dutch-linked civilian casualties, two investigated by CENTCOM and the Public Prosecution Service, and declined to say whether Dutch aircraft were involved in the non-credible list.
With regard to the category of non-credible reports, the ministry maintains its line that no statements are made about this.
Voor wat betreft de categorie « non-credible reports » handhaaft het ministerie de lijn dat hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht 'Nederland gebruikte martelkampen op Bali tijdens de onafhankelijkheidsoorlog'

An MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers why the government declined to respond to reports of Dutch torture camps on Bali during the independence war, and whether it would take the findings into account. The government said it welcomes publications that shed light on the period, that it awaits the results of the independent NIOD/KITLV/NIMH study due in February 2022, and will then take an integral position.
The Cabinet awaits the outcomes of the NIOD, KITLV and NIMH research and will on that basis determine an integral position on the use of violence in Indonesia in 1945–1949.
Het Kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van NIOD, KITLV en NIMH af en zal op basis daarvan een integraal standpunt bepalen over het geweldsgebruik in de jaren 1945–1949 in Indonesië.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries'

An MP asked the State Secretary and ministers why the Saba/Sint Eustatius ferry service failed to start on 1 November 2021, whether customs and Marechaussee were unprepared, and about affordability and remaining obstacles. The government answered that the start slipped to 14 November due to tender extensions and missing safety certificates, that the ferry started on 1 December 2021, and that ministries coordinated with the island authorities.
Due to the extension of the tender period at the request of the participating parties, the target start date had to be adjusted to 14 November 2021.
Door verlenging van de aanbestedingstermijn op verzoek van de deelnemende partijen moest de streefdatum van de start echter worden bijgesteld naar 14 november 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over autonome wapensystemen

The MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Defence whether the Netherlands should work to stop fully autonomous weapons, whether the ICRC call for new binding rules changes the 2015 Dutch position, and when the AIV/CAVV advice would arrive in time for the December 2021 review conference. The government answered that it rejects fully autonomous weapons in principle, that existing international law suffices for now, that it will first seek clarification of existing frameworks rather than new instruments, and that it will reconsider its position after the new advice.
The cabinet will consider the advice and formulate a cabinet response.
Het kabinet gaat zich buigen over het advies en een kabinetsreactie formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de schadevergoedingen na het werken met Chroom-6

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence how many people have received compensation for Chromium-6 exposure, the amounts paid, the number of claims filed and rejected, and whether the list of recognised diseases has been updated. The Minister reported 511 recipients, 7.1 million euro paid, 929 coulance and 527 uitkering claims, 412 rejections for diseases not on the list, and that the RIVM report and an updated list are still awaited.
I expect to receive the RIVM report and the conclusions and recommendations of the Joint Committee in the short term.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn de rapportage van het RIVM en de conclusies en aanbevelingen van de Paritaire Commissie te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat Defensie 3.600 vacatures heeft op Defensie.nl

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Defence Minister about reports of 3,600 vacancies, the distinction between vacant posts and vacancies, civilians filling military posts, and how the staffing shortage will be addressed. The Minister confirmed a staffing shortage, explained that vacant posts differ from vacancies, denied changing the vacancy definition, and listed recruitment measures including reservists and HR transition.
Defence has not changed the definition of the term vacancy and does not intend to change the definition of the term vacancy.
Defensie heeft de definitie van de term vacature niet gewijzigd en is niet voornemens om de definitie van de term vacature te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “Het karige loonbod”

An MP asks the Defence Minister how a meagre pay offer can fill nearly ten thousand vacancies, whether it will worsen staff shortages, whether it should be withdrawn, and about shortages of equipment, munitions and instructors. The minister answers that the offer used the full available pay room, that the vacancy count is nuanced, and that funding of about four billion euros per year is needed, a decision for the next cabinet.

I am of the opinion that Defence, together with the trade union federations, has extracted everything from the pay room available from the cabinet and has presented the maximum achievable outcome to defence personnel.

Ik ben van mening dat Defensie samen met de vakcentrales alles uit de door het kabinet beschikbare arbeidsvoorwaardenruimte heeft gehaald en een maximaal haalbare uitkomst aan het defensiepersoneel heeft voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over een commandant die zijn bemanning niet wil laten testen

SP MPs asked whether a navy commander refusing to test crew with Covid-19 symptoms on Zr.Ms. Rotterdam was acceptable and what Defence policy is. The Minister says medical care aboard is the commander's responsibility, Defence follows government policy with exceptions for operational readiness, and crew were quarantined and tested only on return.
That is why Defence chooses, also because of the high vaccination rate, not to test routinely but to treat patients based on the actual clinical picture.
Daarom kiest Defensie ervoor om, ook vanwege de hoge vaccinatiegraad, niet standaard te testen, maar patiënten te behandelen op basis van het daadwerkelijke ziektebeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse president van plan is de gevechtsmissie in Irak voor het einde van het jaar te beëindigen

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that the US would end its combat mission in Iraq by year end, including its concrete plans, notification of allies, implications for troop presence and Dutch safety, and the effect of al-Sadr's election win. The government answered that US combat troops will withdraw by 1 January 2022, that allies were informed via the anti-ISIS coalition, that the remaining 2500 troops will focus on advisory and capacity building, and that ISIS remains a threat with ongoing attacks.
On the security risks and mitigating measures for the Dutch deployment, the House will be informed separately in the article 100 letter.
Over de veiligheidsrisico's en mitigerende maatregelen voor de Nederlandse inzet wordt de Kamer separaat in de artikel 100-brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de grote financiële tekorten bij de krijgsmacht

An MP from Van Haga asked the Defence Minister about ammunition shortages, an estimated structural €700 million budget gap, possible unit closures and what was meant by a 'fundamentally different' armed forces. The minister confirmed the mismatch between needs and budget, pointed to €95 million and the Hermans motion funding, said €13-17 billion extra is needed in the Defence Vision, and left choices to the next cabinet.
Decisions on this are for a next cabinet.
Besluiten hierover zijn aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vervuilende afscheidsvlucht van de KDC-10

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a 550 km farewell flight with an old KDC-10 tanker, emitting about 50,540 kg CO2, was justified given climate ambitions and its cost. The minister replied that the flight was a fitting farewell to a plane that transported veterans and supported missions, that it cost about 7,042 euro within the regular budget, and that the non-CO2 effects were insignificant due to low altitude.
The flight was a fitting farewell to the transport aircraft that since 1995 have carried tens of thousands of veterans to various mission and deployment areas and flown them home again.

De vlucht was een passend afscheid van de transporttoestellen die sinds 1995 tienduizenden veteranen naar verschillende missie- en inzetgebieden hebben gebracht en vervolgens weer naar huis hebben gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de oefening Steadfast Noon

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about the NATO nuclear exercise Steadfast Noon: whether it was held, how transparency is handled, which countries take part, the status of New START, and whether Nuclear Sharing should end with the F-35 arrival at Volkel. The minister confirmed the exercise took place with Dutch participation, described transparency efforts, noted New START was extended to 2026, and maintained that the F-35 is meant to take over the nuclear role, declining to comment on other allies' policies.
The cabinet does not make statements about the nuclear weapons policy of other NATO allies.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over het kernwapenbeleid van andere NAVO-bondgenoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het verzoek van de ambassade in Kabul om militaire bijstand

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why they rejected the Kabul embassy's request for military assistance, why it was omitted from the factual account, and why the request came only on 16 August. The ministers replied that no refusal occurred, that the embassy recommended a special forces protection team on 16 August which deployed on 17 August, and that the Taliban's rapid takeover surprised everyone.
There has been no question of rejecting a request for military assistance.
Van afwijzing van een verzoek tot militaire bijstand is geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gevolgen van gaswinning in Drenthe

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Drenthe residents affected by gas extraction and storage damage have the same rights and damage protocol as Groningen residents, and how NAM's handling of claims and the planned compensation fund are progressing. The minister says all Dutch citizens have the same civil-law right to compensation, that the Tcbb was asked to advise on a uniform protocol and an independent claims body before year-end, and that the Groningen protocol is stalled pending agreement on a new one with NAM stepping back.

I have asked the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb) to explore the option of setting up an identical damage protocol for the rest of the Netherlands for damage caused by mining, handled by an independent body.

Ik heb de Technische commissie bodembeweging (Tcbb) gevraagd om de optie te verkennen om voor de rest van Nederland een gelijkluidend schadeprotocol in te richten voor schade veroorzaakt door mijnbouw met een onafhankelijk orgaan dat de schade afhandelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het rapport van de Auditdienst Rijk over toepassing van het billijkheidsbeginsel bij het opleggen van mestboetes

An MP asked whether the government would publish the RVO.nl mitigation policy for manure fines, the average reduction percentages in 104 mitigated cases, and the reasons for mitigation. The minister refused to publish the policy to avoid strategic behaviour, said averages are not meaningful and no capacity exists for case-by-case review, and reported only that 71 fines for accountability violations were imposed in 2014–2016 without tracking how many were mitigated.
Publishing the mitigation policy could lead entrepreneurs to anticipate it and create strategic behaviour.
Openbaarmaking van het matigingsbeleid kan ertoe leiden dat ondernemers daarop gaan anticiperen en er berekenend gedrag ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kuik over het bericht dat Groninger winkeliers duizenden euro’s aan boetes krijgen

MPs Hijink and Kuik asked whether it is desirable that tenant and owner shopkeepers be forced to open on Sunday shopping days under penalty, and about the burden on small shopkeepers and staff. The State Secretary answered that contractual obligations are permissible but penalties should be a last resort, that the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court ruling clarifies limits on unilateral changes to opening hours, and that the courts, not the government, would judge whether a clause or penalty is unreasonable.
There are no figures on the number of cases in which a penalty is actually imposed.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal gevallen waarin daadwerkelijk een boete wordt opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de ondergrondse puppyhandel

An MP asked the Minister about the underground puppy trade, paper and chip fraud, breeding standards, inbreeding, Raad van Beheer powers, enforcement and internet sales. The minister answered that fraud cannot be fully eliminated, outlined a white list of traders, passport requirements, EU coordination, a pilot on breed health, work on making article 3.4 enforceable, and ongoing talks with Marktplaats rather than an online sales ban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over afhandeling klachten en benutting slimme meters

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about complaints over smart meters raised on the Radar broadcast, including the handling of complaints, the 'kastje-naar-de-muur' problem, and how savings potential is promoted. The minister answered that the meters measure reliably, that complaints have been handled through a step-by-step procedure with grid operators and suppliers, and that monthly consumption overviews and savings measures are being pursued.

I take the complaints in the Radar broadcast about energy suppliers' and grid operators' customer service, estimated energy use and the communication about it in relation to the smart meter as a serious signal.

Ik vat de klachten in de Radar-uitzending over de klantenservice van energieleveranciers en netbeheerders, geschat energieverbruik en de communicatie daarover in relatie tot de slimme meter op als een serieus signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Hoge blootstelling pesticide geeft geboorteafwijking'

An SP MP asked the government whether it would respond to Californian findings linking pesticide exposure to birth defects, whether comparable pesticides are used in the Dutch sector, whether Dutch data are missing, and whether health risks including birth defects are covered by the RIVM exposure study. The minister referred all five questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents, giving no substantive answers.
I refer you to my answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het niet vervolgen van het illegaal afschieten van 82 beschermde grauwe ganzen door Faunabeheereenheid Flevoland

An MP asked the minister whether the Flevoland wildlife management unit should be prosecuted for shooting 82 protected greylag geese without a valid permit, and why the environmental service declined a criminal investigation. The minister explained that the permit was only usable after the objection period, that the unit admitted shooting during that period, that the service dropped criminal proceedings given the low risk of repetition, and that prosecution remains legally possible but was not pursued.
The Omgevingsdienst then decided to refrain from a criminal investigation because it considers the chance of recurrence small.
De Omgevingsdienst heeft daarop besloten af te zien van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek omdat zij de kans op herhaling klein acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over onderhoud van huurhuizen in Groningen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about housing corporations in Groningen halting maintenance on rental homes, the use of foam insulation on roofs, and tenants being left to live in unsafe, poorly maintained homes during the earthquake-reinforcement operation. The ministers answered that tenants can raise maintenance with corporations, the Huurcommissie, the municipality, or the kantonrechter, that the government acknowledges delays and will consult the region on reinforcement and sustainability.
Tenants can also turn to the municipality if deferred maintenance leads to insufficient structural quality.
Ook kunnen huurders zich tot de gemeente wenden als achterstallig onderhoud ertoe leidt dat de bouwtechnische kwaliteit onvoldoende lijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over onvoldoende mobiel bereik in delen van Brabant

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the minister about poor mobile coverage in parts of Brabant, including whether the 112 emergency number is unreachable in Olland and what Agentschap Telecom has done. The state secretary answered that primary responsibility lies with operators and municipalities, that Agentschap Telecom forwarded the provincial letter and offers technical support, and that it is in contact with three other municipalities.
The province of Noord-Brabant acknowledges that primary responsibility for mobile accessibility lies with mobile operators and municipalities.
De provincie Noord-Brabant erkent dat de primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor mobiele bereikbaarheid bij mobiele operators en gemeenten ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het alarmerend bericht over door mest verontreinigd grondwater

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands should adopt German and French programmes requiring organic farming in drinking-water protection areas, and whether cost-benefit studies should be mandatory. The minister answers that the Dutch Delta approach and a nitrate action programme with tailored plans for 40 drinking-water intakes already address this, and that new mandatory cost-benefit studies are unnecessary.
Having new cost-benefit studies carried out (mandatorily) is therefore not necessary.
Het (verplicht) laten uitvoeren van nieuwe kosten-batenstudies is dus niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Veel glyfosaat in landbouwgronden: Verlenging toelating niet verstandig'

MP De Groot (D66) asked the minister whether she knew of research showing glyphosate in agricultural soils, whether she would ask the Ctgb for advice on its implications for renewing glyphosate's approval, and whether EFSA should review the research. The minister confirmed knowledge of the research, said she had asked the Ctgb for advice and informed parliament of it, and said EFSA review was unnecessary because EFSA had already advised the Commission with a similar conclusion.
I have now asked the Ctgb for advice and have informed your House of the outcome.
Ik heb het Ctgb inmiddels om advies gevraagd en heb uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Groningse opkoopregeling van huizen die niet eerlijk verlopen is

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the unfair Groningen house-buyback pilot (Koopinstrument), including the lottery-style selection, unclear criteria, the handling of a complaint outside the General Administrative Law Act complaint procedure, and the broader lack of trust and state leadership in the gas-extraction region. The minister defends the pilot as fair, acknowledges the Ombudsman's recommendations on communication and transparency, refuses to revisit rejections, and commits to developing a follow-up buyback scheme via the NCG.

Nevertheless, I must note that the National Ombudsman recommends that the NCG and I provide more clarity on the role, position and responsibility of the NCG in a follow-up to the Koopinstrument and communicate this clearly to Groningers.

Desondanks moet ik vaststellen dat de Nationale ombudsman de NCG en mij aanbeveelt om bij een vervolg van het Koopinstrument meer helderheid te verschaffen over de rol, positie en verantwoordelijkheid van de NCG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over ernstige verontreiniging door lekkages NAM in Rossum

MPs Mulder and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a serious soil and groundwater contamination from leaks at an NAM site in Rossum, including when it was discovered, why it went unnoticed, and remediation timing. The minister answered that the historic contamination, first found in 1985, cannot be traced to its cause or exact timing, that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority, and that remediation is not urgent while current use poses no unacceptable risk.
The production water comes from oil extraction in Schoonebeek.
Het productiewater is afkomstig van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er door visserij nauwelijks meer volgroeide vissen zijn in de oceanen

An MP asked the minister whether old-growth fish have become scarce under commercial fishing, whether the EU fisheries policy adequately protects them, and whether she will push for better protection. The minister acknowledges the age-structure effect of fishing but says evidence on the reproductive role of older fish is mixed, age structure is not an indicator in the CFP, and existing catch limits and minimum sizes are sufficient.
I consider the combination of these measures sufficient to protect fish species against overfishing.
De combinatie van deze maatregelen acht ik voldoende om vissoorten tegen overbevissing te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat bontartikelen in tien Europese landen onjuist worden gelabeld

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Fur Free Alliance report finding most fur garments in ten EU countries mislabelled, and about enforcement of the EU textile labelling rules. The minister calls the findings worrying, commits to raising the report and clearer labelling in EU expert groups, and says enforcement is primarily the responsibility of businesses and member-state inspectorates, with NVWA inspection being reactive.
As far as I am aware, no data on European compliance by enforcement services are available.
Voor zover ik weet zijn er geen gegevens over Europese naleving van de handhavingsdiensten beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Tongeren, Van der Lee en Beckerman over overheidssteun voor de productie en het gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen

MPs from GroenLinks and the SP asked the government about the ODI/CAN-E report on public support for fossil fuels, the Netherlands' commitment to phase out inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, the absence of a consolidated overview of such support, and the state's share of decommissioning costs. The government denied direct specific support to fossil fuel firms, said budgets do not separate fossil from renewable support, and pointed to the Masterplan for Decommissioning and the new Nexstep platform.

Overviews that specifically distinguish between companies that use and/or produce fossil energy and companies that use and/or produce renewable energy are not available, as that distinction is not made in the budgets.

Overzichten die een specifiek onderscheid maken tussen bedrijven die fossiele energie gebruiken en/of produceren en bedrijven die hernieuwbare vormen van energie benutten en/of produceren, zijn niet voorhanden, aangezien dat onderscheid in de begrotingen niet wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Nederland de fossiele industrie met 7,6 miljard euro per jaar steunt

An MP asked whether the Netherlands subsidises the fossil fuel industry with 7.6 billion euro a year, whether the polluter-pays principle should guide climate policy, and how this squares with the energy transition and Paris goals. The government denied that fossil producers receive specific subsidies, stated it supports renewables and energy saving, and said the future of fossil phase-out is for the next cabinet to decide.
As indicated, there is no question of companies receiving specific government support for the use or production of fossil energy.
Zoals aangegeven, is er geen sprake van dat bedrijven specifieke overheidssteun ontvangen voor het gebruik of de productie van fossiele energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat 66% van het stimuleringsgeld van Economische Zaken naar het buitenland gaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Dutch Dutch Venture Initiative Beheer BV existed, whether it was a shell company used to channel public funds to Luxembourg, and whether the DVI should have been tendered. The minister answered that the BV was a shareholding vehicle dissolved in 2017 with no activities, that DVI is a private-law entity not subject to tender, and that the Luxembourg structure was chosen because the EIF is based there.

DVI is a private-law entity aiming to invest on market terms in venture capital funds for innovative enterprises and, like similar funds the EIF has set up for other European countries, does not need to be tendered.

DVI is een privaatrechtelijke entiteit die tot doel heeft om marktconform te investeren in risicokapitaalfondsen voor innovatieve ondernemingen en hoeft, net als soortgelijke fondsen die het EIF voor andere Europese landen heeft opgezet, niet te worden aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het incident bij het tankenpark van de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked about a leak of aardgascondensaat at the NAM tank park near Farmsum, its environmental and safety effects, earthquake resistance of tanks, incident history, and supervision. The government answered that SodM and ILT supervise the site, the leak was cleaned up with no reported fauna deaths, the tanks are on the priority list for earthquake-resistance review, and supervision of loading procedures is ongoing.
It is being examined whether preventive additional measures are needed in case an earthquake occurs that is stronger than any so far in the area.
Onderzocht wordt of preventief aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn voor het geval een aardbeving plaatsvindt die zwaarder is dan zich tot nu toe heeft voorgedaan in het gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht “Nieuw faillissement voor voormalig Aldel"

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the second bankruptcy of the former Aldel aluminium smelter, the total state subsidy it received, lessons learned, whether energy-intensive industry support should be ended, and the status of a direct Germany power interconnector. The minister said about 4.57 million euro in ETS indirect emission compensation was paid in 2016-2017, that support for energy-intensive firms will not be categorically excluded, and that the interconnector plan has been shelved for now.
I do not intend to categorically exclude energy-intensive companies from the regular instruments or from consideration of any additional government efforts.
Ik ben niet voornemens om energie-intensieve bedrijven bij voorbaat uit te sluiten van het reguliere instrumentarium of bij de overweging van eventuele extra overheidsinspanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Drentse gasopslag bij Steenbergen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for a timeline of permit changes and capacity expansions at the Norg gas storage facility, and whether the permitting and seismic assessments were independently reviewed. The Minister gave a detailed chronology, said SodM and Tcbb advice was independent, and confirmed the 2015 pressure decision must be reconsidered after a Council of State ruling, with the storage ceiling temporarily reduced.
I see no reason to question the independence of their judgement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de onafhankelijkheid van hun oordeel in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verdrievoudiging van de gaswinning bij Wapse

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about competent authority over the Wapse gas extraction, the environmental impact assessment requirements, and the legal status of the gas volume units and extraction permit. The minister explained the division of competences, defended the MER procedure and independent review, and said the court will settle the unit question while the case remains pending.
The entire matter is currently before the court.
De hele kwestie ligt momenteel onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Gesprekken over schadeprotocol aardbevingsgebied vastgelopen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about confusion and delays in Groningen damage handling for the 'buitengebied' (outside the former contour), including the status of border areas, the TU Delft study, the voucher and second-opinion process, and the independence of the reviewing bureaus. The minister replied that the former contour was dropped, that the TU Delft study results are due in early 2018, that second opinions will be done by selected bureaus under a uniform method, and that the voucher acceptance numbers are premature to interpret.
There is no such thing as 'the outer area'.
Er is geen sprake van «het buitengebied».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de ontheffing die is verleend voor het houden en laten meereizen van een olifant bij een circus

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why Circus Freiwald received a temporary exemption to keep and transport an elephant despite the ban on wild animals in circuses, and how this fits the welfare rationale and supervision. The minister replied that no European sanctuary was available after experts found the elephant fit for relocation, that the NVWA supervises compliance, and that the conditions bar performances and direct public contact.
Direct contact is mainly understood to mean touching the elephant.
Met direct contact wordt met name het aanraken van de olifant bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het voornemen garnalenvissers het MSC-keurmerk voor duurzame visserij te geven

The MP asks whether the MSC label for North Sea shrimp fishers is credible given reported bycatch of around 60% and overfished stocks, and what the timeline is for the landing obligation. The minister answers that the certifier assessed bycatch (about 78% shrimp, 11% benthic animals, 9% fish, 2% flatfish), points to voluntary measures and a coastal fisheries agreement, argues the label is an independent private initiative that performs better on stocks, and says the landing obligation applies from 2019 with survival-exemption and pulse-fishing options still under study.
The awarding of quality marks is a private initiative.
Het toekennen van keurmerken is een privaat initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de grote medische problemen in de raskattenfokkerij

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about serious hereditary health problems in pedigree cat breeding, including whether breeding for harmful traits should be enforced and whether inbreeding and microchipping cats should be banned or mandated. The Minister says enforcement of the breeding rules is complex, is being reviewed with the NVWA, LID and NGOs, reports inspection figures and a pilot, and declines to mandate chipping of cats.
At present I am therefore examining, in consultation with the NVWA, the LID and several NGOs, how breeding animals in a harmful way can be made easier to enforce.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik dan ook in samenspraak met de NVWA, de LID en enkele NGO's, hoe het op een schadelijke manier fokken van dieren beter handhaafbaar te maken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de energierekening volgend jaar verder stijgt

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the renewable energy levy (ODE) and energy tax rise, whether polluters pay and whether households are fairly burdened compared with industry. The minister defended the 50-50 household-business split as balanced, explained the temporary energy tax increase as funding for housing corporation energy saving under the Energy Agreement, and gave tariff and budget tables.
Because of this starting point, a degressive tariff structure comparable to the energy tax was also chosen.
Vanwege dit uitgangspunt is tevens gekozen voor een degressieve tariefstructuur die vergelijkbaar is met de energiebelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het faillissement van Aldel

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the bankruptcy of aluminium producer Aldel, including job protection, subsidies, regional investment funds and private equity practices. The minister said the government generally does not intervene in individual firms, pointed to UWV support for workers and the expected takeover by York Capital, and declined to comment on Klesch's investment and tax choices.
I do not have broad insight into the choices and underlying motives regarding Klesch Group's investments, nor into the use of fiscal and legal options involved with those investments.

Ik heb geen breed inzicht in de keuzes en achterliggende motieven ten aanzien van de investeringen van Klesch Group, noch in het gebruik van fiscale en juridische mogelijkheden die met die investeringen gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat 66% van het stimuleringsgeld van Economische Zaken naar het buitenland gaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why about two-thirds of DVI venture capital investment went abroad, and whether the approach and costs should change. The minister defended the fund-of-funds approach through leverage, said the aim is for investments in the Netherlands to be about four times the government's contribution, and promised a 2018 evaluation of the risk-capital instruments.
In 2018 the risk capital instruments, including DVI, will be evaluated and I will inform your House of the outcomes and my findings in due course.
In 2018 zal het risicokapitaalinstrumentarium, waaronder DVI, worden geëvalueerd en ik zal uw Kamer te zijner tijd over de uitkomsten en mijn bevindingen daarbij informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de hygiëne in pluimveeslachterijen vaak niet op orde is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that hygiene in poultry slaughterhouses is often substandard, including which shortcomings led two plants under heightened NVWA supervision, animal welfare violations, the falling share of compliant premises, and sanctions. The minister answered that the plants improved during supervision, that welfare shortcomings are being addressed, that the NVWA enforces a graduated sanctions policy that can ultimately lead to suspension, and that responsibility for compliance lies with industry.
It cannot be stated how many animals were affected by the shortcomings.
Het is niet aan te geven hoeveel dieren getroffen zijn door de tekortkomingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Azmani over het bericht ‘NAM erkent (gedeeltelijke) overschrijding, maar ontkent overtreding’

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about reports that NAM exceeded its gas extraction uncertainty margin at Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk, and how supervision and penalties work. The minister explained the 20% margin is a planning assumption, said SodM is still assessing NAM's response, promised to clarify winning plans and permit conditions, and described the EUR 2 million as a coercive measure rather than a fine.
SodM is currently assessing that response, including whether the overrun could have been prevented.
SodM is op dit moment bezig met de beoordeling van die zienswijze, waarbij ook wordt bekeken in hoeverre de overschrijding was te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over schade door zoutwinning en gaswinning bij Veendam, Muntendam, Hoogezand, Tripscompagnie en Borgercompagnie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about compensation for damage from salt and gas extraction in several villages near Veendam and Hoogezand, and about oversight of cumulative subsidence. The minister answered that subsidence-related damage is not expected, that the Tcbb independently reviews claims, that SodM supervises cumulative subsidence limits, and that a national damage protocol is being explored with advice due in December 2017.
I have asked the Tcbb to explore the option of establishing a uniform damage protocol for the whole of the Netherlands for damage caused by mining, with an independent body handling the damage.

Ik heb de Tcbb gevraagd om de optie te verkennen om voor heel Nederland een gelijkluidend schadeprotocol in te richten voor schade veroorzaakt door mijnbouw met een onafhankelijk orgaan dat de schade afhandelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over forse overschrijdingen van het gaswinningplan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about large overshoots of permitted gas production at Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk, the NAM's claim that overshoots are allowed at end of field life, monitoring, risks, and enforcement. The minister said SodM confirmed the maximum permitted production was exceeded, that the instruction decisions need clearer production-limit wording, that he does not see a structural problem, that a new plan was filed for Maasdijk and Monster, and that SodM is preparing a penalty order against NAM.
In its advice of June 2017 to me, SodM indicated that for Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk it was found that the maximum permitted production had been exceeded.
In haar adviezen van juni 2017 aan mij heeft SodM aangegeven dat voor Hardenberg-Oost, Monster en Maasdijk is geconstateerd dat de maximaal vergunde productie is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de grootste gasvondst van afgelopen 25 jaar

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the largest Dutch gas find in 25 years, covering risks of the exploration drilling, timeline to production, fault mapping, gas quality, phase-out of Dutch gas extraction and supply security. The minister said the test drilling was successful, that monitoring and existing safety rules apply, that further permits would take at least two years, and that the gas is low-calorific and extraction is not yet at issue.
Further activities and the timeline following this exploratory drilling depend on Hansa's (extraction) plans.
Verdere activiteiten en het tijdpad van het vervolg van deze exploratieboring zijn afhankelijk van de (winnings)plannen van Hansa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het onderzoek 'De schaduwzijden van Graniet'

MPs Sazias and Van Brenk asked the government about a report on modern slavery, child labour and dangerous conditions in South Indian granite quarries, including what the government is doing with importing firms, procurement and the multi-stakeholder natural stone covenant. The Minister says a covenant is being negotiated with the sector, will raise the issue in the EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, expects companies to carry out due diligence under the OECD guidelines, and notes that public procurement and decentralised governments are being engaged, though no mandatory transparency rules are planned.
Are you prepared to require companies to be fully transparent about their supply chain policy regarding their duty of care to promote human rights?
Bent u bereid bedrijven te verplichten volledig transparant te zijn over hun keten (beleid) op het gebied van hun zorgplicht voor het bevorderen van mensenrechten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht 'Vliegen op één rij kost fortuin'

MP Van Helvert asked whether hidden extra charges for choosing seats on airline tickets break the law, what rules ensure full price transparency, whether the ACM has fined airlines for this, and whether airlines may charge for seats keeping families together. The government answered that total prices must be shown upfront, optional seat fees must be disclosed early and opt-in, the ACM enforces this and has fined providers, and airlines may charge for specific seats with no legal cap on fees.
Booking specific seats is increasingly an optional choice.
Het boeken van specifieke zitplaatsen is steeds vaker een facultatieve optie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Jetten over het rapport van de Europese Commissie waarin stevige kritiek wordt geuit op de manier waarop de veiligheid van ons voedsel aan de Europese buitengrenzen (Schiphol e

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers about an EU Commission audit criticising the document checks on food imports at Schiphol and Rotterdam, including scanned rather than original certificates. The government acknowledged the findings, defended the current approach for non-animal products, and said an impact analysis and concrete actions would follow.
I acknowledge the conclusions and the accompanying recommendations.
Ik erken de conclusies en de daarbij horende aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Gesprekken over schadeprotocol aardbevingsgebied vastgelopen’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why talks on a new damage protocol for the Groningen earthquake area stalled, whether NAM still plays a role in assessing damage, whether the burden of proof will shift, whether the protocol covers Drenthe and Friesland, how the backlog will be cleared, whether the Commissie Bijzondere Situaties continues, and when the protocol will be adopted. The minister acknowledged the talks have not yet produced the desired result, confirmed NAM will no longer assess causes and amounts while retaining liability, confirmed the statutory presumption of causation will apply, and said the protocol will likely be adopted only after the next cabinet takes office.
All parties, including NAM, agree that NAM should no longer play a role in assessing damage causes and deciding compensation amounts, while NAM retains its liability.

Alle partijen, inclusief NAM, zijn het eens over het uitgangspunt dat NAM niet langer een rol dient te spelen in het proces van beoordeling van schadeoorzaken en beslissingen over de hoogte van vergoedingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken  over uitputting van de landbouwgrond

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that agricultural soil is being depleted, including the claim that doing nothing is harmful to farming. The minister acknowledged the global degradation concern, said the Carpay report's steenmeel claims lack scientific support, and deferred concrete soil policy to a future cabinet, promising only to recommend that it consider the UN findings.
As part of the soil strategy still to be developed, I will recommend that the new cabinet take the outcomes of the Global Land Outlook into account.
In het kader van de nog te ontwikkelen bodemstrategie zal ik het nieuwe kabinet aanbevelen om de uitkomsten van de Global Land Outlook mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het voornemen van Gedeputeerde Staten van Limburg om het doden van bevers toe te staan

An MP asked the minister whether the provincial executive of Limburg's approval of a beaver management plan permitting killing of beavers complies with the Nature Conservation Act and EU habitat rules. The minister answered that the assessment is for the provincial executive, outlined the damage and safety risks beavers can cause, noted alternative measures and the protected status under EU law, and declined to intervene through interbestuurlijk toezicht.
It is up to the provincial executive to assess whether these conditions are met.
Het is aan gedeputeerde staten om te beoordelen of aan deze voorwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat er een groei van 122% is geconstateerd in varianten van ransomware

An MP asked the ministers whether the reported 122% growth in ransomware variants would continue, whether Dutch society and economy are sufficiently resilient, and what EU-level steps are being taken on device security certification. The government answered that growth is hard to predict, pointed to extra cybersecurity funding of 26 million euros from 2018, awareness campaigns, and EU proposals on a certification framework that will be discussed further.
The cabinet has therefore reserved additional funds for cybersecurity on Budget Day.
Het kabinet heeft daarom bij Prinsjesdag aanvullende middelen voor cybersecurity gereserveerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Vervuilde bodem NAM in Manderveen geen gevaar voor gezondheid'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about contaminated soil at gas and oil extraction sites, including which sites are polluted, the status of remediation at Coevorden 5 and 17, and who is responsible when the polluter cannot be held liable. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that SodM has been asked to compile one, that provinces hold competence for historical pollution, and that the polluter is primarily liable for remediation.
I therefore do not currently have the overview requested by your House.
Ik beschik op dit moment dan ook niet over het door uw Kamer gevraagde overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van den Bosch over het bericht “Laat een prachtig huwelijk niet op de klippen lopen”

MPs Ziengs and Van den Bosch asked about the naval shipbuilding cluster's economic importance, the lack of new orders, and whether the Defence Materiel Organisation has enough capacity for several naval projects. The ministers answered that the cluster is important, that a study on its economic value is planned for early 2018, and that investment decisions are for the next cabinet.

Decision-making on new investments, for example investments in naval equipment, and the possible consequences for the personnel capacity of Defence and of the DMO in particular, is for the next cabinet.

Besluitvorming over nieuwe investeringen, bijvoorbeeld investeringen in marinematerieel, en de eventuele gevolgen hiervan voor de personele capaciteit van Defensie en van de DMO in het bijzonder, is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about demands to remove the Centrum Veilig Wonen from the new Groningen damage process, and about delays in damage handling and reinforcement caused by NAM's involvement. The minister said the NCG is in talks with NAM and CVW, that NAM will step back from damage decisions while keeping liability, and that responsibility for delays is shared and not with one party.
The NCG is holding talks with NAM and CVW to keep the backlog as small as possible and achieve structural improvements.
De NCG voert gesprekken met NAM en CVW om de achterstand zo klein mogelijk te houden en tot structurele verbeteringen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de exorbitante ontslagvergoeding van een ex-topman bij Alliander

An SP MP asked why the government tolerates an exorbitant severance payment to a former Alliander executive, why Alliander won a 2016 sustainability prize, and how the topsalary law and grid-operator rules were handled. The minister answers that the Wet normering topinkomens does not apply to the network company Alliander by deliberate choice, that the prize is judged on transparency, and that the Raad van Commissarissen introduced a pay ceiling and shareholders pressed for more moderation.

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that internship places were falling sharply, risking shortages of skilled workers, and whether the state should fund internships. The questions were declared withdrawn (vervallen) because they had been answered otherwise or the answer was no longer considered timely.
The questions below are to be considered withdrawn.
Onderstaande vragen dienen als vervallen te worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over over het bericht dat zelfstandigen door gemeenten van schuldhulp worden uitgesloten

MPs Hijink and Van Dijk asked whether municipalities exclude self-employed people from debt relief and whether this forces them to stop their businesses. The State Secretary answered that such exclusion is not allowed, that individual assessment is required, that the Bbz scheme is an alternative for some, and that she will raise the issue with the VNG.
Municipalities may not apply exclusion grounds within debt relief.
Gemeenten mogen geen uitsluitinggronden in het kader van de schuldhulpverlening hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat honderd miljoen euro aan subsidie is toegewezen voor een grote mest(co)vergistingsinstallatie in Rilland

An SP MP asked the ministers about the EUR 100 million subsidy for a large manure co-digestion plant in Rilland, covering nuisance from traffic, siting, emissions, landscape integration, the total energy gains from the EUR 2.5 billion spent on manure digesters, and whether such subsidies remain a sound investment. The minister answered that the provincial permit covers environmental effects, that the subsidy is a maximum under SDE+ and depends on actual output, that he considers subsidising digesters cost-effective, and that local residents' information is a municipal and provincial responsibility.
Informing residents about this initiative and organising the participation that goes with it is a task of local authorities.
Het informeren van bewoners over dit initiatief en het organiseren van inspraak die daarbij hoort is een taak van de lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een onderzoek dat stelt dat de huidige gaswinning de kans op ernstige aardbevingen niet vermindert

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs Minister about a study by Dempsey and Suckale finding that current Groningen gas extraction does not reduce the chance of serious earthquakes, and about the 17% probability of a M3.6 quake, the expert conclusions, and whether SodM will consult the authors.
