The minister said the study was commissioned by NAM for a 2016 expert workshop, that SodM and TNO found no fundamentally new insights, that the risk figures were considered in the 2016 and 2017 winningsplan decisions, and that he saw no reason to ask SodM to contact the researchers urgently, while listing ongoing research programmes.
Experts from SodM have however assured me that these studies have so far not led to any substantial new or different insights regarding seismicity in Groningen.
Deskundigen van SodM hebben mij echter verzekerd dat deze onderzoeken tot nu toe niet hebben geleid tot wezenlijke nieuwe of andere inzichten inzake de seismiciteit in Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het inspectieonderzoek naar de stroomstoring van Amsterdam en omstreken van 17 januari 2017

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why the 1-1-2 emergency line's intake arrangements date from when mobile phone use was limited, why about 19% of callers got no contact during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, and what is being done about mobile reachability, waiting times and standards. The Minister answered that a national intake structure and a renewed technical infrastructure are being introduced, that a cost-benefit analysis on a standard for outage-resilient 1-1-2 access will be sent to parliament in early 2018, and that the Agentschap Telecom has advised several municipalities.
As indicated in the policy response, a thorough cost-benefit analysis will first be carried out to determine what a reasonable standard is.
Zoals aangegeven is in de beleidsreactie, wordt eerst een gedegen kosten en baten analyse uitgevoerd om te kijken wat een redelijke norm is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Engelshoven en Paternotte over het bericht '112 bij ramp? In de wacht' naar aanleiding van het onderzoek naar de stroomstoring in Amsterdam op 17 januari 2017

MPs Van Engelshoven and Paternotte asked about 112 emergency call failures during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, prior recommendations, telecom obligations and the lack of a norm for continuous 112 access. The minister answered that most earlier recommendations were implemented, that a risk analysis and new technical infrastructure in 2018 address remaining gaps, and that a norm for uninterrupted access awaits a cost-benefit analysis.
That is therefore the reason why the Ministry of Economic Affairs first wants to have a cost-benefit analysis carried out before moving to a norm for uninterrupted access to 1-1-2.
Dat is dan ook de reden dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken eerst een kosten en baten analyse wil laten uitvoeren voordat overgaan wordt tot een norm voor onderbroken toegang tot 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Fox IT houdt zeggenschap staat af’

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether the government secured co-control over Fox Crypto after NCC Group's takeover, dropped its first right of purchase, and what safeguards protect state secrets. The minister confirms ICT separation and contract transfers are done, says co-control and ownership terms are still under discussion, and gives only partial, procedural answers on secrecy safeguards, declining operational details for security reasons.
For security reasons I will not go into specific questions about the protection of state secrets.
Om veiligheidsredenen ga ik niet in op specifieke vragen over de beveiliging van staatsgeheimen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huishoudens twee derde van de milieubelastingen betalen

An SP MP asked the government about reports that households pay two-thirds of environmental taxes, the industry's share of those levies, whether the burden distribution undermines public support, and where the revenue is spent. The government confirmed the figures, said industry's share of energy tax and renewable energy levy was about 10% and that a full breakdown is not registered, and pointed to the Energy Agenda, an SER study and the general budget as the spending channels.
A complete picture of the precise contribution of the industrial sector to the revenues from environmental taxes and levies is lacking.
Een volledig beeld omtrent de precieze bijdrage van de sector industrie aan de opbrengsten van de milieubelastingen en heffingen ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stijging van CO2-uitstoot in 2016

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the 2020 CO2 reduction target (25% versus 1990), upheld by the court, is still achievable given a 1% rise in 2016 and a reduction of only 11% so far, and how the remaining 14% will be achieved year by year. The government denies the target is out of reach, says the Energy Agreement should close the remaining 4 Mton gap and that the NEV 2017 will be used to check course, with additional measures if needed.
At the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on track to implement the Urgenda judgment.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de mogelijke rol die de EU gaat krijgen bij controversiële bedrijfsovernames in lidstaten

An MP asked the Economy Minister about the EU's possible new role in controversial foreign takeovers of companies, and whether this would affect Dutch plans to protect firms from hostile bids. The minister said the Commission's proposal is a framework for screening foreign investment on national security grounds, that the Dutch government will assess it in a BNC-fiche, and that proposals on protecting Dutch firms are for a future cabinet.
The cabinet will now study the Commission proposal in more detail, after which the House will receive an assessment in the usual way via a BNC-fiche.
Het kabinet zal het Commissievoorstel nu nader bestuderen, waarna de Kamer volgens de gebruikelijke wijze een appreciatie zal ontvangen middels een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Groot, Geurts en Lodders over gegevensverstrekking aan Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw voor het programma Onderzoek en Innovatie

MPs asked whether the minister should give the agricultural sector body BO Akkerbouw the names, addresses and acreage data of non-member farms, given data-protection limits and administrative burden, for a mandatory research levy. The minister declined direct transfer of the data, offering instead KvK data transfers and an opt-in consent route via RVO.nl, arguing this is proportionate and workable under the Wbp.
This means that providing the acreage data, without the farms having given consent, does not meet the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Dit maakt dat het verstrekken van de areaalgegevens, zonder dat de akkerbouwbedrijven daar toestemming voor gegeven hebben, niet voldoet aan de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Toorenburg over de werking van de Wet Damocles

MPs Kuiken and Van Toorenburg asked whether a Raad van State ruling of 30 August 2017 deviates from case law on closing homes under the Damocles law (Opiumwet art. 13b), and whether finding drugs in a home remains sufficient grounds for closure. The minister answered that the ruling confirms existing case law: a trade-sized quantity suffices for a presumption of sale, the burden shifts to the resident, and closure powers are unaffected.
This ruling does not deviate from existing case law.
Deze uitspraak wijkt niet af van de bestaande jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over de berichten dat stikstofoverschot de biodiversiteit ernstig bedreigd

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that nitrogen surplus threatens biodiversity, including declining butterflies and capercaillie, and whether PAS measures and RIVM projections are adequate. The minister confirmed the capercaillie reintroduction is failing due to habitat quality, attributed nitrogen deposition partly to agriculture, and argued the PAS assessment shows deterioration will be prevented until 2030, while deferring the post-2030 assessment.
An appropriate assessment has been carried out for the PAS, as prescribed in the Nature Conservation Act.
Voor de PAS is een passende beoordeling uitgevoerd, zoals voorgeschreven in de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het afbreken van een mast van de tweemastklipper Amicitia

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about the mast collapse of the sailing ship Amicitia, the state of certification and inspection of the 'brown fleet', and inspection staffing compared with Germany and Denmark. The minister acknowledged the OVV findings, described inspection intensification and staffing, and promised a fuller response to the OVV recommendations by January 2018.
The accident with the Amicitia has been the reason for me to intensify the existing supervision of the inspection bodies.
Het ongeluk met de Amicitia is voor mij aanleiding geweest om het bestaande toezicht op de keuringsinstanties te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de zeehondentochten op de Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked about proposed closures of sandbanks in the Wadden Sea to seal tour operators, the basis for those proposals, stakeholder consultation and enforcement. The minister replied that the proposals are preliminary, follow a set consultation procedure with a decision planned for spring 2018, and that closures are based on monitoring and enforced, while seal populations are stable.
The closed area is also not enlarged under the current proposals in the starting document, but rather reduced.
Het gesloten gebied wordt ook met de huidige voorstellen in het startdocument niet vergroot, maar juist verkleind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het ontbreken van meetresultaten ammoniakconcentraties

MP Futselaar asked why ammonia concentration measurements from the MAN monitoring network in nature areas have not been published on the RIVM website since 2014, and whether this is linked to the PAS. The minister attributes the delay to technical and methodological reasons (a systematic error correction) and says the 2015 and 2016 data will be published in September, denying any link to the PAS.
The RIVM indicates that the measurement data for 2015 and 2016 will be placed on the MAN website in September of this year.
Het RIVM geeft aan dat de meetdata van 2015 en 2016 in september van dit jaar worden geplaatst op de website van het MAN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de berichten “Vijf jaar na de aardbeving die Groningen wakker schudde” en “Alders in actie tegen afketsen 'Groningen-verzekering'”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM had indicated it would not extract less than 20 billion cubic metres per year, why this was not reported to parliament, and whether the government would pursue alternative gas operators, fund test cases and keep arbiters available for Groningen residents. The minister denied any signal from NAM about a 20 billion cubic metre threshold, said alternative operators were not warranted, deferred the test-case funding to a successor and promised talks with the insurers' association and the National Coordinator.
During the debate of 4 July I indicated that I was not aware of this signal, and that still holds.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van 4 juli aangegeven dat mij dit signaal niet bekend is, en dat geldt nog steeds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over het bericht ‘Tuinbouw in de knel door raffinaderijbrand Pernis’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the greenhouse sector's CO2 supply disruption after the Pernis refinery fire needs an emergency fix and talks with industry to prevent recurrence. The minister replied that CO2 supply is a private arrangement with no government role, but that EZ is exploring additional CO2 sources and buffering within existing green deal and smart grid frameworks, with timing unpredictable and supply restored from 21 August.
This is a collaboration between private parties, in which the government plays no role.
Dit is een samenwerking tussen private partijen, waarbij de overheid geen rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Keijzer over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Health ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands, its consequences for innovation and jobs, and how supply shortages would be prevented. The minister answered that production has been largely abroad for years, that Nederland specialises in R&D, that topsector policy and acquisition efforts continue, and that the medicines register and shortage reporting body would monitor any relocation.
The largest part of medicine production has been taking place outside the Netherlands for a very long time.
Het grootste deel van de geneesmiddelenproductie vindt al heel lang buiten Nederland plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het betalen door data te delen en de verkoop van consumentendata aan bedrijven en de overheid

An SP MP asked the ministers whether consumers should be allowed to obtain products or services free or discounted in exchange for sharing personal and social media data, and whether consumers are adequately informed about data sold to companies or government, including smart appliances. The minister answered that consumers must receive clear, complete information, that personal data processing requires consent under the Wbp and upcoming AVG, that the AP and ACM supervise compliance, and that government access to such data would require a formal legal basis.

If the government wants insight into the same information about the living environment of the home, Article 10(1) of the Constitution requires a statutory provision granting the government such a power.

Wil de overheid inzicht in diezelfde informatie over de leefomgeving van de woning, dan dient krachtens artikel 10, eerste lid, van de Grondwet, een wettelijke bepaling te bestaan die de overheid een dergelijke bevoegdheid toekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over monumenten in het aardbevingsgebied

An MP asked the ministers whether the NAM has bought listed farmhouses and other heritage buildings in the Groningen earthquake area, what will happen to them, and how unlisted characteristic buildings are protected from demolition. The minister answered that NAM owns eight listed monuments plus 74 objects in total, that municipalities are still inventorying characteristic buildings, and that protection runs through zoning plans and a heritage programme, without committing to new state powers.
At this moment it is not known whether this portfolio also contains characteristic and/or defining buildings.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend of zich in deze portefeuille ook beeldbepalende en/of karakteristieke gebouwen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de haalbaarheid van de emissiereductie van broeikasgassen van 25% in 2020

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the CE Delft finding that the 25% greenhouse gas reduction target for 2020 (Urgenda ruling) is very likely unattainable with current policy is accepted, and how the 2017 projection handles the uncertainties (wind onshore, CCS ROAD, electricity imports) and what will be done if the analysis proves right. The Secretary of State disagrees, saying the Energy Agreement targets should close the remaining 4 Mton gap, that ROAD is no longer counted after withdrawal, and that the NEV 2017 will be reviewed with additional measures such as closing a coal plant if needed.
With the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on course to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat gemeenten hun aandelen Eneco verkopen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about municipalities selling their Eneco shares, including concerns about public control of energy, the energy transition and jobs. The minister replies that network operation remains in public hands under the Wet onafhankelijk netbeheer, that the energy transition targets and instruments are unaffected, and that the decision on selling shares lies with the municipal shareholders.
It is up to the shareholders of Eneco to decide whether they wish to give up their shares.
Het is aan de aandeelhouders van Eneco is om te besluiten of zij afstand willen doen van hun aandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport 'Wordt de 25% emissiereductie van broeikasgassen in 2020 gehaald?'

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government whether the CE Delft report showing the 25% CO2 reduction target for 2020 is uncertain should be accepted, what concrete measures will ensure it is met, and why each factor (wind yield, ROAD cancellation, lower electricity imports) pushes emissions higher. The state secretary referred to earlier answers, said the NEV 2017 will give an integrated overview expected in October, promised the ROAD status update for the 2018 budget, and offered no new concrete measures.
The NEV 2017, expected in October, will give an integrated overview of the effects of all relevant energy developments affecting greenhouse gas emissions in the Netherlands.

De NEV 2017, die naar verwachting in oktober uitkomt, zal een integraal overzicht geven van de effecten van alle relevante ontwikkelingen op energiegebied die van invloed zijn op de broeikasgasuitstoot in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het onderzoek naar aardbevingsschade in het buitengebied dat de prullenbak in kan

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister for a detailed response to a critique by a law firm of Witteveen+Bos's study of 1,600 earthquake damage claims in rural Groningen, and whether the minister would consult the National Coordinator Groningen on the demand of the Groninger Gasberaad. The minister replied that the claims were handled under the protocol in force until 31 March 2017, that Parliament had already been informed, that Witteveen+Bos has published a substantive response, and that a meeting between NAM and Gasberaad on an independent review of the study is being arranged.
At the initiative of the NCG, a meeting will soon take place between NAM and Gasberaad, in which the possibility of an independent review of the study will be discussed.
Op initiatief van de NCG zal binnenkort een gesprek plaatsvinden tussen NAM en Gasberaad, waarin de mogelijkheid van een onafhankelijke toetsing van het onderzoek wordt besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Marijnissen over de impact van de Groningse versterkingsopgave voor de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Economic Affairs how the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation affects care institutions, including guarantees of support, who bears costs, resident relocation and compensation, and whether gas extraction should be reduced further. The government answered that a joint programme with the NCG, care providers, insurers and local authorities is being prepared, that NAM pays for safety reinforcement while costs of future-proofing fall to care providers and insurers, and that the production ceiling is reduced by 10% from October 2017 with a broader gas phase-out to be considered in transition paths.
Further details on the implementation of the reinforcement operation will follow once the steering group has completed the programme.
Verdere details over de uitvoering van de versterkingsopgave volgen als de stuurgroep het programma gereed heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Staat van de sector geothermie

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about safety risks, safety culture, permitting, and oversight in the geothermal energy sector, following the SodM 'State of the Sector' report. The minister answered that a 'verbeterplan geothermie' is underway, that new geothermal-specific legislation is targeted for late 2017, and that permit and safety checks, including seismic risk analysis near Groningen, will be tightened, though many answers defer to ongoing work.
It is not acceptable if laws and regulations are not complied with.
Het is niet acceptabel als wet- en regelgeving niet wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verdrievoudiging van de gaswinning bij Wapse

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about tripling gas extraction at Wapse, the MER threshold, subsidence measurement, and the criminal referral of the Vermilion file. The minister defended the permit as meeting legal criteria, argued subsidence is driven by total volume, and declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation.
While the criminal investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any substantive statement about the content of the file or the status and progress of the investigation.
Gaande het strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen inhoudelijke mededeling doen omtrent de inhoud van het dossier, alsmede over de status en voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht “Greenpeace spant kort geding aan om biomassameestook RWE te stoppen”

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Greenpeace's kort geding to stop RWE's biomass co-firing, whether substantive agreements on sawdust origin existed before subsidy payment, and whether the subsidy should be withdrawn. The minister confirmed awareness, said the sustainability criteria are set in the SDE+ scheme, that the dispute falls under a private convenant the government is not party to, and that he will not interfere, declining to withdraw the subsidy.
Given the private-law nature of the agreements in the convenant, I do not wish to interfere in this discussion.
Gelet op het privaatrechtelijke karakter van de afspraken uit het convenant, wil ik mij niet mengen in deze discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over zorgen die er bij het Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen bestaan over de veiligheid bij delfstoffenwinning en geothermie

An MP asks the minister about State Supervision of the Mines' concerns over safety in gas extraction and geothermal energy, including predictability of quakes, offshore decommissioning funding, geothermal operators lacking approved extraction plans, and clearer rules on where mining may take place. The minister acknowledges model uncertainty, promises an interim geothermal framework and tighter Mijnbouwwet rules on decommissioning finance, and says the structure vision on the subsurface is being reviewed.
If SodM finds in the meantime that an unsafe situation arises, SodM will intervene and halt the exploration or extraction.
Indien SodM in de tussentijd constateert dat er zich wel een onveilige situatie voordoet, zal SodM ingrijpen en de opsporing of winning stilleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht van PostNL dat goede bezorging op het platteland binnen enkele jaren onmogelijk wordt

MP Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL's warning that rural mail delivery would become impossible without relaxed rules, including questions on mailbox removal, market decline, the AMM cost estimate and takeover risk. The minister said the UPD's financial sustainability is under pressure, that policy choices are for the next cabinet, that about 26% of 2,082 net mailbox removals were rural, and that volume decline exceeded earlier forecasts.
The choice for new policy is for the next cabinet.
De keuze voor nieuw beleid is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de voorgestelde forse daling van de subsidiebedragen voor duurzame energie productie (SDE+)

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether cutting SDE+ renewable energy subsidy amounts for 2018 undermines the 14% renewable target, the government's steering role, and environmental and landscape safeguards, including the Eemshaven cable routing. The minister defends the proposed basisbedragen as cost-driven, says consultation is still ongoing with a final advice pending, and denies that environmental concerns are neglected.
Based on the final advice, I will decide together with the Minister of Finance on opening the SDE+ 2018, and will inform your House of this in the autumn.
Op basis van het eindadvies zal ik samen met de Minister van Financiën besluiten over de openstelling van de SDE+ 2018. Hier zal ik uw Kamer in het najaar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het achterblijven van de categorie biobrandstof als aandeel in duurzame energie

An SP MP asked why biofuel blending in petrol and diesel lags despite legal obligations, and why the CBS figures on actual biofuel use are uncertain. The state secretary acknowledged the gap between CBS and register figures, attributed it to 2015 rule changes allowing early booking, and said a legal amendment would tie booking to delivery at the pump, with a decision deferred until talks with NEa, CBS and industry conclude.
Before the end of the year I will inform the House of the outcomes.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat gemeenten pleiten voor een verplichte bedenktijd voor de aanschaf van huisdieren

An SP MP asked whether the government would respond to 36 municipalities calling for a mandatory cooling-off period before buying pets, and about enforcement against illegal online pet and puppy trade, a 'white list' of dog sellers, and the extension of the pet species list. The Secretary of State answered that existing 2014 rules should be evaluated before adding new measures, pointed to planned evaluation under the Wet dieren, said enforcement is limited to complaints for private owners, and promised further information on Marktplaats cooperation and a white list.
I am of the view that these measures, introduced on 1 July 2014, should be given a chance and evaluated before new measures are taken.
Ik ben van mening dat deze maatregelen, die 1 juli 2014 zijn ingesteld, een kans moeten krijgen en geëvalueerd moeten worden alvorens nieuwe maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Hijink over de plannen van postbedrijf Sandd

Two MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister whether he had long held postal firm Sandd's plans to deliver post cheaper than PostNL, whether those plans threaten postal workers' pay and conditions under the Tijdelijk Besluit Postbezorgers, what labour criteria apply when appointing a Universal Postal Service provider, and whether Sandd complies with the 80% permanent-contract rule. The minister confirmed receiving Sandd's information memorandum in November 2016, said arbeidsvoorwaarden rules apply and flexibility is needed, left compliance monitoring to the ACM, and noted that terminating the existing government contract is legally difficult.
It is therefore not for me to make a statement on this.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het artikel “Nieuwe lekkage AkzoNobel in Hengelo: kalk en pekel gelekt”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a new large leak at AkzoNobel in Hengelo, the timeliness of reporting to SodM, a list of leaks, the company's safety management and whether its permits will be reviewed. The minister answered that the leaks were reported to SodM in time (except one, put 335), that SodM supervises AkzoNobel's safety management and leak list, and that a new risk analysis and pipeline renovation are underway, with permit revision planned.
SodM has therefore asked AkzoNobel to carry out a new risk analysis following this recent leak.
SodM heeft daarom AkzoNobel gevraagd om naar aanleiding van deze recente lekkage een nieuwe risicoanalyse uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de totstandkoming van een fiscaal gunstige tegemoetkoming aan chemieconcern ICL

Green Left MP Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance and the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade about emails suggesting a tax ruling was agreed with chemical group ICL, despite the State Secretary's claim that he did not know one existed, and about related audit, negotiation and subsidy questions. The government declined to confirm or deny a ruling citing tax secrecy, described the ICL correspondence as a letter of intent and pre-meeting, and rejected the characterisation of negotiation and subsidy as reflecting actual practice.

As indicated in the thirty-member debate of 5 July, the cabinet cannot, because of the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, confirm or deny whether an APA or ATR was issued to ICL.

Zoals in het dertigledendebat van 5 juli jl. is aangegeven, kan het kabinet vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen niet bevestigen of ontkennen of een APA (Advance Pricing Agreement) of ATR (Advance Tax Ruling) is afgegeven aan ICL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het opdrijven van prijzen van hotelkamers door boekingswebsites

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the minister whether hotel-booking platforms' 'lowest price' clauses restrict hotels and whether they should be banned, along with commission rises, room vacancy effects and Booking.com's promotion of student room rentals. The minister rejected a ban, stating that platform contracts are private matters, that ACM has already loosened the clauses, and that rental of student rooms is restricted by contract and law rather than by Booking.com's campaign.
I am not aware of the content of such agreements, which are concluded between two private parties.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van dergelijke overeenkomsten die tussen twee private partijen worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat malware mogelijk energiebedrijven kan platleggen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Industroyer malware, reported by ESET, could disrupt Dutch energy companies given similar equipment and protocols, and what the government role is in protecting vital infrastructure. The government answered that intrusion is a prerequisite, that responsibility lies primarily with companies under Elektriciteitswet and Gaswet with ACM supervision, that the NCSC advises vital providers, and that the NIS directive implementation bill was in consultation.
Government and vital organisations work together in the Netherlands to protect vital infrastructure.
Overheid en vitale organisaties werken in Nederland samen aan de bescherming van de vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Rijksdienst: 'Maak van niet te redden monumenten ruïnes'

MPs Van Tongeren and Dik-Faber asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed was effectively giving up on monuments in the Groningen earthquake area by recommending ruins, and how the government would protect heritage. The ministers replied that the RCE's framework aims to preserve monuments, that some monuments may be irreparable with owners and municipalities deciding, that data on their number is lacking, and that a heritage programme will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
At this moment we do not yet have sufficient data available to make a reliable statement about this.
Op dit moment hebben wij nog niet voldoende gegevens beschikbaar om hier een betrouwbare uitspraak over te kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked whether personal data held by UWV and other government bodies, including data stored abroad, can be guaranteed to stay out of reach of the US government after reports that Google must hand over user data. The government answered that it cannot give such a guarantee because legal bases such as mutual legal assistance treaties allow transfers to the US, and it does not plan extra measures against foreign storage beyond case-by-case risk assessment.
No, I cannot give that guarantee.
Nee, die garantie kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over nieuwe problemen die ontstaan naar aanleiding van de versterkingsopgave van woningen in Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new problems arising from the reinforcement of houses in Groningen, including calls to separate SodM from the ministry, the safety standard used, the 13,000 unresolved damage claims and verjaring risks, and the role of municipalities. The minister largely defended the existing arrangements, pointing to the NCG's Meerjarenprogramma, the new schadeprotocol, and a planned annual review of gas extraction levels, while stating that total scope cannot yet be determined.
Regarding SodM's positioning relative to the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the cabinet recently took a position following the Safety Board's evaluation of earthquake risks in Groningen.

Over de positionering van SodM ten opzichte van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (EZ) heeft het kabinet onlangs, naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid inzake aardbevingsrisico’s in Groningen, een standpunt ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over het modelcontract voor de energiemarkt

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the model energy contract is confusing, sometimes not actually available, and not offered by four of 26 suppliers. The minister said he had no further signals beyond the report, passed the concerns to the ACM regulator, and noted the model contract has not been formally evaluated.
I have therefore passed the signal about the model contract on to the ACM.
Het signaal over het modelcontract heb ik dan ook aan de ACM doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de vergelijkingssite van de energieleveranciers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the energy comparison website and whether model contracts are offered there, whether comparison sites must include them, the notice period, and redress for consumers. The minister answered that suppliers must offer model contracts on their own sites, comparison sites may choose which products to include but must be clear about it, the 30-day notice period applies, and complaints go first to the supplier and then to the Geschillencommissie Energie, with the ACM supervising.
The signal that the model contract could not in all cases actually be concluded, I have therefore passed on to the ACM.
Het signaal over het modelcontract dat niet in alle gevallen daadwerkelijk af te sluiten zou zijn, heb ik dan ook aan de ACM doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over het optreden van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

MPs Van Dijk and Hijink asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Consumer and Markets Authority (ACM) rarely acts against deception and fraud by firms, including a stalled enforcement request and a debt collector under scrutiny for four years, and whether the ACM should be given more teeth or replaced by a separate consumer authority. The minister answered that the ACM has adequate instruments and fines, that enforcement choices are its own, that the handling of one enforcement request was flawed, and that no new proposals or a separate authority are planned.
I cannot give any information about possible investigations concerning a specific company.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken betreffende een specifiek bedrijf kan ik geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg-Janssen over nationale veiligheidseisen bij aanbestedingen van cruciale communicatiediensten van de overheid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about national security requirements in government tenders for critical communication services, including price as a selection criterion, openness of the tender, Brexit-related hacking risks, foreign ownership and oversight capacity. The minister replied that quality including security is an important criterion, that security and privacy requirements apply, that the government sees no need for a locality requirement or extra capacity, and that cross-departmental ex-ante analyses of national security risks are underway.
For communication of state-secret information, the Government Information Security Instruction 2013 requires ministerial approval, advised by the Working Group on Special Information.
Voor communicatie van staatsgeheime informatie is in het Voorschrift Informatiebeveiliging Rijkdienst Bijzondere Informatie 2013 (VIRBI 2013) bepaald dat ministeriële goedkeuring noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over het artikel "Scholen steken voor onderwijs bedoelde miljoenen in de kachel"

Two MPs asked the government whether it is undesirable that school boards spend education funds on cleaning, maintenance and energy, and whether it will act on school energy use and building sustainability. The State Secretary answered that lump-sum funding gives school boards freedom of spending, that primary school finances are sound, and pointed to existing energy rules and a subsidy scheme for school sustainability advice.
School boards themselves weigh whether to spend more or less on materials or personnel.
Schoolbesturen maken zelf de afweging om meer of minder middelen uit te geven aan materieel of personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de berichten “Vakkracht blijft schaars” en “Schreeuw om vakkracht”

The MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the shortage of skilled workers, cross-border labour mobility, reshoring, vmbo-mbo cooperation, technical education trends, student choice and a national labour market monitor. The ministers answered by describing the Techniekpact, the Actieteam GEA, reshoring policy, regional investment and cooperation programmes, and existing information tools, without addressing executive oversight.
The Techniekpact is intended to improve the alignment of science and technology education with the labour market and thereby reduce the shortage of science and technology personnel.
Het Techniekpact is bedoeld om de aansluiting van het bètatechnische onderwijs op de arbeidsmarkt verbeteren en daarmee het tekort aan bètatechnisch personeel terugdringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het artikel ‘Akzo en ministerie spanden samen tegen PPG, blijkt uit mails’

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that AkzoNobel and the ministry coordinated against PPG, and whether two VVD-linked AkzoNobel supervisory board members created a perception of conflict of interest. The minister acknowledged the board composition and declined to see any conflict of interest or harm to political integrity, without addressing the substance of the coordination reports.
I do not see why conflict of interest or harm to the standing of politics would be at issue in any way.
Ik zie niet waarom belangenverstrengeling of het schaden van het aanzien van de politiek op enigerlei wijze aan de orde zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over kleinschalige experimenten op het gebied van innovatief ondernemerschap

An MP (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about whether innovation policy is effective, the scope for small-scale experiments and legal room to exempt innovators from regulation. The minister answered that evaluation methods are adequate, that experiments are welcome with methodological caveats, and that existing legal frameworks are being reviewed without committing to new powers.
I cannot agree with the finding that good experiments hardly get off the ground.
Ik kan mij niet vinden in de constatering dat goede experimenten amper van de grond komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands while thriving abroad, and what the government will do to keep research and production in the country. The minister answers that the number of firms has been stable, that production is under pressure due to specialisation, that the government supports life sciences policy and IMI participation, and that it is working to attract the European Medicines Agency, without committing to new concrete measures.
The research has not declined, but there are signals that production is under pressure.
Het onderzoek is niet afgenomen, maar er zijn signalen dat de productie onder druk staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de complexiteit van de regeling verlaagd tarief bij collectieve opwek of postcoderoosregeling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about the complexity of the reduced VAT rate scheme for collective renewable energy and the postcode rose scheme, including inconsistent tax office assessments, the effect of moving out of the postcode area, and whether a separate SDE+ category should be created. The government answered that VAT treatment depends on contractual arrangements, that an inventory of cases is underway, that moving out of the area can affect participation with only limited extra administrative burden, that the scheme will be evaluated this autumn, and that a separate SDE+ category would not reduce complexity and would harm effectiveness.
This autumn the evaluation of the scheme will begin.
Dit najaar zal begonnen worden met de evaluatie van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Patstelling postcoderoos tussen energieleveranciers en coöperaties'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is undesirable that customers of some energy suppliers cannot take part in the postcoderoos scheme, and whether the minister will oblige suppliers to participate or address the issue in the evaluation. The minister says all suppliers should participate ideally, will look at administrative burdens in the evaluation, but does not currently plan to make participation mandatory, leaving initiative with suppliers.
I am currently not considering obliging the energy suppliers.
Ik overweeg op dit moment niet om de energieleveranciers te verplichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over voedselverspilling voor energiewinning

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about food waste being diverted to anaerobic digesters for energy, including subsidy effects, energy crop land use, co-digestion controls and the SDE+ incentive. The State Secretary largely defended the policy as technology-neutral and needed for renewable energy targets, noted that enforcement by the NVWA has been strengthened, and promised follow-up through a biomass and food transition agenda.
In the programme De Monitor I said I am willing to examine whether the subsidy on biogas digestion leads to good food being used for digestion.
In het programma De Monitor heb ik gezegd dat ik bereid ben na te gaan of er door de subsidie op biovergisting goed voedsel voor vergisting gebruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over de aanbesteding van mobiele telefonie

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked how government data, including phone traffic of civil servants, is stored and protected against foreign access such as under the USA Freedom Act, and what contract conditions apply to the new mobile telephony tender. The minister answered that data location is assessed per case, that EEA-only processing, notification duties and termination rights were included in the new contract, and that the Vodafone-Ziggo joint venture did not trigger termination.
To prevent data being processed or shared by the contractor in breach of Dutch law, requirements have been included in the contract.
Om te voorkomen dat in strijd met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving gegevens door de opdrachtnemer worden verwerkt of gedeeld, zijn eisen in het contract opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over het grote aantal gunningen van infrastructuurprojecten aan buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked why foreign builders won a large share of major infrastructure contracts and how this fits the Marktvisie. The minister replied that most GWW contracts went to Dutch firms, that foreign partners add expertise and better price-quality, and that the government and market will jointly implement the Marktvisie.
The large majority of the contracts went to Dutch construction firms: 49 of the 53 GWW contracts in the study were awarded to (combinations of) companies with no foreign involvement.

Het overgrote deel van de opdrachten is naar Nederlandse bouwbedrijven gegaan: 49 van de 53 GWW opdrachten uit het onderzoek zijn gegund aan (combinaties van) bedrijven waar geen sprake is van buitenlandse inbreng.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het onterecht afwijzen van bevingsschades rond Emmen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why earlier quake-damage claims around Emmen were rejected by Witteveen+Bos, despite criticism from the technical commission Tcbb, and whether affected residents can get counter-expertise. The minister said the Tcbb review is attached, that the protocol will be improved with the Tcbb, that residents can request a second opinion from the Tcbb under the Mijnbouwwet, and that the NAM voucher concerned Groningen rather than Emmen.
I take its conclusions very seriously and will, together with the Tcbb, examine how an improved protocol for damage handling can be shaped.
Ik neem haar conclusies zeer serieus en zal zoals hierboven al aangegeven samen met de Tcbb bekijken hoe vorm gegeven kan worden aan een verbeterd protocol voor schadeafhandeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het teruggeven van het geld aan het bedrijfsleven uit de reserves van de product- en bedrijfschappen

An MP asked the government about reserves of the former product and trade boards and how leftover funds will be used, and asked for an overview of reserves, social plan spending, the liquidator's costs and timing. The government answered that reserves are published per board, that the liquidation runs to 2018 or later with leftover funds to be used for a general purpose benefiting the sector, and gave staffing and cost figures.

As I indicated to the House, I intend to decide on what can best be done with the money once it is clear whether any money remains and, if so, how much, and it is my intention to inform the House of that.

Zoals ik in de Kamer heb aangegeven ben ik van plan om op het moment dat duidelijk is of er geld over is en, zo ja, hoeveel een besluit te nemen over wat er zo goed mogelijk met dat geld kan worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voornemen last onder dwangsom gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

An MP asked why the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) rejected a enforcement request on gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, why the NAM's long-term subsidence study was judged insufficient, and whether extraction would be halted. The minister defended the rejection and the deadline handling, said the IGM independently judged the study inadequate and intends a penalty order, and declined to give opinions on the study or to halt extraction, pointing to the Auditcommissie and the Hand aan de Kraan procedure.
As Minister, I cannot and will not give judgments or instructions on the study to be delivered or on this assessment by the IGM.
Als Minister kan en wil ik geen oordelen of aanwijzingen geven over het op te leveren onderzoek of dit oordeel van de IGM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Consument & Markt een rekenhulp introduceert voor roamingkosten

The MP asks whether consumers are adequately informed about limits on the EU roam-like-at-home rules, whether intra-EU calls to other member states should be regulated, and whether the minister will push for EU regulation. The minister says consumers are sufficiently informed through contract terms and notifications, that cross-border calling pricing is market-driven and not generically out of proportion to cost, and that he does not wish to advocate EU regulation of intra-EU calls.
I am of the view that consumers are sufficiently informed about these limitations under the EU roaming rules.
Ik ben van mening dat consumenten op grond van de roamingregels in de EU voldoende worden ingelicht over deze beperkingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de rechterlijke uitspraak waarin staat dat het Openbaar Ministerie strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet doen naar de aardbevingsschade die is veroorzaakt door de gaswinning van

An MP asked ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service should investigate Groningen earthquake damage caused by NAM gas extraction, whether the Landelijk Parket should take the case, and whether the Raad van State hearing should be delayed. The government confirmed it would not appeal the Dijk ruling, declined to direct the prosecutor in an individual case, and said it would not further delay the July 2017 Raad van State hearing.
The Minister of Security and Justice may, under the Judiciary Organisation Act, give general and specific instructions on the performance of the Public Prosecution Service's duties and powers.

De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie kan volgens de Wet op de Rechterlijke Organisatie algemene en bijzondere aanwijzingen geven betreffende de uitvoering van de taken en bevoegdheden van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat nieuwbouwwoningen nog steeds op gas worden aangesloten

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they accept that stopping new homes from being connected to gas is vital for Groningen and climate goals, how the many already-built homes will switch later, and how municipalities wanting gas-free building can be supported. The minister agreed the step is important, said the gas-connection obligation will be replaced by a connection right via amendment and the Omgevingswet would let municipalities set their own rules, and pointed to the Green Deal and a transition path, without giving a firm timeline.
The bill on progress of the energy transition (Kamerstuk 34 627) is pending before your House, with amendments submitted on the right to a gas connection.
Bij uw Kamer is aanhangig het wetsvoorstel voortgang energietransitie (Kamerstuk 34 627 ) waarop amendementen zijn ingediend met betrekking tot het recht op een gasaansluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat in nieuwbouw nog steeds vaak aardgas wordt aangesloten

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that new homes are still often connected to the gas grid, including the cost of connections and alternatives, and how this fits the Energy Agenda's plan to end the gas connection obligation. The Minister estimated that over 80% of new homes are still gas-connected, said a law change to remove the obligation will follow via an amendment, and pointed to existing municipal and Green Deal options while giving no firm timeline.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Maak haast met gasloos’

MPs Van der Lee and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on slow progress in building gas-free new homes, and whether the gas connection obligation should be scrapped and gas networks replaced with renewable heat plans. The minister said gas-free building is already possible, a change to the Gas Act is planned via an amendment, and no national overview of network replacement dates exists yet.
Amending the Gas Act is desirable to give effect to the Energy Agenda intention that in principle no new gas infrastructure is laid in new-build neighbourhoods.
Aanpassing van de Gaswet is wenselijk om het voornemen uit de Energieagenda te effectueren dat in beginsel geen nieuwe gasinfrastructuur meer aangelegd wordt in nieuwbouwwijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de stelling dat de aardbevingsproblematiek is opgeblazen tot bureaucratisch monstrum

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the earthquake problem in Groningen has become a bureaucratic monster, and about how value loss is assessed in the three-expert procedure, the outcomes compared with research, and the buy-out scheme. The minister declined to comment on the merits of the value-loss scheme because it is before the courts, explained the methods and CBS findings, and said a follow-up to the buy-out pilot is being prepared.
Since the case is still before the court, I cannot make substantive statements about it.
Aangezien de zaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik hierover geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Google must hand over user data stored in foreign data centres to the US, and whether Dutch government data and citizens are protected from foreign surveillance. The Minister of the Interior answered that location decisions are left to each responsible body within existing rules, that full protection and an overview of data locations cannot be guaranteed, and that US court ruling and Judicial Redress Act issues apply only in limited ways.

It is not appropriate for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to have an up-to-date overview of where the data of all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions are stored.

Het is niet aan de orde dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties moet beschikken over een actueel overzicht van de locatie waar de data van alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semipublieke instellingen zijn opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van gasboringen in de Wadden

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether recent NAM research shows that subsidence forecasts after gas production stops are highly uncertain, whether the Natura 2000 policy premise still holds, whether the Wadden 'accommodation space' is exceeded, and why the LTS study was delayed. The minister answered that SodM judged the NAM study insufficient but correctable by October 2017, that no exceedance of the natural limit is currently foreseen, that the 'hand on the tap' commitment stands, and that no evidence of deliberate delay was found.

The State Supervision of Mines (SodM) indicates that the identified shortcomings in the NAM study, traced by SodM to a number of concretely named points for improvement, can and must be remedied by 31 October 2017.

Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) geeft aan dat de geconstateerde tekortkomingen in de NAM-studie, die door SodM zijn herleid tot een aantal concreet benoemde verbeterpunten, uiterlijk 31 oktober 2017 hersteld kunnen en moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vertraging en gebrek aan kennis bij herstel van schade en versterking van monumentaal erfgoed in de provincie Groningen

An MP from ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays and lack of heritage expertise in repairing and reinforcing listed buildings in Groningen, including criticism of the Centrum Veilig Wonen and the reported scrapping of a heritage help desk, and asks about progress on a motion for a coherent heritage policy. The minister replies that expertise requirements, a pilot and a joint heritage programme under the National Coordinator Groningen are underway, that the programme will be sent to parliament after summer, and that talks with owners' organisations are in place, while giving no firm commitment on reinstating the help desk.
I aim to send the heritage programme to your House after the summer.
Ik streef ernaar het erfgoedprogramma na de zomer aan te bieden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Gronings Erfgoedloket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the NCG had abandoned a heritage help desk for Groningen monuments, why the tender was halted, what budget is available, and whether the response to earthquake damage to heritage is adequate. The minister said the desk is still planned, the tender was stopped on procurement grounds, a joint heritage programme is being developed, and a separate approach and budget for heritage is agreed in principle.
Alongside the budgets needed for damage repair and reinforcement by NAM, the joint heritage programme will determine which budget is needed.
Naast de benodigde budgetten voor schadeherstel en versterken bij NAM zal in het kader van het gezamenlijke erfgoedprogramma in beeld gebracht worden welk budget nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen voor olie- en aardgaswinning bij Woerden

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about plans to extract gas at the Papekop field near Woerden, covering Vermilion's financial guarantees, the cumulative risk and reservation of funds, and the weight given to local objections. The minister answered that Vermilion has not yet applied for an environmental permit or submitted an updated extraction plan, that creditworthiness is assessed through several means, and that regional authorities will be consulted under the new Mining Act procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de voortzetting van betaalme.nu

MP Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about late payments to SMEs, the future of the Betaalme.nu self-regulation initiative and whether its subsidy will be extended. The minister said payment behaviour has improved but there is room for more, that self-regulation remains important alongside the 60-day payment-term law, and that talks on Betaalme.nu's future are ongoing with the subsidy ending in August 2017.
We are currently in discussion with Betaalme.nu and with representatives of the business community about the future of Betaalme.nu.
Over het vervolg van Betaalme.nu zijn we op dit moment in gesprek met Betaalme.nu en met vertegenwoordigers van het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Groningen nog 400 zwaardere aardbevingen te wachten staat

MP Nijboer asked the minister about a report predicting 400 more severe earthquakes for Groningen and whether the damage would be overwhelming. The minister replied that the Hagoort method is a simplified version of NAM's assessment, its outcomes fall within NAM's range, and that a NAM damage methodology report is due by 1 November 2017, after which further policy will be decided.
Depending on these outcomes, I will determine whether additional policy is needed and, if so, how this will be shaped.
Afhankelijk van deze uitkomsten bepaal ik of er aanvullend beleid nodig is en zo ja, hoe dit wordt vorm gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht 'Onzichtbare regeldruk van honderden miljoenen euro’s teistert bedrijfsleven'

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that policy rules (beleidsregels) by implementing bodies create hidden regulatory burden for business, and whether these burdens are quantified and reduced. The minister answered that policy rules are formally not legislation and cannot add obligations, that the cited cases largely reflect existing law, inspection instructions or business-own costs, and that knotty cases will be addressed through the existing maatwerk approach without coordinating or quantifying policy rules further.
Policy rules are formally not legislation, so they cannot contain additional obligations for citizens, businesses and institutions beyond those already following from the legislation they elaborate.

Beleidsregels zijn formeel geen wetgeving. Ze kunnen dan ook geen aanvullende verplichtingen voor burgers, bedrijven en instellingen bevatten ten opzichte van de verplichtingen die al volgen uit de wetgeving ter uitwerking waarvan de beleidsregels zijn opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Paternotte over het niet in kaart brengen van bepaalde regeldruk

MPs Mulder (CDA) and Paternotte (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why regulatory burden from ministry, agency and supervisor policy rules is not measured, whether it counts toward the 2.5 billion euro reduction target, and what the Actal advisory council's findings on policy rules imply. The minister replied that policy rules are not formally legislation and are not counted, that no follow-up research is needed, that he is not convinced of additional costs from policy rules, but that bottlenecks will be tackled through case-by-case work and invites businesses to report problems.
Policy rules are formally speaking not legislation.
Beleidsregels zijn formeel gezien geen wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de toekomstige beschikbaarheid van IC-prototypes voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en wetenschappelijk onderzoek

MP Bruins asked the minister whether the EU's decision not to continue funding Europractice, which provides chip prototyping services to universities and industry, would harm Dutch science and industry, and whether alternative, more continuous funding could be sought. The minister answered that Europractice-PLUS failed the minimum quality threshold in the EU evaluation, that the Netherlands has raised the issue with the Commission and other member states, and that a follow-up proposal may be submitted to a call expected in October 2017.
The Netherlands raised this issue at a meeting of this Committee on 18 May.
Nederland heeft deze kwestie tijdens een zitting van dit Committee aan de orde gesteld op 18 mei jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Wassenberg en Beckerman over het bericht 'Netherlands to get first US LNG cargot'

MPs Van Tongeren, Wassenberg and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that a US shale gas LNG cargo would arrive in Rotterdam, whether it is meant for the Dutch market, whether shale gas from the US is undesirable, and whether the government can block this transport. The minister answered that the buyer decides the destination, that the origin of the gas cannot be verified, that countries are sovereign over their resources, and that a blockade would be unenforceable, contrary to EU law and to diversification goals.
In doing so, I see no reason nor possibility to impose a blockade on gas from the United States or on shale gas.
Daarbij zie ik geen reden noch mogelijkheid om een blokkade op te werpen ten aanzien van gas uit de Verenigde Staten of ten aanzien van schaliegas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Von Martels over berichten dat consumenten problemen met hun voertuig ondervinden na het toepassen van de software-update van Volkswagen

MPs Van Eijs and Von Martels asked whether the Volkswagen software update causes higher fuel use, power loss and EGR valve failures, whether EGR removal is adequately regulated, and how consumers are compensated. The minister replied that independent tests (KBA, RDW, TNO) found no negative effects on fuel use or power, that a ban on removing emission controls is being prepared, and that PON handles complaints individually while the recall is voluntary for consumers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de overname van uitvaartorganisatie De Facultatieve

An SP MP asked the Economics and Finance Ministers about the acquisition of funeral organisation De Facultatieve, including share rules, valuation, the shared accountant, and member involvement. The government declined to judge the private transaction, pointed to the civil code, accountant independence rules and public company records, and noted Hermans' Senate side-functions.
The cabinet has no involvement in the ownership and business transactions of individual private enterprises and organisations.
Het kabinet heeft geen bemoeienis met het eigenaarschap en de zakelijke transacties van afzonderlijke private ondernemingen en organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de ‘Vrienden van de Industrie’

An MP asked why the Netherlands did not join the Friends of Industry coalition and whether it would do so, and how it intends to influence the upcoming EU industrial strategy. The minister explained that the Netherlands was present but did not co-sign due to opposition to the 20% industrial share target, and outlined its general EU industrial policy approach without committing to joining.
The Netherlands does not support this target because the services sector is not included and, through servitisation, the distinction between manufacturing and services is increasingly blurring.

Nederland steunt deze inzet niet omdat de dienstensector hier niet in mee wordt genomen en door «servitisation» het onderscheid tussen maakindustrie en dienstverlening steeds verder aan het vervagen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat volgens de rechter een datavrije muziekbundel niet in strijd is met netneutraliteit

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a court ruling that T-Mobile's data-free music bundle does not violate net neutrality, and about the consequences for Dutch law. The minister answered that the ruling makes the categorical ban on zero-rating in the Telecommunications Act unenforceable, that the ACM will not appeal, and that the ban will likely be removed, while the ACM investigates whether T-Mobile's specific offer breaches the EU regulation.
Since the ACM is not appealing, it makes sense to remove the categorical ban on price discrimination from the Telecommunications Act.
Nu de ACM niet in hoger beroep gaat, ligt het in de rede om het categorische verbod op prijsdiscriminatie in de Telecommunicatiewet te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de verkoop van een bedrijfstak door Unilever

An SP MP asked ministers whether the government would respond to Unilever's plan to sell its margarine division, its effect on jobs and R&D, subsidies received, and whether a takeover cooling-off period proposed by Hommen should be supported. The minister said the government is talking with Unilever to keep the activities in the Netherlands, respects the company's own commercial decisions, explained the existing takeover rules supervised by the AFM, and said subsidy recovery is not possible because no traceable commitments were made.
The cabinet is in talks with Unilever to keep the company and its activities in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met Unilever om het bedrijf en zijn activiteiten voor Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked whether activist investor Elliott's demand that the AkzoNobel supervisory board chair resign, and reported sharing of price-sensitive information with PPG, is realistic as serving the company's continuity and how the government views this conduct. The minister answered that the matter falls under the Dutch corporate law framework (shareholder meetings, 10% and 3% thresholds, Code response times), declined to confirm the information-sharing allegation because the AFM is responsible and bound by confidentiality, and stated that shareholders may pursue their interests within bounds of reasonableness, with greater responsibility for larger stakes.
Because of the confidentiality obligation resting on the AFM, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege de op de AFM rustende geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen hierover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Unilever is straks misschien niet meer Nederlands'

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Unilever possibly ceasing to be Dutch, the protection mechanisms other countries use against foreign takeovers, the tax benefits Unilever receives, and the AkzoNobel takeover dispute. The government replied that it keeps an open stance on takeovers, outlined protection mechanisms in other countries and the Netherlands, said it is talking to Unilever, refused to disclose individual tax benefits citing tax secrecy, and said the AkzoNobel dispute is a private matter for the courts.
Under the tax secrecy provision of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no statements can be made about the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsbepaling van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kunnen immers geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a possible hostile takeover of AkzoNobel by PPG, the role of the AkzoNobel foundation, competition and job effects, works council protections, and whether the Wet ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie could protect firms of national importance. The minister answered that boards must weigh stakeholder interests, that the priority-share foundation can appoint management in a hostile bid, that competition authorities would review any merger, and that the telecom bill covers only national security and public order, not jobs or headquarters.
It is not possible to state the consequences of a possible split for employment; this depends heavily on what the parties involved agree.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevolgen van een eventuele splitsing op de werkgelegenheid te geven, dit is sterk afhankelijk van wat de betrokken partijen afspreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het schadeonderzoek Groningen Buitengebied

The SP MP Beckerman asked the minister whether the Witteveen+Bos damage study on the Groningen outer area, commissioned by NAM, is credible and whether NAM should withdraw from damage handling. The minister answered that an independent steering committee supervised the study, that NAM is withdrawing, that a one-off offer of up to 1,500 euro for non-recognised damage is being made, and that residents keep their choice and existing procedures.
Residents make their own independent assessment of whether to accept this NAM offer or not.
Bewoners maken een zelfstandige afweging of zij dit aanbod van NAM accepteren of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de schadeafhandeling in Groningen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the handling of earthquake damage claims in Groningen, including halted repairs, the closing of the old claims procedure, slow or inadequate settlements in specific villages, the NAM's 1,500 euro offer, and an independent damage commission. The minister mostly answers that individual cases cannot be discussed publicly, that a new procedure starts on 1 July 2017, and that details of the new independent commission are not yet settled.
It does not befit me as Minister to publicly exchange views with the House of Representatives on the details of individual damage cases.
Het past mij als Minister niet om in het openbaar met de Tweede Kamer van gedachten te wisselen over de details van individuele schadegevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de NAM toch meepraat over het nieuwe op te stellen schadeprotocol

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM's continued involvement in drafting the new damage protocol for Groningen gas-extraction claims undermines residents' trust, and whether the minister would halt talks with NAM. The minister answered that NAM will no longer assess or settle damage claims under the new procedure run by the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen, though NAM remains liable and will be consulted only on liability.
NAM will no longer have any involvement in assessing damage or determining compensation amounts under the new procedure.
NAM heeft in de nieuwe procedure geen betrokkenheid meer bij de beoordeling van schades en de vaststelling van schadebedragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over stijgende winsten en haperende investeringen

Opposition MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why profits are rising while business investment lags, and whether corporate tax cuts would spur investment. The government answered that lower interest rates and cyclical factors explain tax revenue, that investment levels are not structurally low, and that investment decisions are primarily for firms, leaving further measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to decide on any measures to further promote business investment.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te besluiten over eventuele maatregelen om investeringen door het bedrijfsleven verder te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over berichten dat Duitsland en andere lidstaten in Europa verbetervoorstellen naar aanleiding van het dieselgateschandaal blokkeren

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether Germany and other member states are blocking EU proposals to strengthen type-approval and market surveillance after the diesel emissions scandal, including EU retesting and fining powers, and what the Dutch position is. The ministers replied that negotiations are ongoing, the Dutch position broadly supports the Commission proposal with alternative methods, and they will report on RDW follow-up investigations and the D66 and European Parliament recommendations later.

To prevent a potential new diesel scandal, I am committed to strengthening the system of market surveillance of, and type approval for, motor vehicles and the uniform application of regulations throughout the EU.

Om een potentieel nieuw dieselschandaal te voorkomen zet ik me in voor versterking van het systeem van markttoezicht op – en typegoedkeuring van motorvoertuigen en de uniforme toepassing van de regelgeving in de gehele EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de ‘hoge kosten voor het verwijderen van een gasaansluiting’

An MP (D66) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about high costs for disconnecting a gas connection, asking about tariff ranges, cost transparency, sealing as an alternative, and whether high costs deter the energy transition. The minister said tariffs vary by grid operator, are cost-based and checked by the regulator ACM only on dispute or market signals, sealing is temporary, and the transition costs will be distributed proportionately.
The regulator checks the cost structure of the tariffs charged for removing a connection when a dispute is filed or when market signals give cause to do so.

De toezichthouder controleert de kostenopbouw van de in rekening gebrachte tarieven voor het verwijderen van een aansluiting wanneer daarover een geschil wordt ingediend of wanneer signalen vanuit de markt daar aanleiding toe geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de digitale veiligheid van bedrijven

MP Hijink (SP) asked the ministers whether companies are doing enough on digital security, what powers exist to enforce cybersecurity duties of care and whether self-regulation suffices. The government answers that it will actively promote the Cyber Security Raad handreiking, that enforcement is split between the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, civil courts and the ACM, that no data exist on negligent firms, and that stimulating duties of care is judged more effective than strict enforcement.
There is no insight into the number of companies that knowingly ignore their cybersecurity responsibilities or use exemption clauses.
Er bestaat geen inzicht in het aantal bedrijven dat hun verantwoordelijkheid voor wat betreft cybersecurity bewust negeert of ontsnappingsclausules hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Nieuw schadeprotocol gaswinning vanaf 1 juli'

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the reported withdrawal of NAM from Groningen damage handling and its takeover by the National Coordinator Groningen, plus related questions on contracts, burden of proof, arbiters, the Technical Commission on ground movement, Centrum Veilig Wonen and gas extraction reduction. The minister answered most questions briefly, largely by referring to earlier letters and debates, stating no additional agreements exist, the new protocol will be set by 1 July 2017, and a further 10% production cut is being prepared.
No additional agreements have been concluded.
Er zijn geen aanvullende overeenkomsten gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de winning van hoog- en laagcalorisch gas

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs which fields supply high- and low-calorific gas, how conversion installations are fed and used, their history, and related capacity and industrial connection questions. The minister answered in detail on field allocation, Wobbe-index ranges, nitrogen conversion use rising sharply since 2015, cost and feasibility of switching industrial users, and storage capacity at Norg.
Making a breakdown of the Wobbe index per well adds no value.
Het maken van een uitsplitsing naar de Wobbe-index per put heeft geen toegevoegde waarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat ‘Nederland minder nieuwe glasvezelverbindingen krijgt’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Netherlands is getting fewer new fibre connections, including whether a two-player market is the cause and what speed needs exist. The minister attributed the decline to high existing network quality and low uptake, said supply broadly matches demand, and noted continued attention to rural gaps and EU competition rules.
I therefore work at European level to ensure that the new regulatory framework promotes competition.
Ik zet me daarom Europees in om te zorgen dat het nieuwe regelgevend kader concurrentie bevorderend werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Voortman over het bericht ‘Energielabel is waardeloos’
