MPs Van der Lee and Voortman asked whether the minister shares FedEC's criticism that the home energy label is unreliable, whether he will strengthen it and engage stakeholders, and how this relates to the EU infringement procedure. The minister rejects the criticism, cites studies showing 86-92% consistency, notes the EU procedure is ongoing, and promises follow-up research reports after the summer.
I do not share the criticism from FedEC.
De kritiek van FedEC deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het initiatief van de Stichting Meent van der Sluis voor de oprichting van Het Andere Monument

Three MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a proposed monument ('Het Andere Monument') for victims of Groningen gas-extraction earthquake damage, including municipal land availability and funding for a youth work-learning project. The minister confirmed awareness, expressed appreciation, noted the National Coordinator Groningen mediated, and said the Social Affairs minister would explore a work-learning route.
The Minister of SZW will explore the possibilities for a work-learning project and will contact the foundation about it.
De Minister van SZW zal de mogelijkheden voor een leer-werktraject onderzoeken en daarover in contact treden met de stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de toekomstige functie van toegepast onderzoek

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a proposal by the TU Eindhoven rector to move applied research organisations (TO2) under universities, and how it relates to a pending evaluation and AWTI advice. The minister values the debate, defers the substantive response to a later cabinet reaction, and says collaboration among knowledge partners is important.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van der Molen over toegepast onderzoek in Nederland

MPs Amhaouch and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the cuts to applied research institutes (TO2) were compensated by innovation subsidies and private contracts, and what the ministry does to help these institutes win market work and keep room for societal research. The minister answered that public-private partnership via the topsector agendas and the PPS-toeslag is the policy, that the cuts were absorbed in topsector support and thematic research while statutory tasks were protected, and that a substantive reply on the TO2 evaluation will follow later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat klimaatlasten oneerlijk zijn verdeeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is unfair that the poorest households bear relatively more of the costs of climate policy, and whether the government will ensure industry pays, protects low incomes and broadens public support. The minister acknowledged the regressive burden, pointed to the Energy Agenda, ETS strengthening, housing-corporation insulation rules and ongoing dialogue, but gave largely general answers without firm new commitments beyond a promised letter before summer.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will inform the House before the summer about the further elaboration and the investments required from housing corporations and their effects.

De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de verdere uitwerking en de daarvoor benodigde investeringen van corporaties en de effecten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de informatievoorziening over de gasboring in Heerenveen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about information provision on a gas drilling project in Heerenveen, including the responsibilities of operators versus the ministry, legal options for municipalities, and permission for Vermilion to continue production under a pending amended winning plan. The Minister answers that operators are responsible for their own communication, that the ministry handles information tied to the procedure, that there is no legal framework for operator communication, and that production was allowed pending formal review after TNO analyses showed no safety concern.
Companies are themselves responsible for communication and environmental management regarding the projects they carry out; this also applies to mining companies.
Bedrijven zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de communicatie en het omgevingsmanagement rond de projecten die zij uitvoeren, dit geldt ook voor mijnbouwbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Na vijf jaar aardbevingsellende staat Jannie met lege handen’

MPs Bosman and Rutte asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that entrepreneurs affected by Groningen gas-extraction damage receive no compensation for lost income or property value. The minister explained that business damage and lost income are compensable via NAM's business desk if causation is proven, with no advance payments, and listed NCG support measures such as an advice point for businesses.
Compensation takes place only after agreement has been reached on the existence and amount of damage, causation and the amount of compensation.
Vergoeding vindt plaats nadat overeenstemming is bereikt over bestaan en hoogte van schade, causaliteit en de hoogte van de vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de subsidiëring van fossiele energie

An MP asked the ministers about a European Parliament report claiming the Netherlands gave 10 billion USD in fossil fuel subsidies in 2015, asked for a ten-year breakdown of fossil and renewable subsidies, and asked whether the government would reduce emissions and meet climate commitments. The minister disputed that fossil fuels are subsidised in the Netherlands, listed only treaty-based excise exemptions and the degressive energy tax structure, gave renewable subsidy budgets for 2017 and 2023, and pointed to ETS and energy-transition paths without committing to new concrete measures.
Fossil fuels in the Netherlands, unlike renewable energy, are not subsidised, not even through fiscal measures.
Fossiele brandstoffen worden in Nederland, in tegenstelling tot hernieuwbare energie, niet gesubsidieerd, ook niet via fiscale maatregelen.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de industrie niet daalt

An MP asked the ministers about reports that industrial CO2 emissions did not fall in 2016 and how this affects the Energy Agreement targets, including the 9 PJ industry energy-saving obligation. The government answered that it considers the agreed measures sufficient to meet all Energy Agreement targets and that an industry alternative to the 9 PJ obligation meets its conditions, with a fallback AMvB ready if needed.
For more information we refer to the letter from the Minister of Economic Affairs of 24 April.
Voor meer informatie verwijzen wij naar de brief van de Minister van Economische Zaken van 24 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de Nederlandse industrie in 2016 niet is gedaald

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why industrial CO2 emissions stayed flat in 2016, whether this conflicts with the Urgenda ruling and Paris commitments, and whether ETS alone is insufficient so national measures are needed. Ministers Kamp and Dijksma attributed the flat figure to higher production and shifts in the power sector, agreed deep cuts are needed, and said the government is consulting industry on additional measures under the Energy Agenda.
Yes, as also indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the cabinet is in discussion with various societal parties and companies on the further elaboration of the Energy Agenda.
Ja, zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording van de voorgaande vragen is het kabinet in gesprek met diverse maatschappelijke partijen en bedrijven over de verdere uitwerking van de Energieagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether coal plant operators and other Energieakkoord parties still lack agreement on biomass sustainability criteria, whether RWE will co-fire biomass at AMER9 and whether SDE+ subsidies for co-firing with non-FSC-equivalent certificates are permitted. The minister replied that agreement was reached in 2015, only implementation talks remain, a transitional reporting regime applies, and an independent advisory committee will assess certificates, with its composition to be announced soon.
An independent advisory committee will advise me on the extent to which certificates meet the Dutch sustainability criteria after the transitional regime.
Een onafhankelijke adviescommissie zal mij gaan adviseren in hoeverre certificaten na het overgangsregime voldoen aan de Nederlandse duurzaamheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het bedrijf moet blijven. FNV voert actie: Ziegler aan de ketting’ van RTV-Noord

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the planned relocation of part of Ziegler's fire-engine production from Winschoten to Croatia, its effect on fire-service readiness, union negotiations, jobs and procurement criteria. The minister answered that fire-service procurement and negotiations are matters for the safety regions and employers and unions, that no signals of reduced readiness exist, that about twenty of roughly 75 jobs are affected, and that general employment policy and UWV support apply.
Negotiations over whether to relocate business activities are a matter for employers and employees.
Onderhandelingen over het al dan niet verplaatsen van bedrijfsactiviteiten zijn een zaak van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over de economische positie van makers

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the weak economic position of actors and other creative makers, including income levels, the Copyright Contracts Act, RODAP's bargaining power and VOD remuneration. The government answered that the 2015 Act strengthens makers' contractual position, that it is too early to judge its effect, that the ACM is the competent competition authority, and that a collective VOD remuneration arbitration is pending.
Halfway through this period (end 2017/early 2018) your House will be informed by way of an interim report on how the act is experienced in practice by the parties.
Halverwege deze termijn (eind 2017/begin 2018) zal uw Kamer bij wijze van tussenstand worden geïnformeerd over hoe de wet door partijen in de praktijk wordt ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de waakvlam bij Loppersum

The MP asks about the NAM's gas production from the five Loppersum clusters, which after Council of State rulings was reduced to a minimum 'waakvlam' level of about 1.6 billion m3 per year, and whether SodM, the SAC and gas production reductions should be involved given increased earthquakes. The minister replies that production is limited to what is needed for supply security, that a reduction in the Groningen production ceiling of 10 percent is being prepared, and that SodM's advice has been sent to parliament.
In line with SodM's advice, I will work with NAM and GTS to examine how production in Loppersum, which takes place for capacity-related supply security, can be further restricted.

Conform het advies van Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) zal ik in samenwerking met NAM en GTS bezien hoe de productie in Loppersum, die plaatsvindt omwille van de capaciteitsmatige leveringszekerheid, nader kan worden beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het CBS meer ongelijkheid meet maar het als minder verkoopt

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that CBS measures higher inequality than previously assumed while presenting it as lower, including revisions, top-income censoring, dividend-tax effects and the Quote 500 comparison. Minister Dijsselbloem answered at length, explaining that revised methods and full population data raised measured inequality, that the Netherlands remains relatively low-inequality internationally, and committing only to possibly publishing supplementary figures on retained business profits.
The CBS is however examining the possibilities of making retained profits visible at household level as a supplement to the income concept used.
Het CBS onderzoekt evenwel de mogelijkheden om de niet uitgekeerde winsten wel op huishoudenniveau inzichtelijk te maken in aanvulling op het gehanteerde inkomensbegrip.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Lacin over de zorgen van werknemers in de kolenketen

MPs Beckerman and Lacin asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about funds for closing coal plants, compensation flows to shareholders, support for workers, and an FNV-proposed 800 million euro coal fund. The minister replied that no funds have been allocated for closing the oldest plants or any future closures, that the FNV fund is acknowledged, and that committing the money before the first closure is not on the agenda.
No funds have been allocated for closing the oldest coal plants before 1 July 2017, nor have funds been allocated for any future closure of coal plants.
Er zijn geen middelen vrijgemaakt voor de sluiting van de oudste kolencentrales voor 1 juli 2017, noch zijn er middelen vrijgemaakt voor eventuele sluiting van kolencentrales in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de verkoop van browsergegevens

An SP MP asked ministers whether the US Congress's repeal of FCC broadband privacy rules, allowing internet providers to sell browsing data without consent, affects Dutch and European users, and what the EU framework (GDPR, ePrivacy) and EU action can do to prevent resale of European browsing data. The minister declined to judge the US decision, said the effects on Europeans are hard to predict, pointed to EU rules (GDPR from May 2018, ePrivacy under revision) as adequate safeguards, and said the Commission, not ministers, initiates legislation and a similar EU proposal is unlikely.
It is up to the European Commission and not to ministers to draft and submit proposals to amend the regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie en niet aan ministers om voorstellen voor wijziging van de regelgeving op te stellen en in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Bouwregels Stad genegeerd’

MPs asked whether a Groningen builder ignored earthquake-resistant design rules, whether earthquake-proof building should become the norm with funding, why the NPR 9998 standard is not yet in the Building Decree, and whether NAM will generously apply the new-build compensation scheme. The minister answered that NPR use is not mandatory and cannot be excluded for some buildings, that the government is exploring regulation so NAM keeps covering reasonable extra costs with a decision expected by end 2017, and that the scheme's percentage compensation will be raised with the ongoing review.
Application of the NPR is not mandatory.
De toepassing van de NPR is niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat aardbevingsbestendig bouwen niet hoeft in Groningen

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked whether construction firms in Groningen are building non-earthquake-resistant homes, how many, why NPR 9998 was not designated in the Bouwbesluit, and whether NAM compensation could be made mandatory. Minister Kamp answered that professional firms should apply the NPR, that its application is not mandatory, that a solution for NAM covering reasonable extra costs is being explored with a result expected by end 2017, and that the NPR will be designated once clarity exists.
Nor are there exact figures on the numbers.
Ook zijn er geen exacte inzichten in aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de berichtgeving dat in Groningen nog steeds niet aardbevingsbestendig wordt gebouwd (Herdruk)

An MP asked the ministers why the earthquake-resistant building standard NPR 9998 is still not written into the Bouwbesluit, whether buildings are still being erected without it, and who is liable for damage. The minister agrees residents must be safe, says the NPR will be designated once legal clarity exists with an options study due by end 2017 to keep reasonable extra costs with NAM, and states NAM's strict liability under Article 6:177 BW applies to quake damage.
The NPR will be designated in the building regulations once there is clarity on this.
De NPR zal worden aangewezen in de bouwregelgeving, zodra hierover duidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de bescherming van de UPD en werkgelegenheid

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about Poland's right of first refusal on farmland and whether a similar state right could protect PostNL and other firms of public interest, and how the EU free movement rules apply. The minister explains the Polish mechanism, notes the European Commission review is informal and confidential, and rejects a similar Dutch regime as unnecessary, saying existing law and the Universal Postal Service framework suffice.
There is currently no additional information available on the status of the investigation or on the contacts between the Polish authorities and the European Commission.
Er is thans geen aanvullende informatie beschikbaar over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek en over de contacten tussen de Poolse autoriteiten en de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de gasopslag bij Langelo en schadeafhandeling

An MP asked the minister about the follow-up study into damage above the Norg gas storage, the role of the National Coordinator Groningen and inspections, the seismic risk analysis, and whether the storage plan's pressure limits would cause more seismicity. The minister answered that the NCG has no role for Norg damage, that the follow-up study is folded into a broader study, that damage claims go to NAM with appeal to the Tcbb, that the revised storage plan will be submitted for advice before a decision, and that the Inspecteur-generaal der mijnen judged the risk analysis satisfactory.
Under the approval decision it is not for me to respond to the reports, but for the Inspector-General of Mines.
Het is conform het instemmingsbesluit niet aan mij om een reactie te geven op de rapportages, maar aan de Inspecteur-generaal der mijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over bij- en meestook van duurzame biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidised biomass co-firing risks deforestation and conversion of valuable nature, prompted by a Zembla broadcast, and how sustainability is checked for foreign pellet production. The minister answered that the Dutch sustainability criteria are strict and verified through certification and independent verifiers, that monitoring of domestic deforestation runs through regular forest inventories, and that subsidies can be reduced or withheld for shortcomings, while declining to judge the pellet production shown in the broadcast without more information.
I will inform your House before the summer recess about the status of the processing of the applications and about the second opening of the SDE+ 2017.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het zomerreces informeren over de stand van zaken van de behandeling van de aanvragen en over de tweede openstelling van de SDE+ 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de duurzaamheidscriteria voor houtpellets

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about sustainability criteria for wood pellets used in industrial power generation, including verification of biomass at specific plants, the Enviva case and indirect land-use change, and whether subsidy money should go to other energy measures. The minister answered that the criteria apply to co-firing and SDE+ steam, that verification will be done by accredited verifiers under a designated supervisor, that only one installation is expected to start in 2017, and that she disagrees subsidies should shift to other sustainability measures.
In addition to accrediting verifiers, I will appoint a supervisor to ensure that no abuses occur when the declarations are issued.
Naast de accreditatie van verificateurs zal ik een toezichthouder aanwijzen om erop toe te zien dat zich geen misstanden voordoen bij het afgeven van de verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport 'Perspectives for the Energy Transition. Investment needs for a low-Carbon Energy Transition'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the IEA/IRENA report on the investment and scale of the global energy transition, including Netherlands' fair share and projected GDP and job effects. The minister agreed the transition must be unprecedented in scale, rejected the claim that the Netherlands lags behind, and pledged to support Germany's G20 climate action plan.
Yes, I am, together with other members of the cabinet, willing to do so.
Ja, daartoe ben ik, samen met andere leden van het kabinet, bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de beschikking wind Drentse Monden Oostermoer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how SDE+ subsidy decisions for the 45 turbines of the Drentse Monden Oostermoer wind park should be read, and why they add up to 189 MW when the agreed maximum is 150 MW. The minister explained that subsidy is capped by maximum subsidisable MWh rather than MW, that the MW figures are the permitted capacities submitted by applicants, and that the choice of turbines is left to the initiators within permit bandwidths.
As I have already indicated, the subsidisable production in MWh is capped.
Zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven is de subsidiabele productie in MWh gemaximeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het faillissement van het Zeeuwse bedrijf Thermphos

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about the bankruptcy of Thermphos, the Kazakh dumping ruling, the EU's role, and state responsibility for the remediation of the site containing low-level radioactive waste. The minister answered that the Rijk helped the province find remediation experts, that the damages claim is a private matter, that the EU and national state bear no direct liability for dumping, and that the company is primarily responsible for remediation under the EU radioactive waste directive.
The national government has in recent months discussed with the province of Zeeland the request for experts.
Het Rijk heeft de afgelopen periode met provincie Zeeland gesproken over de vraag om deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de gaswinning in Groningen en de toename van de seismiciteit bij Loppersum

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the NAM must include SodM's requested study of rising seismicity near Loppersum in its half-yearly monitoring report, send all such reports to parliament, and deliver an alternative production-distribution study and a societal risk calculation by specified dates, and why about one billion cubic metres of production must be kept at the Loppersum clusters. The minister answered that the monitoring report is already a licence condition, that reports are sent and published, that the production study and societal risk calculation are due by 1 November 2017 under the licence conditions, and that Loppersum clusters must stay open for supply security.
Yes. Incidentally, I note that NAM also publishes the measurement and monitoring report itself.
Ja. Overigens merk ik op dat NAM de meet-en monitoringsrapportage zelf ook publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Agnes Mulder over windenergie op zee en netwerken op zee

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether plans for an artificial North Sea island hub conflict with the planned offshore wind farms off the Dutch coast, and why wind farms are not sited further offshore. The minister replied that the island is a long-term idea beyond 2030, not an alternative to the 3,500 MW target for 2023, and that near-shore zones remain the cheapest to develop.
It is not an either-or, but a both-and.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de waarborgsommen bij energielevering

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about rising security deposits (waarborgsommen) charged by energy suppliers, including possible cartel behaviour, use of credit checks and data on arrears, and whether the practice is lawful. The minister answered that no signals of a rise were received, that the ACM supervises deposits and that new general terms from 1 April 2017 allow deposits to be adjusted, while stating that the ACM would be informed and could investigate.
I have received no signals that there is an increase in the number or height of the security deposits that energy suppliers ask consumers for.
Tot nu toe heb ik geen signalen ontvangen dat er een toename is in het aantal of de hoogte van de waarborgsommen die energieleveranciers aan consumenten vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de NAM de toename van aardbevingen bij Loppersum moet onderzoeken

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the rising number of earthquakes near Loppersum is worrying, when the SodM results are expected, and whether the NAM study will address reducing earthquakes and include an independent second opinion. The minister answered that SodM has requested further NAM analysis, that the seismicity signal value has not been exceeded, that SodM will advise by early April, and that an independent verification by CBS will feed into SodM's findings on 1 May 2017.
I will inform your House of that advice and of the consequences I attach to it.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over dat advies en de consequenties die ik daaraan verbind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Leenders en Jacobi over de onkostenvergoeding voor de plaatsing van hoogspanningsmasten

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether compensation for high-voltage pylons on farmland differs by period, whether some owners were bought out permanently for small sums, and whether TenneT could harmonise payments nationally. The minister answered that full compensation applies everywhere, that older buy-outs were legally permissible and that the current TenneT system is already applied nationally.
This principle is always and everywhere applied, regardless of the period in which the compensation was agreed.
Dit principe wordt altijd en overal toegepast, onafhankelijk van de periode waarin de schadevergoeding is afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over illegale gaswinning in Heerenveen

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about gas extraction under Heerenveen without an approved winning plan, the council's advisory rights, the lack of baseline measurements and whether extraction should be halted. The minister answered that he had consented to the plan in 2012, that a 2015 amendment was under review with a draft decision expected in July 2017, that the municipality's advisory rights were not bypassed, and that he sees no acute risk justifying an immediate halt.
I have the authority to intervene at the moment there is or threatens to be a serious impairment of interests.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid in te grijpen op het moment dat er sprake is of dreigt van een ernstige aantasting van belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinning onder een woonwijk en bedrijventerrein in Heerenveen

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the municipality of Heerenveen was not informed about gas extraction by Vermilion under its territory, whether the extraction expansion required a revised winning plan first, and what communication and baseline measurements are planned. The Minister answered that Heerenveen was consulted in 2012, that the amended plan is now in a formal procedure with advice requested, that production continues under the 2012 plan pending review, and that a list of pending plans will be provided.
By letter dated 29 June 2016 I informed Vermilion that production could continue under the existing 2012 winning plan pending treatment of the amended winning plan.

Met een brief d.d. 29 juni 2016 heb ik Vermilion laten weten dat de productie kon doorgaan op basis van het vigerende winningsplan uit 2012 in afwachting van de behandeling van het gewijzigde winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de gasboring in Heerenveen

MP Smaling asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about gas extraction at Langezwaag near Heerenveen, including whether production continues under a modified, unapproved winning plan and how municipal consent and communication work under the new Mining Act. The Minister replies that production continues under the 2012 plan, that the amended plan is under statutory advisory procedure with municipal advice, and that there is no gap in the law, though extra communication is needed.
Following these advices, I will draft a draft decision, which will then be made available for public inspection.
Naar aanleiding van deze adviezen stel ik een ontwerpbesluit op, dat vervolgens ter inzage wordt gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat Vermilion zonder toestemming gas wint bij Heerenveen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether gas extraction by Vermilion near Heerenveen (under the Skoatterwâld neighbourhood) was taking place without permission, what the risks to residents were, and whether production must stop. The minister replied that Vermilion's 2012 winning plan remained valid, that TNO and SodM found no direct cause for concern, that the inspector-general has announced a penalty order for one well, and that he will not intervene or direct SodM's investigation.
Under article 128a I cannot give a special instruction on how the inspector-general of mines carries out a specific investigation.
Op grond van artikel 128a kan ik geen bijzondere aanwijzing geven ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de inspecteur-generaal der mijnen een specifiek onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat de installatiebranche een tekort van 15.000 vakmensen in de komende vier jaar verwacht

MPs Amhaouch and Heerma (CDA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports of a 15,000-worker shortage in the installation sector, including whether this threatens the Energy Agreement, whether training should be made more widely available, and whether training funds should be opened up across sectors. The minister answered that the 3,000 annual vacancies are UNETO-VNI's own projection consistent with UWV expectations, that the Energy Agreement targets remain within reach, and that existing Techniekpact cooperation makes a separate taskforce or cao consultation unnecessary.
The figure of 3,000 annual vacancies cited by the chairman of UNETO-VNI is based by UNETO-VNI on an expected 3% annual growth in employment in the installation sector.

Het door de voorzitter van UNETO-VNI genoemde aantal van 3.000 vacatures op jaarbasis is door UNETO-VNI gebaseerd op een verwachte groei van de werkgelegenheid in de installatiebranche van 3% per jaar
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over de berichten “Bod Unilever van baan” en “De drie meedogenloze saneerders uit Brazilië”

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and the Prime Minister about a reported takeover bid for Unilever by 3G Capital, including effects on Dutch jobs, R&D, food security, sustainability, and whether Dutch takeover protection could block it. The minister answered most questions on substance, noting the bid is off the table, the Netherlands' Corporate Governance Code applies, and the planned telecom-only takeover law does not cover this sector, with no commitment to block a future bid.
As long as the acquiring party would maintain a statutory Dutch-based listed company, that listed company falls under the scope of the Dutch Corporate Governance Code.

Zolang de overnemende partij een statutair in Nederland gevestigde vennootschap met beursnotering zou handhaven, valt die beursvennootschap onder de reikwijdte van de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht “Nationale Ombudsman haalt bakzeil: Ed Nijpels en SER wél eerlijk over windenergie”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that the National Ombudsman revised his finding on SER and Ed Nijpels' statements on wind energy, and whether the Ombudsman had come under pressure and should resign. The minister answered that the matter is for the Ombudsman, that the revision followed a legitimate review request and new information about how the factcheck was prepared, and that there is no reason for the Ombudsman to resign.
I regard this as a matter for the National Ombudsman.
Ik beschouw dit als een zaak van de Nationale ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de aansprakelijkheid van PostNL bij diefstal van de inhoud van postpakketten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether addressees can hold PostNL liable for theft of package contents, and whether the Universal Postal Service terms (art. 4.2) unfairly exclude them. The minister answered that only the sender can claim under the Postal Act 2009 and the Complaints Board, that the addressee should pursue the sender or the online seller, and saw no reason to ask PostNL to amend its terms.
I see no reason to urge PostNL to do so.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om PostNL hiertoe te bewegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het onderzoek van de Consumentenbond over het Bel-me-niet Register

An MP asked the minister about a Consumentenbond survey finding that 89% of respondents received unsolicited sales calls, whether the bond's proposal to extend Bel-me-niet protection to former customers should be adopted, and whether the Telecommunicatiewet should be improved. The minister said the current right-of-objection system is balanced, rejected the proposal, but will consider amending the rules during the ePrivacy review.
I therefore see no reason to adopt the Consumentenbond's proposal.
Ik zie daarom ook geen reden om het voorstel van de Consumentenbond over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Mei Li Vos over ondersteuning van het postbedrijf, de kranten en tijdschriften en het culturele erfgoed

MPs Mohandis and Mei Li Vos asked whether Belgium's 2016 bpost concession, which requires early newspaper delivery and nationwide coverage funded up to EUR 200 million, is approved state aid and whether the Netherlands could use the same model. The minister confirmed the Belgian arrangement was approved by the European Commission but declined to use such compensation in the Netherlands, judging the domestic distribution network already adequate.
I see no reason to make use of this possibility in this case.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om in dit geval van deze mogelijkheid gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over slamming door telecomcowboys

The MP asks whether the minister knows of ACM warnings about slamming of small businesses, what steps have been taken against it, and what the ACM's proposal to extend the signed-contract requirement to businesses means. The minister answers that self-regulation talks among telecom providers are advanced but not yet agreed, that he is considering binding measures if self-regulation fails, and that he is cautious about extending the written-consent requirement to businesses, while promising a letter to parliament by end of March.
That is why I am considering binding measures should self-regulation fail.
Daarom beraad ik mij op mogelijke dwingende maatregelen indien zelfregulering niet slaagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Mei li Vos over het bericht “Consumentenbond wil Bel-me-niet-Register ook voor ex-klanten”

MPs Jacobi and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why consumers registered on the Bel-me-niet register can still be called by former customers, and whether the law will be changed to protect all consumers. The minister replied that former customers may still be called, that the right of objection (recht van verzet) provides a balanced safeguard, and that the rules will be reviewed in the context of the revision of the ePrivacy directive, in consultation with stakeholders.
I consider it important to continue pursuing these goals.
Ik vind het belangrijk om deze doelen te blijven nastreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Drenthe moet op zoek naar alternatieve locaties voor windmolens’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the wind energy search zones in Drenthe could be expanded and whether the Minister would constructively discuss this with the provincial executive. The Minister declined to widen the zones, citing the agreed 285.5 MW target for Drenthe under the Energy Agreement, and said no request to amend the agreements had been received from the province.
Given the agreements made with the province of Drenthe on onshore wind energy in 2020, I see no possibility to expand the search zones for wind energy in the province of Drenthe.
Gelet op de gemaakte afspraken met de provincie Drenthe over windenergie op land in 2020 zie ik geen mogelijkheid om de zoekgebieden voor windenergie in de provincie Drenthe te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het oponthoud van de aanleg van glasvezel in de provincie Overijssel

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays in fibre-optic broadband rollout in rural Overijssel, including state aid classification, wholesale access obligations, the provincial umbrella scheme and remaining unconnected households. The minister answers that the rules and steps are clear, that CIF has resumed preparations, and that the government will inform parliament about the umbrella scheme around summer, without addressing accountability for the delay itself.
As promised, the House will be informed further about the umbrella scheme around the summer.
Zoals toegezegd wordt de Kamer rond de zomer nader geïnformeerd over de koepelregeling

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het verschenen persbericht met als strekking dat er fouten door Agentschap Telecom zijn gemaakt bij de handhaving van de regiogerichtheidseis bij RadioNL

Parliamentarian Remco Bosma asked the minister whether Agentschap Telecom wrongly enforced the regional-orientation requirement against RadioNL, and how enforcement works. The minister rejected the claim of improper enforcement, described the rules and the disputed criteria, and said a licence reallocation is planned for the end of the year.
In my view, research into compliance with the regional-orientation requirement for RadioNL's programmes was carried out in a careful and proper manner.
Naar mijn oordeel is er op goede en zorgvuldige wijze onderzoek verricht naar de naleving van de regiogerichtheidseis bij de programma's van RadioNL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Overheid eist invloed bij cyberbeveiliger FOXIT’

An MP asked ministers whether the takeover of Fox-IT by NCC Group risks state secrets reaching foreign intelligence, why the government was informed only after the sale, and how dependent it is on private encryption firms. The government answered that existing secrecy law and contractual security requirements, with state supervision, cover the risk, that ministries were informed beforehand, and that alternative Dutch suppliers exist only in limited form.
Before the takeover, the ministries of the Interior and Defence were informed about it.
Voorafgaand aan de overname zijn de ministeries van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie ter zake ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Gesthuizen, Oosenbrug en Agnes Mulder over de locatie Zeewolde voor de middengolfzender

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Zeewolde medium-wave mast is a non-duplicable monopoly, whether the owner NOVEC must provide sharing under the Telecommunications Act, and whether the government should help find an alternative site for Groot Nieuws Radio before its lease ends. The minister answered that finding a suitable site is the licence holder's responsibility, that the government will help assess alternatives, and that the access dispute is pending before the ACM, so he cannot comment on the substance.
During ongoing legal proceedings I cannot make substantive statements about the matter in question.
Gedurende lopende juridische procedures kan ik geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de desbetreffende zaak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over doorverbindwebsites die consumenten onnodig op kosten jagen

MPs Oosenbrug and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why ACM has not acted against misleading call-routing websites that charge high per-minute rates, and whether the Telecommunications Act or maximum call costs should be changed. The minister answered that ACM is still investigating how to tackle these practices, that new rules would only be considered if current law proves inadequate, and that authorities and consumer groups already warn consumers.
ACM cannot make statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ACM geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over SDE+ subsidie voor de gedupeerden van de hevige hagelstormen in Zuid-Oost Nederland afgelopen zomer

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked whether the government would guarantee SDE+ subsidy availability for hail-storm victims in south-east Netherlands, and whether it would consult the province, municipalities and sector. The minister answered that SDE+ is competitive and cannot give individual developers advance certainty, pointed to increased 2017 budgets and NIA support for Noord-Brabant, and referred back to his answer on question 2 for questions 3 and 4.
The SDE+ scheme offers no possibility to give individual project developers advance certainty about project applications.
De SDE+ regeling biedt geen mogelijkheid om individuele projectontwikkelaars vooraf zekerheid te bieden over projectaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het feit dat de slimme energiemeter fors minder energiebesparing oplevert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the smart meter's weak energy savings, a PBL report, the investment payback, and whether a display should be standard. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, pointed to a planned covenant with energy partners and marketing measures, and declined for now to make in-home displays standard.
I am currently in discussion with the parties to the Energy Agreement about a binding covenant.
Momenteel ben ik in gesprek met de partijen bij het Energieakkoord over een taakstellend convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Mei Li Vos over staatssteun voor Belgische mediabedrijven die Nederlandse krantenbedrijven willen overnemen

MPs Mohandis and Mei Li Vos asked about Belgian state support (postal distribution compensation to bpost and a 0% VAT rate on printed newspapers) enabling Belgian media firms to acquire Dutch newspapers, and whether this distorts the Dutch market. The Secretary of State answered that the EU Commission has found both measures compatible with EU rules, that no distortion was established, and that the future of the Dutch press is primarily the sector's responsibility, with a promised information letter on research into independent journalism before summer.
The European Commission concluded in its aforementioned decision that the Belgian DAEB press distribution complies with EU state aid rules.
De Europese Commissie heeft in haar voornoemd besluit geconcludeerd dat de Belgische DAEB persdistributie voldoet aan de EU staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Albert de Vries en Brouwer over het bericht ‘Geef grenswerkers belastingkorting’

MPs Albert de Vries and Brouwer asked whether the government would tackle tax and social security differences that create uncertainty for cross-border workers and would adopt expat-style tax relief for them. The ministers answered that the government relies on information provision and existing compensation schemes, that harmonisation is not feasible, and that the action team's agenda will be followed up.

The cabinet and the border regions are strongly focusing on optimising information provision for cross-border workers on tax and social insurance differences, so that the differences become transparent.

Het kabinet en de grensregio’s zetten voor fiscale verschillen en verschillen in sociale verzekeringsstelsels fors in op het optimaliseren van de informatievoorziening voor grenswerkers, zodat de verschillen inzichtelijk worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over uitwisseling van personeel tussen ministeries en overige, bij de gaswinning betrokken instanties

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether personnel are exchanged between ministries and gas-extraction bodies, how the roles of licensor, supervisor and operator are kept separate after the OVV report, and about bonus policies at Gasunie, Gasterra, SodM, EBN and NAM. The minister answered that staff mobility is normal, that secondments occurred only with Gasunie and EBN, that the gas-ceiling decision followed the regular licensing procedure, and that bonus criteria tied to gas sales were dropped from 2016.
It does not befit me to interpret these individual considerations.
Het past mij niet om deze individuele overwegingen te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Ouwehand over het overzicht methaanemissies door olie- en gasindustrie

MPs Van Tongeren and Ouwehand asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about methane emission estimates and measurement methods in the oil and gas industry, including reporting gaps, the 1990s basis of the calculation method, and verification by SodM. The minister answered that emissions are calculated from measured flow rates and standard factors, that SodM supervises company reporting with four experts, and that NOGEPA is reviewing methods, while declining to fully answer the questions on Groningen gas production data that were covered by a separate Wob request.
For answering questions 28 to 31 I refer to my response to these questions, which I sent to your House on 9 February.
Voor de beantwoording van vragen 28 t/m 31 verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op deze vragen, die ik uw Kamer op 9 februari jl. heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Tongeren over het Wob-verzoek inzake de besluitvorming aangaande de gaswinning in Groningen d.d. 20 december 2016

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Groningen gas extraction decision-making, including NAM's reduced storage volume, seismicity models, SodM's advice, preventive measures, and the Norg field. The minister answered most questions in substance, citing SodM advice and the extraction plan, while declining to treat some related items as separate matters and pointing to ongoing procedures.
SodM advises maintaining an annual production level of 24 billion Nm3
SodM adviseert om een jaarlijks productieniveau aan te houden van 24 miljard Nm 3

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de weergave van gegevens in het eindrapport ‘Herevaluatie Verwerking Productiewater Schoonebeek’ (eindrapport) dat door Royal Haskoning DHV in opdracht van NAM is opgestel

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about claims that the Royal Haskoning DHV report on alternatives to Twente water injection misrepresented costs and capacity of purification technologies from Saltech and Nieuwe Weme, and asked for further justification, a pilot, and advisory input. Minister Kamp replied that the report was commissioned by NAM, that the additional purification variants were designed with the technology providers, that Deltares and the Commissie voor de m.e.r. are advising independently, and that a decision was expected in February 2017.
To ensure independence, I asked the Commissie voor de m.e.r. and the knowledge institute Deltares to advise me on the research design, the interim report and the final report.

Om de onafhankelijkheid te borgen heb ik de Commissie voor de m.e.r. en het kennisinstituut over water en waterzuivering Deltares gevraagd om mij te adviseren over de onderzoeksopzet, het tussenrapport en het eindrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jan Vos en Wolbert over de bezinningsperiode in de Drentse Veenkoloniën

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would insert a reflection period in the Drenthe wind park decision, pending the Council of State appeal, and pause irreversible steps while exploring alternatives with local stakeholders. The minister refused to withdraw or suspend the permit, citing the provincial renewable energy target, but committed not to start placing turbines before the Council of State ruling and to explore solar alternatives with local authorities.
Pending the Council of State ruling, no start will be made on placing the wind turbines.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zal geen begin met de plaatsing van de windmolens worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de bescherming van de universele postdienstverlening en de werkgelegenheid in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL's universal postal service and employment deserve protection against foreign takeover, citing Poland's 2016 farmland law and asking why the telecom-focused ownership-control bill excludes postal services. The Minister answered that Poland's farmland restrictions are only justifiable under EU free-movement rules on narrow grounds, that postal services are not designated vital infrastructure, and that a study on strengthening supervision of the universal postal service is under way.
I have found that additional measures can be taken within the UPD framework to strengthen supervision of the implementation of the UPD in the event of a foreign takeover.
Ik heb geconstateerd dat in kader van de UPD wel aanvullende maatregelen genomen kunnen worden om het toezicht op de uitvoering van de UPD in geval van een buitenlandse overname te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederland verspeelt kansen in veelbelovende ruimtevaartmarkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article saying the Netherlands is losing opportunities in the space market, including its low ranking in ESA programme investment and risks to ESTEC. The minister agreed space technology is important, explained Dutch ESA contributions and the geo-return principle, and said the government is looking at further support for ESTEC.
Currently it is being considered what more the Netherlands can do for ESTEC to further secure its presence in Noordwijk.
Momenteel wordt bezien wat Nederland extra kan doen voor ESTEC om haar aanwezigheid in Noordwijk verder te bestendigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de compensatie van emissierechten

An MP asked whether the state's roughly 89 million euro in indirect ETS emissions-cost subsidies, paid to firms that already receive free allowances, amounts to a double benefit and weakens carbon pricing incentives, and whether the ECB could buy ETS allowances. The minister answered that the subsidy compensates competitive disadvantage from electricity costs, is budgetarily separate from auction revenue, and that ECB purchases of allowances fall outside its mandate, while committing to pursue ETS strengthening via EU negotiations.
However, these subsidy expenditures are budgetarily decoupled from the revenue from the auction of emission allowances.
Deze subsidie-uitgaven zijn echter budgettair losgekoppeld van de inkomsten uit de veiling van emissierechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de overname van PostNL-loketten door DHL en Sandd

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL counter services being taken over by DHL and Sandd in Bruna shops, and whether this threatens universal postal service for vulnerable groups. The minister answered that negotiations are ongoing, that PostNL must meet statutory coverage and consultation requirements overseen by ACM, and that there is no sign of breach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de praktijken van Loterijverlies B.V.

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about the links between the Loterijverlies foundation and the Loterijverlies B.V., whether members were transferred to the B.V. without clear disclosure, the suspended foundation director's ties, and consumer-protection options. The minister answered that the relationships are subject to ongoing court proceedings and cannot be discussed in detail, cited the court rulings, and said ACM gives no public information on specific companies beyond its own enforcement findings.
These relationships and the course of affairs at the Loterijverlies foundation are also currently the subject of legal proceedings. For that reason I cannot go into them further.
Deze relaties en de gang van zaken bij de stichting Loterijverlies zijn daarnaast op dit moment onderwerp van juridische procedures. Ik kan hierop om die reden niet nader ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht 'Waddenclub: stop gaswinning direct'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that seabed subsidence under the Wadden Sea was faster than NAM predicted, and whether this justified stopping gas extraction under the hand-on-the-tap principle. The government answered that the Audit Committee found the subsidence within the permitted limits and no evidence of nature-threatening change, that the anomalies stem from LiDAR measurement inaccuracy, and that NAM will follow the committee's recommendations.
The advice of the independent Audit Committee and the monitoring results give me no reason to assume there is a striking, nature-threatening decline.
De adviezen van de onafhankelijke Auditcommissie en de monitoringsresultaten geven mij geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er sprake is van een opvallende natuurbedreigende verlaging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over zoutwinning

An MP asked the minister about soil contamination from diesel leakage at salt-mining well 335 by AkzoNobel, the scope of the investigation into other wells, and the integrity of pipelines and wells under intensified supervision by SodM. The minister largely accepted SodM's conclusions, explained the phased testing programme and pipeline repairs, and said no further measures were needed for now since SodM reports the intensified supervision is working.
SodM's intensified supervision made AkzoNobel recognise the seriousness of the matter, insofar as this was still necessary.
Het verscherpt toezicht van SodM heeft AkzoNobel, voor zover dat nog nodig was, de ernst van de zaak doen inzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de doelstellingen voor wind op land

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why 2016 wind-on-land capacity additions were low, whether the 6,000 MW target for 2020 will be missed, and whether a motion on higher SDE+ subsidy rates for small wind projects and an improved postcode scheme would be implemented quickly. The minister answered that the 2020 target remains achievable with provincial cooperation, that a supplementary study on small-scale wind will be commissioned and reported before the autumn SDE+ round, and that the postcode scheme evaluation will occur in 2017.

As I indicated in my letter of 3 January 2017, I am implementing the Jan Vos motion by commissioning additional research into the conditions and possible costs and returns associated with stimulating small-scale wind turbines.

250 ) heb aangegeven, geef ik uitvoering aan de motie Jan Vos door een aanvullend onderzoek te laten doen naar de randvoorwaarden en mogelijke kosten en opbrengsten die samenhangen met de stimulering van kleinschalige windmolens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de koppeling van warmtenetten aan kolencentrales

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs what 'technology-neutral' public financing of heat infrastructure means, whether heat-grid costs will be socialised through network tariffs, how this fits a motion against coal-linked heat, and whether Gasunie should be asked to avoid favouring fossil sources. The minister answered that technology-neutral means infrastructure open to any heat source, that tariff socialisation is undetermined pending a regulatory study, that public financing may apply if it facilitates the energy transition, and that as shareholder he cannot interfere with Gasunie's investments due to independence rules.
I see no reasons to do so.
Ik zie hier geen redenen toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het productieplafond voor de bij- en meestook van biomassa

An MP asks whether the 25 PJ cap on biomass co-firing in coal plants under the Energy Agreement covers total final energy including heat, and whether the SDE+ scheme is consistent with that agreement. The minister answers that the cap applies to subsidised renewable electricity (or electricity plus heat), that compensation for heat produced adds roughly 3–4 PJ unsubsidised, and that the SDE+ 2016 and 2017 schemes are in line with the agreement.
It is correct that the 25 PJ is a maximum.
Het is correct dat de 25 PJ een maximum is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen van NAM om de put Vries-10 in Assen op te starten

MP Dik-Faber asks the minister why NAM may start gas production from the new well Vries-10 in Assen before the updated Westerveld winning plan is approved, given residents' fears of quakes and damage and the earlier local requests to halt production. The minister answers that SodM found production within the existing winning plan allowed, that production has already started, that a seismic risk analysis places the field in the lowest risk category, and that he will not order a halt pending the new plan.
SodM found that the limits of the current winning plan are not expected to be exceeded over the next two years by bringing Vries-10 into use, so production may start under that plan.
SodM heeft geconstateerd dat de grenzen van het vigerende winningsplan met het in gebruik nemen van put Vries-10 de komende twee jaar naar verwachting niet zullen worden overschreden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de versterkingsoperatie die nu ineens tien jaar kan gaan duren

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen reinforcement operation now may take ten years instead of five, whether residents are left in uncertainty too long, how many homes must be reinforced, and why the new compensation scheme took a year. The minister replied that the approach has the support of all administrative parties, that a block-by-block inspection-then-reinforcement method is used with work starting in Q4 2017, and that the total scope and resident displacement cannot yet be determined, deferring to ongoing inspections.
No statement can currently be made about the scope of the total reinforcement task.
Over de omvang van de totale versterkingsopgave is op dit moment geen uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het akkerbouwonderzoek

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) took months to respond to the Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw's request for data needed for an agricultural research levy, and whether this delay endangers EUR 1.2 million in projects. The minister confirmed the request was filed in July, cited data protection (Wbp) constraints, and said the BO may obtain KvK numbers of non-member market participants so it can ask them to authorise RVO to share acreage data.
I have decided, within the scope permitted by the Wbp, to enable the Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw to obtain from RVO the Chamber of Commerce numbers of non-member market participants.

Ik heb besloten – binnen de ruimte die de Wbp biedt – het de Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw mogelijk te maken de Kamer van Koophandel-nummers (KvK-nummers) van de niet bij haar aangesloten marktdeelnemers van RVO te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over de uitspraak van de bestuursrechter betreffende vergunning voor het opsporen van schaliegas door Cuadrilla

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Tongeren asked whether a court ruling that the refusal to extend Cuadrilla's shale gas exploration permits was unfounded affects the ban on commercial shale gas drilling, and what options the minister has. The minister replied that the ruling does not affect the moratorium, that he chose to appeal rather than extend or revoke the permits, and that the new Mining Act allows permits to be revoked or restricted in light of changed societal views.
I have therefore lodged an appeal against the court's ruling on 11 January 2017.
Ik heb daarom 11 januari 2017 hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het zoutwinplan bij Kiel-Windeweer van Nedmag

An SP MP asked the Economics Minister about public anger over Nedmag's salt-mining plan near Kiel-Windeweer, the number of damage reports from gas extraction, whether a baseline survey by an international expert team could be required, and how damage from gas and salt extraction would be distinguished and settled. The minister said the 440 figure is not recognised, that about 10,000 damage reports exist for the municipality, that a baseline survey obligation could be attached to an approval decision once a plan is submitted, and that the NCG would mediate in complex damage cases.
I will put the question of whether land subsidence caused by gas and salt extraction can damage houses to the scientific panel.
Ik zal de vraag of de bodemdaling, die veroorzaakt wordt door gas- en zoutwinning, schade kan veroorzaken aan huizen voorleggen aan het wetenschappelijk panel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Dik-Faber, Ouwehand, Smaling en Jan Vos over het WOB-verzoek van Milieudefensie over gaswinningsbesluit 2016

Five MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's influence on the 2016 Groningen gas extraction decision, including a pre-sent expectations letter, consultations with NAM and Shell, and the withholding of an SodM advice from parliament. The minister answered that a draft expectations letter was shared with NAM only to test interpretation and feasibility, that the SodM advice was not actively sent but was later provided and published, and that the extraction ceiling was set on safety grounds at 24 billion m3 per year.
Since the SodM advice only confirmed that the process communicated to your House could proceed, I did not find it necessary to actively inform your House about it.
Aangezien het advies van SodM slechts bevestigde dat het met uw Kamer gecommuniceerde proces doorgang kon vinden, heb ik het niet nodig gevonden uw Kamer hier actief over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de koppeling van kolencentrales aan warmtenetten

MP Dik-Faber asks whether the minister will reconsider public financing of heat networks and the Gasunie Leiding over West, given that several potential heat customers refuse coal-plant heat. The minister answers that he foresees no public funds specifically for coal-plant waste-heat projects, that any public infrastructure financing will be technology-neutral, and that Gasunie is involved on its own grounds; he promises to inform parliament soon on coal-plant scenarios.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over een rapport over de waarde van kolencentrales

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he accepts a report arguing that three new Dutch coal plants are worth far less than the operators claim and risk becoming stranded assets, and whether he will push for their closure. The minister says he took note of the report but has no opinion on the plants' value, sees no need to brief the companies, and will inform parliament shortly on phasing out coal, without committing to it now.
I will inform your House more fully on this in the short term.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover op korte termijn nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht 'omstreden wondersap Xango werft student-verkopers'

An MP asked the ministers whether multilevel marketing sold to young people such as Xango is legitimate, whether it amounts to a pyramid scheme, and whether authorities will act against it. The minister answered that MLM is lawful, that businesses must follow consumer-protection and gambling rules enforced by ACM and the Kansspelautoriteit, that individual cases and ongoing investigations cannot be commented on, and that action against US legislation is not for the Dutch government.
It is not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het niet oplossen van schade door de NAM in Termunterzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about NAM's refusal to resolve damage to a house in Termunterzijl, including whether it is linked to gas extraction, the family's forced relocation on NAM's advice, and reversal of the burden of proof. The minister declined to go into substance because of pending litigation against NAM and the State, noted rising non-earthquake damage reports, and said the burden-of-proof bill is pending in the Senate with entry into force expected before year-end.

A court case concerning this file is pending before the Northern Netherlands District Court, in which NAM and the State are defendants. Against that background I will not go into the substance of this file.
Over dit dossier is een procedure aanhangig bij de rechtbank Noord-Nederland, waarin NAM en de Staat zijn gedaagd. Tegen die achtergrond ga ik niet inhoudelijk in op dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashof over ‘Brabants grondwater stinkt’

An MP asked the ministers whether they share concerns about health risks from hydrogen sulphide released when groundwater is pumped in Noord-Brabant, and whether they would check all measuring points and start follow-up research with the province. The minister answered that the province, as competent authority, has acted responsibly by commissioning TNO research and is itself primarily responsible for further steps and communication, with the issue placed on the agenda of regular national-provincial consultation.
In my view, the province, as competent authority, has discharged its responsibility appropriately by having TNO carry out thorough research into hydrogen sulphide gas in groundwater in Noord-Brabant.

Antwoord 4, 5 De provincie heeft als bevoegd gezag naar mijn mening op een verantwoorde wijze invulling gegeven aan haar verantwoordelijkheid door TNO een gedegen onderzoek 2 naar waterstofsulfidegas (H 2 S) in grondwater in Noord-Brabant uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het KNMI, dat aardbevingen niet goed zou registreren

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the KNMI misrepresents Groningen earthquakes by naming quakes after the nearest village, so that eleven quakes are attributed to Garmerwolde rather than Groningen city, and whether this distorts regional spread and should be corrected. The minister answered that the KNMI never claimed only one quake hit Groningen city, that the naming procedure was changed on 1 December 2016 to use municipal boundaries, and that the regional picture is unaffected since analyses use coordinates.
On 1 December 2016 the KNMI retroactively introduced a new naming procedure that looks at the distance between the epicentre and a municipal boundary.
Op 1 december 2016 heeft het KNMI met terugwerkende kracht een nieuwe naamgevingsprocedure geïntroduceerd waarbij wordt gekeken naar de afstand tussen het epicentrum en een gemeentegrens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over kosten salderingregeling zonne-energie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Economic Affairs minister about the cost of the net-metering (salderingsregeling) scheme for solar power and the postcode-rose scheme, including forgone energy tax revenue, cost-effectiveness per tonne of CO2 and how the schemes compare with SDE+. The state secretary answered with estimates of forgone revenue, cost figures from an IBO report, a commitment to evaluate the scheme and to inform parliament in the first half of 2017.
The research will be completed this year. The Minister of Economic Affairs and I will inform your House in December about the outcomes of the evaluation and the follow-up process.
Het onderzoek wordt dit jaar afgerond. De Minister van Economische Zaken en ik zullen uw Kamer in december informeren over de uitkomsten van de evaluatie en het vervolgproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht “Helft vliegtuigpassagiers krijgt geen vergoeding bij lange vertraging”

An MP asked the government about a report that half of air passengers receive no compensation for long delays, and whether the ILT (inspectorate) is doing enough to prevent barriers to claims. The state secretary answered that airlines largely comply with information duties, that the ILT handles complaints and can enforce, but that no structural problem or new measures are seen, while noting the 80,000 figure cannot be verified.
I have no overview of the total number of compensation claims, the extent to which they are justified or not, or whether money remains unpaid that should be paid out.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het totaal aantal compensatieclaims, de mate waarin deze gegrond zijn of niet en of er geld blijft liggen dat uitgekeerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het onderzoek naar de kerncentrale Borssele

MP Van Tongeren asked the minister about a report on the financial position of the Borssele nuclear plant and whether the Holtkamp scenarios and cost assumptions hold, including investment history, decommissioning costs, and options for storing unused contaminated fuel. The minister confirmed the report's findings, declined to give a full investment overview, explained the modelling assumptions, and said direct storage of unused fuel would need new facilities, with no firm cost or timeline.
Due to the commercial sensitivity of the underlying amounts and the possible consequences for EPZ's negotiating position, the Holtkamp report gives only a global description of the total amount.

Vanwege de bedrijfsgevoeligheid van onderliggende bedragen en de mogelijke consequenties voor de onderhandelingspositie van EPZ, wordt in het rapport Holtkamp slechts een globale omschrijving van de hoogte van het totale bedrag gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over het bericht 'Traag internet of verplicht tv - vier vragen over de macht van KPN en Ziggo'

Two PvdA MPs asked the economic affairs minister about broadband prices, the duopoly of KPN and Ziggo, and bundling practices that force consumers into expensive packages. The minister answered that alternative internet-only offers exist, that access regulation remains needed, that no own price study is necessary, and that the competition authority ACM is already researching the market.
I refer specifically to the market analysis decision on unbundled access that was published on 17 December.
Ik verwijs specifiek naar het marktanalysebesluit ontbundelde toegang dat op 17 december is gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de bemoeienis van NAM met bouwprojecten in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister whether NAM's involvement in new-build projects in Groningen, including the absence of a new-build scheme in the multi-year programme, causes delays and should be curbed. The minister answered that the NPR 9998 standard is being made legally binding, that a revised new-build scheme will be proposed by year end, and that the NCG is discussing NAM's role with NAM and municipalities, without committing to stop NAM's involvement.
The draft multi-year programme 2017–2021 provides that a revised scheme must be established, agreed with the administrative and societal steering committee.
In het concept Meerjarenprogramma Aardbevingsbestendig en Kansrijk Groningen 2017–2021 is opgenomen dat een herijkte regeling tot stand dient te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de import van groen gas

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about importing green gas, including a pilot, foreign green-gas certificates, the European registry, and how the renewable energy target is calculated. The minister says a small pilot is undesirable, a European platform is being developed instead, Vertogas is asked to take a larger role, and the energy agenda will address conflicting targets.
I will examine whether it is desirable and possible for Vertogas to still sign this letter of intent.
Ik zal onderzoeken of het alsnog ondertekenen van deze «letter of intent» door Vertogas gewenst en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid in Nederland

MPs Agnes Mulder (CDA) and Oosenbrug (PvdA) asked the ministers about poor mobile coverage in dozens of villages, regional differences, municipal antenna permitting, and reports of 112 emergency calls failing. The minister answered that coverage is generally very good, that municipalities and operators share responsibility for local improvements, that Agentschap Telecom offers technical help, and that the national government has no power to override a municipal refusal of an antenna permit.
The national government has no possibility to overturn such a decision by a municipality.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen mogelijkheden om een dergelijk besluit van een gemeente te verwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Advies van wijzen voor Groningen’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a commission of wise persons should analyse the Groningen earthquake problem, and about a court ruling holding EBN jointly liable for earthquake damage. The minister said the National Coordinator Groningen will be strengthened and no new commission is needed, and that the State and EBN will decide their own response to the ruling while the case is pending.
Against this background, I see no reason to have a new commission examine the approach to the earthquake problem caused by gas extraction.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik geen aanleiding om een nieuwe commissie zich te laten buigen over de aanpak van de aardbevingsproblematiek als gevolg van de gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over grensoverschrijdende gaswinning Groningse gasveld

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about cross-border gas extraction from the Groningen field under the Ems estuary, including pressure communication with German wells and whether seismic risk models account for offshore volumes. The minister answered that the offshore part is integral to the Groningen field and included in subsidence and seismicity models, that German fields are not connected and thus excluded, and that EBN co-financed exploratory wells on German territory to refine the estimate of original gas in place.
That part of the Groningen gas reservoir extending under the Ems estuary has been included in the models used to calculate reservoir compaction and subsidence.
Dat deel van het gasreservoir van het Groningenveld dat zich uitstrekt onder de Eemsmonding, is meegenomen in de modellen, waarmee reservoircompactie en bodemdaling zijn berekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de zeer hoge uitkering aan de topman van NXP bij de verkoop van het bedrijf

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the reported USD 428 million payout to NXP's chief executive from the company's sale, and the risks of such exorbitant pay, were acceptable, and whether the clawback rules and NXP subsidies would be reviewed. The minister, on behalf of the economic affairs minister, declined to judge the amount, said pay assessment is for shareholders and the company, referred to earlier answers on clawback and subsidies, and gave no new commitments.
I have no opinion on the amount reported in the media that the NXP chief executive would keep from the takeover if he exercised his options and sold his shares.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de in de media genoemde hoogte van het bedrag dat de uitvoerend bestuurder van NXP zou overhouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Samsom, Jan Vos en Hoogland over de komst van een Tesla-fabriek naar Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister and Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would do everything possible to attract a Tesla Gigafactory to the Netherlands for green jobs and manufacturing. Minister Kamp answered that the Netherlands is a suitable location and the cabinet will make efforts, but that Tesla alone decides on location and he cannot yet estimate investments or jobs.
The cabinet will certainly make efforts to bring the production plant to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zal zich zeker inspannen om de productiefabriek naar Nederland te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het vergoeden van schade voor inwoners in Groningen

Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about compensation for property value loss in Groningen, whether it duplicates NAM payments, the buy-out pilot, and the annual review (ijkmoment) of the gas-extraction permit. The minister answered that the NAM value-loss case is pending before the appeals court, that the government value-increase scheme is separate from NAM's scheme, that the buy-out pilot will be evaluated in early 2017, and that decentralised governments will be involved in the annual review though without formal consultation rights.
As the case is still before the court, I will not make substantive statements about it.
Aangezien de zaak nog onder de rechter is, doe ik hier inhoudelijk geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de mogelijke krimp van het opgestelde vermogen aan windenergie op land
