An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether around 1,330 MW of ageing onshore wind turbines risks removal when subsidies expire, threatening the 14% and 16% renewable energy targets, and whether the government will compensate. The minister answered that the figure is a theoretical maximum, that replacement or refurbishment is feasible within current frameworks, that no extra subsidy will be created, and that he will discuss the matter with the provinces at a meeting on 1 December.
I will discuss this further with the provinces at an administrative consultation I have with them on 1 December.
Ik zal hier nader met de provincies over spreken tijdens een bestuurlijk overleg dat ik op 1 december a.s. met hen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over windmolens die afgebroken worden maar niet meer worden vervangen, waardoor het Energieakkoord in gevaar komt

MP Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether dismantled wind turbines not being replaced endangers the 6,000 MW onshore wind target of the Energy Agreement, and asked about subsidy loss, RVO risk estimates, SDE+ 2017 adjustments, postcode scheme continuation, provincial zoning constraints and a roundtable with industry. The Minister confirmed the risk (up to 1,330 MW) but said most owners keep turbines running, rejected special higher subsidies for small turbines, committed to an early evaluation of the postcode scheme and to raising the issue with provinces, and noted it is on the wind-on-land core team agenda.
I will consult with the State Secretary of Finance to carry out this evaluation as soon as possible in 2017.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de Staatssecretaris van Financiën om deze evaluatie zo spoedig mogelijk in 2017 uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er namens de Stichting Rookpreventie Jeugd aangifte is gedaan tegen vier tabaksfabrikanten die actief zijn in Nederland

An SP MP asked the government to respond to a report that criminal complaints were filed against four tobacco manufacturers, and about laser-perforated filters and TNCO measurement gaps versus real consumer exposure. The State Secretary said the Openbaar Ministerie assesses the complaint, the NVWA is the competent supervisor and will keep enforcing the ISO method until a new one is adopted, and he will raise validated methods at EU level.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess the complaint.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om de aangifte te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'SODM: aantal overtredingen door mijnbouwbedrijven stijgt'

An MP asked the minister whether the rise in SodM warning letters to mining companies (from four to ten) is undesirable, whether it reflects measurement changes, and what role the minister sees in reducing incidents. The minister answered that violations are unwanted, explained the warning letters concerned missing documents and late notifications, attributed the rise partly to a risk-based inspection method, and pointed to pending legislation strengthening offshore and mining safety and SodM's independence.
As a result of the proposed amendments to the Mining Act, SodM's tasks will increase.
Als gevolg van de voorgenomen wijzigingen van de Mijnbouwwet zullen de taken van SodM toenemen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman Ed Nijpels en de Sociaal-Economische Raad (SER) op de vingers tikt, omdat zij onvolledige en eenzijdige informatie geven over windenergie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he views the National Ombudsman's finding that Ed Nijpels and the SER gave one-sided information on wind energy, and whether he would reprimand or dismiss Nijpels for repeatedly misleading citizens. The minister agreed that government information must be objective and correct, deferred to the Ombudsman as the SER has filed a review request, and rejected the claim of systematic misinformation, so he sees no reason to act.
I do not share the view that there would be systematic provision of incorrect information by the chair of the Borgingscommissie.
Ik deel de opvatting niet dat er sprake zou zijn van stelselmatige verstrekking van verkeerde informatie door de voorzitter van de Borgingscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over het tegenhouden van het energiebesparingssysteem glastuinbouw door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the ministry is not declaring the greenhouse horticulture energy-saving scheme (EBG) generally binding despite broad sector support and the government's own plans for sustainability initiatives. The minister answered that the request is still under assessment against applicable frameworks, that he supports the scheme's energy-saving goal, and that a separate planned bill on sustainability agreements has different conditions, promising to inform parliament as soon as possible.
The State Secretary and I will inform your House as soon as possible about the assessment of the request.
De Staatssecretaris en ik zullen uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de beoordeling van het verzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de minister van Economische Zaken doorgaat met het gebruik van Gmail voor communicatie met ambtenaren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether ministers' private email accounts used for work should be investigated, which officials used such accounts, and why the Rijksbeveiligingsambtenaar and the national security advice were not acted on earlier. The minister answered that the government sees no need to extend the Auditdienst Rijk investigation to all ministers, that a concrete reason exists for his own account, that the security officer was informed in 2014 and 2016, and that the advisory report cannot be shared with parliament.
The cabinet is of the view that an investigation of a private email account is an infringement of personal privacy.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een onderzoek van een privé e-mailaccount een inbreuk op de persoonlijke levenssfeer is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Jacobi over de belangenverstrengeling bij commerciële stichtingen die consumenten zouden moeten helpen bij collectieve schaderegelingen

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jacobi asked whether the governance of claim foundations representing consumers in mass-damage cases is adequate, given research showing most do not comply with the voluntary Claimcode, and whether a Consumer Ombudsman should be created. The minister acknowledged the non-compliance, said a bill would make certain Claimcode requirements legal admissibility conditions for collective actions, and declined to create a Consumer Ombudsman for now, citing the private-enforcement primacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de ondoorzichtige tarieven van publieke laadpalen

An MP asked ministers whether they would make public charging-point tariffs transparent and engage market parties on this after a Radar broadcast. The minister replied that price transparency is the responsibility of market parties and ACM, pointing to open protocols like OCPI and the NKL platform without committing to a concrete new step.
Making tariffs visible at the charging point is a responsibility of market parties.
Het inzichtelijk maken van tarieven aan de laadpaal is een verantwoordelijkheid van marktpartijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de mislukte aanbesteding van Zaakgericht Werken (ZGW) door de Dienst ICT Uitvoering

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Zaakgericht Werken tender by DICTU failed and why the work was then awarded through a minicompetition, including tender conditions, pricing, cost arrangements and whether AT and IGZ have clarity. The minister answered that the minicompetition covered a different assignment, that the original tender was withdrawn under its reserved rights, and that AT and IGZ have approved a phased approach with a proof-of-concept phase completed.
In this case there is no question of 'the same assignment'.
Er is in casu geen sprake van «dezelfde opdracht».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de verlenging van de zoutwinning van Frisia tot 2052

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Frisia salt-mining permit under the Wadden Sea was extended to 2052, whether this conflicts with the motion protecting the Wadden area, and whether the decision should be reviewed by an independent expert team and capped at 2036. The minister answered that the extension is conditional on five-yearly updates of the sea-level scenario under the 'Hand aan de Kraan' principle, that existing strict conditions remain, and that no further expert review is needed given the involvement of KNMI, Deltares and TNO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over schade in Groningen door stijging van grondwater door aardbevingen

An SP member asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that rising groundwater caused by earthquakes is damaging properties in Groningen, asking about a geologist's report, the number of damage claims, and whether an international expert team should assess the cause. The minister answered that he does not have the report, that no damage claims linked to groundwater rise are on record, and that he would have the report verified by an independent body if it were made available.
However, I do not have that final report.
Ik beschik echter niet over dat eindrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het aannemen van een bewijsvermoeden bij aardbevingsschade

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether the court's recognition of a causal presumption linking gas-extraction earthquakes to Groningen damage should lead the State and NAM to stop litigating and to reassess settled claims. The minister answers that causation must be judged case by case, that the presumption only applies to the specific case, that the wetsvoorstel bewijsvermoeden will introduce a statutory presumption for the future, and that no reassessment of closed claims is planned.
I see no reason to ask NAM to reassess claims that have already been closed.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om NAM te vragen reeds afgesloten zaken opnieuw te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de geofoons in Twente, die bevingen meten in Twente veroorzaakt door de afvalwaterinjectie door de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM)

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked why geophones near the Twente wastewater injection sites were not all live-readable and whether NAM promised such live access, and about responsibility for data collection and analysis. Minister Kamp answered that KNMI operates and analyses the stations, that connectivity issues explain the gaps, and committed to contacting KNMI to ensure live data, open storage and periodic analyses.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Bosma en Bosman over een nieuwe graaftechniek voor kabels

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new cable-laying techniques, the standard 60 cm burial depth, who can authorise other depths, and liability for damage to cables. The minister replied that no statutory depth exists, that NEN norms are advisory, that municipalities can prescribe depths under the Telecommunicatiewet, and that liability is for the courts to decide under the WION.
There is no statutorily prescribed depth for laying cables.
Voor de aanleg van kabels bestaat geen wettelijk voorgeschreven diepte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Van Dekken en Nijboer over Het bericht 'Lijmklassieker blijft een succes' en de problemen met de Europese regelgeving

Three PvdA MPs asked the government whether new EU limits on lead migration in children's toys and paints, which they claimed make paint production impossible, are justified and whether the government has acted on such regulation. The Minister of Health answered that the limit is a migration limit that is 340 times stricter than the drinking water standard, that production is not made impossible, that no cases of EU rules burdening entrepreneurs are known, and that no action has been taken because there is no reason to.
No. The limit value for migration of lead in this type of toy is currently 3.4 mg/kg.
Nee. De grenswaarde voor migratie van lood in dit type speelgoed is op dit moment 3,4 mg/kg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dik Faber en Van Tongeren over schade aan huurwoningen in Middelstum

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about damage to rental homes in Middelstum caused during reinforcement works, including months of drainage problems and loose structural bolts, and whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen and the NCG could intervene. The minister confirmed it concerns one dwelling, declined to detail an individual damage case, said a repair plan exists, and agreed that the corporation will check bolts in all Middelstum homes soon.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht ‘Kamp bereid tot harder optreden tegen dumpen van staal’

Teeven (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares concern that Chinese steel dumping threatens Dutch jobs, whether harder action is needed, and how higher duties would be pursued in Europe. Minister Kamp answered that the current lesser duty rule duties are effective, he sees no reason to abandon the rule or seek higher duties now, and he asked industry for evidence before considering additional measures.
At present the cabinet therefore sees no reason to abandon the lesser duty rule in favour of an alternative.
Op dit moment ziet het kabinet dus geen aanleiding om de lesser duty rule te laten varen voor een alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het importeren van groen gas

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why imports of green gas certificates (garanties van oorsprong) are not allowed, whether this can be lifted, what role Vertogas could play, and whether green gas can reduce Groningen gas extraction. The minister answered that there is no import ban as such, but imports cannot be verified without a shared European platform, that a pilot is undesirable, and that green gas can reduce demand for Groningen gas while safety and supply security remain leading.
There is no import ban for green gas.
Er is geen importverbod voor groen gas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de invloed van NAM op bouwprojecten  in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM is interfering in new construction projects in Groningen, causing delays and overreaching on design and location, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister acknowledges the NAM compensation schemes and that the Boterdiep parking-garage project was delayed, says an exception was made after mediation by the National Coordinator Groningen, and states that delay is undesirable and that the NCG is working to revise the scheme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat Frankrijk een internationale aanpak wil op het gebied van encryptie

An MP from D66 asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about France's proposal for an international approach to encryption, including whether the Netherlands received the proposals and whether weakening encryption would harm security and trust. The government confirmed it was informed of the Franco-German initiative, reaffirmed its unchanged position supporting strong encryption, and said it sees no current way to weaken encryption without compromising digital security.
The Dutch position and the considerations underlying it have been translated into English and are actively promoted internationally.
Het Nederlandse standpunt en de afwegingen die daaraan ten grondslag liggen zijn vertaald naar het Engels en worden internationaal actief uitgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘EU-president Juncker eist beter roamingplan’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares the Commission president's call for a better draft roaming proposal, whether roaming costs can be fully abolished in 2017, and how cross-border workers are protected. The minister replied that the Commission's new proposal defines reasonable use without day limits, that Dutch negotiating positions focus on lower wholesale tariffs and clarity for operators and regulators, and that cross-border workers may roam at domestic rates under the proposal.
I will, in the further handling of the proposal, ask for clarification of the position of border residents and cross-border workers.
Ik zal bij de verdere behandeling van het voorstel vragen om een verduidelijking van de positie van grensbewoners en grenswerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Bruins en Gesthuizen over de toegezegde evaluatie van de Winkeltijdenwet

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of the promised evaluation of the Shop Opening Hours Act, including whether workers' interests, Sunday rest and small retailers are considered, whether municipalities copy neighbouring municipalities' policy, and when the report will be sent. The Minister answered that an external evaluation is underway covering these interests and neighbouring-municipality effects, that he will not anticipate its outcome, and that the results and a policy letter will be sent before year-end.
So as not to anticipate matters, I first await the outcomes of the evaluation.
Om niet op de zaken vooruit te lopen, wacht ik eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het opwerpen van functionaliteitsbeperkingen van consumentenproducten via firmware updates

MP Remco Bosma (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is lawful for a manufacturer to restrict a consumer electronics product's functionality through a firmware update, citing HP printers rejecting third-party ink. The minister answered that the answer depends on the contract and information provided, that normal use must remain possible even if the consumer declines the update, and that HP announced a corrective firmware update, with the ACM responsible for enforcement.
It is not for me but for the regulator, the ACM in this case, to determine whether there is an infringement.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de toezichthouder, de ACM in dit geval, om te bepalen of er sprake is van een overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bruins over het opleggen van boetes aan een winkelier die op zondag zijn winkel niet openstelt

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bruins asked whether landlords may fine shop tenants who keep their shops closed on Sundays, despite municipal freedom and earlier ROZ commitments. Minister Kamp answered that municipalities cannot oblige shops to open, that the contractual landlord-tenant arrangements fall under contract freedom, and that he will await the evaluation of the Winkeltijdenwet before committing to further measures.
I would like to await this evaluation before making statements on whether sufficient measures have been taken to prevent shopkeepers from receiving a fine if they do not want to open on Sunday.

Ik wil graag wachten op deze evaluatie alvorens uitspraken te doen of er voldoende maatregelen zijn genomen om te voorkomen dat winkeliers een boete krijgen indien zij op zondag niet open willen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de verkoop van elektrische en hybride auto’s fors is afgenomen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that sales of electric and hybrid cars fell, whether the 2016 rise in the company car tax (bijtelling) explains it, and how this fits with climate, air quality and energy goals and earlier motions to stimulate electric driving. The minister answered that electric car sales keep growing steadily, that the PHEV decline is partly due to the tax change, that EU-level emission standards are the preferred instrument, and that he will inform parliament further in the autumn on the Groot motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht “Bureaucratie remt ontwikkeling Dronetechnologie”

MP Monasch asked the State Secretary whether bureaucracy is slowing drone technology development, including the authorisation of test centres. The government answered that a lighter mini-drone regulation took effect on 1 July 2016, that test-centre applications are handled with ILT and that new regulation to facilitate testing is being prepared.
The cabinet is preparing regulation to further facilitate the conduct of flights for testing and experimenting with drones.
Het kabinet is regelgeving aan het voorbereiden om de uitvoering van vluchten ten behoeve van testen van en experimenteren met drones verder te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat weinig Nederlanders werk vinden in Duitsland

MPs from ChristenUnie and CDA asked about a report that few Dutch people seek work in Germany, and about the Actieteam grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid, INTERREG funding and cross-border information points. The minister acknowledges untapped cross-border job potential, describes ongoing Actieteam work with results promised in Q1 2017, and notes that border information point funding is temporary with an SZW evaluation planned for 2018.
As far as can now be seen, the cabinet will inform you of the results of the Actieteam by the first quarter of 2017 at the latest.
Naar het zich nu laat aanzien, wordt u uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal 2017 door het kabinet geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het Actieteam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het uitblijven van het onderzoek van het Agentschap Telecom naar de plaatsing van windturbines bij Lofar

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs minister why the Agentschap Telecom study on wind turbines near the LOFAR radio telescope was not sent to Drenthe after the recess, whether a meeting with the provincial deputy was cancelled, and whether the minister would reconsider the Drentse Monden wind park and delay decisions pending a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answered that the study was finished on 19 September and published after additional mitigation research, that the meeting was cancelled because the impact was not yet clear, and that he would not reconsider or postpone the wind park decision.

A meeting between provincial deputy Stelpstra of Drenthe and myself was scheduled for 25 August. I cancelled that meeting because at that time I did not have sufficient insight into the effects of the wind park on the LOFAR radio telescope to take a position on it.

Op 25 augustus jl. stond een gesprek gepland tussen gedeputeerde Stelpstra van de provincie Drenthe en mijzelf. Ik heb dat gesprek geannuleerd, omdat ik op dat moment niet voldoende inzicht had in de gevolgen van het windpark op de radiotelescoop LOFAR om hierover een standpunt te kunnen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de mislukte aanbesteding van Zaakgericht Werken door de Dienst ICT Uitvoering

MP Gesthuizen asked the minister why DICTU abandoned the failed tender for Zaakgericht Werken, why it then ran a mini-competition among framework partners, and how the BIT advice was reflected. The minister explained that stopping the tender was a separate DICTU judgement made before the BIT advice, that the mini-competition followed BIT recommendations with a focus on implementing the case system for AT and IGZ, and described the selection of Atos.
The decision to stop the tender was a standalone assessment by DICTU.
Het besluit om de aanbesteding te stoppen is een op zichzelf staande afweging geweest van DICTU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ruimtelijke inpassing van windpark De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment about the spatial planning of the Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farm, covering objections handling, compensation and participation, the Energy Agreement, the Crisis- en herstelwet, the Aarhus Convention and ECHR compliance, LOFAR interference, and the rule of law. The minister answered that objections were handled in a Nota van antwoord, that a gebiedsfonds and planschade rules exist, that the plan meets good spatial planning and the ECHR/Aarhus standards, and that the process was carefully conducted.
In view of the foregoing, I am of the opinion that the decision is compatible with the ECHR and the Aarhus Convention.
Gelet op het vorenstaande ben ik van oordeel dat het besluit zich verdraagt met het EVRM en het Verdrag van Aarhus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘FrieslandCampina wil collectieve subsidie voor mestvergisters’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether farmers can apply for SDE+ subsidy collectively for manure digesters, whether extra conditions apply, and whether non-participating farmers can still apply. The minister replied that a collective application is possible in principle, that a separate scheme for monomanure digestion is planned pending EU state-aid approval, and that individual farmers can apply under the regular SDE+.
Within the regular SDE+ it is necessary to submit an application stating the specific location and/or permits.
Binnen de reguliere SDE+ is het noodzakelijk om een aanvraag in te dienen met opgave van de specifieke locatie en/of vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Modewinkelier staat voor het blok’

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether commission-based platforms like Zalando threaten retailers, including price rises, abuse of dominance under the Competition Act and unfair trading rules. The minister answered that platforms offer benefits, that retailers can choose to leave, that the ACM rather than the minister assesses abuse of dominance and complaints can be filed there, and that unfair-practice rules protect consumers rather than imposing duties on platforms toward retailers.
It is up to the entrepreneur to decide whether he wishes to use a specific platform as a sales channel.
Het is aan een ondernemer zelf om te bepalen of hij gebruik wil maken van een specifiek platform als verkoopkanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Oosenbrug en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Voor je het weet, troggelt de doorverbindsite je centen af’

MPs Jacobi, Oosenbrug and Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about commercial websites that route consumers to police, tax authority and company customer-service numbers via expensive 0900 numbers costing up to 90 cents per minute. The minister finds this undesirable, notes the ACM supervises 0900 numbers and unfair trade practices, has discussed the numbers with the ACM, and says new rules would only be considered if current law proves inadequate.

I consider it undesirable that consumers are misled by this and pay unnecessarily high information rates to contact agencies or companies that are reachable by phone for free or at limited call costs.

Ik vind het onwenselijk als consumenten hierdoor worden misleid en onnodig hoge informatietarieven betalen om telefonisch contact op te nemen met instanties of bedrijven die gratis of tegen beperkte belkosten telefonisch bereikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over misleidende datingsites met valse profielen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about dating sites using fake profiles, including whether such sites can be taken offline and how victims are supported. The government answered that the ACM can investigate and fine misleading practices but cannot take websites offline, that this power is under discussion at EU level, and that it is working with victim support organisations.
It is not possible to take websites offline, because the ACM lacks the power to do so.
Het is niet mogelijk om websites offline te halen, omdat de bevoegdheid hiertoe bij de ACM ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over marktverstorende bestedingen van netwerkbedrijven

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about dividend flows and commercial activities of grid operator Liander and its parent Alliander, including alleged cross-subsidisation and whether public shareholders have sufficient oversight. The minister answers that legal rules (Besluit financieel beheer netbeheerder, Elektriciteitswet, Gaswet) limit commercial side activities and cross-subsidy, that ACM supervises compliance, that no grounds for concern exist, and that he will discuss the matter with shareholders and the energy transition bill will address activity boundaries.
I have no signals that grid operator Liander does not meet these requirements.
Ik heb geen signalen dat netbeheerder Liander niet aan deze eisen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over een onderzoek van CE Delft naar de vraag over hoe recht gedaan kan worden aan de Urgenda-rechtszaak

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CE Delft study on how to comply with the Urgenda court ruling (25% CO2 cut by 2020) and whether closing coal plants would be needed and what the costs would be. The government answered by referring to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 32 813, nr. 123) answering the same questions.

The written questions from MP Jan Vos (PvdA) to the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CE Delft study on how to give effect to the Urgenda court case, question number 2016Z16273, have been answered in the letter 'Response to questions and request regarding the Urgenda case and CBS figures on greenhouse gas emissions' (Parliamentary paper 32 813, no. 123).

Antwoord 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Jan Vos (PvdA) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over een onderzoek van CE Delft naar de vraag over hoe recht gedaan kan worden aan de Urgenda-rechtszaak, vraagnummer 2016Z16273 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op vragen en verzoek inzake de Urgenda-zaak en CBS-cijfers over broeikasgasuitstoot» (Kamerstuk 32 813, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de berichten rondom de veiligheid van de reactor in Petten

An MP asked the ministers whether financial pressure on NRG, the operator of the Petten reactor, has subordinated nuclear safety, whether management pressures staff to keep the reactor running, and whether an independent investigation (e.g. by the Safety Board) and phasing out nuclear installations are warranted. The government answers that the regulator ANVS found no compromise of safety, that it has conducted intensified oversight and will host IAEA missions in October 2016 and early 2017, and that the financial questions will be addressed in a decision in Q4 2016, without committing to phasing out.
The ANVS exercises independent supervision over NRG.
De ANVS houdt onafhankelijke toezicht op NRG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het rapport ‘Zorg tussen wal en schip’

An MP asked several ministers about the OVV report on medical assistance at sea by the Kustwacht, covering staffing, investment, coordination with healthcare, and whether the Kustwacht annual report is sent to parliament. The minister defers substantive answers on most questions to a forthcoming full response to the OVV report, providing only partial information on summer incident patterns and the state of helicopter talks.
The answer to the above questions 2, 3, 4 and 5 I will include in my response to the OVV report.
Het antwoord op bovengenoemde vragen 2, 3, 4 en 5 neem ik mee in mijn reactie op het OVV-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Ahold na de fusie met Delhaize leveranciers met terugwerkende kracht minder gaat betalen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Ahold Delhaize's plan to retroactively reduce payments to suppliers breaches the fair trading code, and about competition and complaint options. The minister said the matter is being discussed in the agrofood fair-trade code steering group, that no specific rules govern such talks, and that the ACM has no grounds to act yet, promising a further letter by end of September 2016.
I am awaiting the outcome of this consultation before giving a further substantive response.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van dit overleg af alvorens een verdere inhoudelijke reactie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Remco Bosma over de uitwerking van de Europese Commissie met betrekking tot het voorstel om de roamingkosten binnen de Europese Unie af te schaffen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the European Commission's proposal to limit abolition of EU roaming charges to 'normal use' (90 days per year, 30 consecutive), and whether this undermines a single European digital market. The minister answered that the proposal was withdrawn, that limits are needed to protect telecom operators and prevent domestic price rises, and that he will await the Commission's new proposal and negotiations on wholesale caps.
The withdrawn proposal of the European Commission elaborated what should be understood as normal use.
Het ingetrokken voorstel van de Europese Commissie werkte uit wat onder normaal gebruik moet worden verstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de voorgenomen sancties door het CBS en het bericht «Verplichte deelname aan CBS-telling Varkensstapel van de zotte»

An MP from the CDA asked the government about mandatory CBS agricultural surveys with fines, the added administrative burden, the low response rates and the lack of prior communication. The ministers answered that the obligation follows from a 2015 AMvB consultation, that the CBS director-general decides independently on fines, and that a meeting with LTO is planned for 19 September.
The director-general of the CBS, as an independent administrative body, is independent in his choice whether or not to enforce a fine.
De directeur-generaal van het CBS is als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan onafhankelijk in zijn keuze om een boete wel of niet tot uitvoering te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het Onderwijsaccountantsprotocol 2016

An SP MP asked the education and economic affairs ministers why the 2016 accountant protocol limits procurement checks above EU thresholds to administrative organisation and internal control, and how this fits with the earlier growth model. The minister replied that full checks were never required, that the lighter scope was chosen to reduce burden and respond to accountants' objections, and that oversight remains via the accountant's reporting, the civil courts and the Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts.
Because I am responsible for making a workable audit protocol available to the institutional accountants, I chose to heed their objections and opted for a less burdensome form of control.

Omdat ik ervoor verantwoordelijk ben een uitvoerbaar controleprotocol aan de instellingsaccountants beschikbaar te stellen, heb ik ervoor gekozen gehoor te geven aan hun bezwaren en gekozen voor een minder zware vorm van controle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘NAM stuurt experts weg’

MP Agnes Mulder asked why NAM ended its agreement with contra-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, which Groningen earthquake victims often used, and whether the government would mediate. The minister answered that NAM cited many complaints about delays and report quality, that Vergnes ended an improvement trajectory, and that residents can still obtain contra-expertise from other firms and appeal to the Arbiter Aardbevingsschade.
This concerns a cooperative relationship between two private parties in which the government is not a party and cannot simply intervene.
Het betreft een samenwerkingsrelatie tussen twee private partijen waar de overheid geen partij in is en niet zonder meer in kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de NAM die niet meer wil samenwerken met een onafhankelijk contra-expertisebureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM may end cooperation with the independent counter-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, and whether this undermines residents' trust and calls for moving damage assessment to the NCG. The minister answered that NAM stopped reimbursing new Vergnes counter-expertises after failed quality improvement talks, that NAM may terminate such private contracts without NCG consent, and that the NCG will take a supervisory role over the CVW.
It is important that experts deliver quality and that residents are adequately helped.
Het is van belang dat experts kwaliteit leveren en dat bewoners adequaat worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het door de NAM opzeggen van het vertrouwen in Leekster contra-expertisebureau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the NAM may end its cooperation with the contra-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, whether NAM is delaying payment of invoices, and whether NAM should be kept further at arm's length from earthquake damage settlement in Groningen. The minister answered that the termination is a private decision by NAM outside government control, that NAM will resume contra-expertise commissions once reports meet standards, and that NCG will take a supervisory role over the Centrum Veilig Wonen.
The cooperation between NAM and Vergnes concerns a collaboration between two private parties in which the government is not a party and cannot simply intervene.
De samenwerkingsrelatie tussen NAM en Vergnes betreft een samenwerking tussen twee private partijen waar de overheid geen partij in is en niet zonder meer in kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over ‘de Groninger Bodembeweging en het Groninger Gasberaad, die niet meer praten met Nationaal Coördinator Groningen’

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about Groningen residents' refusal to talk with the National Coordinator Groningen over the NAM damage protocol, including the rise in rejected c-damage claims, NAM's and CVW's influence, and the damage contour line. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to ongoing audits and research due in early 2017, and agreed to individually assess claims without a contour line, though he declined to give the NCG the power to set the protocol itself.
The damage protocol, established by NAM, is intended to achieve rapid and low-threshold handling of damage claims by the CVW.
Het schadeprotocol, dat is vastgesteld door NAM, is bedoeld om tot snelle en laagdrempelige afhandeling te komen van schadeclaims door het CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘TU Delft geeft de NAM ervan langs’

An MP asked the minister whether TU Delft's validation of the Arcadis study, which found the NAM damage contours unsound, means the contours cannot be used to sort damage claims, and how claimants outside the contours will be inspected and compensated. The minister confirmed that contours cannot be used to decide claims, that inspections will run through December 2016 with a new expert panel pilot and arbiter access, and that the pilot will be independently evaluated.
NAM now accepts the NCG's conclusion that the damage contour line it set is not tenable and that all reported damage must nevertheless be assessed individually.
NAM conformeert zich nu aan de conclusie van de NCG dat de door NAM vastgestelde schadecontourlijn niet houdbaar is en dat alle gemelde schades alsnog individueel moeten worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het validatieonderzoek van de TU Delft

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a TU Delft validation study finding that NAM's Arcadis-based damage contour around the Groningen gas field is not tenable, and whether NAM and the CVW will drop it and compensate damage outside it. The minister agreed the contour is not tenable, said NAM and CVW accept that all reported damage must be assessed individually via a pilot overseen by an independent steering committee, and said a supervisory role for the NCG on the CVW will be detailed later.
Based on the results of the TU Delft study, the NCG concludes that the damage contour set by NAM is not tenable and all reported damage must be individually assessed.

Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de TU Delft concludeert de NCG dat de door NAM vastgestelde schadecontourlijn niet houdbaar is en alle aangemelde schade alsnog individueel moet worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat bomen in Twekkelo zijn beschadigd door een leidingbreuk in het zoutwinningsgebied

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a pipeline leak of brine from salt mining in Twekkelo that damaged trees, the delay in reporting, the cause, and oversight of AkzoNobel's pipelines, including whether the regulator SodM was doing enough. The minister answered in detail, describing the leak timeline, the roughly 1,400 cubic metres of brine released, the corroded T-piece and planned replacements, and SodM's decision to place AkzoNobel under intensified supervision.
I therefore think that placing AkzoNobel Salt BV (hereinafter: AkzoNobel) under intensified supervision by SodM is an appropriate step.
Ik denk daarom dat het onder verscherpt toezicht plaatsen van AkzoNobel Salt BV (hierna: AkzoNobel) door SodM een gepaste stap is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de heropstart van de afvalwaterinjectie in Twente

MPs Mulder and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the permits, chemical content, liability, legal classification, seismic risk and timing of the restart of wastewater injection in Twente by NAM. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, committing to send the permits and the evaluation reports, while declining to treat the injection as a waste-disposal matter under EU rules.
Yes, I will send these permits separately to your House in the short term.
Ja, deze vergunningen zal ik op korte termijn separaat naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over marktverstorend gedrag van PostNL door het hanteren van roofprijzen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Tax Authority's award of a 72-hour postal contract to Sandd, with PostNL scoring the maximum price points, amounted to predatory pricing, and what the ACM's ex ante powers allow. The minister replied that the 15-cent price floor exceeds current rates, that the award weighed price and quality equally, that scores and bids are confidential, and that the ACM can act under the Postal Act and plans to repeal Article 9 of the Postal Act.

The scores obtained concern confidential information that the contracting authority, in this case the Tax Authority acting through category management on behalf of central government, communicates only to bidders.

De behaalde scores betreffen vertrouwelijke informatie die door de aanbestedende dienst, in dit geval de Belastingdienst vanuit categoriemanagement namens de rijksoverheid, enkel richting inschrijvers wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Veen naar aanleiding van het bericht kartelvorming Europese truckfabrikanten

MPs Visser and Van Veen asked whether the government had noted the European Commission's truck cartel fine, and how much direct and indirect subsidy went to the truck makers and Dutch operators during the cartel period. The minister confirmed awareness, listed modest direct subsidies to DAF, Scania, Volvo and Renault, and programme subsidies to operators, and said clawback was not possible because no grounds existed and the subsidy rules were not affected.
There are therefore no indications that the cartel agreements affected or violated the relevant subsidy rules.
Er zijn dan ook geen aanwijzingen dat de kartelafspraken de betreffende subsidieregels heeft geraakt dan wel heeft overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Leenders over berichten inzake de Zuid-West 380 kV Oost-hoogspanningsverbinding

MPs Cegerek and Leenders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that alternative routes for the ZW380 Oost high-voltage line were not taken seriously, that the route document was biased, and that TenneT ignored environmental guidelines and altered routes. The minister denied these claims, saying alternatives were incorporated through an interactive process, the route document follows the guidelines, and the environmental impact report will determine the preferred alternative with an independent monitoring commission.
I do not agree with this claim. The route document substantiates, based on the policy starting points of SEV III and the EIA principles, why the distinct realistic alternatives were considered.

Ik ben het niet met deze stelling eens. In het tracédocument is op basis van de beleidsuitgangspunten van SEV III- en m.e.r.-principes onderbouwd waarom de onderscheidende realistische alternatieven in beschouwing zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over mijnwaterschade in Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays in the study of mine-water damage in Limburg, its deadline, the reasons for delay, responsibility for damage and limitation periods. The minister answered that the study results will be published by end 2016 due to a peer review, that the Rijk is not responsible for mining damage (operators are liable), and that claims for coal-mining damage are time-barred since the mines closed in 1974.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hoogland over problemen inzake autohuur in het buitenland

An MP asked ministers about problems Dutch consumers face when renting cars abroad, what actions were taken and the status of the EU-level Joint Action with car rental firms. The minister acknowledged the problems, described the EU-led self-cleaning process and stated that new rules are not opportune for now, while awaiting the effects of measures taken.
At this moment I do not consider it opportune to come with proposals for new rules, as we are still awaiting the effects of the measures taken.
Op dit moment acht ik het niet opportuun om te komen met voorstellen voor nieuwe regels, nu we nog in afwachting zijn van de effecten van de genomen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het aanpakken van frauderende franchisegevers door OM en FIOD

An MP from the Labour party asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice why the public prosecutor and FIOD declined to prosecute alleged franchise fraud, and how franchisees are protected in the pre-contractual phase, including the Dutch Franchise Code and acquisition fraud law. The minister replied that the prosecutor decided not to prosecute after investigation, that a court challenge under article 12 Sv is pending and cannot be discussed, that the Franchise Code remains self-regulation with plans for possible legislation later, and that the law on acquisition fraud is not retroactive.
I cannot say anything further about that while this procedure is still ongoing.
Ik kan daar verder niets over zeggen zolang deze procedure nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het nieuwsbericht “Ongeplande centrale-uitval plus veel wind vergen uiterste van TenneT”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the July 2016 market restrictions TenneT imposed due to grid congestion, and whether such problems will increase with renewables. The minister explained the combination of wind feed-in, unplanned plant outages and high imports/exports caused a rare congestion, that TenneT used market restrictions as a regular tool, and that a planned grid expansion by end 2018 should reduce the need, while acknowledging more flexibility may be needed later.
Applying market restrictions is in itself a regular activity for TenneT to resolve an N-1 exceedance in parts of the grid.
Het toepassen van marktrestricties is op zich een reguliere activiteit voor TenneT om een N-1 overschrijding in delen van het net op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over de verstoring van een Israëlkraam in een Jumbo supermarkt

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked the ministers whether an online protest campaign against an Israeli product display in a Jumbo supermarket in Krimpen aan den IJssel was undesirable, and what the government would do to protect supermarkets and staff from intimidation. The minister answered that such actions fall under freedom of expression, that criminal law applies to threats or intimidation, that no signals of disruption of public order were received, and that no extra measures against protest campaigns are needed.
I therefore see no reason to take additional measures against protest campaigns.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om extra maatregelen te nemen tegen protestcampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ‘grote schade door hagel Zuid-Oost Brabant’

MP Van Gerven asked about the government's response to hail and storm damage in south-east Brabant, including coordination with insurers, asbestos clean-up, solar panel schemes, declaring a disaster area, and hardship cases. The Secretary of State answered that a national working group with the province, municipalities, insurers and ministries is addressing the damage, refers to earlier letters for progress, notes that the disaster compensation law does not apply, and says hardship cases are handled case by case.
Although this situation is far-reaching for the entrepreneurs involved, the Disaster Damage Compensation Act does not apply.
Hoewel deze situatie ingrijpend is voor betrokken ondernemers, is de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het bericht “LTO Noord: op basis van dit onderzoek kun je toch geen conclusies trekken?”

MPs Jan Vos and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that LTO Noord calls a Sweco study on uneven land subsidence in Groningen agricultural fields too thin to support conclusions, and whether gas extraction is excluded as a cause and whether independent research and dialogue with LTO Noord will happen. The minister answered that the Sweco report is not yet public and that he has asked the NCG to review it with the commission and LTO Noord, after which he will inform parliament.
The Sweco report is not yet public.
Het rapport van onderzoeksbureau Sweco is nog niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schade aan huurwoningen door gaswinning

MPs asked why housing corporation Woongroep Marenland refuses to repair gas-extraction damage to tenants' homes in Appingedam and what the minister and the NCG will do about it. The minister declined to comment on an individual case, citing a pending court dispute, but reported that the damage was repaired under NAM supervision and during an NCG inspection, and agreed tenants must be taken seriously.
As a rule I do not go into individual cases. There is a conflict between a tenant and a housing corporation involving a pending court ruling.
In de regel ga ik niet in op een individuele casus. Er is hier sprake van een conflict tussen een huurder en een woningcorporatie waarbij een gerechtelijke uitspraak aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Italianen weigeren Gronings gas te betalen”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Italian company Eni refuses to pay for Groningen gas, including whether such gas is still exported and whether supplies should be halted. The minister answered that the arbitration dispute is ongoing and declined to comment on individual contracts, said the Eni contract concerns high-calorific gas, that no export volumes can be stated, and that stopping supply is not an option.
Apart from the fact that I do not make statements about individual contracts, it therefore cannot be stated how much Groningen gas is supplied to Eni.
Nog los van het gegeven dat ik geen mededelingen doe over individuele contracten, is daarom niet aan te geven hoeveel Groningengas er aan Eni is en wordt geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de heropstart van de oliewinning in Schoonebeek en de hervatting van de injectie van productiewater in Twente

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the minister whether NAM had informed him of its plan to resume wastewater injection and oil production at Schoonebeek, why parliament was not informed of the decision, and to release the evaluation and Deltares report. The minister confirmed NAM notified SodM and his ministry, said the decision was postponed to year-end, promised to send the evaluation and advice by early September, but declined to provide some documents and deferred the decision to consultation with the region.
I expect to send the Commission's advice and the Deltares second opinion to your House in early September 2016.
Ik verwacht het advies van de Commissie en de second opinion van Deltares begin september 2016 naar uw Kamer toe te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Kamp vindt Green Deals nuttig, maar zet financiering stop’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the government will stop funding Green Deals, despite judging them useful, and about the effects on success rates and scaling. The minister replies that most Green Deals have no government funding, that the instrument is about cooperation, network support and a single contact point, and that ending funding mainly means that funded-type Green Deals will no longer be concluded.
The expected effect is that the type of Green Deals that request financial support will no longer be concluded, and in time will no longer be requested.
Het effect dat wordt verwacht is dat het type Green Deals waar financiële ondersteuning bij gevraagd wordt niet meer zullen worden gesloten, en op termijn ook niet meer zullen worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Recourt over het mogelijke verlies van 4000 banen bij Tata Steel in IJmuiden

MPs Jan Vos and Recourt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of possible loss of 4,000 jobs at Tata Steel IJmuiden, whether merger talks with ThyssenKrupp are under way, whether government is kept informed, and what it will do to protect jobs. The minister confirmed the reports, said Tata Steel has started talks with strategic European partners including ThyssenKrupp, that the ministry is informed and in regular contact with the company, and that he values the plant highly, without committing to a specific intervention.
The ministry was directly informed by Tata Steel Netherlands of the talks with strategic partners in the steel industry, and there is regular contact about any further developments.

Het ministerie is direct door Tata Steel Nederland op de hoogte gesteld van de gesprekken met strategische partners in de staalindustrie en er is regelmatig contact over eventuele verdere ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de bij- en meestook van biomassa

An SP MP asked the minister whether 1.5 billion euros of SDE+ subsidy for co-firing biomass in coal plants is justified and whether policy will change after a motion; the minister replied that co-firing is a Energieakkoord target, defended the sustainability criteria, and said the KNAW advice is being integrated into the circular economy programme. The minister refused to change course but promised to inform parliament after the summer.
I will inform the House on this after the summer when sending the circular economy programme.
Ik zal zoals gezegd uw Kamer hierover na de zomer met het verzenden van het programma circulaire economie informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over restwarmte uit de Uniper-kolencentrale

The MP asked whether the minister requested Gasunie to study a heat pipeline carrying residual heat from the Uniper coal plant to the Westland, whether this fits Gasunie's legal role, and whether public funds or regulated tariffs would be used. The minister denied asking Gasunie to study it, said Gasunie New Energy joined the feasibility study voluntarily, and stated that GTS's regulated transport tasks do not permit investments in heat infrastructure.
It is therefore not permitted for Gasunie to make investments in heat infrastructure from the regulated tariffs, or to recover such investments through the regulated tariffs for gas transport.

Het is dan ook niet toegestaan dat Gasunie vanuit de gereguleerde tarieven investeringen doet in warmte-infrastructuur, danwel deze investeringen terugverdient via de gereguleerde tarieven voor het transport van gas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Nijboer over het bericht “Nog geen uitspraken vanwege schending bankierseed”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Nijboer asked why the banker's oath disciplinary Tuchtcommissie had issued no rulings a year after its introduction, why 43 of 57 complaints were rejected by the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken, and how franchisees denied access to their credit files and loan information could be protected. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the first year was a transitional period without retroactive effect, that rejected complaints were civil disputes for Kifid or the courts, that six complaints are pending with first rulings expected late 2016, and that DNB and AFM are investigating how banks implement the oath.
An adequate procedure at the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken appears to be assured.
Een adequate procesgang bij de stichting Tuchtrecht Banken lijkt geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vertraging in het onderzoek over schade aan woningen in Steenbergen en de gasopslag van de NAM bij Langelo

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the NAM's follow-up investigation into damage to homes near Steenbergen and Norg has not started, why residents are poorly informed, and whether expanding the Norg gas storage is responsible given unresolved damage reports. The minister answers that the National Coordinator Groningen visited Norg and that NAM is preparing follow-up and validation studies independent of the minister, and that conditions including a seismic network and a risk update by 1 November 2016 are imposed before the storage plan is reviewed.

In addition, I have required NAM to provide, by 1 November 2016 and to the satisfaction of the Inspector-General of Mines, a written update of the seismic risk analysis for the Norg underground gas storage.

Daarnaast heb ik NAM opgelegd om voor 1 november 2016, ten genoegen van de Inspecteur-Generaal der Mijnen een schriftelijke update aan te leveren van de seismische risicoanalyse voor de ondergrondse gasopslag Norg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de boycot van een bedrijf door de gemeente Smallingerland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the municipality of Smallingerland excluding agricultural machinery firm De Boer from procurement over a violation, questioning proportionality, transparency and compliance with the Aanbestedingswet 2012. The minister answered that the legal assessment of such municipal exclusion is for the courts, that procurement principles apply, and that the government is not in a position to judge or call the municipality to account.
It is not for me to call a municipality to account for its conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om een gemeente aan te spreken op haar handelwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het Verhoeven over het bericht dat gemeenten en winkels zich niet houden aan de regels voor wifi-tracking

An MP asked whether municipalities and shops are complying with privacy rules on wifi-tracking of phones in public spaces, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the Data Protection Authority did not investigate concrete cases in 2016, gave guidance letters instead, considers its enforcement powers sufficient, and pointed to awareness campaigns, while stating that the AP found no non-compliance by municipalities.
It is therefore not known whether municipalities and shops comply with the rules.
Het is dus niet bekend of gemeenten en winkels zich aan de regels houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ontwikkelingen aangaande kredietunies in Nederland

MPs Nijboer asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the role of credit unions in SME lending, subsidy targeting, unregulated bodies calling themselves credit unions, banks acting as intermediaries, and regional or sectoral focus. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that credit unions are small, that subsidies are not split by model, that AFM oversees crowdfunding intermediaries using the name, and that banks' conditions are case-specific without committing to new action.
There is no reason to prohibit these initiatives from calling themselves a credit union.
Er is geen reden om deze initiatieven te verbieden om zich kredietunie te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de toename van het aantal zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers) in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs asked the government about a rise in self-employed people without staff (zzp'ers) in debt assistance, its causes, access barriers and whether minimum rates should be set. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the trend, said debt assistance is aimed at citizens and that self-employed people can use municipal business support, rejected minimum rates for zzp'ers, and pointed to information initiatives.
Yes. I am already doing so.
Ja. Ik ben daarmee ook reeds doende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers, Visser, De Boer en Van Veen over het bericht ‘Nederland traag met investeren via Europa’

VVD MPs asked why the Netherlands uses relatively little EFSI investment funding, whether projects were rejected, and whether EFSI should be extended beyond 2018. The minister replied that seven Dutch EFSI transactions worth EUR 287 million have been approved, that rejections are not recorded, that the NIA was set up to help pipeline projects, and that the government will assess any extension constructively, demanding budget clarity and evaluation.
The number of rejections for EFSI is not recorded, because that may contain business-sensitive information.
Het aantal afwijzingen voor EFSI wordt niet geregistreerd, omdat dat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van een privé-e-mailadres voor werkaangelegenheden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about his use of a private email account for work matters, the security rules that apply, the 2014 hacking investigation and possible foreign access to the data. The minister admitted frequent but not prohibited business use of private email, ordered an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into whether classified material was present, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departmental Confidential, State Secret Confidential, State Secret Secret or State Secret Top Secret under the VIR-BI were present in my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim zoals bedoeld in het Voorschrift Informatiebeveiliging Rijksdienst Bijzondere Informatie (VIR-BI) op mijn privé e-mailaccount aanwezig waren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over mobiele dekking in spoor- en autotunnels

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of mobile coverage in rail and road tunnels, including the Delft rail tunnel, and why it was delayed. The State Secretary answered that coverage in the Delft tunnel became available on 12 May 2016, admitted it came later than wished, and promised to report to parliament in autumn 2016 on talks with providers and to inform on responsibilities and tunnel standards.
It would have been better for travellers if they had been able to use a well-functioning mobile network directly when the rail tunnel opened.
Het was voor de reizigers beter geweest wanneer zij direct bij open telling van de spoortunnel over een goed werkend mobiel netwerk hadden kunnen beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Gesthuizen over digitale platforms voor verhuur van woningen aan toeristen, zoals Airbnb en Wimdu

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers for Housing and Economic Affairs about short-term tourist rental of homes via platforms like Airbnb, including whether social rental homes may be rented out and whether a notification duty is needed. Minister Blok answered that social housing must not be used for tourist rental, that existing laws (Huisvestingswet, Woningwet, Wro) already give municipalities enough enforcement tools, and that no notification duty is planned for now, while the government is working on a tax-data provision and on local agreements with platforms.
Due to privacy considerations, there is currently no possibility to oblige Airbnb to provide the data of providers or users of its services to the government.
In verband met de privacy is er op dit moment geen mogelijkheid om Airbnb te verplichten de gegevens van aanbieders of gebruikers van hun diensten aan de overheid te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over de buitenproportionele hoge tarieven van bellen en internetten buiten de Europese Unie

MPs Jacobi and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why mobile calling and internet tariffs outside the EU are far higher than inside it, and whether he would regulate them or amend the Telecommunications Act. The minister answered that non-EU roaming tariffs are unregulated and undesirable, but he will not regulate them domestically because wholesale rates would make providers loss-making, and he sees the matter as an EU/ITU/WTO negotiation issue.
I do not intend to make agreements with providers in the Netherlands to regulate tariffs for calling and internet use outside the European Union.
Ik ben niet voornemens om afspraken te maken met providers in Nederland om tarieven voor bellen en internetten buiten de Europese Unie te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de mogelijkheid voor consumenten om bij annulering van een vliegticket deze over te kunnen dragen aan een ander

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked why consumers can transfer package holidays but not airline tickets, and whether the government would allow resale of cancelled flight tickets as proposed by TradeYourTrip. The minister answered that package transfers are governed by Civil Code rules, airline resale is banned by IATA-based airline terms, and that the government will consult industry and consumer groups and examine feasibility, fraud and safety implications.

I will, together with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment, enter into discussions with the Consumentenbond, industry bodies such as ANVR and BARIN, and airlines to discuss the possibilities and implications.

Ik zal in samenwerking met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu in gesprek gaan met de Consumentenbond, brancheorganisaties zoals de ANVR en de BARIN en luchtvaartmaatschappijen om de mogelijkheden en implicaties te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het wel produceren van rapporten maar niet repareren van de schade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen produce costly reports without repairing gas-damage, including claims of 25,000 euro in reports, that these exceed the actual damage, and that they rarely call back. The minister declined to discuss the individual case in detail, said agreement had been reached so repairs can start, noted the CVW is improving its communication, and said handling speed depends on repair complexity.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het onderwerp geen compensatie dubbele heffingen voor pluimveehouders voor het Diergezondheidsfonds door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland

An MP from the CDA asks why poultry farmers with multi-year animals were charged twice for the Animal Health Fund levy in 2014 and 2015 and whether they will be compensated. The State Secretary acknowledges about 1,800 farms were disadvantaged, commits to refunding the double charge against the final 2015 assessment, and explains the calculation rules.
Therefore I will compensate the poultry farmers concerned.
Daarom zal ik de betrokken pluimveehouders tegemoet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de kwaliteit van postbezorging

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about declining postal delivery quality, theft of post, working conditions and market competition, citing a VGP survey showing slight declines in business mail. The minister answered that universal service quality is stable or improving per ACM and PostNL data, that the VGP sample is not fully representative, and that a market review is planned with a new policy rule on postal obligations.
I committed to your House on 30 March to such a study in response to the Vos and Bosma motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 30 maart een dergelijk onderzoek toegezegd in reactie op de motie Vos en Bosma.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer inzake een werkbezoek aan een internationaal bedrijf dat zich richt op het ontwikkelen, ontwerpen en bouwen van schepen en materieel voor de bagger- en offshore- industri

MPs Visser and De Boer asked whether the government has policy supporting Dutch firms in international deep-sea mining, and whether a national legal framework is needed for such activities beyond national jurisdiction. The minister answers that deep-sea mining is embedded in the Topsector Water innovation agenda, that a national law is being considered through the Integraal Afwegingskader without commitment, and that Dutch influence in the International Seabed Authority does not depend on national legislation.
The preparatory process for a possible Dutch legislative process has started, in the form of applying the Integral Assessment Framework (IAK).
Het voorbereidingstraject voor het eventuele Nederlandse wetgevingsproces is gestart, in de vorm van het toepassen van het Integraal Afwegingskader (IAK).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schadetaxaties door het Groninger Taxatie Bureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the Groninger Taxatie Bureau, acting for the Centrum Veilig Wonen, routinely rejects earthquake damage claims, makes counter-expertise dependent on NAM-set limits and underreports damage, and whether NAM and CVW prioritise keeping compensation costs low. The minister denied these allegations, stating that experts follow the NAM protocol and Handboek Aardbevingsschade, that residents may choose a counter-expert and the Arbiter Aardbevingsschade, and that he has no signals of a gap between management and the workfloor.
No. The resident is free to choose their own counter-expert, who is paid by the CVW at a set hourly rate.
Nee. De bewoner is vrij om zelf een contra-expert te kiezen die wordt betaald door het CVW volgens een vastgesteld uurtarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het niet doorgaan van de overname van PostNL door Bpost

An MP asked the economy minister whether the failed takeover of PostNL by Bpost affects service quality, workers, universal postal service obligations and shareholder structure, and whether a law protecting Dutch firms from unwanted foreign takeovers would cover PostNL. The minister said the takeover talks ended, that universal service obligations remain fully in force, that consequences depend on the parties' agreements, and that the protection bill is delayed and will be sent to parliament after the summer.
I will inform your House further about this after the summer and will then also address the scope of the possible measures.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover na de zomer nader informeren en zal dan ook ingaan op de reikwijdte van de mogelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over de mislukte overname van PostNL door Bpost

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the failed takeover of PostNL by Belgian Bpost, including state influence, EU rules, the universal postal service and the level playing field. The minister says Bpost's Belgian state ownership is outside his view, the Commission found Belgian compensation compliant with state aid rules, PostNL is a private company, and he is studying the Dutch postal market and will review additional measures.
On the state of affairs and developments in the Dutch postal market, and therefore possible opportunities and risks, I am currently conducting research, as announced earlier this year to your House.
Naar de stand van zaken en ontwikkelingen op de Nederlandse postmarkt, en dus eventuele kansen en risico’s, doe ik momenteel onderzoek, zoals eerder dit jaar in uw Kamer aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Van Dekken over de hoogspanningsverbinding van 380 kV in Groningen van Eemshaven naar Vierverlaten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the promised further study into undergrounding part of the 380 kV line in Groningen, the status of that study, and whether all area partners are involved in the upcoming administrative consultation. The minister confirmed TenneT's study is ongoing with a decision after summer 2016, and said provincial and municipal officials and residents' groups are consulted at set moments, though not always at the same table.
Based on this study and consultation with the region, I will take a decision after the summer of 2016.
Mede op basis van dit onderzoek en overleg met de regio zal ik na de zomer van 2016 een besluit nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over het bericht van de Consumentenbond dat hotelkamers in Nederland vaak vies zijn

MPs Heerma and Mulder asked the ministers whether a Consumentenbond finding that many hotel rooms are dirty is linked to reported exploitation of hotel cleaners, what hygiene criteria apply, and what the latest data on one- and two-star hotels show. The minister answered that no link is known, that no legal cleaning criteria exist beyond food-hygiene rules enforced by the NVWA, that no hygiene statistics are available, and that the market and review sites should handle hygiene transparency.
There are no figures known about the hygiene of hotels.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de hygiëne van hotels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht “Grond bij Oppenhuizen zakt veel meer bij gaswinning”

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Economic Affairs minister whether a second-opinion study predicting much larger subsidence and a 19% earthquake chance at the Oppenhuizen gas field requires rejecting the drilling plan, and whether reversed burden of proof and a baseline survey of buildings should apply. Minister Kamp replied that SodM and TNO found the predictions plausible, the maximum subsidence is under two centimetres and legally binding, reversed burden of proof does not apply because no building damage is expected, a baseline survey has been agreed, and a single damage desk study will be reported by 1 July 2016.
I asked the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) and TNO to respond to the study by Mr Houtenbos.
Ik heb Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) en TNO gevraagd om een reactie op het onderzoek van de heer Houtenbos.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van de term aardbevingsschade in plaats van mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Arbiters Aardbevingsschade decrees still use the narrower term earthquake damage instead of the broader mining damage that the minister had promised. The minister replied that the NCG follows the Civil Code concept, that the decrees will be amended only once all relevant parties commit to the arbiter's rulings, and that the arbiter adds a low-threshold dispute mechanism distinct from the Mijnraad and Tcbb, which remain in place.
Once this is the case, amending the establishing decree can be considered.
Wanneer dit het geval is, kan aanpassing van het instellingsbesluit worden overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de bouw van een outletcentrum in Zevenaar

An MP asked the Economics and Infrastructure ministers whether the approved Zevenaar outlet centre conflicts with the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, regional retail deals and provincial steering, and what further action is possible to stop it. The minister answered that the Ladder is only a duty to motivate, that the decision belongs to local and provincial authorities and the courts, and that no further appeal is possible against the Council of State ruling.
No appeal is possible against the Council of State's decision.
Tegen het besluit van de Raad van State is geen beroep mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Remco Dijkstra over de berichtgeving en klachten met betrekking tot de opslag van radioactief afval bij NRG in Petten

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports that radioactive waste stored at NRG in Petten is unsafe, and about a complaint filed with the Autoriteit Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming. The minister says there is no direct danger, that waste is safely stored, and answers the complaint's four points, acknowledging past incomplete waste records and past safety-culture problems that have since improved.
In the past the administration of radioactive waste was incomplete, so the figures used varied over the years.
In het verleden was de administratie van het radioactief afval onvolledig, waardoor de gehanteerde getallen in de loop van de jaren hebben gevarieerd.
