Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Oosenbrug over de beperkte bescherming van de consumenten wanneer het misgaat bij het overstappen van abonnementen met een overstapservice

MPs Jacobi and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why consumers are left paying double telecom subscription fees when a provider's switching service goes wrong, and who is responsible. The minister answered that the new provider is responsible for cancelling the old contract, that few complaints exist, and that the government sees no reason for measures beyond the self-regulated service improvements and the Geschillencommissie route.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over de ontmanteling van kerncentrale Borssele

MPs Jan Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant is loss-making and needs a 200 million euro capital injection, and whether a nuclear decommissioning strategy and study could be completed within two months. The minister replied that EPZ makes no loss because shareholders must buy its electricity at cost, that a study of the nuclear knowledge infrastructure is under way and will conclude in autumn, and that the cabinet will inform parliament on the plant's future shortly.
As I previously promised, the cabinet will inform your House shortly about the future of the nuclear plant in light of DELTA's financial situation.
Zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd, zal het kabinet uw Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de toekomst van de kerncentrale in het licht van de financiële situatie van DELTA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de noodstroomvoorziening Borssele

An MP asked ministers about the Borssele nuclear plant's emergency power supply, the absence of an environmental impact assessment for the licence revision, and whether the plant meets its safety commitments. The minister answered that the regulator found no significant environmental impact, that the plant has a backup grid connection and diesel generators, and that a planned upgrade in 2017 will further improve safety.
The ANVS has judged that these proposed changes do not involve significant adverse environmental effects and that an environmental impact assessment is not necessary for them.
De ANVS heeft geoordeeld dat bij deze voorliggende wijzigingen geen sprake is van belangrijke nadelige gevolgen voor het milieu en dat het niet nodig is om hiervoor een m.e.r. uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de misleidende uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Borgingscommissie Energieakkoord

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about claims by the chair of the Energy Agreement oversight committee on wind-energy cost reduction and fossil fuel subsidies, and whether he should be replaced. The minister rejected the claims as inaccurate, said the 40% cost reduction target is on track, and declined to ask the chair to retract or resign.
I think Mr Nijpels gives an excellent interpretation of his role as chair of the Energy Agreement oversight committee.
Ik vind dat de heer Nijpels op uitstekende wijze invulling geeft aan zijn rol als voorzitter van de Borgingscommissie Energieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht dat de noodstroomvoorziening van kerncentrale Borssele ondermaat is

An MP asked the minister about reports that the emergency power supply of the Borssele nuclear plant is inadequate, and whether the claims by Wise and Greenpeace and by the plant's owner are correct. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, referred to an earlier letter, and stated that the claim about loss of the second grid connection is factually incorrect because that connection through the coal plant remains in use until a replacement in 2017.

The claim by Greenpeace and Wise that, due to the decommissioning of the nearby Borssele coal plant in November 2015, this second connection to the grid of the KCB running via that coal plant has also lapsed, is factually incorrect.

De bewering van Greenpeace en Wise dat door het uit gebruik nemen van de nabijgelegen Kolencentrale Borssele in november 2015 ook deze tweede verbinding met het elektriciteitsnet van de KCB die via deze kolencentrale loopt is vervallen klopt feitelijk niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de uitspraak van de Europese Commissie dat detectie van adblockers illegaal is

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether websites running scripts to detect ad blockers breach the Dutch telecom rule requiring consent for storing information on user devices, and whether enforcement or a regulator investigation is planned. The minister answered that the ACM considers such detection scripts covered by the statutory exception for quality or effectiveness measurement without significant privacy impact, so no enforcement action is taken and the independent regulators will decide their own roles.

The ACM is of the view that this situation falls under the exception in the third paragraph of article 11.7a of the Telecommunications Act, so the information obligation and consent requirement do not apply.

De ACM is van oordeel dat het hier gaat om een situatie die valt onder de uitzondering in het derde lid van artikel 11.7a van de Telecommunicatiewet, waardoor de informatieplicht en het toestemmingsvereiste niet van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over aardbevingsbestendige normen in Groningen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about progress in setting earthquake-resistant standards for new, renovated and reinforced buildings, industrial installations and infrastructure in Groningen. The minister replied that the individual risk norm of 10^-5 per year was set in November 2015, that building norms were translated into a practice guideline, and that norms for industry and infrastructure are still being developed, with a government response expected in autumn 2016.
A response to this still open recommendation has been promised to your House. I expect to be able to give it in autumn 2016.
Aan uw Kamer is een reactie toegezegd op deze nog open staande aanbeveling. Deze verwacht ik in het najaar van 2016 te kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “Shell in je elektromotor”

An MP asked the government about hydrogen fuelling infrastructure, the number of hydrogen vehicles, and a low-pressure hydrogen technology by H2Fuel, including whether research on its efficiency would be conducted. The answers give current and planned counts of tanking points and vehicles, state the technology is at an early stage requiring further validation, and say the ministry is considering how to do so.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment is currently considering how this can best be carried out.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu beziet momenteel op welke manier dit het beste kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘ACM wil structurele ruimte voor aansluiting smart grids’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the energy transition needs more room in laws and regulations, citing ACM's position on smart grid connections. The minister answered that no concrete legal obstacles are currently known, that ACM can only grant exemptions from its own codes and chose a code change instead, and that the new Electricity and Gas Act will broaden experimentation rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over gezondheidsklachten als gevolg van meervoudige mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about health complaints linked to repeated gas-extraction damage in Groningen, the RUG Gronings Perspectief findings, and how policy would respond. The minister confirmed the interim findings, said the NCG already prioritises relieving affected residents and will use the results to improve procedures, and declined to speculate on the study's final conclusions about underlying causes.
In response to this report, the NCG has already indicated that the results will be used to improve the damage protocol and the working method of the Centre for Safe Living (CVW) in that respect.
In reactie op dit rapport heeft de NCG reeds laten weten dat de resultaten zullen worden benut om het schadeprotocol en de werkwijze van het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) in dat opzicht te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de NAM BTW-constructie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VAT construction by NAM in which damage compensation to Groningen earthquake victims was invoiced in NAM's name, so that VAT could be reclaimed, and whether this could be criminal or burdened victims. The State Secretary answered that VAT on repair services is generally due but declined to give details about NAM's specific arrangements citing tax confidentiality (art. 67 AWR), and refused to give victims legal immunity or request a tax ruling.
Given the fiscal confidentiality duty of art. 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot go into this matter concretely.
Gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van art. 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet concreet ingaan op deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Zzp’er verwacht schade door nieuwe wetgeving”

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that freelancers expect harm from the new Wet DBA and about unclear enforcement, sector support, boetes and administrative burden. The government answered that the Belastingdienst will not enforce repressively until 1 May 2017 except in three named situations, that it will publish questions and answers and a summary of inquiries, and that it monitors implementation through consultations and stakeholder channels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de uitspraak van de rechter inzake Amsterdam versus Colt Technology Services b.v. ten aanzien van energiebesparende maatregelen

An MP asked the ministers about a court ruling on Amsterdam versus Colt Technology Services concerning the energy-saving obligation under the Activities Decree, and whether municipalities have enough enforcement tools and whether recognised measure lists resolve disputes. The minister answered that the agreements in the Energy Agreement are being implemented, that the recognised measure lists are a voluntary but legally anchored route for companies, and that the system will be evaluated after two years.
It has also been agreed to evaluate the new system two years after the new regulations entered into force (December 2015).
Er is bovendien afgesproken om twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe regelgeving (december 2015) de nieuwe systematiek te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedalingsregeling

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Groningen value-decline compensation scheme applies in some municipalities but not Oldambt, whether value-increase rules also exclude Oldambt, and about the status of a motion for a similar scheme. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the value-increase scheme now covers all earthquake damage above 1,000 euro, said the motion will be considered in the spring memorandum, and justified the value-decline geographic boundary by a CBS study of housing-market functioning.
The cabinet will take this motion into account in the decision-making for the spring memorandum and will then inform the House of Representatives about it.
Het kabinet betrekt deze motie bij de besluitvorming in het kader van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer hierover vervolgens informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) drie casemanagers heeft aangenomen die eerder voor NAM de schadeafhandeling hebben gedaan

MP Smaling asked whether the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) hired three case managers who previously handled damage claims for NAM, and whether their independence is guaranteed and whether they handled the same complex cases earlier. The minister answered that the NCG hired them for their expertise on complex cases, that they were contracted via an external agency, that a list of 195 complex cases was identified with NAM and reassigned cases will go to other case managers, and that no one is excluded on the basis of prior clients.
If a damage case arises that is connected to a matter in which they were involved on behalf of NAM, it will be assigned to another case manager.
Indien zich een schadegeval aandient dat verband houdt met een zaak waar zij namens NAM bij betrokken zijn geweest, dan wordt deze toegewezen aan een andere casemanager.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Vermue en Albert de Vries over de alternatieven voor het nieuwe hoogspanningstraject in Zeeland

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about alternative routings for a new high-voltage line in Zeeland proposed by D-Cision, including whether the existing 150 kV line will fail by 2020 and whether the minister will consult the province and municipalities. The minister confirmed awareness, argued the existing line need not be upgraded for 10 to 15 years, said the preferred route remains best, and promised to assess the proposal's effects and inform the House before summer 2016.
As I indicated during the General Consultation on 20 April 2016, I am currently working to map the effects of this.
Zoals ik tijdens het Algemeen Overleg op 20 april 2016 heb aangeven ben ik momenteel bezig om de effecten hiervan in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Nijboer over afvalwater van NAM in de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about media reports that NAM would discharge treated production water into the Wadden Sea via the Eems, and why NAM does not simply choose the purification-and-discharge option. The minister replied that the re-injection alternatives are still under evaluation with a decision expected in December 2016, that composition monitoring classifies the injection water as non-hazardous, and that he does not recognise the portrayal of NAM as cost-evading.
The supervisory committee's task is to check whether the research process is transparent and that the questions and concerns in the region are taken into account in the study.
De begeleidingscommissie heeft als taak om te controleren of het onderzoeksproces transparant verloopt, en dat de vragen en zorgen die leven in de regio worden meegenomen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over de Klachtenregen over zzp-verzekeringen arbeidsongeschiktheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the ministers about complaints over disability insurance for self-employed workers, including whether premiums should be refunded when insurers refuse benefits over non-disclosed medical history and why premium restitution under the old Commercial Code was dropped. The government answered that insurers may refuse claims only where the non-disclosed information was material, that premium restitution is limited under article 7:938 BW, and that it will review the rule with stakeholders and report after the summer.
In view of the above, I see sufficient reason to review, in consultation with the relevant stakeholders, article 7:938 of the Civil Code and the scope of the right to premium restitution.
In het voorgaande zie ik voldoende aanleiding om in overleg met de relevante stakeholders artikel 7: 938 BW en de reikwijdte van het recht op premierestitutie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over de verduurzaming van sportcomplexen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether greening sports facilities was an agreed measure of the Energy Agreement, whether the sports energy-savings subsidy is the main instrument, whether its budget will be topped up, and what the added value is if not. The minister replied that the subsidy stems from a parliamentary motion and is separate from the Energy Agreement, that no budget top-up is planned, and that other schemes remain available.
No, both my colleague of Economic Affairs and I see no possibilities within our budgets to top up the budget.
Nee, zowel mijn collega van Economische Zaken als ik zien geen mogelijkheden binnen onze begrotingen om het budget nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zwakke beveiliging van de Nederlandse kerncentrales tegen terrorisme

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the weak protection of Dutch nuclear power plants against terrorism, with only unarmed guards, is acceptable, and whether the government will follow US experts' advice to station armed teams on site. The minister answered that protection meets national and international rules, threat levels are monitored, no concrete threat information exists, and the government will not change its approach without concrete threat intelligence.
No substantive information is provided about specific security measures.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het onderzoek ‘Sluiting van kolencentrales’ van SEO in opdracht van Natuur & Milieu

An MP asked the minister about an SEO study commissioned by Natuur en Milieu on closing coal plants, including criticism from Uniper and TNO and whether the study's emission figures from 1990s plants are outdated. The minister acknowledged the study relies on old emission data, presented actual emission figures for the new plants showing they are often lower than SEO assumed, and expected the social benefits to be considerably lower than reported.
In the report, SEO itself notes that the emissions it uses to calculate social benefits are based on emission figures of two coal plants from the 1990s.
In het rapport benoemt SEO zelf dat de emissies die zij hanteert om de maatschappelijke baten te berekenen gebaseerd zijn op de uitstootcijfers van de twee kolencentrales uit de jaren »90.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afhandeling van meldingen van aardbevingsschade door het Centrum voor Veilig Wonen (CVW) buiten de contour

Three PvdA MPs asked why claims for earthquake damage outside the damage contour are not being processed by CVW while a validation study is pending, and whether registration and provisional payments could proceed now. The minister replied that NAM's Arcadis study finds such damage negligible, that an independent validation is due around summer and the minister will inform parliament then, and that NAM will visit all reporters but wants the validation results first; a judgement now would almost certainly mean rejection.
I will inform your House at that moment.
Ik zal uw Kamer op dat moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht “Schrap het verpandingsverbod”

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the proposal to lift the ban on pledging claims (verpandingsverbod) to ease SME credit. The minister answered that the problem lies in contractual clauses rather than statute, that a statutory change would be a restriction on freedom of contract, that talks with the banks and factoring association are ongoing, and that a decision will follow after stakeholder consultation.
On this basis, the final decision on the proposal made will take place.
Op basis hiervan zal de definitieve besluitvorming over het gedane voorstel plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Aardbevingsschade maakt Groningers machteloos'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Groningen residents feel powerless over earthquake damage handling by NAM and CVW, and about NAM's treatment of damage outside the theoretical contour. The minister promised to send the Onafhankelijke Raadsman report with his response shortly, and said NAM is legally obliged to compensate all damage, with validation of its outside-contour research expected around summer.
I will shortly send your House the report, accompanied by my response to the findings and recommendations.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn het rapport aanbieden, vergezeld van mijn reactie op de constateringen en aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Visser en De Boer over het bericht ‘Naar een duurzame energiehuishouding met LNG’ in het NEN magazine van februari 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an article on building an EU-wide LNG refuelling network, who is responsible for it, who pays, and how the Netherlands can use LNG opportunities. The minister answered that the market should build alternative fuel stations with government setting conditions, that the Netherlands supports the internal energy market, and that various LNG safety, Green Deal and promotion efforts are underway.
In principle the market is responsible for realising the networks of alternative fuel and charging stations.
In principe is de markt aan zet om de netwerken van alternatieve tank- en laadstations te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel in collectieve arbeidsovereenkomsten

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether cao rate agreements for self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) in the architects' cao breach the Dutch cartel prohibition, and whether such rules should be declared generally binding. The minister answered that competition enforcement belongs to the ACM, that the avv-procedure is still ongoing, that the cao rules are not generally binding for now due to competition risk, and that no further guidelines on bogus self-employment are needed.
It is therefore only up to the ACM to make statements in individual cases.
Het is dan ook slechts aan de ACM om uitspraken te doen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over sluiting van kolencentrales

Two MPs asked whether a previously announced CCS obligation for coal plants should reduce any compensation owed to operators if coal plants are phased out, and whether a 2007 ministerial statement implied such an obligation. The minister answered that compensation depends on many factors still being studied, that the 2007 minister did not state a binding CCS requirement within ten years, that operators were not clearly told of a CCS obligation, and that the financial consequences are still under investigation.
At present I am investigating what the possible financial consequences of measures concerning coal-fired power plants would be.
Op dit moment ben ik aan het onderzoeken wat de mogelijke financiële consequenties zouden zijn van maatregelen rond kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat vliegreizen stilletjes duurder worden

An MP asked the economics minister about reports that flight prices are rising through hidden fees, including baggage charges, and whether the market regulator ACM is acting against non-transparent pricing. The minister answered that ACM enforces price transparency rules, can fine airlines up to 450,000 euro, has already fined several carriers, but sees no reason to talk with the airline sector and treats baggage fees as avoidable optional costs.
The ACM supervises article 23 of the Air Transport Regulation and the Unfair Commercial Practices Act.
De ACM houdt toezicht op artikel 23 van de Luchtvaartverordening en de Wet oneerlijke handelspraktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gesjoemel met tickets in Nederland en België

An SP MP asked the Economics Minister about resale of concert tickets in NL and BE, including fraud, identity misuse, and cross-border evasion of Belgian resale ban. The government answered that resale is legal in NL, that ACM supervises transparency, prosecution is for the OM to decide, and it sees no reason for joint investigation.
The ACM does not make statements about individual cases.
De ACM doet geen mededelingen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht dat EVnetNL laadpalen wil overdragen aan gemeenten

The MP Bosman asks whether the transfer of EV charging points from EVnetNL to municipalities is market-distorting, whether managing charging points is a municipal task, and whether the transfer can be reversed. The minister answers that the transfer is a matter between EVnetNL and the municipalities, consistent with the Green Deal, that market parties already operate such points, and that no reversal is planned.
No, this is a matter between municipalities and EVnetNL, see also answer 2.
Nee, dit is een zaak tussen gemeenten en EVnetNL zie ook antwoord 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de vervanging van een dorpswindmolen

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a village windmill replacement in Reduzum, and the Friesland wind-energy targets, are consistent with the national wind action plan and what role the Rijk should play in local energy initiatives. The minister replied that the provinces are responsible for local projects, that his role is to set frameworks and subsidies, and that Friesland's 2020 wind target is at risk but the Kop van Afsluitdijk project may now be realised on time.
It is the responsibility of the provinces, in consultation with municipalities and the local population, to decide on concrete initiatives such as this project.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om in overleg met gemeenten en de lokale bevolking te beslissen over concrete initiatieven zoals dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over “de onwil bij OM en FIOD om frauderende franchisegevers aan te pakken”

MP Mei Li Vos asked whether prosecutors and the FIOD are failing to pursue franchisors who defraud franchisees by reporting widely varying inventory valuations, and whether the Dutch fraud law or the Franchise Code can be used against them. The minister replied that each complaint is assessed individually on criminal liability, provability and expediency, that no separate registration exists for franchise fraud, that the acquisition-fraud bill offers civil and criminal routes, and that the Franchise Code is a self-regulatory instrument rather than a government enforcement tool.
The Public Prosecution Service's registration systems do not separately record the classification 'franchise fraud' or 'inventory valuation fraud'.
In de registratiesystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie wordt niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd op de classificatie «franchisefraude» of «inboedeltaxatiefraude».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het behoud van de gasinfrastructuur op de Noordzee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether offshore platforms in the North Sea should be kept for future wind farms and whether gas must remain available for extraction. The minister found reuse of existing infrastructure interesting, said fossil fuels and Dutch gas remain needed, supports keeping the option to extract remaining reserves within the energy agreement, and promised to keep talking with industry and inform the House.
I am willing to remain in consultation with the parties involved and to explore the advantages and disadvantages of the various options.
Ik ben bereid met de betrokken partijen in overleg te blijven en te verkennen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van de verschillende opties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Jan Vos over de waardevermeerderingsregeling

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why no applications for the value-increase scheme (waardevermeerderingsregeling) were processed since December 2015, whether missing information from the Centrum voor Veilig Wonen causes delays, how this fits with the budget running out, and how the government will act on motions. The minister denied that no applications were processed, explained the sequencing rule and privacy-based data handling, and said the government will inform parliament in the spring budget memorandum.
The cabinet will take the motions into account in the spring budget memorandum and will then inform the House.
Het kabinet betrekt de moties bij de behandeling van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer dan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het retourneren van kleding bij Perry Sport

An MP asked the government about consumers losing refunds, gift cards and online return rights because of the Perry Sport bankruptcy, and why the 14-day online return right differs from in-store purchases. The minister answered that consumers must file claims with the curator or administrator, that the return right can be enforced only while the business continues under the curator's supervision, and that in-store purchases lack a statutory cooling-off period because the goods can be inspected beforehand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Veldhoven over de opsporingsvergunning bij Grou

MPs Jacobi and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Vermilion's exploration permit near Grou/Akkrum, including whether the permit could be revoked for delays, the location of the test drilling, the Leeuwarden council motion against new gas extraction, and the relation between gas exploration and geothermal energy. The minister answered that Vermilion met the notification requirement, that the delay is not Vermilion's fault so revocation is not warranted, and that gas and geothermal development rarely compete.
If this did not have the desired effect, I am entitled to revoke the exploration permit.
Als dit niet tot het gewenste effect zou leiden, dan ben ik gerechtigd om de opsporingsvergunning in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de tekorten van onderzoeksinstituten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that shortfalls at applied research institutes (TO2) reach 300 million euro, including safety concerns for laboratories and test facilities. The minister confirmed the figures stem from his October 2015 letter, gave a 165 million euro estimate for new facilities, declined to give a per-institute breakdown or a firm safety assessment, and pointed to a Strategic Agenda for 2017-2021 and new financing models.
For maintaining existing facilities, no reliable estimate can be given.
Voor de instandhouding van bestaande faciliteiten is geen betrouwbare schatting te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de positie van leveranciers bij het faillissement van V&D

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the position of suppliers in the V&D bankruptcy, including curators' duties to all creditors, fees for access to stores, deadlines for suppliers, and possible support for suppliers. The minister answered that curators primarily serve the estate's collective interest, that suppliers' recovery options are negotiable, that bankruptcy claims are difficult and for courts to judge, and that suppliers can use existing credit guarantee schemes like the BMKB.
In any case, the assessment of the facts is for the court, should creditors wish to bring this case before it.
De beoordeling van de feiten is hoe dan ook aan de rechter, in het geval dat crediteuren deze zaak aanhangig willen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er sprake is van het overtreden van de wet bij het verkopen van energiecontracten door Essent

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Essent's door-to-door sales of energy contracts, including withholding the 14-day cooling-off period and deducting a gift card on cancellation, violated the law, and whether the minister would order Essent to inform consumers. The minister said compliance is for the ACM and courts to judge, noted that the ACM had already made Essent's commitments binding in November 2015, and said Essent accepts unused gift cards back without charge.
However, it is not for me to assess whether companies comply with applicable laws in a specific case.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te beoordelen of bedrijven geldende wetten in een concreet geval naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Amhaouch over onterechte reputatieschade van bestuurders van het Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire

MPs Agnes Mulder and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers whether the SEO report on governance at Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire unjustly damaged the reputations of its board members, and questioned the handling of the tender and the decision to build the wind-diesel plant. Minister Kamp answers that the SEO conclusions on governance shortcomings were confirmed by the Landsadvocaat and Mazars, that the tender produced one bid, that no criminal referral is warranted, and that no apology is due.
As appears from the answer to question 9, the investigations were not carried out unjustly.
Zoals uit het antwoord op vraag 9 blijkt, zijn de onderzoeken niet onterecht uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermue en Albert de Vries over het inkomen van de algemeen directeur van energiebedrijf Delta

PvdA MPs asked whether the salary increase for Delta's general director, which staff opposed, is acceptable given losses and public ownership, and whether shareholders should intervene. The government answered that Delta is exempt from the WNT pay cap because it is a company, that shareholders should act, that the WNT scope will be revised, and that the company's network split leaves WNT application unchanged.
Government shareholdings in NVs and BVs have been kept outside the WNT by the legislator, on the reasoning that the government could sufficiently influence pay policy through its shareholding.

Overheidsdeelnemingen in NV's en BV's zijn door de wetgever (in algemene zin) buiten de WNT gehouden op grond van de overweging dat de overheid via de lijn van het aandeelhouderschap het beloningsbeleid voldoende zou kunnen beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over ongewenste sms-dienstabonnementen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about unwanted premium SMS subscriptions, including whether the sales practices violate unfair commercial practice rules, whether minors can be signed up, and whether self-regulation or new legal rules are needed. The minister said the ACM is responsible for enforcement, declined to comment on individual cases, supported adjusting the mobile industry code to use the term 'betalen' and said he would convey this to the code foundation, and called for prevention under shared responsibility while deferring judgement on new legislation.
This data is not known to me.
Deze gegevens zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de inzet van PostNL in de onderhandelingen over de PostNL- en zaterdagbestellers-cao

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL's cao proposals linking falling profits to the costs of employing former self-employed parcel couriers, and PostNL's pricing relative to competitors, reflect a competitive disadvantage that merits ACM market-power investigation. The minister confirmed knowledge of the letter, declined to assess it as part of ongoing union-company talks, noted PostNL's annual report figures, said the ACM's ongoing parcel market scan would address pricing and level playing field, and deferred to the independent ACM on whether to start further market analyses.
It is not fitting for me as Minister to express an assessment of that.
Het is past mij als Minister niet om daarover een waardering uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat windmolens in de Veenkoloniën de telescoop van Astron ‘Lofar’ dreigen te nekken

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether wind turbines in the Veenkoloniën threaten the Lofar telescope at Exloo, and why Astron was not involved earlier in the wind park planning. The minister answers that talks with Astron, the developers and the province are ongoing to mitigate interference, that the planning decision is due in Q3 2016, and that the wider questions on investments and EU contacts are not his to answer or are a national responsibility.
The talks with Astron follow their own track and that consultation is still ongoing.
Het gesprek met Astron kent een eigen traject en dat overleg vindt nog steeds plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht “Brussel blokkeert supersnel internet”

An MP asked the Economic Affairs minister about reports that Brussels blocks fast internet, including the status of a motion on accelerating broadband and the rules restricting regional investment. The minister answered that state aid rules allow public funding but require Commission approval in grey areas, that no concrete regional proposals exist yet, and that he will talk with provinces and providers to improve information sharing.
I see no reason to raise this topic in the Competitiveness Council, apart from the fact that the Council has no formal role in it.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om dit onderwerp aan de orde te brengen in de Raad voor Concurrentievermogen, daargelaten het feit dat de Raad hier geen formele rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mondengebied monddood’

MPs Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder and Smaling asked why the ministry's wind park information sessions require barcode registration, ban phones-recording and filming, and whether the personal data register complies with privacy law and was reviewed by the privacy authority. The minister defended the restrictions as protecting privacy and openness, said data will be destroyed after the sessions, acknowledged the registration form lacked a controller notice, and did not seek the privacy authority's advice.

I have noted that the online registration form for the sessions does not state that the Ministry of Economic Affairs is responsible for processing the personal data and for what purpose the data is requested.

Ik heb geconstateerd dat het online registratieformulier voor de spreekuren niet vermeldt dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken verantwoordelijk is voor de verwerking van de persoonsgegevens en met welk doel de gegevens worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder betreft het vonnis van de Hoge Raad over all-in prijzen bij mobiele telefoonabonnementen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Supreme Court ruling that all-in mobile phone subscriptions are credit agreements and whether providers unlawfully hid device prices, including what consumers and providers face and how further breaches will be prevented. The minister confirmed the ruling, said providers must state the device price separately, expects providers to comply, and pointed to ACM and AFM enforcement and the De Vries motion on exempting telecom credit from financial supervision rules.
It may be assumed that providers will bring their advertising and contract terms into line with the applicable laws and regulations.
Aangenomen mag worden dat de aanbieders hun reclame-uitingen en contractvoorwaarden in overeenstemming zullen brengen met de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Veen, Visser en Duisenberg over de financiering van kennisinstituut Wetsus na 2016

Four VVD MPs asked how the knowledge institute Wetsus, a public-private water technology research centre, would be financed after 2016 and whether it could be moved into NWO, KNAW or a TO2 status. The minister replied that funding continues through transition money, NWO calls, regional funds and private contributions, that structural funding falls outside IenM's remit, and that no move to NWO or KNAW is currently planned.
For the period from 2016 onward, the Wetsus funding is foreseen as follows.
Voor de periode vanaf 2016 is de Wetsus-financiering als volgt voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de contourenregeling

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he welcomed NAM director Schotman's call to abandon the contour map (contourenkaart) for gas-extraction damage, and how this fits with the proposed evidentiary presumption law that still relies on the earthquake contour. The minister answered that NAM must compensate damage regardless of location, that the map plays no role, and that the presumption is limited to the Groningen field effect area because a broader presumption would be disproportionate.
The bill aims to strengthen the evidentiary position of those harmed, without leading to a disproportionate situation.
Het wetsvoorstel beoogt de bewijspositie van benadeelden te versterken, zonder tot een onevenredige situatie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Jan Vos over de waardevermeerderingsregeling

MPs Bosman and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Groningen value-increase compensation scheme budget (about 125 million euro) had been exceeded and whether applicants would be refused. The minister answered that 85 million euro had been paid on approved claims, that the cap will likely be substantially exceeded if all pending claims are approved, and that the government will address the motion on the scheme in the spring memorandum.
If all submitted applications and applications that may still follow on the basis of damage reports are approved, the subsidy ceiling will be substantially exceeded.
Als alle ingediende aanvragen en aanvragen die op basis van schademeldingen nog kunnen volgen worden goedgekeurd zal het subsidieplafond ruim worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Van Dekken over een slechte bereikbaarheid van 112 in de omgeving Vlagtwedde, Oost Groningen

MPs Vermue and Van Dekken asked whether 112 is poorly reachable by mobile phone around Vlagtwedde in Groningen, whether this is an exception, and what steps will be taken. The government answered that mobile reachability of 112 is good nationally, that 100% is not achievable, that supplementary tests show 99.58% success, and referred to a letter of 18 February for the status update.
100% mobile reachability of 1-1-2 is not possible.
100% mobiele bereikbaarheid van 1-1-2 is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over verzekeringen tegen internetfraude

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about insurance products offering a safety net against internet fraud, whether consumers should bear losses, and whether banks and online sellers are shifting losses onto consumers. The minister answered that such insurance is a private market choice, that banks must prove gross negligence to pass losses to consumers under Dutch civil law, and that he sees no shift of losses onto consumers.
I do not observe such a development.
Ik neem een dergelijke ontwikkeling niet waar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “dat er meer onderzoek nodig is naar een alternatieve variant van 380 kV verbinding van het toekomstige windpark Borssele”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Westerschelde cable alternative to the new 380 kV Borssele connection was not studied, and about costs, land access and residents living between two lines. The minister replied that the new line is needed for grid security and capacity, that undergrounding a long stretch or upgrading the existing line is not feasible, and that no further independent study is planned.
I am of the view that societal interests are best served by the new 380 kV connection.
Ik ben van mening dat de maatschappelijke belangen het best worden gediend met de nieuwe 380 kV-verbinding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de investeringsplannen van TenneT bij de 380kV-verbindingen in Zeeland en de aansluitingen van het toekomstige windpark Borssele

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether TenneT plans 5-7 billion euro in Zeeland grid investments, whether those plans are secret, and how necessity, route choice, cost-efficiency and conflicts of interest are overseen, including the Algemene Rekenkamer criticism and the stalled STROOM bill. The minister denied the 5-7 billion figure for Zeeland (that is the national programme, with about 1.2 billion for the Zuidwest 380 kV link), said only commercially confidential parts are secret, and pointed to ACM and ministerial reviews, promising a new bill after the summer.
Only these parts of TenneT's investment plans are secret.
Slechts deze delen van de investeringsplannen van TenneT zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de radio-uitzending ‘Hoogspanning in Zeeland’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a radio broadcast on a new high-voltage route in Zeeland, including whether an underwater Westerschelde alternative had been studied and whether residents' nuisance was minimised. The minister confirmed the alternative was not studied, rejected it as infeasible and inefficient, and described the route's landscape integration and cable-bundling measures.
This indeed has not been investigated.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over hernieuwbare energie in Noordwest-Europa en regelgeving voor de visserijsector

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government to respond to a European Parliament manifesto on North Sea renewable energy and to address fishing-sector rules around offshore wind farms, including transit for vessels over 24 metres. The minister agreed to strengthen North Sea cooperation, to broaden its scope to include fisheries, and to review transit rules after a two-year trial period from 2017.

Yes. It is important that the scope of North Sea cooperation on renewable energy is broadened, integrating among other things maritime spatial planning, including the fisheries and environmental dimensions.

Ja. Het is belangrijk dat de reikwijdte van de Noordzeesamenwerking rondom hernieuwbare energie wordt verbreed, waarbij onder andere maritieme ruimtelijke ordening, inclusief de visserij- en milieudimensie, integraal wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de fusie tussen Ziggo en Vodafone

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Ziggo-Vodafone joint venture, its market shares, which authority would review it, possible remedies, job losses and access regulation for fixed networks. The minister said the joint venture is a 50-50 arrangement under review by the Commission or ACM, that remedies and any market dominance are for the competition authorities to decide, and that he would press for continued access to both fixed networks in the EU telecom framework.
Both companies hold 50 percent of the shares in that enterprise.
Beide ondernemingen zijn voor 50 procent aandeelhouder in die onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de verlaging van vergoedingen aan winkeliers met een postpunt

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL's plan to cut fees paid to shop-based postal points, the reasons for stamp price rises, expected closures and effects on liveability, and whether an exclusivity clause in PostNL's contracts is compatible with competition law and should be investigated by the ACM. The minister answered that the matter is primarily between PostNL and the retailers' association, that universal service rules and spreading requirements in the Postbesluit remain in place, and that he sees no reason to ask the ACM for a specific investigation.
I therefore see no reason to specifically ask the ACM to carry out an investigation now.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding om ACM nu specifiek te vragen een onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over de circulaire economie

Representative Houwers asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs about circular economy measures: phosphate recovery pilots in the Achterhoek, research on crop phosphate uptake and on reduced phosphate fertiliser use, recycled phosphate markets, other scarce nutrients, compost from household waste, nutrient synergies between sewage sludge and organic waste, and ammonia scrubber certification. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing research, regulations and sector developments, declining to add a new pilot site, and referring some matters to other ministries or to a forthcoming letter.
No, there is currently no room to add a company to the mineral concentrate pilot.
Nee, er is momenteel geen ruimte om een bedrijf toe te voegen aan de pilot mineralenconcentraat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Graus over het bericht “Weer dode potvissen gezien bij Texel”

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether electromagnetic radiation from undersea power cables could disturb whale navigation, whether this is considered in new cable permits, and whether it will be included in the investigation into stranded sperm whales. The state secretary replied that research has not shown that such cables cause measurable effects on marine mammals, that stranding causes remain unknown, and that the cause of death is generally suffocation under their own weight.
It is noted that it is not known that magnetic fields from undersea power cables cause demonstrable effects on marine mammals.
Geconstateerd wordt dat het niet bekend is dat magnetische velden van onderzeese stroomkabels aantoonbare effecten veroorzaken op zeezoogdieren.
Vragen van het lid JanVos (PvdA) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over de nationalisatie van de kerncentrale Borssele (ingezonden 12 februari 2016).

An MP asks the Economy minister about the reported Zeeland push to nationalise and close the Borssele nuclear plant, covering losses, decommissioning fund, closure timing and state aid. The minister only announces that the answers need interdepartmental coordination and will follow around mid-March, without answering any question on substance.
Because interdepartmental coordination is needed to answer, it is not possible to answer the questions within the usual deadline.
Vanwege de voor de beantwoording benodigde interdepartementale afstemming is het niet mogelijk om de vragen binnen de gebruikelijke termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Tongeren over de berichtgeving van RTV Oost over het gevaar voor mens en natuur van de afvalwaterinjectieputten van NAM

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about media reports on risks from NAM's wastewater injection wells in Twente, including new research, corrosion of injection pipes, transport pipeline leaks, and disclosure of wastewater composition. The Minister answered that the evaluation was ongoing with a decision expected mid-2016, that existing controls and monitoring were in place, and that some information would be provided or published while other points were answered with reference to existing reports and procedures.
I have asked the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment to advise on this evaluation study.
Ik heb de Commissie voor de m.e.r. gevraagd een advies te geven over dit evaluatieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Veldhoven over de berichtgeving over een enorm gaslek in de Verenigde Staten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a large gas leak at a US storage field could happen in the Netherlands, what protocols and inspections exist, and what the health and environmental consequences would be. The minister answered that Dutch rules are stricter (mandatory downhole safety valves, stricter cementing), that SodM supervises inspections and emergency plans, and that SodM will assess relevance of the US investigation once available.
Once the investigation into the cause and remedy of the leak becomes available, the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) will examine its relevance for the Dutch situation.
Zodra het onderzoek naar de oorzaak en remedie van de lekkage beschikbaar komt, zal Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de relevantie daarvan voor de Nederlandse situatie onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over sluiting van kolencentrales en de mogelijke kosten hiervan

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an op-ed claiming closing Dutch coal plants would cost little, about the link to a 2018 CCS obligation, emissions-rights costs, the Urgenda ruling, and SDE+ subsidies for biomass co-firing. The minister disagreed that a 2018 CCS obligation would reduce state costs, said compensation depends on factors still under study, and promised a cabinet response to the IBO CO2 report in the first half of 2016.
The IBO CO2 will provide building blocks for additional measures to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Het IBO CO 2 zal bouwstenen aandragen voor aanvullende maatregelen om het vonnis in de Urgenda-zaak uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer, Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

Three PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers whether tender specifications for the marine barracks construction could favour regional firms in Zeeland, and why such room is possible in other public tenders but not here. The minister answered that favouring local firms through specification requirements is not permitted under procurement law, and that regional businesses can instead take part via consortia or as subcontractors.
Making room for local businesses in the programme of requirements leads to favouring those businesses and is not permitted.
Ruimte maken voor lokale bedrijven in het programma van eisen leidt tot bevoordeling van deze bedrijven en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een mogelijke btw-deal bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked whether a VAT integration-supply or other VAT arrangement applies to earthquake damage settlements in Groningen, why NAM routes payments via notaries, and how VAT treatment works for the Groninger Forum. The minister declined to comment on any specific VAT ruling, citing the tax inspector's exclusive competence and secrecy, described the general VAT deduction rules, and said NAM follows a standard settlement and deposit procedure without commenting on individual cases.
The tax inspector has the exclusive, statutorily established competence to rule on this arrangement.
Het is de exclusieve, wettelijk vastgelegde bevoegdheid van de belastinginspecteur om een uitspraak te doen over deze constructie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het traineren van een afgesloten overeenkomst bij een complexe schade in Groningen

An SP MP asked the minister whether NAM's delay in paying a signed damage settlement in Bedum, its reopening of the agreement with a depot arrangement, and its claims on VAT and construction control were acceptable. The minister largely referred to earlier answers, said the trust of Groningers is promoted by swift damage repair, and stressed the need for agreement between the victim and NAM.
For swift damage repair it is necessary that the victim and NAM agree on the chosen solution.
Voor voortvarend schadeherstel is het noodzakelijk dat gedupeerde en NAM overeenstemming hebben over de gekozen oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over overheden die ondanks milieubeloften vieze energie inkopen

An SP MP asked why municipalities and provinces that pledged green electricity still buy cheapest, often grey, power, and what this says about the value of their pledges. The minister replied that green power is guaranteed by the EU certificate (gvo) system, that the cities' purchases are compliant, and declined to assess companies' green image or to support small green suppliers in tenders.
The European guarantee-of-origin system guarantees that the electricity consumed comes from a renewable source.
Het Europese systeem van gvo’s garandeert dat de stroom die wordt geconsumeerd uit een duurzame bron afkomstig is.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Grote steden kiezen massaal voor kolenstroom» (ingezonden 23 december 2015).

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that large cities buy coal-based electricity, and how splitting green-electricity purchases into commodity power and separate guarantees of origin fits government sustainable procurement policy. The government answered that the split still supports green electricity consumption, pointed to more impactful alternatives, described pilots and studies on area-based procurement, and listed the state's guarantee-of-origin purchases by source 2010-2015.

Vragen van het lid JanVos (PvdA) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over gemeenten en provincies die in plaats van groene stroom grijze stroom inkopen voor eigen gebruik (ingezonden 28 december 2015).

MP Jan Vos asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether municipalities and provinces that claim to buy green electricity actually source it via GvO certificates tied to coal plants and whether this system should be abolished. The Minister says the GvO system is an EU obligation that cannot be abolished, that the practice complies with the covenant, and that phase-out of coal plants is separate from GvO trading.
I am not aware of the precise method of green electricity purchase by these provinces and municipalities.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de precieze methode van de groene stroominkoop van deze provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Thales Nederland

Two MPs asked the defence and economic affairs ministers whether Thales Nederland's 200 job cuts relate to postponed naval investments, what this means for the domestic defence industry and armed forces' access to radar technology, and how investment planning accounts for industry knowledge. The minister replied that the cuts are a company reorganisation, that investment decisions are weighed against the budget, that access to SMART-L radar technology is secured through signed contracts, and that knowledge is maintained via the Gouden Driehoek cooperation and maintenance contracts.
The measure announced by Thales Nederland is of a business-economic nature and concerns an internal reorganisation.
De maatregel die Thales Nederland heeft bekendgemaakt is van bedrijfseconomische aard en betreft een interne reorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat AkzoNobel zoutholtes in Twente wil vullen met onder meer vliegas

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to fill unstable salt caverns in Twente with fly ash, and about risks of subsidence, liability, monitoring and cost. The minister answered that the caverns are monitored under a protocol, liability rests with the mine operator under civil law, and fly ash has been dropped as filler after public opposition.
AkzoNobel has indicated that the recent public debate showed that there is no support for this.
AkzoNobel heeft aangegeven dat uit de recentelijke maatschappelijk discussie is gebleken dat het draagvlak hiervoor ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de verketeling van warmte-installaties door de werking van de Warmtewet

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the trend of individual boilers replacing collective heating systems (verketeling) and whether the Warmtewet contributes to it. The minister confirmed signals of the trend, said it mainly affects building-bound block heating with about 6,500 homes switching, attributed part of the cause to the Warmtewet's storage compensation and NMDA pricing, and committed to working on removing such incentives in the upcoming amendment without interim measures.
I aim to remove as much as possible those elements in the Warmtewet that currently (possibly) create an incentive for verketeling.
Ik streef ernaar om elementen in de Warmtewet die nu (mogelijk) een prikkel tot verketeling vormen zoveel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht van de ANWB dat autofabrikanten ongezien data van automobilisten verzamelen

An MP asked ministers about reports that car manufacturers collect driver data without drivers' knowledge, including which privacy law applies, whether consumers are informed and must consent, and whether data can be sold to third parties. The government answered that manufacturers are responsible for complying with privacy law under the European directive and Dutch Wbp, that information duties and consent via purchase contracts apply, and that transfer or sale of personal data is only allowed within legal limits.
A complete overview of all data that all types of cars generate and store cannot be provided.
Een volledig overzicht van alle gegevens die alle typen auto’s genereren en opslaan kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven over het budget voor energie-innovatie in 2016

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked why the Topsector Energie was prioritised over the DEI demonstration scheme in reallocating 2016 energy-innovation budget, which projects receive additional funds, and which DEI projects might fall through. The minister replied that the Topsector Energie budget stays roughly flat, the DEI budget rises slightly, no additional funds go to the Topsector, and DEI tender outcomes will only be known after the tranches close.
There is no question of additional budget for the Topsector Energie.
Er is geen sprake van additioneel budget voor de Topsector Energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er sprake is van belangenverstrengeling bij het Energieonderzoek Centrum Nederland (ECN)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of conflict of interest at ECN, where a former director privately owned and ran wind turbines subsidised under the MEP scheme, and about related pay and investment matters. The minister answered that ECN's management found no conflicting interests but that an appearance of conflict arose, that the screening framework will be tightened with independent advice, and that no subsidy misuse was found, while refusing a freeze on onshore wind.
ECN does acknowledge that the appearance of a conflict of interest has arisen and that this is undesirable.
ECN constateert wel dat de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is ontstaan en dat dit onwenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «Directeur verdiende aan gesubsidieerde windmolens»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that a former director of a wind energy company linked to ECN earned over 1 million euros from subsidised windmills, raising conflict-of-interest concerns. The minister said the director was not responsible for subsidy advice, that the risk lay with the operator under MEP and the state under SDE+, that no insider knowledge misuse was found, and that the appearance of conflict of interest was acknowledged with integrity measures promised.
As I explained in my answer to question 2 from Member Smaling, I agree with ECN's conclusion that the appearance of a conflict of interest has been created.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Smaling heb toegelicht ben ik het eens met de conclusie van ECN dat de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is gewekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Merkies en Grashoff over de belastingontwijking door wapenproducenten

MPs Bruins, Merkies and Grashoff asked whether seven of the ten largest arms producers use Dutch tax structures, whether they have rulings, and whether their substance is adequate. The State Secretary declined to give information on individual taxpayers under confidentiality rules, explained the substance test and risk-based supervision, and said public country-by-country reporting awaits an EU impact assessment.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik geen informatie verstrekken over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over Dumpstaal uit China

An MP asked the trade and economic affairs ministers about alleged dumping of Chinese cold-rolled steel, its effects on climate goals and Tata Steel's Hisarna technology, and whether they would press the European Commission on anti-dumping timing and measures. The minister replied that an EU anti-dumping investigation is underway with preliminary findings due by 14 February 2016, that the Netherlands weighs environmental costs of duties case by case, and that the issue has been raised in EU Council meetings.
Yes. This issue was discussed during an extraordinary session of the Competitiveness Council on 9 November 2015 and at the regular Foreign Affairs Council (trade) on 27 November 2015.
Ja. Deze kwestie is besproken tijdens een ingelaste sessie van de Raad van Concurrentievermogen op 9 november 2015 en tijdens de reguliere Raad voor Buitenlandse Zaken handel op 27 november 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de bij- en meestook van duurzame biomassa in kolencentrales

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the approximately 3 billion euro subsidy for biomass co-firing in coal plants is cost-efficient, whether alternatives like wind or solar should be chosen, and whether the subsidy should be reconsidered in light of the Urgenda ruling. The minister defended the co-firing subsidy as needed to meet the 2020 renewable energy target, said no realistic alternative exists for 25 PJ by 2020, and deferred the Urgenda cost questions to a forthcoming study.
At this moment it is not possible to state the societal costs and the costs per household and for SMEs for the mentioned policy packages.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk om voor de genoemde beleidspakketten de maatschappelijke kosten en de kosten per huishouden en voor het MKB aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Monasch over het faillissement van Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport en Steve Madden

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport and Steve Madden, and whether the government would help preserve jobs and engage the retail sector. The minister said the ministry is actively involved behind the scenes, that sales of much of the Macintosh group are advanced, and that retail partners are exploring acceleration of the Retailagenda and transition support for workers.
My ministry has been involved in the bankruptcy process since late December and takes an active stance behind the scenes.
Mijn ministerie is sinds eind december betrokken bij het faillissementsproces en neemt achter de schermen een actieve houding aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een snel stijgend aantal beschadigingen aan boerderijen en drainagesystemen door bodemdaling in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why NAM and the Commissie Bodemdaling dismiss rising damage to farms and drainage systems from subsidence in Groningen as mere settlement damage, whether NAM will pay, and when the Grontmij study is due. The Minister confirmed complaints have risen, explained that the official studies find uniform subsidence with no absolute effect on water levels, noted NAM must pay damage caused by gas extraction, gave a spring 2016 timeline for the study, and pointed to a case-manager arrangement while negotiating with NAM.
Yes, I am aware that the number of damage reports has increased.
Ja, het is mij bekend dat het aantal meldingen van schade is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de onderlinge samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) en het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW)

Opposition MPs asked the minister whether the cooperation agreement between NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) is public, whether CVW is independent of NAM, and how contra-expertise hours are allocated. The minister said the agreement is private and not public, but was reviewed by the Commission of Toezicht, which found CVW independent and the relationship critical but sound, and promised to amend the damage protocol on contra-expertise.
This agreement is not public, but it has been reviewed by the Supervisory Committee on the Centrum Veilig Wonen, set up by me, in order to assess the working relationship between NAM and CVW.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, maar wel ingezien door de door mij ingestelde Commissie van Toezicht op het Centrum Veilig Wonen om de werkverhouding tussen NAM en CVW te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over massale schade door gaswinning bij Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about widespread gas-extraction damage in villages near Delfzijl and whether he would press the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen for a fast investigation and speedy settlement. The minister confirmed the reports, said an investigation into the causes of high damage rates at the edges of the earthquake area starts in the first quarter of 2016, and promised attention to speedy, careful settlement of damage claims.

The National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) will start an investigation in the first quarter of this year into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de gelijke behandeling van aardbevingsschade in alle gemeenten

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether earthquake damage in Oldambt villages such as Nieuwolda, 't Waar and Nieuw-Scheemda mirrors the situation in Delfzijl, and asked the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen to extend its investigation to the whole area. Minister Kamp answered that the NCG will start in early 2016 an investigation into causes of high damage percentages at the edges of the earthquake area, including the municipalities named.

The Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) will start in the first quarter of this year an investigation into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mijnbouwschade in Delfzijl

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Economic Affairs minister about mining damage (gas extraction) in villages around Delfzijl outside the official damage contours, and what this means for the KNMI PGA map, NAM compensation, the Meijdam advice, and infrastructure safety. The minister answers that an independent research into causes is starting, that damage reports outside NAM's contour are assessed case by case, and that the PGA map is for reinforcement prioritisation rather than damage estimation.

The National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) will start in the first quarter of this year an investigation into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de rol van private equity in de ondergang van V&D

An MP asks ministers about the role of private equity firm Sun Capital in the bankruptcy and possible restart of V&D, and whether bankruptcy law protects against abuse. The government answers that the curator leads any restart under judicial supervision, that existing rules guard against abuse, and that the private equity role will be examined in a separate study.
Because of competitive sensitivity, the curators do not disclose the identity of the selected parties.
De curatoren maken vanwege de concurrentiegevoeligheid de identiteit van de geselecteerde partijen niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Monasch over het faillissement van onder andere V&D en Macintosh

MPs Cegerek and Monasch asked about the bankruptcies of V&D and Macintosh, the risk of retail vacancy, and why the ministers suspended parts of Zuid-Holland's retail ordinance without informing parliament. The government answered that restructuring is underway, pointed to the Retailagenda and Retaildeals, and explained that suspension was justified by doubts about compliance with national and EU law, with the provincial dispute still pending.
When there is genuine doubt that this is being complied with, intervention is necessary.
Wanneer er gerede twijfel is dat hier niet aan wordt voldaan, is ingrijpen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Feest-bv’s ontlopen Drankwet met truc; Baromzet weggeboekt in apart bedrijfje’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about sports clubs and similar bodies moving bar activities into separate 'party BVs' to avoid the Alcohol Act and whether the Market and Government Act protects entrepreneurs from unfair competition. The minister replied that the Market and Government Act only binds government bodies, not such clubs, that ACM has no enforcement role here, and that subsidy rules fall under the General Administrative Law Act, with a fuller evaluation response to follow.
In my response to the evaluation of the law, which I will send to your House shortly, I will go further into the results of the evaluation
In mijn reactie op de evaluatie van de wet, die ik binnenkort aan uw Kamer zal sturen, zal ik verder ingaan op de resultaten van de evaluatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de chemiesector in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen National Coordinator's programme lacks a concrete plan for making Delfzijl's chemical sector earthquake-resistant, when it will come and when binding standards will exist. The minister answered that an industry table chaired by the coordinator will develop a joint approach expected in Q1 2016, that a Deltares/TNO guideline exists while standards are still under discussion, and that much of the research lies with industry itself.
Companies and competent authorities will jointly develop, via the so-called Industry Table, a comprehensive approach linking existing and planned methods and studies.
Bedrijven en bevoegde instanties zullen via de zogenaamde Industrietafel samen een sluitende aanpak ontwikkelen, die bestaande en voorgenomen methodieken en onderzoeken verbindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een verschuiving van de aardbevingen naar de randen van het gaswinningsgebied

MPs asked whether earthquakes are shifting to the edges of the Groningen gas field after production cuts at Loppersum, and whether closure sequencing could worsen the situation and be included in the gas-extraction decision. The minister answered that faults do not move, that quakes in the edge areas follow local pressure decline and production, and that NAM has been asked to optimise production allocation across the field, with SodM supervising the work.

In line with SodM's advice of 1 December 2015, I have asked NAM what the optimal production distribution across the entire field (including the Loppersum area) is, in order to further reduce the risk now and in the future.

Conform het advies van SodM van 1 december 2015 heb ik NAM gevraagd wat de optimale productieverdeling over het gehele veld (inclusief het Loppersumgebied) is, om het risico nu en in de toekomst verder te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Deskundigen zetten vraagtekens bij KNMI-kaart”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the KNMI's October 2015 PGA hazard map underestimates the Groningen reinforcement task, whether the NPR earthquake-resistant building standard will be written into the Building Decree, and about the Meijdam committee's safety norm. The minister answered that the new map uses only Groningen measurements, that the NEN committee found further calculations are needed for NPR use, that SodM prefers the NAM production-driven method and that talks on independence are ongoing, and that the 10^-5 safety norm applies regardless of cost.
Currently in talks with SodM, TNO and KNMI to examine how this can take shape in the short term (before 1 April 2016).
In gesprek met SodM, TNO en KNMI om te bezien hoe dit op korte termijn (voor 1 april 2016) vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijke aardbevingen bij Langelo door uitbreiding van de gasopslag in gasveld Norg

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why residents near Langelo were not informed or involved about the expansion of the Norg gas storage, the earthquake risk, and 80 damage reports, and whether NAM would be pressed on communication and a damage covenant. The minister replied that residents were kept informed during construction, that the Arcadis damage study was published and presented, that the risk is considered very small, and that no additional damage-compensation rules are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Deskundigen zetten vraagtekens bij KNMI-kaart”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about expert doubts over the KNMI's Groningen PGA earthquake-hazard map, whether SodM reviewed it, why the KNMI statistical map was chosen over NAM's production-based model, and whether that choice affects the gas-extraction decision. The minister answered that SodM had internationally reviewed the map, that both methods are needed for mutual verification, that SodM prefers the NAM-derived method, and that he is working with SodM, TNO and KNMI to institutionalise an independent production-based method by 1 April 2016.
To secure the independence of this production-based method for the PGA map, I am now in discussion with SodM, TNO and KNMI to consider how this can take shape in the short term (by 1 April 2016).

Om de onafhankelijkheid van deze productiegestuurde methodiek voor de PGA-kaart te borgen, ben nu ik in gesprek met SodM, TNO en KNMI om te bezien hoe dit op korte termijn (voor 1 april 2016) vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het rapport “Gesjoemel met bodembeweging”

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether gas-extraction subsidence in Franeker and Northeast Friesland exceeds the forecasts made at licensing, whether subsidence is assessed by the producer, and whether models and their timing errors are disclosed.
