The minister acknowledges that subsidence has been larger than forecast (up to factor 3-4 in Franeker), says damage is not expected, states the producer normally sets subsidence figures with SodM supervising, and says some models are publicly available with independent TNO checks.
Damage to buildings is not expected, not even on the basis of the revised (higher) subsidence forecasts.
Schade aan bebouwing wordt niet verwacht, ook niet op basis van de bijgestelde (hogere) voorspellingen voor de bodemdaling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Fokker

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked whether Fokker's job cuts of 270 positions affect Dutch defence industry, the armed forces, F-35 technology access, and whether Thales cuts signal a wider trend. Minister Kamp answered that the cuts stem from the civil aircraft market, do not weaken Fokker's strategic partnership with Defence, are unrelated to Thales, and that future trends cannot be predicted.
Through the measures now announced, the strategic partnership in the form of industry cooperation with Defence is not affected.
Door de nu aangekondigde maatregelen wordt het strategische partnerschap in de vorm van samenwerking van de industrie met Defensie niet aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch inzake de gaswinning in Súdwest-Fryslân

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why he proceeds with the Oppenhuizen gas extraction and pipeline despite opposition from the municipality and province, and about the peat soil, the expected subsidence and the scale of the field. The minister replied that he is legally bound to decide on the winning plan regardless of local opposition, that subsidence will be assessed and monitored by Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen and TNO with mandatory plan revision if it deviates, and that Vermilion will engage in local consultations and agreements.
This political position of the municipality and province does not, however, release me from my legal responsibilities and the applicable legal framework.
Deze politieke stellingname van gemeente en provincie ontslaat mij echter niet van mijn wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden en de daarbij geldende wettelijke kaders.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Grote steden kiezen massaal voor kolenstroom» (ingezonden 23 december 2015).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary whether large cities buying coal-based electricity on lowest price with separate green certificates fits the government's sustainable procurement policy, and asks how the national government buys its electricity, from which suppliers and with which certificate origins. The reply is an interim notice from the minister of Economic Affairs that answers will follow in early February because interdepartmental coordination is needed.
I expect to be able to send the answers to your House in early February.
Ik verwacht de beantwoording begin februari naar uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.

Vragen van het lid JanVos (PvdA) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over gemeenten en provincies die in plaats van groene stroom grijze stroom inkopen voor eigen gebruik (ingezonden 28 december 2015).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether several municipalities and provinces claim to buy green electricity that is in fact coal-fired power from E.ON and GDF Suez, bought via green certificates that add no extra renewable output, and whether they should reconsider this practice and the certificate system. The minister's reply is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual three weeks and will follow in early February.
Because interdepartmental coordination is needed to answer, these questions cannot be answered within the usual three-week period.
Vanwege de voor de beantwoording benodigde interdepartementale afstemming kunnen deze vragen niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn van drie weken worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het onderzoek van de respectievelijke ministeries naar het ‘te strikte beleid’ van de provincie Zuid-Holland inzake de vestiging van megawinkels

MP Smaling asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Economic Affairs about their review of whether Zuid-Holland's restrictive retail-location rules for megastores are too strict, and about the status of the Raad van State advice, the national retail structure vision and the Bro provision. The minister answers that the review concerns a request by Decathlon for annulment of provincial rules, that a partial suspension of article 2.1.4(3)(a) is proposed, that the Bro provision does not restrict provinces, and that the government will not draft a national retail structure vision, relying on the Retailagenda instead.
It has been decided, prior to that decision and for the reasons given in the previous paragraph, to propose suspension of one part of article 2.1.4, third paragraph, of the provincial regulation.
Besloten is om voorafgaande aan die beslissing, om redenen genoemd in de vorige alinea, een onderdeel van artikel 2.1.4, derde lid, voor te dragen voor schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Van Dekken, Mei Li Vos en Jasper van Dijk over de economische positie van makers van reclamedeuntjes

MPs asked whether the economic position of jingle composers is weakened by a near-monopoly of a few advertising music firms and by practices of Buma/Stemra and broadcasters, and what the Auteurswet and Buma/Stemra could do about it. The government answered that competition law and the new author-contract law provide remedies, that complaints must come from the makers themselves, and that the law will be evaluated within five years.
Buma/Stemra is not a party to the agreement that composers and lyricists conclude with a client.
Buma/Stemra is geen partij bij de overeenkomst die componisten en tekstschrijvers sluiten met een opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de onafhankelijkheid van het Centrum Veilig Wonen

MPs Jan Vos, Nijboer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW), which handles earthquake damage claims for NAM, is truly independent of NAM, and raised concerns about the oversight commission, the damage assessment process, pressure towards demolition, the Handboek Aardbevingsschade and the reversal of the burden of proof. The minister replied that NAM remains legally liable, that CVW is operated at arm's length under a tender, that the oversight chair is independent, that damage assessments and contra-expertise are handled properly, and that a bill on a statutory presumption of causation will be submitted after Council of State advice.
I have asked the Council of State for urgent advice on the bill concerning the statutory presumption of evidence.
Ik heb de Raad van State gevraagd om spoedadvies over het wetsvoorstel omtrent het wettelijk bewijsvermoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat een rechtsbijstandsverzekering voor Groningers in het aardbevingsgebied taboe is

An MP asked the government about reports that legal expenses insurance is refused to Groningen residents in the earthquake area, and whether this inequality would be ended. The minister replied that the insurers' association says cover is possible though not guaranteed, that the Minister of Economic Affairs asked the National Coordinator Groningen to investigate insurers' conditions, and that subsidised legal aid is available for those who qualify.

The Minister of Economic Affairs has therefore asked the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) to conduct further research into the conditions insurers impose for taking out legal expenses insurance within the earthquake area.

De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft daarom de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar de voorwaarden die verzekeraars stellen om een rechtsbijstandsverzekering af te sluiten binnen het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat rechtsbijstandsverzekering taboe is voor Groningers in aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asks whether insurers excluding residents of the Groningen earthquake area from legal expenses insurance, citing an ongoing dispute, is acceptable, and raises related questions on subsidised legal aid, the WAG foundation arrangement and the NCG's proposed arbiter. The minister replies that insurers say residents can still obtain cover for future claims depending on each insurer's policy, that no equivalent exclusion areas are known elsewhere, and that the NCG has been asked to investigate whether insurers' conditions are disproportionate.
The Dutch Association of Insurers has informed me upon request that the claim that residents of the Groningen earthquake area cannot take out legal expenses insurance is not accurate.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat de stelling dat bewoners uit het Groningse aardbevingsgebied geen rechtsbijstandsverzekering kunnen afsluiten, niet accuraat is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Taxfree shoppen bestaat niet op Schiphol”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether businesses and Schiphol may advertise 'taxfree prices' when consumers still pay VAT and are not cheaper than regular prices, and whether the Reclame Code Commissie should investigate. The minister answered that the ACM and RCC are responsible, that neither received complaints, and that the SRC will hold an exploratory talk about a monitoring project.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises compliance with these rules.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) houdt toezicht op de naleving van deze regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het artikel ‘Toeristenbelasting is een melkkoe’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked about a report that municipal tourist tax is a cash cow, with hotels and bungalow parks charging guests more than the municipal rate, and whether this breaches advertising rules and is lawful. The minister confirms hoteliers may pass on the tax under article 224 Gemeentewet, says overcharging would be undue payment and misleading, and leaves enforcement to the consumer authority ACM and courts while declining to judge specific conduct.
It is not correct to withhold more tourist tax than the municipality in question charges.
Het is daarbij niet juist om meer in te houden aan toeristenbelasting dan dat door de desbetreffende gemeente in rekening wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Restaurantje spelen in eigen huis’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the platform Airdnd, which lets people run home restaurants, and whether such hobby cooks should follow the same hygiene, fire safety and tax rules as professional restaurateurs, and whether new regulation is needed as Hotrec proposes. The minister answered that home restaurants are already covered by food safety, alcohol licensing and tax rules enforced by the NVWA and municipalities, that he prefers a case-by-case approach over new general regulation, and promised further information before year end.
I am therefore more in favour of a case-by-case approach.
Ik ben dan ook meer voorstander van een case-by-case aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dik-Faber inzake het Wob-verzoek over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Jacobi and Dik-Faber asked why the Minister had not yet answered a Wob (freedom of information) request on salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, which was more than five months old. The Minister replied that the information was provided on 18 November 2015, after an inventory of 558 documents required considerable review and coordination.
The Wob request submitted on 29 May 2015 was picked up immediately at the time.
Het op 29 mei 2015 ingediende Wob-verzoek is indertijd direct opgepakt.
Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over de bestuurlijke puinhoop bij Water en Energiebedrijf Aruba (WEB) (ingezonden 1 december 2015).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about administrative problems at Water en Energiebedrijf Aruba (WEB), including who is responsible and whether costs should be borne by the regulated domain. The minister answered that Aruba is an autonomous country within the Kingdom, so the Aruban government is the contact point, and that the Bonaire utility has no such problems.
Because Aruba is a country within the Kingdom, the Aruban government is the point of contact for concerns about the water and energy supply there.
Omdat Aruba een land binnen het Koninkrijk is, is de regering van Aruba het aanspreekpunt voor zorgen over de water- en energievoorziening aldaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over concurrentieverstoring door subsidieregelingen

Two VVD MPs asked whether the subsidy to LTO for the 'beveilig mijn boerenbedrijf' project led to only one supplier being chosen per product, and whether subsidy rules should require multiple suppliers. The minister confirmed LTO selected the suppliers itself and said the government sees no need for supplier-selection rules in specific subsidy schemes beyond existing competition law.
The cabinet sees no reason to set rules in specific subsidy schemes in this area, beyond the applicable competition laws and regulations.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om, naast de geldende wet- en regelgeving ter bevordering van concurrentie, op dat terrein ook regels te stellen in specifieke subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Ziengs over het artikel 'Brede cao biedt zekerheid voor alle werkenden”

Two VVD MPs asked whether minimum rates for self-employed workers (zzp'ers) set in collective labour agreements, as proposed by FNV and agreed in the architecture sector, are acceptable and lawful under competition rules. The minister answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition, that the ACM supervises this, and that the government is not aware of consultation with zzp'ers, without committing to any new action.

Collective labour agreement provisions concerning self-employed persons without staff who qualify as undertakings under competition law, and which contain tariff agreements for them, will most likely fall under the cartel prohibition of the Competition Act.

Cao-bepalingen die zien op zelfstandigen zonder personeel die kwalificeren als ondernemer in de zin van het mededingingsrecht en die afspraken bevatten over tarieven voor deze zelfstandigen zullen hoogstwaarschijnlijk onder het kartelverbod uit de Mededingingswet vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zzp'ers in cao’s

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether collective agreements may set minimum fee rates for self-employed workers without staff, and how this relates to bogus self-employment, competition law and tax treatment. Minister Asscher answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition unless the workers are bogus self-employed, that the ACM decides on bogus self-employment, and that the agreement has no effect on tax deductions or the Belastingdienst's assessment.
Whether or not there are bogus self-employed workers does not appear from this collective agreement provision.
Of al dan niet sprake is van schijnzelfstandigen blijkt niet uit deze cao-afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de grote verschillen tussen de postzegelprijs voor consumenten en op de zakelijke markt

MP De Liefde asks why the universal postal service stamp price (73 cents in 2016) far exceeds business mail tariffs, and whether the difference reflects only collection method, and urges a market analysis by the ACM. Minister Kamp explains the gap by PostNL's legally mandated nationwide network, bulk-processing economies in business mail, declining volumes, and says the ACM confirmed the UPD tariff reflects actual costs, while the ACM is already analysing the 24-hour business market.
The cost difference mainly stems from the extensive network that PostNL, as UPD provider, is legally required to maintain.
Het verschil in kosten vloeit met name voort uit het uitgebreide netwerk dat PostNL als UPD-verlener wettelijk verplicht in stand moet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over het opzeggen van de FM-vergunning door Open Rotterdam

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether Open Rotterdam's decision to stop radio broadcasting, leaving the FM frequency unused, could be remedied before 2018 by letting another broadcaster use it. The minister confirmed that under the Mediawet only one local public broadcaster per municipality may be designated and that the frequency is reserved for Open Rotterdam, so reallocation to others is not possible, though a third party could broadcast on Open Rotterdam's frequency in agreement with it and the municipality.
An FM licence for local public broadcasting is only granted to the local public media institution designated by the Commissariaat voor de Media for that municipality.
Een FM-vergunning voor lokale publieke omroep wordt slechts verleend aan de lokale publieke media-instelling die door het Commissariaat voor de Media voor deze gemeente is aangewezen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jan Vos over de invloed van grote bedrijven op het duurzaamheidsbeleid

MPs Cegerek and Jan Vos asked whether large companies unduly influence sustainability policy, citing a PhD study on business lobbying, and whether small players are disadvantaged in schemes such as SDE+, the postcode rose scheme and the energy savings fund. The minister answers that government policy is now shaped jointly with stakeholders, that the cabinet weighs interests itself, that most innovation funds go to SMEs, and that the postcode rose and energy savings fund rules have been simplified, with a further review promised.
In doing so, the cabinet is responsible for a balanced weighing of the various interests.
Daarbij is het kabinet verantwoordelijk voor een evenwichtige afweging van de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over de splitsing van DELTA en de positie van kerncentrale Borssele

MPs Jan Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the planned split of DELTA, the one-year transition period set by the regulator ACM, and the future ownership of the Borssele nuclear plant, including the Van Gent motion and nationalisation options. The minister answered that the ACM will decide on a enforcement order with a transition period by year-end, that the state retains tools (Electricity Act, nuclear law, Borssele covenants) to block unwanted changes of control, and that he will not comment on nationalisation beyond referring to the earlier answers.
I aim to ensure that the position of the Borssele nuclear power plant remains well safeguarded in all cases.
Ik streef ernaar dat de positie van de kerncentrale Borssele in alle gevallen goed geborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het artikel ‘Plannen voor grote trainingsfabriek op Heijplaat’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about plans for a large training plant for the process industry at Heijplaat, including whether the minister would contribute funding. The minister confirmed the financing is nearly complete and a Social Affairs cofinancing grant of 700,000 euro was granted, but declined an additional contribution from the Economic Affairs budget, pointing to other schemes.
I see no possibilities to make an additional contribution for the following reasons.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om een aanvullende bijdrage te leveren om de volgende redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen naar aanleiding van de eindrapportage ‘Brabant Protein Future – Een nieuwe Proti-keten’

A Dutch MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the legal status of insects for human food and feed in the EU compared with the US and Canada, and about EU rules barring animal-derived residues as insect substrate. The state secretary answered that EU feed and animal by-product rules are the constraint, that EFSA advice is pending, and that the Netherlands supports regulatory change if it is done safely.
The Netherlands supports removing obstacles in European laws and regulations for the use of insects, provided this can be done safely for humans, animals and the environment.
Nederland is voorstander van het wegnemen van belemmeringen in Europese wet- en regelgeving ten behoeve van het gebruik van insecten mits dit kan op een veilige manier voor mens, dier en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Nijkerken-de Haan en Öztürk over de keuringen beperkt houdbare producten die via Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) ons land binnen komen in Zuid-Limburg

MPs asked why perishable goods imported via Maastricht Aachen Airport must be tested at a single NVWA laboratory in Wageningen, why more labs are not certified, and whether the long turnaround times disadvantage the airport compared with Germany and Belgium. The government confirmed the Wageningen lab handles high-risk non-EU produce under EU rules, and said an ongoing MAR-L study of laboratory procedures and tariffs will report by year end.
The results of this study are expected to be ready by the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zijn de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind dit jaar gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over gasdeals van Gasunie en Shell met Russisch staatsbedrijf Gazprom, alsmede over de politieke onafhankelijkheid van gasproductie in de Noordzee

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked whether the Gasunie and Shell/BASF gas deals with Gazprom comply with EU sanctions, public interest duties and efforts to reduce Russian energy dependence. The minister answered that the government is not party to private deals, sees no conflict with sanctions in principle, that Gasunie must still weigh public interest in concrete projects, and that no separate impact study is planned.
The cabinet does not consider this necessary.
Het kabinet acht dit niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over een juridische analyse van de visie van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) op de Kip van Morgen

MPs Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked whether an informal ACM view on the Kip van Morgen chicken-welfare agreement should meet motivation duties, whether public interests like sustainability and animal welfare are weighed, and how competition rules and the Wouters doctrine apply. The minister answered that the ACM must motivate informal views but at a lower bar, that public interests are considered, and promised a revised sustainability policy rule by year end and follow-up with the European Commission.
An informal view is a provisional judgment and does not bind the ACM or the undertakings involved.
Een informele zienswijze is een voorlopig oordeel en bindt de ACM en de betrokken ondernemingen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het windpark op de NDSM-werf in Amsterdam-Noord

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about an 18 MW wind project on the NDSM wharf in Amsterdam, questioning why the province of Noord-Holland blocked it despite local support and whether the minister could intervene. The minister answered that no formal application exists yet, that the province rejected the principle request for not meeting spatial rules (including a 600 m distance from housing), and that the province is on track for its wind target and will discuss the distance norm with the municipality, but he sees no role for himself.
The province has informed the municipality of Amsterdam and the initiator Coöperatie NDSM Energie U.A. that the current principle application does not meet the set spatial frameworks.
De provincie heeft de gemeente Amsterdam en de initiatiefnemer Coöperatie NDSM Energie U.A. laten weten dat de huidige principe-aanvraag niet voldoet aan de gestelde ruimtelijke kaders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over veto op proef met gasolie in Twente

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked why a test of gasoil storage in Twente salt caverns by AkzoNobel was halted, whether the company acted properly without an approved safety report, who is liable for future cavern leaks, and whether storage is safe. Minister Kamp answered that the test was not stopped, only the above-ground part was tested, the underground filling awaited a complete safety report, the revised report is now considered complete by advisers, and liability lies with the permit holder under the Mining Act and Civil Code.
I will therefore declare the safety report complete in the short term.
Ik zal op korte termijn het veiligheidsrapport dan ook volledig verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over voortdurende onbereikbaarheid van 112 voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked why 112 emergency access for deaf and hard-of-hearing people remained unreliable, citing Signaal's finding that over half of test calls got no text reply, and asked about timelines, adoption of the REACH112 recommendations and release of technical reports. Minister van der Steur answered that a software upgrade caused the problem, that it was fixed on 23 October 2015, that an independent TNO study is pending, and that selected technical reports are attached.
I have made a selection of the technical reports on the reachability and reliability of 112 for deaf and hard-of-hearing people that are relevant to you.
Ik heb een selectie gemaakt van voor u relevante rapportages van de technische onderzoeken naar de bereikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van 112 voor doven en slechthorenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het sluiten van elektriciteitscentrales

The MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs what the reported closure of gas-fired power plants by GDF Suez means for long-term security of electricity supply, including TenneT's sensitivity variant C, possible solutions and implementation times. The minister answers that the closures were already largely accounted for, that a worst-case shortfall of 1.3 GW by 2022 is covered by 6.2 GW of temporarily idled capacity and interconnection, and that supply security is adequately guaranteed.
It is important to carefully monitor the security of the electricity supply.
Het is belangrijk om de leveringszekerheid van de elektriciteitsvoorziening zorgvuldig te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de verplichte energie-audit

MP Jan Vos asked the minister about the mandatory energy audit under the EU Energy Efficiency Directive, its implementation status, sanctions for non-compliance, awareness, and sanctions in neighbouring countries. The minister answered that existing MJA3/MEE plans and certified systems largely satisfy the audit duty, that municipalities/provinces enforce it with sanctions available under the Environmental Management Act, and that lists and clearer criteria are being prepared.
The competent authority (municipalities and provinces) assesses whether the audit obligation has been met.
Het bevoegd gezag beoordeelt of is voldaan aan de auditverplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat Windows 7 en 8.1 meer data van gebruikers gaan verzamelen

An MP asked ministers whether Windows 7, 8.1 and 10 updates add tracking software that collects more user data, and how this fits Dutch privacy and cookie rules. The minister confirmed Microsoft's diagnostic data exchange, explained the consent and information duties under the Telecommunicatiewet and data protection law, and noted the CBP may investigate, without committing to new action.
Supervision of compliance with Article 11.7a of the Telecommunications Act rests with the Authority for Consumers and Markets.
Het toezicht op de naleving van artikel 11.7a van de Telecommunicatiewet berust bij Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving dat bedrijven worden gestimuleerd gas uit de Noordzee te winnen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs to explain his statement that companies should be encouraged to extract more gas from the North Sea, and how this fits with his claim that fossil fuels are not subsidised, including through tax measures. The minister referred to a parallel letter on the review of the 25% investment deduction for marginal gas fields, and argued that the deduction is a stimulus that enables otherwise unprofitable investment rather than a subsidy, noting prior EU state-aid approval.
I am examining whether the current 25% investment deduction for exploration and extraction of marginal gas deposits on the Dutch continental shelf should be extended, adjusted or replaced after 2016.

In mijn brief geef ik aan dat ik momenteel onderzoek of de huidige investeringsaftrek van 25% voor investeringen in de opsporing en winning van marginale gasvoorkomens op het Nederlands deel van het continentaal plat na 2016 moet worden verlengd, bijgesteld of vervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Ontploffing en brand bij Belgische kerncentrale Doel vlakbij Woensdrecht’

An MP asked the ministers about the explosion and fire at Belgian nuclear plant Doel near the Dutch border, the extension of Doel 1 and 2, crisis communication with Dutch municipalities, and how Belgian incidents are prevented. The minister answered that there was no danger to the Dutch population, that the Belgian regulator FANC handles licensing and informs municipalities within 5 km, and that cross-border cooperation and joint exercises exist.
I will also contact my Belgian counterpart myself to discuss further the importance of the safety of the nuclear power plants.
Ook zal ik zelf met mijn Belgische collega in contact treden om nader te spreken over het belang van de veiligheid van de kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan een pluimveeslachterij op 19 oktober 2015

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the NVWA refused the poultry sector's request to keep slaughterhouses running on 26 and 27 December, and why it handled the request slowly and charged waiting costs to the company. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA allowed a one-time exception for 26 December with conditions, that the sector was informed, and that the claim procedure for NVWA-caused losses exists.
The NVWA will allow poultry slaughterhouses, on a one-time basis, to submit applications for inspections on Saturday 26 December (Second Christmas Day).
De NVWA zal eenmalig voor pluimveeslachterijen toestaan om aanvragen voor keuringen op zaterdag 26 december (Tweede Kerstdag) in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘NAM mag druk onder Langelo opvoeren, ondanks kans op zwaardere bevingen’

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's plan to increase gas storage at Norg despite the risk of stronger earthquakes, and why residents were not informed. The minister said the storage expansion approval dates from June 2014, the August 2015 change only lifts a compartment-level pressure restriction, municipalities and province were informed but residents were not, and seismic risk remains very limited according to SodM and TNO, with a monitoring network planned.
The residents were not separately informed.
De omwonenden zijn niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Geef premie van 4000 euro aan alle inwoners aardbevingsgebied’

MPs asked whether all residents of the Groningen earthquake area should receive a 4,000 euro premium, as proposed by the Groninger Bodem Beweging, and whether this was promised in the earlier administrative agreement. The minister said no such promise exists, that the waardevermeerdering scheme covers only homeowners, and that the National Coordinator is reviewing all schemes, with the current scheme reopened retroactively for damage cases outside the 11 municipalities.
The administrative agreement 'Trust in Recovery and Recovery of Trust' provides that homeowners will be offered a value-increasing package.
In het bestuursakkoord «Vertrouwen op Herstel en Herstel van Vertrouwen» is afgesproken dat aan woningeigenaren een waardeverhogend pakket beschikbaar wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat grensgemeenten moeten kunnen meepraten over de kerncentrales in het Belgische Doel

An SP MP asked the government about calls for neighbouring Dutch border municipalities to use consultation rights over extending the lifetime of the Belgian Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants, including whether an environmental impact assessment is needed. The minister answered that the Belgian regulator FANC decides independently on safety, that no environmental impact assessment is required, that contacts and joint exercises exist, and that she will inform the Chamber of new developments.
It is up to the Belgian government to give a judgement on the extension of the operating life.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om een oordeel te geven over de levensduurverlenging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Moors over de hulp van een netbeheerder betreffende het betalen van de energienota

MPs Bosman and Moors asked whether netbeheerder Alliander's infrastructure arm contributes staff to a new charity, Energiebank Nederland, and whether a public company with a statutory task should fund poverty policy. The minister answered that Alliander provides about three full-time equivalents until 1 April 2016, costs borne by the infrastructure company rather than passed to tariffs, and left the choice to the company and its public shareholders within legal limits.
It is therefore a decision for the shareholders whether they consider such spending desirable.
Het is dan ook een afweging van de aandeelhouders of zij een dergelijke besteding wenselijk vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over het vermeende manipuleren van de prognoses voor zonne- en windenergie

MPs Jan Vos, Van Tongeren and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the IEA manipulated its wind and solar growth forecasts, and whether its outlook is accurate. The minister denied any bias, explained that the WEO presents scenarios rather than forecasts, said the IEA's methodology is careful, and argued the scenarios help inform policy choices.
However, the IEA does not present growth forecasts in the sense of predictions in its annual World Energy Outlook.
Het IEA presenteert in de jaarlijkse World Energy Outlook echter geen groeiprognoses in de zin van voorspellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het Multi Level Marketingbedrijf Vemma

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the supplement company Vemma, which recruits students as 'entrepreneurs', should be investigated as a pyramid scheme after foreign regulators classified it as one, and whether it must disclose its revenue split between membership fees and product sales. The minister answered that enforcement is for the ACM, the Gaming Authority and the prosecutor, that companies need not publish such revenue breakdowns, and that the ministry will strengthen online information on MLM rather than launch a dedicated website.
No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een heldere uitleg van de vigerende cookiewetgeving

Member Oosenbrug (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs to clarify the cookie rules, why the ACM targets website operators rather than publishers abroad, and whether the ACM will clarify the split of obligations. The Minister confirms the consent and information duties under the Telecommunications Act, explains that website operators are the practical contact point, notes the ACM is independent, and points to existing ACM guidance and an industry cookie standard.
The ACM is an independent supervisor. It is up to the ACM to decide how it supervises article 11.7a of the Telecommunications Act.
ACM is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder. Het is aan ACM om te bepalen hoe zij toezicht houdt op artikel 11.7a van de Telecommunicatiewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de onderzoeksrapporten inzake schaliegas

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how follow-up research on shale gas would be designed, including the number, location and technique of scientific boreholes, their costs and funding, and whether municipalities and provinces could refuse them. The minister answered that no research programme is currently on the table, pending the Energy Report 2015, and gave only broad outlines, promising open data and consultation with local authorities.
A research programme on shale gas is currently not on the agenda.
Een onderzoeksprogramma naar schaliegas is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de verdere besluitvorming inzake Pallas

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the second tranche of the 80 million euro loan to the Pallas reactor foundation would be paid out, whether private financing and sound operations were required first, and what the consequences of absent private investment would be for the state budget. The minister confirmed the imminent decision, said private financing is only expected after the first phase ends around 2018/2019, admitted the state bears the risk if no private investment follows, and promised to inform parliament of major decisions.
Naturally, I will inform your House in the interim on important decisions.
Vanzelfsprekend zal ik uw Kamer bij belangrijke besluiten tussentijds informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de waarschuwing voor massasterfte van herten in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of warnings that some 5,000 deer in the Oostvaardersplassen could starve, what the costs would be, and whether the failed experimental management should be ended by selling all grazers. The state secretary answered that the warning concerns about 2,000 animals, that early-reactive management is in place within regular costs, that the plan is not a failure, and that selling all grazers is not planned.
No. I refer you for this also to my letter of 12 March.
Nee. Ik verwijs u hiervoor ook naar mijn brief van 12 maart jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid klein over het RLI-Rapport “Rijk zonder CO2: naar een duurzame energievoorziening in 2050”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the RLi report on a fully sustainable energy supply in 2050 focused only on CO2 and whether the RLi would receive an additional assignment covering other emissions and renewables. The minister replied that the RLi's definition of a sustainable supply covers CO2-equivalents including methane and that no additional assignment is needed, promising the Energy Report at year-end and an Energy Dialogue starting in 2016.
I therefore do not consider an additional assignment for the RLI to be opportune.
Ik vind een aanvullende opdracht voor de RLI dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over concurrentiebeperkend gedrag van PostNL

MP Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL's surcharge on competitors was discriminatory under the Postal Act, whether PostNL could be persuaded not to appeal the court ruling, and when agreement on cost methodology and tariff room could be expected. The minister confirmed the ACM found the surcharge discriminatory, that the court agreed, that PostNL may freely appeal, and that the ACM set the 2016 tariff room and offered MPs a technical briefing.
On the basis of that investigation the ACM concluded that the surcharge is discriminatory towards postal transport companies and imposed an order subject to periodic penalty payments on PostNL.
Op basis van dat onderzoek heeft de ACM geconcludeerd dat de toeslag discriminatoir is ten opzichte van postvervoerbedrijven en heeft een last onder dwangsom opgelegd aan PostNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jans Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de toepassing van fracking bij gaswinning in Saaksum

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's plan to use fracking to recover remaining gas near Saaksum, the risks, alternatives and consultation with local authorities. The minister answered that fracking here is a routine, safety-checked stimulation within the existing plan, that SodM reviews the risk documents before work starts, that no alternative exists for this rock type, and that NAM has consulted local authorities, but declined to ask NAM to refrain.
However, regarding the upcoming work, I see no reason and no possibility to ask NAM not to carry it out.
Ten aanzien van de aanstaande werkzaamheden zie ik echter geen reden en geen mogelijkheid om NAM te verzoeken deze niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat Nederland meer CO2 uitstoot dan vorig jaar in dezelfde periode

The MP Smaling asked the government about reports that Dutch CO2 emissions were higher than a year earlier, how this fits the 25% reduction target for 2020, and whether firmer agreements would be made. The state secretary answered that cold weather and coal use caused the rise, that the EU obligations will still be met, that additional measures are needed beyond 18-21% for 2025, and that the government will send its position on the IBO CO2 study in the first half of 2016.

The IBO CO2 is expected to be completed at the end of 2015. The cabinet will send you its position on the outcomes of the IBO in the first half of 2016 and will also indicate which follow-up steps will be taken.

Het IBO CO 2 wordt naar verwachting eind 2015 afgerond. Het kabinet zal u in de eerste helft van 2016 zijn standpunt toesturen over de uitkomsten van het IBO en daarbij tevens aangeven welke vervolgstappen zullen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht over een ingestorte boerderij in Bedum

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs what steps had been taken in the Bedum farmhouse collapse case, why the counter-expertise took so long, and whether NAM's lack of communication and support for residents was adequate. The minister declined to comment on the individual case in detail, described the procedural steps and the municipality's coordinating role, acknowledged that long silences are undesirable, and asked the National Coordinator Groningen to examine the adequacy of support for residents.
In general I am reluctant to respond to individual cases.
Ten algemene ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over zogenaamde Multi Level Marketing bedrijven

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the number and taxation of entrepreneurs in multi-level marketing firms, whether MLM firms should have a duty to inform aspiring entrepreneurs, and whether the business model of ACN should be referred to regulators and prosecutors. The Minister said the data are not recorded, declined to commission research, placed responsibility on prospective entrepreneurs, and forwarded the complaints about ACN to the ACM, the Ministry of Security and Justice and the Ksa without judging the company.
I have forwarded the request to examine ACN's business model to the ACM.
Ik heb het verzoek om naar het verdienmodel van ACN te kijken doorgeleid naar de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik van supercookies door Vodafone

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Vodafone's use of 'supercookies' (ASID headers) that transmit app and browsing behaviour is lawful in the Netherlands, and what rules and supervision apply. The minister answered that ASID headers are governed by the Wbp rather than the Telecommunicatiewet, that consent is often required, that the Dutch privacy regulator supervises compliance, and that he sees no point in asking consent in every case.
It is primarily the provider's responsibility to assess whether it must ask for consent or can rely on another legal basis for processing personal data.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de aanbieder te beoordelen of hij toestemming moet vragen of een beroep kan doen op een andere grondslag voor de verwerking van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over een conflict tussen PostNL en zijn pakketbezorgers

MP Mei Li Vos asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a conflict between PostNL and its parcel couriers, including the NIWO permit, the bargaining agreement, rates, and whether couriers are genuinely self-employed. The government answered that it is not a party to the conflict, was not involved in the agreement, appointed an explorer whose report is sent to parliament, and left the self-employment assessment to the Tax Authority and courts.
The cabinet is not a party to this.
Het kabinet is hierin geen partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Consumentenbond boos over ‘dubbele’ energierekening’ op de NOS nieuwssite

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs Minister about energy supplier NLE switching customers to payment in advance, causing a one-off double bill, and about losing a welcome bonus when cancelling. The minister acknowledged the one-off double charge, said payment plans are available, referred the complaints about information to the regulator ACM, and saw no need for further action on debt.
I have forwarded the complaints about the information provided on the forfeiture of the welcome bonus to ACM.
De klachten over de informatievoorziening ten aanzien van het vervallen van de welkomstbonus heb ik doorgegeven aan ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over inspraak en betrokkenheid van burgers, provincies en gemeenten bij plannen voor gasboringen in Assen, Blijham en Saaksum

MP Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about public participation and consultation rights for residents, provinces and municipalities over gas drilling and fracking plans in Assen, Blijham and Saaksum, including whether new procedures and risk analyses apply. The Minister answered that a changed winning plan with a risk analysis and public objection procedure will be required before gas production, that the Blijham test drilling is finished without useful results, and that Saaksum fracking falls under the existing winning plan with a notification.
This amended winning plan will, in line with my response to the Safety Board's recommendations, follow the extended preparation procedure with the possibility of submitting objections.

Dit gewijzigd winningsplan zal conform mijn reactie op de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) de uitgebreide voorbereidingsprocedure met mogelijkheid tot het indienen van zienswijzen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het opnieuw uitstellen van het Nationaal Programma voor eindberging van kernafval

An MP asked why the government missed the 23 August 2015 deadline for a National Programme on final disposal of radioactive waste, when it will be available, whether public consultation is adequate, and how long-term funding for disposal is guaranteed. The minister answered that studies took longer than planned, the draft programme goes out for consultation in autumn with a final decision later, and the disposal fund is invested via COVRA with returns lagging targets, to be reviewed.
The European Commission has been informed of the delay so that sufficient time can also be taken for public consultation.
De Europese Commissie is op de hoogte gesteld van de vertraging zodat ook voldoende tijd kan worden genomen voor de inspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de eindberging van kernafval

An SP MP asked why the government requested an extension for its national nuclear waste disposal programme, how public consultation will be ensured, how the disposal fund will cover costs, and whether postponing a final solution to later generations is acceptable. The minister explained delays from supporting studies, promised public consultation this autumn and a Tweede Kamer submission, and defended interim surface storage with a final decision around 2100.
The draft programme will be made available for public inspection this autumn for citizens to comment on.
Het ontwerp programma wordt dit najaar ter inzage gelegd voor burgers voor inspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over mogelijke risico’s van het plaatsen van windturbines aan weerszijden van de Oude Maas ter hoogte van Barendrecht en Binnenmaas

An MP asked the ministers about risks of wind turbines near the Oude Maas for shipping radar, turbulence and noise, dike safety, and whether turbines might have to be shut down. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat tests radar and sightline effects, no study on sound or turbulence was done since no evidence suggests an effect, and the initiator bears the feasibility responsibility while the waterschap checks dike impacts.
As far as I am aware, no research has been carried out into the possible influence of sound waves and turbulence on the radar systems used in shipping.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft geen onderzoek plaatsgevonden naar de mogelijke invloed van geluidsgolven en turbulentie op de in de scheepvaart gebruikte radarsystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over trage internetverbindingen in het onderwijs en de ambities op het gebied van digitale leermiddelen en hoogwaardig onderwijs

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Economic Affairs about slow internet connections in schools and the government's ambitions for digital learning materials. The government says most schools can currently manage with available speeds, describes the Doorbraakproject support and a planned action plan, and says schools should contribute to local broadband initiatives while receiving extra funds.
As a first step, it will be mapped which schools experience problems and which solutions are effective.
Als eerste stap wordt in kaart gebracht welke scholen problemen ervaren en welke oplossingen effectief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht over de overdracht van de schadeafhandeling door NAM aan het CVW

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's phased handover of damage claims to the Centrum voor Veilig Wonen (CVW), and whether this contradicts earlier statements that such a transfer would risk errors. The minister answered that circumstances changed (faster CVW processing, broad wish for NAM not to handle claims itself), that about 2,300 files transfer while around 2,000 stay with NAM including complex cases, and that subsidence damage is compensated when attributed to gas extraction.
Due to the large number of cases this is not possible.
Omwille van het grote aantal zaken is dit niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat TNO bezuinigt op onderzoek naar maatschappelijke thema’s

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported cuts at TNO affecting research on societal themes such as work and health, the effect of VAT rules, and which research would stop. The minister answered that the cuts stem from earlier coalition agreement targets, that TNO will keep quality of work and health knowledge, that a preliminary allocation is still being negotiated, and that the Beschikking will be finalised by the cabinet later.
The national government will carefully monitor over the coming year whether the desired quality is still being provided.
De rijksoverheid zal het komende jaar zorgvuldig monitoren of de gewenste kwaliteit nog steeds wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en Van Tongeren over meetgegevens op het Nederlandse olie- en gasportaal

MPs Mulder, Omtzigt and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported monthly wastewater injection volumes above a 300,000-barrel threshold at Rossum-Weerselo-2, the relevance of a Science study on US injection and induced seismicity, and felt tremors near the injection well. The minister replied that monthly averages stay below that threshold, that the US study is not directly transferable to Dutch conditions, that TNO and SodM are assessing it with results expected in late September, and that the geophone network is being expanded.
I expect an answer from SodM and TNO at the end of September and will inform your House about it then.
Ik verwacht eind september een antwoord van SodM en TNO en zal uw Kamer hier dan over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Benzine is 20 eurocent te duur’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Dutch petrol prices are 20 cents per litre too high and whether the minister will intervene or ask the ACM to investigate. The minister denied the analysis, explained that fuel prices are set in separate markets with lags and local competition, and saw no need to intervene or commission new research, though the ACM monitors the market.
For the reasons given in the answer to question 2, I see no need to intervene or to commission new research into the level of fuel prices.
Om de genoemde redenen in het antwoord op vraag 2 zie ik geen noodzaak om in te grijpen of opnieuw onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar de hoogte van de brandstofprijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Jacobi over de strenge regionaliteitsregels voor regionale commerciële radiozenders

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Rotterdam court ruling that strictly interpreted regionality rules for regional commercial radio, including birthplace criteria and the size of the region. The minister defended the Agentschap Telecom interpretation, appealed the ruling on the digital-range point, declined to loosen the rules for the next licensing period, and said the agency has an independent duty to enforce the law.
The Agentschap Telecom has an independent responsibility (and competence) to enforce the law.
Het Agentschap Telecom heeft een eigenstandige verantwoordelijkheid (en bevoegdheid) om de wet te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Klever over het bericht dat windmolenparken op zee 80% minder energie opleveren

MPs Madlener and Klever asked whether offshore wind farms really produce 80% less energy than claimed, whether subsidy and cost calculations should be revisited, and whether all wind plans should be halted. The minister replied that the wake effect is known and accounted for, that the press report confused installed capacity with output per square kilometre and used a hypothetical scenario unrealistic for the Netherlands, that no new insights change subsidy or costs, and that plans will not be halted.
No, see the answers to questions 2 and 3.
Nee, zie de antwoorden op vraag 2 en 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de opslag van vliegassen in zoutkoepels in Twente

An MP asked the ministers about a pilot to stabilise unstable salt caverns in Twente by filling them with residual materials such as fly ash, and about the safety risks, legal basis, and alternatives. The minister answered that the pilot is permitted under the national waste plan, that safety studies are required before permits are granted, and that the risks will be tested in the permit and storage plan process.
For granting the environmental permits and approving the storage plan, follow-up studies must be carried out on the specific caverns for which stabilisation is foreseen within the pilot project.

Voor het verlenen van de omgevingsvergunningen en het instemmen met het opslagplan dienen vervolgonderzoeken uitgevoerd te worden ten aanzien van de specifieke cavernes waarvoor stabilisatie binnen het proefproject is voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat toekenning van DLO-gelden via de topsectoren een hoog ons-kent-ons-gehalte heeft

SP MPs Smaling and Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether allocation of DLO research funds via the top sectors shows an 'old boys network' bias, questioning transparency, SME access and the balance of research topics. Minister Kamp answers that the calls are open and transparent with predefined criteria, that government is substantively involved in the top sector agendas, that multiple roles held by individuals are disclosed, and that conflict-of-interest and complaint procedures apply.
The assessment of the proposals proceeds transparently.
De beoordeling van de voorstellen verloopt transparant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het negeren van een uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie

An MP asked ministers why an erotic website's advertising, already ruled against by the Advertising Code Commission, could reappear on a beach banner and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The government answered that the Code applies to banners, that the firm complied with the earlier ruling (96% of advertisers comply), that a new complaint is being assessed, and that current instruments are adequate.
Given the high percentage of advertisers that follow a ruling (96%), I consider the current instruments sufficient.
Gelet op het hoge percentage adverteerders dat een uitspraak opvolgt (96%), acht ik de huidige instrumenten voldoende.
Vragen van de leden AgnesMulder en VanHelvert (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Economische Zaken en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het faillissement van Imtech (ingezonden 17 augustus 2015)

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Infrastructure and Environment nine questions about the consequences of the Imtech bankruptcy for the state budget, SME suppliers, government-funded infrastructure projects and insolvency law. The minister's reply is only a holding notice stating that interdepartmental consultation delays the answers and that they will be sent by the end of next week.
Due to the necessary interdepartmental coordination, it is not possible to answer these questions within the usual period.
Vanwege de benodigde interdepartementale afstemming lukt het niet om deze vragen te beantwoorden binnen de gebruikelijke termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Henk Leenders over de 380 kV-hoogspanningslijn tussen Doetinchem en Wesel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a letter from the Bomenstichting Achterhoek, the number of trees to be felled for the 380 kV line between Doetinchem and Wesel, alternatives considered, and compensation and landscaping. The minister replied that no letter was sent, that the foundation accepts the plans with adequate compensation, that the route was based on the most environmentally friendly alternative in the MER, and that replanting obligations are legally binding in the landscape plan.
I am aware of the reported news item. That item contained incorrect information; no letter was sent.
Ik ken het aangehaalde bericht. Dit bericht bevatte onjuiste informatie, er is geen brief verstuurd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Smaling over de enquête onder architecten en de toepassing van de Europese regels bij aanbestedingen

An SP MP asks about a survey of architects who say EU procurement rules disadvantage them: unpaid design phases, strict reference requirements and unexplained decisions. The Minister of Economic Affairs replies that the 2012 Procurement Act's proportionality measures are working but need better application, that unpaid preliminary designs are contrary to the Gids proportionality guidance unless justified, and that a bill to be sent to parliament in autumn will allow longer reference periods.
As announced in the letter, I am focusing on promoting better procurement.
Zoals aangekondigd in de brief zet ik in op het stimuleren van beter aanbesteden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Smaling over het beter aanbesteden van architectuuropdrachten

An MP asks whether selection criteria in architecture tenders should be monitored independently, whether the Proportionality Guide can be evaluated, whether tenders can be made fully public, and whether structural funding for the Architectuur Lokaal/PIANOo advisory support should be restored. The minister declines independent monitoring and binding sanctions, notes the Commission of Tender Experts is non-binding by design, refuses to publish submitted bids, and routes the funding question to PIANOo.
Publishing submitted tenders is not permitted under Article 2.57 of the Public Procurement Act 2012 and is undesirable from a competition-law standpoint.
Het openbaar maken van ingediende offertes mag op grond van artikel 2.57 van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 niet en is vanuit mededingingsrechtelijk oogpunt onwenselijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de Nederlandse geluidsnormen voor windturbines die slechter zijn dan die van de buurlanden

An SP MP asked the government whether Dutch noise standards for wind turbines are weaker than those in neighbouring countries, whether residents have appeal rights, and whether averaging allows peaks to be offset. The state secretary rejected the claim that Dutch rules are the most flexible, pointed to available appeal routes and maatwerk, and said no revision of the norms is planned.
The noise standards that onshore wind turbines must meet are set out in section 3.2.3 of the Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer.
De geluidsnormen waaraan windturbines op land moeten voldoen, zijn opgenomen in paragraaf 3.2.3 van het Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over financiering van franchiseondernemingen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether overly rosy business plans are used to obtain bank loans under the state-guaranteed BMKB scheme in franchising, and whether independent drafting of such plans should be required. The minister said misleading forecasts can be challenged in court, that banks bear a significant share of risk and bear losses from unrealistic forecasts, that no independent drafting obligation is needed, and provided anonymised guarantee data showing loss rates in line with the scheme average.
I therefore see no further consequences on this point in the context of the Dutch Franchise Code.
Ik zie dan ook geen verdere consequenties op dit punt in het kader van de Nederlandse Franchise Code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat delen van het Groninger Forum zouden moeten worden gesloopt

MP Van Tongeren asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that parts of the Groninger Forum must be demolished, how costs of the construction pause and reinforcement are split, whether the state co-pays, and whether other new-build projects are halted or must be demolished for earthquake risk. The minister confirms the pause was agreed with the municipality and NAM, NAM agreed to consider delay costs for compensation, cost allocation is still under negotiation, and cost-sharing for other projects is agreed per project.
This concerns an ongoing negotiation for a specific project, involving the contractor, the client and third parties, and the final outcomes are not yet settled.

Het betreft hier een nog lopend onderhandelingstraject voor een specifiek project, waarbij de aannemer, de opdrachtgever en derde partijen betrokken zijn en de definitieve uitkomsten nog niet vaststaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over het bericht ‘Havens verliezen hun belastingvrijstelling’

MPs Albert de Vries and Groot asked whether the European Commission has moved to a new phase and issued an ultimatum over the temporary corporate tax exemption for Dutch seaports, how the Commission treats indirect state aid to ports in other member states, and what alternatives exist. The Secretary of State declined to disclose the content or outcome of ongoing talks with the Commission and did not assess alternatives, referring instead to the earlier answers, while noting that talks aim to avoid forced recovery of the aid from 1 January 2016.
The talks between the cabinet and the European Commission are still ongoing.
Het gesprek tussen het kabinet en de Europese Commissie is nog steeds gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht van Energieonderzoekscentrum Nederland (ECN) dat de zware industrie nu het energiegebruik moet aanpakken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether heavy industry will fail to contribute to the energy transition if competitiveness remains the leading concern, and whether targeted incentives or feed-in tariffs should be used. The minister replied that energy efficiency benefits competitiveness, pointed to the Energy Agreement and bilateral agreements with industry, and said a decision on new instruments would wait for the 2016 evaluation of the Energy Agreement.
Should the evaluation show that energy-intensive industry is not on track to meet the Energy Agreement's targets, I will consult the parties to the Energy Agreement on how to resolve this.

Mocht uit de evaluatie blijken dat de energie-intensieve industrie niet op schema ligt om de doelstellingen van het Energieakkoord te halen, dan zal ik overleggen met de aangesloten partijen bij het Energieakkoord hoe dit op te lossen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de gevolgen van de onlangs ingevoerde aanpassing van de Opiumwet (nieuw art. 11a) voor Nederlandse ondernemers in de hennepzaadindustrie en in d

MPs from D66 asked whether the new article 11a of the Opiumwet could criminalise sales of hemp seed, whether that conflicts with legality, the economic size of the hemp seed industry, and whether seized seeds would be grown by police. The minister answered that hemp seed is excluded from the Opiumwet prohibitions but that sales can fall under article 11a when intended for illegal cultivation, that legal fibre hemp cultivation remains permitted under Green Deals, and that the claim of police growing cannabis is untrue, with seeds only undergoing DNA testing.
Yes, I know this report, but it does not match the facts.
Ja, ik ken dit bericht, maar het stemt niet overeen met de feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over de implementatie van het cookiebeleid op de websites van de Publieke Omroep

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether NPO websites respect users' cookie choices, whether settings are remembered, and what the government will do to make sites accessible without accepting privacy-sensitive cookies. The minister answered that the sites were reviewed, the NPO fixed a display error and a remembering problem, and enforcement rests with the ACM and CBP, which have already acted.
Whether the NPO complies with the legal requirements and continues to do so is of course for the ACM to assess.
Of de NPO aan de wettelijke eisen voldoet en blijft voldoen is uiteraard aan de ACM om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over mogelijke gasboringen bij Woudsend

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he knew of the province of Friesland's opposition to new gas drilling, whether the Woudsend drilling was necessary, and how he would handle the case once municipalities gain more influence under the Mining Act. The minister answered that the province's stance does not affect national legal powers, that the drilling fits the small-fields policy subject to legal requirements, that the project is not yet in an approval procedure, and that the ministry already acts in line with the planned reform.
The province's position leaves the legal provisions, tasks and powers of both the national government and the province unaffected.
De stellingname van de provincie laat de wettelijke bepalingen, taken en bevoegdheden van zowel het Rijk als de provincie onverlet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over geïnduceerde aardbevingen en waterinjectie

An MP asked the minister about induced earthquakes from wastewater injection in Twente, citing a US study linking high-rate injection to seismicity, and asked about monitoring, injection limits and permit suspension. The minister answered that Dutch practice differs from the US, that no injection exceeded the 300,000 bbl threshold, that the seismic network will be expanded, and that no permit suspension is planned.
I did point TNO and SodM to the article and asked them to examine further the relevance of this article for the Dutch situation.
Ik heb TNO en SodM wel gewezen op het artikel en hen gevraagd de relevantie van dit artikel voor de Nederlandse situatie nader te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Schut-Welkzijn en Ziengs over het bericht “Negen manieren om je als zzp-er goedkoper te verzekeren”

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the disability insurance market for self-employed workers offers enough cheaper 'adapted' policies, whether rules or advice obligations block them, and whether the 13-week registration deadline for voluntary insurance should be extended. Minister Asscher replied that many options exist, that no legal barriers are known, that the AFM sees room for better advice, and that extending the deadline is not favoured because of adverse selection, promising to return to the issue after the IBO zzp.
In the context of the IBO zzp and the Weyenberg motion, I will return to the insurability of the disability risk.
In het kader van het IBO zzp en de motie Weyenberg 3 , zal ik terugkomen op de verzekerbaarheid van het arbeidsongeschiktheidsrisico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over zogenaamde multi-level marketingbedrijven

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ACN multi-level marketing company, shown in a TV report, operates as a legal business model or an illegal pyramid scheme, and asks about investor protection, unfair trade practices and a warning website. The minister replies that assessment belongs to the Kansspelautoriteit, the ACM and ultimately the courts, that paying a membership fee does not by itself prove a pyramid scheme, and that no dedicated website is planned.

The assessment of the conduct of the company concerned is for the supervisory authorities involved, the Kansspelautoriteit and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), and ultimately for the courts.
De beoordeling van de handelwijze van het betreffende bedrijf is aan de betrokken toezichthouders, de Kansspelautoriteit en de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM), en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het beleid van het Agentschap Telecom ten aanzien van de regelgeving rondom regiogerichtheid van radiozenders (

MP Klein asks the minister how the government will implement a Rotterdam court ruling on regional programming requirements for commercial radio and whether frequency scarcity still exists. The minister contests the court's finding on digital DAB+ reach, announces an appeal on that aspect, says enforcement rests with the Agentschap Telecom and points to forthcoming policy letters on commercial radio frequencies and medium wave.
In this procedure I am the defendant.
In deze procedure ben ik verweerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sluiting van de kerncentrale Tihange

MPs Jan Vos and Van Tongeren asked whether the government would act on Dutch municipal motions urging closure of the Belgian Tihange plant, press Belgian counterparts, and clarify iodine tablet distribution and emergency planning. The minister replied that nuclear safety is a Belgian national responsibility handled by FANC, that cooperation with FANC is being strengthened, and described the regional emergency plans and iodine tablet stocks without giving an exact distribution radius.
Nuclear safety is a national responsibility and it is therefore the Belgian regulator that decides whether the plant is safe or must be closed.
Nucleaire veiligheid is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en het is dan ook de Belgische toezichthouder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de algemene voorwaarden van De Persgroep voor freelance journalisten

An MP asked ministers about De Persgroep's new terms for freelance journalists, including unilateral change with eight days' notice, competition clauses, broad exploitation rights and licence fees. The government answered that these are private civil-law contracts, that disputes are for the courts or the ACM, and that the new copyright contract law sets a 'fair remuneration' standard it cannot judge itself.
However, this concerns a civil-law contract between private parties to which the government is not a party.
Het betreft hier echter een civielrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen private partijen waarbij de overheid geen partij is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over sponsoring van de klimaattop Parijs door fossiele bedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers whether sponsorship of the Paris climate summit by fossil fuel firms (EDF, Engie, Air France) undermines its credibility and whether they would demand a verifiable sustainability step from these companies. The state secretary answered that involving business strengthens the summit, that sponsorship fits UNFCCC guidelines, and that companies must contribute to the EU 40% CO2 reduction target by 2030.
The cabinet does not believe that the financial contribution of these companies to the Paris climate summit undermines its credibility.
Het kabinet vindt niet dat het leveren van een financiële bijdrage van genoemde bedrijven aan de klimaattop in Parijs de geloofwaardigheid ondergraaft.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de Minister van Economische Zaken over TenderNed (ingezonden 26 juni 2015).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about frequent TenderNed outages, deadline extensions, bidders unable to submit, and liability for downtime. The minister acknowledged the outages, said exact figures on affected tenders cannot be given, and pointed to existing extension rules and a forthcoming bill allowing alternative submission routes.
As a result, it is not possible to give a reliable estimate of the number of businesses that could not submit a bid due to TenderNed outages.
Hierdoor is het niet mogelijk een goede schatting te geven van het aantal ondernemingen dat niet heeft kunnen inschrijven als gevolg van storingen bij TenderNed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over storingen bij TenderNed

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether earlier questions about TenderNed have led to fewer reported outages being posted or removed from the TenderNed Twitter account. The minister answered that only one outage tweet was removed because the fault had already been fixed, and that part of TenderNed's infrastructure was adjusted on 22 June, with results being monitored.
One report of a malfunction has been removed, because the malfunction had already been resolved directly after the tweet was posted.
Er is één melding van een storing verwijderd, omdat de storing al verholpen was direct na het plaatsen van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over het minder uitbetalen voor het gebruik van online muziek aan artiesten

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked why Buma/Stemra pays composers and lyricists less for online music streams and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the imbalance, blamed unlicensed competition and costly rights identification, and pointed to the forthcoming CRM implementation bill, a campaign and a planned congress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over 375 ontslagen bij FrieslandCampina in Beilen en Leeuwarden

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about 375 layoffs at FrieslandCampina in Beilen and Leeuwarden, including the lack of early notice to local government and plans for reemployment. The minister answered that the company's internal decision-making comes first, that the sector and regional plans support job transitions, and that the Dutch Dairy Chain programme continues unchanged.
I trust that FrieslandCampina will actively, together with the parties involved such as the trade unions and regional governments, work to help employees move from job to job.

Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat FrieslandCampina zich actief, samen met de betrokken partijen als de vakorganisaties en de regionale overheden, zullen inzetten om werknemers van werk naar werk te begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘CdK haalt ongemeen fel uit naar de NAM’

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Groningen Commissioner of the King criticised NAM's slow handling of complex earthquake damage claims, including a case in Nieuwolda where work stopped despite safety concerns. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the damage protocol, the transfer of new claims to the Centrum Veilig Wonen, and agreements with NAM to finish complex cases by year-end.
As Minister, it is not appropriate for me to respond to individual cases.
Als Minister past het mij niet om op individuele gevallen te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de financiële strop van 5 miljoen euro voor het Rotterdamse Warmtebedrijf

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a reported 5 million euro financial squeeze on Warmtebedrijf Rotterdam from paying full price for residual heat from AVR, and about risks from single-source supply, coal plants and waste reduction. The minister answered that a court summary ruling was complied with, the parties are negotiating, and that heat sourcing is left to regional parties, with the energy route to be set out later.
It is up to the local and regional parties to work this out.
Het is aan de lokale en regionale partijen om dit uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Wolbert over universele beschikbaarheid van breedbandinternet

MPs Oosenbrug and Wolbert asked whether broadband should be a universal service and how to reach the roughly 330,000 addresses in rural areas lacking 30 Mbps access. Minister Kamp answered that a universal service obligation adds little for the Netherlands, pointed to facilitating measures and regional tailoring, and saw no legal obstacles or need for uniform rules.
For the Netherlands, I consider the added value of a universal service obligation for broadband internet to be small.
Voor Nederland acht ik de toegevoegde waarde van een universele dienstverplichting voor breedbandinternet gering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij subsidieverstrekking voor zonnepanelen naar aanleiding van het artikel “Te oud voor subsidie” in de Telegraaf

An SP MP asked whether the age limit of 75 for the SVn Duurzaamheidslening (a consumer loan for solar panels) amounts to age discrimination against over-75s. The minister replied that SVn offers loans, not subsidies, that the age limit is a creditworthiness criterion for SVn to decide, and that he will take no action and does not consider it discrimination.
In my view there is no age discrimination, since a lender may apply criteria when granting a loan to be sure of repayment.
