Naar mijn mening is er geen sprake van leeftijdsdiscriminatie aangezien een geldverstrekker bij het afgeven van een lening criteria kan hanteren om zekerheid te houden over de terugbetaling van leningen aan de geldverstrekker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de bezuinigingen op het nationale standaardenlaboratorium VSL

The MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about budget cuts to the national metrology institute VSL, their size, the reasoning behind them, and industry objections including alleged favouritism toward German clients. The Minister answers that the cuts follow from the Lenteakkoord and Rutte II, that a multi-year plan will be discussed with VSL and industry with results reported in spring 2016, and that the alleged discrimination is hard to substantiate but will be investigated at EU level.
I will inform your House in spring 2016 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2016 over de uitkomsten daarvan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling naar aanleiding van een artikel in NRC Handelsblad over de uitkomsten van een IMF-rapport inzake wereldwijde subsidies voor fossiele energie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about IMF figures on global fossil fuel subsidies, whether Dutch fossil energy is subsidised including tax advantages, whether the minister supports IMF calls for higher fossil fuel taxes, and whether a Green GDP should be introduced. The minister answered that most of the IMF amount reflects unpriced externalities, that fossil fuels are not subsidised in the Netherlands though some excise exemptions stem from international treaties, that he agrees with removing artificial pump prices in developing countries but sees no reason for a specific Dutch fossil tax, and that no Green GDP will be pursued due to lack of international consensus on measuring environmental damage.
Fossil fuels are not subsidised in the Netherlands, including through fiscal measures.
Fossiele brandstoffen worden in Nederland niet gesubsidieerd, ook niet via fiscale maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Verhoeven over het clusteren van werkzaamheden bij een aanbesteding door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Schouten and Verhoeven asked whether Rijkswaterstaat's combined multi-year maintenance tender for the West-Nederland-Zuid area breached the Aanbestedingswet's ban on unnecessary clustering and disadvantaged SMEs. The government answered that a complaint was upheld, the tender was withdrawn and split into three smaller lots, and it will evaluate the law's clustering rules in the summer.
Rijkswaterstaat found the complaint well-founded and withdrew the tender.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft de klacht gegrond bevonden en heeft de aanbesteding ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de voorgenomen verhuizing van de SLO naar Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Education and Economic Affairs ministers whether SLO's planned move of 120 staff from Enschede to Utrecht is acceptable, given its state funding and the Chamber's past preference for spreading government-funded jobs, and whether the minister would talk with SLO about staying in Enschede. The minister answered that the move has negligible regional employment effects, that SLO is a private-law body whose location decision requires only formal ministerial consent that the minister sees no grounds to withhold, and that she sees no reason to intervene.
A possible conversation with SLO about its location could arise within the subsidy relationship between OCW and SLO.
Een eventueel gesprek met SLO over haar vestigingsplaats zou aan de orde kunnen zijn in het kader van de subsidierelatie tussen OCW en SLO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling naar aanleiding van een artikel in De Volkskrant van 6 mei jl. onder de titel “Energierekening dit jaar 200 euro lager”

MP Smaling asked whether household energy bills fall by about 200 euro this year due to lower oil prices and European grid integration, and whether fossil energy will stay cheaper than renewables. The minister confirmed the drop is mainly driven by lower crude oil and fuel prices, explained gas and electricity price drivers, and said renewable subsidies via SDE+ bridge the gap while expected future price trends remain uncertain.
As indicated in the newspaper article, the decline in the average energy bill is mainly caused by the sharply fallen prices of crude oil.
Zoals in het krantenartikel is aangegeven, wordt de daling van de gemiddelde energierekening vooral veroorzaakt door de scherp gedaalde prijzen voor ruwe olie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het aanspreken van hostingproviders door de politie op cybercrime

An MP asked about police plans to approach hosting providers about cybercrime under the 'Nederland Schoon' project, including whether content could be taken offline without a judge. The State Secretary explained the project targets cybercrime facilitated by Dutch hosting providers, that no specific content removal will be requested within the project, and that formal removal orders still require prosecutor action with investigating judge authorisation.
In the discussions within the Nederland Schoon project, hosting companies will be neither requested nor required to remove specific content from their network.
In de gesprekken binnen het project Nederland Schoon zal aan de hostingbedrijven verzocht noch gevorderd worden om specifieke content van hun netwerk te verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Veen naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘MIT-regeling voor advies en haalbaarheidsprojecten mkb overtekend’

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the MIT innovation subsidy for SMEs was oversubscribed within two days, how many firms are affected, and whether budgets can be raised. The minister explains the joint regional-national instrument rollout and high demand, says budgets are roughly sufficient but under review, and promises a report to parliament in autumn.

As I committed in the committee debate on business policy and innovation of 10 March, I aim to give the House insight into the results of the various MIT subsidy components around the 2016 budget debate.
Zoals ik in het AO Bedrijvenbeleid en Innovatie van 10 maart jl. heb toegezegd, streef ik ernaar om rondom de begrotingsbehandeling 2016 van mijn ministerie de Kamer inzicht te geven in de resultaten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar bodem Wijnaldum’ in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports on soil subsidence in Wijnaldum, whether the Tcbb only examines mining-related causes, and whether residents get timely compensation and burden-of-proof reversal. The minister explained the Tcbb's legal mandate and compensation procedure, said damage to public infrastructure is handled faster through agreements, and referred to earlier letters on reversing the burden of proof.
It is in the interest of both the citizen and the mining company that the correct cause of the damage is established.
Het is zowel in het belang van de burger als van de mijnbouwonderneming dat de juiste oorzaak van de schade wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen het lid De Liefde over hoge servicekosten voor toegangskaarten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why businesses charge consumers card surcharges that exceed actual costs, which is unlawful, and whether the ACM's weak enforcement and low fines are acceptable, and whether fines will be raised. The minister said the ACM independently chooses its enforcement instruments, that fines should deter, and that a bill raising ACM fine maxima has been submitted, while the ACM decides itself whether to investigate surcharging.
The bill ... raises the maximum fines the ACM can impose under the laws it supervises.
Het wetsvoorstel ... verhoogt de maxima van de boetes die de ACM kan opleggen op grond van de wetten op de naleving waarvan zij toezicht houdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het miljoenenverlies bij het Afval Energie Bedrijf in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary about EUR 89 million in losses at Afval Energie Bedrijf Amsterdam, whether these were foreseeable before its privatisation, and about the balance between waste supply, incineration capacity, imports and energy use. The state secretary largely answered on waste-market policy, said the municipality's reasons and the loss question fall outside his remit, and affirmed that continued import of foreign waste is acceptable.
It is further not for me to explain the reasons that played a role at the municipal government, nor to pass judgment on whether the losses could have been prevented.

Het is verder niet aan mij om een toelichting te geven op de redenen die bij het gemeentebestuur speelden, noch om een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of de verliezen voorkomen hadden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedaling van woningen door aardbevingen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VU study finding house values drop 1.2 to 1.9 percent per earthquake above 2.2 on the Richter scale, and about the adequacy of the compensation scheme and its trust and complexity. The minister disputes the VU finding based on Ortec Finance studies, describes the compensation scheme and planned market measures, and promises to pass the findings to the National Coordinator Groningen.
I will bring the outcomes of this study and of the study commissioned by the Dialogue Table to the attention of the National Coordinator Groningen.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en het onderzoek dat gedaan wordt in opdracht van de Dialoogtafel onder de aandacht brengen van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het herstel van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and CVW control contractor choice for earthquake damage repair in Groningen, and how the government responds to criticism of CVW's expert assessments and WOZ valuations. The minister answered that residents can choose among three options including their own contractor, that the procedure protects choice and counter-expertise, and that WOZ valuation is a municipal responsibility.
The Supervisory Committee of CVW oversees the proper execution of CVW's work.
De Commissie van Toezicht van CVW ziet toe op een gedegen uitvoering van de werkzaamheden door CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de impact van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake damage in Groningen, including whether induced quakes are comparable in impact to Southern European quakes and the safety of primary schools such as CBS De Regenboog in Bedum. The minister replied that induced quakes have a different impact than natural ones, that shake-maps will be published after the new seismic network is operational in summer 2015, and that school buildings are being inspected and reinforced by NAM, with a final report on the Bedum school expected in a few weeks.
Yes. With the new seismological network in Groningen, currently being built, it will become possible to make ground acceleration visible directly after an earthquake in the form of shake-maps.

Ja. Met het nieuwe seismologische netwerk in Groningen, dat op dit moment wordt opgebouwd, wordt het mogelijk om ook de grondversnelling direct na de beving inzichtelijk te maken in de vorm van «shake-maps».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het aardbevingengebied

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake damage claims in Groningen falling outside NAM's contour map, NAM's self-assessment of claims, reinforcement of homes and dikes, confidentiality in settlements, and related housing market and compensation issues. The Minister defends the contour-based approach, says NAM will now send experts to all claims and expand monitoring, and states that the Tcbb and a national coordinator will handle disputes and reinforcement.
Naturally, consultation has taken place on this with the province and municipalities.
Vanzelfsprekend heeft hierover afstemming plaatsgevonden met de provincie en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de aardbevingsbestendigheid van het Chemiepark in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about a 2015 letter from Delfzijl's mayor on earthquake resistance of the Delfzijl chemical park, whether a study was promised in 2013, and whether research has been done and the municipality will be informed. The minister confirms the letter and a working group with a methodology by Deltares and TNO, but says the research is run by individual companies, funded by NAM, takes up to two years, and results will only be shared through the regular permitting process with the municipalities.
I will ask the National Coordinator Groningen to discuss with the parties involved whether, and if so how, the research process can be accelerated.
Ik zal de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen vragen om met de betrokken partijen te bespreken of, en zo ja, hoe het onderzoeksproces versneld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de inwerkingtreding van de negende tranche van de Crisis- en herstelwet in Groningen

An MP asked whether adding earthquake-related measures (Groningen reinforcement, value-enhancing works, cables and pipelines) to the ninth tranche of the Crisis and Recovery Act would limit provincial and municipal influence, conflict with the Onderzoeksraad's recommendation, and allow faster expropriation or other rule changes. The minister answered that the tranche only accelerates administrative procedures without changing local competences, that other rules (expropriation, monuments, nature, environment) are unchanged, and that the Act will not be reconsidered.
Including the said measures in Annex I of the Crisis and Recovery Act means that the administrative-law procedural accelerations of chapter 1, section 2 of the Act apply to them.
Het opnemen van de genoemde maatregelen in Bijlage I van de Chw betekent dat hierop de bestuursrechtelijke procedurele versnellingen van hoofdstuk 1, afdeling 2, van de Chw van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het artikel “Experts kritisch op wapenexportplan”

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the ministers about a press report criticising the arms export plan, including CDIU consultation, the timing and validity of export licences, and EU-level distortion of competition through state-owned shipyards. Minister Ploumen answered that licences are issued before delivery with a prior sounding procedure available, that licences usually run one year, and that the EU has long worked to reduce competition distortion in defence procurement.
A licence is issued prior to the actual delivery of the goods.
Een vergunning wordt verstrekt voorafgaand aan de daadwerkelijke levering van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over subsidiering van biomassa bijstook

Four MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidising biomass co-firing (including 15% cheaper residual streams such as animal meal) risks over-subsidisation, and questioned the basis of the SDE+ base amounts and the withheld ECN/DNV GL reports. The minister answered that the NGO agreement does not fix the SDE+ rate, that the price effect is within calculation margins, and that the preliminary ECN note will not be published though the final version was.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer, Van Dekken en Albert de Vries over vestigingsplaatsen voor een kerncentrale

Three PvdA MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen makes the Eemshaven unsuitable as a nuclear plant site and whether it should be dropped from the SEV III energy structure plan. The minister answered that the risk is premature grounds to exclude the site, that Eemshaven remains a safeguarded location, and that it will be reviewed in the second SEV III evaluation in 2016.
This will be considered at the second evaluation of SEV III, in 2016.
Dit zal worden bezien bij de tweede evaluatie van het SEV III, in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat windturbines in het offshore Amaliawindpark bij IJmuiden niet veilig zijn en dreigen te bezwijken

An MP asked the minister whether offshore wind turbines at the Amalia wind farm are unsafe and could collapse, and what this means for the planned offshore rollout, subsidies, and onshore turbines. The minister acknowledged a first-generation design error, said repairs are underway with a fix that will not affect new parks, subsidies do not cover repair costs, and the error does not apply to onshore turbines.
This concerns a design error that occurs in the first generation of offshore wind farms.
Het betreft hier een ontwerpfout die voorkomt bij de eerste generatie windparken op zee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Brand door hennepteelt breekt vaak uit in bewoond huis’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about a report that cannabis-cultivation fires often break out in occupied homes, and what measures will be taken to dismantle more plantations in 2015 and whether energy-theft identification requirements will be introduced. The minister says the problem is serious, describes existing enforcement measures and the new preparatory-acts offence, and reports talks with the energy sector on civil claims and an identification requirement, which remain under consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over achterblijvende digitalisering in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Harvard Business Review research ranking the Netherlands as the fastest receding digital economy among 51 countries is reliable and what policy follows. The minister answered that the index's data and methodology are only partly transparent and that other rankings show the Netherlands improving, and listed digitalisation initiatives such as ICT breakthrough projects and a startup envoy.

The usefulness of the index, especially where its conclusions differ from other indices based on the same sources, I cannot properly assess because the authors give only partial insight into the underlying data and methodology on which the conclusions are based.

De bruikbaarheid van de index, met name waar de conclusies afwijken van andere indexen die op dezelfde bronnen zijn gebaseerd, kan ik niet goed beoordelen omdat de auteurs maar gedeeltelijk inzicht geven in de onderliggende data en methodologie waarop conclusies gebaseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van de heer Don, bestuurslid van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM), over verdere liberalisering van het spoor

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the ACM board member Don's call for studying the splitting and tendering of the Dutch main rail network was appropriate, given that the ACM is an independent regulator and the matter belongs to ministerial policy. The government answered that Don spoke as chair of IRG-Rail, that the Dutch position remains flexible and against splitting the main network, that the ACM may comment on policy only within agreed limits and did not address rail in its Signaal 2015, and that the ACM is not conducting its own study on splitting, only a required competition assessment.
The ACM is an independent administrative body within the meaning of the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies.
De ACM is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan in de zin van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de noodzaak om de kerncentrale Borssele te controleren op scheurtjes

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant's reactor vessel should be fully inspected for cracks after Belgian findings, and why the 2013 inspection report was not published. The minister answered that Borssele's vessel differs from the Belgian ones, that the inspection sampling was sufficient, and that the report is for the operator EPZ to publish; no additional inspection was deemed necessary, though ANVS will monitor developments.
The NRG report was commissioned by EPZ, the licence holder of the KCB. It is therefore up to EPZ whether or not to make the report public.
Het rapport van NRG is in opdracht van EPZ, de vergunninghouder van de KCB, opgesteld. Het is daarom aan EPZ om het rapport al dan niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Bashir en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

MPs of the SP asked the government about reports that it squeezes the construction sector, including cost overruns on A15 and A2 projects, the risks of a Ballast Nedam bankruptcy, and whether lowest-price awarding and design-build-finance-maintain contracts cause sector losses. The minister answered that cost overrun figures are confidential, that Rijkswaterstaat compensates responsibly-caused extra costs, that EMVI (best value) is the main award criterion, and that the Aanbestedingswet evaluation will be sent to parliament by summer.
Financial information from contractors, insofar as I have it, I cannot make public.
Financiële informatie van opdrachtnemers, voor zover ik hierover beschik, kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over hoge servicekosten voor toegangskaarten

MPs Van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers whether excessive service fees added to concert and event tickets, including a claim of 56,000 euro per week for website maintenance and fees for printing one's own ticket, are acceptable, and whether a cap or all-in ticket should be introduced. The minister replied that pricing and fees are for market parties, that existing consumer-information and unfair-practice rules and the ACM's oversight are sufficient, and that a cap is undesirable.
Determining the height of the service fees is up to market parties.
Het bepalen van de hoogte van de servicekosten is aan marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de opruiming van niet meer in gebruik zijnde windmolens

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how many decommissioned windmills remain standing in the Netherlands, why they are not removed, and how their continued presence could be prevented. The minister said the exact number is unknown, that removal is usually economically viable, and that the government is examining temporary zoning and licensing to require removal at end of life.
The exact number of no longer operational windmills that remain standing cannot be determined by me.
Het exacte aantal niet meer in gebruik zijnde windmolens dat blijft staan is voor mij niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bashir over ‘de dubbele petten bij Bijzonder Beheer Rabobank’

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about alleged 'double hats' at Rabobank's Bijzonder Beheer unit, its subsidiary Bodemgoed buying assets of failing clients, the transparency of auctions, and use of the BMKB guarantee scheme. The government defended the practice as in the client's interest, rejected concerns about deliberate harm to clients, and provided purchase and portfolio figures while stating it saw no reason to intervene.
Due to confidentiality of company data, payments to individual banks are not disclosed.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgegevens worden uitkeringen aan individuele banken niet geopenbaard
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het opgesteld vermogen zonne-energie in Nederland naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘scepsis over hoeveelheid zonne-energie’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the installed solar PV capacity in the Netherlands is not precisely known and how the CBS and the Productie Installatie Register data are compiled. The minister acknowledged that exact figures are unavailable, explained the CBS survey (about 20 percent uncertainty) and the registration duty under the Netcode Elektriciteit, and said grid operators report that most installations are registered without current capacity or safety problems.
Yes, it is correct that it is not exactly known how much capacity of solar energy installations has been installed in the Netherlands.
Ja, het klopt dat niet exact bekend is hoeveel vermogen aan zonne-energie-installaties in Nederland is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het falen van de wetgeving inzake betalingstermijnen voor zzp’ers en kleine ondernemers

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that late-payment rules fail sole traders and small firms, and whether large firms abuse their position toward SMEs and whether the RVO's own terms disadvantage them. The minister answered that the research is only a press release and cannot be assessed on substance, that a study of inter-firm payment behaviour is being prepared, and that remedies exist (late-payment interest, a fixed EUR 40 fee, complaint points and the Commission of Procurement Experts).
A study on payment behaviour between companies is currently being prepared by EZ.
Op dit moment wordt door EZ een onderzoek voorbereid over het betaalgedrag tussen bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over regeldrift

MPs asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurers demand extensive documents from employers before advising on pension schemes, given the aim to cut administrative burden. The minister says the Wft uses open norms, the AFM guidelines are not a checklist, the burden is hard to estimate and is not tracked, and the Actal study on financial-sector regulation will examine similar cases.
Because there are various ways to gather information from the client, the administrative burden arising from this cannot be reliably estimated.
Vanwege de verschillende mogelijkheden om informatie bij de klant in te winnen zijn de administratieve lasten die hieruit voortkomen niet goed in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over een 100%-controle in de reactor van kerncentrale Borssele

Two MPs asked the minister whether hairline cracks in the Borssele reactor vessel can be excluded, whether a 100% inspection and equally sensitive equipment as in Belgium can be required, and whether the research report and standards used are adequate. The minister replied that cracks found in Belgian vessels were not present in Borssele, that the inspection was qualified in advance under ENIQ and assessed by Lloyd's Register and the regulator, and that the report is publicly available via EPZ though not physically held by the regulator.
The NRG research report is not physically in the hands of the ANVS but has been made public by the licence holder EPZ.
Het onderzoeksrapport van NRG is fysiek niet in handen van de ANVS maar is door de vergunninghouder EPZ openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Toorenburg over de voortgang van de ondergrondse opslag van kernafval in Mol

MPs Mulder and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Belgian experiment at Mol on heat effects of high-level nuclear waste storage and whether Belgian authorities had contacted Brabant authorities as agreed in 2011. The minister confirmed awareness, said Belgium had made an informal 2011 commitment to inform Brabant authorities of new developments, and said no contact was missing because stakeholders were invited to an information meeting in February.
I visited Mol in May 2013 and had NIRAS inform me about this dossier.
Ik ben in mei 2013 naar Mol geweest en heb me daar laten informeren door NIRAS over dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over energievergelijkingssites

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether energy comparison sites mislead customers seeking green electricity, whether intermediary fees undermine their independence, and whether GvO certificates allow coal power to be sold as green. The minister replied that the ACM as regulator judges misleading practices, that comparison sites may choose their own revenue models, that GvO trade does not remove the incentive for domestic renewable production, and that declined to start a new investigation itself.
It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) as supervisor to assess whether in this specific case there is misleading conduct contrary to legal provisions.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) als toezichthouder om te beoordelen of in dit specifieke geval sprake is van misleiding die in strijd is met wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over gasboringen op Terschelling

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the permitting status, Natura 2000 and tourism risks, CO2 content, drilling and stimulation techniques, blow-out risk, financial liability and reserve volumes of the Terschelling gas field. The minister answered that a winning permit decision is expected mid-year, that the environmental and natura assessments will follow under the national coordination regime, that liability rests with the operator, and declined to give reserve or revenue estimates before the permit is granted.
First I must decide whether the winning permit requested by Tulip Oil under the Mining Act can be granted.
Eerst dien ik te besluiten of de door Tulip Oil aangevraagde winningsvergunning op grond van de Mijnbouwwet kan worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinningsplannen op Terschelling, Schiermonnikoog en bij Oppenhuizen

An MP asked the ministers about planned gas extraction near Terschelling, Schiermonnikoog and Oppenhuizen, including protection of the Wadden Sea, the powers of provinces and municipalities, and the energy transition. The ministers answered that permits are still in procedure, that no moratorium is needed, that local authorities have formal consultation rights, and that the Structuurvisie Ondergrond and Energierapport 2015 are in preparation.
The Provincial Executive of the province of Friesland advises me on the mining permit application submitted by Tulip Oil under the Mining Act.
Het College van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Friesland adviseert mij inzake de door Tulip Oil ingediende winningsvergunningaanvraag op basis van de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Van Dekken over de gaswinningsplannen op en rond Terschelling

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Tulip Oil's gas extraction plans near Terschelling, including CO2 content, risks to the island's freshwater supply, use of harmful substances, and how national interest is weighed against nature and water protection. The Minister answered that the CO2 share (about 14%) and the feasibility of reinjection await TNO and Energiebeheer Nederland advice, that risks to freshwater and substances will be assessed in the EIA after permit approval, and that further decisions under the national coordination regime will follow.
I first await these advices before I can address concrete quantities of gas (or CO2).
Ik wacht eerst deze adviezen af, alvorens ik kan ingaan op concrete hoeveelheden gas (of CO 2 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over mogelijke oversubsidiëring van biomassa bijstook

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the SDE+ subsidy for co-firing biomass in coal plants could over-subsidise plants that use up to 15% low-cost alternative fuels such as animal meal and pits. The minister answered that the ECN/DNV GL note shows effects within uncertainty margins, that no specific scenario was calculated for animal meal, and that the cumulative subsidy is about 3 billion euro, while not committing to notifying the 15% rule separately to the European Commission.
On the basis of the note, I therefore conclude that the use of 15% alternative fuels does not lead to over-subsidisation.
Op basis van de notitie concludeer ik dan ook dat het gebruik van 15% alternatieve brandstoffen niet leidt tot oversubsidiëring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de verkoop door RWE van gasvelden in het Britse deel van de Noordzee aan de Luxemburgse investeringsmaatschappij LetterOne van Michail Fridman

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about RWE's sale of North Sea gas fields in the UK to a Russian-linked investment company and whether the Netherlands could block it or secure gas supplies, including via a Dutch foundation. The Minister answered that the Dutch government does not share UK concerns for Dutch supply, that the Dutch state can refuse transfer of mining licences on technical, financial and conduct grounds but not on nationality, and that a Dutch foundation alone would not shield assets from EU sanctions.
Under the Mining Act my consent is required for this transfer.
Op grond van de mijnbouwwet is mijn toestemming vereist voor deze overdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tongeren over de tienjarige levensduurverlening van Doel 1 en Doel 2 in België

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Belgium's decision to extend the life of the Doel 1 and Doel 2 reactors by ten years, including whether a cross-border environmental impact assessment is required. The minister replied that the decision rests with the operator, the Belgian government and the FANC, that no MER procedure is required under Belgian rules, and that he has agreed closer cooperation with the Belgian regulator.
The choice whether or not to extend the operating life of the Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants lies with the licence holder (Electrabel), the Belgian government and the FANC.
De keuze om wel of niet de levensduur van de kerncentrales Doel 1 en Doel 2 te verlengen is aan de vergunninghouder van de kerncentrales (Electrabel), de Belgische regering en het FANC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de bestedingen van de overheid aan onderzoek en innovatie

MP Van Veen asked the government whether public spending on research and innovation is falling, what figures the Rathenau Institute relies on, which definition of innovation applies, and whether a total overview of such spending can be included in the budget. The State Secretary acknowledged a decline in public investment mainly due to earlier cuts but said levels remain relatively high, listed planned increases to NWO and Horizon 2020 matching, and declined to put the overview in the budget, pointing to the independent Rathenau publication instead.
The cabinet attaches importance to the independent institute Rathenau producing an overview that gives insight into the level of public funds of the central government for research and innovation.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat het onafhankelijk instituut Rathenau een overzicht maakt dat inzicht biedt in de hoogte van de publieke middelen van het Rijk voor onderzoek en innovatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Oosenbrug over de slechte ontvangst van TV West en TV Utrecht

MPs Mohandis and Oosenbrug asked whether the government is aware of poor reception of TV West and TV Utrecht after the channels were re-tuned, and whether this is undesirable given their emergency-broadcasting role; they also asked about frequency choice and when Ziggo will resolve it. The Secretary of State confirmed awareness, noted that the regional radio stations (not TV) are formal emergency broadcasters, said frequency management is Ziggo's responsibility, and reported that Ziggo promised to fix complaints via a free cable and technician visit, with all complaints so far resolved.
The emergency broadcaster status applies only to radio, not to television and online media.
De status van calamiteitenzender geldt alleen voor de radio, niet voor televisie en online media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het risico op aardbevingen door afvalwaterinjectie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake risks from deep wastewater injection, including the De Hoeve quake, reported leaks and incidents in Twente, and seismicity near Borgsweer in Groningen. The minister answers that injection permits account for induced seismicity, monitoring is in place, incidents were low-risk, and a 2011 evaluation is planned, while largely defending current practice.
I am currently in discussion with the province of Overijssel on this subject and it is being examined whether this evaluation can be brought forward.
Ik ben momenteel met de provincie Overijssel in gesprek over dit onderwerp en er wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheid deze evaluatie naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en De Boer over het ACM-besluit over de overtreding van de Spoorwegwet door NS

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about an ACM finding that NS breached Article 67 of the Spoorwegwet, whether NS blocked publication and threatened a damages claim over the Limburg tender, and whether ACM would publish its decision and correspondence before the Spoorwegwet debate. The State Secretary confirmed one article was breached, said NS sought interim relief and announced a possible damages claim, and declined to request publication or correspondence, citing ACM's independence and pending legal proceedings, while committing to send the answers to Parliament.
Given the independence of the ACM, it is for the ACM and possibly the court to decide on making this information public.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de ACM is het aan de ACM en eventueel de rechter om te beslissen over het openbaar maken van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over “Scheurtjes Kerncentrale Doel groter”

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether cracks in the reactor vessels of Belgian plants Doel 3 and Tihange 2 were larger than before, whether the Borssele plant had been checked with equally sensitive equipment, and whether Dutch regions had been informed. The minister confirmed larger hydrogen flakes were found after more sensitive testing, stated Borssele's 2013 tests used qualified equipment and that nuclear safety is a national responsibility, and said the plants are shut down so no new Dutch safety implications arise.
Nevertheless, the ANVS will continue to closely monitor developments in Belgium and other countries regarding hydrogen flakes.
Desondanks blijft de ANVS de ontwikkelingen in België en in andere landen omtrent waterstofvlokken nauwkeurig volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over het bericht ’Hoe een illegale windmolen blijft doordraaien’

Two MPs asked whether an illegal wind turbine that the Council of State ruled must be stopped should be enforced by the municipality, and how wind energy is sited with local residents. The minister answered that the Council of State confirmed enforcement was required but the decision now rests with the municipality, which the national government has no role in, and that participation will be anchored in the Omgevingswet.
It is up to the municipality to take a new decision. The national government has no role in this.
Het is aan de gemeente om een nieuw besluit te nemen. Het Rijk heeft hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over betere benutting van restwarmte

An MP asked the ministers whether residual heat should be used more widely to reduce gas dependence, what barriers heat suppliers face, and whether the findings of a dissertation would be incorporated. The minister agreed that residual heat can help, said the best option depends on local conditions, acknowledged remaining barriers, and promised to address the topic in a forthcoming heat vision.
In my heat vision, which I will send to your House before 1 April, I will address the possibilities for better utilising the heat potential.
In mijn warmtevisie, die ik voor 1 april a.s. naar uw Kamer zal sturen, ga ik in op de mogelijkheden om het potentieel aan warmte nog beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over multilevel marketing bedrijven

An MP asks whether the Kingdom Business/Conligus MLM advertised on Marktplaats is a pyramid scheme, whether courts or the Kansspelautoriteit have acted on such schemes, and whether MLM firms should disclose income and earnings. The government declines to judge the specific company, says it has seen no relevant rulings or enforcement, and says participants must receive complete and accurate information under the Civil Code.
It does not befit me as State Secretary of Security and Justice to give a legal judgement on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij als Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie niet een juridisch oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over de mogelijkheden voor sportverenigingen om te investeren in zonnepanelen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether sports clubs can contribute to decentralised renewable energy, whether they must pay VAT on solar power that other small consumers do not, and what fiscal incentives could make solar panels or energy saving attractive for them. The minister confirmed the VAT position under EU case law, noted that clubs can deduct input VAT only for taxable supplies, listed existing energy tax schemes, and announced a subsidy scheme for sports clubs effective 1 January 2016.
To implement this motion, I am currently drafting a subsidy scheme together with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, which will take effect on 1 January 2016.
Ter uitvoering van deze motie stel ik momenteel samen met de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport een subsidieregeling op die per 1 januari 2016 effectief zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het interview met de heer Nijpels “Windmolens moeten er toch komen”

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether claims by Nijpels, chair of the Energy Agreement guarantee commission, about wind subsidies and job creation are accurate, and why the SDE+ levy is not abolished. The Minister answers that maximum subsidy costs are about 3.5 billion euro for onshore wind to 2032 and 5.5 billion for offshore wind, that a rough estimate of about 1 billion per year is needed for new renewable projects, that the 15,000 jobs target is considered achievable, and that Nijpels' statements are his own responsibility.
The statements of Mr Nijpels are for his own account.
De uitspraken van de heer Nijpels zijn voor zijn eigen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Onderzoek nodig bij windmolens bij Medemblik’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about metal fatigue risks in Nedwind turbines after two blades were lost near Medemblik, including inspection rules and safety measures. The minister answered that the turbine type is unique in the Netherlands, that independent investigation and expanded inspections are underway, and that the Activiteitenbesluit already sets safety rules enforced by the competent authority, with possible improvements being explored with the sector.
The outcomes of these inspections and the follow-up steps will be shared with me.
De uitkomsten van deze inspecties en de vervolgstappen zullen met mij gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven over het bericht dat Valkenburg de ideale plek is voor een ‘Unmanned Valley’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Verhoeven asked the government about a report proposing Valkenburg airfield as a testing site for unmanned vehicles, and whether the land-use plan for housing, work and recreation is consistent with the government's innovation ambitions. The minister answered that the masterplan allows room for smaller drone testing but not larger drones, that a self-driving car test regulation has been sent to parliament, that the central government re-offered an alternative solution to local parties in January 2015, and declined the request for a one-week answer deadline.
In July 2014 the central government offered the solution direction mentioned in the answer to question 4 to the parties involved.
Het Rijk heeft in juli 2014 de oplossingsrichting, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 4, aangeboden aan de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en De Liefde naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘ICT-sector trekt weg’

MPs Van Veen and De Liefde asked whether ICT firms are really leaving the Netherlands, how large any shortage of ICT staff is, and what is being done about it. The Minister answered that there is no evidence of an exodus, that firm startups and closures are roughly stable, that the ICT training intake is rising, and listed programmes such as the Techniekpact and the sector plan.
I have no information showing that the ICT sector is leaving the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen informatie waaruit blijkt dat de ICT-sector wegtrekt uit Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de uitspraken van de president van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB), die twijfelt aan het realiteitsgehalte van projecten die zijn ingediend voor het Europese investerin

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether the EIB president's doubts about projects submitted to the EFSI fund are justified, whether EFSI mainly targets unprofitable investments, and whether the government will help regional provinces' investment funds access EFSI. The minister denied that EFSI mainly targets unprofitable investments, stressed projects are economically sound and assessed on merit, and said regional parties can apply and the government will play a facilitating role.
From my responsibility for the EIB, I fulfil a facilitating role in this, together with the Minister of Economic Affairs.
Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid voor de EIB vervul ik hierin een faciliterende rol, samen met de Minister van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het door de Nederlandse Kamer van Koophandel georganiseerde seminar over buitenlandse uitzendkrachten

An MP asked ministers about a seminar on importing foreign temporary agency workers for agricultural firms, promoted as 'free staff from Slovakia', and whether it fits the fight against sham constructions. The minister answered that the seminar was organised by the bilateral Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in Slovakia, not the Dutch KvK, and that the government supports the country-of-work principle and a targeted review of the posting directive.
The seminar in question was not organised by the Dutch Chamber of Commerce but by 'The Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in The Slovak Republic'.
Het genoemde seminar werd niet georganiseerd de Nederlandse Kamer van Koophandel, maar door «The Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in The Slovak Republic»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de opkomst van Apple en Google in het betalingsverkeer

MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether the uneven playing field between banks and tech firms like Apple and Google in payments, data-use rules and payment data protection should be closed. The government answered that all parties must comply with the same privacy law, that the voluntary banking code is only a further interpretation of it, and that the new EU directives and privacy regulation will add registration and risk-based duties.
All the parties mentioned, both financial institutions and other companies, must comply with the same privacy legislation.
Alle genoemde partijen, dus zowel financiële instellingen als andere bedrijven, moeten voldoen aan dezelfde privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over uraniumspeculatie bij Urenco

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about uranium speculation by Goldman Sachs stored at Urenco's Almelo site, including safety, transport permits, Euratom ownership and the planned Covra depleted uranium expansion. The minister confirmed Goldman Sachs stores UF6 there via a subsidiary, stated that speculation has no effect on safety, permits, or enriched uranium volumes, and said it is commercially confidential which other firms store uranium there.
Which companies besides Goldman Sachs store uranium on Urenco's site in Almelo, and how much they store, is commercially confidential information.
Welke bedrijven naast Goldman Sachs uranium opslaan op het terrein van Urenco in Almelo en hoeveel uranium zij daar opslaan, is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de financiële risico’s van leaseconstructies voor zonnepalen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the promised energy savings and tax benefits of a 17-year solar panel lease are guaranteed and what financial risks consumers face. The minister said he cannot assess the contract terms, reaffirmed that net metering is guaranteed until 2020, and noted that operational leases fall outside the financial supervision act while the AFM is exploring leasing risks more broadly.
I am not familiar with the contract terms of the offering party and therefore cannot make any statements about them.
Ik ben niet bekend met de contractvoorwaarden van de aanbiedende partij en kan om die reden hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Oproep tot transparantie in ontwikkeling criteria voor biomassa’ en ‘Groen paspoort van FSC verlopen’

An MP asks whether FSC timber certification has fallen short of Dutch sustainable procurement criteria since 2012, why PEFC and MTCS are excluded, and whether TPAC's independence and added value are sound, given reported conflicts of interest in developing biomass criteria. The Secretary of State answers that TPAC re-assessment of FSC is still ongoing, that PEFC was approved in 2010, that the biomass criteria process is transparent, and that TPAC's funding and future depend on EU coordination which will be reported to parliament later.
After completion of the assessment, TPAC will publish the assessment results.
Na afronding van de beoordeling maakt TPAC de toetsingsresultaten bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Zorgen om lichtere norm voor aardbevingsschade'

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether NAM's lower peak ground acceleration norm for earthquake damage repair was discussed with the ministry and the Dialoogtafel, and what the minister will do about it. The minister replies that NAM stayed within the approved framework, no consultation took place, and a revised NPR norm will be presented and explained to parliament in early February.
NAM did not lower the norms in the design of the pilot scheme and remained within the framework of the decision.
NAM heeft de normen niet verlaagd in de opzet van de pilotregeling en is binnen de kaders van het besluit gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Dit kan echt niet’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Groninger residents' case where a family with two children allegedly had been waiting two years in a replacement home, and whether NAM could reopen a valuation despite earlier commitments, and whether such cases belong before the Commission for Exceptional Cases. The minister said the family was not in a replacement home for two years but in its own home, that a temporary home became available in December, that NAM has offered options, and that individual cases are not shared for privacy reasons, while referring to the handover of claims to the CVW and the role of the ombudsman-type raadsman.
Furthermore, as Minister of Economic Affairs I want to be restrained in sharing information about individual cases, for privacy reasons.
Verder wil ik als Minister van Economische Zaken terughoudend zijn met het delen van informatie over individuele gevallen, omwille van de privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het rapport Web & Winkel

Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked Minister Kamp whether he knows the Web & Winkel report, whether a framework for assessing retail areas' future-proofness will be drawn up with provinces and municipalities, what opportunities he sees in the experience economy, and whether mobile payment terminals fail in rural areas due to lack of network coverage. The minister confirms awareness, says a framework will be considered if there is support, promises to inform parliament in Q1 2015 on the Retailagenda, and states Dutch mobile coverage is about 99% with no known widespread payment failures.
If there is sufficient support among the parties involved, including municipalities and provinces, it will be considered how to arrive at such an assessment framework.
Als hiervoor voldoende draagvlak bestaat bij de betrokken partijen, waaronder nadrukkelijk ook gemeenten en provincies, zal worden bezien hoe tot een dergelijk afwegingskader te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven de import van illegaal gekapt hout

An MP from D66 asked ministers about a report claiming 46% of wood imported into the Netherlands falls outside the EU Timber Regulation, and about steps to stop illegal wood in processed products. The state secretary disputed the 46% figure as a miscalculation (about 6% by weight, 16% by value), acknowledged a 16.8% gap for secondary products, and said the issue would be raised in the Commission's evaluation of the regulation.
In that context I will raise the problem of imports of processed products made from illegal wood, as mentioned in the Probos report, with the Commission.
Ik zal in dat kader de problematiek van de import van bewerkte producten van illegaal hout, zoals genoemd in het rapport van Probos, aan de orde stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de voor 3 februari geplande vliegshow met onbemande commerciële systemen (drones) op vliegveld Valkenburg niet door dreigt te gaan

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked whether the planned drone show at Valkenburg airfield, part of the TUSExpo 2015 event, is threatened by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf starting demolition of the runway, whether consultation took place, and why demolition begins now. The minister answers that the demolition follows a Masterplan and a contract signed in December 2013 that was widely known, that the organisers only contacted the agency on 26 January, that the agency offered alternative venues which were declined, and that the sloop proceeds under that contract.
The demolition has therefore been known for some time and has received media attention.
De sloop is hierdoor geruime tijd bekend en heeft media-aandacht genoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Ten Broeke over het artikel ‘Twentse bedrijven op weg naar Duitse grond’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report that Twente firms are moving to German land, the investment climate, land price differences with Germany, and whether officials actively recruit cross-border firms. The minister referred to an earlier letter on the Twente investment climate, gave indicative land price differences and six 2013 cases where Germany was chosen, denied an active official lobby for German firms, and explained the regional aid map.
See my letter of 20 January 2015 (Parliamentary Paper 32 637, no. 164) on the Twente investment climate and the closure of the Philips site in Emmen.
Zie mijn brief van 20 januari 2015 (Kamerstuk 32 637, nr. 164 ) over het vestigingsklimaat Twente en de sluiting van de Philips-vestiging in Emmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over schepenveilingen door de Rabobank aan de Rabobank

An SP MP asked whether Rabobank buys back its own foreclosed inland vessels through a subsidiary and whether state guarantees of up to 1 million euro per vessel create an incentive and harm skippers. The minister confirmed the practice, defended it as protecting against sales below expert floor prices, said the guarantee does not double-compensate the bank and that the skipper remains liable for the residual debt, and denied any subsidy or incentive problem.
There is therefore no double compensation paid to the bank.
Er vindt dus geen dubbele vergoeding aan de bank plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over kostenefficiënte en lastenluwe toepassing van aanbestedingsregels

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about communication between contracting authorities and bidders, over- and under-specification of tenders, SME barriers (social return, sustainability, certificates), EMVI costs, PPS for ICT and contract management under the Aanbestedingswet 2012. The minister replied that the ongoing evaluation of the Act will cover these issues, pointed to existing tools (market consultation, nota van inlichtingen, Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts, civil court) and declined to adopt a general code of conduct for now.
I do not want to anticipate this evaluation because that would risk presenting an unrepresentative picture.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op deze evaluatie omdat daarmee het risico bestaat dat er een niet representatief beeld wordt geschetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het sluiten van de Philipsvestiging te Emmen

Two MPs asked the ministers about Philips' decision to close its Emmen site and move work to Poland and Spain, including tax benefits, regional jobs support, and reshoring. The government regrets the closure but says companies must decide location on business grounds, cannot comment on individual tax matters, and will work through employer federations and reshoring initiatives.
Because of the tax confidentiality obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax affairs of individual taxpayers such as Philips.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet echter geen uitspraken doen over belastingaangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen zoals Philips.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over aanhoudende klachten over het telefoniebedrijf Pretium

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether telecom firm Pretium and KPN ignore the written-consent requirement for phone contract transfers, and whether the law or ACM oversight should change. The minister answers that the ACM independently supervises compliance and is already investigating, that the requirement protects consumers from unwanted switching rather than applying to firms losing customers, and that he does not intend to change the law.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises compliance with the written-consent requirement.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) houdt toezicht op de naleving van het schriftelijkheidsvereiste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de langetermijncontracten en gasverkoop

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the separation of low- and high-calorific gas transport, gas sold via the TTF, and why Groningen gas production was not reduced further by using nitrogen conversion capacity. The minister answered that the two gas networks are physically separate, that TTF is a virtual delivery point, that the TTF volumes cannot be split by origin, and that production caps were set to protect Loppersum and supply security, with the 2015-2016 maximum lowered to 39.4 bcm per year.
The answer to question 3 related to the total volume of low-calorific gas from the Groningen field delivered via the TTF.
Het antwoord op vraag 3 had betrekking op de totale hoeveelheid laagcalorisch gas uit het Groningenveld die via de TTF is geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius en Yücel over de medewerking van het kabinet aan het plan om de werkloosheid in Twente aan te pakken

MPs Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether the cabinet will cooperate with the Twente 'Twente Werkt' action plan against high unemployment, and referred to earlier motions on regional economic renewal and border regions. Minister Kamp replied that the ministries already participate in the plan, pointed to earlier letters, acknowledged a skills mismatch in Twente and said no substantial changes to government jobs in the region are foreseen, while leaving the specific contribution per action line to a later letter.
The ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and Economic Affairs are already actively participating in the 'Twente Werkt!' action plan.
De ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Economische Zaken werken al actief mee aan het Actieplan «Twente Werkt!.»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de veronderstellingen van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB)

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the CPB's assumptions, its quality checks, and whether wage moderation drove Dutch productivity, investment and export share. The minister replied that the CPB has multiple internal and external quality controls, that Dutch productivity and export share remained stable or high, and that wage moderation is a second-best tool against unemployment.
Many checks and balances have been built into the CPB's working method to prevent one-sided views that are not based on scientific consensus and facts.
Er zijn in de werkwijze van het CPB veel checks and balances aangebracht om het ontstaan te voorkomen van een eenzijdige, niet op wetenschappelijke consensus en op feiten gebaseerde visie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht `De Nationale Energie Verkenning van PBL en ECN`

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about press criticism of the 2014 National Energy Exploration (NEV) and its household energy bill figures, including the SDE+ levy, network costs and the fixed-cost assumptions. The minister acknowledges errors in the NEV that overstated the 2020 bill reduction (EUR 46 instead of EUR 66), says the 14% renewable target is still assumed achievable, and promises a fuller analysis in the NEV 2015.
I deeply regret the above errors in the NEV, all the more so because as a result the House could not have the correct information either.
Ik betreur de bovenstaande fouten in de NEV zeer, temeer omdat hierdoor ook uw Kamer niet over de juiste informatie kon beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat Nederlandse huishoudens vele honderden miljoenen euro’s te veel hebben betaald voor hun gas en hun energiebelasting

An MP asked whether Dutch households were overcharged for gas and energy tax for decades due to temperature-related metering errors, and whether they will be refunded retroactively. The minister denied overcharging on average, explained the 2008 study, the 2015 temperature-correction changes, and refused refunds, noting energy tax is tied to measured volumes.
On average, therefore, there is no question of amounts having been overpaid.
Gemiddeld genomen is daarom geen sprake van teveel betaalde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht "Gebrek aan MKB-krediet remt groei Nederland"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about OECD and ECB findings that limited SME credit is slowing Dutch growth and about the effects of bank capital rules. The ministers answered that weakened SME finances and lower domestic demand explain falling credit, that DNB finds banks can meet the new rules under the baseline scenario, and that further measures will be reported.
The cabinet will inform the House shortly about the effects of the accumulation of regulation on the banking sector and credit provision.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de effecten van de stapeling van regelgeving op de bancaire sector en de kredietverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat windturbineparken op zee gebakken lucht zijn

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he responded to reports that offshore wind parks yield no CO2 savings, whether subsidies should stop, and how the 50 billion euro investment figure from the Energy Agreement was derived. The minister rejected the link to combined heat and power, refused to stop offshore wind subsidies citing climate and supply security, said the 50 billion figure was an investment estimate by another person whose basis is unknown, and defended the Energy Agreement.
I am not prepared to stop subsidising offshore wind energy.
Ik ben niet bereid te stoppen met het subsidiëren van windenergie op zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken over doorverkoop van toegangsbewijzen voor concerten

MPs Monasch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about resellers selling concert tickets before official sales start, unusable tickets, and whether this amounts to internet fraud. The government answered that such resale is not per se unlawful but must be clearly disclosed, that consumers and the ACM have remedies, and that a bill criminalising professional internet non-performance is expected in 2015.
We have no insight into the nature and extent of the risk buyers face when purchasing resold entrance tickets.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de aard en omvang van het risico dat kopers lopen bij de aankoop van doorverkochte toegangskaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht over het negeren van draagvlak voor windmolens op land in de provincie Friesland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Friesland's provincial government would drop small village wind turbines in favour of large projects, whether the 530 MW target should be a maximum, and how the province's wind target and public support were weighed. The minister said wind-permitting responsibilities are shared with the province, that the national RCR process for large projects is under his regime with a 250 MW minimum for Windpark Fryslân, and that support is one factor but the province decides on smaller projects.
The framework for the decision-making is the wind energy on land structural vision (SvWOL) submitted to the States General on 31 March 2014.
Het kader voor de besluitvorming is de op 31 maart 2014 aan de Staten Generaal aangeboden structuurvisie windenergie op land (SvWOL) 2 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de berichten “Nieuwe 380 kV hoogspanningslijn: 'Aantasting leefklimaat Oosterhout” en “Oosterhout blijft zich verzetten tegen hoogspanningstracé 380kV”

An MP asked why TenneT only recently changed the planned 380 kV power line route near Oosterhout, whether residents and local officials were excluded, why information evenings were cancelled, and whether residents are still unclear about the new route. The minister explained the reliability analysis and redundancy findings, said information was delayed for safety and uncertainty reasons, and announced five new information evenings.
As indicated, this concerns postponement of the information evenings, not cancellation.
Zoals aangegeven gaat het om uitstel van de informatieavonden, niet om afstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leegte, De Liefde en Ziengs over activiteiten van netbeheerbedrijven op de markt voor laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether grid operators' commercial activity in the electric vehicle charging-point market, via subsidiary Allego, creates an unfair level playing field and whether this should be prohibited. The minister acknowledged the risk of cross-subsidy and unequal advantage, said grid operators should only perform statutory tasks in the forthcoming STROOM bill, and committed to clearer rules, transparent accounting and publication of anonymised information.
Grid operators may only carry out statutory tasks.
Netbeheerders mogen alleen wettelijke taken uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een zwaar gesubsidieerde elektrische auto bijna net zoveel fijnstof produceert als een benzinewagen

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop subsidising electric cars after a report claimed they emit almost as much fine particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether VAT and registration tax should be cut instead. Minister Kamp answered that total particulate emissions including brake and tyre wear are about a third lower for electric cars, that subsidies will be reconsidered in the Autobrief 2.0, and that the 160,000 euro-per-car figure is not recognised.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het transport via coax- en glasvezelkabel door Caiway

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked whether Caiway, taking over the Twente cable network from Ziggo from 1 January 2015, would control both transport and services and thereby block competition, and raised questions on ADSL reach, pricing, alarm services, email retention and the EU push for cable opening. The minister answered that Cogas, as network owner, is not obliged to admit other providers but has opened its network, that competition is expected on the new fibre network, that Caiway prices were aligned with Ziggo's with some service differences, and that the ACM sees no reason for investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over Nep-kortingen die misleidend zijn voor consumenten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about fake discounts that suggest a price reduction from a previous higher price that never existed, and whether named retailers engage in unfair trading practices. The minister condemned misleading discounts, said the matter is for the consumer authority ACM and the courts to judge, and noted ACM is aware of the cases.
It is not for me to judge whether in this specific case there is misleading conduct that violates legal provisions.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of in dit specifieke geval sprake is van misleiding die in strijd is met wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat TenneT een tracé voor hoogspanningskabels plotseling verlegt

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked why TenneT's planned 380kV cable route between Roosendaal and Tilburg was moved from the northern to the southern alignment and when the planning procedures would proceed. Minister Kamp answered that the northern route was dropped because four-circuit connections are unacceptable for grid security and international obligations, that the new route will be optimised with local stakeholders, and that formal procedures are expected in autumn 2017.
The new planned route must first be technically elaborated in consultation with regional parties and optimised where necessary and possible.
Het nieuwe voorgenomen tracé moet eerst in overleg met de regionale partijen technisch uitgewerkt worden en waar nodig/mogelijk worden geoptimaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht «Ministerie durft info-avonden hoogspanningsmasten Oosterhout, Zevenbergen niet aan: «Te gevaarlijk»

MP Van Veldhoven asked why the information evenings on the Zuid-West 380 kV high-voltage line in Oosterhout and Zevenbergen were cancelled, and whether the route change and the need for the line were justified. Minister Kamp answered that the evenings were postponed for public order and safety reasons, five new evenings are planned, the southern route was chosen to avoid sensitive destinations, and a Ministry report on grid quality norms was sent to the House.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over het terugvorderen van btw over gestolen elektriciteit

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a court ruling that network operators cannot recover VAT and energy tax on electricity stolen by illegal tapping, and whether this encourages theft and whether the law should change. The minister replied that VAT cannot be levied on theft under EU VAT rules, that theft remains a punishable offence, and that the VAT rules cannot be changed domestically, while recoverable costs such as the electricity price and transport remain claimable.
Within this EU framework there is no room to tax theft with VAT.
Er bestaat binnen dit EU-kader geen ruimte om diefstal wel te belasten met btw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de langetermijncontracten en gasverkoop

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about GasTerra's long-term gas export contracts, Groningen low-calorific gas volumes, TTF trading, domestic deliveries, nitrogen conversion capacity, and whether expiring long-term contracts should be extended. The minister answered with volumes and explanations, and said the State as shareholder will ensure no new long-term contracts are concluded and existing ones are not extended or increased.
It cannot be traced what share of Groningen gas is in the low-calorific gas that end users in the Netherlands receive.
Het is niet te herleiden wat het aandeel Groningengas is in het laagcalorisch gas dat eindverbruikers in Nederland ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de G20 landen dicht bij een deal zijn om de ‘Patent Box’ af te schaffen

An MP asked whether G20 countries were close to a deal to abolish patent boxes and whether the Netherlands would replace the Innovatiebox with an investment incentive for startups. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands is involved in OECD talks on a substance criterion but that abolition is not on the table, and the Innovatiebox will be kept.
The Innovatiebox is not being abolished.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het pleidooi van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om het hoofdrailnet op te splitsen

An SP MP asked whether an ACM board member's call at Mobiliteitspoort for a study into splitting the main rail network, and his public comments, were appropriate, and whether ACM can be expected to make more such political statements. Minister Kamp replied that ACM is an independent authority that may speak publicly on its supervisory tasks but is limited on policy matters, that the speech fits its powers, that an independent study found negative effects for passengers from splitting the network, and that political positions belong to the ministers.
The government is currently considering whether the procedure for the Signal document should be included in the working agreements in the 2013 ACM–ministers relationship statute.
Momenteel wordt bezien of de werkwijze rondom het Signaal een plaats zou moeten krijgen in de onderlinge werkafspraken in het Relatiestatuut ACM en ministers 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over een extra drempel die Rabobank opwerpt voor mkb-ondernemers die krediet willen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Rabobank requiring an online questionnaire for SME credit applications up to 1 million euro, reduced personal contact, and why Dutch SME credit approval rates are far lower than Germany's. The minister replied that the digital option is an added service, that no clarification from Rabobank is needed, that credit refusals reflect weaker borrower positions and weaker economic conditions, and that a 400 million euro guarantee budget and action lines are being pursued.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, this is an additional service for entrepreneurs who prefer to work digitally, and there is no contradiction with Mr Draijer's statements.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 aangegeven betreft dit een extra service voor ondernemers die liever digitaal werken en is er geen tegenspraak met de uitspraken van de heer Draijer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het adviesrapport Actal inzake de Voorjaarsrapportage regeldruk

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Actal's advice criticising the spring 2014 regulatory burden report, including omitted one-off and European compliance costs, incomplete annex entries, the unclear euro/hour reporting, and inconsistent adherence to fixed change dates. The minister rejected the claim that reporting is not solid, explained the exclusion of one-off and EU compliance costs, acknowledged a booking error to be corrected, and promised further clarity in the autumn report and a quantification effort for EU compliance costs.
This is correct and traceable to the fact that the regulatory burden effects and related increases partly fall on other ministries (SZW, BZK).
Dit is juist en terug te voeren op het feit dat de regeldrukeffecten en de bijbehorende toenames deels neerslaan bij andere departementen (SZW, BZK).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst geen btw-voordeel geeft aan bewoners die gezamenlijk zonne-energie willen betrekken

Smaling (SP) asked why cooperative neighbourhood solar projects under the postcoderoos scheme receive no VAT benefit, and whether a VAT advantage will be introduced. Staatssecretaris Wiebes replied that EU-based VAT rules offer no special regime, that such cooperatives are treated as entrepreneurs with input-VAT deduction, and that officials have discussed the matter with sector groups.
The tax authority grants no VAT benefit to projects falling under the so-called postcoderoos scheme.
De belastingdienst kent geen BTW-voordeel toe aan projecten die binnen de zogenaamde «postcoderoos-regeling» vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Cogas gooit Ziggo van de kabel, abonnees moeten naar Caiway’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would act after Cogas reportedly required Ziggo cable customers in Twente to move to Caiway, with no alternative provider on the new fibre network until 2015. The minister answered that the ACM has concluded access regulation cannot be imposed on cable networks, that the operator may freely choose providers, and that the government has no means to force greater customer choice, while noting it would welcome such an obligation if the EU framework allowed it.
I have no means to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over de verplichte overstap van Cogas-klanten van Ziggo naar Caiway

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Cogas customers being forced to switch from Ziggo to Caiway, including lost services, higher costs, email portability and whether the ACM should investigate abuse of dominance. The minister answered that Cogas is upgrading its network to fibre and Ziggo declined to provide fibre services, that Caiway offers bundles that may or may not cost more, and that the ACM sees no reason to investigate.
Enquiries with the ACM show that it sees no reason to investigate whether there is a possible infringement of Article 24 of the Competition Act.
Navraag bij de ACM leert dat zij geen aanleiding ziet voor een onderzoek naar de vraag of er sprake is van een mogelijke overtreding van artikel 24 Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de controle op Europese subsidies

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Interior about the burden of controls on EU subsidies, the risk of double enforcement, reclaiming of EU funds, and the trust principle. Minister Kamp answered that the Commission's rules differ from Dutch principles, that the government is working to balance controls and promote risk-based audits, and that it will prepare a new bill replacing the state-aid recovery bill.
