To safeguard the lawfulness of expenditure, I am of the view that there must be a good balance between the control efforts of national and European control bodies and their efficiency.

Om de rechtmatigheid van de uitgaven te borgen ben ik van mening dat er sprake moet zijn van een goede balans tussen de controle-inspanningen door de nationale en Europese controle-instanties en de doelmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat het CBP pleit voor het inhoudelijk analyseren van dataverkeer

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the data protection authority (CBP) advocated content analysis of traffic such as Deep Packet Inspection, and whether this fits privacy protection. The minister answered that the CBP only stated legal limits on retention, that analysis without prior consent may breach privacy, that subscribers may consent to analysis, and that existing apps offer alternatives, so no research into alternatives is needed.
Yes, analysing traffic data (for example via DPI) can lead to a breach of privacy, namely where no prior consent has been obtained for the analysis.
Ja, het analyseren van verkeersgegevens (bijvoorbeeld via DPI) kan leiden tot schending van privacy, namelijk in het geval er geen voorafgaande toestemming is verkregen voor het analyseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over het artikel ‘Gemalen kunnen veel energie besparen’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about press reports that pumping stations (gemalen) could save considerable energy, and whether this could help meet the 2020 efficiency target. The minister said the studies show savings potential but are too limited to confirm the 20% figure, committed to discussing bemaling with the Unie van Waterschappen, and noted that investments pay back in 7-10 years.
I am certainly willing to do that.
Ik ben daar zeker toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat NLVOW de gedragscode windenergie niet ondertekent

MPs de Vries and Mulder asked whether the government would mediate toward a joint wind energy code of conduct after NLVOW refused to sign the NWEA-led code, and whether it would make the code binding. The minister answered that a joint code is the responsibility of private parties, urged all parties to keep talking, and declined to make any code mandatory, while noting that statutory participation and planning-damage compensation exist.
I call on the parties to keep talking with each other.
Ik roep partijen op met elkaar in gesprek te blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over de tekortschietende financiering van Wageningen UR

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked whether the 2% cap on annual funding changes for Wageningen UR, set in 2001, disadvantages the institution compared with other universities, and whether the rule should be reconsidered. Minister Kamp answered that the cap avoids sharp budget fluctuations, that the rule will be included in a government review of funding for Economic Affairs and OCW education with results feeding into the 2016 budget, and that compliance with the top-income norm is monitored.

This arrangement will be included in the study the cabinet is starting into education funded by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and education funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Onderhavige regeling wordt betrokken in het onderzoek dat het kabinet start naar onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht dat de bouw van windmolenparken op zee de maatschappij 5 miljard euro schade oplevert

PVV MP Klever asks whether the government will stop offshore wind development after a report claimed it causes 5 billion euro in damage, and how it will justify subsidy spending. Minister Kamp replies that the cited figure comes from a cost-benefit analysis of inside-12-mile-zone wind parks that does not address whether offshore wind is desirable, and that offshore wind remains necessary for climate targets and supply security, so he will not stop it.
I am not willing to stop promoting offshore wind energy.
Ik ben niet bereid te stoppen met de stimulering van windenergie op zee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitvoering van de motie over een bindende doelstelling voor duurzame energie per lidstaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government had changed its instructions to the Permanent Representation in Brussels to implement a motion calling for binding national renewable energy targets per member state. The minister declined to disclose the instructions to protect negotiating position, reported that the Netherlands pushed for national breakdown at the October European Council without majority support, and that the outcome was a binding EU-wide 27% target for 2030 without national breakdown.
To safeguard the Dutch position in European negotiations, official instructions to the Permanent Representation in Brussels are not public.
Om de Nederlandse positie in Europese onderhandelingen te waarborgen zijn ambtelijke instructies aan de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over vervanging van windturbines

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether replacing wind turbines previously supported under the MEP scheme with SDE+ subsidies is desirable, and whether the subsidy design favours replacement over new build. The minister confirmed 34 replacement projects (about 56 MW, turbines on average nearly 11 years old), agreed to introduce a lower base rate for replacements and cumulation checks from 2015, and said he is willing to consider whether replacement deserves support.
For replacement of existing wind turbines, a category with a tailored base amount lower than for entirely new wind turbines will be included in the SDE+.
Voor vervanging van bestaande windturbines zal in de SDE+ een categorie worden opgenomen met een daarop toegesneden basisbedrag, dat lager is dan voor volledig nieuwe windturbines.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over de overname van Ziggo door Liberty Global (UPC)

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked the minister about the Liberty Global (UPC) takeover of Ziggo, its market effects, the EU conditions, and whether access regulation of KPN and cable networks is adequate. The minister answered that the EU Commission found no extra competition problems, that the ACM will keep regulating KPN's unbundled access, and that he will push at EU level to regulate both networks more easily.
I have asked the ACM to inform me one year after its final decision about developments in the internet, television and fixed telephony markets.
Ik heb de ACM verzocht mij een jaar na haar definitieve besluit te informeren over de ontwikkelingen in de internet-, televisie- en vaste telefoniemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Jan Vos over het in surseance verkerende staalbedrijf Nedstaal

MPs Vermeij and Jan Vos asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would engage with Nedstaal, a steel company in suspension of payments, about a scaled-down restart, press for preserving regional jobs, and ensure UWV takes extra action for dismissed workers. The minister reports ongoing contact with management, the curator and the municipality, a takeover by Andus Group preserving 200 of 280 jobs, and a regional steering group with UWV and sector support for the 80 workers losing their jobs.
Together with the sector it is being examined whether support can be offered to Nedstaal's employees from the sector plan and what that support would consist of.
Samen met de sector wordt onderzocht of er ondersteuning geboden kan worden aan de werknemers van Nedstaal vanuit het sectorplan en waaruit deze ondersteuning bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht in het FD van 1 oktober 2014:  “Nederland blijft achter met Europese subsidies”

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the low Dutch success rate (4 of 108 applications) in the first round of the EU SME instrument, and whether Dutch SMEs can benefit more. The minister confirms the figures, explains the success rate is still early to judge, and promises to examine how to better reach the target group and keep the Chamber informed.
I will keep the Chamber informed of the further approach and the results thereof.
Ik zal de Kamer op de hoogte houden van de verdere aanpak en de resultaten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het telecombedrijf Pretium en het schriftelijkheidsvereiste

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether telecom company Pretium's claim that a phone keypress satisfies the written-form requirement for telephone sales is correct, and asked for ACM to clarify and enforce the rule. The minister explained the written-form requirement's purpose and examples of compliance, said whether a keypress suffices is for ACM and courts to judge, and said ACM would publish examples on ConsuWijzer while not commenting on enforcement.
Whether a mere click on a telephone key is sufficient to satisfy the written-form requirement is not for me to assess.
Of een loutere klik op een telefoontoets voldoende is om aan het schriftelijkheidsvereiste te voldoen is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de voorgenomen fusie van ANP en Novum

MP Verhoeven asked whether the planned takeover of news agency Novum by ANP risks a monopoly, how the minister views it given earlier competition-authority precedent, and whether the ACM will be asked to investigate. The minister declined to judge individual cases, said the deal falls below the merger notification thresholds so no ACM merger review is expected, but noted the ACM could still act against cartels or abuse of dominance.
That ruling is known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over windparken op zee

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about uncertainty over offshore wind park construction, including the NWEA proposal for existing permit holders to seek subsidies, the delayed delivery of the route map, the feasibility of the Energy Agreement target, and the choice of Borssele over Hollandse Kust. The minister replies that the NWEA proposal does not speed up rollout, the route map and bill are on schedule, existing permits will not be used, and Borssele is chosen because preparations there could start earliest.
I hope for a swift treatment by the House of Representatives and the Senate.
Ik hoop op een snelle behandeling door de Tweede en Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Forse kritiek van gemeenten en provincie op NAM’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about criticism from municipalities and the province of the NAM's handling of the Groningen gas extraction accord, including the pace of reinforcing homes, the budget for new construction, consultation with the regional dialogue table, and individual information. The minister answered that the pace will be scaled up with a plan due January 2015, the budget is currently sufficient, NAM will report progress to the dialogue table, and information channels are being improved.
Thereupon I myself went to Groningen to discuss this with the Dialogue Table.
Daarop ben ik zelf naar Groningen gegaan om dit met de Dialoogtafel te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over duurzame energie in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands, including reported postponement of geothermal energy on Saba and the Sint Maarten green energy strategy. The government answered that it supports renewable investment, funds Saba and Sint Eustatius utilities for wind or solar, consulted Saba's government on geothermal, and says it does not block geothermal exploration but has no budget for multi-year losses.
Furthermore, it must be noted that the cabinet does not place any obstacle in the way of any party setting up geothermal energy in the Caribbean.
Voorts moet opgemerkt worden dat het kabinet geen enkele partij iets in de weg legt om geothermie in de Caribben op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de besteding van de opbrengsten van de veilingen van grenscapaciteit op het elektriciteitsnet

MPs Van Hijum and Agnes Mulder asked how the €664 million from cross-border capacity auctions on the electricity grid would be spent, and whether it could improve supply security in vulnerable 'uitloper' areas. The minister answered that EU rules require the proceeds to fund interconnector investments or lower network tariffs, not grid reinforcement in uitloper areas, and described the existing TenneT reinforcement programme and timelines.
Under European regulations, TenneT is obliged to use the auction proceeds for investments related to interconnector capacity or for lowering network tariffs.
Op basis van Europese regelgeving is TenneT verplicht om de veilinggelden aan te wenden voor investeringen die samenhangen met de interconnectiecapaciteit of voor verlaging van de nettarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht ‘Gaswinning. Dan krijg je dit’

An MP asked the minister about a Groningen family whose barn collapsed and who still await compensation and replacement housing four months later, plus alleged intimidation by NAM and the municipality and the use of a 620,000 euro dialogue table budget. The minister answered that responsibility for the collapse (storm damage, neglect, possible quake contribution) is still being determined by an expert firm, the insurer has paid for stolen goods, a housing offer was made and the acute housing need appears resolved, and both NAM and the municipality deny pressuring the family.
Because more cases are expected where earthquake damage is not, or not initially, identified as the main cause, I will consult with municipalities to agree a careful procedure for such cases.

Omdat voorzien wordt dat er meer gevallen zijn of zullen volgen waarbij aardbevingsschade niet, of niet als eerste instantie, als hoofdoorzaak wordt aangemerkt zal ik met gemeenten in overleg treden om in deze gevallen een zorgvuldige procedure af te spreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over het gebruik van cookies bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO)

An MP asked the minister whether the NPO's repeated use of tracking cookies without prior consent, flagged by the Dutch data protection authority, would be addressed and whether the CBP report would be sent to parliament. The minister declined to judge an independent regulator's individual decision, noted NPO has taken measures, and said websites must comply with the law without committing to concrete government action.
It is not for the cabinet to give a judgement on a decision of an independent supervisor in an individual case.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over een besluit van een onafhankelijke toezichthouder in een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het gebruik van cookies op de websites van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO)

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether public broadcaster NPO violates privacy law by placing tracking cookies without prior consent, as the Dutch data protection authority CBP found, and how this relates to a bill amending the Telecommunications Act. The minister said supervision of the Data Protection Act is for the independent CBP, and explained that the cookie presumption in the bill is sharpened so that cookies used only for analytics or without profiling are excluded.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether, in a specific case, personal data is processed in breach of the Data Protection Act.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of in een concreet geval sprake is van een verwerking van persoonsgegevens in strijd met de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Kooiman over het bericht “Tienduizenden zonder 112”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Kooiman asked whether tens of thousands of people cannot reach emergency number 112 by mobile phone, and what is being done about coverage gaps and cross-border cooperation. The minister replied that TNO and Agentschap Telecom are mapping outdoor mobile coverage for 112 (map due in December), that cost and technical options are excluded from that study, and that cross-border arrangements with Belgium and Germany already route emergency calls to the correct Dutch centre.
I am currently having research carried out into outdoor mobile coverage in relation to the accessibility of the emergency number 1-1-2.
Ik laat momenteel onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mobiele dekking buitenshuis in relatie tot de bereikbaarheid van het alarmnummer 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Snel internet verstoort kerkdienst en sport’

MP Agnes Mulder asked whether the sale of 4G frequencies disrupted wireless microphones used by churches, theatres and gyms, and whether buyers were bound by conditions and the costs to users were fair. The minister confirmed interference can occur, said alternative frequencies were found and users informed with a transition period to end 2015, and judged the problem limited based on about two monthly contacts with the Agentschap Telecom.
Based on information from Agentschap Telecom, I have the impression that the scale of the problem is limited.
Op basis van informatie van Agentschap Telecom heb ik de indruk dat de omvang van het probleem beperkt is.
Vragen van het lid Oosenbrug (PvdA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken over schending van de Cookiewetgeving (ingezonden 17 september 2014).

An MP asked the ministers whether Apple's free U2 album placed on devices complied with the cookie rules requiring user consent, whether Apple used listening statistics for profiling, and whether the regulators would be asked to investigate. The minister answered that consent under article 11.7a Telecommunicatiewet is required, that the government does not know whether Apple complied (a matter for ACM), that enforcement against foreign firms is limited, and that investigations are primarily for the regulators themselves.
The government does not know whether Apple complied with the requirements of article 11.7a in this case; it is for the regulator ACM to assess this.
Het is de regering niet bekend of Apple in dit geval aan de eisen van artikel 11.7a heeft voldaan, het is aan toezichthouder ACM om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er een aardbeving heeft plaatsgevonden bij Froombosch

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about two earthquakes near Froombosch, the historical frequency and magnitude of quakes there, whether seismicity has risen since the Loppersum well closures, and whether damage claims are being handled quickly. The minister confirmed the reports, listed seven earlier quakes above magnitude 1.5, said recent quakes show no change in seismicity, and reported about 400 related damage claims with most light cases resolved within three months.
Contact has already been made with 75% of residents, and appointments for a visit by the damage expert have been made with half of them.
Er is inmiddels met 75% van de bewoners contact geweest en met de helft zijn afspraken gemaakt voor een bezoek van de schade expert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Smaling over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Smaling and Klaver asked whether the government had properly examined using German brine instead of salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether that option was included in the environmental permit and appropriate assessment. The minister answered that German brine is economically unviable due to lower salt concentration, high transport costs and supply risks, so no renewed talks with Frisia are planned, and that the permit cannot be revoked while objection proceedings are pending.
I see no reason to question this conclusion.
Ik zie geen reden om deze conclusie in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de veranderde taakopvatting van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Statistics Netherlands (CBS) director-general's stated shift toward providing more contextual information and preventing misuse of data, and whether this is politically neutral and was agreed with the minister. The minister answered that the approach aims to reduce misinterpretation, that the choice of publication method lies with the director-general under the CBS Act, and defended the neutrality of a rent-increase press headline.
No, the manner of publishing statistics, as well as the choice of methodology, is reserved for the director-general of statistics.
Nee, de wijze van het openbaar maken van statistieken is, evenals de keuze van de gebruikte methodologie, voorbehouden aan de directeur-generaal van de statistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over groene stroom uit het buitenland

MP Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that green electricity sold in the Netherlands is largely imported, and whether consumers expect new domestic renewable capacity to be built. The minister answered that in 2013, 74% of guarantees of origin used were from abroad, pledged clearer origin labelling on electricity labels from 2015, and explained that the GvO system is EU-based and functions as intended.
For the consumer, it must be clear what they are buying when they purchase renewable electricity.
Voor de consument moet helder zijn wat hij koopt wanneer hij hernieuwbare stroom inkoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Jan Vos over hoge vastrechtkosten in de energiesector

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about high fixed connection charges (vastrecht) in the energy sector, which they said could mislead consumers, and about abolishing them, linearising tariffs and improving price transparency. The minister replied that tariff structure is left to suppliers in a free market, that fixed charges preserve consumer choice and competition so abolition would be undesirable, and that improving transparency via ACM-supervised 'Aanbod op Maat' and harmonised terminology is the preferred route.
I see making the tariff structure more transparent as the most effective way to safeguard consumer choice and to stimulate competition and market functioning in the energy sector.

Ik zie het transparanter maken van de tariefopbouw als de meest effectieve manier om de keuzevrijheid van de consument te borgen en de concurrentie en de marktwerking binnen de energiesector te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de toegang tot het glasvezelnetwerk van Reggefiber

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the timing of the ACM's review of KPN's takeover of Reggefiber, whether competitors must keep access to the fibre network, whether non-discriminatory wholesale access is sufficient, and whether the ACM could be asked to answer the questions. The minister said the ACM will decide after the European Commission's Liberty Global/Ziggo decision, that the ACM is independent and the minister cannot pre-empt its review, that current access must be non-discriminatory, and that the ministry will report on EU telecom framework changes later in the year.
The ACM is an independent administrative body (ZBO). This means it has independent tasks and powers assigned to it directly by the legislature.
De ACM is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO). Dat betekent dat zij zelfstandige taken en bevoegdheden heeft die door de wetgever direct aan haar zijn toebedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijke opslag van kernafval in zoutkoepels in Friesland en Groningen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Economic Affairs Minister about risks of storing nuclear waste in salt caverns in Friesland and Groningen, and whether such sites are excluded. The minister replied that site-specific research and site selection are not on the agenda for decades, that geological disposal is the preferred option, and that the OPERA research programme finishes in 2016.
As I indicated earlier, site-specific research or a site selection in the research and policy is not on the agenda for the coming decades.
Zoals ik eerder al aangaf is locatiespecifiek onderzoek of een locatiekeuze in het onderzoek en het beleid de komende tientallen jaren niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over de berichten ‘Werknemers pro forma tot de islam bekeerd’ en ‘werknemers bekeerd voor klus’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that Dutch workers were pro forma converted to Islam for a job in Saudi Arabia were known, and how their safety and the Saudi restrictions on non-Muslims were viewed. The minister confirmed awareness, said there were no indications the workers were at risk, declined to judge Saudi policy or the company director's stance, and said the matter would be raised in regular contacts.
The matter will be raised in the regular contacts between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands.
De kwestie zal opgebracht worden in de reguliere contacten tussen Saoedi-Arabië en Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Agnes Mulder en Wolbert over de dreigende sluiting van attractiepark De Sprookjeshof in Zuidlaren

MPs Ziengs, Agnes Mulder and Wolbert asked about the threatened closure of the De Sprookjeshof amusement park, the inconsistent certification of identical attractions by inspection bodies, and whether the government is responsible for consistent rules. The minister answered that certification rules were applied correctly, that individual inspection was required for unique slides, that operators bear primary responsibility for compliance, and that the answers could not be sent by the requested date.
On 12 September the NVWA held consultations with the CdK Drenthe, where it was agreed that the inspection body and the owner of De Sprookjeshof will again consult on measures that ensure safety.

Op 12 september heeft de NVWA met de CdK Drenthe overleg gevoerd waarbij is afgesproken dat de keuringsinstelling en de eigenaar van De Sprookjeshof opnieuw in overleg gaan over de maatregelen die de veiligheid waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kredietverlening aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ECB lending support for SMEs, the causes of weak SME credit, and whether family loans could be encouraged through a revived Tante Agaathregeling tax scheme. The ministers say the ECB's TLTRO effects are hard to estimate, attribute low SME lending mainly to falling demand and weaker borrower positions, and point to SME financing measures while staying cautious about new tax measures.
The cabinet has therefore decided to support market parties in setting up a subordinated loan fund (AGL) fund
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten marktpartijen te gaan ondersteunen bij het oprichten van een achtergestelde leningenfonds (AGL)-fonds
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Oosenbrug over het telecombedrijf Pretium en het schriftelijkheidsvereiste

MPs Mei Li Vos and Oosenbrug asked whether telecom company Pretium complies with the written-confirmation requirement for telephone sales in force since 13 June 2014, and asked the minister to ensure compliance. The minister said supervision lies with the ACM, which has informed businesses and consumers about the rules and will act against non-compliance.
It is up to her to assess whether individual companies comply with this requirement.
Het is aan haar om te beoordelen of individuele bedrijven zich aan dit vereiste houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat de lange arm van de VS bestuurders nerveus maakt

An MP asked the government about reports that the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act could hold Dutch executives liable for foreign bribery and whether the Netherlands should tackle corruption more effectively. The government answered that Dutch law and the OECD convention already criminalise foreign bribery, that the FCPA has no known link to US embargoes, and that enforcement capacity has improved through joint investigations, with a fuller policy response promised later.
For details on the follow-up to the OECD recommendations I refer to the integrated policy response promised to your House for the coming autumn.
Voor details over de opvolging van de OESO-aanbevelingen verwijs ik naar de aan uw Kamer voor aankomend najaar toegezegde integrale beleidsreactie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht

An MP asked ministers whether the ECHR ruling on inheritance tax exemptions for businesses versus individuals closed the door on claims by the Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht, and whether such foundations using false expectations for financial gain are permissible, and what ACM and the Reclame Code Commissie can do without consumer complaints. The Minister answered that the ECHR ruling is final and inadmissible, that the civil courts and ACM would judge the foundation's conduct, that no new complaints have reached ACM, and that ACM and the RCC have enforcement tools, with the RCC cautious about acting ex officio.
The Court answers the question put to it in the negative and declares the applicants inadmissible.
Het Hof beantwoordt de voorgelegde vraag ontkennend, en verklaart de verzoekers niet-ontvankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de precaire situatie wat betreft de energievoorziening in België

Smaling (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Belgium's precarious energy supply, possible Dutch help if shortages arise, gas and electricity trade with Belgium, the safety of Belgian nuclear plants near the border, and public information. Minister Kamp answered that the Belgian situation is being monitored and that interconnection capacity and cooperation are being expanded, that no nuclear incident has occurred and the FANC supervises safety, and that residents need no extra information for now.
At this moment two reactors in Doel and one reactor in Tihange are safely shut down.
Op dit moment zijn twee reactoren in Doel en één reactor in Tihange veilig afgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat recyclebaar afval wordt verbrand als gevolg van extra overheidssteun voor biomassa

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked whether SDE+ subsidies for bioenergy divert recyclable biomass and waste (A-wood, pallets, pruning wood, potato peels) away from material reuse, contrary to the circular economy goal. The minister replied that bioenergy is needed for renewable targets and cascading will be monitored, that the SDE+ uses market prices for biomass, and that the Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan and VANG programme will be evaluated or explored without committing to binding restrictions.
In my letter to the House of Representatives on cascading I indicated that a condition of government steering is that no structural displacement effects arise that obstruct high-value applications.

In mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer over cascadering heb ik aangegeven dat een randvoorwaarde bij overheidssturing is dat er geen structurele verdringingseffecten ontstaan die hoogwaardige toepassingen belemmeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Twee op de drie Nederlanders steunen windmolens’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether provinces are meeting their Energy Agreement commitments on onshore wind and whether all provincial zoning plans have been received and assessed. The minister states that most provinces meet the agreed targets, that the plans were delivered for the monitor, and that a guarantee on the 2020 target cannot be given, but promises to send the monitor and an overview to parliament.
I will send your House an up-to-date overview of the state of affairs in all provinces shortly.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn een actueel overzicht van de stand van zaken in alle provincies toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Eneco laat particulieren beleggen in zijn windpark’

MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked the ministers about a report that Eneco lets private individuals invest in its wind park, including how the AFM checks and warns about risks, whether subsidised returns of 8 to 12% are possible, what happens to investors if subsidies or electricity prices fall. The minister answered that the AFM reviews prospectuses for completeness, consistency and comprehensibility, that the 8 to 12% figures were wrongly reported, that subsidy changes affect only new parks, and that the AFM oversees advertising but no advance warning was committed.
The AFM checks whether the prospectus is complete, consistent and comprehensible.
De AFM controleert of het prospectus volledig, consistent en begrijpelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van het bericht “CPB onderzoekt gevolgen “instortend” Schiphol”

An MP asked whether the CPB is studying the economic effects of Schiphol losing its hub function and whether this affects the Lelystad expansion. The government denied any such commissioned study, explaining only that the CPB and PBL are updating long-term scenarios in which the hub position is one uncertainty, without economic effects being examined.
No. The Netherlands Bureau for Economic Policy Analysis (CPB) is not conducting research into the economic consequences of Schiphol losing its hub function, including in relation to Lelystad.
Nee. Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) doet geen onderzoek naar de economische gevolgen van het wegvallen van de hubfunctie van Schiphol, ook niet in relatie tot Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over beloningen bij netbeheerder Liander

MPs Kerstens and Jan Vos asked the ministers about reports that 34 Liander staff, including eleven large severance payments, exceeded the WNT pay norm in 2013. Minister Plasterk answered that seven top officials and 17 others exceeded the maximum, that the top officials fall under transitional law, and that the sector will be judged on the WNT, with a report to parliament by end 2014.
The number of salaries above the WNT norm at present is a consequence of the historical development of salaries in the public and semi-public sector.
Het aantal salarissen boven de WNT-norm op dit moment is een gevolg van de historische ontwikkeling van salarissen in de publieke en semipublieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Fokke over het betaalgedrag van gemeenten

Opposition MPs Öztürk and Fokke asked ministers about municipalities paying invoices late, despite the 30-day statutory term, and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the Ombudsman's findings, said a public monitor on municipal payment terms will be set up with the VNG and KING, and declined to send a circular or to suspend Municipality Fund payments.
You will be informed about this by the end of October at the latest, as promised in the aforementioned letter.
U wordt hierover uiterlijk eind oktober geïnformeerd, zoals toegezegd in voornoemde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bezorgen van pakketten op zondag door PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL's plan to deliver parcels on Sundays, which could erode the Sunday rest and bring a Sunday Act or shop-hours law into play, is lawful and what protections exist for workers and municipalities. The minister answered that the government sees no need for new rules, that the Shop Hours Act does not cover parcel delivery, that courts would decide any Sunday Act breach, and that workers' right to refuse Sunday work is protected.
No, as indicated in the answer to question 2, living and working patterns can change, as can consumer preferences.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 kunnen leef- en arbeidspatronen wijzigen, evenals consumentenvoorkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de verlening van erkenningen aan Halliburton B.V. te IJmuiden

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether issuing explosives-handling recognitions to four Halliburton B.V. staff in IJmuiden prejudges the decision on shale gas, and about the company's safety and environmental record. The minister answered that the recognitions only allow explosives use for mining activities under a licence-holder's order, that no shale gas activity will occur pending the structuure plan, and that the Explosives Act does not allow revocation or require financial security.
I am not in a position to comment on investigations and legal proceedings currently underway in another country.
Ik ben niet in een positie om uitlatingen te doen over onderzoeken en juridische procedures die momenteel gaande zijn in een andere natie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Jacobi over berichten over mogelijke opslag van kernafval onder de grond in Friesland

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether there is research into underground storage of nuclear waste in Friesland, what alternatives to final disposal exist, and when final disposal would apply. The minister answered that the OPERA bureau study on Boom clay does not identify suitable sites, that site-specific research is not on the agenda for decades, that a study of long-term options will be sent to parliament by year-end, and that waste is stored at COVRA for at least 100 years before deep disposal.
Site-specific research or a site selection is not on the agenda in the research or in policy for the coming decades.
Locatie specifiek onderzoek of een locatiekeuze is in het onderzoek én in het beleid de komende tientallen jaren niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Aandeelhouders farma belangrijker dan patiënten’

An MP asked whether pharmaceutical R&D serves health needs rather than best-selling drugs, whether financial incentives are right, whether public-funded business models should be studied, and whether industry invests enough in research relative to profits. The minister answered that drug development is primarily the industry's responsibility, that regulation also matters, that she will not commission a broad study of public-funded business models but will pursue targeted measures such as antibiotics and EU initiatives, and that she cannot judge the investment-to-profit ratio.
I am not a proponent of a broad and unqualified study into possibly more effective business models based on public financing for the entire pharmaceutical sector.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een breed en ongeclausuleerd onderzoek naar mogelijk effectievere businessmodellen op basis van publieke financiering voor de hele farmaceutische sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Elias over wie de baas is van 'de rode knop' op de afstandsbediening

MPs De Liefde and Elias (VVD) asked whether the government intends to resolve the dispute over who controls the 'red button' on TV remotes between broadcasters and cable/telecom providers, and how the legal rules differ between cable, IP-TV and over-the-top services. The State Secretary answered that the rules on must-carry obligations are technology-neutral since 1 January 2014, that the legislator cannot impose carriage obligations on specific techniques such as HbbTV, that the relevant rules will be reviewed and modernised later this year, and that carriage negotiations between providers and broadcasters are free commercial negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht «Inloggen op mijn.rvo.nl verandert»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about changes to the login method for mijn.rvo.nl, including late notice to entrepreneurs, the readiness of the new system, the transition period, the costs of eHerkenning certificates, and the consequences for those who cannot switch in time. The minister answered that eHerkenning has been in use for years, that the transition runs over six months with the old credentials phased out, that RVO does not charge subscription fees, and that the government has a responsibility to avoid unequal conditions with the private sector.
The start date of 1 July will therefore not be postponed.
De ingangsdatum van 1 juli wordt dus niet opgeschort.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Voortman over het bericht dat overheden ervoor zorgen dat langdurige werklozen en arbeidsgehandicapten een hevige concurrentiestrijd leveren aan de onderkant van de arbeidsmark

MPs Schouten and Voortman asked whether social return in public tenders disadvantages social enterprises employing people far from the labour market, and whether government will support social entrepreneurship. The government answered that social return targets only extra placements, that social and regular firms face similar obstacles, that municipalities are responsible for their own tenders, and that it has asked the SER for advice due in early 2015.
Regarding the case in the article, the municipality concerned is responsible for the tenders it issues and the social conditions it sets. I have no insight into that.

Ten aanzien van de casus in het artikel geldt dat de betreffende gemeente verantwoordelijk is voor de aanbestedingen die zij doet en de sociale voorwaarden die zij daarbij stelt. Ik heb daar geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat de grootste pensioenbeheerder van Nederland niet gaat beleggen in windmolenparken op zee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the largest Dutch pension manager's refusal to invest in offshore wind farms, and the need for subsidies on wind turbines, and whether drilling for shale gas should start soon. The minister acknowledged the news, deferred the pension fund's return criteria to the fund, kept offshore wind subsidies under the Energy Agreement, and refused to start shale gas drilling until pending studies and a structure vision are completed.
As I indicated in the consultation with your House on 5 June, I first want to await all announced studies.
Zoals ik in het overleg met uw Kamer op 5 juni heb aangegeven wil ik eerst alle aangekondigde onderzoeken afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Leegte over de brandstoffenmix

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about double-counting of CO2 emissions in well-to-wheel calculations of fuel mixes, and whether a future vision process could be independently reviewed. The state secretary answered that electricity generation and refining are equivalent in double-counting terms, gave a table comparing electric and combustion vehicles, and said the vision process is open to stakeholders, reviewed, and will become a recurring three-yearly exercise under new EU rules.
There is no fundamental difference between electricity generation and refining when it comes to double counting in the well-to-wheel emissions calculation.
Er is geen principieel verschil tussen elektriciteitsopwekking en raffinage als het gaat om dubbeltelling in de berekening van well-to-wheel emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «Essent start bouw Windpark Zuidwester», waarin RWE aankondigt dat zijn deelpark in 2017 in bedrijf zal worden gesteld

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the RWE wind park Zuidwester, delayed to 2017, would lose its SDE+ subsidy, and why an exception was being made for RWE. The minister answered that the subsidy is reduced pro rata rather than withdrawn, that the park still contributes to the renewable energy target, and that no exceptions are made for RWE.
No exceptions are made for RWE, see also the answers to questions 5 and 6.
Er worden geen uitzonderingen gemaakt voor RWE, zie ook het antwoord op de vragen 5 en 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het 380 kV hoogspanningstracé Borssele – Rilland

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about the urgency, necessity and routing of the 380 kV Borssele–Rilland power line, including links to offshore wind, health concerns and alternative routes. The government answered that capacity is needed given grid overload and interconnection plans, that the project is not being rushed but split procedurally, and that the health precautionary policy and buy-out scheme apply, with alternatives assessed in the environmental procedure.
There is no question of accelerated realisation of the Borssele-Rilland route.
Er is geen sprake van een versnelde realisatie van het traject Borssele-Rilland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het bericht dat ontbreken GSM dekking levens kan kosten

MPs from the CDA asked the government about a reported death in Lattrop where AED alerts did not arrive, whether mobile coverage gaps endanger lives, and whether providers meet licence coverage obligations. The Minister replied that the network functioned properly, that 100% coverage is not achievable, that alternative emergency routes are advised, and that no coverage requirements exist in current frequency licences, with a ministry study on mobile coverage and 112 announced.
I do not have such information available.
Dergelijke informatie heb ik niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het ontbreken van democratische controle op de kosten van het Energieakkoord

PVV MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that the Energieakkoord lacks a carefully substantiated cost calculation and asked for an overview of direct and indirect costs, including tax revenue loss and private damage. Minister Kamp rejects the claim that the calculation is missing, points to the PBL and ECN analyses and promised annual energy projections (NEV) from October 2014, but did not provide the requested overview.
Are you willing to send the Chamber an overview of all costs arising from the Energy Agreement?
Bent u bereid om alsnog een overzicht van alle uit het Energieakkoord voortvloeiende kosten naar de Kamer te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Ouwehand over schaliegasboringen Argentinië

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie and PvdD asked the government about Shell's shale gas test drilling in Argentina, including proximity to a protected area, environmental information access, consultation and compensation for local farmers, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the drilling lies outside the current protected area, that Shell claims legal compliance and denies harm to livestock, that the embassy's 2013 site visit was routine economic diplomacy, and that OECD guideline questions fall to the National Contact Point.
Whether and to what extent the Environment and Information Disclosure chapters apply to Shell's activities in Vaca Muerta, I cannot assess.
Of en in hoeverre de hoofdstukken Milieu en Informatieverstrekking van toepassing zijn op de activiteiten van Shell in Vaca Muerta, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de regeldruk in de kappersbranche en andere bedrijven in de ambachtseconomie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about administrative burden in the hairdressing and craft sectors, including survey findings that regulation costs 5 to 8 percent of salon costs, and what the government would do about it. The minister acknowledged the burden, committed to discussing it with the branch association and reviewing the Bedrijfseffectentoets, and gave an overview of craft-sector data and support measures without committing to a dedicated new priority.
The cabinet sees reason in the above to discuss the underlying report with ANKO and to examine whether, and if so how, administrative burden in the hairdressing sector can be (noticeably) reduced.

Het kabinet ziet in het bovenstaande aanleiding om met ANKO over het onderliggende rapport in gesprek te gaan en te bekijken of en zo ja, op welke wijze de regeldruk in de kappersbranche (merkbaar) kan worden verminderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over verlaging van RVOB-grondtarieven

An MP asked why the government lowered the SDE+ land compensation for wind on land, whether RVOB's land rates are above market and how they compare with coal and biomass plants. The minister confirmed the reduction to limit price-raising effects on land, stated RVOB sits at the low end of market-conform prices, and said land pricing is primarily RVOB's responsibility.
I am in principle not involved in land transactions.
Ik ben in beginsel niet bij grondtransacties betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Hamer over de berichten 'Aardschokken ook een kans' en 'Laat het werk niet weglopen'

MPs Van Dekken, Nijboer and Hamer asked about reports that small Groningen builders are losing repair work to large firms, the labour needed for earthquake-damage repair, and the new facilities company 'Groningen versterkt'. Minister Kamp answered that homeowners freely choose contractors, expects a positive economic impulse, notes labour estimates vary pending the executing organisation, and cannot yet assess the initiative because the framework is not yet set.
However, I cannot currently confirm that these numbers of construction workers are needed.
Ik kan echter op dit moment niet bevestigen dat deze aantallen bouwvakkers nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over afvalopslag in zoutholtes

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about plans to stabilise salt caverns in Twente by filling them with waste-based material, covering applicable law, consultation with authorities and residents, leakage risks, liability, alternatives and whether sinkholes are guaranteed to be prevented. The government answered that several laws apply, that a risk assessment and risk management plan are still pending and will be reviewed by supervisory bodies before a decision, and that the mining company is liable for damage.
State Supervision of Mines, TNO and the Technical Committee on Soil Movement assess the storage plan before I make a decision.
Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen, TNO en de Technische Commissie Bodembeweging beoordelen het opslagplan alvorens ik een beluit neem.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de brief over windenergie van de provincie Gelderland, die o.a. aan de gemeente Ermelo is gestuurd, waarin staat dat voor fossiele energie jaarlijks 5,8 miljard euro subsidie wo

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Gelderland province letter stating that EUR 5.8 billion per year is spent on fossil energy subsidies, and whether the province should correct it. The minister answers that the figure is incorrect, lists the excise exemptions and degressive energy tax structure as the items at issue, and states that these answers serve as the correction.
The passage in which the province of Gelderland states that EUR 5.8 billion in subsidies is granted annually to fossil energy is not correct.
De passage waarin de provincie Gelderland aangeeft dat jaarlijks 5,8 miljard euro subsidie wordt verstrekt aan fossiele energie is niet correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over ingestorte boerderij Bedum’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the collapse of a barn in Bedum, the evacuation of residents, why NAM and the municipality would not explain the cause, and how information on earthquake damage in the area is provided. The minister answered that the municipality commissioned an independent investigation into the cause, that residents were advised to leave on fire brigade advice, that several earlier evacuations were due to combined factors, and that information is shared via official consultations, the Dialoogtafel and NAM communications.
Because there was no clarity about the causes of the collapse at that time, the letter and press release did not go into possible causes, also to prevent speculation.
Omdat er toen geen duidelijkheid was over de oorzaken van de instorting is – ook om speculatie te voorkomen – in de brief en het persbericht niet nader ingegaan op mogelijke oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eerste schip met teerzandolie volgende week in Europa aankomt

MPs Van Veldhoven and Dik-Faber asked whether the first shipment of Canadian tar sands oil reaching Europe would reach the Netherlands, whether consumers could choose non-tar-sands fuel, and how this fits EU climate policy. The minister replied that the government has no insight into individual oil transactions or origin data, that mandatory origin labelling is not required internationally, and that the Fuel Quality Directive rules on crude sourcing will be discussed once the Commission proposal is out.
The Dutch government also does not hold data on the place of purchase and origin of oil.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt ook niet over gegevens over plaats van aankoop en herkomst van olie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Jan Vos over de dubbeltellingregeling voor betere biobrandstoffen

MPs Bisschop and Jan Vos asked the government about the Corbey Commission's advice to simplify the double-counting scheme for advanced biofuels, including abolishing partial double counting, and about the lack of a level playing field in the EU. The Secretary of State agreed to adopt the advice on removing partial double counting using a 70/30% threshold, to be implemented by the NEa by year-end, and offered affected parties a choice about existing decisions.
I adopt this part of the advice and will swiftly amend the regulations accordingly.
Ik neem dit gedeelte van het advies over en pas de regelgeving daarop snel aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht dat een kwart van het winkeloppervlak in de toekomst leegstaand en kansloos zal zijn

An MP asked the ministers whether the projected 25 percent reduction in retail floor space and rising shop vacancy warrant government intervention, including convening stakeholders and new regulation. The minister answered that shop vacancy is a market-driven, structural issue best handled through regional tailor-made agreements via the Winkeltop, and that existing instruments suffice, with a PBL analysis due in autumn.
For now I choose to actively facilitate the efforts from the Winkeltop to stimulate regional parties to reach tailor-made solutions
Ik kies er vooralsnog voor om de inzet vanuit de Winkeltop, om regionale partijen te stimuleren om te komen tot maatwerkoplossingen, actief te faciliteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Nijboer over de berichten ‘Mobiliteitscentrum schiet tekort’ en ‘Er zijn juist heel heldere afspraken gemaakt’

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Nijboer asked about former Aldel workers at the Delfzijl mobility centre who complain about limited training options, UWV rules, sanctions, age discrimination and sick workers' access to the training fund. The minister answers that training is tailored, the EUR 2,500 cap was agreed as an average, 70 of 340 candidates have found work, and the government sees no evidence of targeted exclusion.
It was agreed that the amount of EUR 2,500 is used as an average available amount for training per candidate rather than as a maximum amount.
Hierbij is afgesproken dat het bedrag van € 2.500 als een gemiddeld beschikbaar bedrag voor scholing per kandidaat wordt gehanteerd in plaats van als maximum bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de situatie bij NRG Petten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the financial distress of NRG Petten, the status of a bridging credit, the future of the planned Pallas reactor and its business case, ECN's role, and economic impact of a possible bankruptcy. The minister said the credit request is under study with a positive stance under strict conditions, decision expected in summer, Pallas is run by an independent foundation with a planning phase of at least four years, and declined to speculate on a bankruptcy that has not occurred.
The credit request is currently being studied.
Het kredietverzoek wordt op dit moment bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li  Vos en Hamer over het bericht "TNT bespreekt reorganisatie pakketdienst"

Two MPs asked ministers about TNT Express's plan to replace permanent drivers and parcel couriers with subcontractors, and whether this constitutes bogus self-employment and whether the Tax Authority should refuse VAR declarations. The minister answered that such replacement is undesirable if used to evade employment protection, that UWV will judge any dismissals, that the Tax Authority cannot verify VAR applications by former employees, and that the Inspectorate SZW's sector exploration is being followed up with planned talks with the sector.
If employees in permanent employment are replaced by self-employed contractors in order to cut costs, that is extremely undesirable.
Als werknemers in vaste dienst worden vervangen door zzp’ers om op die manier de kosten te drukken, dan is dat uiterst onwenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Agnes Mulder en Geurts over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onde

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Geurts asked about an oil leak from strategic oil storage in salt caverns at Amtsvenn in Germany and about planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, including risks to the Netherlands and whether operations should wait. The minister replied that the leak likely lies in a borehole casing, that Dutch risks are considered low, that the Enschede design differs and is monitored, that the regulator SodM can intervene, and that AkzoNobel may proceed with preparatory work but has said it will not store diesel until the German cause is clear.
If at any point I see a need to intervene, I can, under article 50 of the Mining Act, prescribe measures in cases of serious harm to safety or the environment or ground movement.

Indien ik op enig moment noodzaak zie tot ingrijpen, kan ik op grond van artikel 50 van de Mijnbouwwet, in gevallen van ernstige aantasting van de bescherming van de veiligheid, het milieu of in gevallen van beweging van de aardbodem, maatregelen voorschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de sanering van het vervuilde terrein van Thermphos in Vlissingen

MP Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the best solution for cleaning up the contaminated Thermphos site in Vlissingen, the responsibility of Zeeland province and Zeeland Seaports, and the European Commission's refusal of funding, and whether national funds could co-finance the clean-up. The minister answered that a deal between the curators, Zeeland Seaports and the province is preferred, that the province and port are responsible as landowner and permit authority, that no EU funding is available, and that no national funds will be provided.
As Minister of Economic Affairs, I am not the appropriate person to form a judgment on the financial position and capacity of the province of Zeeland and Zeeland Seaports.
Ik ben als Minister van Economische Zaken niet de aangewezen persoon om een oordeel te vormen over de financiële positie en draagkracht van de provincie Zeeland en Zeeland Seaports.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (Duitsland, bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onder Ensche

An MP from D66 asked about liability for oil leaks in nature areas, the location and subsurface suitability of planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, alternatives, and risks by substance. The minister answered that the permit holder would be liable, that the planned storage is near several nature and drinking water areas, and that underground storage was chosen for cost, safety and strategic reasons.
Under the Civil Code article 175 and 177, the permit holder is liable for damage to nature and the living environment if oil leaks in nature areas were to occur in the Netherlands.

Op grond van het Burgerlijk Wetboek 6, artikel 175 en artikel 177, is de vergunninghouder aansprakelijk voor schade aan natuur en leefomgeving indien olielekkages in natuurgebieden zich in Nederland voor zouden doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Zoektocht naar olielek in Duitse Amtsvenn bij Enschede ook tijdens Pasen’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether an oil leak from a salt cavern in Germany near Enschede undermines the safety of the planned diesel storage there, whether further soil-safety research is needed, and whether the AkzoNobel permit should be suspended. The minister replied that the Dutch storage permitting and SodM supervision are adequate, no extra research is needed, the permit will not be suspended, and SodM and the ministry are monitoring the German situation.
At this moment I also see no reason to halt AkzoNobel's preparatory work or to revoke the permits.
Ik zie op dit moment ook geen aanleiding om de voorbereidende werkzaamheden van AkzoNobel stil te leggen of de vergunningen in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Hamer over het bericht dat de grenzen wagenwijd open staan voor buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Monasch and Hamer asked whether German administrative requirements imposed on Dutch construction firms, such as prior registration of workers and posting of deposits, conflict with EU free movement and whether Dutch SMEs can be protected, including via a LIMOSA-type register. The minister replied that host-state rules must be necessary and proportionate, that the government will push for reduction of disproportionate requirements, and that a registration system and identity passes are being considered in implementing the new enforcement directive.
The Netherlands is currently examining which control measures it wishes to adopt and will make a proposal for this when implementing the Enforcement Directive.
Nederland beziet thans welke controlemaatregelen zij wenst over te nemen en zal hiervoor een voorstel doen bij de implementatie van de Handhavingsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven naar aanleiding van het bericht van 28 april 2014 dat de alternatieve taxidienst Uber wordt verboden in Brussel en Berlijn

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked whether Dutch law accommodates innovative platforms such as Uber and Airbnb, after bans in Brussels and Berlin. The minister answered that existing taxi rules pose no obstacles to intermediaries like Uber, that the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act will be evaluated in autumn 2014, and that the German and Belgian rulings do not affect EU internal market policy.
In autumn 2014 the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act 2000 will be evaluated.
In het najaar van 2014 wordt het taxideel van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over het gebruik van open standaarden bij de doventolkdienst KPN Teletolk

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether new providers of Total Conversation software have entered the Dutch market for KPN Teletolk and whether KPN complies with open standards and the Telecommunications Act. The minister replied that no new providers have entered yet, that KPN is still resolving interoperability issues with some vendors, and that complaints can be brought to the regulator ACM, with a resolution expected within six months.
KPN thereby complies with the requirements set by the Telecommunications Act.
KPN voldoet daarmee aan de eisen die de Telecommunicatiewet stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat Shell, Unilever en Philips de politiek oproepen het innovatiebeleid te moderniseren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a call by CEOs of Shell, Unilever, Philips and others to align science and innovation policy with societal themes such as ageing and greening, and about concrete proposals and the forthcoming science vision. The minister answered that the government already links the top-sector policy to societal challenges, welcomed several CTO proposals as interesting, and committed to a workshop with business, science and government and to take the input into the science vision due around summer.
To that end, together with the ministers of Education, Culture and Science, I will contact the authors of the letter in the short term.
Ik zal daartoe samen met de bewindslieden van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap op korte termijn contact opnemen met de opstellers van de brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over Aalt Dijkhuizen als boegbeeld van de topsector Agri&Food

MPs Van Gerven and Smaling asked why former Wageningen UR executive Aalt Dijkhuizen was chosen as figurehead of the Agri&Food top sector, given his public opposition to organic farming, and how the biological sector's share of funding and the 2013 amendment were implemented. The minister answered that he was chosen for his sector knowledge and networks, that his remarks were personal, that the sector's budget and amendment implementation are described in earlier letters, and that no second figurehead is needed.
Mr Dijkhuizen's statements were made in a personal capacity, and he indicated that he is absolutely not an opponent of the organic sector.
De uitspraken van de heer Dijkhuizen zijn op persoonlijke titel gemaakt, waarbij hij heeft aangegeven dat hij absoluut geen tegenstander van de biologische sector is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de komst van een schip met Noordpoololie naar Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would act to stop a tanker of Arctic (Northern Pole) oil bound for Rotterdam, including lobbying EU ministers for an import ban, and whether his planned Yamal visit had a purpose. The minister confirmed the report, pointed to his letter on the Arctic balance, said no legal basis exists to block unloading and refining, and took no further action.
I will not take any further action on this point.
Ik zal op dit punt geen verdere actie ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «NAM ontruimt huis Lageland na bevingsschade»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why a house in Lageland was emptied after earthquake damage, how many homes are bought out, the criteria, whether owners are fully compensated, and whether NAM should publish which homes it buys. The minister explained the house was evacuated for safety, described the compensation schemes including a value-loss scheme, declined to publish buyout details citing privacy, and rejected a generic buyout scheme in favour of reinforcing homes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat lokale groene energie niet goed van de grond komt

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the reduced energy tax rate for local energy projects, in force since 1 January 2014, is inadequate because almost no projects have been realised, and whether uncertainty over net metering and the Vos motion has slowed them. The minister answered that no permits had yet been issued, that realising sustainable projects takes time, and that the Vos motion concerns only behind-the-meter generation, so it is unrelated to local projects.
This does not mean, however, that the conclusion must be drawn that the scheme in its current form is not adequate.
Dit betekent echter niet dat de conclusie moet worden getrokken dat de regeling in de huidige vorm niet toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid van 112 in het grensgebied

Two PvdA MPs asked whether mobile 112 emergency calls work reliably in border regions and whether full mobile coverage is required. The Minister acknowledges coverage complaints, says the extent is unknown and under study, explains that 112 calls are routed across networks, and rejects coverage requirements in licences while advising residents to use landlines and promising ongoing communication.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs is researching the scope of mobile coverage.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken doet onderzoek naar de reikwijdte van de mobiele dekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de overname van BEB door Gasunie

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Finance Ministry knew of the regulatory risks behind a 1.5 billion euro write-down on the BEB/Gasunie acquisition and whether the 2005 Gasunie share purchase overpaid. The minister answered that Finance was aware regulatory risk was important but judged its materialisation very unlikely, that the earlier denial was incorrect, and that the 2005 price was a negotiated outcome not an overpayment.
The Ministry of Finance was aware at the time of the acquisition that regulatory risk was an important risk.
Het Ministerie van Financiën was ten tijde van de overname op de hoogte van het feit dat het reguleringsrisico een belangrijk risico was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de mogelijke postcodediscriminatie bij energiebedrijf Oxxio

Two MPs asked the ministers whether energy company Oxxio's creditworthiness checks and deposit demands amount to postcode discrimination under the Equal Treatment Act, and whether the minister would act against Oxxio or other energy firms. The minister replied that Oxxio does not decide on postcode alone, that the postcode plays only a limited role, that no direct discrimination was found, and that the ACM and the Equal Treatment bodies are the proper channels, so no further steps were planned.
Oxxio states that no increased risk is established on the basis of the postcode alone.
Oxxio geeft aan dat er geen verhoogd risico vastgesteld wordt op basis van enkel de postcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘gaswinning zorgt opnieuw voor een conflict tussen provincie en het Rijk’

MPs Jacobi, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the national government requires water boards to pay half the cost of strengthening dikes in Groningen because of gas-field economic interests, and how the government will limit gas-extraction harm and fund dike reinforcement. The minister denies any such demand, describes the standard 50/40/10 cost split under the flood protection programme and a separate 100 million euro fund for earthquake-proofing vital infrastructure, and says talks with water boards are ongoing.

There is, however, no requirement from the central government that the water board pay half the costs of dikes that receive a stricter standard because of the economic importance of the gas locations and therefore need to be strengthened.

Er is echter geen sprake van een eis van het Rijk dat het waterschap de helft van de kosten betaalt voor dijken die vanwege het economisch belang van de gaslocaties een strengere norm krijgen en daardoor versterkt zouden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Leegte over het visietraject duurzame brandstoffenmix

MPs Dijkstra and Leegte asked about a working group on a sustainable fuel mix, the tank-to-wheel versus well-to-wheel CO2 accounting, consumer choice, environmental effects of batteries, and whether the chair of the gas-vehicle table, linked to a company with gas interests, could guarantee an objective outcome. The government answered that the process is broad and multi-stakeholder, that the vision and an action plan with cost-benefit analysis will follow, and that stakeholder diversity ensures objectivity.
I will send the vision to your House after the summer.
Ik zal de visie na de zomer aan uw Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het belastingregime voor lokale energiecoöperaties

An MP asked whether the tax regime for local energy cooperatives creates VAT, energy-tax and network-cost obstacles for member participation and business cases. The minister answered that the reduced energy-tax rate is a stimulus, that VAT liability depends on facts and circumstances, and that the 10-year investment guarantee will not be extended.
I am not willing to extend the 10-year period.
Ik ben niet bereid de periode van 10 jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over nationale subsidies voor hernieuwbare energie

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the implications of an Advocate-General's opinion in the Ålands Vindkraft case for national renewable energy subsidies (SDE+), including cross-border import of electricity and Guarantees of Origin. The minister answered that a Court ruling endorsing the opinion would require amending the EU renewables directive, that cross-border cooperation mechanisms are being studied with a letter due in autumn 2014, and that an EU-wide consumption-based system is not currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to advocate for such a system.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om te pleiten voor een dergelijk systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “scheepswerf Peters in Kampen vraagt faillissement aan”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the bankruptcy of shipyard Peters in Kampen, including whether a guarantee application under the shipbuilding finance guarantee scheme was rejected and how many guarantees had been granted. The minister confirmed the bank withdrew its offer after no sound post-delivery financing was arranged, that EZ/RVO did not grant a guarantee, that €44 million in guarantees were approved in 2013, and that the curator will assess options while UWV handles job placement for affected workers.
Early 2014 RVO received a request from the bank to agree to a changed financing structure.
Begin 2014 ontving RVO een verzoek van de bank om in te stemmen met een gewijzigde financieringsopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het opnemen van de Structuurvisie Schaliegas in de Structuurvisie Ondergrond

Two MPs asked whether the Structuurvisie Schaliegas will be integrated into the Structuurvisie Ondergrond, whether test drilling should wait for that integrated assessment, whether the role of shale gas and need-and-necessity questions will be addressed before legal changes, and whether drinking water and geothermal energy will get priority over shale gas drilling. The minister answered that the shale gas vision will be fully integrated, that mining companies agreed to undertake no activities until it is adopted, that CE Delft is studying costs and benefits with the planMER, and that functions get no absolute priority, with scarcity-linked functions possibly favoured.
As you know, I have agreed with the mining companies that no activities will be undertaken until the Structuurvisie Schaliegas has been adopted.
Zoals u weet heb ik met de mijnbouwondernemingen afgesproken dat totdat de Structuurvisie Schaliegas is vastgesteld er geen activiteiten worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Aukje de Vries over crowdfunding

MPs Lucas and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about crowdfunding: the platforms licensed or exempted by the AFM, the difference between licences and exemptions, legal certainty, barriers, EU rules, investor caps and the scope for equity crowdfunding. The minister answered at length, describing the AFM regime, the planned review of the supervisory framework, and monitoring, while stating that current caps and rules stay in place for now.
I intend, together with the AFM, DNB and EZ, to re-examine the current supervisory framework for crowdfunding and to investigate whether the current regulation can be better tailored to crowdfunding.

Ik ben daarnaast voornemens om, in samenwerking met de AFM, DNB en EZ, het huidige toezichtkader voor crowdfunding opnieuw onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken of de huidige regelgeving nog beter op crowdfunding kan worden toegesneden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over de bouw van cavernen in De Duitse Dollard

SP MPs Van Gerven and Paulus Jansen asked whether brine from salt caverns in Jemgum (Germany) could be used by Frisia Zout BV instead of dumping it, and whether this would be more environmentally friendly than mining salt under the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that the German brine appears technically suitable but transport costs make it commercially unviable for now, that environmental effects of the dumping are considered negligible, and that Frisia's Wadden Sea permit application is still under review.
I do not consider it self-evident that salt extraction under the Wadden Sea can take place.
Ik vind het niet vanzelfsprekend dat zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over wifi- en bluetooth tracking

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about wifi and bluetooth tracking of shoppers and passers-by under the Dutch data protection act, including how the legitimate-interest balancing test works, whether data subjects are informed, and whether iOS users are told when bluetooth is re-enabled. The state secretary answered that the controller must balance its interests against privacy, that the data protection regulator (CBP) holds that public-space tracking weighs more heavily toward individuals, that no legal duty exists to notify iOS users, and that device privacy settings are primarily the user's responsibility.
The College states that in the case of wifi tracking on the public road, article 8 of the Personal Data Protection Act applies, in particular subsections a and f.
Het College geeft aan dat in het geval van wifi-tracking op de openbare weg, artikel 8 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens van toepassing is, in het bijzonder onderdeel a en f.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘Netbeheerder Alliander wil hoger loon topman dan nu is toegestaan’

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether grid operator Alliander, which falls under the WNT pay cap, should be exempt, why state-owned TenneT and Gasunie are outside the WNT, and whether Alliander's German expansion is a loophole. The minister replied that Alliander remains under the WNT, that the draft bill keeps regional grid operators covered, that state holdings follow a separate pay framework, and that international activity is not a loophole.
Alliander falls under the WNT. As a result, it is not permitted to offer a salary above the WNT pay maximum.
Alliander valt onder de WNT. Daardoor is het niet toegestaan om een bezoldiging boven het bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over avonturen van netbeheerders

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Dutch regional grid operators' foreign expansion, such as Alliander's bid for a Berlin gas network, risks Dutch consumers and shareholders and whether the state should intervene.
