The minister answers that foreign activities are not automatically prohibited but require careful assessment by the public shareholders, that Dutch tariffs must not bear foreign losses, and that he sees no reason to intervene while legal requirements are met.
As long as the legal requirements for good grid management in the Netherlands are met, I see no reason to intervene.
Zolang er wordt voldaan aan de wettelijke eisen voor goed netbeheer in Nederland zie ik geen aanleiding om in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Kuiken over het besluit van Philip Morris om 90% van het personeel van haar fabriek in Bergen op Zoom te ontslaan

Two MPs asked ministers how they judge Philip Morris's plan to dismiss 90% of its Bergen op Zoom workforce, whether they will act quickly, and whether reshoring and a mobility centre are being pursued. The minister answered that the decision is a commercial one, that the ministry has contacted the firm, that a mobility centre financed by Philip Morris is being prepared, and that a regional economic strengthening plan and a study of reshoring will follow.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Nederlandse websites massaal privacywetgeving schenden door het ongevraagd plaatsen van tracking cookies

MP Gesthuizen asked whether enforcement of privacy law is failing given reports that many Dutch websites place tracking cookies before consent, and how enforcement will be improved. The government answered that the ACM and CBP are pursuing lasting behaviour change rather than fines (none imposed yet), that market transparency is recognised as a problem, and that existing law is adequate, with no tightening planned.
For enforcement it is important that the supervisory authorities act in such a way that lasting behavioural change occurs among companies to which the law applies.
Voor de handhaving is belangrijk dat de toezichthouders zo optreden dat het komt tot een blijvende gedragsverandering bij bedrijven waarop de wet van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over het bericht ‘Hoe een Amerikaanse zakenman miljoenen verdiende aan het failliete Aldel’

MPs Mulder and Geurts asked the Economics Minister to reflect on press reports that US businessman Klesch profited from the bankrupt Aldel, including dividends, management fees, pledges over assets and a possible 14 million euro gain, and on state and provincial support given to Aldel. The minister said curators' final report is awaited before the figures can be confirmed, listed the support given (including a provincial bridging loan with conditions) and said the provincial loan was secured on expected ETS compensation, while no pre-verification of the pledges was known at the time.
Curators are currently investigating Aldel. The date for delivery of the curators' final report is not yet known.
Momenteel doen curatoren onderzoek naar Aldel. De datum van oplevering van het eindverslag van de curatoren is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de nieuwe regels omtrent aanbesteden en het bevorderen van het samen met het bedrijfsleven opstellen van algemene inkoopvoorwaarden

MP Ziengs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the motion on co-drafting general procurement terms with business is being implemented, whether central and local governments involve business in drafting them, and what is being done. The minister replied that the state general terms were revised with business consultation, a periodic consultation with business associations has started, and the VNG's model terms were drafted with a stakeholder advisory group, with alternative clauses offered where consensus was lacking.
Furthermore, business will be closely involved at the end of next year in the planned evaluation of the ARIV 2014 and ARVODI 2014.
Voorts zal het bedrijfsleven eind volgend jaar nauw worden betrokken bij de voorgenomen evaluatie van de ARIV 2014 en de ARVODI 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Dutch telecom and data-protection rules, including the opt-in cookie provision, apply to data Samsung collects from smart TVs, and whether new rules are needed. The government answered that existing law is adequate, that opt-in consent already applies, that compliance is for the independent regulators ACM and CBP to assess, and that it will bring the case to their attention.
Whether Samsung complies with this provision is not for me to assess, but for the two independent regulators, the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the Data Protection Authority (CBP).

Of Samsung deze bepaling naleeft staat niet ter beoordeling aan mij, maar aan beide onafhankelijke toezichthouders, Autoriteit consument en markt (ACM) en het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de integriteit van het management van Typhoon Capital over het boek Windhandel en aanvullende vragen over de gevolgen van het onderzoek dat de curatoren van het failliete Econce

An MP asks the minister whether the management of Typhoon Capital, largely former Econcern managers, is beyond doubt on integrity given the book Windhandel and the curators' bankruptcy report, and whether a Bibob integrity check was done before a 4.5 billion euro subsidy. The minister declines to judge integrity from a book, notes curators and the rechter-commissaris handle such matters, and refuses to request a Bibob advice because the subsidies went to ZeeEnergie CV and Buitengaats CV, not to Typhoon's managers.
If not, why not? Answer 5: No, I am not willing to still invoke the Bibob act to check the management of Typhoon.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 5 Nee, ik ben niet bereid om alsnog een beroep op de wet Bibob te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de gevolgen van het onderzoek dat de curatoren van het failliete Econcern hebben uitgevoerd voor de directie van Typhoon

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the implications of the Econcern curators' investigation for Typhoon's management, including possible bribery, and whether the SDE subsidy or permits should be suspended. The minister declined to comment on the curators' findings, saw no reason for a special forensic investigation or subsidy suspension, and said the subsidy decisions of May 2010 remain unchanged with payments expected from 2016.
I have no opinion on the curators' investigation report. It is part of the curators' duty of care to wind up the Econcern estate.
Over het onderzoeksverslag van curatoren heb ik geen mening. Het behoort tot de zorgplicht van curatoren om de boedel van Econcern te vereffenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over het frequentiespectrum voor draadloze microfoons

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether reallocating radio spectrum (the 700 MHz band) could disrupt wireless microphones used in broadcasting, and what compensation or solutions would be offered. The minister answered that the 800 MHz reallocation was handled through consultation with the sector and a three-year transition, that no compensation is considered necessary, and that the 700 MHz decision will be handled similarly with flexible, sector-involved solutions.
Given these measures, in my view additional provisions such as compensation are not necessary.
Door deze maatregelen zijn in mijn ogen aanvullende voorzieningen in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld compensatie niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren, en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het nieuwe handelsverdrag met de VS het Nederlandse schaliegasverbod bedreigt

MPs Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren and Agnes Mulder asked whether the proposed EU-US trade deal (TTIP) and its investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) clause could undermine a Dutch shale gas fracking ban and expose the state to damages claims, and whether Chevron's support for ISDS poses a risk. Minister Ploumen answered that ISDS would contain an exception for indirect expropriation covering general non-discriminatory public-interest measures, that parliament remains free to ban fracking, that a study on ISDS effects including on environmental regulation is underway with results due before summer, and that she cannot guarantee Chevron will not use ISDS but considers a successful claim unrealistic.
Yes, even after the conclusion of TTIP, the Dutch parliament can still take a decision on a ban on shale gas extraction.
Ja, ook na het sluiten van TTIP, kan het Nederlandse parlement nog steeds een besluit nemen over een verbod op schaliegaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en van Toorenburg over de GSM-ontvangst enquête van het CDA Zaltbommel

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about poor mobile reception in the municipality of Zaltbommel, including whether residents can miss emergency alerts, whether 112 and AED access are endangered, whether emergency services are hindered, and whether the minister will meet the parties involved. The minister answered that alerts can be received through other channels, that 112 calls are adequately handled, that AED alternatives exist, and that a meeting is unnecessary because 4G rollout is expected to improve coverage, with an update promised later in the year.
I do not consider a meeting necessary.
Ik acht een gesprek niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aukje de Vries en Mei Li Vos over premieverhogingen van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor ZZP’ers

MPs Ziengs, Aukje de Vries and Mei Li Vos asked about insurers raising disability insurance premiums for self-employed workers via en-bloc clauses, including questions on legal limits, complaint routes, switching options and AFM oversight. The minister answered that insurers must apply such clauses reasonably and sparingly, that the AFM and DNB oversee communication and solvency, and that the AFM will explore the product's cost-efficiency and en-bloc use.
The AFM will, from its product oversight and product development process supervision, start an exploration into the use of the en bloc clause in disability insurance.

In het licht hiervan zal de AFM vanuit het toezicht op producten – en productontwikkelingsproces (PPP) een verkenning starten naar het gebruik van de en bloc clausule bij arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat CO2-opslag in de Noordzee toch doorgaat

An MP asked the ministers whether the CO2 storage project under the North Sea would go ahead, what it costs taxpayers, why, and whether the risks to flora and fauna justify it. The government confirmed the subsidy of 150 million euros, argued CCS is unavoidable in the energy accord, rejected the environmental objections citing the environmental impact report, and said investors have not withdrawn.
The Netherlands granted a subsidy of 150 million euros to the ROAD project in 2010.
Nederland heeft in 2010 een subsidie van € 150 miljoen toegekend aan het ROAD-project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de toepassing van de Warmtewet, naar aanleiding van het Algemeen overleg Energie van 18 februari 2014

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs five questions on how the Warmtewet's maximum heat tariffs, connection cost rules, shared-meter situations and landlord-tenant heat supply are applied and enforced. The minister answered that ACM enforces tariffs, a monitor of parameters is underway, one-off connection fees are left to negotiation, and existing contracts continue, with the government promising to inform parliament in Q2 2014.

In the general consultation of 18 February in which I undertook to map problems in implementing the Heat Act, I indicated that I would inform the House of the findings and conclusions in the second quarter.

In het algemeen overleg van 18 februari waarin ik heb toegezegd knelpunten rondom de uitvoering van de Warmtewet in kaart te brengen, heb ik aangegeven de Tweede Kamer in het tweede kwartaal te informeren over de bevindingen en conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat slechts tien procent van de gedownloade boeken middels de legale weg wordt verkregen

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about reports that only ten percent of downloaded e-books are obtained legally, and about copyright compensation, the 21% VAT rate on e-books and market reform. The state secretary answered that downloading for private use falls under the private-copy exception with levies pending a CJEU ruling, supported an awareness campaign, pointed to the author contracts bill, and said VAT harmonisation is under EU review while market actors should develop business models.

Downloading (reproducing) e-books for one's own practice, study or use, on the other hand, falls under the private-copy exception of Article 16c of the Copyright Act, so the rightholder's consent is not required.

Het downloaden (reproduceren) van e-boeken voor eigen oefening, studie of gebruik, daarentegen, valt onder de thuiskopie-exceptie van artikel 16c van de Auteurswet zodat toestemming van de rechthebbende niet is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de stichting collectief onrecht

An MP asked the government about the Stichting Collectief Onrecht's advertising that taxpayers must join to keep rights to refunds of inheritance and gift tax, its fees and 'no cure no pay' claim, and its conduct toward consumers. The government answered that joining has no bearing on rights, that fee arrangements are a matter of private contract, that the ACM and civil courts handle misleading advertising, and that the Staatsloterij case is still pending before the Supreme Court.
There is therefore no connection between registering with the Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht and retaining or losing rights.
Er is dan ook geen relatie tussen een aanmelding bij de Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht en een behoud of verlies van rechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever inzake overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about innovation and SDE subsidies for the Noordoostpolder wind park, including risk allocation, locational costs, and cable and transformer costs. The minister answered that developer risks are passed to the initiator, that the subsidy was approved by the European Commission and will be reviewed, and that location-specific factors can justify innovation subsidies, while some questions were answered only by reference to earlier letters.
After construction, a Milieusteunkader review will still take place, on the basis of which it will again be examined whether too much subsidy has been paid.
Na de bouw zal nog een Milieusteunkader toetsing plaatsvinden op basis waarvan nogmaals bekeken wordt of er niet teveel subsidie is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Zembla uitzending “Woede in de winkelstraat”

An MP asked the ministers whether franchisees need stronger legal protection after a Zembla broadcast on abuses in franchising, such as forced purchasing and wrong sales forecasts, and whether a new statutory franchise contract is needed. The minister answered that franchisees should negotiate more critically, that information for aspirant franchisees will be improved, and that new legislation is unnecessary because existing rules and criminal law suffice.
As previously indicated, I intend to improve the information for aspiring franchisees on Ondernemersplein.nl.
Zoals eerder aangeven, ben ik voornemens de voorlichting aan aspirant-franchisenemers op Ondernemersplein.nl te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Lucas over het bericht dat een grote scheepsbouworder mogelijk naar een Spaanse scheepsbouwer gaat

MPs Schouten and Lucas asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Texel ferry operator TESO's provisional choice of a Spanish shipyard, despite Dutch innovation in the design, reflects unfair Spanish state subsidies and what the government will do to recover the order. The minister answered that Spain is bound by the EU shipbuilding aid framework, that the Commission has acted against past Spanish tax-lease aid, that he has no signals of current unlawful aid, and that he sees no reason to intervene because the order appears to be won on normal commercial terms.
At present I have no indications that the Spanish government is giving support to shipyards that leads to unfair competition.
Thans heb ik geen aanwijzingen dat de Spaanse overheid steun geeft aan werven die tot oneerlijke concurrentie leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de oplossing van de EMV-knelpunten bij hoogspanningsnetten (Elektrisch Magnetisch Veld)

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the costs of undergrounding high-voltage lines and buying out homes under them can be socialised through network tariffs, and why the minister's position squares with a European Commission reply deferring to the national regulator. The minister answers that the position is unchanged, that the regulator ACM sets tariffs and shares the analysis, that the Commission's reply does not alter the view, and that the cost split with municipalities and the state will not be revised.
There is no difference between the European Commission's answer and my earlier answer during the debate.
Er zit geen licht tussen het antwoord van de Europese Commissie en mijn eerdere antwoord tijdens het debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over knelpunten voor franchisenemers

An MP asked the Economics and Justice ministers about problems franchisees face, including the NFV's organisation, representation of franchisees, the VAKcentrum's identified knelpunten and calls for new legislation, an updated EIM study, and better information on the Ondernemersplein portal. The minister answered that franchising mostly works, that stakeholder talks are ongoing, that extra legislation is unlikely to solve the problems, that an EIM update is not needed, and that the Ondernemersplein information will be expanded.
However, it is not plausible that additional legislation will be able to solve the outlined problems.
Het is evenwel niet aannemelijk dat extra wetgeving de geschetste problemen zal kunnen oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat de bouw van windmolens 6000 banen kost

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether the reported loss of 6,000 jobs from offshore wind farms within the 12-mile zone is acceptable and whether those plans will be scrapped, and why regional effects are not studied. The minister answered that the figures come from a preliminary study measuring intended visits rather than actual effects, that the feasibility study is still in its final phase, and that regional effects are acknowledged and may be examined in a later phase.
It is therefore too early to conclude that placing wind turbines within the 12-mile zone would cost 6,000 jobs.
Het is daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat plaatsing van windmolens binnen de 12-mijlszone 6.000 banen zou kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Maij over het niet benutten van mogelijkheden ter ondersteuning van bedrijven die de EU biedt

MPs Vos and Maij asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands is failing to use the room EU state aid rules offer, whether the Commission advises on designing aid measures, and what will be done about it. The Minister confirmed the Commission can advise confidentially, said the Netherlands uses this in cases such as Nedcar and Pallas, and promised to strengthen contacts with Commission services and internal coordination on state aid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over wifi-tracking door winkels

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked whether shops may collect device identifiers via wifi or bluetooth from people inside and passing by their stores, and whether shops must disclose this and whether the data protection authority will be asked to investigate. The state secretary answered that tracking inside a shop may be justified as a legitimate interest under the Dutch data protection act if limited to visitor counts and movement, but collecting data from passers-by on the public road requires consent, and the minister will discuss the issue with the data protection authority.
The Minister of Economic Affairs indicated at the general consultation with your House on 12 February that he would discuss this issue with the Data Protection Authority (CBP).
De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft tijdens het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 12 februari j.l. aangegeven dit vraagstuk te zullen bespreken met het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door de overheid in eigen beheer nemen van de bezorging van reguliere pakketten, het verzorgen van koeriers- en transportdiensten en de bezorging van gerechtelijke briev

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the government about worker anxiety, job security, staff numbers and service quality as the state plans to bring parcel delivery, courier services and delivery of court letters in-house via IPKD. Minister Blok answered that no decision on staff transfers can yet be given, that Valid Express workers will be taken over where no suitable post exists at PostNL, and that legal quality standards for court letters will be ensured.
What consequences the in-sourcing plans will have for staff of companies currently performing these tasks cannot be stated in advance.
Welke gevolgen de inbestedingsvoornemens hebben voor personeel van bedrijven die deze taken nu uitvoeren, is niet op voorhand te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Kuiken over het plan van het Zweedse verpakkingsbedrijf Tetra Pak om zijn fabriek in Moerdijk eind dit jaar te sluiten

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about Tetra Pak's plan to close its Moerdijk factory, questioning the decision given strong 2013 results and asking what tools exist to keep investment in Dutch plants. The minister answers that the closure is a business decision the government cannot intervene in, lists existing innovation and investment subsidy instruments, and says the company is supporting affected workers through a social plan and talks with potential buyers of staff.
The plan to close the Moerdijk factory at the end of 2014 is based on business and strategic choices. The government cannot intervene in those.
Het voornemen om de fabriek in Moerdijk eind 2014 te sluiten is gebaseerd op bedrijfsmatige- en strategische keuzes. Daar kan de overheid niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het onderzoek in opdracht van de Europese vakorganisatie UNI Post & Logistics over de werkgelegenheidseffecten van de liberalisatie van de postsector

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he views a UNI Post & Logistics report finding that postal liberalisation in Europe largely had negative employment and working-condition effects, including whether liberalisation failed to deliver better service and lower prices and whether dropping the five-day delivery obligation will worsen service. The minister acknowledged job losses and worse conditions, attributed them mainly to falling mail volumes from digitalisation, said liberalisation benefited business customers, and said a periodic evaluation of the universal postal service will be added to the upcoming bill.
The intention is therefore to include a statutory, periodic evaluation of the universal postal service in the bill modernising the UPD.
Het voornemen is daarom om in het wetsvoorstel ter modernisering van de UPD een wettelijke, periodieke evaluatie van de UPD op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Hamer over het bericht dat er weer veel banen verdwijnen bij MSD in Oss

MPs Jan Vos and Hamer asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the loss of around 440 jobs at MSD in Oss, including how affected workers will be helped and what is being done with the municipality. Minister Kamp answered that a social plan with retraining support and an external job-placement firm is in place, that he is already in talks with MSD, Oss and the province, and that the Pivot Park offers opportunities for starters.
In cooperation with the municipality, province, Brabant Development Agency and MSD, I will examine what the possibilities are.
In samenwerking met de gemeente, provincie, Brabantse Ontwikkelingsmaatschappij en MSD zal ik bekijken wat de mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Yücel over het voornemen van het concern AKZO om de productieafdeling van de vestiging Deventer naar het buitenland te verplaatsen

MPs Kerstens, Hamer and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to move production from Deventer abroad, costing about 215 jobs, and what the government could do. The minister replied that the decision is a business-economic one the government cannot interfere with, pointed to general business-climate policy and R&D retention in Deventer, and said the ministry had discussed the decision with the company's management.
However, the cabinet cannot interfere in the business-economic decisions of companies.
Het kabinet kan zich echter niet mengen in bedrijfseconomische beslissingen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht "DDB wil meer informatie ZuivelNL"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that the Dutch Dairy Board wants more information on the new dairy chain body ZuivelNL, including a levy of EUR 0.05 per 100 kg milk, and whether interbranch organisations may take over productschap tasks and use general binding declarations. The minister answered that the LTO-NZO cooperation is not yet a recognised interbranch organisation under the CAP, that the levy is a voluntary private contribution rather than a statutory levy, that public tasks remain with the ministry and no general binding declaration applies, and that a framework regulation will be published in the second quarter of 2014.
A private organisation is free to ask its voluntarily affiliated participants for a financial contribution, whether or not it is an interbranch organisation within the meaning of the CAP.
Het staat een private organisatie, of dit nu een brancheorganisatie in de zin van het GLB is of niet, vrij om een financiële bijdrage te vragen aan de (vrijwillig) aangesloten deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over grote tariefsverhogingen voor de gebonden klanten bij stadsverwarmingsnetten

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about sharp district heating tariff increases for bound customers from 1 January 2014, whether the Warmtewet allows extra connection charges, whether the ACM can test reasonableness, and whether excessive increases can be reversed. Minister Kamp answers that the tariffs follow the NMDA principle and a price cap, that rising bills are the result of the new system, that the ACM can handle complaints, and that the ministry will not add a separate reasonableness test but will monitor costs.
I therefore do not intend to introduce a form of tariff review other than the maximum price based on the NMDA principle.
Ik ben dus niet voornemens een andere vorm van toetsing op de tarieven in te voeren dan de maximumprijs gebaseerd op het NMDA-principe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de toepassing van de Warmtewet bij complexen met blokverwarming

MP Paulus Jansen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the application of the Warmtewet to apartment complexes with block heating, including whether the law is clear on 17 points, whether guidance will be improved, whether ACM has the expertise and has tested tariffs, and whether heat efficiency can be linked to the Energy Agreement. The minister answered that the terms in the article are outdated, that the law protects consumers regardless of heat source, that ACM handles complaints (three pending), that a heat vision will follow, and that efficiency is not a goal of the law.
I will send the vision to the House of Representatives around the summer.
Ik zal de visie rond de zomer aan de Tweede Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over energiebelasting, btw en salderen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about energy tax exemption for self-generated solar power, VAT on private solar generation, netting rules, and CBS statistics on solar output. The Minister explained that the exemption requires generation for the consumer's own account and risk, that the Tax Authority's earlier flexible practice has been withdrawn, and that VAT liability on self-consumed solar power follows from EU rules.
Your Chamber will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Uw Kamer zal daar zo spoedig mogelijk over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het opstellen van duurzame energiedoelstellingen voor 2030

An MP asked whether the government still supports leading international cooperation on sustainable energy, how it relates to a letter from eight EU ministers calling for binding 2030 renewable targets, and why the Netherlands did not co-sign it. The government answered that it backs a CO2 reduction target of at least 40% and that, as Green Growth Group members disagree on separate renewable and efficiency targets, the Netherlands took no explicit position and was not asked to co-sign.
In the Green Growth Group the Netherlands, in line with the cabinet's response to the European Green Paper, has argued for a CO2 reduction target of at least 40% compared with 1990.
Nederland heeft in de Green Growth Group conform de kabinetsreactie op het Europese Groenboek gepleit voor een CO 2 -reductiedoel van ten minste 40% ten opzichte van 1990.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Bosman en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat de aanleg van glasvezel in Caribisch Nederland twee keer duurder is dan begroot en volledig door de Nederlandse belastingbetaler wo

MPs from the VVD asked why the Caribbean Netherlands submarine fibre cable cost roughly double its budget, why the state took on extra costs, and why it became a shareholding in SSCS B.V. without prior parliamentary approval. The minister replied that costs exceeded the original estimate by about EUR 8.9 million (not a doubling), that the extra funds covered redundancy and protection, that the shareholding was a transitional choice under the Comptabiliteitswet, and that the company is non-profit with cost-based tariffs.
With my letter of 9 December I aimed to align as closely as possible, albeit retrospectively, with the normal procedure of Article 34.
Met mijn brief van 9 december jl. heb ik beoogd zoveel mogelijk, zij het achteraf, aan te sluiten bij de normale procedure van artikel 34.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vastrecht bij productie- en leveringsbedrijven van energie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether fixed energy-supply charges are reasonable, whether they differ across providers, and whether their rise is justified given lower costs for billing and customer service. The minister answered that ACM supervises tariffs as a whole under a benchmark model it does not publish in detail, that fixed charges vary between providers, that providers may choose which costs to put under the fixed charge, and that fixed charges make up only about 6% of an average household bill.

ACM does not provide detailed information about this assessment model and the criteria it uses, because a public model would allow a maximum tariff to be derived that could act as a market reference price.
Over dit beoordelingsmodel en de criteria die daarin worden gebruikt verstrekt ACM geen gedetailleerde informatie, omdat uit een openbaar beoordelingsmodel een maximumtarief is af te leiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over ernstige vervuiling door de productie van windmolens

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of serious pollution from neodymium production in Baotou, China, and whether Dutch wind turbine magnets come from there. The minister confirmed the link is possible but limited, shared concern about Chinese pollution, and said Dutch firms and the special envoy can offer help while the decision rests with China.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Rog over het nakomen van afspraken over compensatiemaatregelen inzake de gasopslag Bergermeer

CDA MPs Mulder and Rog asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of compensation commitments tied to the Bergermeer gas storage, including a Alkmaar energy conference, the A9 Heiloo exit, a development company with a TAQA staff member, and TAQA's headquarters move. The minister answered that most commitments are progressing (energy region, conference planned for September 2014, Pallas project, A9 exit under discussion), that the convenants are between TAQA and municipalities rather than the ministry, and that TAQA is expected to keep its headquarters commitment.
As shown in my answers to questions 2 and 4, I am of the view that good progress is being made in realising the agreed commitments.
Zoals blijkt uit mijn antwoorden op de vragen 2 en 4 ben ik van mening dat goede voortgang wordt gemaakt met het realiseren van de gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat het Rijk met verkeerde cijfers rekent en dat het bouwen van windmolens op zee veel duurder gaat uitpakken

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the government miscalculates offshore wind costs, including whether a 40% cost reduction derives from industry figures and whether tourism job losses were assessed. The minister said a feasibility study on wind within the 12-mile zone is nearing completion, that cost reduction depends on several factors, and that environmental impact assessments already cover tourism effects, so separate reporting is unnecessary.
I hope to be able to inform the House about the results in the first half of 2014.
Ik hoop de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2014 over de resultaten te kunnen informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever naar aanleiding van beantwoording van vragen over het bericht dat overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie moet worden beperkt tot bedrijven die nieuwe productiemethodes introduceren

MP Klever asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the extra innovation subsidy of 116 million euro for the Noordoostpolder wind park, including the cost per kWh, the grid connection costs and the subsidy deadlines. The minister answered that the subsidy covers 92 million for offshore-style turbines in shallow water and 24 million for large onshore turbines, that these projects involve technical innovation, and that the subsidy works out at about 5.7 and 2.4 cents per kWh respectively.
There is 92 million euro available for wind turbines built in shallow water and 24 million euro for the wind turbines on land.
Er is 92 miljoen euro beschikbaar voor windturbines die gerealiseerd worden in ondiep water en 24 miljoen Euro voor de windturbines op het land
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de bescherming van rijksmonumenten in het aardbevingsgebied van Noord Oost Groningen

An MP asked ministers about damage to listed monuments in the Groningen earthquake zone and who enforces the ban on destroying protected monuments. The government said enforcement under the Monumentenwet lies with municipalities, while a provincial taskforce and a joint agreement with NAM aim to coordinate repair and prevention.
The current Article 11(1) of the Monumentenwet 1988 places enforcement with the lower government.
Het huidige artikel 11, eerste lid, van de Monumentenwet 1988 legt de handhaving bij de lagere overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked ministers about postal delivery in the Caribbean Netherlands, including e-commerce access, postcodes, whether the ACM supervises the islands, and the change of ownership of concession holder Flamingo Communications. Minister Kamp answered that e-commerce is a market matter outside the postal concession, that postcode costs are unknown, that the ACM's tasks are set by the Wet post BES with no general competition oversight on the islands, and that the ownership change did not affect Flamingo's assessment.
In the Caribbean Netherlands the ACM has no tasks in general competition supervision, as laid down in the Mededingingswet in the European Netherlands.
In Caribisch Nederland heeft de ACM geen taken in het kader van generiek mededingingstoezicht, zoals dat in Europees Nederland is neergelegd in de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Dijkgraaf over de toename van het aantal winkelopenstellingen op Eerste Kerstdag

MPs Gesthuizen and Dijkgraaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the rise in shop openings on Christmas Day and the protection of workers and small shopkeepers, and whether municipalities need a separate exemption with a draagvlak study. The minister replied that municipalities must weigh interests under the Algemene wet bestuursrecht, that workers can invoke existing laws and cao rules, and that enforcement against unlawful openings is a municipal responsibility, with no specific requirements for a support survey.
I do not have an overview of how the various municipalities give substance to this.
Ik heb geen overzicht over hoe de verschillende gemeenten hier invulling aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinning in Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Groningen gas production of about 54-55 billion m3 in 2013, above the 42.5 bcm per year ceiling, and the advice to reduce output because of stronger earthquakes, are acceptable, and why export figures are secret. The minister replied that the ceiling is a small-fields policy instrument that does not govern Groningen output, that export figures are published in GasTerra's annual report, and that exports of Groningen gas as such cannot be separated.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het opstellen van nota’s en meterstanden voor energie en water

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Infrastructure and Environment about disputes over annual energy and water bills, estimated meter readings, price comparison sites, and smart meter rules. The government answered that disputes are rare and falling, that estimates are used mainly when consumers do not report meter readings, and that it sees no structural overestimation or need for new rules.
The share of annual bills that leads to a dispute between consumer and energy supplier is very small.
Het aandeel jaarnota’s dat leidt tot een geschil tussen afnemer en energieleverancier is erg gering
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de negatieve verevening voor gemeenten waar windmolens worden gebouwd

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether municipalities hosting wind turbines lose much of the extra OZB revenue to negative equalisation in the Gemeentefonds, and whether this undermines local support and benefit-sharing. The ministers answered that wind turbines are equalised only at 70% of the notional OZB base, that 58% of turbine value falls under the machinery exemption and is excluded from the WOZ base, and that OZB is not an instrument for building local support, which rests on participation and financial participation schemes.
I do not recognise the problem you describe, because equalisation only concerns OZB revenues insofar as the windmill does not fall under the machinery exemption.
Het door u geschetste probleem herken ik niet omdat de verevening alleen ziet op de OZB-opbrengsten voor zover de windmolen niet onder de werktuigenvrijstelling valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het ROAD CCS demonstratie project

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether E.ON and GDF SUEZ made firm commitments to invest in the ROAD CCS demonstration project and why they are not being honoured, and asked for talks to secure a quick investment decision. The minister said the national government was not the competent authority for the coal plant permits, is not aware of firm commitments, backs CCS in principle, and expects a decision shortly after 31 January 2014.
In this matter the national government is not the competent authority.
In deze is het Rijk niet het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Groot over de uitzending ‘Caribisch Nederland, Drie jaar later, Bonaire’

Two MPs asked the government about a broadcast on Bonaire's high prices, falling real incomes, electricity and produce costs, and competition, and whether the 2010 tax reform and the switch to the US dollar caused price rises. The minister answered at length, acknowledging strong price rises and partly attributing them to global factors and dollarisation, citing indexation, tax relief and planned electricity and price regulation, while admitting gaps in data.
The Statistics Netherlands has started a study into, among other things, income developments on the islands.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek is een onderzoek gestart naar, onder andere, (bewegingen in) de inkomenssfeer op de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Miljoenensubsidie voor taxi's die amper reden’

Two PVV MPs asked about press reports of a subsidy for taxi firm Prestige GreenCab that barely operated, asking how the former director behaved, how the money would be recovered, and what electric-driving subsidy projects exist with measurable targets. The minister answered that the project submitted incomplete financial proof, the subsidy was set at zero with a six-week objection period before recovery, and listed the subsidy programmes with their monitoring and disbursement rules.
On that basis, AgentschapNL decided on 16 December to set the subsidy for the project at zero.
Op grond daarvan heeft AgentschapNL op 16 december jl. besloten de subsidie van het project vast te stellen op «nihil».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) over de opsporingsvergunningen aardwarmte Friesland en Utrecht – Noord-Brabant

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether geothermal exploration permits granted to Transmark Renewables could involve fracking near drinking water, a national park and Natura 2000 areas, and how this compares with shale gas rules. The minister replied that the permit alone allows no drilling, further permits and environmental assessments are required, provinces Overijssel, Utrecht and Noord-Brabant have objected, and environmental protection under the Mining Act is limited but covered by other laws.
An exploration permit, such as the one I granted to Transmark Renewables B.V., does not however give me the possibility to attach environmental conditions.
Een opsporingsvergunning, zoals door mij verleend aan Transmark Renewables B.V., biedt mij echter niet de mogelijkheid voorschriften op te nemen ten aanzien van het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Dikkers over het zeer trage betaalgedrag van een aantal grootbedrijven ten koste van het MKB

MPs Mei Li Vos and Dikkers asked whether large firms such as DE Master Blenders lengthening payment terms to 180-200 days complies with the 60-day statutory limit, and whether enforcement should be strengthened, including by the ACM. The minister replied that civil contracts are not subject to government enforcement, that public supervision is undesirable due to administrative burden, and that suppliers can go to civil court, collective action, or the ACM.
Civil-law contracts are not a subject of government enforcement.
Civielrechtelijke overeenkomsten zijn geen onderwerp van handhaving van overheidswege.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vastrecht bij de productie- en leverings-bedrijven van energie

Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why energy suppliers charge fixed monthly fees (vastrecht) that cover overhead, whether these fees have risen faster than energy prices and mislead consumers, whether the ACM supervises them, and whether suppliers should instead recover overhead through the variable price. The minister replied that fixed charges are a legitimate element of a free market, that the ACM monitors total tariffs and sees no problem, that he will ask the ACM for a fixed-charge overview, and that he sees no need for further study or a mandate to shift overhead into variable prices.
I see no problem in the way fixed charges are billed.
Ik zie geen probleem in de wijze waarop vastrecht in rekening wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over de richtlijn bekendmaking niet-financiële informatie

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would oppose Lithuanian Council presidency compromise text narrowing non-financial reporting duties to risks material to the company itself and allowing firms to withhold information harmful to them. The minister answered that the government supports the directive in principle, will treat its BNC-fiche position as the starting point, and cannot discuss specific confidential compromise proposals.
Because of the confidentiality of the compromise proposals, I cannot go into specific proposals that may be made therein.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de compromisvoorstellen kan ik niet ingaan op specifieke voorstellen die daarin mogelijk worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de fors stijgende energierekening

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that grid costs and the household energy bill would rise sharply due to green electricity, and asked for a breakdown of current and projected bills. The minister answered that grid integration costs are uncertain, gave 2012 and 2013 bill breakdowns and forward price and surcharge trends, and said the energy bill is not expected to rise sharply on grid costs alone, pointing to ACM's regulatory oversight of grid operators.
It is not possible to give an exact prediction of the future development of the overall energy bill.
Het is niet mogelijk om een exacte voorspelling te geven van de toekomstige ontwikkeling van de gehele energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het verlenen van een vergunning aan Cuadrilla

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Cuadrilla's financial position and corporate responsibility, given the SOMO quick scan, justified granting it an exploration licence, and why no financial guarantee under article 46 of the Mining Act was required. The minister replied that the financial capacity and corporate responsibility assessments gave no grounds to refuse or revoke the licence, that business-confidential financial data will not be published, and that the guarantee could not be required at the exploration stage.
Business-confidential financial data about Cuadrilla I cannot and will not make public.
Bedrijfsvertrouwelijke, financiële gegevens over Cuadrilla kan en wil ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over de 3VO kaart

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked the ministers whether a prepaid 3V card topped up via beltegoed.nl and billed later to the phone bill, and whether AFM and DNB pass responsibility to each other. The minister answered that DNB and AFM share supervision, that AFM is examining whether such top-ups amount to credit, that ABN AMRO and 3V have blocked the method and launched an internal inquiry, and that the minister will raise the issue in the EU e-money directive evaluation.
DNB and the AFM cannot make statements about investigations into individual companies and products.
DNB en AFM kunnen geen mededelingen doen over onderzoeken naar individuele ondernemingen en producten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over misstanden in franchiseland en de mogelijke aanpassing van de franchiseovereenkomst

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether franchise abuses are increasing, whether the franchise agreement should be made a named contract in the Civil Code, and whether franchisees can get legal aid for business disputes. The minister denied clear signs of a sharp rise, said no new research is planned, did not prioritise codifying franchise agreements, and explained that legal aid for business disputes is generally excluded with narrow exceptions.
At this moment I see no reason to commission new research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nieuw onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over de prijs van windenergie

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the cost, price and reliability of wind energy under the Energy Agreement, including claims of a €70bn burden, profile effects, Gemini subsidies, and household energy bills. The minister disputes several figures, explains grid reliability and programme responsibility rules, and states that the Energy Agreement lowers households' energy bills relative to earlier projections.
The figure mentioned is not correct.
Het genoemde getal is niet correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether Dutch law can reach directors of foreign legal entities in cases of pauline acts or bankruptcy fraud, whether the cross-border director-liability rules and the civil director ban are effective, and what was done after a 2011 Supreme Court ruling. The minister answered that cross-border cases are inherently complex, that the Netherlands raised the issue in the EU insolvency regulation review, that foreign director liability is governed by the law of the company's home state, and that the director-ban bill is still pending at the Council of State.
Precisely because of the inherent cross-border aspects, we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level.
Juist vanwege de inherente grensoverschrijdende aspecten achten wij het overigens van belang om over dit vraagstuk op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht dat overheidssubsidie voor duurzame energie moet worden beperkt tot bedrijven die nieuwe productiemethodes introduceren

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that EU state aid rules would restrict renewable energy subsidies to innovation, what this means for the Dutch SDE+ scheme, and the innovation subsidy for the Noordoostpolder wind park. The minister replied that the Commission's guidance is not an instruction to limit subsidies to innovation, that SDE+ already uses competitive allocation, that wind parks can be innovative, and that the subsidy goes to the project initiators with budgets reserved until 2016.
As is customary after the publication of a Commission Communication, the cabinet will shortly send you a BNC fiche with a more extensive explanation of the Dutch position.
Zoals gebruikelijk na het verschijnen van een Mededeling van de Commissie zal het kabinet u binnenkort een BNC-fiche met daarin een meer uitgebreide toelichting op het Nederlandse standpunt sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht ‘Half miljoen werklozen, ook bakkers en slagers; Chemiesector vreest ontslaggolf door hoge energierekening’

MP Klever (PVV) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares fears of mass layoffs in the chemical sector due to high energy costs, how this fits with the Energy Agreement's job projections, and whether structural measures beyond ETS compensation are needed. The minister acknowledged pressure on chemical competitiveness, pointed to a roundtable with industry and a letter on agreed measures, argued the Energy Agreement lowers energy cost increases and creates investment-driven jobs, and provided the Deloitte report.
The report referred to, commissioned by the VNCI, is attached as annex 4 to this letter.
Het bedoelde rapport, dat is opgesteld in opdracht van de VNCI, is als bijlage 4 bij deze brief gevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de externe en interne veiligheid van windturbines

An MP asked the government about the safety of wind turbines after the storm of 28 October 2013 and a fatal accident at Ooltgensplaat, including damage overviews, applicable safety and occupational health rules, and inspection practice. The minister answered that no national damage overview exists, that existing Arbo and Warenwet rules apply, that the Inspectie SZW is investigating the Ooltgensplaat accident and may adjust rules, and that inspections occur only in response to signals.
The Inspectie SZW investigation will determine whether the applicable provisions of the Working Conditions Act and the Consumer Goods Act have been adequately complied with.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW zal uitwijzen of de van toepassing zijnde voorschriften van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet en Warenwet adequaat zijn nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked about the new postal concession for Caribbean Netherlands, including the tender outcome, service changes, the 10-year term, enforcement tools, price rise and street addressing. The minister answered that Flamingo Communications was designated concessionaire, that the government can enforce via ACM orders, fines or withdrawal, and that addressing and postcode plans are progressing, without promising new oversight mechanisms.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises whether the concession holder complies with its obligations.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) ziet er op toe dat de concessiehouder zijn verplichtingen naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de geschillenbeslechting tussen Zimbabwe en Nederlandse ondernemers

An MP asked ministers about the unresolved arbitration award owed by Zimbabwe to Dutch farmers whose land was expropriated in 2001-2002, including progress, the route for dispute settlement, and whether Dutch engagement with Zimbabwe is consistent with the unpaid compensation. The minister replied that Zimbabwe was ordered by an ICSID tribunal in 2009 to pay compensation, that payment has not yet followed despite repeated pressure, that the case remains a priority, and that development cooperation has not resumed while Dutch firms decide on investments themselves.
The Netherlands will continue to request attention, both publicly and on the margins, at appropriate moments for this recognised claim of Dutch investors.
Nederland zal op gepaste momenten zowel openlijk als en marge aandacht blijven vragen voor deze erkende claim van de Nederlandse investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over berichten inzake de vijandige overname van KPN door América Móvil

Merkies (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he would respond to a hostile takeover bid for KPN by América Móvil and whether public-interest telecom services, including emergency-services networks, would be protected against foreign takeover. Minister Kamp answered that takeovers are for companies and shareholders to decide, that existing law and contracts would bind any acquirer, and that the government is examining whether stronger safeguards for national security are needed, reporting back in early 2014.

More structurally, the cabinet wants to examine whether existing measures can be applied more effectively to safeguard public interests, in particular national security, and whether additional provisions are needed in the event of a takeover.

Meer structureel gezien wil het kabinet bezien of in het kader van de effectieve borging van publieke belangen, in het bijzonder de nationale veiligheid, bestaande maatregelen effectiever kunnen worden toegepast en of aanvullende voorzieningen nodig zijn bij een overname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over berichten inzake de vijandige overname van KPN door América Móvil

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the consequences of the proposed takeover of KPN by América Móvil for public interests such as service quality, investment and workers, and whether the government can block the deal. The minister answered that public interests are protected by telecom law and competition supervision, that no legal basis exists to block the takeover, and that binding commitments with América Móvil and a review of structural safeguards are being pursued.
No, there are no statutory provisions that make it possible for the State to block such a takeover.
Neen, er bestaan geen wettelijke bepalingen die het mogelijk maken een dergelijke overname tegen te houden door de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitzending van Kassa ‘Kwaliteit holt achteruit in de kinderopvang’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a Kassa broadcast on falling quality in childcare, including staff-child ratio breaches, possible concealment from inspectors, budget cuts and staff workload. The minister answers that the GGD and municipalities enforce the ratio, that more risk-based inspection and quality supervision are planned, that the 100 million euro investment is intended to restore demand, and that the government will not accept lower quality standards.
I am ultimately responsible for the supervision and enforcement system. Within that system I want to move more towards quality supervision.
Ik ben eindverantwoordelijk voor het systeem van toezicht en handhaving. Binnen dat systeem wil ik meer toe naar kwaliteitstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Agnes Mulder over nazorg steenkoolwinning

MPs Knops and Mulder asked the minister of Economic Affairs why damage from coal mining in Limburg is not compensated, given that claims are time-barred, why the government ignores its own technical commission's findings, whether morally owed compensation should be paid, and why the Netherlands did not share costs for securing old shafts as Germany was helped. The minister answered that claims against the Mining Damage Guarantee Fund are barred under the 30-year limitation rule, that the fund cannot pay outside legal grounds, that a separate letter on follow-up steps would be sent, and that research into post-mining effects and shaft safety is underway.

On the steps that may be taken in this context and on the investigations announced in the answer to question 8 regarding aftercare for coal mining, I will inform you further by separate letter at the same time.

Over de eventueel te nemen stappen in dit kader en over de in het antwoord op vraag 8 aangekondigde onderzoeken in het kader van de nazorg voor de steenkolenwinning zal ik u gelijktijdig bij separate brief nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over de hoge kosten van wind op zee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the reliability of the 40% cost reduction for offshore wind assumed in the Energy Agreement, the budget implications of higher costs, steel price risks and a fallback plan such as cooperation with Germany. The minister answered that the sector committed to the 40% reduction, that ECN and PBL modelled the agreement and found the budget sufficient, and that a cooperation mechanism may be used if needed.
I intend to further develop the system and amend the SDE+ Decree so that cooperation mechanisms can be used if necessary to achieve the target.
Ik ben voornemens de systematiek verder uit te werken en het Besluit SDE+ aan te passen, zodat de samenwerkingsmechanismes zo nodig gebruikt kunnen worden om het doelbereik te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de betaling van havengelden voor de recreatievaart

MP Albert de Vries asked whether berth payment and cancellation terms in marinas are set by HISWA conditions, what legal framework applies, and whether monthly or quarterly payment and monthly cancellation could be legally mandated for private boat owners. The minister explained that private marinas follow their own terms, municipal and provincial harbour fees are retributions under provincial and municipal law, and rejected national rules on this detail, preferring self-regulation by the sector.
I see no reason for national regulation at this level of detail.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nationale regelgeving op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin Van Dijk over de nieuwe telefoonbemiddelingsdienst voor doven

MPs Van Laar, Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether the new relay service for deaf users, which requires Total Conversation software from a single provider, leaves analogue text-phone users without access and whether insurers cover the costs. The minister answered that TC is an open standard, insurers cover the software licence and equipment, and access is adequate, while acknowledging a small group may briefly lose service.
All insured persons known to have received a text phone in the past have received a letter from their health insurer.
Alle verzekerden van wie bekend is dat men in het verleden een teksttelefoon heeft gekregen, hebben van hun zorgverzekeraar een brief ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over misleidende kortingen bij elektronicawinkels

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether discount claims in electronics shops and online, such as inflated reference prices and false 'last piece' claims, are misleading and what can be done. The Minister said misleading practices are unacceptable, referred the matter to the consumer authority ACM which enforces unfair trading rules with fines up to 450,000 euro, and judged existing legislation sufficient.
I have, however, informed the ACM of the practices described in the newspaper article.
Wel heb ik de ACM in kennis gesteld van de praktijken die in het krantenartikel worden beschreven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over nut, noodzaak en kosten van windenergie

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the public should vote on the Energy Agreement, why the costs are not 70 billion euro, what analysis shows the country needs wind farms, and whether citizens should be consulted on wind parks. The minister answers that the Netherlands is a representative democracy, that the agreement has broad support, that the 70 billion figure is incorrect, and that wind energy is needed to meet EU renewable targets.
The Netherlands is a representative democracy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de veiligheid van de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Borssele nuclear plant still meets the agreed top-25% safety benchmark and how the IAEA unplanned capability loss indicator should be read. The minister answered that the benchmark commission found Borssele within the safest 25%, that UCL is not a safety measure, and that restart is expected in December.
At present the Borssele nuclear power plant therefore meets the safety requirement agreed in the 2006 covenant.
Op dit moment voldoet de kerncentrale Borssele dus aan de veiligheidseis zoals die in 2006 in het convenant is afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over het bericht “Ingreep in emissiehandel wekt woede van Tata Steel”

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Netherlands pushes to strengthen the EU ETS while compensating energy-intensive firms like Tata Steel, and whether the cross-sectoral correction factor fits the Steel Action Plan. The minister answered that the correction factor is mandated by the EU Directive and cannot be changed without revising it, and defended the ETS as the central instrument, with Dutch efforts focused on post-2020 safeguards for internationally competitive firms.
This intervention is however in line with the European emissions trading directive (ETS).
Deze ingreep is echter in lijn met de Europese richtlijn emissiehandel (ETS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het fonds voor duurzame energie, gekoppeld aan de levensduurverlenging kerncentrale Borssele

The SP MP Paulus Jansen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of the EUR 100 million additional innovation investments by Essent and Delta, the SET sustainable energy fund, and how parliament can oversee compliance with the Borssele nuclear plant covenant. The minister answered that most approved projects are in progress, the 2014 deadline will be extended by five years, project details are confidential, and biennial reporting to parliament will follow.
Individual projects are not reported on due to commercial confidentiality.
Over individuele projecten wordt vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet gerapporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de Wet onafhankelijk netbeheer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Unbundling Act (Wet onafhankelijk netbeheer) has delivered its benefits, whether the government will commission an independent evaluation, and about investment, employment and monitoring of integrated grid operators. The minister declined to assess the Act's effects while the Supreme Court appeal on the Court of Appeal's ruling is pending, and gave limited data on investment, quality and employment while noting that ACM has no complaints about cross-subsidy.
I do not consider it prudent to make further statements about the Won at this time.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig om op dit moment verdere uitspraken te doen over de Won.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over werelderfgoed Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the ministers about a Waddenvereniging report on opportunities from Wadden Sea World Heritage status, including tourism limits, whether the status added restrictions, and the tourism strategy. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the status adds no extra restrictions beyond existing law, pointed to promotion and a trilateral tourism strategy due at the February 2014 conference, and said the status did not itself impose new limits.
The World Heritage status in itself does not impose any additional restrictions or rules.
De werelderfgoedstatus op zich levert géén extra beperkingen of regels op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Brazilië gebruikersdata binnen de grenzen wil houden

Two SP MPs asked whether Brazil's plan to force foreign tech firms to store user data domestically would protect Dutch citizens' data, and whether Dutch law can bind foreign companies. The minister replied that US jurisdiction over Google means server location is not decisive, saw no reason to contact Brazil, and explained that the Wbp applies to firms with a Dutch establishment or that process data using Dutch-located means.
This follows from the fact that the United States claims very broad jurisdiction, which leads to extraterritorial effects.
Dit vloeit voort uit het feit dat de Verenigde Staten zichzelf een zeer ruime rechtsmacht aanmeten die tot extraterritoriale effecten leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de signalen dat de Amerikaanse NSA ook topmensen uit het bedrijfsleven afluistert

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether the US NSA also spies on Dutch business leaders and Dutch companies for economic purposes, and what the risks and government response would be. Minister Plasterk answered that intercepting metadata for counterterrorism is acceptable within legal limits, that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss its methods or examples of corporate espionage, and that the government will send a signal to the US, referring to a letter of 28 October 2013.
No public statements can be made about the working methods and knowledge level of the AIVD, including examples of corporate espionage.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van AIVD, inclusief voorbeelden van bedrijfsspionage.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Klaver over de uitwerking van het verlaagde energiebelastingtarief voor decentrale duurzame elektriciteitsopwekking door coöperaties en V.v.E.’s zoals overeengekomen in het

GreenLeft MPs asked how the reduced energy tax rate for cooperatives and homeowners' associations generating renewable electricity would work, including metering, self-consumption, and whether business members may participate. The State Secretary answered that metering and netting are allowed under conditions, that business members are excluded for policy and state-aid reasons, and that the scope for business small users will be studied by summer 2014.
Entrepreneurs may not be members of the cooperative, because the scheme is intended for local renewable energy generation by cooperatives of, and for, private small consumers.

Ondernemers mogen geen lid zijn van de coöperatie, omdat de regeling is bedoeld voor de lokale duurzame energie opwekking van energie door coöperaties van – en ten behoeve van – particuliere kleinverbruikers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de bekendheid en toepassing van het Besluit bijstandsverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz) voor zzp’ers

An MP asked whether ZZP self-employed workers know about the Bbz assistance scheme and what the government will do to raise awareness. The state secretary answered that data on financial distress is lacking, that awareness is only indicative, and listed existing and planned outreach measures with municipalities and Divosa/VNG.
From this department I intend to grant subsidy to Divosa and VNG to organise various activities in autumn 2013 and the first and second quarters of 2014 that will raise awareness of the Bbz.

Ik ben vanuit dit departement voornemens subsidie te verlenen aan Divosa en VNG om in het najaar van 2013 en het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2014 diverse activiteiten te organiseren die meer bekendheid aan het Bbz zullen geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over privacyschendingen door middel van de bonuskaart van Albert Heijn

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Albert Heijn's loyalty card exposes customers' purchase histories to privacy risks, whether such data counts as personal data under the Wbp, and whether other retailers face similar risks. The state secretary answered that purchase data is personal only when traceable to a person, that the card number gives access only to purchase history without identifying details, that the first five digits are no longer printed on receipts, and that he lacks an overview of other retailers' safeguards, leaving the final legal judgement to the Data Protection Authority.

The final judgement on whether consumers' purchase data must be regarded as personal data and whether shops such as Albert Heijn must protect it accordingly rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.

Het finale oordeel over de vraag of aankoopgegevens van consumenten als persoonsgegevens moeten worden beschouwd en of winkels als Albert Heijn deze dienovereenkomstig moeten beschermen is aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Oosenbrug over de onmogelijkheid om over te stappen bij glasvezel abonnementen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether fibre-optic internet customers can only switch providers when they have no other fibre subscription, causing gaps in service, and whether providers agreed to create switching barriers that may breach the cartel ban. The minister acknowledged operational problems, denied any agreement to create switching barriers, and declined to instruct the competition authority ACM to start an investigation, citing its independence.
However, I cannot instruct the ACM to start an investigation.
Ik kan de ACM echter niet opdragen om een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren met betrekking tot het bericht “Huurcontract bindt gemeente in dossier schaliegas”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a private contract between the municipality of Boxtel and a Cuadrilla subsidiary on shale gas, and about the liability of the municipality and the State for damages if permits are delayed or the contract is ended. The Minister replied that the State is not a party to the contract, that municipal liability depends on the circumstances, and that the State would be liable for damages only in limited cases such as a wrongful permit withdrawal, while offering a briefing on the mining permit procedures.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs is not a party to this agreement and therefore was not involved in its creation.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken is geen partij bij deze overeenkomst en dus ook niet betrokken geweest bij de totstandkoming ervan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren met betrekking tot het bericht “Next checkt: Na proefboring is winning amper tegen te houden”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the criteria for shale gas exploration and extraction licences, whether licences can be withdrawn, liability for damages, and the financial position of Brabant Resources. The minister answered that licences are assessed under the Mining Act, that withdrawal grounds concern market regulation and the applicant's technical and financial capacity rather than environmental effects, that no security was requested, and that the company's financial data are confidential.
Such data are commercially confidential and cannot be made public.
Dergelijke gegevens zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kunnen niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een mogelijke uitbreiding van de AMS-IX naar de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the ministers whether AMS-IX's planned US expansion risks exposing exchanged data to US surveillance laws (Patriot Act, FISA), whether it threatens data protection, and whether AMS-IX should be treated as vital infrastructure and advised on its structure. The government answered that US law applies to activities on US soil, that the EU-US expert group is discussing surveillance, that Dutch data-transfer rules apply, that AMS-IX is not classified as vital infrastructure but a review is underway, and that it will not advise the company on its structure.
Under this US legislation the provider can, after intervention by a US judge, be obliged to cooperate with requests from US authorities.
Op basis van deze Amerikaanse wetgeving kan de aanbieder, na tussenkomst van een Amerikaanse rechter, verplicht worden mee te werken aan verzoeken van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plan om de leefbaarheid van het dorp Moerdijk op te offeren voor economische ontwikkeling

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether the advisory commission's view that port and industrial growth at Moerdijk should take priority over village liveability, and the resulting environmental, health and traffic impacts, were acceptable. The government answered that the trade-off is a matter for the regional authorities in the consultation on the port vision, that environmental norms still apply, and that it sees no role for the national government at this stage.
Given this consultation process, I currently see no role for the national government.
Gelet op dit consultatieproces zie ik thans geen rol voor de rijksoverheid weggelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether foreign-company directors of Dutch companies can escape joint liability under Dutch law, and whether EU legislation is needed to change this. The minister replied that liability depends on the foreign law of the company's seat, that the Netherlands will raise harmonisation in the Commission's consultation, and that the upcoming civil director-ban bill will address misuse of foreign legal entities.
Because we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level as well, we will raise this in the consultation the European Commission is currently holding.

Omdat wij het van belang achten om over dit vraagstuk ook op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen, zullen wij dit opbrengen in het kader van de consultatie die de Europese Commissie momenteel houdt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jan Vos over een dreigend tekort aan laadpalen voor elektrische auto's

MPs Kuiken and Jan Vos asked the state secretary and the minister of Economic Affairs about a looming shortage of public charging points for electric cars, including projected car numbers, charging infrastructure, and municipal support. Minister Kamp answered that around 20,000 EVs are expected by end 2013, that charging infrastructure will grow under the 'ladder van laden' approach, and that an agreement with stakeholders is expected by year end.
The hope and expectation is that this agreement can be signed before the end of this year.
De hoop en verwachting is dat deze afspraak voor eind van dit jaar kan worden ondertekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA) via telecomaanbieders het internationaal telefoonverkeer afluistert

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the government about reports that the US NSA was intercepting international telephone traffic via Belgian provider Belgacom, and whether Dutch telecom providers had been similarly breached or approached. The minister said there is no indication of a comparable breach in the Netherlands, that providers are responsible for their own security under the Telecommunicatiewet, that the government does not know whether foreign services approached Dutch providers, and that EU-US expert group work and the JBZ-Raad addressed the issue.
No public statements are made about contacts between the Dutch intelligence and security services and foreign services.
Over contacten tussen de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en buitenlandse diensten worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de posttarieven van PostNL per 1 januari 2014 wederom gaan stijgen

An SP MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the reported 4-cent rise in the postage stamp price from 2014, questioning whether a 45% increase since 2010 is acceptable, why PostNL uses its full tariff room, and whether the rise follows from withdrawing a claim against Sandd.
