The minister answered that declining volumes make the universal postal service costlier, that the price stays below the West-European average, that PostNL's proposed tariff room is needed for a viable service, and that cost increases are rightly borne by users alongside cost-cutting measures such as fewer post offices, with a bill in preparation.
It is reasonable that an increase in the costs of the UPD is paid by users of the UPD.
Het ligt in de rede dat een toename in de kosten van de UPD wordt betaald door gebruikers van de UPD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het bericht “Techneuten gezocht in buitenland; Fugro lijdt onder tekort aan hoogopgeleid personeel”

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Fugro faces a shortage of highly educated technical staff, whether the government is engaging with Fugro and education institutions, and what it can do to keep the firm from relocating to Italy. The minister replies that Fugro is pursuing organic growth and works with local education providers, that no specific state help is requested, and that the government supports public-private cooperation and existing technical training and labour-market measures.
Fugro has indicated that, beyond the ongoing efforts around the Techniekpact and business policy, it does not expect specific help from the central government
Fugro heeft aangegeven op dit moment, naast de lopende inzet rondom het Techniekpact en het bedrijvenbeleid, geen specifieke hulp van het Rijk te verwachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de boycot van Israëlische producten door een aantal supermarkten

MP De Roon (PVV) asked ministers whether planned labelling of settlement products and supermarket boycotts harm Palestinian livelihoods and whether the government would tell retailers that specific labelling is unnecessary. The government replied that labelling advice is not a boycott, that no specific settlement labelling has been decided, that EU origin rules apply to all imports, and that it will inform the retail association of the state of play.
There is no question of a decision on specific labelling of products from settlements.
Er is geen sprake van een besluit tot specifieke etikettering van producten uit nederzettingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de exclusieve afnameverplichtingen tussen brouwers en horecaondernemers op de biermarkt en het effect van aangekondigde maatregelen in de grensregio

Two MPs (Mulder and Omtzigt, CDA) asked about exclusive beer purchase obligations between brewers and hospitality businesses, expected beer excise revenue, cross-border beer consumption, and the financial effects of planned excise measures in border regions. The state secretary answered that the market must function effectively, gave the 2012 excise revenue figures, said data on cross-border consumers is not recorded, declined to give a calculation rule for the excise effect, and promised to inventory relevant memos and send any found separately by end of October.
This request cannot be met in the short term. This will first have to be inventoried.
Aan dit verzoek is niet op korte termijn te tegemoet te komen. Dit zal eerst moeten worden geïnventariseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de prijzenoorlog in de supermarkten en de brief van Plus Supermarkten aan haar leveranciers

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about supermarket price wars, Plus Supermarkets passing lost margins on to suppliers, and whether the voluntary fair trading code and government oversight are adequate. The minister answered that the code is a self-regulatory pilot supplemented by existing law, with the ministry facilitating and monitoring it, and that ACM's competition role does not cover margin distribution.
It was agreed that the FNLI will collect a number of anonymised supplier complaints with the associated anonymised contractual frameworks between those suppliers and their buyers.
Afgesproken is dat de FNLI een aantal geanonimiseerde klachten van leveranciers met bijbehorende geanonimiseerde contractuele kaders tussen die leveranciers en hun afnemers zal verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Hijum over het bericht “AH Veendam bood kwart miljoen voor zondagopenstelling”

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked whether a supermarket offering a quarter million euros in sponsorship for Sunday opening amounted to bribery and whether such deals are common. The minister said he was unaware of similar practices, that municipalities must guard against conflicts of interest, and saw no reason to assume bribery in this case.
If a municipality is approached by a company asking it to use its powers in a certain way, the municipality must guard against conflicts of interest and partiality.

Indien een gemeente wordt benaderd door een bedrijf met het verzoek op een bepaalde wijze van zijn bevoegdheden gebruik te maken, dient deze gemeente te waken voor belangenverstrengeling en partijdigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over persoonsgegevens bij digitale televisie en Netflix

An MP asked the state secretaries about personal data handling by Netflix and digital TV providers, including whether Dutch privacy law applies to Netflix operating from Luxembourg and whether viewing data can reveal sensitive information. The government answered that the Dutch Wbp does not apply to Netflix, which falls under Luxembourg law implementing the same EU directive, and described Ziggo's opt-in rules for sharing viewing data.
The Wbp does not apply because Netflix has no establishment in the Netherlands.
De Wbp is niet van toepassing aangezien Netflix geen vestiging in Nederland heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Den Haag en tabak’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Health, Economic Affairs and Finance whether the government had consulted the tobacco industry before setting its position on the EU Tobacco Products Directive, and whether this conflicted with the FCTC treaty and earlier statements. The government replied that industry contact is limited to technical implementation matters, that the industry was only consulted on the directive after the BNC fiche was sent to parliament, and that no FCTC violation occurred.
VWS deliberately chose not to consult the tobacco industry and health organisations while the government position was being drafted.
VWS heeft er bewust voor gekozen om, ten tijde van het opstellen van het regeringsstandpunt, niet met de tabaksindustrie en de gezondheidsorganisaties in overleg te treden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over het bericht dat Delta de afspraken uit het Energieakkoord dreigt te negeren

Two PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether Delta's refusal to close its coal plant conflicts with the Energy Agreement, how compliance will be ensured, and whether he will negotiate with Delta. The minister answered that Delta, as an Energie Nederland member, is bound to the agreement, that the coal tax exemption returns in 2016 only if the plants close, and referred to a separate letter on ACM's view.
I assume these companies stand by their signature and will therefore, within the limits of competition law, work constructively towards closing their old coal plants.

Ik ga ervan uit dat deze bedrijven staan voor hun handtekening en dus – binnen de mededingingsrechtelijke mogelijkheden – op constructieve wijze zullen werken aan sluiting van hun oude kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de beslissing van Verbrugge Terminals om niet in Vlissingen-Oost maar in Zeebrugge te investeren in een containerterminal

An MP asks the ministers whether they know Verbrugge Terminals chose to invest in Zeebrugge rather than Vlissingen-Oost, whether Flemish state aid to ports distorts competition, and whether the government will raise this with the European Commission and condition its support for the EU port regulation on state-aid rules. The minister confirms the facts, calls the Flemish funding regime an unequal playing field that the Commission has already found compatible with EU rules, says the case strengthens his push for port state-aid guidelines, and makes no commitment to raise it with the Commission directly.
The Dutch view of port management and port services is a business-like one, in which users pay fully and at market-conform rates for the products and services delivered to them.

Het Nederlandse beeld van havenbeheer en havendienstverlening is een bedrijfsmatige, waarbij de gebruikers volledig en marktconform voor de kosten van de aan hen geleverde producten en diensten betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid

An MP from D66 asked the government why it lacks a clear vision on raw materials and whether supply shortages and conflict-sourced inputs threaten Dutch agriculture, chemicals and textiles. Minister Kamp answered that raw-material security is primarily the responsibility of business, cited existing initiatives such as conflict-free tin and the planned monitoring and research, but declined to commit to a new overarching strategy or to a partnership with the TNO/HCSS expertise centre.
Raw-material supply security and procurement policy are in the first instance the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid en inkoopbeleid zijn in eerste aanleg de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Den Haag vindt de klachten over bevingen maar gezeur’

MPs Jan Vos and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that The Hague dismisses complaints about earthquakes as nagging, and about the backlog of damage claims from gas extraction in Groningen. The minister replied that NAM has expanded its assessor capacity, that claims are being processed with a target of three months, that the Tcbb and an independent ombudsman have reviewed the process, and that research and communication with local authorities are ongoing.
From the outset it has been clear to me that the increase in the number of earthquakes, and their possible strength, is increasing unrest among residents.
Het is voor mij van het begin af aan helder dat de toename van het aantal aardbevingen, en de mogelijke sterkte ervan, de onrust bij de bewoners doen toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het nationaal programma radioactief afval

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how public participation on the national radioactive waste programme would be made fair, whether reversibility of final disposal is required, whether disposal should await solutions for long-term knowledge retention, and whether waste imports should be banned. The minister answered that participation channels will be equal and a participation trajectory will start, that reversibility is a Dutch national requirement, that new waste may be produced and final disposal is planned after at least 100 years of storage, that knowledge retention is handled by COVRA, and that a ban on imports will not be introduced.
Soon a public participation trajectory will start in which the public and various organisations will be informed and involved in the choices that must be made to arrive at final disposal.

Binnenkort zal er een publieksparticipatie traject starten waarin het publiek en verschillende organisaties geïnformeerd en betrokken worden bij de keuzes die voorliggen om tot een eindberging te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de gevolgen van het inflatiecijfer op de huurstijgingen

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers whether the Woonbond's claim that the inflation figure inflates rent increases is valid, and whether the calculation method should be changed. The minister rejected the Woonbond's three arguments as consistent with international guidelines and declined to start a study of an alternative inflation measure.
I therefore see no reason to start a study into a different inflation figure as the basis for rent policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een onderzoek te starten naar een ander inflatiecijfer als basis voor het huurbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Merkies (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat er hogere handdrukken worden uitgereikt dankzij sluiproutes (Ingezonden 7 juni 2013).

The SP MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister whether severance packages at listed companies circumvent the Dutch Corporate Governance Code's one-year salary cap and whether the excessive severance tax applies. The minister answered that the Code is largely complied with, that the monitoring commission found no clear evidence of circumvention, promised to ask the commission to focus on transparency, and provided tax revenue figures.
I therefore ask the Commission to, in addition to attention to compliance with provision II.2.8, pay specific attention to transparency in the annual report on the departure of directors.
Ik vraag de Commissie daarom om, naast aandacht voor de naleving van bepaling II.2.8, specifiek aandacht te besteden aan transparantie in het jaarverslag bij vertrek van bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de schadeafhandeling na aardbevingen ten gevolge van gaswinning

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the slow handling of damage claims after the Groningen earthquakes caused by gas extraction, including the share of claims assessed, agreed deadlines with NAM, and counter-expertise requests. The minister reports that about 35% of claims had completed assessment reports by early August 2013, explains the capacity problems, states an aim of assessment within three months without firm guarantees, and gives the counter-expertise figures.

I have had the damage settlement process reviewed by the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb), and I have also appointed an independent Ombudsman where citizens can take their complaints and concerns.

aan uw Kamer heb aangegeven, heb ik het proces van schadeafhandeling laten toetsen door de Technische Commissie Bodembeweging (Tcbb) en daarnaast heb ik een afhankelijke Raadsman ingesteld, waar burgers terecht kunnen met hun klachten en zorgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘De macht van de tabakslobby, hoe de industrie de winkelier voor haar karretje spant’

An SP MP asked the government for its reaction to a press article on tobacco industry lobbying, including the moral judgement on covertly funded anti-tobacco-prevention campaigns and the FSIT fund linked to the NSO retailers' association, and whether other similar fundraising organisations exist and what will be done to prevent them. The state secretary answered that retailer organisations may freely represent their sector's interests, that other similar bodies may exist, and that they must comply with existing rules such as the tobacco advertising ban, without committing to new action.
It is not for the cabinet to prevent such organisations, which seek to represent the interests of a sector, from being established.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te voorkomen dat dergelijke organisaties, die de belangen van een sector willen vertegenwoordigen, worden opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en De Rouwe over een mogelijk ongeoorloofde subsidiëring en staatssteun bij de verkoop van Syntus aan Keoli

MPs Mulder and De Rouwe asked whether NS's reported 11 million euro loss on the sale of Syntus to Keolis implies state-funded subsidy or illegal state aid, and whether the state ultimately bears the loss. The minister answered that the loss was a write-off on a loan and the company's value, that the sale avoided a bankruptcy, and that no state aid or distortion of competition was involved because the state is not a party to the transaction.
In this transaction there was no question of loss compensation or state aid, as the State is after all not a party to this transaction.
Bij deze transactie was geen sprake van verliescompensatie danwel staatssteun, de Staat is immers geen partij in deze transactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over onduidelijke regels omtrent identificatieplicht voor zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether self-employed workers (zzp'ers) face unclear and contradictory identification rules when accepting assignments, and how their privacy is protected. Minister Kamp replied that identification is only required when a client demands a Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie, that the client must keep copies for seven years, and that the Chamber of Commerce only shares business addresses unless legal exceptions apply.
Self-employed workers are not obliged to identify themselves when accepting assignments.
Zzp'ers zijn niet verplicht zich te identificeren bij het aannemen van opdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven over de uitvoering van de subsidieregeling voor zonnepanelen

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the solar panel subsidy scheme: whether subsidies can be obtained without proof of payment, whether checks are only sampled under the high-trust approach, how many applicants were checked, whether other schemes are run the same way, how the money will be evaluated, and what the scheme means for employment after the China import dispute. The minister replied that a signed purchase agreement is required, that 224 sampled applications were checked with no undue payments found, that the scheme will not be evaluated, and that the employment outlook is uncertain.
That is why it was decided not to request proof of payment at the time of the subsidy application.
Daarom is er voor gekozen om op het moment van de subsidieaanvraag geen betalingsbewijs te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat ondernemers in de problemen komen door rentederivaten

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that SMEs face problems from interest rate derivatives, including the scale of the problem, litigation, the AFM investigation, comparison with housing corporations, mis-selling and the duty of care. The minister answered that no data on numbers or amounts is available yet, that the AFM investigation results come in September, and that further steps will wait for those results.
At this moment I have no additional information on how many entrepreneurs are struggling with problematic (interest rate) derivatives or what total amount is involved.
Op dit moment heb ik geen aanvullende informatie over hoeveel ondernemers kampen met problematische (rente)derivaten of om welk totaalbedrag het zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Mei Li Vos over de btw-vrijstelling die geldt voor PostNL

Two MPs asked the government about the VAT exemption for universal postal services that benefits PostNL, including its origins, its size and revenue cost, and whether the government would push for its abolition in Europe. The State Secretary confirmed the exemption covers only universal service parcels, explained its historical basis, declined to give volumes or revenue loss citing confidentiality, and said the Netherlands supports abolition, which the Commission withdrew, with a possible future proposal to be notified to parliament.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of the data, the exact size of the UPD share of the total market cannot be stated.
Door de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens, kan de exacte grootte van het UPD-aandeel in de totale markt niet worden aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de gevolgen van het faillissement en de herstart van Better Place inzake accu-oplaadstations

An SP MP asked the Economics and Foreign Affairs ministers about the consequences of Better Place's bankruptcy and relaunch for EU and Dutch support, possible claw-back of subsidies, and whether Dutch and EU engagement with the company was consistent with due diligence regarding Israeli settlements. The minister answered that the cabinet had no prior notice of the relaunch, that the Dutch state had no financial obligations or direct involvement, that the EU subsidy fell under EU guidelines, and that Dutch settlement policy is unchanged.
The cabinet was not informed in advance of the relaunch.
Het kabinet is niet vooraf op de hoogte gesteld van de doorstart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de mogelijke verkoop van NUON door Vattenfall

The MP asks whether the government sees NUON as strategically important for energy supply and the Energy Agreement, and whether it will examine a state stake in or full takeover of NUON. The minister answers that NUON is an important supplier, that the government will not take a stake because the market is liberalised and supervised by the ACM, and that Vattenfall's search for an investment partner is a normal market matter.
State participation in Nuon is not an issue.
Deelname van het Rijk in Nuon is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de rol van de Rijksoverheid bij het inpassen van windparken in de provincie Drenthe

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the national government should coordinate the siting of Drenthe wind farms over 100 MW, whether the provincial alternative will be assessed, and how the national government will keep control. The ministers answer that the national coordination scheme applies, the provincial variant will be assessed in the environmental report, and the national government retains decision-making on spatial siting after consulting the province and municipalities.
Decision-making regarding spatial integration is and remains reserved for the national government.
Besluitvorming met betrekking tot de ruimtelijke inpassing is en blijft voorbehouden aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de problemen waar de Bond van Belastingbetalers tegenaan is gelopen

MPs Mulder and Van Hijum asked why the Bond van Belastingbetalers could not learn which firms received subsidies under the Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven scheme, and whether recipients and uses would be published. The minister agreed in principle to publish recipients and amounts for 2011 (excluding sole traders), but refused to disclose the specific security measures funded, citing the risk to firms and staff.
I am certainly willing to make public which companies received subsidy in 2011 under Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven and which amounts these companies received.
Ik ben zeker bereid bekend te maken welke bedrijven in 2011 subsidie hebben ontvangen in het kader van Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven en welke bedragen deze bedrijven hebben ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over werknemers van PostNL die tijdens de staking het werk van de zelfstandige pakketbezorgers overnemen

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether PostNL was right to call on its staff to deliver parcels with private cars during the strike by self-employed couriers, whether this breaches the right to strike, and how staff were insured. The minister said the parties reached an agreement, that the right to strike is for courts to weigh case by case, and that PostNL insures its staff and would be held liable as client in case of third-party damage.
It is therefore not for me but, where applicable, for the court to judge any possible conflict with the right to strike.
Het is dus niet aan mij maar in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen over eventuele strijdigheid met het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat online zoeken naar gezondheidsgerelateerde informatie privacyrisico’s met zich meebrengt

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports that online searches for health information, such as herpes, create privacy risks through tracking cookies and data leaks to third parties. The minister answered that Dutch law (Wbp, Telecommunicatiewet cookie rules) protects such data, that the CBP and ACM are investigating tracking cookies and can enforce, but gave no specific new action beyond pointing to existing supervision and public information.
The CBP cannot make further statements about these ongoing investigations.
Over deze lopende onderzoeken kan het CBP geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het aanbesteden van onderhoud en reparatie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Aanbestedingswet 2012 omitted the NACE-over-CPV priority rule, causing maintenance and repair contracts to be tendered at EU level unnecessarily and disadvantaging Dutch SMEs. The minister replied that the annexes handle the classification, that contracting authorities may choose procedures proportionately, and that the government supports a single CPV classification in EU revisions.
The Netherlands is committed to simplifying regulations.
Nederland zet zich in voor vereenvoudiging van regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ook in Nederland door justitie veel gegevens worden verzameld

Opposition MP Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch investigative services can freely query collected telecom and internet data without independent oversight, and whether foreign agencies can access it directly or bypass mutual legal assistance. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on the CIOT system, stated that queries (2.758.435 in 2012) are subject to judicial control and audits, and denied that foreign agencies have direct access, saying foreign requests always go through mutual legal assistance.

These documents describe the basis and working method of CIOT queries, the number of authorisations and the number of queries (2,758,435 queries in 2012), and the (judicial) control and supervision of the queries.

In deze stukken worden de grondslag en de werkwijze van CIOT-bevragingen beschreven, het aantal autorisaties en het aantal bevragingen (2.758.435 bevragingen in 2012) en de (rechterlijke) controle en het toezicht op de bevragingen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over het bericht ‘Barrières terug van weggeweest. Nederlandse technologiebedrijven krijgen zelfs binnen EU met belemmeringen te maken’ zoals gepubliceerd in Trouw op 19 jun

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers whether they agree that trade barriers facing Dutch tech firms, both inside and outside the EU, are a bad development and what the government will do about them. The government agreed barriers are undesirable, said most reported obstacles concern non-EU export markets, and pointed to EU initiatives, Solvit, the trade barrier complaint point and diplomatic posts as support tools.
I am happy to consult with FME-CWM to further clarify the identified problems.
Ik ga graag in overleg met FME-CWM om de gesignaleerde problemen nader te duiden
Antwoord vragen van de leden Graus en Van Vliet over de gevolgen van de voorgenomen accijnsverhoging

Two MPs from the PVV asked the ministers whether the 2013 beer excise increase and the planned 2014 increase will actually raise revenue or merely fuel excise tourism, cross-border unfair competition and revenue losses. The state secretary of Finance answered that 2013 beer excise receipts are in line with expectations, that Dutch excise applies to foreign brewers selling here, that illegal commercial trade is being tackled with the Belastingdienst and brewers' association, and that a border-effects report will be sent after the summer recess before the government decides on the 2014 increases.
After the summer recess I will send the border-effects report I promised to the House of Representatives.
Na het zomerreces zal ik de door mij toegezegde grenseffectenrapportage aan de Tweede Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Hamer over het bericht ‘NOM wil bemiddelaar om PPG te redden’

Two Labour MPs asked the Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that the Northern Development Company (NOM) wanted a mediator to save fibre-optic firm PPG, which faced closure threats amid union action. Minister Asscher answered that PPG management and union FNV Bondgenoten reached a deal through mediation by the Drenthe Commissioner of the King, that the closure threat is lifted, and that the dispute is a private matter so no further government action is needed.
The negotiations between PPG's management and FNV Bondgenoten are primarily a private matter and have since led to a good outcome.
De onderhandelingen tussen de directie van PPG en FNV Bondgenoten betreffen in eerste aanleg een private aangelegenheid en hebben intussen tot een goede uitkomst geleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-R(ail)

MP Dik-Faber asked the ministers about the status of the GSM-R interference problem caused by public mobile networks, cost liability, legal options to require better train radio equipment, EU-level action, licence conditions and 4G timing. The government answered that a coordination model is nearing completion with results due later in summer, that the legal options for mandating equipment still need study, that EU-wide work is underway, and that it cannot yet commit to a solution.
The results will become available later this summer.
De resultaten zullen later deze zomer beschikbaar komen.
Vragen van het lid RemcoDijkstra (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over schaarse grondstoffen (ingezonden 4 maart 2013).

MP Remco Dijkstra asked whether the Dutch government has sufficient insight into which scarce raw materials are critical for the economy, what the plan to secure essential materials entails, and how far cooperation with business and bilateral agreements with source countries have progressed. The minister answered that a CBS material monitor and an EU list of critical materials form the basis, that a deeper study with firms and knowledge institutions will start in summer, that the strategy combines bilateral contacts, transparency and efficiency, and that cooperation with business and other EU states such as Germany is ongoing.
Based on the EU list and additional materials supplied by industry, an in-depth study in cooperation with companies and knowledge institutions will be carried out from the summer.

Op basis van de EU-lijst en aanvullende materialen aangedragen vanuit het bedrijfsleven 2 , zal vanaf de zomer een verdiepend onderzoek in samenwerking met bedrijven en kennisinstellingen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Öztürk over het opnieuw aanscherpen van de kredietvoorwaarden voor MKB-ondernemers

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister about banks tightening credit conditions for SMEs in 2013, including whether Basel III and profit motives explain it and what the government will do to make banks fulfil their social responsibility. The minister acknowledges the problem, attributes much of it to weak demand and higher risk, points to guarantee schemes and Qredits, and says he will keep talking with banks without committing to a concrete new step.
Contacts with the banks explicitly concern the functioning of banks given this two-sided social interest.
De contacten met de banken gaan nadrukkelijk over het functioneren van banken gegeven dit tweeledige maatschappelijke belang.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Leegte en Litjes naar aanleiding van berichten in de media over de overname van energieproducent Ecopower op Bonaire door het Amerikaanse energiebedrijf Contour

MPs Bosman, Leegte and Litjens asked the ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about the electricity price rise on Bonaire caused by the dispute between Ecopower and the utility WEB, including subsidies, integrity investigations, and the role of the island government. The minister replied that prices are now cost-covering, payments are per invoice, an audit was done, the island executive is commissioning a governance review, and the Onderzoeksraad Integriteit Overheid does not cover these bodies.
I will ask the island executive of Bonaire to include this subject in that investigation.
Ik zal aan het bestuurscollege van Bonaire verzoeken om dit onderwerp bij dit onderzoek te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen Lucas, Neppérus en Ziengs over regeldruk door informatieuitvragen van de Centrale Dienst voor In- en Uitvoer van de Belastingdienst en van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

MPs Lucas, Neppérus and Ziengs (VVD) asked whether the CDIU and CBS collect statistics from contracting authorities and businesses in burdensome ways, such as postal-only responses and malfunctioning CBS software. The minister replied that TED data is incomplete, so missing data is requested directly, that the new Aanbestedingswet moves notifications to TenderNed, and that about 98% of statistical burden on businesses stems from EU regulation, with CBS working to reduce it.
The intention is to have the collection of data related to the statistical obligation go electronically via TenderNed in the future.
Het is de bedoeling om in de toekomst de verzameling van gegevens in verband met de statistiekverplichting elektronisch via TenderNed te laten verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, Hoogland en De Rouwe over aanleg en beheer van wandel- en fietsroutes

MPs asked about the state of national walking and cycling route networks, their financing after central funding ended, obstruction by waterboards and infrastructure, and planning protection. The government replied that responsibility for these networks now rests with the regions, that it will not intervene, and that it will not add new reporting obligations.
With the signing of the Nature Governance Agreement, care for the national route networks is the responsibility of the regions (mainly provinces, municipalities and recreation boards).
Met de ondertekening van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur is de zorg voor de Landelijke Routenetwerken de verantwoordelijkheid van de regio (met name provincies, gemeenten en recreatieschappen).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht ‘Nederland laat fiscale kansen liggen om verder te vergroenen’

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Netherlands is missing fiscal opportunities to green its economy, including KPMG's ranking, recent green tax changes and removals, and the employment effects of green taxation. The government answered that the Netherlands is already a frontrunner in environmental taxes, listed the recent measures and their rationale, and said further green taxation is constrained by level-playing-field concerns and that new taxes work best at EU level.
I share the view that green fiscal policy can have positive effects on innovation, the environment and sustainability.
Ik deel de mening dat fiscale vergroening positieve effecten kan hebben op innovatie, milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie (EC) naar een vermeend Europees oliekartel

MPs Kuiken, Jan Vos and Mei Li Vos asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the European Commission's investigation into a suspected European oil cartel, including its evidence, duration, scope, Dutch consumer harm, and the role of the ACM competition authority. The minister replied that the Commission has been very restrained and gave no concrete evidence beyond its press release, that the ACM can assist and must decide independently whether to investigate, and summarized Germany's Bundeskartellamt fuel-market study.
Because of the importance of the investigation, the European Commission is very restrained in giving statements that touch on the content of its investigations.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang is de Europee Commissie zeer terughoudend in het geven van mededelingen die de inhoud van haar onderzoeken raken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de auto van de zaak voor het autogebruik

MPs Bashir and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers whether they endorse Van Ommeren's analysis that the company car tax regime causes large economic losses through extra car travel, parking and vehicle choice. State Secretary Weekers rejected the analysis and its conclusions, arguing the evidence for the claimed effects is weak and that existing tax burdens and employer incentives already address these issues.
No, I endorse neither the main lines of the analysis nor all of the conclusions.
Nee, ik onderschrijf noch de hoofdlijnen van de analyse noch alle conclusies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Graus over het bericht “EU wil meer concurrentie met haven Rotterdam”

PVV MPs Madlener and Graus asked ministers whether the government would act against EU port-liberalisation proposals that could strengthen competitors of Rotterdam and how much EU money would fund them. The minister said the Port Regulation is still being studied, that TEN-T funds are not linked to the regulation and effects on the second Maasvlakte cannot yet be stated, and that the Netherlands opposes unfair competition and will treat all applications equally.
Via the BNC procedure I will inform you as agreed no later than 14 June 2013.
Via de BNC procedure zal ik u volgens afspraak uiterlijk op 14 juni 2013 informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Kerstens over zzp'ers die door de Bbz-regeling in de knel raken

MPs asked whether self-employed people on Bbz benefits are being pushed into financial trouble when a Bbz loan is converted into a non-repayable benefit, causing loss of allowances, and how the tax office and municipalities handle the annual statement and this conversion. The minister answered that the conversion is taxed in the year of definitive determination, that individual cases fall to municipalities and the tax secrecy duty, suggested adjusting income estimates for allowances, and said he will ask the state secretary to explore options and inform the House.
However, I have persuaded the state secretary of Finance to explore other options to mitigate or remove the described effects.
Wel heb ik de staatssecretaris van Financiën bereid gevonden andere mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de geschetste effecten te matigen dan wel weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat er gesjoemeld zou worden met groene stroom

MPs Jan Vos and Agnes Mulder asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that green electricity was being sold using imported guarantees of origin, which may not reflect new domestic renewable capacity, and about consumer transparency. The minister confirmed the practice has been possible under EU rules for some time, said consumers can already differentiate products, and called on suppliers to state country of origin on energy labels while declining to create a single comparison system.
I think the country of origin is useful information for the consumer and I believe stating it contributes to transparency.
Ik denk dat het land van herkomst zinvolle informatie is voor de consument en vind dat het vermelden hiervan bijdraagt aan de transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Oztürk over de ontwikkeling van winkelruimte

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about rising retail vacancy and whether municipalities should be restrained from developing new shop space, including whether the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation is applied and supervised. The minister acknowledged rising vacancy, said local tailoring and the ladder suffice, rejected intervention at a set vacancy level and new provincial instruments, and did not commission research on the ladder's application.
I will not restrict municipalities in the development possibilities included in existing zoning plans.
Ik ga gemeenten niet beperken in de ontwikkelmogelijkheden die in vigerende bestemmingsplannen zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat criminelen in toenemende mate APAAN gebruiken als grondstof voor de productie van synthetische harddrugs

MP Oskam asked ministers whether criminals increasingly use APAAN as a precursor for synthetic hard drugs, and why it is not listed under the Dutch precursor law or the EU registered-substances list. The government confirmed rising seizures and conversion labs, explained that the Den Bosch ruling concerned precursor registration rather than drug status, said the appeal was partially withdrawn pending EU Court preliminary questions, and declined to ban APAAN under the Opium Act because it is not a psychoactive drug.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has argued at EU level that APAAN should be placed on the list of registered substances.
Verder heeft Nederland in EU verband bepleit dat APAAN op de lijst met geregistreerde stoffen komt te staan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over het (voorbarig publiceren van het) advies omtrent etikettering van producten uit Joodse nederzettingen

The MP De Roon asks why the draft advice on labelling products from Israeli settlements was published prematurely, whether labelling is a politically motivated and discriminatory measure, and whether it breaches WTO rules. The minister replies that the advice concerns technical guidance to businesses on correct origin labelling under existing EU rules, that a draft was posted by mistake and then removed, and that no trade sanction or special labelling is involved.
AgentschapNL unintentionally placed a draft advice on the website, while consultations within the EU and national decision-making were not yet concluded.
AgentschapNL heeft onbedoeld een concept advies op de website geplaatst, terwijl consultaties binnen de EU en nationale besluitvorming nog niet waren afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de biermarkt en het markt- en procedeergedrag van Heineken

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about alleged aggressive market and litigation conduct by Heineken towards cafe owners and rivals, including whether it breaches competition law, whether the ACM is investigating abuse of dominance, and whether unfair trading rules should extend to businesses. The minister declined to comment on private disputes, said the ACM is analysing the horeca beer market and will report soon, and opposed extending consumer unfair-practice rules to business relations, favouring self-regulation.
Because of the importance of the investigation, the ACM makes no statements about (possible) ongoing investigations into infringements of the Competition Act.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang doet de ACM geen uitspraken over (mogelijke) lopende onderzoeken naar overtredingen van de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de benoeming van Marco van Kalleveen in een commissie voor goed bestuur

An SP MP asked why Marco van Kalleveen, a former Bain Capital vice-president, was appointed to a commission drafting a governance code for the semi-public sector, and whether his role contributed to misconduct there. The minister replied that the commission was balanced and that Van Kalleveen's private-sector experience in advising boards on strategy and oversight is valuable, without addressing the misconduct question directly.
When composing the commission, the aim was a balanced distribution of experience and expertise on governance and oversight in the (semi-)public and private sectors.
Bij het samenstellen van de commissie is gezocht naar een evenwichtige verdeling van ervaring en expertise op het terrein van bestuur en toezicht in de (semi)publieke en private sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over de impact van de veranderende Nederlandse energiemarkt

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the financial impact of a changing energy market: overcapacity, unprofitable gas and coal plants, biomass co-firing for the renewables target, supply security, and the investment climate given the national coal tax. The minister largely agrees with the PwC/IPA picture, says supply security is guaranteed to 2019 and likely to 2027, treats plant closures as a market matter, and rejects national CO2 measures as ineffective under the ETS.
I have no insight into the profitability or loss-making of individual electricity plants.
Ik heb geen inzicht in winst- of verliesgevendheid van individuele elektriciteitscentrales.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de DigiNotar-affaire op basis van WOB-stukken

An MP asked the government twelve questions about how operational management of DigiNotar was taken over after its 2011 certificate breach, including the legal basis, the scope of the power of attorney and the user lists. The minister answered that only operational management was taken over under a power of attorney from VASCO, with no specific statutory basis, and pointed to the Wob decisions for the detailed description.
DigiNotar was not taken over de facto. Only operational management was taken over after good consultation with VASCO.
DigiNotar is niet de facto overgenomen. Alleen het operationeel management is overgenomen na goed overleg met VASCO.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat in vergelijking met andere Europese landen het mobiele dataverkeer in Nederland het duurst is

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether mobile data prices in the Netherlands, reportedly the highest in Europe, indicate an insufficiently functioning market and what the minister will do about it. Minister Kamp disagrees that the market is failing, citing the report's narrow focus on premium data-only plans and difficulties in international comparison, but promises to study how to make a more meaningful price comparison and report in autumn.
I will investigate how we can arrive at a more meaningful international comparison of mobile telecommunications tariffs and will inform you of the outcomes of such a comparison this autumn.

Ik ga onderzoeken hoe we tot een betekenisvollere internationale vergelijking kunnen komen van mobiele telecommunicatietarieven en zal u over de uitkomsten van zo'n vergelijking dit najaar informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het aandeel hernieuwbare energie vrijwel gelijk is gebleven

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why renewable energy's share barely rose in 2012 and what will be done about energy efficiency, wind targets and innovation. The minister attributed the stagnation to rising total energy consumption, said the SDE+ scheme will still reach the 16% target by 2020, and promised a further letter on energy efficiency soon.
There are currently two tracks underway regarding energy efficiency.
Op dit moment lopen er twee trajecten ten aanzien van energie-efficiëntie
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de mogelijke verkoop van URENCO

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands intends to sell its URENCO shares, whether the promised legal and financial investigation is complete, and how public interests such as non-proliferation and safety would be safeguarded after a sale. The minister confirmed the intention to sell in response to the UK and German private shareholders wishing to exit, said the public interests must be effectively secured first, and that the exact arrangements are still under discussion with the UK, Germany and the German shareholders.
The cabinet has – as a result of the wish of the United Kingdom and the German shareholders E.on and RWE to sell their URENCO shares – the intention to also divest the Dutch shares.

Het kabinet heeft – als gevolg van de wens van het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de Duitse aandeelhouders E.on en RWE om de aandelen in URENCO te verkopen – het voornemen om ook de Nederlandse aandelen te vervreemden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat PostNL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked why PostNL, after reducing jobs for employees with disabilities, now plans to employ people with work disabilities as postal deliverers, and whether this replaces costlier staff. The government answered that PostNL denies disadvantaging disabled staff, that the job cuts stem from market changes, and that it sees no evidence of replacing employees with cheaper workers.
I have no indications that PostNL found its own employees with disabilities too expensive and is now replacing them with cheaper workers with disabilities.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat PostNL de eigen medewerkers met een beperking te duur vond en deze nu vervangt door goedkopere werknemers met een beperking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacyvoorwaarden bij apps en ander mobiel telefoongebruik

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about app privacy terms, Apple's user terms, and whether mobile location data can be traced to individuals. Minister Kamp answered that privacy law requires clear, readable terms and informed consent, that the matter of specific producer-consumer relations is not for him to judge, and that consumers can complain to the Autoriteit Consument & Markt and the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens.
It is not for me to pass judgment on how that relationship is shaped.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de invulling van die relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het toenemend aantal regels

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether the number of regulations has risen, whether decentralisation explains this, and how regulatory burden is defined and reduced. The minister says decentralisation adds local tailoring that increases rules but lowers measured burden, outlines a 2.5 billion euro burden-reduction target and joint programmes with municipalities.
It is not for me to judge the quality of regulation by decentralised governments.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de kwaliteit van regelgeving van decentrale overheden.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over het wegnemen van belemmeringen voor de bouw van een Russische olieterminal in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the economics minister how he had actively helped remove obstacles for a Russian-linked oil terminal in Rotterdam port, what permits were involved, whether security risks existed, and how the operator was selected. The minister replied that the obstacles concerned WWII explosives surveys delaying a lease, that he made no promises on permits which follow regular procedures before the province and municipality, and that the port authority chose the operator through an open procedure in which he was not involved.
There is no question of commitments on my part regarding the permit procedures.
Van toezeggingen mijnerzijds aangaande de vergunningprocedures is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Paulus Jansen over een belastingaanslag over wateronttrekking ten behoeve van een installatie voor warmte-koudeopslag

MPs Van Tongeren and Paulus Jansen asked whether a heat-cold storage (WKO) installation that extracts and reinjects groundwater was liable for groundwater tax under the Wbm, and why nine-year-old residents in Etten-Leur received an assessment. The State Secretary answered that the exemption required a permit, closed-loop reinjection into the same aquifer, and compliance with permit conditions, that the tax was abolished from 1 January 2012, and that he had no indication the inspector misinterpreted the law, citing tax confidentiality for concrete cases.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation, I cannot provide information on concrete cases.
In verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik over concrete gevallen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de olie- en gasopslag in Groningen

MPs asked whether oil storage in Eemshaven, licensed on older earthquake assumptions, must be made earthquake-proof, whether systematic risk studies cover licensed firms, and whether NAM should pay for upgrades. The government replied that Vopak is still assessing its terminal, that 11 studies including effects of quakes above 3.9 Richter are underway, that NAM will be approached if preventive upgrades are needed, and that COVA can rely on Vopak's licence compliance.
As part of the 11 studies mentioned, the possible surface effects of an earthquake larger than 3.9 Richter are also being examined.
Als onderdeel van de genoemde 11 onderzoeken wordt ook onderzocht wat de mogelijke effecten aan het oppervlak zijn van een aardbeving groter dan 3.9 Richter
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Kernafval net over de grens’ in het Dagblad van het Noorden van 11 april 2011

Three PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether plans exist to store nuclear waste in salt domes across the border from Vlagtwedde, and about health, drinking water and consultation with Groningen and Germany. The minister replied that Germany has no concrete site plans yet, only a renewed site search with a committee report due in 2015, and that Dutch policy favours geological disposal while contact with Germany would follow if a border site emerged.
There are no plans in Germany to store radioactive waste just across the border near Vlagtwedde.
Er zijn in Duitsland geen plannen om radioactief afval vlak over de grens bij Vlagtwedde op te slaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de vrijheid van telecombedrijven bij het aanbieden en in rekening brengen van mobiel dataverkeer

An MP asked the economic affairs minister how consumers can be protected from unexpectedly high mobile data bills, including blocked-data subscribers still being charged and the lack of insight into data use. The minister said providers bear primary responsibility, pointed to a 2012 transparency code and existing alerts and dispute-committee routes, and declined to commit to new legislation.
I consider it first and foremost the responsibility of the providers to properly inform consumers about their products and services.
Ik vind het allereerst de verantwoordelijkheid van de aanbieders om consumenten goed te informeren over hun producten en diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Klever over Iraanse gasexport naar Nederland

MPs De Roon and Klever asked whether the government would investigate Iranian claims of gas exports to the Netherlands in 2012 despite sanctions, and how it assessed existing Iran sanctions. The minister replied that the sanctions are effective, that the EU gas import ban only took effect on 21 December 2012 so no violation occurred for earlier exports, and that EU sanctions have territorial reach, so no international investigation is pursued, though the EU lobbies third countries to join.
As a result, there is no violation of sanctions if gas was exported to the Netherlands before that date.
Hierdoor is er geen sprake van overtreding van sancties indien voor die datum gas naar Nederland is geëxporteerd.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de Garantieregeling Scheepsnieuwbouwfinanciering

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs and Infrastructure ministers whether the shipbuilding loan guarantee (GSF) applies to inland vessels, why it is not extended to modernisation, and what the budget and risks are. The minister answered that the guarantee is a level-playing-field measure for shipyards, not a capacity stimulus, that it covers new builds with a ceiling of 1 billion euro per year, and that modernisation is excluded to preserve EU state-aid compliance.
The purpose of the GSF is to enable shipyards to finance the construction of a vessel, not to stimulate an increase in inland shipping capacity.
Doel van de GSF is scheepswerven in staat te stellen de financiering van de bouw van een schip te realiseren en niet om de vergroting van de capaciteit in de binnenvaart te stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Middenstand boos op KPN’

An MP asks whether telecom providers like KPN may charge extra for outages they cause and whether they are legally bound to fix standard faults, and asks about the cost to SMEs. The minister says parties may agree paid higher service levels, that providers have a statutory duty to keep services available, cites KPN figures on extra service contract costs, and says KPN will consider communicating shorter repair times while the government reviews further protection for business users.
I believe parties should have the freedom to make additional agreements on more extensive service provision.
Ik vind dat partijen de vrijheid moeten hebben om aanvullende afspraken te maken over verdergaande serviceverlening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de onderhoudsstop van de kerncentrale Borssele

An SP MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the timing of the maintenance outage at the Borssele nuclear plant, whether the whole reactor vessel is inspected given its age, the inspection technique used, and whether the outage is long enough for a full scan. The minister answered that the outage runs from 12 April to about 17 May 2013, that the vessel is inspected ultrasonically under an expanded programme, and that the regulator will extend the inspection if the results warrant it.
Should the outcomes of the measurements give reason for it, the investigation will be extended.
Mochten de uitkomsten van de metingen daartoe aanleiding geven wordt het onderzoek uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en De Liefde over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten kiezen voor het vrijwillig melden van cybersecurity incidenten

Two MPs from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about reports that the United States opts for voluntary reporting of cybersecurity incidents while the EU proposes a mandatory reporting duty, and about the consequences for Dutch citizens, businesses and cloud computing. The minister answered that the EU proposal does include a reporting obligation, that Dutch legislation on a reporting duty is being prepared, that the US executive order relies on voluntary sharing with privacy safeguards, and that the government will take the differences into account in EU negotiations.
Antwoord vragen Öztürk over het kennisgebrek ten aanzien van verplichtingen van MKB-ondernemers

An MP asked the ministers whether a survey finding that half of SME owners do not know they must pay sick wages for up to two years, absent insurance, signals a dangerous knowledge gap, and what causes and remedies exist. The minister replied that about 80% of small employers hold sickness insurance, so most are informed, that information is widely available, and no new measures were announced.
In particular, the fact that 80% of small employers have insurance indicates that most employers have informed themselves well (or had themselves informed).
Met name het feit dat 80% van de kleine werkgevers een verzekering heeft, duidt er op dat de meeste werkgevers zich goed (hebben laten) informeren.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat Post NL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked whether PostNL's plan to employ about 500 people with work disabilities as part-time postal deliverers, via secondment from sheltered workshops or social assistance, risks displacing regular workers and serving as cheap labour. The state secretary called the initiative positive, said PostNL reports no displacement, and said no indications of exploitation exist, while declining to cancel planned cuts to sheltered workshops.
I currently have no indications that there is any displacement or exploitation.
Ik heb thans geen aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van verdringing en uitbuiting.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de column op www.boerenbusiness.nl dat Deutsche Bank in strijd handelt met de zorgplicht

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether Deutsche Bank breaches its duty of care by terminating credit agreements with about 18,000 clients and enforcing high break fees, and whether DNB and the AFM should intervene. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the courts, not he or the supervisors, must judge civil-law duties, that the bank's strategy change is its own business decision, and that the bank has promised to find individual solutions.
On your questions concerning alleged violation of civil-law norms, I cannot give an answer.
Op uw vragen die betrekking hebben op vermeende schending van civielrechtelijke normen, kan ik geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord vragen Klever over de gevolgen van de energietransitie voor onze werkgelegenheid, concurrentiepositie en staatskas

An MP from the PVV asked the economics minister about the effects of the energy transition on jobs, competitiveness and state revenue, citing German criticism and a TNO report, and asked whether the government would pause to analyse these consequences first. The minister replied that the Netherlands pursues a cost-efficient transition via SDE+ and innovation, gave a table of declining gas revenues to 2017, and said the SER national energy accord will model economic and affordability effects before it is finalised in summer.
In the Netherlands we aim for a cost-efficient transition to a sustainable energy supply.
In Nederland streven we naar een kostenefficiënte overgang naar een duurzame energievoorziening.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Öztürk en Mei Li Vos over de heffing door het Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel voor het jaar 2013

MPs Öztürk and Mei Li Vos asked why the Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel raised its 2013 levy above the previous year's level, how this relates to the planned abolition of the product and trade boards, and whether levy payers are properly informed. Minister Kamp replied that the increase reflects provisioning for the wind-down, higher purchasing costs and lost subsidies, that the board holds reserves insufficient to cover closure costs including a social plan, and that existing information duties suffice so no additional measures are needed.
I am of the view that, beyond the applicable statutory obligations and the supervision exercised over them, no additional measures are necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat er, naast de geldende wettelijke verplichtingen en het daarop gehouden toezicht, geen aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over de verhoogde verplichte heffing van het af te schaffen van het Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel (HBD)

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he knows the Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel raised its compulsory levy from €79 to €110, whether this rise is unwelcome, and whether a levy could still be imposed in 2014. The minister confirmed the increase, explained it as covering the wind-down costs and higher purchasing costs, and said levies may still be imposed until the bodies are formally abolished, while promising to inform parliament this spring.
I will, as promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, inform your House this spring about the process to abolish the product and industry boards.

Ik zal uw Kamer, zoals toegezegd tijdens de behandeling van de begroting van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, dit voorjaar informeren over het traject tot opheffing van de product- en bedrijfschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Gesthuizen en Schouten over de berichtgeving dat winkeliers boetes moeten betalen als ze niet meedoen aan de koopzondagen

MPs from CDA, SGP, SP and ChristenUnie asked the Economics Minister whether fines for shops that refuse Sunday opening, reportedly written into leases, restrict entrepreneurial freedom, and how widespread such clauses are. The minister replied that private parties are free to set lease terms, that EU freedom of establishment does not apply to private commercial relations, that the government will not intervene in contractual freedom, and that he has no overview of how many shops face such fines.
I am not aware of how often penalty clauses are included in contracts.
Het is mij niet bekend hoe vaak er boeteclausules in overeenkomsten worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen De Liefde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Jumbo verstuurt 3-procentsbrief aan leveranciers huismerk’

MPs De Liefde and Lodders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that Daymon unilaterally imposed a 3% discount on Jumbo's private-label suppliers and how this relates to the unfair trading practices code and related motions. The minister said commercial negotiations are a matter between firms, that the government facilitates a self-regulatory code with dispute resolution, that legislation would only be considered if self-regulation fails, and that the motions will be addressed by letters before summer.
The government should in principle interfere as little as possible in this.
De overheid hoort zich daarmee in beginsel zo min mogelijk te bemoeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van de overname van Deutsche Bank voor diverse klantengroepen

An MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about Deutsche Bank Nederland dropping 18,000 clients, whether boetevrij exit should be allowed, what tools the government and DNB have, and whether the 2007 ABN Amro/HBU sale was flawed. The minister answers that the bank's strategic and contractual decisions are its own, that case-by-case solutions are expected, and that he will press the bank in a meeting.
It is not for me to directly intervene in the strategic decision of an individual bank or in the contractual relationship between a bank and its customers.
Het is niet aan mij om rechtstreeks in te grijpen in de strategische beslissing van een individuele bank of in de contractuele relatie tussen een bank en haar klanten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mogelijke marktverstoring door Keuringsinstituut Kiwa

An MP asked the economics minister whether the keuringsinstituut Kiwa's unfounded claims about declining solar panel yields and its planned quality register distort the market, and whether an independent solar quality mark is needed. The minister said he has no professional view on Kiwa's claims, that Kiwa is a commercial firm responsible for its own statements, and that government oversight of solar panel safety rests with the NVWA under the Warenwet, leaving a quality mark to the sector.
I have no professional opinion on this. Kiwa itself bears responsibility for its statements.
Ik heb hier geen professionele mening over. Kiwa draagt zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vos Mei Li en Vos Jan over het bericht ”Brandgevaar bij 650 duizend zonnepanelen”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked about reports of fire hazards in 650,000 solar panels, whether all systems can be tested before summer, whether the company was obliged to report known defects, whether other manufacturers' panels are linked to fires, whether certification registers should be mandatory and linked to subsidies, and who is liable for buyers of a bankrupt manufacturer's panels. The minister answered that testing is the producers' responsibility, that the NVWA advises owners to switch off the affected system, that failure to report known dangers is an economic offence, that no other fires are known, that certification is voluntary and mandating it is not desirable, and that liability is a civil matter handled by the curator and insurer.
Testing of solar panel systems is the responsibility of the companies that place the products on the market, not of the NVWA.
Keuring van zonnepaneelsystemen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven die de producten in de handel brengen en niet van de NVWA.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het realiteitsgehalte van het bestuursakkoord IPO/Rijk over 6.000 megawatt wind op land

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether the provincial site realty check for 6,000 MW onshore wind had been completed, what the provinces' guarantee in the 2013 administrative accord means, and what happens if sites are annulled by courts. Minister Kamp answered that the Bosch en Van Rijn report was finished, found the IPO bid fell short, and that extra agreements now require provinces to guarantee 6,000 MW with monitoring but no legal sanctions.
The report was completed on 22 March 2013. You will find the report attached to the answer.
Het rapport is op 22 maart 2013 afgerond. U treft het rapport als bijlage bij de beantwoording aan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klever over het bericht «EU leitet Beihilfeverfahren gegen Deutschland ein»

An MP asked the Economics minister whether the EU's state-aid investigation into German energy transport-cost exemptions affects Dutch industry, notably aluminium smelter Aldel, and what the government will do to protect jobs. The minister answered that the investigation supports the Dutch position, that a Dutch scheme capped at 50% should not be treated as unlawful aid, and that EU rules apply equally to all member states.
I will maintain contact with the EC to stay informed about the possible shape of European legal frameworks regarding a large-consumer scheme.
Ik zal contact onderhouden met EC om op de hoogte te blijven van de mogelijke invulling van Europese juridische kaders omtrent een grootverbruikerregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jan Vos met betrekking tot het bericht dat het onderzoek naar schaliegas niet onafhankelijk genoeg wordt uitgevoerd

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether criticism from the advisory reference group on the shale gas research, and reports that the research is not independent enough, is cause for concern and what will be done. The minister says the reference group is a constructive feedback channel, that the research will be transparent and reviewed by the EIA commission, and that the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment will be involved through the Structuurvisie Ondergrond without accepting a bigger role in carrying out the research.
Insofar as these points fall within the scope of the research, they will be taken into account and incorporated.
Voor zover deze punten onder de scope van het onderzoek vallen, worden deze meegenomen en verwerkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber met betrekking tot schaliegas

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Cuadrilla's preliminary shale gas research near Luttelgeest or Marknesse amounts to test drilling, what the studies cover, whether the municipality was consulted, and how other shale gas drilling requests will be assessed. The minister answered that no drilling will take place during the research, that only an exploration permit has been granted with further permits needed before drilling, and that an independent study on the risks of shale gas is due on 1 July.
I want to emphasise that no test drilling will be carried out in the announced Cuadrilla research.
Ik wil hierbij benadrukken dat er bij het aangekondigde onderzoek van Cuadrilla geen proefboringen geplaatst worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht dat ZZP’ers (zelfstandigen zonder personeel) slachtoffer zijn van cybercriminaliteit

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice whether they recognise a trend of cybercriminals targeting sole traders and small firms, some going bankrupt, and what will be done about it. The government said it has no information on such a trend or on bankruptcy figures, points to an ongoing police study and a planned survey in Flevoland, and lists awareness campaigns and websites for SMEs and sole traders.
We have no information about the trend reported in the article that cybercriminals increasingly target sole traders and small firms.
Wij hebben geen informatie over de in het artikel gesignaleerde trend dat cybercriminelen het in toenemende mate voorzien hebben op eenmansbedrijven en kleine ondernemingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Wolbert over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT treatment of self-employed nurses in healthcare, including whether unclear rules create unfair competition and why inspectors allegedly apply rules inconsistently. The State Secretary answered that self-employed nurses working under a hospital's supervision are VAT-liable, denied inconsistent enforcement, and said the Tax Administration has informed the sector and updated its public guidance.
I do not recognise the criticism that tax inspectors apply the rules inconsistently.
Ik herken de kritiek niet dat belastinginspecteurs de regels niet eenduidig zouden hanteren.
Vragen van het lid Leegte (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de elektriciteitsprijzen (ingezonden 6 februari 2013).

MP Leegte (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Dutch electricity wholesale prices are diverging from European prices, whether the Netherlands has become the most expensive country, and what the competitiveness risk is. Minister Kamp answered that Northwest European markets are strongly converging, that the Netherlands is slightly above Germany by about 4 euro per MWh due to German renewables support, and that measures are underway to further integrate markets.
I recently agreed with my German colleagues to jointly examine how renewable energy can become more part of the market.
Ik heb recent met mijn Duitse collega's afgesproken om gezamenlijk te gaan bekijken hoe duurzame energie meer onderdeel kan gaan uitmaken van de markt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Kerstens en Hamer over ‘het onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden in de Nederlandse pakketdienstensector’.

MPs Mei Li Vos, Hamer and Kerstens asked ministers about working conditions and bogus self-employment among parcel couriers, including PostNL subcontracting, VAR certificates, and whether the Inspectorates and competition authority should intervene. The government acknowledged the problems are undesirable, said bogus self-employment should be prevented and an action plan would follow, announced inspections and an exploratory study, and declined to disclose details of agreements with specific taxpayers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-rail

An MP asked the state secretary and economic affairs minister about GSM-R rail interference from the 4G frequency auction, including cost allocation, EU access rules, and legal options. The government replied that a coordination model is nearly finished and that it will answer the questions substantively in April, deferring full answers until then.
For a correct and complete answer to the questions posed, it is in our view desirable that the development of this model has been completed.
Voor een juiste en volledige beantwoording van de gestelde Kamervragen is het volgens ons gewenst dat de ontwikkeling van dit model is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten nog meer mogelijkheden heeft om in clouddata graaien

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw (D66) asked whether US law (the FISAA, extended on 30 December 2012) lets US authorities access personal data stored in the EU by US-based cloud providers, and what the consequences and remedies are. The state secretary answered that the Act grants no new powers, that no concrete cases of such demands for EU-stored data are known (US authorities say requests go via mutual legal assistance), and that the government will raise the issue in the EU data protection regulation negotiations.
Negotiations are under way in Brussels on a General Data Protection Regulation.
Er wordt in Brussel onderhandeld over een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over het bericht in het Financieele Dagblad van 27 februari 2013 “TNO reikt reddingsboei aan om worstelende topinstituten voor omvallen te behouden”

MP Lucas asked the minister of Economic Affairs about TNO's offer to take over struggling Technological Top Institutes, the alleged coercive contracting and competitive distortion, the request for a 40 million euro matching fund, and whether TNO's statutory tasks still count as pre-competitive. The minister defended multi-year public-private cooperation, denied that any coercion occurs, said matching is primarily for the knowledge institutions, and committed to review cooperation rules and to address TNO's statutory tasks in a forthcoming policy letter.
Regarding matching, I point to the principle that the consideration of it is in the first instance a matter for the knowledge institutions themselves.
Ten aanzien van matching wijs ik op het uitgangspunt dat de afweging daarvan in eerste instantie een zaak is van de kennisinstellingen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over verlichting en energiebesparing

An MP asks whether the Netherlands should follow France in requiring offices and shops to switch off lighting at night to save energy, and how much energy this would save. The minister answers that switching off unnecessary lighting is sensible, estimates 2 PJ savings, but rejects a blanket obligation, pointing to existing building and activity-decree rules and promising a further energy-saving plan in spring 2013.
An obligation to switch off all lighting is not an obvious course in the Netherlands.
Een verplichting om alle verlichting uit te schakelen ligt in Nederland niet voor de hand.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over de NMa opinie "Versterking landbouw vraagt om innovatie, niet om minder concurrentie"

An MP asked the ministers about an NMa opinion arguing that strengthening agriculture requires innovation rather than less competition, and whether the NMa's language about MEPs and national politicians undermines its independence. The minister answered that the NMa's opinion is within its independent role, that the government supports producer organisations under the CAP reform while keeping competition rules, and that the NMa will supervise compliance with competition rules.
The NMa, from its economic expertise, states how it views the CAP reforms and the role competition should play in them.
De NMa geeft vanuit haar economische expertise aan hoe zij aankijkt tegen de hervormingen in het GLB en de rol die mededinging daar in zou moeten nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Monasch over het bericht dat Nederland meer zonnepanelen wil

MPs Jan Vos and Monasch asked whether the government will engage with the energy and construction sectors to take firm steps toward more solar panels in new buildings, given public support. The minister welcomed the enthusiasm, said the market is growing well and that intervention would distort it, so he sees no reason for extra action.
I therefore see no reason to undertake additional activities.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om extra activiteiten te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het vooruitlopen van diverse gemeenten op mogelijke wijziging van de Winkeltijdenwet

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether municipalities that tolerate Sunday opening in breach of the current Shop Hours Act should be stopped, and what leverage the minister has. The minister answered that such municipalities should enforce the law, that he has no direct means to force enforcement, that stakeholders can request enforcement and appeal to the administrative court, and that the ministry is consulting the VNG on a weighing framework for a guideline.
