I have no means at my disposal to ensure that municipalities take enforcement action.
Ik heb geen middelen tot mijn beschikking om ervoor te zorgen dat gemeenten handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over bloedkolen uit Colombia

An MP asks whether Dutch power plants import coal from Colombia linked to labour, environmental and security abuses, and asks about the coal dialogue, supplier transparency and the role of trade and development policy. The minister says Colombia bears primary responsibility, companies should follow due diligence, the coal dialogue and Better Coal are the preferred route, and full supplier disclosure is not yet required.
Self-regulation based on dialogue, as described in the answers to questions 6, 8 and 7, is my preference.
Zelfregulering op basis van dialoog zoals beschreven in de antwoorden op de vragen 6,8 en 7 heeft mijn voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het stimuleren van innovatie en concurrentie bij aanbestedingen

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about a court ruling on a government ICT tender for SAP licences, the legal unity of the state in procurement, reuse of systems, vendor lock-in and openness to innovative suppliers. The minister answered that the ruling gives no reason to revise procurement policy, that the tender was lawfully split into two lots, that the state's procurement decision levels follow EU criteria, and that the government aims to avoid lock-in and engage the market.
The ruling in this case gives no reason to revise the Dutch central government's current procurement policy, whether or not for ICT.
De uitspraak in deze zaak geeft geen aanleiding het huidige aanbestedingsbeleid van de Rijksoverheid, al dan niet ten aanzien van ICT, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de winstgevendheid van warmtekrachtkoppelingsinstallaties (WKK) in de glastuinbouw sterk is gedaald

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the profitability of combined heat and power (WKK) installations in horticulture has fallen, partly due to coal-fired plants, and about CO2 effects, ETS, flexibility, gas price manipulation and possible support for WKK. The minister answered that electricity production is a market outcome, that investment risk lies with entrepreneurs, that energy policy is technology-neutral, and that REMIT legislation on market integrity has been submitted to parliament.
Energy and climate policy aims at generic promotion of clean and efficient production, leaving technology choice to market parties as far as possible.
Het energie- en klimaatbeleid is gericht op generieke stimulering van schone en efficiënte productie, waarbij zoveel mogelijk de technologiekeuze bij marktpartijen wordt gelaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de uitspraken over fusies van ziekenhuizen

An MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers whether competition authority NMa treats hospital mergers more strictly than hospital cooperation, and whether it discourages cooperation while nudging hospitals toward mergers. The minister replies that NMa is meant to target cartels, not useful cooperation, that NMa issues informal opinions only on request, and that a dedicated merger test for healthcare is being legislated.
The supervision by the NMa is aimed at combating cartels.
Het toezicht van de NMa is erop gericht om kartels tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de juistheid van de berichten dat Deutsche Bank een toezegging doet aan boeren die met hun hele financiering naar een andere bank gaan

An MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether Deutsche Bank's reported pledge to let farmers leave without penalty is accurate, how break-fee clauses apply to split loans and swaps, and whether the bank's changed lending policy will be put in writing. The minister says Deutsche Bank will work with clients to find solutions, may revisit break fees, and will inform clients about its strategy in April 2013, but he declines to intervene in the bank's commercial strategy and defends break-fee clauses in general.
It is not for me to directly intervene in the strategic decision of an individual bank.
Het is niet aan mij om rechtstreeks in te grijpen in de strategische beslissing van een individuele bank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Mei Li Vos over afspraken tussen spooraannemers over de prijs van onderhoud van het spoor

MPs Hoogland and Mei Li Vos asked whether rail contractors Volker Rail, BAM Rail and Strukton Rail were engaging in unlawful price agreements on track maintenance, whether the competition authority should be consulted, and how the government would respond to a pending court ruling on performance-based maintenance (PGO) tenders and the experience with those contracts. The state secretary replied that there were no concrete indications of cartel behaviour, that the NMa supervises competition and may investigate, that ProRail was vindicated and may proceed with the Eemland award, and that PGO contracts have raised quality and lowered costs according to ProRail, with further inspection research underway.
At this moment I have no concrete indications that this is the case regarding the agreements between rail contractors.
Op dit moment heb ik geen concrete aanwijzingen dat daarvan in het geval van de afspraken tussen spooraannemers sprake is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘EU: China dupeert Europese staalmarkt’

MP Agnes Mulder asked whether the government agrees with the European Commission's findings that China subsidises its steel industry and its proposal to impose duties of up to 50 percent on Chinese coated steel. Minister Ploumen answered that the Commission analysis is confidential within an ongoing anti-subsidy procedure, that the government supports countervailing duties where subsidies and injury are established, and that it is following the sector and participating in the High Level Roundtable.
The European Commission's analysis is a confidential document within an ongoing anti-subsidy investigation.
De analyse van de Europese Commissie betreft een vertrouwelijk document in het kader van een lopend antisubsidie onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Wolbert en Ziengs over het verklaren van Ruinerwold tot een beschermd dorpsgezicht door de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

Three MPs asked why the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed designates Ruinerwold as a protected village view despite opposition from the municipal council and the province, and what this means for economic development and solar panels. The minister explains the designation procedure, that municipal and provincial advice plays an important role but cultural-historical values are leading, and that the municipality decides on permits without blocking development or renewable energy.
The cultural-historical values are leading in the designation procedure, but the advice of the municipal council and Provincial Executive plays an important role in the weighing towards the decision.
De cultuurhistorische waarden zijn bij de aanwijzingsprocedure leidend, maar de adviezen van de gemeenteraad en van Gedeputeerde Staten spelen een belangrijke rol bij de afweging tot het besluit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over het bericht «Geen doorstart voor fosforfabrikant Thermphos»

MPs Vos and De Vries asked the ministers about the failure to find a buyer for Thermphos's Vlissingen plant, job losses, and who bears liability for dismantling and remediating the site. The minister answered that no buyer or going-concern prospect exists, government actively supported the curators, job losses are being addressed regionally, and liability questions remain with the curators, with no commitment to new legal measures beyond exploring them with the infrastructure minister.
For licence holders of nuclear reactors there is currently a statutory obligation to ensure funds are available for dismantling and remediation under all circumstances.

Voor vergunninghouders van kernreactoren bestaat er op dit moment een wettelijke verplichting om ervoor te zorgen dat er onder alle omstandigheden gelden beschikbaar zijn voor ontmanteling en sanering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Knops over het bericht dat honderdduizenden Nederlanders teveel betalen voor gas

MPs Agnes Mulder and Knops asked the minister whether consumers are overpaying for gas transport because of oversized connections, whether tariffs should be lowered, and whether they will be compensated. The minister disputed the VEH's conclusions, said the regulator NMa sets tariffs and he cannot compel lower ones, and noted that network operators will offer free downsizing and review compensation case by case.
I cannot force the network operators to lower the gas transport tariffs.
Ik kan de netbeheerders niet dwingen de tarieven voor het transport van gas naar beneden bij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de cookiemuur van de Publieke Omroep niet rechtsgeldig is

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the government how it would respond to the CBP's criticism of the public broadcaster NPO's cookie wall, which denies access to sites for users who refuse tracking cookies, and what steps it would take. The state secretary said OPTA and the CBP are responsible for enforcement, that the government will consult the NPO within a month on alternatives, and that tracking cookies are not needed for basic site functions.
It is up to OPTA to judge the lawfulness of the NPO's conduct in light of the cookie provision.
Het is dus aan OPTA om een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de NPO in het licht van de cookiebepaling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Litjens over het bericht ‘Zaak Dommelsvoort Cuijk uitgesteld’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether she had refused permission to relocate a badger family from Dommelsvoort to Gassels Broek because the replacement habitat was not yet ready, and whether she would talk with the municipality of Cuijk as the court had suggested. The State Secretary confirmed the habitat is not yet of sufficient quality, said talks with the parties are ongoing, and expected a solution around mid-year without pre-empting the court case.
I do not want to anticipate the outcome, partly because the case is before the court.
Op de uitkomst daarvan wil ik niet vooruitlopen, mede ook omdat de zaak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de kosten verbonden aan creditcardbetalingen

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked about the high cost of credit card payments for retailers, whether card companies may charge above cost, whether the EU consumer rights directive will curb fees, whether Dutch action should not await EU payment services rules, and whether the regulators should investigate. The minister answered that retailers negotiate with their payment provider, that no action is warranted now, that the directive limits surcharges to actual costs, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and may start its own investigation.
I currently see no reason to take action in this area.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om actie op dit vlak te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de hoge betalingskosten voor verkopende partijen bij PayPal

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about high PayPal fees charged to sellers, whether a legal cap applies, and whether the EU consumer rights directive or a regulator investigation would change this. The minister answered that no legal maximum exists, that consumers are protected from excessive surcharges by the directive, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and has been informed of the concerns.
The NMa is an independent regulator, so it is not for me to ask it to investigate certain markets.
De NMa is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder, het is dan ook niet aan mij om haar te verzoeken onderzoek te doen naar bepaalde markten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over het bericht dat Polen en Tsjechië schakelaars aan de grens bouwen om de dump van wisselvallige windstroom uit Duitsland te keren

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about Poland and Czechia building phase shifter transformers at the German border, the consequences for Dutch supply and economy, and lessons from Norwegian wind policy and local opposition to windmills. The minister answers that PSTs are already used by the Netherlands and Belgium, that the effects are limited and coordinated with TSOs, that wind lowers prices, and that the issues are already under consideration.
I want to make concrete agreements with Germany quickly.
Ik wil snel concrete afspraken maken met Duitsland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Schouw over het bericht dat er nauwelijks controle is op het rookverbod in de horeca

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether enforcement of the smoking ban in hospitality is too thin, given roughly 3,154 targeted checks by the NVWA in 2012, uneven regional coverage and reported fine figures. The state secretary answered that enforcement is as optimal as current capacity allows, that the problem is concentrated in cafés and discotheques, that about 4,000 targeted checks are planned for 2013, and that he is examining options to expand enforcement capacity.
I am currently examining the options to increase enforcement capacity.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment de mogelijkheden om de handhavingscapaciteit te vergroten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het aanbieden en uitzetten van kweekwild voor de jacht en consumptie

An MP from the Animal Party asked whether a company breeding wild animals for hunting and consumption could be selling them for release in the wild, and whether the sale of farmed game should be controlled or labelled. The state secretary replied that releasing animals is prohibited under the Flora and Fauna Act but breeding and trade are allowed, that cross-border free movement means released animals may end up sold in the Netherlands, and that no additional labelling or consumer information is planned.
Releasing animals is prohibited (Article 14 of the Flora and Fauna Act).
Het uitzetten van dieren is verboden (artikel 14 Flora- en faunawet).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over multi level marketing

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice about multi-level marketing practices (including ACN's telecom sales), whether they are misleading or illegal pyramid schemes, and whether consumer and gambling authorities are informed. The government answered that MLM is a lawful sales method, that the Consumer Authority and Gambling Authority supervise compliance with existing law, that no change to legislation is currently needed, and that it will not judge individual companies.
It does not befit me to give a judgment on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over onderzoek naar Q-koorts in Herpen

MP Van Gerven asked about the status of a Q-fever foundation with ten million euros for research, and whether the minister would support a population study in Herpen proposed by provincial health authorities. The minister referred to an earlier letter on the foundation, said experts advised against general screening but a targeted study in Herpen could be funded as an incidental project subject to ethical conditions.
Because the Q-fever foundation is still being set up and there is a broadly shared wish to start this research quickly, I will finance this as an incidental project
Omdat de stichting inzake Q-koorts nog in oprichting is en er een breed gedragen wens is om snel met dit onderzoek te starten, zal ik dit als een incidenteel project financieren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken inzake de stroomtarieven van aluminiumproducent Aldel

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the electricity tariffs facing aluminium producer Aldel, a German grid-cost exemption for large consumers, and unfair European competition. The minister replied that a Dutch equivalent of the German rule is being studied within the STROOM legislative agenda, that the Commission's state-aid view is awaited, and that a concrete compensation scheme is under consideration.
Because of the redistribution effects, it is important to consider any large-consumer scheme in an integrated way within the broader revision of tariff regulation under the STROOM legislative agenda.

Vanwege de herverdelingseffecten is het van belang een eventuele grootverbruikerregeling integraal te bezien binnen de bredere herziening van de tariefregulering die plaatsvindt binnen de wetgevingsagenda STROOM.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leegte over Pressemitteilung van het Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Technologie in Duitsland over de stroomprijscompensatie voor energie-intensieve bedrijven

MP Leegte asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a German press release announcing electricity price compensation for energy-intensive firms, and what it means for Dutch competitiveness. The minister answered that Germany's compensation may distort the level playing field for Dutch firms, that the Dutch cabinet is still deciding how to use EUR 375 million from 2014, and that details will be sent to parliament in Q2 2013.
At this moment I do not want to anticipate a precise allocation of the 375 million.
Op dit moment wil ik niet vooruit lopen op een precieze invulling van de 375 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de proportionaliteit van een Europese aanbesteding van sleepdiensten door de inkoopafdeling van de politie

An MP asked whether the police joint-procurement body's Europe-wide tender for towing and storage services, which bundles contracts and sets a EUR 5 million turnover requirement, is proportionate and whether it will exclude small firms. The minister answered that the tender is lawful under current rules, the turnover requirement is within case-law limits, and that the new Procurement Act will restrict such requirements from April 2013.
Under the currently applicable rules, I consider this tender proportionate.
Onder de nu geldende regelgeving acht ik deze aanbesteding proportioneel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de verhouding tussen de gebiedsvisie van de provincie Drenthe en lopende grote windprojecten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how two large wind park projects under the national coordination scheme (RCR) relate to the Drenthe provincial wind area vision that omits them, and whether they will proceed after the national wind structure vision is adopted. The minister answered that the national scheme applies by law, that the projects will be tested against the national vision and an MER study including one provincial variant, and that certainty can only come at the decision stage.

Certainty about the continuation of the currently ongoing RCR projects can only be given at the moment of decision-making on the relevant zoning plans, based on the necessary MER study and the frameworks then established in the national wind structure vision.

Zekerheid over het doorgaan van de nu lopende RCR-projecten kan pas worden gegeven op het moment van besluitvorming omtrent de betreffende inpassingsplannen op basis van het daarvoor noodzakelijke (MER)-onderzoek en de dan vastgestelde kaders van de Rijksstructuurvisie wind op land.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu van activiteiten in het Waddengebied

An MP asked about the cumulative effects on nature and environment of activities in the Wadden Sea, including salt mining by Frisia, shrinking ebb-tidal deltas, the number of permits, and whether the ministry will coordinate cumulative assessment. The State Secretary answered that permits for Frisia are still pending, that effects will be monitored with a hand-on-the-tap approach, that cumulative effects are assessed by each competent authority, and that no ministry coordination or regional talks are deemed necessary.
I am of the view that the cumulative effects on nature and environment are adequately mapped through the legal instruments described above when assessing new activities.
Ik ben van mening dat de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu door bovenbeschreven wettelijk instrumentarium adequaat in beeld worden gebracht bij het toetsen van nieuwe activiteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat jongeren onder 18 jaar nog steeds tot zonnebankstudio’s worden toegelaten

MPs Bruins Slot and Geurts asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that studios still admit under-18s to sunbeds, with many non-member studios breaking the age rule. Minister Schippers acknowledged non-compliance (about 80% overall compliance, higher among SVZ members), defended existing Warenwet rules and NVWA enforcement, and declined for now to criminalise minors or introduce an age-check obligation.
For now, the current legislation, aimed at sunbed providers, is sufficient.
Vooralsnog is de huidige wetgeving, gericht op de aanbieders van zonnebanken, afdoende.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht «Chemische bedrijven investeren te weinig»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that chemical companies are investing too little, whether this is typical for the sector, whether SMEs and large firms differ, how it fits with innovation contracts under the Top Sector Chemistry, and what the government does about raw material prices. The minister attributes the investment decline to Asian market growth, weak European growth and lower energy costs elsewhere, says it is a European rather than Dutch phenomenon, outlines existing raw materials policy and EU/international efforts, and does not commit to new concrete action.
The chemical industry invests over EUR 43.4 million in cash in the TKIs in 2013 alone.
De chemische industrie investeert ruim € 43,4 miljoen alleen al in cash in de TKI’s in 2013.
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug over het gebrek aan breedband in buitengebieden

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the lack of broadband in rural areas, including whether universal service obligations should cover broadband. The minister answered that nearly all households have broadband and that the market plus targeted government and provincial initiatives address remaining gaps, rejecting a change to universal service.
No, as indicated in question 4: broadband internet is in practice already available universally in the Netherlands.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in vraag 4: breedbandinternet is in Nederland in de praktijk al «universeel» beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Liefde over de postbezorging op de BES-eilanden

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the postal service on the Caribbean Netherlands islands and whether the current operator, Nieuwe Post NV, is claiming about 2 million guilders in compensation for losses. The minister answered that no adequate accountant-backed evidence of losses was given and no legal basis for compensation exists, that an external exploration found alternative operators interested, and that the concession will be extended only up to one year while a new tender is prepared, with Parliament to be informed of the outcome.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of this tender process.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van dit gunningsproces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over onredelijke schuldeisers waardoor er onnodig bedrijven failliet gaan

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Dutch bankruptcy law gives creditors too strong a position, causing firms to fail unnecessarily or relocate abroad, and whether a court could bind unreasonable creditors before bankruptcy. Minister Opstelten acknowledged the problem, announced a bankruptcy law reform programme with stakeholder consultation and comparative research, but gave no firm commitment to a quick bill and said fraud prevention currently has priority.
That is why I have also announced legislation providing for the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.
Daarom heb ik ook wetgeving aangekondigd die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het bericht “‘Land- en tuinbouw goed voor 10 pct van economie en werkgelegenheid', NRCnext checkt”

An MP asked why the government website still claimed agriculture is 10% of the economy after the minister had conceded the primary sector is only about 1.2% of GDP, and whether the figure would be corrected. The state secretary agreed to correct the website, saying the broader agro-complex (including processing and supply) accounts for about 10%, and committed to distinguishing these sectors clearly in future communication.
To give a correct picture, the government website has been adjusted so that the Dutch agro-complex accounts for about 10% of the Dutch economy and employment.
Voor een correct beeld is de website van de Rijksoverheid aangepast in die zin dat het Nederlandse agrocomplex goed is voor circa 10% van de Nederlandse economie en werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het advies van de federatie Goud en Zilver aan juweliers om geen gebruik meer te maken van de pakketdienst van PostNL

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Federation Goud en Zilver advised jewellers to stop using PostNL parcel delivery after parcels went missing, and about PostNL's handling of complaints and subcontracted delivery workload. The minister replied that the federation only advised using better-secured parcel services, that complaint volumes showed no clear increase, that PostNL is liable only in limited cases, and that he will monitor complaints linked to PostNL's reorganisation.
I committed during the Voortgezet Algemeen Overleg of 28 November 2012 to monitor the complaints arising from the reorganisation and to provide an analysis.
Ik heb tijdens het Voortgezet Algemeen Overleg van 28 november 2012 toegezegd de klachten naar aanleiding van de reorganisatie te volgen en van een analyse te voorzien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over aanstaande facturen van de product- en bedrijfschappen

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked whether the government knows that product and trade boards are already sending invoices for 2013, when the abolition of the boards will take effect, whether boards should waive levies if they hold reserves, and when the last invoices will be sent. The minister answers that the boards will be abolished as agreed in the coalition agreement, public tasks will move to the ministry from 2014, a legislative process will start, and levies may still be needed until abolition because reserves may not cover long-term obligations.
Until the moment of abolition, the boards constitute administrative bodies with their own board, responsibility and the power to impose levies.
Tot het moment van opheffing vormen de schappen bestuurslichamen met een eigen bestuur, verantwoordelijkheid en de bevoegdheid om heffingen op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over de gebrekkige handhaving van de wet controle rechtspersonen en faillissementsfraude

Two MPs asked why the Wet controle rechtspersonen and its Radar system, meant to block convicted bankruptcy fraudsters from founding companies, have produced only about ten referrals, why costs rose to 18.7 million euro, and whether the law is a paper tiger. The minister replied that the system was deliberately started small, that Radar already can analyse other legal persons, that risk reports are valued by users, and that a separate letter on bankruptcy fraud was sent on 27 November 2012.

Supervision of legal persons was started in a limited and controlled way, in consultation with the supervisory and investigative bodies, and was tailored as far as possible to the needs of the receiving parties.
Het toezicht op rechtspersonen is, in overleg met de toezichthoudende en opsporende instanties, beperkt en beheerst gestart en is zoveel mogelijk toegesneden op de behoefte van de afnemende partijen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Geurts en Lodders inzake introductiemoment groepshuisvesting drachtige zeugen

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the minister why the 4-day group housing requirement for pregnant sows is kept, whether it harms animal welfare, the environment and farmers' competitiveness, and whether it should be relaxed. The minister answered that research and agreements with sector parties justify keeping the requirement, that farmers with management problems will be supported through a good-practice guide, and that no relaxation is planned.
I therefore see no other reason than to maintain the introduction of pregnant sows into the group four days after mating and to accelerate the drafting of a guide of good practices.
Ik zie dan ook geen andere reden dan vast te houden aan de introductie van drachtige zeugen na vier dagen na dekken in de groep en het versneld opstellen van een gids van goede praktijken
Antwoord vragen De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Subsidie voor erotische zitzak’

MPs De Graaf and Klever asked the minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on a subsidy for an erotic beanbag, its public benefit, whether such subsidies are pointless, and a full list of innovation subsidies since 2005. The minister answered that the WBSO is a generic tax scheme judged effective, that the government does not determine project goals, and that fiscal scheme projects cannot be listed due to tax secrecy, while stating it will keep generic innovation schemes.
This is a generic fiscal scheme aimed at encouraging companies in all sectors of the economy to innovate.
Dit is een generieke fiscale regeling die er op gericht is bedrijven in alle sectoren van de economie aan te zetten tot innovatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het voorstel voor een gasfonds

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs about a proposed gas fund, the use of gas revenues, sovereign wealth funds and future budget effects of declining gas income. The minister says the fund idea comes from a working group on communication about mining, that it is up to industry to finance any such fund, and that the government is studying the proposals and will inform parliament before the budget debate.
I am currently studying the working group's proposals and will then decide which ones will be taken up for further elaboration.
Ik ben nu bezig de voorstellen van de werkgroep te bestuderen en zal daarna beslissen welke opgepakt zullen worden voor nadere uitwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dikkers en Recourt over het bericht dat er tritium in het grondwater is gekomen door een lek van de reactor in Petten

MPs Jan Vos, Dikkers and Recourt asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports of tritium in groundwater from a leak at the Petten reactor, including how long the leak went unnoticed, the amount released, health risks, and prevention. Minister Kamp answered that the leak was found on 11 November 2012, roughly 10 GBq was estimated released, RIVM saw no direct health risk, and NRG is repairing the pipe and cleaning up under KFD supervision, with further inspection and tightened maintenance.
The KFD has instructed NRG to tighten and carry out the inspection and maintenance programme.
De KFD heeft NRG opgedragen om het inspectie- en onderhoudsprogramma aan te scherpen en uit te voeren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Knops over de mogelijke sluiting van de centrale Buggenum

MPs Agnes Mulder and Knops asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the possible closure of the Buggenum Willem-Alexander power plant, its jobs, the government's options to keep it open, and security of supply. The minister answered that closure is a market decision by Nuon, that the government does not steer which plants stay open, and that security of supply remains good.
I have brought this to the attention of Nuon.
Ik heb dit onder de aandacht gebracht van Nuon.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacy van internetters

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether personal data of a 16-year-old was handed to the state by Skype without a valid request, and how many such cases occur per year. The minister explains that police may not request voluntary data disclosure, that spontaneous third-party disclosures are permitted with a proces-verbaal, and that no statistics on such cases are kept.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep statistics on the number of cases in which personal data was spontaneously provided to investigators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt geen statistieken bij over het aantal gevallen waarin spontaan persoonsgegevens aan de opsporing zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Agnes Mulder over kolencentrales Maasvlakte

Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the coal plants at Maasvlakte, including whether the CCS subsidies and conditions for the plants were at risk and what the consequences would be for energy supply, emissions and renewables. The minister answered that the subsidies are not lost, the plants are under construction and not conditioned on CCS in their permits, and that the government remains confident in the ROAD CCS project.
The EEPR subsidy and the national co-financing are not lost for CCS if no clarity arrives in the short term.
De EEPR-subsidie en de nationale cofinanciering gaan niet voor CCS verloren als er op korte termijn geen duidelijkheid komt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de inkomenspositie van zzp’ers

An MP asked the ministers whether self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) are increasingly turning to food banks, which municipalities are affected, whether they are informed about social assistance and local tax relief, and how their income has changed. The minister replied that food-bank client data is not kept by government, pointed to information portals and municipal duties, noted that the rules for local-tax relief for small entrepreneurs are being amended, and cited CBS and EIM data showing a diverse group with a small average income decline in 2011.
Data on the client base of food banks are not kept by the government.
Gegevens over het klantenbestand van voedselbanken worden door de overheid niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Heerma over een tekort aan stageplaatsen in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo)

MPs Rog and Heerma (CDA) asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about the shortage of internship places in vocational education (mbo), including the causes, the proposal of a tax benefit for employers, the link to the labour market and youth unemployment. The minister answers that the economic crisis is the main cause, that the tax deduction will be converted into a better-targeted subsidy, that SBB will launch an internship offensive, and that the government will monitor youth unemployment and consider further measures.
The cabinet closely monitors the development of youth unemployment and is entering into discussions with social partners to see whether additional measures are needed.
Het kabinet houdt de ontwikkeling van de jeugdwerkloosheid nauwgezet in de gaten en treedt in gesprek met sociale partners om te bezien of aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Maij over landroof in Mozambique

MPs Van Dijk and Maij asked the government about land grabbing linked to tree plantations in Niassa, Mozambique, the GSFF investment, ABP pension fund oversight, and possible monitoring mechanisms. The minister answered that the report captures real problems but is incomplete, that the new GSFF management has taken steps, and that ABP's oversight body discussed the investment, while the ministry will raise the report's recommendations in the next consultation.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will, as sector employer for the central government, raise the report's recommendations at the next meeting between the Verantwoordingsorgaan and the ABP board where responsible investment is discussed.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal – als sectorwerkgever Rijk – de aanbevelingen in het rapport in het eerstvolgende overleg tussen het Verantwoordingsorgaan en het ABP-bestuur waar over verantwoord beleggen wordt gesproken, inbrengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het artikel «Innovatie stokt bij goede intenties»

MP Jan Vos asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report that innovation is stalling, questioning whether public-private research contracts worth about 500 million euros a year have been concluded and how this squares with earlier commitments, and about the broader top sectors policy. The minister answers that the innovation contracts are a broader agenda, that the 500 million euro TKI target for 2015 stands, and that the government is supporting SMEs and generic instruments alongside sector-specific policy.
I have no reason to assume that this ambition will not be realised.
Ik heb geen enkele reden om aan te nemen dat deze ambitie niet wordt gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het wegebben van steun van kennisinstellingen en bedrijfsleven aan het innovatiebeleid van het ministerie

An SP MP asks the Economics Minister whether declining support from knowledge institutions and business for the ministry's innovation policy, and a planned EUR 110 million cut, threaten the innovation agenda. The minister answers that the stimulus funding was temporary, that the top-sector policy is being made structural, and that private R&D is expected to rise, while detailed budget breakdowns will follow later.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Veen over de economische kosten van mislukte bedrijfsoverdrachten

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the economic costs of failed business transfers, citing a report claiming EUR 4 billion annual turnover loss and 80,000 jobs lost. The minister rejected the report's conclusions as based on a hypothetical total-inactivity assumption, pointed to existing support (KvK advice, guarantee schemes), and saw no need for additional measures.
No, I cannot endorse these conclusions, because the study assumed the hypothetical situation that all failed business transfers and closures of healthy firms lead to total inactivity.

Nee, ik kan deze conclusies niet onderschrijven, doordat in het onderzoek is uitgegaan van de hypothetische situatie dat alle mislukte bedrijfsoverdrachten en opheffingen van gezonde bedrijven leiden tot totale inactiviteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over fiscale bevoordeling van overuren door buitenlandse seizoenwerkers

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the arrangement agreed between LTO Nederland and the Tax Authority, allowing overtime pay to be converted into tax-free housing and travel allowances for foreign seasonal workers, reduces tax and premium revenue, distorts competition, encourages overtime, and whether unions were consulted. The minister replied that the Tax Authority's explanation fits existing law, that no revenue is lost because an existing exemption is used, that competition and overtime incentives are not affected, and that consultation with unions was not needed.
This concerns an explanation that fits within the current legal framework and the Tax Authority's current policy.
Het gaat hier om een uitleg die past binnen de huidige wettelijke kaders en het huidige beleid van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de TV-serie Barbie’s Baby en het bericht ‘Holleeder-geknuffel moet stoppen’

MP Bisschop asked ministers whether broadcasting a TV series featuring a baby and a planned Holleeder interview were acceptable, and whether child labour rules and child protection were adequately applied. The minister answered that broadcasters are responsible for content and that the Labour Inspectorate issued a fine report because the producer had no exemption for child work, while stating that parents are primarily responsible and child protection intervention was not triggered.
The Labour Inspectorate has drawn up a fine report.
De Inspectie SZW heeft een boeterapport opgemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer, Kerstens en Monasch over "Bouwbedrijven rommelen met faillissementen"

MPs Hamer, Kerstens and Monasch asked minister Kamp whether he would act on reports of construction firms abusing bankruptcies, dismissals of workers rehired as self-employed, and threats to collective sector agreements. The minister answered that government has no active role in preventing bankruptcy fraud beyond criminal enforcement, that dismissal permits are granted only for genuine self-employed workers, and that no signals of endangered sector arrangements exist, with an SER advice pending.
As already indicated in answering earlier parliamentary questions on bankruptcy fraud, the government has no role in preventing and combating bankruptcy fraud.
Zoals bij de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over het onderwerp faillissementsfraude al is aangegeven heeft de overheid geen rol bij het voorkomen en bestrijden van faillissementsfraude.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Ministerie ziet een duidelijke toename arbeidsuitbuiting”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of rising labour exploitation, whether zero tolerance applies, how many fines, sanctions or work stoppages were imposed, and what will be done to prevent it. The minister confirmed zero tolerance, explained the new sanctions law (effective 1 January 2013) and stated that court rulings on six completed investigations are still pending, so no details on violations or recidivism can be given.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "particuliere pensioenproducten en de bijstand"

MP Karabulut asked whether it is acceptable that people saving for retirement through private third-pillar products must deplete those savings before receiving social assistance, unlike second-pillar pension savers, and asked for numbers and financial consequences of changing the asset test. The state secretary answered that there is no legal inequality, that the government is studying self-employed pension saving and may consider exempting third-pillar pensions, but declined to give the financial consequences.
Based on the outcomes of this research, it may be considered to examine further whether it is desirable, and if so, how, to exempt third-pillar pension assets from the social assistance asset test.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek kan worden overwogen om nader te onderzoeken of het wenselijk is, en zo ja, hoe
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over "Boete voor roken buiten pauze"

An MP asked the state secretary whether an employer may fine employees who smoke outside breaks under health policy, and whether such a fine is compatible with the Tobacco Act and the Civil Code. The state secretary answered that the fining rules were agreed with the works council, that the Civil Code limits fines and gives courts power to reduce them, and that enforcement of the Tobacco Act lies with the NVWA, not the Inspectie SZW.
I am of the view that IHC thereby complies with the regulations.
Ik ben van mening dat IHC daarmee voldoet aan de regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het gebrek aan voortgang van de ambitie om meer vrouwen in topfuncties te benoemen

An MP asked the government why the share of women in top public-sector posts has stagnated and what role government should play in reaching the 30% target. The minister reports a small rise in women among senior civil servants (20% in 2008 to 25.9% in 2012), attributes slow progress largely to cuts, and defers the question of a government role to the incoming cabinet.
Whether and to what extent the government should have an exemplary role in the coming years is a matter for the new cabinet.
Of en in hoeverre de overheid de komende jaren een voorbeeldfunctie moet hebben is een zaak voor het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over de banenmarkt die werd georganiseerd door de stichting Studie en Werken op Maat voor WO en HBO afgestudeerden met een beperking

MP Heerma asked whether a job fair for university and HBO graduates with disabilities, organised with BZK, had taken place, what it yielded, and why hiring distinguished between people with and without a Wajong benefit. The minister answered that the Rijk expanded its presence after private employers withdrew, 27 candidates got follow-up interviews, the state does not register disabilities, and hiring only selects on the benefit indication to meet a parliamentary 1% motion.
It is not registered whether a person has a disability. Registration of disabilities is not permitted under the Personal Data Protection Act.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd of men een beperking heeft. Registratie van beperkingen is op grond van de Wet bescherming Persoonsgegevens niet toegestaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht "steeds meer ouders gebruiken kinderopvangtoeslag als extra salaris"

An SGP MP asked whether parents using childcare allowance as extra income is a government responsibility, whether the childcare allowance system inherently leads to misuse, whether a universal basic parenting budget should be considered, and whether maintaining the childcare subsidy is fiscally irresponsible given a CPB study. The state secretary answered that paying for childcare is a matter between parents and providers, the allowance is directly linked to costs so misuse is not inherent, a universal budget is not pursued because the existing scheme already covers child costs, and the CPB shows the allowance raised female labour participation while cuts were justified by rising costs.
No. The childcare allowance is a percentage of the costs parents incur for using childcare.
Nee. De kinderopvangtoeslag is een percentage van de kosten die ouders maken voor het gebruik van kinderopvang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over het bericht "kinderdagverblijven kampen met problemen door wanbetalende ouders"

An MP asked whether childcare centres face rising non-payment by parents, whether this is fraud, and what measures the government will take, including a blacklist and direct payment of childcare allowance to centres. The state secretary said non-payment is a matter between centres and parents, that no national figures on non-payers exist, that no government role is seen beyond possible direct payment arrangements being worked out with the sector.
Information on the development of the number of non-payers across all childcare institutions is not known.
Informatie over de ontwikkeling van het aantal wanbetalers voor het totale aantal kinderopvanginstellingen is niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bodemloze put van re-integratie

An SP MP asked the state secretary about 10 billion euros spent on commercial reintegration firms with unclear job outcomes, and whether municipalities should instead provide placement themselves and whether the performance of firms like Fourstar will be investigated. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold broad discretion, gave rough CBS figures on about 367,000 people placed in work, rejected both the call to ban private providers and any national investigation into individual firms, and refused to discuss individual cases.
It is up to the municipalities to choose the most effective use of commercial parties.
Het is aan de gemeenten om de meest effectieve inzet van commerciële partijen te kiezen.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya over het beperkte aantal re-integratietrajecten voor 45-plussers

An MP asked the minister about the low number of re-integration trajectories for workers over 45 and the poor job-finding rate of older unemployed people. The state secretary answered that UWV and municipalities decide on instruments, that research shows no age difference in net effectiveness, and that older people need other measures alongside re-integration.
The UWV and municipalities are responsible for implementing re-integration policy; they decide which instrument is used for whom.
Het UWV en gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het re-integratiebeleid; door hen wordt besloten welk instrument voor wie wordt ingezet.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over "administratieve rompslomp voor parttime zzp'ers"

MP Hamer asked whether part-time self-employed workers struggle to obtain a VAR WUO declaration from the Tax Authority, causing them to lose assignments, and whether government will help solve this and send a letter by 1 October 2012. The state secretary answered that the VAR assessment applies uniform criteria to all applicants, that part-timers less often qualify as entrepreneurs under existing case law, and that a web module will be introduced to make the qualification process more transparent, with no change to the legal definition planned.

I am of the view that a web module can provide clarity to the client and contractor about the classification of their working relationship and the associated rights and obligations, so that both parties know where they stand.

Ik ben van mening dat een webmodule duidelijkheid kan bieden aan opdrachtgever en opdrachtnemer over de kwalificatie van hun arbeidsrelatie en de bijbehorende rechten en plichten zodat beide partijen weten waar ze aan toe zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de derivatenpositie en de risicobeheersing van pensioenfondsen en andere instellingen

An MP asks the minister whether pension fund derivative counterparty risk is adequately managed and requests a breakdown of derivative positions in public and semi-public institutions by sector and institution. The government answers that the risk is adequately controlled, that no per-institution overview exists at ministry level, and that several ministries are reviewing whether to tighten rules and supervision.
Currently the ministries do not have overviews of derivative positions per institution.
Momenteel beschikken de ministeries niet over overzichten van derivatenposities per instelling.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum over de gevolgen van het vernieuwde jobcoachprotocol

An MP asks whether the revised job coach protocol, which ends support after three years except for an exception clause, is causing employers to dismiss young disabled workers, and whether UWV rarely honours exception requests. The state secretary replies that rejection rates barely changed, that 81% of long-term job coach recipients still have jobs, and that the trend of mass dismissals is not confirmed by the figures.
The picture that job coaching support is being ended on a large scale by the new Protocol is not reflected in the figures.
Het beeld dat op grote schaal voorzieningen jobcoaching worden beëindigd door het nieuwe Protocol is niet terug te zien in de cijfers.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over "de oneerlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden op de bouwplaatsen in de Eemshaven"

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the minister about alleged underpayment of Romanian workers below the CAO construction wage at Eemshaven construction sites and the limits of inspection and enforcement. The state secretary replied that the Inspectorate SZW found Minimum Wage Act violations at Forklift, that CAO enforcement is primarily the responsibility of the social partners, and pointed to the EU enforcement directive proposal on chain liability while avoiding commitments on new measures.
Enforcement of collective agreements, like their creation, content and compliance, primarily falls under the responsibility of the social partners.
De handhaving van cao's valt – net als de totstandkoming, de inhoud en naleving van cao's – primair onder de verantwoordelijkheid van cao-partijen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Neppérus en Lodders over de vermindering van pensioenaanspraken van particuliere pensioen bv’s

MPs Neppérus and Lodders asked why directors-major shareholders of private pension BVs cannot reduce pension entitlements as pension funds can, and whether the Adviescommissie's advice to widen the tax rule was considered. The state secretary answered that the rules cannot be widened without disproportionate costs and that a limited one-off reduction at pension start will be proposed in the Belastingplan 2013.

I intend to include in the Belastingplan 2013 a proposal under which, in certain cases and under strict conditions, a one-off reduction of pension entitlements built up in own management can take place at the pension start date.

Ik ben voornemens in het Belastingplan 2013 een voorstel op te nemen op grond waarvan in bepaalde gevallen en onder strikte voorwaarden op pensioeningangsdatum (eenmalig) een vermindering van in eigen beheer opgebouwde pensioenaanspraken kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar, Van Klaveren en Wilders over "het ‘ramadan-proof’ maken van cao’s"

PVV MPs asked whether collective labour agreements should accommodate Ramadan, asked about economic costs of Ramadan fasting, and whether Muslims should work in Islamic countries. The minister answered that employers and employees may agree facilitation of religious activities, that direct discrimination on religion is prohibited under equal treatment law, that costs are unknown, and that such arrangements are the employee's own responsibility.
It is the employee's own responsibility to make good arrangements with the employer when he or she wishes to take time off work to take part in such activities in private life.

Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de werknemer om goede afspraken met zijn werkgever te maken wanneer hij of zij vrij wil nemen van het werk voor deelname aan dergelijke activiteiten in de privésfeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over ruim half miljoen werklozen in Nederland

An MP asks the Social Affairs minister whether the government's deficit-reduction course is failing to tackle the rise above half a million unemployed, and whether it will adopt a youth unemployment action plan and sector support for construction. The minister replies that fiscal repair is a precondition for recovery, that rising unemployment is not reason to revise the budget package, that a youth action plan already ran in 2009 and regional follow-up continues, that construction support is rejected as costly and obstructive, and that the WW budget effect is already within forecasts.
A precondition for economic recovery is the restoration of public finances.
Randvoorwaarde voor economisch herstel is het herstel van de overheidsfinanciën.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Dibi over "het bericht dat de werkloosheid sterk is toegenomen"

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in unemployment to 510,000 and rising youth unemployment, asking for extra measures, a European youth guarantee and a special Eurotop. The minister replied that the rise is mainly due to weak growth and expected to continue until 2014, that budget consolidation and structural reforms are the answer, and that the youth unemployment level compares well within Europe.
Only with a strong and healthy economy can employment grow.
Alleen met een sterke en gezonde economie kan de werkgelegenheid groeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over een discriminerende vacature

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked why UWV and the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling could not act against a job advert excluding people on benefits, and what measures would prevent such adverts. The state secretary said exclusion on benefit receipt is not a protected ground, that CGB could act only if it constituted indirect discrimination on a protected ground, and that the government will ask the SER for advice on labour market discrimination.
The cabinet intends to request advice from the Social and Economic Council (SER) on labour market discrimination.
Wel kan ik melden dat het kabinet voornemens is om aan de Sociaal Economische Raad (SER) een advies te vragen over het onderwerp discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer inzake het verlies van 400 arbeidsplaatsen bij DSM

An MP asked ministers whether DSM's planned loss of 400 Dutch jobs, after receiving part-time unemployment support, was justified and whether EU globalisation funds would be used if forced dismissals occur. The minister answered that the decision is DSM's responsibility, that no collective dismissal notice has been filed, and that the EGF could be considered only if the 500-dismissal threshold is met.
This decision is the responsibility of DSM.
Deze beslissing is de verantwoordelijkheid van DSM.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over "Meer klachten over discriminatie"

An MP asked about reported rises in discrimination complaints, especially in the workplace, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said complaint counts do not prove more discrimination, pointed to general measures and a planned SER advisory request on labour-market discrimination, and said the local anti-discrimination evaluation is under way.
The cabinet intends to ask the Social and Economic Council (SER) for advice on discrimination in the labour market.
Het kabinet voornemens is om aan de Sociaal Economische Raad (SER) een advies te vragen over het onderwerp discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over “het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen op de kinderopvang”

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a broad parliamentary majority now favours reversing childcare cuts, and whether the cuts will be reversed quickly. The minister replied that no majority plans to fully reverse the 2013 childcare allowance cuts, that the 2013 scheme will be published by 15 October as agreed, and that he will implement measures already approved by cabinet and both chambers.
I intend to implement the measures that the cabinet and both chambers have already agreed to.
Ik ben voornemens uitvoering te geven aan de maatregelen waar kabinet en beide Kamers reeds mee hebben ingestemd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Europa moet van onze pensioenen afblijven”

An MP asked the minister whether his Elsevier interview saying Europe must stay off Dutch pensions was authorised, how it squares with the Chamber's position on the Pension White Paper, which plans he distances himself from, and whether he will write to the Commission and has a blocking minority. The minister answered that the government supports the White Paper's general aims but has serious concerns about the IORP directive revision, which would raise buffer costs for pension funds; he says he is pursuing this via Commission contacts and cooperation with Germany, the UK and Ireland, but these four do not form a blocking minority.
However, the four countries do not form a blocking minority.
De vier landen vormen echter geen blokkerende minderheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over “de overvolle peuterspeelzalen”

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether cuts to childcare are causing overcrowding and waiting lists in playgroups, pushing toddlers with language delays out, and what action will be taken. The minister replied that he has no figures on waiting lists, that playgroups are a municipal responsibility, that municipalities can respond locally, and that he sees no displacement effect or need for new proposals.
I have no figures on waiting lists or an increasing number of children in playgroup care.
Ik heb geen cijfers over wachtlijsten of een toenemend aantal kinderen in het peuterspeelzaalwerk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over “het bericht inzake de oproep van de Aannemersfederatie om een meldplicht in te voeren voor personen uit andere EU-lidstaten, die in Nederland als zelfstandige of op detacher

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the construction federation's call for a registration duty for EU self-employed and posted workers, and about enforcement against bogus self-employment. The minister answered that a Limosa-style system is still under assessment pending an EU enforcement directive and a Court of Justice ruling, and listed existing enforcement measures and cooperation efforts.
After adoption of the Enforcement Directive and the ruling in the Commission's infringement procedure against Belgium, I will decide on introducing a system like Limosa.

Na vaststelling van de Handhavingsrichtlijn en de uitspraak in de infractieprocedure die de Commissie tegen België heeft aangespannen, zal ik een besluit nemen over de invoering van een systeem als Limosa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over de slechte positie van werksters in Nederland

An MP asked the minister why domestic cleaners (werksters) in the Netherlands lack the same rights as other employees, and about the size of the undeclared cleaning sector. The minister rejected extending full employee protections, arguing the Regeling Dienstverlening aan huis gives adequate protection and that abolishing it would revive old problems, and said he had no figures on the undeclared sector or measures planned.
I have no insight into what kinds of workers are employed in the undeclared cleaning circuit.
Antwoord 5 Ik heb geen inzicht in wat voor arbeidskrachten werkzaam zijn in het «zwarte schoonmaakcircuit».

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP), van Gent (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de slechte rechtspositie van werksters in Nederland (ingezonden 15 augustus 2012).

MPs Karabulut, van Gent and Hamer asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the weak legal position of domestic cleaners (werksters) in the Netherlands, including unclear social security, absence of a CAO, minimum wage status, enforcement of the Regeling Dienstverlening aan huis, and ratification of the 2011 ILO domestic workers convention. The minister defended the existing regulation, said current data on the number of domestic workers is unavailable, rejected a new study, dienstencheques and tax deductibility as too costly, and said ratification of the ILO convention will be considered after consulting social partners.
There is no current information available on the number of domestic helpers working under the Regeling Dienstverlening aan huis.
Er is geen actuele informatie voorhanden over het aantal huishoudelijke hulpen dat volgens de Regeling Dienstverlening aan huis werkzaam is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Çelik over het uitblijven van 'exitgesprekken' met voortijdig schoolverlaters

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the absence of exit interviews with early school leavers, who face higher unemployment and crime risk, is acceptable and whether such interviews should be mandatory, and whether the halving target should be adopted. The minister agreed interviews are sensible and promotes them through schools and parent involvement, but declined to make them mandatory, said the 2016 target of 25,000 is ambitious and that an even sharper target is not feasible, and linked youth unemployment to temporary contracts and lack of qualifications.
It is up to the educational institution to make conducting exit interviews a regular part of the deregistration procedure.
Het is aan de onderwijsinstelling om het voeren van exitgesprekken een regulier onderdeel te maken van de uitschrijfprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over "de onregelmatigheden binnen het pensioenfonds van het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)"

MPs Groot and Vermeij asked the minister whether supervision of the CBR pension fund failed given irregularities found by an Integis investigation, and what measures and remedies apply. The minister answered that the investigation concerned a separate toeslagfonds (supplementary fund) outside prudential pension supervision at the time, that current rules prohibit such standalone funds, and that correction of irregularities is for the employer and works council to resolve.
No conclusions can therefore be drawn from this investigation about supervision of the CBR pension fund.
Er kunnen aan dit onderzoek dan ook geen conclusies worden verbonden over het toezicht op het pensioenfonds van het CBR.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Timmermans over naheffing door de Duitse fiscus aan Nederlandse oud-dwangarbeiders

Two PvdA MPs asked why elderly Dutch former forced labourers received back-tax demands from the German tax authority on their German state pensions despite a stated exemption, and asked for clear Dutch-language guidance and relief. The state secretary answered that an exemption exists but requires formal recognition as 'Verfolgte', that Germany agreed to a bilateral arrangement for those who can show their pension stems from forced labour, and that Dutch-language information is available and being sent with tax forms.
He then promised to resolve this problem efficiently and without bureaucracy by also granting exemption, within bilateral consultation, to forced labourers who formally fall outside the exemption.
Hij heeft mij toen toegezegd deze problematiek op efficiënte en onbureaucratische wijze te willen oplossen door in het kader van bilateraal overleg ook vrijstelling te verlenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

An MP asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families, including in Curaçao, have their child benefit reduced under the residence-country principle, and whether they should be exempt given they pay Dutch premiums. The minister confirmed benefits are indexed to the cost level of the child's country of residence and rejected an exemption for deployed soldiers, since the rule applies to all exported benefits without special categories.
The residence-country principle means the amount of a benefit is aligned with the cost level of the country in which the beneficiary or the child lives.
Het woonlandbeginsel houdt in dat de hoogte van een uitkering wordt afgestemd op het kostenniveau van het land waarin de belanghebbende of het kind woont.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Hamer over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

MPs Eijsink and Hamer asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families are harmed by the new country-of-residence principle reducing child benefit, and whether they should be compensated. The minister replied that child benefit is now set at the cost level of the child's country of residence, that the law was not intended to target soldiers, and that no increase in the foreign allowance is planned.
The purpose is to prevent benefits paid outside the Netherlands from diverging from local standards.
Doel hiervan is te voorkomen dat uitkeringen die buiten Nederland worden verstrekt, met lokale maatstaven uit de pas lopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Jong en Wilders over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren dramatische vormen aanneemt

PVV MPs asked the ministers why unemployment among non-Western immigrant youth is so much higher than among Chinese youth, and whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants and work refusal in Rotterdam's port explain it. The minister attributed the gap to cyclical sensitivity, lower education levels and flexible contracts, rejected the claim of mass unskilled immigration and of mass work refusal, gave a welfare figure, and declined to revoke residence permits, saying non-Western migrants are treated like Western ones.
The cabinet does not treat non-Western allochtones differently from Western allochtones
Het kabinet behandelt niet- westerse allochtonen niet anders dan westerse allochtonen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over een actieplan om de sterk stijgende jeugdwerkloosheid terug te dringen

An MP asked the minister about rising youth unemployment, the gap between migrant and native youth, and whether the Netherlands should adopt a Finnish/Swedish-style youth guarantee action plan. The state secretary answered that the rise reflects the economic downturn, that the government relies on generic measures emphasizing youth's own responsibility, and pointed to earlier action plans and regional cooperation.
The cabinet is strongly committed to preventing and combating youth unemployment.
Het kabinet zet stevig in op het voorkomen en bestrijden van de jeugdwerkloosheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar en Wilders over de tweede kwartaalcijfers van de vier grootste pensioenfondsen

PVV MPs asked the minister why pension fund coverage ratios fell after record-low interest rates, whether the valuation method is to blame, and what concrete short-term measures will be taken, including returning to a fixed 4% discount rate and spreading recovery deadlines. The minister attributed the decline mainly to market and life-expectancy developments, rejected returning to the fixed rate, and only promised a package of measures in September.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over "in het buitenland gedetineerde uitkeringsontvangers"

An MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unemployment and social benefit recipients detained abroad, including whether the Foreign Ministry can share detention data and whether such benefits can be stopped. The government answers that benefits must stop during detention abroad, that current data-sharing rules under the privacy law block the transfer, and that a legislative amendment will create a legal basis for sharing the data.

On the basis of this statutory basis, the Minister of Foreign Affairs can provide data on detained Dutch nationals and foreigners with a Dutch residence permit, which he holds and which are necessary for entitlement to benefits, to municipalities, SVB and UWV.

Op basis van deze wettelijke grondslag kan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken de gegevens van in het buitenland gedetineerde Nederlanders en buitenlanders met een Nederlandse verblijfsvergunning, waarover hij beschikt en die noodzakelijk zijn voor het recht op een uitkering, verstrekken aan gemeenten, SVB en UWV.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Klaver over werkgevers die particuliere recherchebureaus inschakelen

MPs Dibi and Klaver asked ministers whether private detective agencies hired by employers are inadequately supervised after licensing, whether this violates employees' privacy, and whether such agencies should access government databases. Minister Opstelten replied that a risk-based police inspection and a privacy-focused CBP supervision effort are being strengthened, that privacy violations are for courts to judge, and that private detectives get no access to the municipal population register or sensitive vehicle registry data.
In consultation with the police and the CBP, I am examining how supervision of compliance with privacy rules by private detective agencies can be strengthened.
In samenspraak met politie en CBP onderzoek ik op welke wijze het toezicht op de naleving van de privacyregels door particuliere recherchebureaus kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koser Kaya over de aanhoudende problemen met koopkracht en belastingdruk op de BES-eilanden

Two D66 MPs asked about the state of the interdepartmental studies on purchasing power, inflation, tax revenue and poverty in Caribbean Netherlands, and about a double-taxation problem with Sint Maarten. The government answered that the Ecorys purchasing-power study and the poverty exploration were completed and sent to parliament in June 2012, that a first revenue estimate was requested, and that talks with Sint Maarten on double indirect taxation were constructive.
Only in autumn 2012 will definitive clarity on the revenue of the new tax system be possible.
Pas in het najaar van 2012 zal definitieve duidelijkheid over de opbrengst van het nieuwe belastingstelsel kunnen worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over Nederlandse WAO’ers in Polen

MP Brinkman asked whether Dutch WAO recipients living in Poland were wrongly told they would not owe tax on their benefit and now face Polish tax claims. The state secretary answered that under the Netherlands-Poland tax treaty Dutch tax may be levied, Poland credits it so there is no double taxation, and the Tax Administration is not responsible for foreign tax rules.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, the Netherlands may levy tax on the WAO benefit.
Zoals bij antwoord 1 is aangegeven, mag Nederland belasting heffen over de WAO-uitkering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het toezicht op pensioenen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about liability of pension insurers when an employer failed to register an employee with the pension provider, and whether insurers should be liable for unknown risks. The minister answers that employees can claim pension rights directly from the provider via a third-party clause, that providers bear the risk and must manage it, and refuses to amend the Pension Act on this point.
With regard to the interest of the individual participant, as explained in the answers to questions 9 and 10, I am not inclined to amend the Pension Act on this point.
Met het oog op het belang van de individuele deelnemer, zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op de vragen 9 en 10, voel ik niets voor een wijziging van de Pw op dit punt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van den Besselaar en Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam illegale buitenlandse jeugd stages aanbiedt

PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam offering internships to students without residence permits is acceptable and whether fines should apply per case. The minister referred to a letter of 25 June 2012 announcing an appeal against a court ruling, and to earlier answers, without substantively answering the questions.
For answering your question I refer to the letter sent to your House on 25 June 2012, in which the cabinet announces it will appeal a ruling of the Hague District Court.

Voor de beantwoording van uw vraag verwijs ik naar de brief die wij uw Kamer op 25 juni 2012 (Kamerstukken II 2011/12, 32 144, nr. 16 ) hebben toegezonden, waarin het kabinet aankondigt in hoger beroep te zullen gaan tegen een uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Irrgang over de mogelijkheid om banksparen ook mogelijk te maken voor het aankopen van het pensioen

MPs Lodders (VVD) and Irrgang (SP) asked whether a mandatory insurance product covering longevity risk could make bank savings usable for buying a pension annuity. Minister Kamp replied that financial effects of non-existent products cannot be calculated and that splitting the product between a bank and an insurer would be complex and error-prone, referring to earlier answers.

Furthermore, I indicated in answer to question 6 of the earlier questions on this subject that I consider splitting the pension product into a savings part held at a bank and an insurance part held at an insurer to be a complicated structure in terms of costs and administration.

Verder heb ik in antwoord op vraag 6 van de eerder gestelde vragen over dit onderwerp aangegeven dat ik het splitsen van het pensioenproduct in een spaardeel dat ondergebracht wordt bij een bank en een verzekeringsdeel dat ondergebracht wordt bij een verzekeraar kostentechnisch en administratief een ingewikkelde constructie vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de mogelijkheid om banksparen ook mogelijk te maken voor het aankopen van het pensioen

An MP asked the government whether banksparen (bank savings) could be used to purchase pension payouts, raising competition and cost questions. The minister said the financial consequences cannot be quantified because banks and insurers differ, and that bank savings cannot cover longevity risk, so the market should first show whether a split product is feasible before legal barriers are discussed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht dat 1 op de 5 werknemer flexwerker is

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports that one in five employees is a flex worker, the reasons for growth, effects on pensions and training, and whether the law still treats permanent contracts as the norm. The minister acknowledged the rise, said permanent contracts remain the norm in law and practice, and pointed to pending labour market reform measures.
Given the caretaker status of this cabinet, I will leave any further measures to a subsequent cabinet.
Gezien de demissionaire status van dit kabinet laat ik eventuele extra maatregelen over aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Jong over "uitkeringsfraude door niet-westerse allochtonen"

MPs Van Klaveren and De Jong asked the government about the scale of benefit fraud by non-Western immigrants and how foreign property held by benefit recipients is checked. The state secretary answered that fraud policy is not based on origin, described municipal and SVB checks abroad (403 asset investigations in 2011), and declined to start a separate investigation while promising a fuller overview in the third quarter.
We see no reason to start an investigation from our ministries in addition to the work of the municipalities and the SVB
Wij zien geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op bovenstaande werkzaamheden van de gemeenten en de SVB vanuit onze ministeries een onderzoek te starten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over inspecties van de GGD van kinderopvangcentra en peuterspeelzalen

An MP asked the minister whether the costs of GGD inspections and re-inspections of childcare centres, playgroups and host parents are publicly funded, how many re-inspections occur, what they cost, and whether providers could pay or fines could be raised. The minister explained that inspection costs are funded via a structural Rijk payment to the municipal fund (about EUR 29.4 million per year), gave 2010 re-inspection counts for daycare and out-of-school care, and said he will examine charging offenders and higher fines as part of research into municipal enforcement effectiveness.

The suggestions to have the offending entrepreneur pay the costs of re-inspections themselves, as well as applying higher fines to organisations that repeatedly violate the law, I will examine further.

De suggesties om de kosten van de herinspecties door de overtredende ondernemer zelf te laten betalen, evenals het hanteren van hogere boetes voor organisaties die herhaaldelijk de wet niet naleven, zal ik nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid  Lodders over “het oneigenlijk gebruik van de pensioenknip”

Lodders (VVD) asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension insurers refuse to apply the 'pensioenknip' (pension split option), its low uptake, and low interest rates and refusals to allow shopping after the first period. The minister answered that awareness is assumed, limited uptake reflects risk aversion, a few AFM complaints arise from technical rules, and insurers are legally bound to cooperate, with courts as the remedy.
