If a pension provider refuses this cooperation, the person concerned can hold the provider to account and, if that does not lead to cooperation, go to court.
Als een pensioenuitvoerder deze medewerking weigert, kan betrokkene de uitvoerder daarop aanspreken en als dat niet tot medewerking leidt naar de rechter stappen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over waarborging van de veiligheid van kinderen in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the minister whether he knew of childcare staff behaving inappropriately without criminal conviction, whether such people should be allowed to work with children again, and what steps he would take. The minister acknowledged such situations occur, pointed to employer screening, and announced continuous criminal-record screening and a statutory reporting duty for abuse, while saying primary responsibility for non-criminal conduct lies with private providers and the sector.

Therefore I will introduce a form of screening under which it is continuously checked whether a new, relevant criminal offence has been recorded in the Judicial Documentation System under the name of a staff member in childcare or playgroup work.

Daarom zal ik een vorm van screening introduceren waarbij continue wordt bekeken of op de naam van een medewerker in de kinderopvang of in het peuterspeelzaalwerk een nieuw, relevant strafbaar feit in het Justitiële Documentatie systeem is bijgeschreven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het nieuwsbericht dat de werkloosheid sterk is toegenomen

MP Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister of Social Affairs about press reports of a sharp rise in unemployment to 489,000 (6.2%) in April 2012, whether it signals a worrying trend, what measures caused it, and whether extra measures for young people and over-55s are planned. The minister answered that the rise is a bad sign but unemployment is relatively low in the eurozone context, that monthly figures are sample-based and cautiously read, that the cause is the economic downturn rather than identifiable measures, and that existing policy (including the 2013 budget agreement and dismissal law reform) is considered sufficient without additional youth- or older-worker measures.
Given the policy already initiated and announced, the cabinet considers additional measures specifically for young people or older workers unnecessary.
Het kabinet acht gegeven het ingezette en aangekondigde beleid additionele maatregelen, specifiek voor jongeren of ouderen, niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de inzet van Ierse en Portugese werkers bij de aanleg van de A2-tunnel

An SP MP asked why Irish and Portuguese workers are used on the A2 tunnel, whether Dutch workers were sought, and whether wages, taxes and pensions are properly handled and inspection launched. The minister replied that the work was tendered EU-wide and subcontracted to an Irish firm, that UWV found insufficient specialised Dutch staff, that the workers hold A1 certificates and are covered by the Dutch CAO, and that the Inspectie SZW and Belastingdienst are already supervising compliance.
The Inspectie SZW and the Belastingdienst have been supervising compliance with the legislation during the A2 tunnel works since early 2012 and will continue to do so until the project is completed.

De Inspectie SZW en de Belastingdienst houden vanaf begin 2012 al toezicht op de naleving van de wetgeving bij de uitvoering van de ondertunneling van de A2 en zullen dit blijven doen totdat het project is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over het teruglopende aantal vacatures en opdrachten voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers)

An MP asked the minister about falling vacancies, the number of new labour market entrants left unemployed, and changes in assignments for self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers), and whether the CBS should report on them. The minister said vacancy decisions lie with employers, that the government supports a good business climate, that CBS already reports zzp data, and that a package of WW and dismissal law reforms is being prepared for 2013.
The number of assignments for zzp'ers does not constitute usable policy information, because it is a diffuse unit
Het aantal opdrachten van zzp'ers vormt geen bruikbare beleidsinformatie, omdat dit een diffuse eenheid betreft
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over misstanden in de kinderopvang in Hoorn

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged abuse of children at a Hoorn daycare centre, the GGD report, and whether the municipality acted effectively. The minister said the GGD report is public, the municipality imposed fines since 2005 and issued a directive removing the operators from daily management, and that courts are involved, while noting slow enforcement timelines and a need for focus on group-level pedagogical practice.
Following this case, I note in general that the deadlines applied by municipalities are sometimes on the long side.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus constateer ik in het algemeen dat de door de gemeenten gehanteerde termijnen soms aan de lange kant zijn.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over de overgangsregeling bij de versnelde verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about the transitional arrangement accompanying the accelerated AOW pension age increase, covering who falls under it, benefit continuation, numbers affected, costs and whether it extends beyond 2013. The minister answered that a phased increase, an advance-payment scheme, a referral to social assistance, and retention of the partner allowance for a small group will apply, with details and cost estimates deferred to a forthcoming bill.
For a further elaboration of the transitional facilities and an estimate of the costs of the provisions, I refer you to the bill
Voor een nadere uitwerking van de overgangsfaciliteiten en een raming van de kosten van de voorzieningen verwijs ik graag naar het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over de onduidelijkheid tussen de vitaliteitsparagraaf in het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma en die paragraaf in het Stabiliteitsprogramma

MPs Vermeij and Hamer asked why the vitality package's mobility bonuses appear in the National Reform Programme but are cut back in the Stability Programme, and which work bonuses are ended. Minister Kamp answered that the programmes were aligned as far as possible, that the mobility budget is frozen rather than abolished, and that the work bonuses for workers and employers are ended as part of the budget agreement.
The final version of the National Reform Programme submitted to your House on 27 April was aligned as far as possible with the commitments in the Stability Programme.
De definitieve versie van het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma dat op 27 april aan uw Kamer is aangeboden, is zo veel mogelijk afgestemd op de afspraken uit het Stabiliteitsprogramma.
Antwoord vragen  Hamer en Van Dam over kleine ondernemers die de volledige ketenboete voor illegale arbeidskrachten in hun maag gesplitst krijgen

MPs Hamer and Van Dam asked whether clients shift the full fine for illegal foreign labour onto small contractors through contract clauses or set-off, and whether this should be stopped. The minister says the broad employer definition makes all chain parties fineable, that fines can be reduced for clients who supervise compliance, and that civil courts can prohibit or moderate such recharging, but he sees no need for statutory measures given contractual freedom.
Statutory measures to prevent recharging I do not consider necessary at this time, partly because this would infringe the contractual freedom of parties.
Wettelijke maatregelen om doorbelasting te voorkomen acht ik nu niet nodig, mede ook omdat dit de contractvrijheid van partijen aantast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Hoe bedrijven sollicitanten misleiden met spookvacatures’

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether ghost job vacancies used by companies and staffing agencies to mislead job seekers are acceptable, who is responsible for tackling them, and whether an information duty for agencies should be introduced. The minister answered that recruitment is a private matter for companies, that the sector's own voluntary application code suffices, and declined to convene talks or impose new obligations.
The process of recruitment and selection is a private matter.
Het proces van werving en selectie is een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over toezicht op de pensioenen

An MP asks the minister whether a previous minister's parliamentary statements, and an amendment later withdrawn, imply that pension insurers can be liable without fault when an employer fails to register an employee. The minister answers yes to the quotations, but maintains that civil liability of the pension provider toward the employee does not arise; liability runs between employer and provider.
In this case, however, there is no civil liability of the pension provider towards the participant.
Er is in dit geval echter geen sprake van civielrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid van de pensioenuitvoerder ten opzichte van de deelnemer.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya over de representativiteit bij verplichtstelling van cao's

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether representativeness figures for the temp-agency collective agreement (ABU cao) and the StiPP pension fund's mandatory declaration rest on dubious data, including the use of FTE figures rather than headcounts and the gap between 200,000 and 700,000 temp workers. The minister answers that the figures meet the legal majority requirement, that the sources were accepted as reliable and verified by an accountant, and that the ministry checks submissions and plans further improvements.
In the present case, the representativeness figures submitted meet the requirements set for them.
In het onderhavige geval voldoen de aangeleverde representativiteitscijfers aan de eisen die daaraan worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Koopmans en Koppejan over de inhuur van flexibele arbeidskrachten via de aanbestedingskalender

MPs Van Hijum, Koopmans and Koppejan (CDA) asked why central government spends over 45 million euro on temporary agency staff during spending cuts, whether this undoes departmental downsizing targets, and about the tender's lot structure, CAO application, SME access and an overview of framework contracts. The minister answered that the 10% external-hire norm applies, that agency staff are used for peaks and temporary tasks rather than replacing permanent staff, that the CAO Rijk does not apply to them but the inlenersbeloning does, and listed current framework contracts and their durations.
For years the House of Representatives has been informed about the scale of external hiring of personnel by central government, including temporary agency workers.
Sedert jaren wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de omvang van de externe inhuur van personeel bij het Rijk, waaronder uitzendkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het handhaven door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) van gunstiger rekenrente pensioenen

Labour MP Vermeij asks the minister whether DNB's decision to keep using a more favourable pension discount rate, pending the new financial assessment framework, conflicts with DNB's earlier stated criteria and implies political interference or undermines planned pension cuts. The minister answers that DNB acts on its legal powers in exceptional market conditions, that the intention to continue averaging aims at sector stability rather than anticipating politics, and that the planned cuts will be reviewed after the end-2012 funding ratio is known.

By stating its intention to continue averaging until it is clear what the consequences of the main lines of the new financial assessment framework for pension funds are, DNB aims to contribute to calm and clarity for the sector.

Door de intentie uit te spreken om rentemiddeling te continueren, totdat duidelijk is wat de gevolgen zijn van de hoofdlijnen van het nieuwe financiële toetsingskader voor pensioenfondsen, beoogt DNB bij te dragen aan rust en duidelijkheid voor de sector.
Antwoord vragen Azmani over het bericht ‘Frauderende moeders moeten afval ruimen’ en het bericht ‘Arme fraudeurs moeten vuilnis rapen’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news reports that mothers defrauding childcare benefits were sentenced to unpaid community work instead of fines, and whether this is proportionate. The minister replied that the reports overstated the numbers (38 women, not hundreds), explained the prosecution framework and fraud threshold, and announced stricter administrative fines and sanctions via a bill and revised prosecution guidelines.
The report speaks of "hundreds of women", while this concerns 38 women.
Het bericht spreekt van «honderden vrouwen», terwijl dit 38 vrouwen betreft.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over de publicatie ‘Ondernemingsraad en Pensioen’

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asked the minister about an academic publication on works councils and pensions, covering works council consent rights, the binding effect of consent on individual employees, and whether tax changes flow into pension agreements. The minister answered that works councils have consent rights over both the pension and implementation agreements, that consent does not bind individual employees in principle, that tax rules do not automatically change pension agreements, and that compensation claims are possible.
Works councils have, under Article 27, consent rights over both the pension agreement and the benefits agreement for arrangements placed with a pension insurer.

Ondernemingsraden hebben conform artikel 27 ten aanzien van regelingen die ondergebracht zijn bij een pensioenverzekeraar instemmingsrecht over zowel de pensioenovereenkomst als de uitkeringsovereenkomst.
Antwoord vragen Groot over "de hoge inflatie in Caribisch Nederland"

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about high inflation on the Caribbean Netherlands islands and its effect on low-income residents, and whether support measures and the annual report would address poverty. The minister confirmed the inflation figures, said benefits and minimum wages were indexed per island, and promised a cabinet response on the purchasing-power study before summer 2012 plus an analysis of poverty by 1 July 2012.
In addition, at the initiative of the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior, a study has been started to gain more insight into price level movements and the income situation.
Daarnaast is op initiatief van de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van BZK een onderzoek gestart om meer inzicht te krijgen in de bewegingen in prijspeil en de inkomenssfeer.
Antwoord vragen Groot over " de koopkrachtondersteuning in het buitenland "

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether and how the government will comply with a Haarlem court ruling that the 33-euro purchasing-power allowance must also be paid to pensioners living abroad, and whether the scheme should be tested against EU social security rules. The minister said the SVB is considering appeal and would not anticipate that, noted the EU treaty has no procedure for courts to review laws, and explained that Caribbean Netherlands counts as abroad for this allowance and has no social security treaty with the Netherlands.
The Social Insurance Bank is studying whether to appeal the court's ruling.
De Sociale Verzekeringsbank bestudeert of zij hoger beroep instelt tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord vragen Van Vliet over het jaarlijks mislopen van 2 miljard aan belastinginkomsten

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about roughly 2 billion euro in tax revenue lost each year, citing a union report on the Tax Administration's collection and write-offs, and about overlapping collection agencies. The government answers that write-offs were about 1.8 billion in 2011 (mostly unrecoverable debts), that open debts of 4.4 billion are not all uncollectable, and that it is studying collection pilots and consolidation without committing to a specific structural change.
Nevertheless I consider this share too high and I have asked the Tax Administration to come up with plans to reduce it.
Toch vind ik dit deel te hoog en ik heb de Belastingdienst gevraagd met plannen te komen om dit omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over pensioenproblematiek bij het bedrijf Georgia Pacific

An MP asked the minister about pension problems for Georgia Pacific workers after acquirer SCA declined to take over the Celtona pension fund, including consequences for retirees and whether minister would talk to SCA. The minister answered that the acquirer need not take over the fund, that accrued rights will be insured or the fund continued, that current workers join SCA's scheme on normal terms, and that he will not engage SCA because pension negotiations are for social partners.
No, I will not engage with SCA. Pension negotiations are a matter for the social partners.
Nee, ik zal niet met SCA in gesprek gaan. Onderhandelingen over pensioenen zijn een aangelegenheid van sociale partners.

Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het afwijzen door het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van een vergoeding voor deeltijd WW bij een paardenhouder die ter voorkoming van besmetting van andere paarden met de

MP Van Gerven asked why the Ministry of Social Affairs rejected a request for short-time work benefit for a horse-riding business that closed to prevent spread of the EHV1 virus, and whether this was not an exceptional circumstance. The minister answered that the risk of animal disease is a normal business risk, that the rejection followed the policy criteria, and that the business acted well but does not qualify for the exemption.
There are no exceptional circumstances that cannot reasonably be attributed to the normal business risk.
Er is geen sprake van buitengewone omstandigheden die in redelijkheid niet tot het normale bedrijfsrisico kunnen worden gerekend.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het ontduiken van vaste contracten en cao’s door payrolling

An MP asked the minister whether employers evade the Flexwet chain rule and collective labour agreements by using payroll firms, and whether the legal employer identity, a six-month cap on temporary agency work, and equal pay rules should be clarified. The minister said he had no signals of such practices, pointed to workers' right to go to court, deferred answers on legal employer and caps pending Stichting van de Arbeid advice, and noted existing and forthcoming equal treatment rules under WAADI and the Uitzendrichtlijn.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over het bericht dat door de lage rente werknemers te maken kunnen krijgen met grote kortingen van hun pensioen

Lodders (VVD) asked the ministers whether low interest rates cause large pension cuts for workers with defined-contribution schemes, and whether the pension 'knip' or its extension could help. Minister Kamp answered that payouts depend on market rates at purchase, that about 626,000 participants hold such schemes with only tens of thousands likely affected per year, and that he sees no need to extend the temporary knip now but will review it in 2013.
I am willing to review in the course of 2013 whether the transitional period bridged by the temporary scheme requires extension
Ik ben bereid om in de loop van 2013 te bezien of de overgangsperiode die met de tijdelijke regeling wordt overbrugd, verlenging behoeft
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "Aspergeteelster uit Someren moet ruim een ton betalen"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling ordering an asparagus grower in Someren to pay over one million euros, and about the support and compensation for exploited workers. The minister answered that the ministry had no role in the criminal case, that a EUR 1.098 million in administrative fines had been imposed (some still under appeal), and that fine proceeds go to general funds rather than to workers.
These fine proceeds do not benefit the workers.
Deze boeteopbrengsten komen niet ten goede aan werknemers.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vroege pensioenleeftijd van het overheidspersoneel

Two D66 MPs asked why the public sector has a low average retirement age, what early-retirement schemes and age-related measures exist for civil servants, and what effects this has on wages and the wider labour market. Minister Spies answered that the low average is driven mainly by police and defence, that the general public-sector retirement age has risen, that remaining early-exit schemes are being phased out, and that no spillover effects to other sectors are expected.
The cabinet's policy is aimed at encouraging people to keep working longer.
Het beleid van het kabinet is er op gericht om het langer doorwerken te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn "over de gevolgen van de wijziging van de ingangsdatum van het AOW-ouderdomspensioen naar de dag van de verjaardag"

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about the income gap created when the AOW pension start date moved to the birthday, affecting early-retirement schemes that were not adjusted. The minister said there is no overview of adjusted schemes, that early-retirement schemes are a matter for social partners, and that pension funds had enough preparation time since talks began in early 2011.
An overview of which early-retirement schemes have been adjusted and which have not is not available.
Een overzicht van welke vroegpensioenregelingen aangepast zijn en welke niet is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over “het verschuiven van de ingangsdatum van de AOW”

An SP MP asked the minister whether pension funds and insurers would keep early-retirement (prepensioen) end dates unchanged after the AOW pension start date was moved, and what steps the government would take to prevent an income gap. The minister said the change is manageable for most people, that individual funds decide whether to adjust, that no overview of which schemes changed exists, and that no concrete government step is planned beyond leaving it to social partners.
An overview of which early-retirement schemes have been adjusted and which have not is not available.
Een overzicht van welke vroegpensioenregelingen aangepast zijn en welke niet is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over de bewering van FNV Bondgenoten dat automatisch leeftijdsontslag van de baan is

Rep. Vermeij asked the minister whether CAO clauses forcing dismissal on the first of the month in which a worker turns 65 are void under the Gelijke Behandeling op grond van Leeftijd wet, and what the consequences, number of CAOs and workers, and notification would be. The minister said the constitutionality judgement lies with the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling or courts, that cao partners bear primary responsibility, that 36 CAOs covering about 1.88 million workers contain such clauses, and that sociale partners would inform parties after any ruling.
It is not for me to judge the objective justification, but for the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling or the judge.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de objectieve rechtvaardiging, maar aan de Commissie Gelijke Behandeling of de rechter.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over het uitblijven van pensioenbetaling door Aegon

An MP asked the minister whether Aegon's failure to pay 1,086 pension recipients on time was unacceptable, what measures could be taken, and whether an apology and same-day emergency payments should be required. The minister replied that the payment delays were caused by a system change, that Aegon has since paid the affected months, and that supervision and any assessment of the response rest with De Nederlandsche Bank as supervisor.
An assessment of the adequacy of that is for De Nederlandsche Bank as supervisor.
Een beoordeling van de toereikendheid daarvan is aan De Nederlandsche Bank als toezichthouder.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over de dramatische daling van het aantal vaste contracten en de gevolgen voor Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a reported sharp fall in permanent contracts, whether flexible employment has become excessive, insecurity for workers, age effects, and training investment. The minister answers that temporary contracts rose modestly due to the recession, that about a quarter of flex workers moved to permanent jobs after a year, that older workers have mostly permanent contracts, and that training gaps between flex and permanent workers are small.
The CBS has started collecting data on the transition of this group.
Het CBS is gestart met het verzamelen van gegevens over de doorstroom van deze groep.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over WW-uitkering aan ex-SHB werknemers en hun pensioen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether former Rotterdam harbour pool SHB workers, who cannot choose their pension start date, should have their WW unemployment benefit reduced by pension income, and whether this is fair given that companies using part-time WW did not have to repay. The minister answered yes to the offset rule, rejected the comparison, and declined to mediate because the matter is a collective labour arrangement for employers and employees.
It is up to employers and employees to make arrangements about this. As minister I have no role in that whatsoever.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om daar afspraken over te maken. Als minister heb ik daarbij geen enkele rol.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij en Van der Veen over diabetes op het werk

MPs Vermeij and Van der Veen asked about a study showing employers are unprepared for diabetes among workers and about the role of occupational physicians and policy to support early recognition. The state secretary answered that the picture is not uniform, pointed to a Gezond Bedrijf action plan and a ZonMw diabetes-and-work guideline, and gave no new binding measures.
In the action plan Gezond Bedrijf I also devote attention to workers with a chronic condition, such as diabetes.
In het actieplan Gezond Bedrijf besteed ik ook aandacht aan werkenden met een chronische aandoening, zoals diabetes.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Hamer over "het ontduiken van de werkvergunningplicht voor Roemeense en Bulgaarse werknemers door Nederlandse bedrijven"

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether companies are abusing posting and self-employed constructions to evade work permit requirements for Romanian and Bulgarian workers, and about illegal employment and wage competition. The minister acknowledged rising notifications, announced higher fines, stricter data sharing between UWV and the Inspectorate, and a requirement for employers to show documentary proof, but said illegal employment figures are unknown and wage rules apply to posted workers.
Figures on Romanians and Bulgarians working illegally in the Netherlands are not known.
Cijfers over Roemenen en Bulgaren die illegaal in Nederland werken, zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht “Toezicht op pensioenen”

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's website claim that pension providers are responsible for employees not registered by employers, and whether the employee can still claim pension rights. The minister agreed with DNB that pension providers are not exempt from liability for employer omissions, that employees can still claim rights even if not registered, and that no change to the law is planned.
I endorse DNB's view as indicated under question 3. Even if the employee was not registered by the employer, he can invoke his pension rights and entitlements.
Ik onderschrijf zoals onder vraag 3 is aangegeven de visie van DNB. Ook als de werknemer niet is aangemeld door de werkgever kan hij een beroep doen op zijn pensioenrechten en aanspraken.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over onduidelijke regels over samenwonen in de AOW

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about inconsistent SVB guidance and unclear rules on what counts as living together for the AOW pension, including the criteria for a shared household, the need for logbooks, and whether clear uniform rules will be made. The minister said assessment is case-by-case under the housing and care criteria and case law, that SVB guidance is meant to be uniform, and that no central rules will be set, while noting appeal is open.
The overall determination of objective individual circumstances and weighing of all relevant factors in the individual case cannot by its nature be captured in central rules of general character.

Het geheel van de vaststelling van de objectieve, individuele omstandigheden en de weging van alle relevante factoren in het individuele geval kan naar zijn aard niet in centrale regels met een algemeen karakter worden vervat.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over de uitzending van Pownews aangaande bouwvakkers die ondanks lage temperaturen moeten doorwerken

An SP MP asked the minister whether working in construction at a wind chill below -6 degrees endangers health, whether the cao frost-leave rule is enforced, and whether the frost regulation burdens employers. The state secretary answered that cao parties are responsible, the Arbobesluit leaves safety to employer and employee, enforcement lies with cao parties and courts, and he sees no pressure on compliance.
That is a matter for the cao parties who made agreements on this.
Dat is een zaak van de cao-partijen die hier afspraken over hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over een aanhouding voor ontucht op een kinderdagverblijf in Vlissingen

MP Hamer asked the ministers about the arrest of a childcare worker in Vlissingen for suspected sexual abuse of a 3-year-old, the information given to parents, the investigation, and progress on childcare quality measures. Minister Kamp answered that details are withheld for the investigation, parents were informed through meetings, a helpline and letters, and the 'four-eyes principle' will be anchored in law.
In the interest of the investigation, it is not possible to make any statements about the content of the investigation that has since continued.
Het is in het belang van het onderzoek niet mogelijk om over de inhoud van het onderzoek dat sindsdien is voortgezet, mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya over discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the minister about labour-market discrimination against non-Western migrants, citing SCP research showing lower invitation rates to job interviews and higher unemployment among these groups. The state secretary answered that discrimination plays a role alongside qualification and cultural factors, and listed existing anti-discrimination instruments such as municipal antidiscrimination services and police-prosecution coordination, without committing to new measures.
Every discriminatory act is unacceptable and must be prevented and combated with force.
Elke discriminatoire handeling is onacceptabel en dient met kracht te worden voorkomen en bestreden.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het bericht in Spitsnieuws van 1 februari jl. dat mannen massaal de kinderopvang verlaten

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether men are massively leaving childcare after the Amsterdam abuse case, and what reasons and consultations exist. The minister answered that only 4 percent of childcare staff are men, no comparable before-and-after data exist, the negative attention may have contributed to some departures, and he regrets their leaving but sees no direct role for the ministry in increasing male staff.
Given the division of responsibilities, I see no possibility to actively promote the number of men in childcare myself.
Gezien de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling, zie ik geen mogelijkheid om zelf actief het aantal mannen in de kinderopvang te bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over “winst voor gemeenten door leges voor registratie van gastouders in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang”

An MP asked whether municipalities charge childminders leges for registration in the national childcare register, and whether this breaches the Municipalities Act ban on profit from services. The minister confirmed some municipalities charge such fees, that full cost recovery is allowed, and that he will consult the VNG on how municipalities can be held to account for passing on rijksbijdragen.
The condition, however, is that when objections are raised to the height of the leges, the municipality must be able to offer complete transparency about the costs charged.
Voorwaarde is wel dat de gemeente bij bezwaar tegen de hoogte van de leges volstrekte transparantie moet kunnen bieden over de in rekening gebrachte kosten.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over repatriëring en boetes aan werkgevers (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the IND and DT&V would continue repatriating undocumented domestic workers while the labour inspectorate had stopped fining their employers, and whether this policy was consistent. The minister confirmed repatriation would proceed, explained that the inspectorate dropped fines after the Council of State ruled the police arrest unlawful, and said the differing actions reflect separate agencies' responsibilities; no further action is planned.
It follows from this ruling that the Inspectorate SZW should not have used its supervisory powers on the basis of the police information.
Uit deze uitspraak volgt dat de Inspectie SZW haar toezichthoudende bevoegdheden op basis van de informatie van de politie niet had mogen aanwenden.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over de correctie van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) op de rentecurve januari 2012

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's January 2012 correction to the pension discount curve, including its effect on coverage ratios, funds facing cuts, and whether monthly or three-monthly averaging applies. The minister answered that the correction raised average coverage by about 4 percentage points, does not affect recovery plans or cut numbers, and that DNB will decide monthly whether to adjust the curve.
It has been agreed that DNB determines each month whether market conditions give reason to adjust the interest rate term structure.
Er is afgesproken dat DNB per maand bepaalt of de marktomstandigheden reden geven tot aanpassing van de rentetermijnstructuur.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de contracten van subcontractors die werken voor Post NL

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about a Zembla broadcast on subcontracted parcel couriers working for PostNL, including whether their contracts amount to disguised employment and whether the tax authority agreed special arrangements. The government answered that the contracts are free commercial arrangements, that employment status depends on the facts and can be tested by the Tax Authority or courts, and that it cannot disclose any Tax Authority agreements with specific taxpayers due to confidentiality rules.
However, no information can be provided about any agreements with specific taxpayers.
Over eventuele afspraken met specifieke belastingplichtigen kan echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het pensioenakkoord

Omtzigt (CDA) asks the minister of Social Affairs how youth and elderly organisations have been involved in the pension agreement commissions and whether their involvement is full, and asks for a reply within a week. Minister Kamp answers that both groups have had meetings and receive the same information, that they do not take part in negotiations but their views are heard, and that he will answer as soon as possible.
These organisations do not take part in the negotiations.
Deze organisaties nemen niet deel aan de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Koopmans over de advertentie “Hollandse asperges met een romige crème van moderne slavernij”

CDA MPs Van Hijum and Koopmans asked the minister why a campaign advertisement labelled 'modern slavery' reappeared in January 2012 after the campaign was supposedly stopped, which media it ran in, and what it cost. The minister admitted the ad should not have run, said the agency was not told to stop it in time, listed the titles and a cost of 79,490 euro, and noted no effect study was done.
The advertisement should not have been placed.
De advertentie had niet geplaatst moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over ‘Werken met asbest vaak niet veilig’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about inspection staffing for asbestos removal, the certifying bodies' performance and the withdrawal of certificates, and whether to replace certification with a licensing requirement. The State Secretary answered that a dedicated 10 fte asbestos inspection team exists, that certifying bodies have been monitored and rules tightened, and that licensing is not planned, while promising a sanctions bill and a joint chain approach.
I do not intend to replace the certification system for asbestos with a licensing system.
Ik ben niet van plan het certificeringstelsel voor asbest te vervangen door een vergunningstelsel.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de schoonmakersstakingen voor doodnormal

MPs Karabulut, Voortman and Hamer asked about cleaner strikes over workload, the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag, Philips bonuses versus cleaner cuts, the gold standard, and government cleaning tenders. The minister said the code is applied in new central government tenders with workload monitored by an independent committee, referred several points to other responsibilities and social partners, and declined to commission a study on in-house cleaning.
I regard the gold standard as a follow-up initiative by FNV Bondgenoten to the code, with comparable starting points.
Ik zie de gouden standaard als een vervolginitiatief van FNV Bondgenoten op de code, met vergelijkbare uitgangspunten.
Antwoord vragen Van den Besselaar en Wilders over het bericht van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) over mogelijke korting van pensioenen

PVV MPs Van den Besselaar and Wilders asked the minister whether DNB should limit its public communication about possible 2013 pension cuts to pension funds, and whether cuts should be suspended while the European crisis lasts. The minister replied that the cuts were foreseeable, that funds bear primary responsibility for informing members, and that he will not agree to a suspension of cuts.
This does not alter the fact that it is primarily the task of pension funds to inform their participants about fund-specific matters.
Dit laat onverlet dat het primair de taak van pensioenfondsen is om hun deelnemers over fondsspecifieke aangelegenheden te informeren.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de crèches leeglopen (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether childcare centres are emptying, why parents cancel care, and how parents on low incomes can keep paying. The minister replied that the Belastingdienst figures still show growth in childcare allowance recipients, that a CPB ex-post analysis is underway, that the FNV survey on parents quitting work is unrepresentative, and that the effects of cuts will be monitored.
The effect of the cuts to childcare allowance in 2012 on the various income groups is being closely monitored; in my view additional research for this is not necessary.
Het effect van de bezuinigingen op de kinderopvangtoeslag in 2012 voor de verschillende inkomensgroepen wordt nauwlettend in de gaten gehouden; extra onderzoek hiervoor is mijns inziens niet nodig.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat transportondernemers lege Duitse GmbH’s opkopen om Nederlandse arbeidsvoorwaarden te omzeilen (ingezonde

An MP asked the state secretary whether shell German GmbH companies used by Dutch transport firms to avoid Dutch labour conditions are legal, who enforces the rules, and how the Wet Arbeidsvoorwaarden Grensoverschrijdende Arbeid is enforced. The minister answered that establishment rules require a genuine presence, that enforcement lies with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that he is consulting social partners in the transport sector.

As I committed to in the answer to earlier parliamentary questions 3, I am in discussion with collective bargaining parties in the transport sector, including FNV Bondgenoten, about the application and enforcement of the regulations.

Zoals ik in de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen 3 heb toegezegd ben ik in gesprek met cao-partijen in de transportsector, waaronder FNV Bondgenoten, over de toepassing van de regelgeving en de handhaving daarvan.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over dat ’t Hofnarretje voor de derde keer niet voldoet aan de inspectie-eisen van de GGD (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the minister why the daycare centre 't Hofnarretje has failed GGD inspection for the third time, whether it is unacceptable, and whether it will be closed immediately and other failing daycare centres investigated. The minister says the municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for supervising and deciding on closure, expresses concern, and promises to report on municipal compliance in the Inspectorate's annual report in spring 2012.
Responsibility for supervising the quality of childcare rests with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het toezicht op de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang berust bij de gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over repatriëring en boetes aan werkgevers (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the IND is still repatriating undocumented domestic workers while the Labour Inspectorate has stopped fining employers, and whether this policy is consistent. The ministry's reply is only a procedural notice that the answers will be delayed for interdepartmental coordination and combined with related SP questions.

I hereby inform you that the answer to the parliamentary questions from MP Koşer Kaya (D66) on 'repatriation and fines to employers' cannot be given within the stated three-week period because further interdepartmental coordination is needed.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) «repatriëring en boetes aan werkgevers» niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken mogelijk is omdat voor beantwoording nadere interdepartementale afstemming nodig is.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het door werkgevers opvragen van medische gegevens van jonggehandicapten tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure (ingezonden 23 decembe

Karabulut (SP) asks whether employers may ask job applicants about past illness, sickness absence and health through application forms, and whether such questions are contrary to the Wmk, as well as what measures will be taken. The state secretary answers that such health questions are not permitted, that a bill amending the Wmk is pending, that pre-employment medical exams are only allowed at the end of the selection process, and that enforcement is left to employers, employees, occupational physicians and social partners, with complaints possible to the Cka.
It is up to employers, employees, occupational physicians, social partners and civil society organisations to ensure that questions contrary to the Wmk do not appear in an application form.

Het is aan werkgevers, werknemers, bedrijfsartsen, sociale partners en maatschappelijke organisaties om er op toe te zien dat vragen die in strijd zijn met de Wmk niet in een sollicitatieformulier voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over «Ook ziektegeld op continentaal plat» (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Dutch nationals working on the Dutch continental shelf while living abroad fall under Dutch social security law, and how the state and UWV made an apparent error, and whether sickness benefit will be granted in similar cases. The minister answers that the Wet sociale verzekeringen continentaal plat, in force since 1 January 2012, now extends Dutch social insurance to all continental-shelf workers, without retroactive effect, and that earlier cases fell under the former WAMN with employer-based obligations.
From 1 January 2012, Dutch social insurance applies on the Dutch continental shelf in the same way as for workers in the Netherlands.
Vanaf 1 januari 2012 gelden de Nederlandse sociale verzekeringen op het NCP op dezelfde wijze als voor werknemers die werkzaam zijn op het grondgebied van Nederland.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over nog steeds ontbrekende voorzieningen voor leerlingen zonder verblijfsvergunning die op stage moeten (in

D66 MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a 'stoutfonds' that would reimburse employers' fines for hosting internship students without residence permits, and about the lack of a legal solution for such students. The minister said he finds funding fines improper and that the cabinet will not propose a way to allow illegally resident youths to do internships, nor make any interim arrangement.
The cabinet will not submit proposals to make it possible for young people residing illegally in the Netherlands to do internships.
Het kabinet zal geen voorstellen indienen om het mogelijk te maken dat jongeren die illegaal in Nederland verblijven stage kunnen lopen.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat vrachtwagenchauffeurs actie aankondigen tegen arbeidsverdringing (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

MP Spekman asked the state secretary about reports that truck drivers planned action against labour displacement by foreign drivers, asking about the causes, effects on Dutch firms and drivers, and planned steps. Minister Kamp answered that existing rules (Detachering directive, cabotage rules, cao enforcement) should prevent displacement, that inspectorates and social partners are being consulted on better enforcement, and that the minister of Infrastructure will raise the issue at EU level and an evaluation of the Wet wegvervoer goederen is due in early 2012.
I am consulting both collective bargaining parties and the inspectorates on how enforcement can be improved.
Ik ben in overleg met zowel cao-partijen als de inspectiediensten over de manier waarop de handhaving kan worden verbeterd.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de advertentie «Hollandse asperges met een romige crème van moderne slavernij» (ingezonden 7 december 2011)

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government's advertisement equating Dutch asparagus with modern slavery was appropriate, given it could cast suspicion on asparagus growers and why enforcement was not funded instead. The minister said the campaign was a government initiative to raise public awareness of labour exploitation, that it was not coordinated with growers, and that the campaign was a one-off that had already been stopped.
Yes, the campaign was stopped on 2 December.
Ja, de campagne is op 2 december gestopt.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de grote bijdrage van Poolse arbeidsmigranten aan de Nederlandse economie (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

Two D66 MPs asked the Social Affairs minister whether Polish labour migrants' economic contribution fits government policy of faster returns and reduced social security access, and whether Bulgarian and Romanian workers should be expected to contribute similarly. The minister acknowledged migrant contributions but stressed problems with labour migration and said the government keeps administrative barriers for Bulgarians and Romanians and will send the Commission a notification on grounds of labour market disturbance without first submitting it to parliament.
For that reason I did not find it necessary to first submit the notification letter to the House.
Om die reden heb ik het niet nodig gevonden om de notificatiebrief eerst aan de Kamer voor te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de veiligheid op kinderdagverblijven niet is verbeterd (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that daycare safety had not improved, including a survey showing most daycare centres do not apply the 'four-eyes principle'. The minister rejected the general conclusion, said the principle is to be specified by industry parties within six months, and said legislation would follow if they fail, with municipalities enforcing once it is codified.
The cabinet has agreed with the covenant parties in childcare that they will come with a proposal for this practice within six months after 11 July.
Het kabinet heeft met de convenantpartijen in de kinderopvang afgesproken dat zij binnen zes maanden na 11 juli jl. met een voorstel voor deze uitvoeringspraktijk zullen komen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het overzicht Financiële stabiliteit van DNB en de antwoorden van de minister van 18 november 2011 (ingezonden 25 november

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister about DNB's November 2011 financial stability overview, which estimates that pension funds need about 200 billion euros to reach required own funds, and about the effects of year-end interest rates and recovery plans. The minister answered that funds must recover within legal frameworks, that the cabinet will consult social partners in summer 2012, and that the decline in coverage ratios is mainly due to interest rates, equity markets and longevity rather than past underpayment of premiums.

Vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over onnodige bureaucratie omtrent het in- en uitschrijven van gastouders in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (ingezonden

An MP asked the minister for Social Affairs about the burden on childminders who must deregister from the national childcare register when they temporarily stop caring for children, with municipalities issuing fines. The minister agreed the rule is burdensome for temporary breaks and said a new regulation effective 1 January 2012 will let childminders stay registered during temporary interruptions such as pregnancy or illness.

In the new Decree on Childcare and Playgroup Registers, effective 1 January 2012, it will be arranged that a childminder's registration in the National Childcare Register can be maintained during a temporary interruption of actual care.

In het nieuwe Besluit registers Kinderopvang en Peuterspeelzalen, dat per 1 januari 2012 in werking treedt, wordt geregeld dat de inschrijving van de gastouder in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang gehandhaafd kan blijven in geval van een tijdelijke onderbreking van de daadwerkelijke opvang.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over korting AOW toeslag bij ex-partner pensioen (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

Deputy Van Hijum asks whether ex-partner pension should be treated as alimony rather than pension income when reducing the AOW partner supplement. Minister Kamp answers that ex-partner pension is a pension benefit under the Wet Verevening Pensioenrechten, so the current treatment as other income stands and no change to the rules is planned.
Therefore I see no reason to amend the Inkomensbesluit.
Derhalve zie ik geen aanleiding om het Inkomensbesluit te wijzigen.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat vrachtwagenchauffeurs actie aankondigen tegen arbeidsverdringing (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

MP Spekman asks the State Secretary about reports of truck drivers protesting labour displacement by lower-cost Eastern European drivers, asking about causes, unequal competition, consequences and government steps. The government replies only with a mededeling that answers will be delayed beyond three weeks due to further information gathering and consultation with social partners.

I hereby inform you that answering the parliamentary questions from MP Spekman about the report of truck drivers announcing action against labour displacement is not possible within the set three-week period, because further information is being gathered and consultation with social partners is taking place.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) over het bericht dat vrachtwagenchauffeurs actie aankondigen tegen arbeidsverdringing niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken mogelijk is omdat nadere informatie ingewonnen wordt en overleg plaats vindt met sociale partners.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onderbetaling van schoonmakers bij O2G2 in Groningen (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that cleaners at a Groningen company were underpaid and whether the Labour Inspectorate would investigate, and whether the government would set up a collective labour agreement enforcement authority. The minister answered that compliance with collective agreements is a matter for the social partners, that the Inspectorate acts only on a well-founded suspicion requested by the parties, and that the government sees no reason to create a new enforcement authority.
It is not up to the Labour Inspectorate to actively investigate this.
Het is niet aan de Arbeidsinspectie om dit actief te onderzoeken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over nog steeds ontbrekende voorzieningen voor leerlingen zonder verblijfsvergunning die op stage moeten (in

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the lack of arrangements for students without a residence permit who must do internships, and about a 'stoutfonds' that would compensate employers' fines. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers will not be given within three weeks and will be combined with a committee written consultation.
These questions will be answered together with the questions the committee for Social Affairs and Employment has asked on this subject within a written consultation.
Deze vragen zullen beantwoord worden samen met de vragen die de commissie voor Sociale zaken en werkgelegenheid heeft gesteld over dit onderwerp in het kader van een schriftelijk overleg.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het artikel «Boete kweker ingetrokken» (ingezonden 19 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs why a €192,000 fine for employing 24 Polish workers without a work permit was withdrawn, whether this signals a policy change on posted workers, and how Netherlands can control posting and bogus self-employment within the EU. The minister answers that the fine was withdrawn because the inspection report lacked sufficient evidence, that the Vicoplus ruling confirms existing policy requiring work permits for 'impure' service provision, that no policy change occurs, and that the government is examining a Belgian-style notification system.
Following a legal assessment in connection with the appeal lodged by the grower, it was concluded that the inspection report on which the fine was based contained insufficient evidence.
In verband met het door de kweker ingestelde hoger beroep is na een juridische beoordeling geconcludeerd dat het boeterapport waarop de boete was gebaseerd onvoldoende bewijs bevatte.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Innovatie van oude instituties moet komen en wat dit voor ondernemers betekent (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether the proposal to give more room to the bedrijfschappen (industry boards) fits the cabinet's plan to slim them down, and what this means for entrepreneurs' levies and innovation tasks. The minister answered that such tasks are only allowed as exceptional additional tasks under strict conditions, that the levies will fall substantially, and that the revised law is planned for 2013.
It cannot be foreseen which tasks would still be carried out if the levies were made voluntary.
Het is niet te voorzien welke taken nog zouden worden uitgevoerd als de heffingen vrijwillig worden gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verkrijgen van de koopkrachttegemoetkoming oudere belastingplichtigen (KOB) in Duitsland (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

MP Karabulut asked whether elderly AOW recipients in Germany can get the KOB allowance, given that the German tax office must sign the SVB form and some may be unknown to it. The minister answered that the 90% income criterion can be verified via a signed declaration, that German tax offices in North Rhine-Westphalia were instructed on signing, and saw no reason to change the procedure.
I therefore have no reason to assume that the procedure in other German states would be different.
Ik heb daarom geen reden om aan te nemen dat de procedure in andere Duitse deelstaten anders zou zijn.
Vragen van het leden Hamer en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over payrollen bij een ROC (ingezonden 31 oktober 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether using a payroll construction to let a ROC (Eindhoven) avoid its unemployment-insurance (WW) own-risk obligation is undesirable and whether it shifts costs onto the collective. The minister said public employers should bear WW risk for their own staff and that shifting it to market-sector funds is undesirable, but argued that the price of the risk is priced into payroll fees, and promised advice from the Stichting van de Arbeid before a government response.
The cabinet has asked the Stichting van de Arbeid for advice on payrolling.
Het kabinet heeft de Stichting van de Arbeid om advies gevraagd over payrolling.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Helft pensioenfondsen onvoldoende gedekt, «drastische» stappen nodig» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that half of pension funds are underfunded and whether cuts or premium rises are needed in spring 2012, and how falling rates and the euro crisis relate. The minister confirms about 200 funds had a coverage shortfall, says over 100 may not recover within their recovery plans and may cut pensions from April 2013, attributes the decline mainly to falling interest rates, longer life expectancy and stagnant markets, and presents the pension accord's contractual adjustment rules as an improvement.
I regard this as an improvement.
Ik beschouw dit als een verbetering.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «pensioenfondsen rekenen zich rijk» (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether allowing pension funds to discount liabilities at expected returns risks overstating funding and forcing indexation at the expense of current workers, and whether this should be reconsidered after expert criticism. The minister answers that the pension accord aims for evenly distributed burdens across generations, that the disconnect rate will be set in the new pension contract drawing on the CPB study, and that no reconsideration is planned.
There is no question of reconsideration, because as I already indicated in answer 3, the starting point of the pension accord is that burdens and benefits are distributed evenly across generations.
Van heroverweging is geen sprake, want zoals ik al heb aangegeven in antwoord 3 is het uitgangspunt van het pensioenakkoord dat lusten en lasten evenwichtig over generaties worden verdeeld.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onderbetaling van schoonmakers bij O2G2 in Groningen (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that cleaners at O2G2 in Groningen were underpaid and that the firm did not follow the collective labour agreement, asking whether the Labour Inspectorate would investigate, how a strong inspectorate fits with budget cuts, and whether a cao-authority would be created. The government's answer is only an interim notice saying the questions cannot be answered within three weeks because further information must be gathered from the company.
because further information must be gathered about the situation at the company concerned
omdat nadere informatie moet worden ingewonnen over de situatie bij het betreffende bedrijf

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvangtoeslag voor docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs en zelfstandig ondernemers (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asks whether teachers in secondary education with tussenuren (gap hours) and self-employed or zero-hours workers will face higher own contributions under the new childcare allowance rules, which count only hours worked. The minister answers that 70% and 140% of hours worked should be sufficient, that prepar ation hours count as worked, that workers can prove hours via payslips or to the Tax Office, and that a general arrangement for all working parents will take effect in 2012.
I have already made an arrangement for all working parents, including the group you mention.
Ik heb reeds een regeling getroffen voor alle werkende ouders, waaronder de door u genoemde groep.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij (PvdA) en Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vutters die dankzij faillissement bedrijf geen uitkering ontvangen (ingezonden 13 september 2011).

MPs Vermeij and Ulenbelt asked the minister how ex-workers of bankrupt Boekelo Decor who lost early-retirement (VUT) benefits can be protected, and whether the buyer or the German parent can be held liable. The minister answered that VUT schemes are the responsibility of social partners, that the buyer generally does not inherit the bankrupt firm's debts, that the German parent is a separate legal entity not party to the collective agreement, and that creditors must file claims with the curator.
This is a matter of private law.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitwasse

MPs Hachchi and Koşer Kaya asked ministers about the use of payrolling to circumvent dismissal rules, the number and age profile of payroll workers in government, the future policy, and the severance pay of civil servants versus payroll workers. The minister replied that the government had asked the Labour Foundation for advice expected in December, would not anticipate it, and that civil servants have no statutory severance while payroll workers' entitlements depend on the sector collective agreement and ultimately the courts.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht over het bepalen van de marktwaarde van pensioenen door de hoogleraren Lans Bovenberg, Sweder van Wijnbergen, T

Rep. Klaver (GroenLinks) asks the Social Affairs minister about professors' criticism that individual pension property rights are undefined, that the discount rate could push funds into riskier investments at the expense of younger members, and that the 10-year smoothing period could leave too little for young people. The minister acknowledges the need for an equitable intergenerational distribution, points to research due end February 2012 and a forthcoming framework note, but does not commit to adopting the specific proposals.
This aspect will be taken into account in the further elaboration of the pension agreement.
Dit aspect zal bij de nadere uitwerking van het pensioenakkoord worden meegewogen.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya (D66), Van Gent (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de rem op arbeidsparticipatie door bezuinigingen kinderopvang (ingezonden 4 oktober 20

Three MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether cuts to childcare subsidies will push parents to work less, citing an ING survey, a critical opinion piece, and CPB model assumptions. The minister replied that the survey shows only a small share of households plan changes, that the expected labour supply effect is about 0.1%, that the cuts were designed to protect low and high earners, and that CPB will finish an ex-post analysis by end 2011.
The CPB will complete this analysis at the end of 2011.
Het CPB zal deze analyse eind 2011 afronden.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over beperkte representativiteit vakbondsleden (ingezonden 11 oktober 2011).

MP Koşer Kaya asked the minister of Social Affairs about the aging and unrepresentative membership of trade unions, including the underrepresentation of women and young people and whether the government should stimulate a better representation. The minister answered that ageing and falling membership are known trends, that union membership is a matter for the unions themselves, and declined to take initiatives to change the membership composition.
It is a matter for the trade unions to bind members to themselves. That is not something I am responsible for.
Het is een zaak van de vakbonden om leden aan zich te binden. Daar ga ik niet over.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 27 september 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked why the tax authority reclaims childcare allowance from a family where the non-working partner is severely disabled and lives apart, and whether a separation was suggested to qualify for support. The government replies that the Childcare Act requires recovery, that municipalities received €28 million to handle social-medical cases, and that the individual assessment is left to the municipality.
The Childcare Act leaves no room for assessing specific situations that do not fall under the law.
De Wet kinderopvang laat geen ruimte voor beoordeling van specifieke situaties die niet onder de wet vallen.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de luchtkwaliteit in kinderdagverblijven (ingezonden 8 sept

MPs Hamer and Monasch asked about indoor air quality in daycare centres, including whether all daycare should be required to use an objective ventilation assessment method and whether remaining crisis funds are available. The minister answered that ventilation assessment should remain a private quality matter, that funds were passed via municipalities to schools, and that a phased voluntary improvement programme plus new Bouwbesluit rules from 2012 are in place.
No, I do not intend to make the objective assessment method mandatory for all daycare centres.
Nee, ik ben niet van plan om de objectieve beoordelingsmethode verplicht te stellen voor alle kinderdagverblijven.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Schouw en Verhoeven (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over barrières bij het inhuren van kennismigranten (ingezonden 1 september

Three D66 MPs asked why employer groups complain that importing skilled workers is too hard, and about the market-rate salary test for the highly skilled migrant scheme introduced in June 2011, its basis, past abuse, refusals, and the income thresholds. The minister defended the test as a safety valve used only on suspicion of misuse, said no refusals had yet occurred, explained the income criteria, and agreed to talk with the employer organisations.
This measure was partly introduced because your House, including through a motion by MP Ulenbelt et al., expressed concern about possible misuse of the highly skilled migrant scheme.
Deze maatregel is onder meer tot stand gekomen omdat uw Kamer, onder andere bij motie van het lid Ulenbelt c.s. zijn zorgen heeft geuit over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het kindgebonden budget (ingezonden 13 september 2011).

MP Spekman asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a family of eight children, six under 18, whose child benefit (kindgebonden budget) was cut, and whether the family could avoid putting children to work early. The minister answered that child costs are shared between parents and the state, that the cuts were softened by amendments, and that the government does not recognise early work as a result of financial hardship.
On 23 and 26 September I sent two amendment memoranda to the House that reduce the cuts to the child-related budget and do not limit it to two children.

Op 23 en 26 september jl. heb ik twee nota's van wijziging naar de Kamer gestuurd waarmee bewerkstelligd wordt dat er minder op het kindgebonden budget wordt bezuinigd en het kindgebonden budget niet beperkt wordt tot twee kinderen.

Vragen van de leden Albayrak en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de kritiek in het Europees parlement op Nederland (ingezonden 15

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about European Parliament criticism of Netherlands over blocking extension of the Globalisation Adjustment Fund and how much Dutch workers benefited. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not block the fund but opposes extending the eased eligibility rules, and gave figures on Dutch applications (13 applications, EUR 21.1 million, 6,382 workers).
I therefore advocate a prompt and thorough external evaluation of the use and effects of the EGF as an instrument to counter the effects of globalisation and the crisis.
Ik pleit dan ook voor een spoedige en gedegen externe evaluatie over het gebruik en de effecten van het EGF als instrument om de effecten van globalisering en de crisis tegen te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de roep van gemeenten om bestandskoppeling te

MPs Spekman and Jadnanansing ask whether they recognise municipal calls for linking data files to fight benefit and study-finance fraud, why OCW/DUO is not in the national steering group, and why benefit, housing and municipal registers are not linked. The state secretary says the government prioritises fraud prevention, is studying harmonisation of data-sharing rules and an inventory of wider data matching, cites existing and proposed measures (home visits bill, student address rules), explains housing data is fragmented, and points to a risk-profile system (SARI) and DUO address checks as privacy-conscious alternatives.
In addition, I have started an inventory of the possibilities for broader use of data matching and data exchange to prevent and combat fraud.
Aanvullend hierop ben ik gestart met een inventarisatie van de mogelijkheden van een bredere inzet van bestandskoppeling en gegevensuitwisseling om fraude te voorkomen en te bestrijden.

Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de plannen van de gemeente Vaals om burgers uit de Europese Unie (EU) zonder inkomen te weren en de reactie van de EU daarop (inge

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the municipality of Vaals' plan to deny residence to EU citizens without income and the European Commission's reaction, including concerns about welfare claims by EU migrants. The minister said the situations are undesirable, announced a bill so benefits are granted only after IND confirms residence rights, and committed to exploring EU-level changes to aggregation and benefit rules.

I am preparing a bill that regulates that – where applicable – foreigners (EU citizens and non-EU foreigners) only become eligible for social assistance after the lawfulness of their residence right, precisely because of the claim on assistance, has been established by the IND.

Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat regelt dat – in voorkomende gevallen – vreemdelingen (EU-burgers en vreemdelingen van buiten de EU) pas in aanmerking komen voor bijstand, nadat de rechtmatigheid van het verblijfsrecht – juist vanwege het beroep op bijstand – door de IND is vastgesteld.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de chaos bij het UWV (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Social Affairs about reports of chaos at the UWV, prompted by a Nationale ombudsman report on one claimant whose benefits were handled by offices with incompatible ICT systems. The minister acknowledges inadequate communication in that case, says it is not representative, and outlines ICT consolidation from 1 January 2012 and new complex-case teams.
UWV did not communicate properly in this case.
UWV heeft in deze zaak niet goed gecommuniceerd.

Vragen de leden Van Hijum en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over een verblijfsstatus en het recht op kinderbijslag (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Hijum and Knops asked the ministers about a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that parents without a valid residence permit may be entitled to child benefit after long residence, and what follow-up policy, cassation and measures to prevent such entitlement are planned. The government answered that the ruling is being contested in cassation before the Hoge Raad, will inform parliament once the consequences are clear, and says its streamlining programme aims to prevent prolonged residence through stacked procedures.
The Sociale Verzekeringsbank has lodged an appeal in cassation with the Hoge Raad.
De Sociale Verzekeringsbank heeft cassatieberoep ingesteld bij de Hoge Raad.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over onwettige uitzendconstructies voor Poolse werknemers (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MPs Spekman and Van Dam asked the minister about a court ruling that a transport firm's agency construction for Polish drivers was unlawful and whether such constructions are widespread, how enforcement will be handled, and whether companies are relocating abroad to avoid Dutch collective labour agreement wages and tax. The minister answered that no data exist on such constructions, that social partners and the Labour Inspectorate share enforcement responsibility with no extra inspectors planned, and that the ruling is under appeal while existing enforcement continues unchanged.
There is no data known about the number of constructions like the one the court ruled on.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over het aantal constructies zoals de constructie waarover de Rechtbank zich heeft uitgesproken.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over arbeidsongeschikt melden voor enkele procenten (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a court ruling that employees who fully resume work cannot be reported sick for a few percent to keep WIA waiting periods running, and about data, information and rules to prevent this practice. The minister agrees such administrative reporting is inconsistent with reality, says no national data exists, rejects written quarterly updates as unnecessary given existing plans of action, and sees no need for legislative change since a UWV second opinion mechanism exists.
No national registration is kept of sickness absence.
Er wordt geen landelijke registratie bijgehouden over het ziekteverzuim.

Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de plannen van de gemeente Vaals om burgers uit de Europese Unie (EU) zonder inkomen te weren en de reactie van de EU daarop (inge

Rep. Azmani (VVD) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the municipality of Vaals' plan to exclude EU citizens without income, the EU's reaction, and whether Dutch welfare rules attract Central and Eastern European migrants, asking whether benefit entitlements should be restricted via EU treaty changes. The minister's reply is only a procedural notice that the answers cannot be given within three weeks because talks with Vaals on support are ongoing.

At this moment talks are still taking place with the municipality of Vaals about how my ministry, together with the Ministry of the Interior, can support the municipality in solving the problems it has identified.

Op dit moment vinden nog gesprekken plaats met de gemeente Vaals over de wijze waarop mijn ministerie samen met het ministerie van BZK de gemeente kan ondersteunen bij het oplossen van de door de gemeente gesignaleerde problemen.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvang op de BES eilanden (ingezonden 31 mei 201

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about the level and funding of childcare on the BES islands, including targets, budget adequacy and problems anticipated.
