The minister answered that island governments are responsible and set targets and budgets, that a reference framework and a special grant from 2013 are planned, and that he lacks data on several points.
The island governments set the objectives for childcare and decide what budget they wish to make available.
De eilandbesturen stellen de doelstellingen voor de kinderopvang vast en bepalen welk budget zij beschikbaar willen stellen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vutters die ondanks faillissement bedrijf geen uitkering ontvangen (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether early-retirement (VUT) recipients who lose their benefits after their former employer goes bankrupt, and are refused unemployment benefit by UWV, can be helped, including by changing UWV rules. The minister answered that such persons are not unemployed while on full VUT, that VUT is not wage under the WW, that no UWV policy change is possible without amending the WW, and that such cases are rare.
I see no possibilities to reach a solution through consultation with the UWV.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om in overleg met het UWV te komen tot een oplossing.
Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de kinderopvang onbetaalbaar wordt door kabinetsbezuinigingen (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare is becoming unaffordable due to cabinet cuts, citing a report of falling demand and whether the Minister will send the report, help parents who withdraw children, and ensure affordable care. The Minister replies that the cuts raise parental costs but remain necessary, that the report's effect is likely overstated, that demand rises in day care and after-school care, and that childcare remains affordable with the childcare allowance.
Due to this cabinet's cuts, childcare indeed becomes more expensive for parents.
Door de bezuinigingen van dit kabinet wordt kinderopvang inderdaad duurder voor ouders.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitblijven van beloofde werklozen voor de tuinbouw (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP asks the minister why promised unemployed workers have not been placed in horticulture under stricter work-permit policy, and about the economic consequences for growers. The minister replies that the policy has not changed, that employers bear responsibility for staffing, that temp agencies can supply sufficient workers, and that UWV will report on the matter in its periodic reports.
No data are available on the sustainability of the placements.
Over de duurzaamheid van de plaatsingen zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor Roemenen in de seizoenarbeid in de tuinbouw. (Ingezonden 26 juli 2011).

MP Van Hijum asks the minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling suspending refusals of work permits for Romanian seasonal horticultural workers, the government's conduct of stricter permit review, the number of permits granted and refused, and consequences for Bulgarian and Romanian applicants. The minister responds that UWV will decide the objections taking the court's reasoning into account, reports permit statistics, argues that the stand-still obligations were not breached because conditions were not made stricter, and states that 180 permits are deemed granted for 16 growers.
I do not think it is right to anticipate these decisions on objection by discussing the content of the court's ruling.
Ik vind het niet juist om vooruit te lopen op deze beslissingen op bezwaar door in te gaan op de inhoud van de uitspraak van de rechter.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitbuiting van illegaal huishoudelijk personeel (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Social Affairs and Justice ministers about exploitation of illegal domestic workers in the EU, including the EU Fundamental Rights Agency's findings, whether Dutch research exists, whether immigration rules should be eased, and what measures will be taken. The government replied that no Dutch research exists and sees no need for a new study, rejected easing immigration rules, and pointed to existing enforcement measures against illegal employment and trafficking without announcing new steps.
Based on this exploratory study or otherwise, I see insufficient reason to launch research specifically into the living conditions of illegal domestic workers in the Netherlands.
Op basis van deze verkennende studie of anderszins zie ik onvoldoende aanleiding om onderzoek in te stellen naar specifiek de levensomstandigheden van illegaal huishoudelijk personeel in Nederland.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over stelselmatige onderbetaling van bouwvakkers bij de Nuon-centrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden 24 ju

MPs Spekman and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether the Labour Inspectorate knows about systematic underpayment of construction workers by staffing agencies at the Nuon power plant in Eemshaven, what action it takes, and whether fines are effective. The minister replied that no Wml violations were found, that the matter concerns collective agreement compliance for social partners, and that the Inspectorate's enforcement will be strengthened through higher fines, risk-based inspections and information sharing.
It is up to the social partners to ensure proper compliance and enforcement.
Het is daarbij aan sociale partners om zorg te dragen voor de juiste naleving en handhaving.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Hamer (PvdA) en Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het UWV dat weiger

MPs from SP, PvdA and GroenLinks asked why UWV refused PostNL dismissal permits for sorting staff and how the dismissal rules were applied, including the shift from permanent to flexible work and a motion on UWV's work instruction. The minister answered that permits were refused because the selection did not follow the afspiegelingsbeginsel and because it was unclear whether temporary and agency staff would continue, and that the work instruction did not play a role in this assessment.
In this case the permits were refused because the dismissal selection was not in line with the afspiegelingsbeginsel.
In dit geval zijn de vergunningen geweigerd omdat de ontslagkeuze niet in overeenstemming was met het afspiegelingsbeginsel.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Poolse chauffeurs via nepbedrijven worden ingezet op Nederlandse trajecten (ingezonden 7 j

MPs Spekman and Van Dekken asked the minister whether Polish drivers are used through fake foreign companies to undercut Dutch wages and working conditions, and what can be done. The minister replied that Dutch minimum wage and the sector CAO apply to posted drivers, cited a Roermond court ruling against a transport firm, said no data exist on driver numbers, and pointed to the social partners and the Labour Inspectorate for enforcement.
There is no data on the number of foreign drivers employed by Dutch companies.
Er zijn geen gegevens over het aantal buitenlandse chauffeurs in dienst van Nederlandse bedrijven.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het alternatieve plan van FNV Bondgenoten voor de pensioenen en AOW (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

SP MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked the minister of Social Affairs whether he would send a letter showing that FNV Bondgenoten's alternative pension and AOW plan leaves a EUR 1.65 billion gap in the ministry's budget. The minister replied that a copy of his letter is attached and placed for inspection with the Central Information Point of the House.

Are you willing to send to the House as soon as possible the letter showing that FNV Bondgenoten's alternative plan for pensions and AOW creates a EUR 1.65 billion gap in the Social Affairs and Employment budget?

Bent u bereid de brief waaruit blijkt dat het alternatieve plan van FNV Bondgenoten voor pensioenen en AOW een gat van € 1,65 miljard slaat in de begroting voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, zo spoedig mogelijk naar de Kamer te sturen?
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vutters die ondanks faillissement bedrijf geen uitkering ontvangen (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

An SP MP asks the minister of Social Affairs whether about twenty former early-retirees of the bankrupt Boekelo Decor lost their benefit and have no unemployment-benefit right, and asks how many companies pay early-retirement schemes directly and whether a UWV policy rule could treat such payments as wages. The minister's response only announces that consultation with the UWV is ongoing and that answers will come late, with no substance given.
It has become apparent that more time is needed to gather the necessary information for a correct answer to the questions.
Het is gebleken dat er meer tijd nodig is om de nodige informatie te verzamelen voor een correcte beantwoording van de vragen.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het gebruik van een sterfhuisconstructie bij een onwelgevallig gerechtelijk oordeel over te betalen ontslagvergo

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the use of a bankruptcy ('sterfhuis') construction by Doorwin to avoid paying dismissal compensation to Limburg Kozijnen staff, after an unfavourable court ruling, is acceptable and whether instruments exist to prevent it. The minister answered that withdrawing a dissolution request is a lawful option, that the motives are for the judge to assess, that bankruptcy filings can amount to abuse of rights under case law and Article 13a of the Bankruptcy Act, and that existing law gives workers sufficient protection, so no new measures are planned.
I see no reason to counter the use of 'sterfhuis' constructions, as is claimed.
Antwoord 4 Ik zie geen reden om – zoals wordt gesteld – het gebruik van «sterfhuisconstructies» tegen te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het hekelen van de toenemende euroscepsis in Nederland door de Poolse regering (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

MPs Koşer Kaya and Schouw asked the minister of Social Affairs about Dutch plans to send Polish EU migrants home, the risk of souring relations with Poland, and consultation with Polish counterparts. The minister replied that measures target all EU labour migrants under EU free-movement rules, that no unilateral action is planned, and that consultation with the Commission and member states is ongoing.
The government does not intend to take unilateral measures that do not conform to European regulations.
De regering is niet voornemens unilaterale maatregelen te nemen, die niet conform Europese regelgeving zijn.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister vanSociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de latere uitbetalingsdatum van arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkeringen door het UWV (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister for Social Affairs about complaints and hardship caused by UWV shifting the payment date of disability benefits, the handling of advance-payment requests, the clarity of information given to clients, and cost savings. The minister reported about 207 complaints all handled within three weeks, roughly 7% of shifted payments received advances with some refused as late, that individual solutions were offered in hardship cases, and that the shift saves about 19.5 million euro per year by retiring an old system.
UWV has indicated that in future cases it will go into more detail on the reasons for the shift.
UWV heeft aangegeven dat het in de toekomst in voorkomende gevallen uitgebreider zal ingaan op de redenen van de verschuiving.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over belangenverstrengeling bij een leidinggevende van het UWV (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether a UWV executive who runs a commercial firm supplying staff and contracts to UWV was in a conflict of interest, whether the Board knew, and what action would follow. The minister confirmed the Board knew, described the contract safeguards and the decision to end the arrangement, and said an integrity bureau review was ordered while ruling out involving the Rijksrecherche for now.
To prevent any appearance of conflict of interest, the UWV Board decided to end the existing situation.
Om elke schijn van belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen heeft de Raad van Bestuur van het UWV besloten de bestaande situatie te beëindigen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Burg (VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat één van de leidinggevenden van het UWV een eigen ICT-bedri

An MP asked ministers whether a UWV ICT manager who was hired as an employee also owns a company supplying staff to the UWV, and what integrity risks and possible criminal conduct this raises. The minister answered that the arrangement was made for efficiency and continuity, that contractual safeguards exclude the manager from procurement and tariff decisions, and that the UWV board has ended the arrangement and ordered an integrity investigation whose outcome will decide further measures.
The UWV board has instructed its integrity bureau to assess whether this arrangement is in line with the integrity policy.
Het bureau integriteit van het UWV opdracht gegeven om te toetsen of deze constructie in lijn is met het integriteitbeleid

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de kwaliteit van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor zelfstandige ondernemers (ingezonden

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the quality of disability insurance for self-employed workers after the AFM found weak budget products. The Minister of Social Affairs said the AFM found no structural misconduct, that Finance is preparing measures on product development and advice, and that he sees no need for further action on specific products.
The Minister of Finance is currently preparing a package of measures addressing the various identified shortcomings.
De minister van Financiën bereidt op dit moment een pakket maatregelen voor die verschillende onderdelen van de geconstateerde tekortkomingen adresseren.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de ministers van Immigratie en Asiel en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een proactieve informatie en communicatiestrategie van de EU op het terrein van arbeidsmigr

MP Van Nieuwenhuizen asked the ministers whether the EU Commission should run a proactive communication strategy promoting labour migration from non-EU countries and whether the Netherlands should oppose it and any EU funding for it. The minister replied that member states decide on admission of third-country workers, that labour migration should follow domestic and EU labour supply, and that he would raise objections with the Commission, while seeing a possible EU role only for highly skilled migration.
Yes, in my contacts with the European Commission I will point out the undesirability of a proactive information and communication strategy by the European Commission using European funds.
Ja, in mijn contacten met de Europese Commissie zal ik wijzen op de onwenselijkheid van een proactieve informatie- en communicatiestrategie door de Europese commissie met de inzet van Europees geld.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijbetalingsverplichting van werkgevers bij waardeoverdracht van een pensioen (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether the pension-transfer top-up obligation for employers is consistent with the rule that pension entitlements must be fully funded, and what happens when a former employer no longer exists. The minister answered that the two rules are separate, that outgoing transfers are not exempt from full funding, that top-up costs are handled case by case, and that a broader temporary solution is being discussed with pension providers and social partners.
From that letter it follows that there is no discrepancy between full funding and top-up payments.
Uit die brief vloeit voort dat er geen discrepantie is tussen affinanciering en bijbetaling.

Vragen van het lid Van den Besselaar (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de controle-actie van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) naar zogenaamde «spook AOW’ers» (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the minister about the SVB's control action against alleged 'ghost AOW' pensioners abroad, questioning its 0.36% fraud estimate, the low recovery amount, and the cost-effectiveness of home visits in other countries. The minister answers that 0.36% is a modelled residual misuse risk rather than measured fraud, that enforcement spending covers all benefits and yields more than it costs, and that foreign checks are risk-based and deter misuse.
The 0.36% figure is not a 'fraud percentage' but the maximum residual misuse risk estimated by the SVB on the basis of a theoretical model.
Het bedoelde percentage van 0,36% betreft niet een «fraudepercentage» maar het door de SVB op basis van een theoretisch model geschatte maximaal resterend misbruikrisico.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Van der Ham en Schouw (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de belemmeringen voor het lop

MPs from D66 asked why youths awaiting a residence permit cannot do internships during regular education, and whether the government will drop the work permit requirement and suspend fines for employers. The government answered that such internships count as work under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen, that it will not change the law or suspend fines, and only urges schools to issue school statements.
The cabinet will therefore not change the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen on this point.
Dit kabinet zal de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen op dit punt dan ook niet wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Van den Besselaar (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Verboden arbeid soms gewoon toegestaan» (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether a Raad van State ruling allowing Turkish workers without a work permit to avoid fines under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen would lead to more abuse and what measures would close the gap, including denouncing the 1973 protocol. The minister said he sees no need to amend the law, expects the ruling not to void fines, and will seek a preliminary reference to the EU Court of Justice if the issue returns, without initiating termination of the association agreement.

Should this issue come before the Council of State again in the future, I will promote that the Council of State submits it to the Court of Justice of the European Union in the form of preliminary questions.

Mocht deze kwestie in de toekomst nog eens bij de Raad van State aan de orde komen, dan zal ik bevorderen dat deze door de Raad van State in de vorm van prejudiciële vragen aan het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie zal worden voorgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de ondernemingspeiling van het Productschap Tuinbouw (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister about an online business survey by the Productschap Tuinbouw, questioning its neutrality and whether PBO legitimacy could be measured better through voluntary contributions. The minister answered that such surveys are voluntary, self-directed bodies' communications, distinct from the legally mandated representative draagvlak survey, and deferred the broader PBO question to a forthcoming cabinet position.
The legally mandated draagvlak survey must be carried out using a representative sample.
Het wettelijk verplichte draagvlakonderzoek dient te worden uitgevoerd door middel van een representatieve steekproef.
Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkeringen in Turkije (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

MPs Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked the minister about the export of Toeslagenwet supplements to Turkey and other countries following the Akdas ruling (C-485/07), including effects on past recipients, export to EU states and treaty countries, and legal options. The minister answered that the Centrale Raad van Beroep must first rule on the Akdas case before the exact consequences are clear, and described existing export rules and treaty renegotiations.
As soon as I have more clarity on this, I will inform your House further.
Zodra ik daar meer duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.

Vragen van het lid Van den Besselaar (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Nederlandse uitkeringen naar Marokko en naar Turkije worden geëxporteerd (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Social Affairs why Dutch benefit supplements are paid to recipients in Turkey and Morocco, on what basis the European Court relied, whether this could set a precedent, what steps have been taken to stop exports, and how far treaty renegotiation has progressed. The minister confirms awareness of the report, refers to parallel questions for the answers on the Court and treaty matters, and explains the export ban since 2000 and the transitional rules under EU regulations.
See answer 6 to questions from MPs Van Hijum (CDA) and Omtzigt (CDA) to the minister and state secretary of Social Affairs on benefits in Turkey
Zie antwoord 6 op vragen van de leden Van Hijum (CDA) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkeringen in Turkije

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt , Sterk en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een concurrentiebeding bij een detacheringsbedrijf (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Social Affairs about a non-compete clause in a staffing agency's contracts, including whether UWV refers jobseekers to such employers and whether refusing such a contract affects unemployment benefit. The minister answered that such clauses are legally permitted and courts can moderate them, that refusing a job with a non-compete is generally not a valid ground to deny benefits except in unusual cases, and that UWV cannot force a jobseeker to sign a contract breaching an earlier non-compete.
The mere fact that an employer has included a non-compete clause in the employment contract is not a reason to regard a job offer as unsuitable.
Het enkele feit dat een werkgever in het arbeidscontract een concurrentiebeding heeft opgenomen, is geen reden om een arbeidsaanbod als niet passend te beschouwen.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Van der Ham en Schouw (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de belemmeringen voor het lop

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Immigration why young people awaiting a residence permit are blocked from doing internships required for their regular education, and whether the previous cabinet's pledge to drop the work permit requirement will be kept. The answer is only a notice that a substantive reply will not arrive within the three-week deadline because interdepartmental coordination is needed.
The reason is that further interdepartmental coordination is necessary.
Reden is dat nadere interdepartementale afstemming nodig is.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over door het «voorlichtingscentrum overheidsbijdragen» verstuurde brieven (ingezon

An SP MP asked whether the private Voorlichtingscentrum overheidsbijdragen has any link to government, whether non-use of public benefits is exposed by it, and whether government gave it address data. The ministers answered that there is no link, that government information may be used commercially, and that no address data was provided.
No. There is no relationship between the government and the Voorlichtingscentrum overheidsbijdragen.
Nee. Er bestaat geen relatie tussen de overheid en het Voorlichtingscentrum overheidsbijdragen.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Buitenlandse Zaken over Roemenen met Hongaarse achtergrond die hier legaal zouden werken (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

MP Ulenbelt asked whether a temp agency in Etten-Leur employing Romanians with Hungarian background is legal, how many Romanians hold Hungarian passports, and whether the government will press Hungary over circumventing Dutch work-permit rules. Minister Kamp replied that Hungary's citizenship policy for ethnic Hungarians is a sovereign matter and the Netherlands sees no ground to raise it with Hungary.
How many Romanians hold a Hungarian passport?
Hoeveel Roemenen hebben een Hongaars paspoort?
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkering van havenspenioenen door Aegon (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the pension buffer held by Aegon for port-worker pensions can be withheld from pensioners, whether it consists of contributions, and whether the minister would mediate. The minister referred to earlier answers, stated that the Supreme Court confirmed Aegon owns the buffer with no legal obligation to use it, and declined further mediation as a private dispute with no reason to intervene.
There is no legal obligation to use or spend the restrained capital for the benefit of third parties.
Er bestaat geen juridische verplichting tot aanwending of besteding van het beklemde vermogen ten behoeve van derden.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onterechte bijdragen aan het Hoofdbedrijfschap Ambachten (HBA) (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked whether levies imposed by the Hoofdbedrijfschap Ambachten on roofing firms and non-member installers, who did not request the services, are acceptable, and whether they should be made voluntary. The minister replied that compulsory levies are a feature of public-law trade bodies, that a pending court case means no comment on the matter, and that a cabinet position on product and trade boards would follow before 1 September 2011.
It is customary not to make statements about a case while it is before the court.
Het is goed gebruik dat er geen uitspraken over een zaak worden gedaan zolang deze onder de rechter is.

Vragen van het lid Van den Besselaar (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over gesjoemel met werknemersaantallen ter verkrijging van avv voor de thans geldende cao voor de Bouwnijverheid, hierna kor

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the employee headcounts used to extend the 2011 construction collective agreement (Bouw-cao) and the BTER fund agreement were manipulated, whether they were independently verified, and whether an independent institute should compile them. The Minister replies that the representativeness threshold of 60% was met, that the figures were checked via accountant statements, and that the government sees no reason for further investigation or stricter rules.
I can both request an assurance statement from an accountant and, if necessary, have further investigation carried out.
Ik kan zowel vragen om een assuranceverklaring van een accountant als – indien nodig – nader onderzoek uit laten voeren.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag niet altijd recent is bij inschrijving gastouders (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that childminders' certificates of good conduct (VOG) may be years old when they register in the national childcare register, and whether the rules allow this. The minister answered that outdated VOGs are possible only for childminders registered during the 2010 transition year, that GGDs can request a recent VOG when there are doubts, and that he is consulting the Justice Minister on post-registration reporting and will inform the House before the summer.
I am of the view that the purpose of the VOG is sufficiently achieved as regards prior screening.
Ik ben van mening dat het doel van de VOG, voor wat betreft controle vooraf, voldoende wordt bereikt.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de aanbevelingen van het VN-Comité inzake Economische, Sociale en Culturele r

MPs Spekman and Timmermans asked ministers how the government would respond to the UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights' 2010 concluding observations on Dutch compliance, including direct effect of the Covenant, discrimination against migrants, detention of asylum seekers and unaccompanied minors, and the optional protocol. The government rejected the criticism on direct effect under the Dutch monist system, described existing measures on discrimination, VVE and youth detention, and said the optional protocol ratification was still under consideration.

Question 7: What is the status of the Netherlands' ratification of the Optional Protocol to the Covenant adopted in December 2008, which among other things provides an individual complaints procedure for citizens?

Vraag 7 Wat is de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de ratificatie door Nederland van het in december 2008 aangenomen Facultatieve Protocol bij het Verdrag, dat onder meer voorziet in een individueel klachtrecht voor burgers?
Vragen van het lid Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de groei van payrolling (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister about the growth of payrolling, including whether dismissal rules, exclusivity clauses, contract extensions and the comparison with temp agencies create disadvantages for workers. The minister says payrolling uses lawful options, that dismissal for payroll workers requires proof of attempts at redeployment, and that the Stichting van de Arbeid will be asked for its view.
I will ask the Stichting van de Arbeid how it views the development of payrolling, including in light of the consequences for workers regarding dismissal.
Ik zal de Stichting van de Arbeid vragen hoe wordt aangekeken tegen de ontwikkeling van payrolling, mede in het licht van de gevolgen voor werknemers als het gaat om ontslag.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over kinderbijslag en de BES (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

MP Van Gent asked whether the General Child Benefit Act should be extended to the Caribbean Netherlands islands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) and which Dutch social provisions are not yet implemented there and when. The minister answered that the islands' distinct conditions justify differing rules, that gradual convergence may be possible later, that child support is provided through tax relief and the onderstand child allowance instead, and that no timetable for introducing Dutch provisions can be given now.
Gradually converging with Dutch legislation may be conceivable in parts and in the longer term, but differing measures must continue to be taken into account.
Geleidelijk toegroeien naar de Nederlandse wetgeving kan op onderdelen en op termijn wellicht denkbaar zijn, maar er moet blijvend rekening worden gehouden met afwijkende maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt , Sterk en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een concurrentiebeding bij een detacheringsbedrijf (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary and Minister of Social Affairs about a non-compete clause in employment contracts offered by a staffing agency to unemployed people referred by the UWV, asking whether such clauses are lawful and desirable, whether refusing them cuts unemployment benefit, and whether the worker must accept a nearby job or pay EUR 5,000. The government's reply is only an interim notice that more time is needed, with the answer to follow after the deadline.
The answer will therefore be given after the stated deadline.
De beantwoor-ding zal daarom plaatsvinden na de gestelde termijn.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over Oost-Europeanen die frauderen om een uitkering te krijgen (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Eastern European EU citizens register as self-employed in the Netherlands to obtain benefits, as reportedly happens in Belgium, and how controls work. The minister answered that registration alone does not increase benefit eligibility, that no abuse comparable to Belgium is recognised, and pointed to measures in his April letter on labour migration.
At present I therefore do not recognise the abuse that may occur in Belgium. I see no reason to conduct research into this now.
Op dit moment herken ik dan ook niet het misbruik zoals dat in België mogelijk voorkomt. Ik zie geen aanleiding hier nu onderzoek naar te doen.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Azmani (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het feit dat door toedoen van de arbeidsinspectie goedwillende

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the labour inspectorate's fining of employers who unknowingly hired foreign workers, due to incomplete government information, is acceptable and whether information provision and fine mitigation could be improved. The ministers answered that government information is adequate, fines can be moderated when fault is limited, and an information campaign and inter-agency coordination are ongoing, without committing to new rules.

If after finding a violation of the Foreign Workers Act it appears that an employer made sufficient efforts to ensure lawful implementation and can show they bear no blame for the violation, no fine will be imposed.

Indien na constatering van een overtreding van de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen blijkt dat een werkgever zich voldoende heeft ingespannen om een wetsconforme uitvoering te bewerkstelligen en hij aannemelijk kan maken dat hem voor de geconstateerde overtreding geen enkel verwijt treft, dan zal ook geen boete worden opgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de ramingen kinderopvangtoeslag (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister why childcare allowance savings and cost projections diverged from realisations, including the gastouderopvang (childminder) estimates and the change in parental contributions. The minister answered that the definitions were unchanged, attributed the gap mainly to autonomous growth and behavioural effects, and said the 2012 projection will be reviewed with the CPB, while declining to request an Algemene Rekenkamer audit.
Because of these uncertainties, I am examining whether the 2012 and later projections need adjustment.
Vanwege deze onzekerheden onderzoek ik of de raming 2012 en verdere jaren aanpassing behoeft.

Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over diverse gemeenten die een eigen wijze van uitvoering van het toezicht en de handhaving van de wet kinderopvang hanteren (ingezonde

An MP asks the minister about several municipalities, including Boekel, that deviate from the statutory childcare supervision regime by cutting inspections or shifting them to childcare agencies. The minister replies that such approaches conflict with the Wko, that the Inspectie will discuss it with Boekel, and that a binding instruction is possible but not currently expected.
I have urgently requested municipalities to carry out the inspections and to adhere to the system of the Wko.
Ik heb gemeenten dringend verzocht de inspecties uit te voeren en zich te houden aan het systeem van de Wko.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Spekman (beiden PvdA) en Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over buitenlandse werknemers bij RWE (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported abuses of foreign workers at RWE's Eemshaven power plant site, including long hours, unsafe conditions, unclear contracts, accidents and underpaid Polish workers, and whether inspections and fines occurred and whether the labour inspectorate should be expanded. The minister answered that the inspectorate inspects roughly weekly, recorded 47 enforcement actions, issued fines, investigated accidents and found no underpayment so far, and judged inspection capacity adequate.
The Labour Inspectorate actively supervises compliance with laws and regulations at RWE's energy plant under construction in the Eemshaven.
De Arbeidsinspectie houdt actief toezicht op de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving bij de in aanbouw zijnde energiecentrale van RWE in de Eemshaven.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de directeur van het Hofnarretje een nieuwe crèche begint (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister about reports that the former director of childcare centre Hofnarretje was setting up a new childcare business at the same address while under investigation for possible violations of the childcare act. The minister said the press report was based on incomplete information, that the municipality was involved, and that a VOG check and GGD assessment would apply, while declining to comment on the individual case.
Anyone who wants to start a childcare centre must submit a certificate of conduct (VOG).
Iedereen die een kinderdagverblijf wil beginnen dient een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG) te overleggen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de latere uitbetaling van uitkeringen in juni door UWV (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the later June payment of WAO, WAZ, WIA and Wajong benefits by UWV, which may cause anxiety among financially vulnerable recipients, is necessary and whether the measure will be withdrawn. The minister answered that no measures are planned, that recipients are informed in advance and can request an advance payment, and that far fewer people have contacted UWV than expected.
I see no reasons for measures on my part.
Ik zie geen redenen voor maatregelen van mijn kant.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een tussenoplossing voor stageproblemen voor illegale leerlingen (ingezonden 8 december 2010).

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the promise to end the work-permit requirement for stages in regular education will be carried out, and whether an interim solution would spare employers fines and let illegal students do internships. The minister replied that illegal residents may not work in the Dutch labour market, so the cabinet sees no need for them to do stages, while the right to theoretical education remains.
Therefore the cabinet considers it unnecessary for these foreigners to do an internship and complete their education with a diploma that qualifies them for the Dutch labour market.
Daarom acht het kabinet het niet noodzakelijk dat deze vreemdelingen stage lopen en de opleiding afronden met een diploma dat kwalificeert voor de Nederlandse arbeidsmarkt.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de latere uitbetalingsdatum van uitkeringen door het UWV (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister why UWV is moving benefit payments for WAO, WIA and WAJONG recipients from around the 15th to the 23rd of the month, why recipients were not told the reasons, and whether a longer transition or bridging advance is possible. The minister explained the move consolidates payment systems and aligns with salary timing, that UWV gave only brief notice without reasons, and that an advance of up to the monthly net benefit is available, so no further measures are planned.
UWV informed those involved briefly about the shift in payment date. It did not go into the reason for the shift.
UWV heeft betrokkenen beknopt over de verschuiving van het betaalmoment geïnformeerd. Daarbij is niet ingegaan op de reden van de verschuiving.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over Roemeense seizoensarbeiders in West-Brabant (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether UWV tightened conditions for hiring Romanian seasonal workers in West-Brabant, whether employers had enough time to find Dutch workers, and whether unemployment benefits should be cut for refusing work. The minister replied that the conditions are unchanged but UWV now checks domestic and EU supply more strictly, that employers are primarily responsible for recruitment, and that UWV was asked to observe a transition period until 1 July.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over gebruik van anonieme gegevens op werk.nl door derden (ingezonden 28 februari 2011).

An MP asks why personal data that UWV says are invisible to third parties when a CV is posted anonymously on werk.nl were nonetheless used by third parties, and asks how many warning emails were sent, which firms misused the data and what action was taken. The minister explains that the CV in the case was posted publicly by a work coach without the jobseeker's consent, that UWV has removed it and apologised, that this was a human error rather than a leak, and that the platform's terms restrict use to recruitment and access has been blocked for offending employers.
The public CV of the person concerned has since been removed from Werk.nl by UWV.
Het openbare CV van de betrokkene is inmiddels door UWV van Werk.nl verwijderd.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie), Leijten (SP) en Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over barrières in regelgeving voor Stichting SOlink

MPs asked the minister why the Social Insurance Bank (SVB) still disagrees with Stichting SOlink, which matches students with elderly hosts, whether companionship can count as an economic service, and whether a fixed contract price is workable. The minister answered that SOlink is a sympathetic but commercial initiative, that the SVB finds its model contracts too vague to establish a commercial relationship rather than a shared household, and that the SVB cannot guarantee SOlink's desired outcome.
The SVB is of the view that SOlink's model agreements so far fall short in describing the services and the price calculated for them.
De SVB is van mening dat de modelovereenkomsten van SOlink tot nu toe tekort schieten in de beschrijving van de prestaties
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de gastouderopvang (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the government's commitments to control the administrative costs of host-parent (gastouder) agencies, how those costs are calculated and disclosed to parents, the monitoring of agency fees, and whether notice periods and penalty clauses hinder parents' choice. The minister answered that no commitment to control costs was made, that transparency rules already apply, that fees total roughly 16% of turnover, and that no maximum fee or regulation is needed at present.
I agree that imposing requirements on the administration of host-parent agencies does not automatically lead to transparency for parents seeking care.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat het stellen van eisen aan de administratie van gastouderbureaus niet automatisch leidt tot transparantie voor vraagouders.
Vragen van de leden Hamer en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over werkzoekende ouderen (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the difficulty older jobseekers face finding work, the stigma they encounter, the future of funding for their network groups, and whether a training right and duty would help. The minister acknowledged the problem, said agreements with social partners on sustainable employability are under negotiation, noted UWV has no separate budget for older jobseekers, and said training is mainly a matter for employers and employees.
UWV has no separate budget for older unemployed people.
UWV heeft geen apart budget voor oudere werklozen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het advies van de landsadvocaat over pensioenen (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the landsadvocaat's advice on accrued pension rights would be made available to the House, and if not, why not. The minister replied that government policy is not to release landsadvocaat advice to the House or third parties, as it is internal advice in a confidential client relationship.
As a general government policy, advice from the landsadvocaat is not made available for inspection to the House of Representatives nor to third parties.
Als algemene beleidslijn van het kabinet geldt dat adviezen van de landsadvocaat niet aan de Tweede Kamer ter inzage worden aangeboden noch ter beschikking van derden worden gesteld.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over juridisch advies landsadvocaat over pensioenakkoord (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

An MP asked why the minister did not send the State Attorney's legal advice on converting old pension rights to parliament, and how the Volkskrant could report on it when parliament could not view it. The minister replied that it is general government policy not to release State Attorney advice to parliament or third parties, as such advice is internal and confidential between the State Attorney and the State as client.
As a general government policy, advice from the State Attorney is not made available for inspection to the House of Representatives nor placed at the disposal of third parties.
Als algemene beleidslijn van het kabinet geldt dat adviezen van de landsadvocaat niet aan de Tweede Kamer ter inzage worden aangeboden noch ter beschikking van derden worden gesteld.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum (CDA) en Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de gemeentelijke leges voor opname van gastouders in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) (ingezonden 15

Two MPs asked the minister why municipalities charge fees to register childminders in the national childcare register, what those costs are, and whether central registration is planned. The minister answered that municipalities are legally entitled to charge cost-recovery fees, that the funding allocation may be refined for 2012, and that centralising only the registration step would yield no efficiency gain, while promising to inform parliament by end of April.
The precise costs of the action a municipality takes to register a childminder in the LRK are not known to me.
De precieze kosten van de handeling die een gemeente verricht om een gastouder op te nemen in het LRK, zijn mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van d

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob ask whether newspaper publishers, who face little competition in national distribution and cannot easily switch contractors, can fairly be fully fined under the Dutch Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wav) chain liability. The ministers answer that competition is irrelevant to compliance, publishers must ensure lawful outsourcing, and fines are moderated only where the client bears reduced culpability, with pending court cases to clarify this.
A client is in principle held to account and fined for violations by subcontractors or service providers.
Een opdrachtgever wordt in beginsel aangesproken en beboet voor overtredingen van onderaannemers of dienstverleners.
Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitzendbureaus die knoeien met buitenlandse arbeidskrachten (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MP Spekman asked the minister of Social Affairs about temporary work agencies and posted-worker abuses, including illegal employment through certified agencies, Bulgarian self-employed workers' low rates, and enforcement of the WAGA. The minister answered that certified agencies do break rules, that a bill will exclude offending firms from the certification register, that information exchange with other member states works well, and that inspection capacity is adequate.
In addition, periodic talks take place at official level with the industry on improving the quality of the certificate.
Daarnaast vinden op ambtelijk niveau periodiek gesprekken plaats met de branche over de verbetering van de kwaliteit van het certificaat.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake het niet verschaffen van een extra tegemoetkoming van de TOG-regeling aan alleenstaanden (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asks why single persons cannot claim the extra TOG allowance for caring for a disabled child at home, while fiscal partners can, and whether this should be changed. The minister confirms the distinction, explains it is based on the single-earner household being left behind in disposable income, denies it favours partners, and promises a letter on child schemes including the TOG this spring.
This spring I will send a letter addressing the coherence, transparency and effectiveness of the child schemes.
Dit voorjaar kom ik met een brief waarin aandacht wordt besteed aan de samenhang, transparantie en effectiviteit van de kindregelingen.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten met een Nederlands paspoort van vleesverwerker Vion in Enschede moeten vertrekken (ingezonden 25

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would reverse the reported dismissal of Dutch-passport agency workers at Vion Enschede, start an investigation into CAO compliance, and inspect the agency. The minister replied that the choice of workforce is the company's, that the agency workers are employed by the staffing agency, that CAO enforcement is for social partners with Labour Inspectorate action only on a reasonable suspicion, and that the Labour Inspectorate has received no complaints about the firm.
Insofar as it concerns compliance with CAO or pension agreements, this is a matter for the company and the staffing agencies involved themselves.
Voor zover het gaat om het nakomen van cao- of pensioenafspraken is dit een zaak van het bedrijf en de betrokken uitzendbureaus zelf.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat het vleesverwerkingsbedrijf VION te Enschede geen Nederlandse uitzendkrachten meer wil inhuren (ingezonden

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that VION in Enschede would stop hiring Dutch temporary agency workers because workers from other EU countries are cheaper, asking how many such workers there are and what action will be taken. The minister said the choice of agency is for the company, that the number of EU agency workers is not known, and that posted workers are entitled to the hard core of Dutch collective agreement conditions.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over beleggen van pensioenfondsen in bedrijven die wapens leveren aan Libie (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MP Ulenbelt asked whether large pension funds invest in firms supplying arms to Libya, whether this is desirable now that Dutch arms exports there are halted, and whether the minister will discourage such investments. The minister replied that pension law allows prudent investment in arms producers, that such firms no longer get export licences for Libya under the embargo, and that he sees no reason for separate rules for pension funds.
I therefore see no reason to create separate regulation for pension funds that invest in companies exporting military goods.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot het maken van aparte regelgeving voor pensioenfondsen die beleggen in bedrijven die militaire goederen exporteren.
Vragen van de leden Vermeij (PvdA) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijstorting in de pensioenpolis (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

MPs Vermeij and Omtzigt asked the minister whether a new employer can receive a refund from its insurer when pension rights are transferred, and whether the minister's earlier answers conflict with the explanatory note to article 19 of the Regeling Pensioenwet. The minister confirmed that refunds are possible in some cases, but argued that his answers do not conflict with the note, since the full transfer value must be used to acquire pension rights for the employee, and said he will examine the problem of employers overpaying.
I will take the consequence just outlined into account in my research into the problem of overpayment (bijbetaling).
Ik zal de zojuist geschetste consequentie meenemen in mijn onderzoek naar de bijbetalingsproblematiek
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over gebruik van anonieme gegevens op werk.nl door derden (ingezonden 28 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister why personal data on anonymous CVs on werk.nl is visible to third parties, which companies use it, how long the UWV knew, and whether the data is now safe. The response is only a notice that answering within three weeks is not possible because further information from the UWV is needed.
because further information from the UWV is needed
omdat nadere informatie van het UWV nodig is

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de bijbetalingsverplichting van werkgevers bij waardeoverdracht van een pensioen (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension transfers leave employers facing large top-up payments, and whether the Pension Act's full-funding requirement is violated by the implementing decree. The minister replied that pension entitlements remain fully funded, that transfer top-up rules are separate, and that the government is consulting the pension sector on avoiding hardship cases.
That is why the pension sector and the Labour Foundation are currently examining how these situations can be prevented or limited.
Daarom wordt thans met het pensioenveld en de Stichting van de Arbeid geïnventariseerd hoe deze situaties kunnen worden voorkomen of beperkt.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vergoedingen in de kinderopvangsector (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP asked the minister about a severance payment of about 2.5 million euro to a dismissed childcare director, the lack of oversight and parent participation, and transparency and ownership consolidation in the childcare market. The minister replied that childcare is a private sector outside the top-income laws, that the board decision is private, that oudercommissies have no say over severance, and that a visit to marketisation and parents' rights will be presented in the third quarter of 2011.
I have no opinion on the conduct of the Supervisory Board at Kanteel Kinderopvang. That is a private matter.
Ik heb geen oordeel over het handelen van de Raad van Commissarissen bij Kanteel Kinderopvang. Dat is een private aangelegenheid.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de koopkracht van mensen met lagere inkomens (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

Plasterk asks whether purchasing power for AOW and minimum-income households falls about 3% over two years and whether higher incomes lose less, and whether the burden of the recession and cuts can be shared more fairly. Minister Kamp answers that it is too early to judge the 2012 purchasing-power picture, that the policy is not yet decided, and that cuts are necessary, with the strongest shoulders still bearing the heaviest burdens.
Even after publication of the CEP, it is still too early to make statements about the purchasing-power picture for 2012.
Het is – ook na publicatie van het CEP – nog te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over het koopkrachtbeeld in 2012.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over fraude in het Westland (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the minister of Social Affairs about fraud in the Westland, including whether capacity of the Labour Inspectorate should be expanded, whether a blacklist of repeat offenders should be created, and whether fines should be raised. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, referred to earlier answers for questions 2 to 5, and pointed to the government's broader anti-fraud commitment and a letter sent to the House.
For answering questions 2 to 5, I refer for brevity to my answers to earlier parliamentary questions.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen 2 t/m 5 verwijs ik kortheidshalve naar mijn antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de gebrekkige aansluiting tussen MBO-opleidingen en het werken in de hav

MPs Hamer and Çelik asked ministers whether vocational colleges (ROCs) and port employers are to blame for the mismatch between MBO training and port jobs, and whether a sector-wide overview and joint table talks were planned. Minister Kamp answered that employers are primarily responsible for their own staffing, that ROC cooperation with employers already exists, and that no separate overview or new table talks were needed.
No, given legal responsibilities this is a matter for the ROCs and port employers themselves.
Neen, gelet op wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden is dit een zaak van roc's en havenondernemers zelf.

Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de rechten die deelnemers kunnen ontlenen aan hun Uniform Pensioenoverzicht (UPO) (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension participants can derive rights from their UPO pension statement, given the AFM's view and a Rotterdam court ruling, and whether disclaimers denying such rights are permitted. The Minister agrees participants can under circumstances derive rights, that accuracy matters, and that disclaimers stating no rights can be derived are factually incorrect, but sees no need for ministerial action.
I share the AFM's view that participants can, under circumstances, derive rights from their UPO.
Ik deel de opvatting van AFM dat deelnemers onder omstandigheden rechten kunnen ontlenen aan hun UPO.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de extra tegemoetkoming aan ouders van thuiswonende gehandicapte kinderen (TOG) (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Ms Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether it is fair that single-earner families with a disabled child receive the TOG allowance while families where both parents earn benefit-level incomes do not, and whether the allowance should be based on household income and parental rather than the child's AWBZ assessment. The minister defended the single-earner design as compensation for disadvantage in disposable income, said household income is not relevant, and stated that only AWBZ care counts for eligibility, with no plans to replace the AWBZ assessment with an income test.
I therefore see no possibility of replacing the AWBZ assessment with an income test.
Ik zie daarom geen mogelijkheid om de AWBZ-indicatie te vervangen door een inkomenstoets.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over pensioenregelingen (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether pension insurers' administrative errors reported by DNB, and the complexity of pension schemes, are unacceptable, and whether the government will push for simplification in the pension negotiations and reduce administrative costs for small firms. The minister acknowledged the errors, supported DNB's request for an action plan, said simplification is for social partners to propose, and pointed to ongoing ministry consultations on wider use of the policy administration to reduce burdens.
I endorse the request DNB made to insurers to draw up an action plan setting out how the shortcomings will be corrected in the short term.
Ik onderschrijf het verzoek dat DNB heeft gedaan aan verzekeraars een plan van aanpak op te stellen waarin wordt aangegeven hoe op korte termijn de onvolkomenheden worden gecorrigeerd.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Van Dam (beiden PvdA)aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over oneerlijke concurrentie op de arbeidsmarkt (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked whether unemployed Polish EU citizens can be expelled, why the government emphasised expulsion rather than unfair labour-market competition and exploitation by employers and agencies, and whether they would answer before 28 February. The minister confirmed that EU citizens who become an unreasonable burden on social assistance can lose residence rights, said a package of measures on labour, housing and registration will be sent by 15 April, and promised the answers by 1 March.
I will inform you about this by 15 April at the latest.
Ik zal u hierover uiterlijk 15 april a.s. informeren.
Vragen van de leden Vermeij (PvdA) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijstorting in de pensioenpolis (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

MPs Vermeij and Omtzigt ask the Minister of Social Affairs whether his earlier answer implies that new employers may receive a refund from insurers after a pension transfer, and whether this conflicts with the explanatory note to article 19 of the Pensioenwet regulations, which says any shortfall burdens the new employer. The minister announces that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because they require further analysis, and promises a reply in week 11.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een vergelijkingswebsite ten aanzien van prijs en kwaliteit van kinderopvang (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister about a childcare comparison website (kinderopvangkaart) run by BOinK, including whether it received subsidies since 2006 and whether it meets its goal of informing parents, and what safeguards exist for accuracy. The minister answers that a 2009 four-year subsidy of EUR 379,400 has been advanced so far, that the site is being filled gradually (about three years to national coverage), that BOinK spot-checks accuracy, and that the final subsidy will be settled on the final report.
On the basis of the final accountability report, the subsidy will be definitively set or reclaimed.
Op basis van de eindverantwoording wordt de subsidie definitief vastgesteld dan wel teruggevorderd.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het gebrek aan toezicht op onderbetaling van werknemers (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the state secretary about underpayment of workers and alleged gaps in the labour inspectorate's oversight, including enforcement capacity, repeat inspections, sectors at risk, cao enforcement and posted or self-employed migrant workers. The minister rejected the claim of inadequate enforcement, citing rising fines and inspections, promised tougher anti-fraud measures and proposals soon, but declined to commit to expanding inspection capacity.
I am preparing a considerably stricter approach to fraud, including higher fines for violations of labour legislation.
Ik bereid een fors strengere aanpak van fraude voor, inclusief hogere boetes voor overtredingen van de arbeidswetgeving.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vermeende schijnzekerheid van pensioenoverzicht (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about pension fund transparency, including NBA advice on communicating probability distributions of pension outcomes, mandatory disclosure of the consequences of underfunding and of pension funds that must take corrective measures, and the risk communication on mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl. The minister agreed that transparency matters, said the information provisions of the Pensioenwet are being evaluated and will take the NBA advice into account, but largely deferred website responsibility to the Stichting pensioenregister and left the corrective-measures motion to the broader pension reform.
Based on the evaluation of the information provisions in the Pensioenwet, it will be examined whether it is desirable to include such an information obligation in the law.
Op basis van de evaluatie van de informatiebepalingen in de Pensioenwet zal bezien worden of het wenselijk is een dergelijke informatieverplichting in de wet op te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een havenclub die afwil van «luxe» arbeidsvoorwaarden (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister whether he agreed with Deltalinqs that workers should accept leaner conditions to avoid losing jobs to foreign labour, whether tenders on the Tweede Maasvlakte undercut Dutch collective agreements, and what the government would do to prevent a race to the bottom and check compliance by foreign firms. The minister replied that working conditions are set by social partners, that Deltalinqs is not a party to them, that posted workers have a hard core of Dutch conditions, and that the Arbeidsinspectie inspects about 12,000 employers yearly, with the government not selecting contractors.
It is up to the collective agreement parties to monitor compliance with working conditions as laid down in the collective agreements.
Het is aan cao-partijen om toe te zien op de naleving van arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals vastgelegd in de cao's.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het vangnet voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp-ers) (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the safety net for self-employed workers (zzp-ers) is adequate, given hidden hardship after the crisis, low uptake of the Bbz benefit, pressure to use pensions before accessing Bbz, and limited debt relief for self-employed people. The minister replied that self-employment income naturally tracks the economy, that most entrepreneurs have buffers, that the government promotes Bbz awareness via municipalities and a website, and that the SER-advice response on pensions and debt relief will come before April.
There is no information known about the degree of non-use of the Bbz.
Er is geen informatie bekend over de mate van niet-gebruik van het Bbz.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over investeringen in kernwapens (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether he would act on a Profundo report showing pension funds invest in firms linked to nuclear weapons, including by engaging funds or using the state's position at the ABP. The minister replied that funds have their own responsibility within legal limits, that no government intervention is warranted, that the pension federation will repeat its survey in 2012, and that he will raise responsible investing with ABP's board without forcing divestment.
That does not alter the fact that he regularly consults with the ABP board about the sustainability of the investment policy.
Dat neemt niet weg dat hij regelmatig met het ABP-bestuur overlegt over de duurzaamheid van het beleggingsbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over verspreiding privégegevens via het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister why home-based childminders' private addresses and phone numbers are published on the national childcare register (LRK) even when some childminders object, and asked for removal. The minister answered that public display of the operating address is needed so parents can verify quality and childcare allowance eligibility, that registration implicitly means consent, and that only mistakenly entered phone numbers can be corrected on request.
By submitting an application for registration, the childminder implicitly agrees to that listing.
Door een aanvraag tot registratie in te dienen gaat de gastouder impliciet akkoord met die vermelding.

Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over privacy en de veiligheid van de gastouders bij registratie in het landelijk register kinderopvang (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether publishing home addresses of childminders in the national childcare register endangers their privacy and safety, and whether the requirement could be limited to name, place and registration number. The minister rejected the privacy concern in general, kept publication of the care location as a transparency measure, but agreed to examine withholding the home address in exceptional cases such as demonstrable safety risks.
I am, however, willing to examine whether it is possible to shield the childminder's home address in the LRK in exceptional cases.
Daarbij ben ik wel bereid te onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om in uitzonderingsgevallen het woonadres van de gastouder in het LRK af te schermen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het voornemen van het Uitvoeringsinstituut WerknemersVerzekeringen (UWV) om de helft tot tweederde van de 130 vesti

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that UWV may close half to two-thirds of its 130 offices due to cabinet cuts, and whether face-to-face service and client support would be preserved. The minister replied that cuts must be made, that fundamental choices including office numbers and e-service are being considered, and that plans will be sent to parliament in spring.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de gevolgen van ketenaansprakelijkheid op grond

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked about court rulings holding PCM Distributiebedrijf and newspaper publishers liable for illegal deliverers under the Dutch Foreign Workers Act, whether fine-setting should reflect culpability, communication with industry, evaluation of the broad employer concept, and bankruptcies from fines. The minister answered that the Council of State found publishers fully culpable, that fine guidelines already reflect culpability, that communication and consultation with the press sector occur, that the broad employer concept will be kept, and that payment arrangements are available though bankruptcy data are not kept.
It is not known whether, and if so how many, companies have gone bankrupt as a result of administrative fines.
Het is niet bekend of en zo ja, hoeveel bedrijven er naar aanleiding van bestuurlijke boetes failliet zijn gegaan.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP) en Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de mislukte onderhandelingen van de schoonmakers en DUO en de Belasting

MPs Karabulut and Klaver ask whether it is acceptable that DUO and the Belastingdienst's move to a new Groningen building leads to cleaners losing jobs or worse terms, and about related contracting and the Schoon genoeg covenant. Minister Kamp answers that the cleaning is the responsibility of the private consortium and its cleaning contractor ISS, that the state is not responsible for dismissals, and that talks between the companies are ongoing.

It is therefore not up to the state services DUO and Belastingdienst but to ISS Nederland BV, engaged by Bouwcombinatie DUO2 VOF, to determine whether, and to what extent, cleaning staff are needed for maintaining the office building.

Het is dan ook niet aan de rijksdiensten DUO en Belastingdienst maar aan het door Bouwcombinatie DUO2 VOF ingeschakelde ISS Nederland BV om na te gaan of, en zo ja in welke mate, schoonmaakpersoneel nodig is voor het onderhoud van het kantoorgebouw.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bereikbaarheid van mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl en de juistheid van de gepresenteerde pensioengegevens (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister why the pension website mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl was nearly unreachable at launch, which pension funds were missing, and whether pensions are fully shown. The minister explained the capacity cap and waiting page, that about a dozen funds (about 4,000 entitlements) were not yet connected, and that MPs' own pension schemes fall outside the register, while promising to explore including them.
I have since contacted the Minister of BZK to explore whether the APPA pension statements can also be included in the pension register.
Ik heb inmiddels contact opgenomen met de minister van BZK om te bezien of de mogelijkheid bestaat dat ook de APPA pensioenoverzichten kunnen worden opgenomen in het pensioenregister.
Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat er in de kinderopvang te weinig kinderleiders op de groep staan (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about reports that many childcare staff regularly work alone with groups exceeding the permitted child-staff ratio, and what will be done to enforce the rules, including unannounced GGD inspections and pressure on municipalities. The minister called the findings worrying, outlined enforcement measures and planned talks with sector parties, while declining to intervene directly in collective labour conditions or budget effects.
Yes. This is an important aspect of the aforementioned process to simplify supervision and improve enforcement.
Ja. Dit is een belangrijk aspect in bovengenoemd traject om het toezicht te vereenvoudigen en de handhaving te verbeteren.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een tussenoplossing voor stageproblemen voor illegale leerlingen (ingezonden 8 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether he would implement his predecessor's commitment to remove the work-permit requirement for internships in regular education and whether an interim solution for illegal pupils and employers could be arranged. The minister replied that consultation with the education minister is ongoing and that the answers will therefore be late and folded into answers to a related question.
The answer therefore cannot be given within the set deadline.
De beantwoording zal daarom niet binnen de gestelde termijn kunnen plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over investeringen in kernwapens (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether he will respond to a report on pension fund investments in controversial weapons, engage pension funds investing in nuclear weapons to withdraw, and use the government's position as employer in ABP to end its nuclear weapons investments. The minister only announces that the answers cannot be given within three weeks because they require consultation with the ministers of the Interior and Defence.
The reason for this is that answering requires coordination with the ministers of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Defence.
De reden hiervoor is dat de beantwoording afstemming vergt met de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie.
Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en over misbruik in kinderdagverblijven in Amsterdam (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister how childcare organisations' structures and information sharing, the LRK register, GGD inspections and training may have allowed abuse of children by a worker in Amsterdam childcare centres. The minister answered that an independent investigation requested by the Amsterdam mayor has been started and will last three months, and that he will report his conclusions and address the questions once the results are known.
Once the results of this investigation are known, I will inform you further about my conclusions.
Zodra de resultaten van dit onderzoek bekend zijn, zal ik u nader inlichten over mijn conclusies.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de voorgenomen ontslagen bij De Vries Kozijnen in Gorredijk. (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether planned dismissals at De Vries Kozijnen in Gorredijk, and the reorganisation process, violated the Collective Redundancy Notification Act (WMCO) and whether intervention was planned. The minister answered that a court ruled the notification met WMCO requirements, that the late involvement of unions and the works council was cured by later consultation, and that no fraud occurred, so the interests of employees were adequately protected.
I do not share that view.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet
