MPs from several parties asked the minister of Social Affairs whether the cabinet is cutting childcare allowance, what the effects, measurable goals, indicators, baselines and milestones are, and how accountability will be given. The minister confirmed the cuts, gave budget figures, but mostly deferred measurable goals and indicators to the 2012 budget and the forthcoming bill, promising a legislative proposal and annual accountability.
The objectives of the cabinet policy based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

Opposition MPs asked the Social Affairs minister for measurable, checkable targets for phasing out the transferable general tax credit in the reference minimum wage and for its effects on benefits, purchasing power and budget. The minister gave brief answers, mostly referring to future budget indicators, and confirmed a bill for 2012 without giving baseline or interim targets.
The cabinet's policy objectives based on the coalition agreement will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.

De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid op basis van het regeerakkoord zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments, income and budget effects for a unified regime for the lower labour market (Wajong, Wsw, WWB). The minister mostly referred back to the letter of 6 December and to the 2012 budget, giving only the Wajong benefit cut and a budget table.
The objectives of cabinet policy will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.
De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs for measurable, accountable targets for reducing benefit fraud and how the government will achieve them. The minister confirmed harder enforcement, gave budgetary savings targets, and deferred the measurable indicators, baseline, interim goals, action plan and costs to a plan of action due in February, with accountability via the annual report and the Integrale Rapportage Handhaving.
In February the House of Representatives will receive the action plan setting out how the government intends to achieve the fraud target.
In februari ontvangt de Tweede Kamer het plan van aanpak hoe de regering de fraudedoelstelling wil behalen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs for measurable, checkable targets, baselines, interim goals, budget effects and timing for the government's cuts to the child benefit (kindgebonden budget). The minister confirmed the cuts, deferred measurable indicators to the 2012 budget, gave budget figures and said a bill would be prepared in 2011 with the wealth test effective 2013.
The objectives of the cabinet policy will be incorporated into the regular operational objectives and indicators in the relevant articles of the 2012 budget.
De doelstellingen van het kabinetsbeleid zullen worden verwerkt in de reguliere operationele doelstellingen en indicatoren in de betrokken artikelen van de begroting 2012.
Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een boete voor Pinkpop (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MPs Van Hijum and Uitslag asked the minister why the Pinkpop festival received a 48,000 euro fine for using two foreign students as volunteers without a work permit, and whether the rules or inspection practice should change. The minister confirmed three fines of 16,000 euro each tied to illegal employment, explained that volunteer status requires a UWV declaration unavailable to profit-making organisations, and said the volunteer rules will be replaced by a work-permit requirement.
I intend to replace the volunteer declaration with a work permit.
Ik ben voornemens om de vrijwilligersverklaring te vervangen door een tewerkstellingsvergunning.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over langer doorwerken in de zorg voor hetzelfde pensioen (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the Social Affairs minister whether it is appropriate for the healthcare pension fund PFZW to cut pension accrual and skip indexation in anticipation of later AOW-age legislation, and whether this harms workers and staff shortages in care. The minister answers that the fund must address its deficit itself, that the cuts are the fund's own decision, and that it is not for him to judge them.
It is not for me to have a judgement on this decision.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over deze beslissing.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Tony van Dijck (PVV) en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het pensioenfonds van Smit Internationale (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MPs Omtzigt, Van Dijck and Vermeij asked the minister whether Boskalis's former Smit management put shareholders ahead of the Smit pension fund, and whether the employer bears a moral duty and should be called to account. The minister refused to engage directly, calling it a matter between Boskalis, the pension fund board and its bodies, though Boskalis offered a one-off EUR 30 million payment conditional on withdrawal of a lawsuit.
This is a matter between Boskalis, the board of the Smit pension fund, the accountability body and the participants' council. There is no role for the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment.
Dit is een zaak tussen Boskalis, het bestuur van het pensioenfonds Smit, het verantwoordingsorgaan en de deelnemersraad. Er ligt geen rol voor de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afwijzing van Smit van de bijstorting in het pensioenfonds van Smit door Boskalis (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Smit's management rejected three offers from Boskalis to top up Smit's pension fund, whether the money went to shareholders, and whether DNB or AFM should investigate and the money be redirected to the fund. The minister confirms the rejections, says the matter is between Boskalis, the pension fund and its bodies with no ministerial role, declines to request an investigation, and notes Boskalis plans a voluntary EUR 30 million top-up.
This is a matter between Boskalis, the board of the Smit pension fund, the accountability body and the participants' council. There is no role for the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment.
Dit is een zaak tussen Boskalis, het bestuur van het pensioenfonds Smit, het verantwoordingsorgaan en de deelnemersraad. Er ligt geen rol voor de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Vragen van de leden Schouw en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de Europese Verordening van Sociale zekerheid (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MPs Schouw and Koşer Kaya asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU Regulation 883/2004 prevents cross-border workers who become fully unemployed from claiming unemployment benefit from their last employment state under the Miethe ruling, and whether the Commission's view that Miethe still applies is accepted. The minister answered that under Regulation 883/2004 only the state of residence pays benefits, that the Miethe ruling no longer applies (as Germany and Belgium also hold), and that no Dutch change is planned.
The Netherlands therefore no longer sees any need to also grant a Dutch unemployment benefit.
Nederland ziet dan ook geen noodzaak meer om tevens een Nederlandse werkloosheidsuitkering toe te kennen.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over barrières in regelgeving voor stichting Solink (ingezonden 29 n

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether regulatory barriers (AOW rules on shared households) hinder the SOlink initiative pairing students with lonely elderly people, and whether the SVB could treat such arrangements as commercial. The minister supports the initiative, says it can proceed within AOW rules if contracts are businesslike, and refuses a generic exemption on equality grounds.
Your request to instruct the SVB to generally regard the agreements between SOlink, the students and the lonely elderly as a 'commercial' relationship, I cannot grant.
Uw verzoek om de SVB op te dragen de overeenkomsten tussen SOlink, de studenten en de alleenstaande ouderen generiek te gaan beschouwen als een «commerciële» relatie, kan ik niet inwilligen.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bijstorten in de pensioenpolis (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and van Hijum asked the minister whether employers must sometimes pay tens of thousands of euros in top-up payments when pension transfers are compulsory on an employee's departure, and how often this occurs, and what will be done to end the problem. The minister acknowledged such situations can arise mainly for SMEs with insurer-held schemes, said no data exist on frequency, promised to inventory solutions with the Stichting van de Arbeid and to inform parliament by Q1 2011, and stated there is no underfunding of insurers' obligations.
I will, together with the Stichting van de Arbeid and the pension sector, inventory how these effects can be removed or limited.
Ik zal – met de Stichting van de Arbeid en het pensioenveld – inventariseren hoe deze effecten kunnen worden weggenomen of beperkt.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over een subsidieaanvraag van ABN Amro bij het Europees Globaliseringsfonds (EGF) (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance whether ABN AMRO's application to the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for retraining 1,350 dismissed workers should be refused, given that the state is sole shareholder and the restructuring stems from the Fortis integration rather than the crisis, and whether the state had been informed. The minister replied that the application is lawful under the EGF rules, that the company co-finances EUR 2.78 million itself, that the restructuring was caused by the financial crisis, and that the state as shareholder does not interfere in operations, while he was informed as subsidy applicant rather than as shareholder.
On 5 October 2010 the Netherlands submitted an EGF application for ABN AMRO.
Op 5 oktober 2010 heeft Nederland een EGF aanvraag voor ABN AMRO ingediend.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor zelfstandigen zonder

MPs Vermeij and Smeets asked ministers about the lack of affordable disability insurance for self-employed workers without staff, the role of the UWV, and whether a mandatory scheme is needed. The government answered that self-employed people are free to insure privately or continue UWV coverage, that it sees no uninsurable professions, and that the SER advice and an AFM review of insurers' claims practices are pending.
Insuring is tailored work, and which type of disability insurance is the best option in terms of price and quality depends on the wishes, needs and circumstances of the person concerned.

Verzekeren is maatwerk en welk type arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering de beste optie is, wat betreft prijs en kwaliteit, is afhankelijk van de wensen, behoeften en omstandigheden van de desbetreffende persoon.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemers Verzeke

An SP MP asked whether UWV recruiting part-timers to replace dismissed TNT postal workers amounts to helping TNT's dismissal plan and pressuring working conditions. The minister rejected that view, saying UWV acts within the law and that TNT and its works council and unions bear primary responsibility for the decisions.
The view that the UWV is cooperating in TNT's mass dismissal plan as described in the question is a view I do not share.
De visie dat het UWV meewerkt aan het massaontslagplan van TNT zoals in de vraagstelling beschreven, deel ik niet.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Oost-Europese concurrentie in de thuiszorg (ingezonden 5 oktober 2

CDA MPs asked whether Bulgarian and Romanian home-care workers are being employed through posted-worker constructions, whether this circumvents work permit rules and amounts to bogus self-employment, and how the Arbeidsinspectie controls this. The minister explained the notification route for cross-border service providers, said the Arbeidsinspectie checks for illegal employment and bogus self-employment, and announced a 2011 inspection project in the care sector.
In these cases it is being examined whether there is illegal employment through the use of bogus self-employed workers or through making labour available without the required work permit.

In deze zaken wordt onderzocht of er sprake is van illegale tewerkstelling door de inzet van schijnzelfstandigen of door het ter beschikking stellen van arbeid zonder de benodigde tewerkstellingsvergunning.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Smits (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over uitval op mbo's door bezuinigingen op kinderopvang (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

SP MPs asked the education minister about MBO students dropping out because of childcare cuts, citing a broadcast on teen mothers and a Schiedam college that provides childcare. The government disputes the scale of the increase, points to the Plusvoorziening funding and childcare allowance, and does not commit to new measures.
The picture painted in the broadcast, that students in the lowest income bracket will have to pay hundreds of euros more for childcare as a result of the cut from 2011, is not correct.
Het beeld dat in de uitzending wordt geschetst dat leerlingen in de laagste inkomensklasse honderden euro’s meer aan kinderopvang moeten betalen als gevolg van de bezuiniging per 2011, is niet juist.
Vragen van het lid Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het artikel «De crèche wordt steeds duurder en slechter» (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report claiming childcare is becoming more expensive and worse, including foreign ownership, weak financial oversight, understaffing in Leiden and lack of parental cost information. The minister said nationality of owners is not registered, enforcement in Leiden has improved under agreements with the Inspectorate, and parents' position will be strengthened via a promised letter and a comparison website.
Enforcement of violations of the quality criteria, including the staff-child ratio, must be tackled by municipalities.
Handhaving op overtredingen van de kwaliteitscriteria, dus ook zeker de beroepskracht-kind-ratio, moet door gemeenten worden aangepakt.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat vijf jaar marktwerking de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang heeft verslechterd (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister for Social Affairs about reports that market forces had worsened childcare quality, including hourly price rises, staffing levels, GGD inspections, concentration among large providers, and the employer contribution. The minister answered that prices had not risen disproportionately according to the NMa, that inspections and enforcement are being tightened, and that the government would write a letter in 2011 but rejected abolishing market provision.
As I indicate in my answer to question 4 from members Koşer-Kaya and Verhoeven, I will send you a letter on this subject during 2011.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 4 van de leden Koşer-Kaya en Verhoeven aangeef, stuur ik u in de loop van 2011 een brief over dit onderwerp.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over marktwerking in de kinderopvang (ingezonden 5 november 2

MPs Koşer Kaya and Verhoeven asked ministers whether market liberalisation in childcare since 2005 has raised prices, created waiting lists and lowered quality, and how competition, parent choice and oversight are assessed. The minister acknowledges the market does not yet function optimally, promises a letter next year and a CPB study, but largely defends the market model and says oversight changes will be considered in that letter.
I have asked the CPB whether it would be willing to conduct research into the childcare market.
Ik heb het CPB gevraagd of zij onderzoek willen doen naar de kinderopvangmarkt.
Vragen van het lid Straus (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de opleidingseisen voor gastouders (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

MP Straus asked the minister whether the official diploma list for childminders (gastouders) should be expanded so that a HBO childcare diploma is recognised, and whether the list would be revised quickly given the 31 December 2010 deadline for childcare allowance. The minister declined to comment on individual diplomas, said the branch proposed a equivalence committee, and that the government is examining how to implement and legally anchor it before adding diplomas.
I want to respond positively to the proposal from the sector.
Ik wil positief reageren op het voorstel van de branche.

MP Klaver asked the ministers whether they knew that many self-employed without staff in Amsterdam lack health, disability and pension insurance, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledged the figures, said the government is pursuing legislation to trace uninsured people and that regional data on disability and pension coverage is not available, deferring broader policy to the cabinet response to an SER advisory report.
I do not know how many of these uninsured people are self-employed without staff, or what the reasons of the uninsured self-employed are for not meeting their legal obligation.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel van deze onverzekerden zzp'er zijn of wat de overwegingen van de betreffende onverzekerde zzp'ers zijn om niet aan hun wettelijke verplichting te voldoen.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het door werkgevers onterecht gedeeltelijk ziekmelden van werknemers die terugkeren van ziekteverzuim (ingezonden

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers partially sick-reporting returning employees is undesirable, whether sanctions or labour inspection apply, whether further research and stricter Poortwachter rules are warranted, and whether employees fear job loss when requesting a UWV expert opinion. The minister replied that no duty exists to report recovery, so no sanction or inspection role arises, that existing rules and the courts adequately protect employees, and that no new measures or research are planned.
I therefore do not intend to take legislative or other measures in this matter, nor to conduct research into the scale of the problem.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om wettelijke of andere maatregelen te treffen ter zake dan wel onderzoek te doen naar de omvang van de problematiek.

Rep. Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health whether they knew that many self-employed workers without staff in Amsterdam lack basic health insurance, disability insurance and pension coverage, and what steps they would take. MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged dismissal fraud and whether UWV can grant advances to claimants, citing a constituent's case. The minister said fraud is a matter for criminal investigation by police or SIOD/FIOD, that the Arbeidsinspectie should only report signals, and that UWV can advance benefits when entitlement is reasonably likely.
A judgment on that is reserved for the judge.
Een oordeel daarover is voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over onjuiste pensioenoverzichten (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

MP Koşer Kaya (D66) asked the minister about the AFM finding that many pension overviews (UPO) contain errors, including for disabled participants, and whether fines or new measures would follow. Minister Kamp acknowledged the errors as worrying but said most deviations are small, that existing AFM supervision is adequate, and that the AFM is taking follow-up action and the sector is working on simplifying the UPO model.
I will not take additional measures myself. That is also not necessary, since supervision on this point is already adequately arranged.
Ik ga zelf geen extra maatregelen treffen. Dat is ook niet nodig, aangezien het toezicht op dit punt al afdoende is geregeld.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aanbieden van beleggingsrekeningen als spaarrekeningen door het Pensioenfonds voor Werk en Re-integratie (PWR

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about losses on the PWRI pension fund's investment-based AOV scheme, which was presented as savings, and whether the AFM could act. The minister replied that the scheme is a legacy savings fund supervised by DNB rather than the AFM, that no benefits were cut, that members were informed, and that three complaints are under supervision.
