Asks the government to pay explicit attention to protecting civil rights when transferring public tasks to semi-public institutions.
requests the government, when transferring public tasks to semi-public institutions, to explicitly pay attention to protecting civil rights
verzoekt de regering, bij de overdracht van publieke taken aan semipublieke instellingen expliciet aandacht te besteden aan de bescherming van burgerrechten
Motie van het lid Özütok c.s. over democratische controle op de uitgave van middelen

Asks the government to consult the VNG and council members' association on obstacles to municipal councils' budget and control rights over joint regulations in social domain spending, and to inform the House by 1 March 2018.
requests the government to consult with the VNG and the council members' association to identify obstacles in decision-making and in democratic control over spending

verzoekt de regering om, met de VNG en de belangenvereniging van gemeenteraadsleden in overleg te treden en te inventariseren welke belemmeringen er in het besluitvormingsproces en daarmee in de democratische controle op de uitgave van middelen en de uitvoering van taken zijn
Motie van het lid Middendorp c.s. over de LTI-leennorm
Asks the government to arrange a one-month transitional period in supervision for the LTI mortgage norm and to consult lenders and advisers on a workable solution.
requests the government to arrange that supervision takes into account a one-month transition period for the lending norms, once
verzoekt de regering, om te regelen dat in het toezicht eenmalig bij de leennormen rekening te houden met een overgangstermijn van één maand
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Paternotte en Van Eijs over de berichten dat studenten boetes ontvangen voor groepsvorming in eigen huis

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether fines for student house gatherings under emergency COVID-19 ordinances are proportionate, consistent and correctly applied. The minister answered that the ban applies only to public space, that the Leiden fines were withdrawn, that enforcement guidance is national but allows local discretion, and that a bill is being prepared to clarify household definitions.
The fines imposed in Leiden mentioned above have been withdrawn, because it later became clear that the emergency ordinance was not applied correctly.
De bovengenoemde boetes die zijn opgelegd in Leiden zijn ingetrokken, omdat achteraf is gebleken dat de noodverordening niet op juiste wijze is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Strategie voor gendergelijkheid: streven naar een Unie van gelijkheid’

An MP asked the government about the European Commission's gender equality strategy 2020-2025, including violence against women, underreporting, ratification of the Istanbul Convention, EU criminal harmonisation, online violence and the Beijing Platform. The minister welcomed the strategy, described existing Dutch programmes on domestic violence and planned legislation on sexual offences, and said Istanbul Convention ratification is stalled in the Council pending a Court of Justice opinion.
The cabinet welcomes this gender strategy and shares the goals formulated in the gender equality strategy.
Het kabinet verwelkomt deze genderstrategie en deelt de doelen die in de strategie voor gendergelijkheid worden geformuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat de politieopleiding wordt verkort tot twee jaar

Parliamentary questions from MP Den Boer (D66) ask the Minister of Justice and Security whether the police training course is being shortened to two years, and about its effects on quality, cybercrime and discrimination content, financing, accreditation, consultation and timing. The minister answers that the shortening is a structural, education-driven change within existing law, that quality is not compromised, that the Chamber was informed in earlier letters, and that the new basic training starts in 2021.
With my letters of 13 November 2019, 17 December 2019, 4 February 2020 and 28 March 2020 I informed your House about the intention to revise basic police education and a possible shortening.

Antwoord 9 Met mijn brieven van 13 november 2019 2 , 17 december 2019 3 , 4 februari 2020 4 en 28 maart 2020 5 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over het voornemen tot een herziening van het basispolitieonderwijs en een mogelijke verkorting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Özütok en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Van 2 uitvaarten per week naar 2 per dag: uitvaartondernemer Marjan Damen draait overuren’

MPs asked the ministers about reports that funeral directors were overstretched by rising COVID-19 deaths, including capacity in mortuaries, the role of Defence and coordination, protective equipment, coffin supply and Islamic and Jewish burial rights. The minister answered that the sector is coping, that a coordination point and Defence support can be arranged if needed, that mortuary and coffin capacity is sufficient with contingency plans, and that burial options exist.
I indeed receive questions from the funeral sector about the Corona crisis, including about the cabinet's measures and RIVM guidelines.
Ik ontvang inderdaad vragen uit de uitvaartsector over de Corona-crisis, waaronder ook over de maatregelen van het kabinet en de richtlijnen van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Canada en Nederland testen trans-Atlantische vluchten zonder paspoort’

D66 MPs asked about a Canada-Netherlands pilot testing passport-free transatlantic travel via facial recognition and a digital traveller identity, including its origins, necessity, duration, privacy safeguards, data use and function creep. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot is voluntary, governed by a data protection impact assessment, will be evaluated and shared with parliament, but gave only general or deferred answers on several points and no firm plans for other countries.
The outcomes and evaluation of the test will be published and I will share them with your House.
De uitkomsten en evaluatie van de test worden gepubliceerd en deel ik met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Sneller en Groothuizen over de implementatie van noodverordeningen ten behoeve van de ‘intelligente lockdown’

MPs Den Boer, Sneller and Groothuizen asked why the legal basis for new COVID-19 'intelligent lockdown' measures was not communicated, why emergency ordinances took days to draft, whether enforcement before legal force was lawful, and when the ordinances will be withdrawn. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the legal bases were in the Minister of Health's directive to safety regions, acknowledged the omission for future letters, defended announcing measures before the ordinances existed, explained the drafting complexity, and said the measures stay in force until the health minister's directive is withdrawn, with review before 28 April.
In future, care will be taken that these legal bases are also stated when informing the House.
In het vervolg zal erop worden gelet dat deze grondslagen ook worden vermeld bij het informeren van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de berichtgeving omtrent de bewapening van boa’s

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the role of buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren (boas) in enforcing COVID-19 emergency measures, their equipment, cooperation with police, radio communication, the possibility of arming them with pepper spray, training, and the progress of a motion on the future of policing. The minister answered that enforcement powers were extended via regulation, equipment is primarily the employers' responsibility, weapons are granted case by case, and the motion is being pursued with the WRR.
The theme of cooperation between boas and the police is part of the policy and implementation agenda to be formed.
Het thema samenwerking tussen boa`s met de politie is onderdeel van de te vormen beleids- en uitvoeringsagenda
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sneller over de lokale noodverordeningen in verband met de bestrijding van het coronavirus

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about the legal basis, decision-making, democratic oversight and publication of local COVID-19 emergency ordinances, and about Latvia's suspension of ECHR rights. The minister acknowledged the omitted legal basis, described the regional chairs' emergency ordinances and the accountability route via municipal councils, and said current measures fit within ECHR limitation clauses.
Omitting the legal basis was an oversight.
Het niet vermelden van de wettelijke grondslag was een omissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Vrijwillig werken bij politie is ook al niet de oplossing’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Den Boer asked the Justice Minister about police volunteers: whether they are used to avoid displacing regular officers, how many there are, whether there is a central competence register, training and waiting lists, and the ideal balance. The Minister answered that volunteers are a valuable addition, that they must not be used to cover capacity shortages, that a Toetsingscommissie monitors displacement, and that the force is working on a national competence portal and expanded training, while providing the figures requested.
However, it is not intended that volunteers be deployed to cover capacity shortages.
Het is evenwel niet de bedoeling dat vrijwilligers worden ingezet om capaciteitstekorten op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de rechtspleging en de rechtsbescherming

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked how the Corona crisis affects criminal justice and legal protection, including the Public Prosecution Service's restricted approach, the Emergency Justice Act (Noodwet rechtspleging) and suspended community service sentences. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police, prosecutors, probation and courts have scaled back work to priority tasks, that remote legal aid is being organised and extra fees given, that the emergency act is not yet needed but would be decided via the Ministerial Crisis Committee, and that community service terms cannot currently be extended by law.
Applying the Emergency Justice Act is, given the exceptional measures it provides, not an instrument to be used lightly.
Het toepassen van de Noodwet rechtspleging is, mede gelet op de bijzondere voorzieningen die deze wet biedt, geen lichtzinnig in te zetten instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Politie arresteert klokkenluider die klaagde over machtsmisbruik’

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of two police officers suspected of leaking confidential police data, and whether this deters internal whistleblowing within the Dutch National Police. Minister Grapperhaus declined to comment on the individual criminal investigation, stated that whistleblowers following the prescribed internal procedure deserve protection while leaking confidential information is not whistleblowing, and pointed to internal procedures, an internal ombudsman and an ongoing evaluation.
As Minister of Justice and Security, it is not appropriate for me to comment on an individual criminal investigation.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid past het mij niet me uit te laten over een individueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de groene BOA’s

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about the position of green enforcement officers (BOA's), including their numbers, violence against them, training, cooperation with police and radio equipment. The minister answered that numbers are not separately registered, violence is a matter for employers and is recorded irregularly, and that the government is working on a plan of action, with progress reports promised for early 2020.
There is no nationally uniform picture of the number of incidents involving green BOA's.
Er is geen landelijk uniform beeld van het aantal incidenten waar groene BOA's bij betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Van der Graaf over de herbenoeming van burgemeesters

Two MPs asked whether the re-appointment procedure for mayors (art. 61a Gemeentewet) should be changed, including limits on terms, a new profile before re-appointment, and a 3-5-7 career principle. The minister replied that re-appointment is tailored per case, no term limit or new profile is needed, the existing council-and-commissioner procedure is adequate, and career talks will be intensified.
I therefore see no reason to amend the Municipal Act on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de Gemeentewet op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Schonis over het bericht 'Veel meer ongevallen, veel minder politie op snelweg'

MPs Den Boer and Schonis asked ministers about a report linking reduced police presence on motorways to rising accidents, including the effectiveness of radar enforcement, the choice of enforcement locations, speed-trap apps, and seatbelt enforcement. The ministers acknowledged the rise in accidents and the importance of enforcement, but defended current enforcement practice, said no separate policy plan was needed, and promised modest follow-up such as the Analysetool Handhaving and trajectory controls.
The SWOV study 'Traffic enforcement on Dutch motorways' focuses on traffic enforcement.
Het onderzoek van SWOV «Verkeershandhaving op Nederlandse autosnelwegen» is gericht op de verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over milieucriminaliteit

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about environmental crime, covering police expertise, illegal bird trapping and eel poaching, illegal waste transport, subsidy and manure fraud, and air-gun regulation. The government answered that police capacity is adequate, that some enforcement data are not registered or fall under provincial responsibility, and that a bill requiring permits for high-power air guns is nearly ready.
Control over bird trapping has been the responsibility of the provinces since 2017, so I will not give a picture or figures on this.
De controle op het vangen van vogels ligt sinds 2017 bij de provincies, daarom zal ik hier geen beeld of cijfers voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Den Boer over de laatste stand van zaken rondom de aanschaf van tweeduizend bodycams

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about the status of the purchase of 2,000 police bodycams, including procurement progress, evidence on effects, privacy safeguards, ethnic profiling and the Ombudsman's role. The minister answered that procurement is underway with operational use expected by end 2020, that privacy rules and a 28-day review regime exist, and that bodycams are not used to combat ethnic profiling.
We are currently having that examined and will inform your House in the second police half-yearly report of 2019 about the outcome of that study.
Ik laat dat op dit moment onderzoeken en zal uw Kamer in het tweede halfjaarbericht politie van 2019 informeren over de uitkomst van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Discriminatie en wangedrag bij politie Den Haag

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of discrimination, excessive force and a poor culture at a Den Haag police unit, and why internal signals were not acted upon. The minister answered that the police chief handles such reports, that an investigation and an ombudsman post are in place, and that he will inform parliament in a spring 2020 report, while seeing no need for further measures now.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the aforementioned processes within the police (see my letters of 9 and 15 October).
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van de eerder genoemde trajecten bij de politie (zie mijn brieven van 9 en 15 oktober jl.) af.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Den Boer, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Politiechef die racisme aankaartte weggestuurd’

MPs Den Boer, Van den Berge and Buitenweg asked whether the Leiden team chief who raised racism and bullying in the police was sidelined by the police leadership, and how the force handles such reports. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the team chief was not placed on non-active duty, that the force says all reports of misconduct are taken seriously, and that he will discuss police culture with the chief commissioner but will not comment on individual personnel cases.
Like your House, I believe we should exercise great restraint in commenting on individual cases.
Met uw Kamer ben ik van mening dat ons grote terughoudendheid past in te gaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Teamchef politie niet meer welkom in Den Haag’

MP Den Boer (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a police team chief, Ms Aboulouafa, was no longer welcome in The Hague after raising misconduct internally, and about social safety within the police. The Minister answered that complaints must be addressed, declined to discuss individual cases because the police chief is responsible for personnel policy, pointed to internal complaint channels, said the trust breakdown is separate from her criticism, and said a broader evaluation and an update in spring 2020 would follow.
Therefore I will not go into the substance of individual cases in my answer.
Daarom zal ik in de beantwoording niet inhoudelijk ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuiken, Laan-Geselschap, Van Toorenburg en Den Boer over terrorismeverdachten die airsoft speelden als mogelijke voorbereiding op een aanslag

MPs from SP, PvdA, VVD, CDA and D66 asked the Justice Minister how airsoft, which RTL reported terrorism suspects played as possible attack training, is controlled, including whether introduced guests need a certificate of conduct (VOG). The minister said current oversight is adequate, that screening looks back eight years, and that he will discuss how to combat misuse with the airsoft association but sees no reason to change the rules now.
I do not comment on individual case matters.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Commotie na hard optreden politie Utrecht tegen dronken studenten’

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a police arrest of drunk students in Utrecht, filmed and shared online, was proportionate, and about police training, use-of-force data and comparisons with other European countries. The Minister defended police discretion in use of force, cited registered figures on assaults on officers and police force use, said some data on injuries is not centrally recorded, and pointed to a planned reform of the use-of-force framework.
Both injuries to police officers and injuries to arrested persons are not recorded centrally.
Zowel verwondingen bij politieambtenaren als verwondingen bij aangehouden personen worden niet op centrale basis geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Raemakers over het bericht “Het raadsel rond de val van burgemeester Peter de Koning: Dit is een stille coup”.

MPs Den Boer and Raemakers asked about the unexplained forced resignation of Gennep mayor Peter de Koning and whether the procedure followed the Municipalities Act, and called for more transparency on mayoral departures. The minister said the breakdown was regrettable, that the commissaris van de Koning reported on the background, that no formal dismissal procedure under article 61b applied, and that she saw no reason for further research but would discuss the theme with the commissioners.
I see no reason for further investigation. However, following the Gennep case I will discuss the theme with the commissioners of the King.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek. Wel zal ik naar aanleiding van de casus Gennep de thematiek met de commissarissen van de Koning bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht “Bij provincie heeft integriteit geen prioriteit”

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether provinces must publish an annual integrity report, why only Noord-Holland did so, and what the Minister will do about integrity in Limburg. The Minister replies that the law requires accountability to provincial states but not a separate integrity report, that the form is agreed with each provincial council, that integrity is not a neglected priority, and that an ambtsbericht on Limburg was received and will be sent to parliament later.
I will inform your House about the content of the official report in the answer to the parliamentary questions from members Özütok (GroenLinks) and Kuiken (PvdA).
Ik zal uw Kamer over de inhoud van het ambtsbericht informeren in de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de leden Özütok (GroenLinks) en Kuiken (PvdA)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Alziend oog voor politie’

MPs Den Boer and Verhoeven asked the Justice Minister about reports that police use a private foundation, RTR-NL, to watch and link camera footage in a regional surveillance room, raising privacy, discrimination and GDPR concerns. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the police keep operational control, the foundation acts as processor under the Police Data Act, staff are vetted and trained, footage is retained for 7 or 28 days, and no new ICT system or tender was involved.
The police have operational control over the viewing of the footage.
De politie heeft de operationele regie op het uitkijken van de beelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over moslimfobie en intimidatie bij de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reported Islamophobia, intimidation and discriminatory language within the police, including alleged leadership inaction, handling of complaints, disciplinary practice and diversity in top positions. The minister condemned discrimination, said the police chief takes all reports seriously, promised a future overview of disciplinary measures from 2020, but declined to comment on individual cases.
I have no insight into police app groups.
Ik heb geen inzicht in politie-appgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over ‘Politie wordt niet diverser door afhakers’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether young police officers with a migration background leave within two years, why, and what is being done to make the force more diverse. The minister answered that no legal basis exists to link staff records to cultural background, that CBS data show a 13% share of staff with migration background and a 12% share of leavers, and listed recruitment and retention measures without confirming a causal link.
There is no legal basis for linking personnel data to cultural background.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag om personeelsgegevens te koppelen aan culturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Den Boer over berichten op Twitter dat mensen een sms kregen van Forum voor Democratie zonder dat zij zich hebben ingeschreven bij de partij

MPs Verhoeven and Den Boer asked how Forum voor Democratie could text people who had not joined the party, whether the Data Protection Authority would investigate, how people can check and delete their data, what sanctions apply, and whether party membership is verified for state funding. The ministers answered that the phone numbers may have been obtained lawfully with consent or were a processing error, that complaints were already with the AP and ACM, that data access and erasure requests are available, and that membership is checked through a declaration of intent and audit.
Inquiries with the AP show that complaints about this situation have indeed been filed.
Navraag bij de AP leert dat er inderdaad klachten over deze situatie zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over ‘Amper beleid bij forse groei buurtpreventie door burgers'

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the rapid growth of neighbourhood watch apps and patrol teams and the lack of national rules or oversight of them. The minister answered that municipalities handle this locally, that citizens may act within legal limits, that no incident or crime-reduction overview exists, and that the issues (including ethnic profiling and vigilantism) will be raised with the VNG and Interior Ministry.
Vigilantism by citizens cannot be tolerated.
Eigenrichting door burgers kan niet worden getolereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Tientallen foute agenten geschorst’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports of dozens of corrupt police officers being suspended, the handling of integrity cases, and Rijksrecherche capacity. The minister answered that the cited report concerns drug crime networks rather than police corruption, that disciplinary statistics are not yet available in a specific form, that the Rijksrecherche is working to increase output, and that integrity measures and registration improvements are being pursued.
At this moment it is still too labour-intensive to generate the total number for specific disciplinary measures.
Op dit moment is het nog te arbeidsintensief om het totaal aantal voor specifieke disciplinaire maatregelen te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat er minder festivals georganiseerd moeten worden om drugsgebruik tegen te gaan

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister whether he still stands by his remark that fewer festivals should be organised to curb drug use, and whether festivals are a municipal matter. The minister said he does not advocate fewer festivals but that organisers and local authorities should weigh whether the ban on hard drugs can be enforced before a festival is permitted, and that he will consult the parties on a more uniform approach.
I am not advocating a reduction in the number of festivals as such.
Ik pleit niet voor een afname van het aantal festivals als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over lange rijen bij de Roemeense stembureaus in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether too few voting locations were provided for Romanian citizens in the Netherlands, causing long queues and a disturbance at the Hague embassy during the 2019 EP and referendum votes, and whether the government would raise this with Romania. The minister answered that Romanian authorities are responsible, that the Netherlands raised its dissatisfaction with the ambassador and Romanian counterpart, and that Romania promised improvements, so no EU-level agenda item is needed.
The Romanian authorities must in future ensure sufficient capacity, polling stations and staff so that every citizen who wishes to vote can do so.
De Roemeense autoriteiten dienen in het vervolg te zorgen voor voldoende capaciteit, stemlocaties en personeel, zodat iedere burger die dat wil kan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Top politieschool moet weg wegens gebrek aan chemie’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Police Academy's top leadership must leave due to insufficient chemistry, and about how this affects leadership continuity, teacher workload and recruitment of 17,000 new officers. The minister confirmed the director stays until a successor is found, an interim operations head was appointed, a recruitment procedure will include external candidates, and extra teachers and a temporary Leusden location are being funded.
An interim head of operations has been appointed with extensive police experience in both operations and business management.
Er is een interim hoofd bedrijfsvoering benoemd met ruime ervaring binnen de politie, zowel in de operatiën als in de bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Den Boer over het bericht ««Helft vrouwelijke journalisten heeft met bedreigingen te maken» NRC checkt»

MPs Sneller and Den Boer asked the government about an NRC report finding that nearly half of female journalists face threats, and about the recommendations to protect them, including freelancers and journalists with a migration background. Minister Slob answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the Stuurgroep agreement and the PersVeilig project, and said the specific position of female and minority journalists will be addressed in a safety plan due in autumn.
It is unacceptable that journalists carrying out their work are hindered in doing so by the actions of others.
Het is onaanvaardbaar dat journalisten die hun werk uitvoeren, belemmerd worden in de uitvoering hiervan door de acties van anderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Vrijwillige brandweer onder druk: ‘Geluk als we met zes man uitrukken’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that volunteer fire brigades are under strain and struggling to recruit, and about possible responses. The minister says there is no mass exodus but regional signals of reduced daytime availability, points to the Veiligheidsberaad programme Vrijwilligheid and international exchange, and says the veiligheidsregio's bear primary responsibility for staffing.
The board of a safety region is the employer of the safety region's staff and therefore also of the firefighters.
Het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio is de werkgever van het personeel van de veiligheidsregio en daarmee ook van de brandweerlieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de registratie van stemgerechtigde EU-burgers in Nederland

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the low registration (12%) of non-Dutch EU citizens to vote in the 2019 European Parliament elections and whether municipalities, such as Haarlem, Gouda, Heerlen, Roermond and Amersfoort, properly informed them of the 9 April registration deadline. The minister replied that municipalities were required and instructed to inform EU citizens, described what each named municipality did, and said an evaluation survey would be held with a view to possible further action for 2024.

I will inform the House of Representatives about the answers municipalities gave to these questions and will then indicate whether I see reason for further action for the next European Parliament election in 2024.

Ik zal de Tweede Kamer informeren over de antwoorden die de gemeenten op deze vragen hebben gegeven en dan ook aangeven of ik reden zie voor nadere actie voor de volgende verkiezing van de leden van het Europees parlement in 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over integriteitskwesties bij de waterschappen

Member Den Boer (D66) asked ministers about 103 integrity cases across the 21 Dutch water boards over four years, why water boards show more cases than provinces and municipalities, and what steps are taken to strengthen integrity, including model codes of conduct and the basic integrity scan for new board members. The minister answers that integrity is primarily the responsibility of officials and board members themselves, points to existing toolboxes, handbooks and codes, explains the high count at Waternet by its size, and promises an evaluation of the integrity scan in 2019.
In 2019 the handbook will be evaluated, after which a next (digital) version will be published.
In 2019 zal de handleiding overigens worden geëvalueerd waarna (digitaal) een volgende versie zal verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over een oppositieleider die vastzit in een Tadzjiekse gevangenis

MPs from D66 asked the government about opposition leader Gadojev, detained in Tajikistan after apparently being arrested in Russia, and whether Interpol listings are being misused against political critics. The government replied that Gadojev returned to the Netherlands with consular help via the German embassy, that Interpol's rules forbid political interventions but full guarantees cannot be given, and that human rights are raised regularly in bilateral and multilateral settings.
However, I cannot speculate on the circumstances in individual cases listed on the Interpol list.
Ik kan echter niet speculeren over de toedracht in individuele casussen die op de Interpol-lijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Den Boer, Van der Graaf en Laan-Geselschap over leren van geweld

MPs asked whether the attacks on mosques in New Zealand warranted revising protection policy for mosques and religious institutions, and whether threat levels had changed. The Minister answered that there are no concrete indications the threat to religious institutions has risen, that existing policy and local measures are sufficient, and pointed to guidance documents and his letter of 21 March 2019.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to revise the existing policy.
Op dit moment zie ik daarom geen aanleiding om het bestaande beleid te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Pon-affaire op herhaling’

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked about reports of a new complaint over a tender by the national police, and about the capacity, workload and prioritisation of the Rijksrecherche. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a new complaint was taken up in September 2018 and handed to the Rijksrecherche in December 2018, that capacity has been a long-standing constraint, and that integrity policy is being strengthened.

After a thorough analysis of the new complaint and review of the extensive documents later submitted, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the Rijksrecherche, decided in September 2018 to take up the complaint.

Na een uitvoerige analyse van de nieuwe aangifte en na bestudering van de naderhand toegezonden omvangrijke stukken, heeft het Openbaar Ministerie in afstemming met de Rijksrecherche in september 2018 besloten de aangifte op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Is Interpol being manipulated by authoritarian regimes’

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether Interpol is being manipulated by authoritarian states through red notices and diffusions, and about rising diffusion numbers, safeguards, and private funding. The Minister denies a demonstrable trend of political misuse, points to added control mechanisms such as a task force and the CCF, and says Interpol funding is not dependent on private donors.
I am of the view that it must be strictly monitored that Interpol's constitution and rules for processing data, including the use of red notices and diffusions, are correctly applied.

Ik ben van mening dat er strikt op moet worden toegezien dat de constitutie en de regels voor het verwerken van gegeven van Interpol, en dus ook het gebruik van red notices en diffusions correct worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geen M of V, maar X: voor het eerst paspoort veranderd in genderneutraal’

Two D66 MPs asked why the government changed its stance on allowing a gender-neutral (X) passport and whether it regrets earlier expectations, and asked about timing of a plan on unnecessary gender registration, whether M/V counts as unnecessary, and why the advisory commission's view should be awaited. The Secretary of State answers that a legal change to the birth certificate would be needed, that passport sex must follow the birth certificate for reliability, that the government will examine feasibility with other ministries and report before summer.
I cannot yet commit to a legal amendment, because it must first be clear what the consequences are in legal, practical and ICT terms.
Een wetswijziging kan ik op dit moment nog niet toezeggen, omdat eerst duidelijk moet zijn welke gevolgen dit in juridische, praktische en ICT-technische zin heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Kerstens en Den Boer over politiek verlof voor militairen om uitzending mogelijk te maken

MPs Belhaj, Kerstens and Den Boer asked whether soldiers can get political leave to attend council or assembly meetings, and whether elected councillors can temporarily transfer their seat to enable deployment abroad. The government answered that soldiers can get extraordinary leave for council duties, but that the Kieswet and Constitution allow temporary seat replacement only for pregnancy, childbirth and illness, so a constitutional amendment would be needed and it is not convinced this is necessary.
An extension of the replacement option for military deployments abroad therefore requires an amendment of the Constitution.
Een uitbreiding van de vervangingsmogelijkheid bij buitenlandse missies van militairen vereist dus een wijziging van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over gouden paspoorten en visa

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked whether golden passports and golden visas, which let wealthy investors obtain EU residence or citizenship, pose crime and terrorism risks and whether the Netherlands should abolish its investor residence permit. The government acknowledged the risk if screening is inadequate, said Dutch investor permits are strictly checked, and promised an evaluation of the Modern Migration Policy Act in Q2 2019 and participation in EU-level discussion.
Based on this evaluation, it can in due course be assessed whether it is desirable to adjust admission schemes.
Op basis van deze evaluatie kan te zijner tijd worden beoordeeld of het wenselijk is dat toelatingsregelingen worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geen M of V, maar X: voor het eerst paspoort veranderd in genderneutraal’

MPs Den Boer and Bergkamp asked whether a court ruling allowing an 'X' gender marker in a passport means others can get it via their municipality, and what legal changes are needed. The Secretary of State answered that an X marker is only possible for people whose sex cannot be determined at birth, requiring a court order to amend the birth certificate, and that the government sees no need for legislative change for now.
In these cases, assessment by a judge remains necessary to amend the birth certificate.
In deze gevallen blijft een beoordeling door de rechter noodzakelijk om tot een wijziging van de geboorteakte te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Den Boer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat een Rus waarschijnlijk de nieuwe baas van Interpol wordt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Den Boer and Van Toorenburg asked whether Russian candidate Alexander Prokopchuk would become Interpol president, whether the Netherlands would vote against him, and whether he was linked to politically motivated Red Notices against Kremlin critics. The Minister answered that Mr Kim was elected president on 21 November 2018, that Red Notice procedures are bound by Interpol's constitution, and that the questions arrived after the vote.
These questions reached me after the election of Mr KIM as the new president of the INTERPOL Executive Committee.
Deze vragen hebben mij bereikt na afloop van de verkiezing van de heer KIM als nieuwe president van het INTERPOL Executief Comité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘EU zet bij grenscontrole dubieuze leugendetectie in’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about an EU pilot (IBORDER CTRL) using a lie-detection system at external borders, questioning its scientific basis, ethical review, and whether the Netherlands would take part. The Minister answered that the pilot runs until August 2019 so effects cannot yet be judged, that the Netherlands does not participate, and that deployment must respect Schengen Borders Code and GDPR rules, while detailed conditions are unknown to him.
The concrete arrangements and conditions for implementing this pilot are not known to me.
De concrete invulling en voorwaarden voor de implementatie van deze pilot zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘DELA gebruikt vingerafdruk overledenen voor commerciële doeleinden’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked whether funeral company DELA's use of deceased persons' fingerprints for commercial products was acceptable, and about legal protection of the dead and the remedies available to relatives. The minister answered that fingerprints taken with consent are a personal choice and part of business operations, that taking them without consent is unacceptable, and that relatives can complain to the company, the funeral complaints institute, the police or a civil court.
That a funeral organisation, such as DELA, sells products bearing the fingerprint of a deceased person for whom consent was given falls within the business operations of that organisation.

Dat een uitvaartorganisatie, zoals DELA, producten verkoopt met daarop de vingerafdruk van een overledene waarvoor toestemming is gegeven, behoort tot de bedrijfsvoering van de betreffende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Den Boer over de Verordening mechanisme om juridische en administratieve belemmeringen in een grensoverschrijdende context uit de weg te ruimen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for the status of the EU regulation on a mechanism to remove legal and administrative obstacles in cross-border situations, including negotiation positions and next steps. The State Secretary answered that the Commission proposal is with member states, the Dutch position is set out in a BNC fiche, the Austrian presidency will not put it on the agenda this year, and the Kamer will be informed periodically in quarterly reports.
I will inform the Kamer periodically through the usual information channels about developments regarding this proposal.
Ik zal de Kamer via de gebruikelijke informatievoorziening periodiek informeren over de ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot dit voorstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over een mogelijk incorrect politie voorschrift en de schijnbare willekeur bij het handhaven van een omgangsregeling

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked about an internal police instruction that wrongly stated a custodial parent withholding a child from court-ordered contact does not commit an offence under article 279 Penal Code, and about perceived arbitrariness in enforcement. The Minister acknowledged the instruction was incorrect, said it was removed and revised, and denied arbitrariness, noting police must establish an offence and consult the public prosecutor.
This is incorrect and not in line with article 279 of the Penal Code.
Dit is onjuist en niet in lijn met artikel 279 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het recht zich te vergissen

An MP (D66) asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs whether the Netherlands should introduce a French-style 'right to make mistakes' for citizens, and what consequences and costs this would have. The State Secretary says the principle appeals to him and that existing Dutch law already allows leniency, but that a general statutory right is not opportune given the Council of State's advice; he will convene a roundtable on the human scale of administrative enforcement and will only study costs if that leads to a general right.
In view of the above and the Council of State's advice, it does not appear opportune to amend the law in the Netherlands to introduce a general right to make mistakes.
Gezien het bovenstaande en het advies van de Raad van State lijkt het niet opportuun in Nederland een wetswijziging door te voeren in de zin van introductie van een algemeen recht op zich vergissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Den Boer over het uitzonderen van Nederlanders in het buitenland bij het kiezen van de Eerste Kamer

MPs Sjoerdsma and Den Boer asked why Dutch citizens living abroad have no say in electing the Eerste Kamer, given the coalition agreement's commitment to easier voting rights including for the Eerste Kamer. The minister replied that options for giving overseas Dutch citizens influence will be mapped and presented to parliament in spring 2019, and that the BES islands will vote for their own electoral college on 20 March 2019.
In my letter of 15 October 2018 I informed your House that in the coming months I will map out the options for giving Dutch citizens living abroad influence over the composition of the Eerste Kamer.

In mijn brief van 15 oktober 2018 heb ik uw Kamer meegedeeld dat ik in de komende maanden de opties in kaart ga brengen om Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen invloed te geven op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de verdeling van de extra politiecapaciteit

The MP asks how the 1,111 additional FTE of police capacity is divided across the ten regional units and the National Unit, on what criteria, how chiefs and mayors were involved, and how the 2% flexibility, ministerial trekkingsrechten, 171 FTE for undermining crime and 769 neighbourhood officers are allocated, plus recruitment intake per unit. The Minister answers in detail with allocation tables, explains a three-step distribution based on the Besluit verdeling sterkte en middelen politie, and commits to a WODC study and forthcoming regulation for the 2% flexibility, but leaves the post-2020 intake breakdown unset.
The WODC has therefore been asked to carry out further research on this.
Het WODC is daarom verzocht hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Nieuwe baas Amsterdamse brandweer wilde machocultuur aanpakken. Hij kreeg oorlog’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of dismissals, conflict with the works council, and a culture problem at the Amsterdam-Amstelland fire service, including diversity, selection and pay of fire chiefs. The minister answered that these are regional responsibilities, declined to comment on the dismissals, saw no national pattern, and promised to put the workforce-turnover question to the parties involved and to inform parliament further.
Under the Safety Regions Act the regional board is responsible for organising the fire service among other things. It is therefore not for me to make further statements about this.
Op grond van de Wet veiligheidsregio’s is het regionaal bestuur belast met de organisatie van onder meer brandweer. Het is daarom ook niet aan mij om hier nadere uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over Opinie 7/2018 van de Europese databeschermingsautoriteit (EDPS) over het voorstel om vingerafdrukken op ID-kaarten op te nemen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary about the EDPS opinion 7/2018 criticising the proposed mandatory fingerprint storage on EU identity cards and its proportionality. The State Secretary agreed fingerprints are sensitive data, said Netherlands will keep questioning proportionality in negotiations, and promised to raise the issue again at the 14 September working group, while deferring to existing purpose-limitation rules.
In response to this and to the opinion of the European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS), I will continue to raise the proportionality of mandatory fingerprint collection.

Naar aanleiding hiervan en naar aanleiding van de opinie van de European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) 1 blijf ik de proportionaliteit van de verplichte afname van vingerafdrukken aan de orde stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de berichten ‘Politie wil vooraanstaande functionarissen bestraffen om plichtsverzuim’, ‘Agenten willen meer transparantie over sanctiebeleid’ en ‘Politiekorps onder druk na b

MP Den Boer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports on unequal police disciplinary sanctions, including a dismissal of an Amsterdam police commander for misuse of police funds while other senior officers received small fines, and calls for more transparency. The minister replied that sanctions are assessed case by case under the force's integrity policy, that individual cases are not discussed for privacy reasons, and that the police will publish an anonymised annual overview of disciplinary measures from 2019.

However, I consider it undesirable to make visible at function or individual level which sanctions have been imposed, given the large and, in my view, disproportionate intrusion this would make into the personal privacy of these employees.

Ik vind het echter onwenselijk om op functie of individueel niveau inzichtelijk te maken welke sancties zijn opgelegd, gezien de grote en naar mijn opvatting onevenredige inbreuk die dit zou maken op de persoonlijke levenssfeer van deze medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Aantal duikteams brandweer in 15 jaar gehalveerd’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that the number of fire brigade diving teams has halved in fifteen years, asking about causes, regional norms, and training. The minister confirmed the halving, attributed it mainly to regionalisation, stricter safety rules and reorganisation, said no national norm exists for diving teams or a definition of water accidents, and left recruitment and training to regional boards.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat er opnieuw politie-uniformen zijn gestolen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of stolen police uniforms, including whether the thefts were targeted, why they were not publicised, and whether theft of uniforms is registered and how delivery tracking could be extended. The minister declined operational detail due to an ongoing investigation, said uniform theft is registered only indirectly (116 new-item requests in 2017 due to theft or loss), and saw no need for further measures given that only two of 88,068 parcels went missing.
An investigation into the thefts in question is ongoing. For the sake of the investigation's interests, I will not provide any updates on its progress.
Naar de betreffende diefstallen is een opsporingsonderzoek gaande. Omwille van het opsporingsbelang doe ik over de voortgang daarvan geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het ‘Evaluatieadvies van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2018’ door de Kiesraad van 17 mei 2018

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked the Minister of the Interior about the Kiesraad's 2018 evaluation advice, which again recommends letting voters with intellectual disabilities receive help from polling-station members inside the voting booth, and about the risks raised in the earlier amendment debate. The Minister answered that the ministry will examine with organisations how such help could be provided, hold a round-table in early September, and inform parliament before the end of the year.
I expect to inform the House about the outcomes of those talks before the end of this year.
Ik verwacht de Kamer voor het einde van dit jaar over de uitkomsten van die gesprekken te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Gemeenten neigen nog naar monisme’

MP Den Boer asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about a study finding that about 20% of municipalities lack the prescribed council group support, that fewer than 40% have the mandated secretary instruction, the evaluation history of the dualisation act, and the government's response to Hessels' recommendations. The minister largely accepts the findings, outlines existing and planned instruments (learning environment, action programme, research into council instruments, draft law strengthening local audit offices, consultation with VNG), and commits to further consultation on the recommendations.
It is of great importance that the municipal council has sufficient support to be able to carry out its agenda-setting, supervisory and representative tasks.
Het is van groot belang dat de gemeenteraad beschikt over voldoende ondersteuning om zijn kaderstellende, controlerende en volksvertegenwoordigende taken waar te kunnen maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Dit keer dumpen de boswachters zelf afval, als statement’

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security, Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and Infrastructure and Water Management about fly-tipping in rural areas after rangers dumped waste as a protest. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a joint plan of action on supervision and enforcement in rural areas would be sent to parliament before the budget debates, and noted that cleanup costs and enforcement capacity are burdens but gave no national data on causes or environmental damage.
As promised in the Nature committee debate of 8 March 2018, I am working with the Minister of LNV on an action plan to improve supervision and enforcement in rural areas.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018 werk ik samen met de Minister van LNV aan een plan van aanpak om het toezicht en de handhaving in het buitengebied te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat de politie vorig jaar 46 klachten heeft gekregen over etnisch profileren

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of 46 complaints against police for ethnic profiling in 2017, the complaint channels, handling, and whether an independent evaluation is needed. The minister gave detailed figures, described the complaints procedure, and declined an independent evaluation, citing existing reviews and ongoing research.
In 2017, a total of 46 complaints about ethnic profiling by the police were received.
In 2017 zijn in totaal 46 klachten ontvangen over etnisch profileren door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht dat particulieren steeds vaker een privédetective inhuren

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the growing use of private detectives by individuals, the number of private investigation agencies, the police's role in overseeing them, and risks to the rule of law. The minister answered that no objective growth figures exist, that agencies are licensed by Justis and supervised by police and the Data Protection Authority, that sanctions were rare, and that the police bear legal oversight responsibility while balancing capacity against other tasks.
Compliance with the applicable rules is supervised by the police. Self-regulation is therefore only one part of the overall package of control mechanisms for the private investigation sector.

Op het naleven van de gestelde regels wordt door de politie toezicht gehouden. Zelfregulering is derhalve slechts een onderdeel van het totale pakket aan controle mechanismen voor de sector van particuliere recherchebureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de berichten 'Debacle met digitale rechtspraak was voorzienbaar' en 'Digitalisering blijft steken'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Interior about press reports on failed digitalisation, including the Commission-Elias follow-up, ICT dependence on large suppliers, open source, and the role of the BIT. The government answered that the Programma Digitaal 2017 was effective and efficient within its frame, that most Elias recommendations were implemented, and that further steps (open source policy, digitalisation agenda) will follow.
The BIT will continue to give attention to the learning effect of BIT advice and ensure that accumulated knowledge and skills remain disseminated.
Het BIT blijft aandacht geven aan het lerend effect van BIT-adviezen en ervoor zorgen dat de opgebouwde kennis en kunde verspreid blijven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht dat de korpschef meer agenten naar het buitenland wil sturen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police chief's plan to send more officers abroad, including which countries and missions police are active in, their powers, immunity, funding and the review of the country programme. The minister answered in detail, listing liaison officer postings and missions, but gave no firm figures on the extra funding or new postings, deferring these to a letter around June 2018.
In my letter of 20 December 2017 I already committed to informing your House around June 2018 in more detail about these aspects.
In mijn brief van 20 december 2017 2 heb ik reeds toegezegd uw Kamer rond juni 2018 nader over deze aspecten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over gestolen politie-uniformen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police uniforms stolen from a courier van and whether home delivery of uniforms to officers' private addresses exposes their personal data to risk. The minister said all uniforms were recovered, that theft is not separately recorded, that delivery now uses a Track & Trace secure-transport pilot with officers choosing home or station delivery, and that no new tender will occur while the pilot is evaluated.
By now all police clothing in this case has been recovered. I cannot make further statements about the ongoing investigation into it.
Inmiddels is alle politiekleding in deze zaak teruggevonden. Ik kan geen verdere uitspraken doen over het lopende onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht Verantwoord gebruik van geweld moet bij agent 'inslijten'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about training hours for police use of force, the neck hold, registration of force, and complaints handling. The minister said police training is at least 32 hours (raised to 42 in the CAO), police cannot yet give reliable hours per unit, the neck hold was reviewed by the Inspectorate and a training framework adopted, and a new registration system and amended instructions are planned for 2019.
The police do not (yet) have reliable data on the training hours completed.
De politie beschikt (nog) niet over betrouwbare gegevens met betrekking tot de gevolgde trainingsuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Mister Cloud’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked the Justice Minister about a Blauw interview with police academy director Kuijs on a 'Kenniscloud' knowledge platform, its relation to the earlier PKN/KomPol, its business model, validation of knowledge, and police case-file quality. The minister answered that the Kenniscloud complements KomPol, that no commercial interests are involved, that validation rests with the responsible police portfolio holder, and that police and prosecutors are jointly implementing a file-quality standard.
There is no question of commercial interests.
Er is geen sprake van commerciële belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het rapport "Demonstratierecht onder druk"

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Minister of Interior about the Ombudsman's report on the right to demonstrate, including municipal bans on demonstrations, the Wom's adequacy for spontaneous disorder, and the effect of local political colour. The Minister broadly endorses protecting the right to demonstrate, promises a letter before the summer recess after talks with mayors, but declines to investigate municipal ban practices, saying responsibility lies with local authorities.
Respecting freedom of demonstration must take priority for local authorities, even when facilitating or banning a demonstration is politically sensitive.
Het respecteren van de demonstratievrijheid dient voor het lokale gezag voorop te staan, ook als het faciliteren of juist verbieden van een demonstratie politiek gevoelig ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht dat motorclubs zich naar België verplaatsen

D66 MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about reports that outlaw motorcycle gangs are shifting activities to Belgium to avoid Dutch measures, and about cross-border cooperation, a possible administrative ban, and EU anti-money-laundering tools. Minister Grapperhaus answered that cross-border cooperation with Belgium and Germany exists, that a bill for an administrative ban on legal persons is being prepared, and that further steps depend on operational needs.
As is known to your House, a law with an administrative ban is being prepared on the initiative of MP Kuiken (PvdA).
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, is er een wet met een bestuurlijk verbod in de maak op initiatief van het lid Kuiken (PvdA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het sociale mediagebruik van de politie

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about police social media posts that exposed personal data such as plates, faces and addresses, and about the rules, training and complaint procedures. The minister said the police are drafting new instructions, that 13 removal requests were received with eight still under review, and that talks on privacy in police videos are ongoing.
It is important that it does not make an unlawful intrusion on citizens' privacy, both for citizens and for the legitimacy of police conduct.
Het is van belang dat zij geen onrechtmatige inbreuk maakt op de privacy van burgers, zowel voor de burgers als voor de legitimiteit van het optreden van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat blindend en slechtzienden in Den Haag kunnen stemmen voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen

Two D66 MPs asked whether blind and visually impaired voters in The Hague can vote independently in the 2018 municipal elections using a template and audio support, and whether every municipality should offer this, including talks with the VNG. The minister confirmed the template is permitted for municipalities but declined to press for national rollout before The Hague's pilot is evaluated, promising to inform parliament on accessibility measures soon.
I therefore consider it still too early to discuss with the VNG before the 21 March council elections whether this approach can also be followed in other municipalities.
Ik vind het daarom nog te vroeg om al vóór de raadsverkiezingen van 21 maart met de VNG te bespreken of deze werkwijze ook in andere gemeenten kan worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Flixbus wil met camera’s drugssmokkel bestrijden’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that Flixbus is installing cameras to fight drug smuggling and about police checks on international bus passengers, questioning their legal basis, effectiveness, and compatibility with EU free movement and Schengen. The Minister answered that the reported delays concern Germany, that checks are targeted at passengers showing suspicious behaviour, that no border controls are carried out, and that camera surveillance is Flixbus's private matter under data protection law with no government role.
I do not have data on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Middendorp en Özütok over het bericht 'Je uitvaart kan een stuk duurzamer maar het mag nog niet'

Three MPs (Den Boer, Middendorp, Özütok) asked the Minister of Interior whether citizens should have more freedom in funeral methods, such as resomation, given environmental benefits and public support, and whether an impact assessment would be conducted. The Minister answered that careful study of ethics, environment and worker safety is needed first, referred to a completed TU Delft report, and promised to inform parliament in the second half of 2018 on policy proposals.
I expect to be able to inform your House further in the second half of 2018 about policy proposals regarding funeral practices in the Netherlands.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in de tweede helft van 2018 nader te kunnen informeren over beleidsvoorstellen met betrekking tot de lijkbezorging in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Moordonderzoeken West-Brabant stilgelegd door onderbezetting’

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether murder and manslaughter investigations in the Zeeland-West-Brabant police unit have been halted due to very high pressure on detective capacity, and what mutual assistance between police units exists. The Minister acknowledges the report, cites high workloads from counter-terrorism, cyber and high-impact crime, points to extra funding and the Politiewet article 56 mechanism for requesting assistance from other units, and refers to answers given to other MPs.
The Police Act provides that under article 56 the Public Prosecutor may request the Chief of Police to obtain assistance from other units for criminal law enforcement.
In de Politiewet is vastgesteld dat op grond van artikel 56 de Officier van Justitie de Korpschef om bijstand kan verzoeken vanuit andere eenheden voor strafrechtelijke handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het onderzoek 'Veiligheidsrisico’s jaarwisseling'

Den Boer (D66) asked the Justice Minister about the OVV report on New Year's Eve safety risks, covering EU fireworks rules, enforcement, Europol/EMPACT cooperation, border controls and tracking technology. Minister Grapperhaus declined to answer the individual recommendations, deferring them to a forthcoming joint response and a new national approach, and promised a letter to parliament in spring 2018.

In this letter I indicated that I do not respond to the individual recommendations of the OVV and that, with the presentation of the new national approach to the New Year's problems, I will provide parliament with a joint response from the partners to the individual recommendations.

In deze brief heb ik aangegeven dat ik niet op de afzonderlijke aanbevelingen van de OVV reageer en dat ik met de presentatie van de nieuwe landelijke aanpak jaarwisselingsproblematiek uw Kamer een gezamenlijke reactie van de partners op de afzonderlijke aanbevelingen zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over coldcaseteams

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security how cold cases are selected, how many arise each year, and whether selection criteria and special teams are needed. The Minister answered that cold cases are chosen by OM and police using age and public-interest criteria, that no national registration exists (about 1500 cases now), and that each unit has a dedicated team, so no new elite teams are planned.
The OM and the police have indicated that there is no national registration of cold cases, making it impossible to show the precise development of their number.
Het OM en de politie hebben laten weten dat er geen landelijke registratie van cold cases plaatsvindt, waardoor het niet mogelijk is om de precieze ontwikkeling ervan weer te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Verhoeven en Den Boer over het bericht 'Burger ingezet bij opsporing'

MPs Groothuizen, Verhoeven and Den Boer (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a new OM directive allowing police publicity of suspects' identities to prevent serious crimes, including identifiable victims and witnesses, and about safeguards, subsidiarity, oversight and ECHR compliance. Minister Grapperhaus answered largely in substance, explaining the criteria and safeguards but declining to commit to annual reporting and saying no specific oversight was planned.
I see no reason to specifically exercise oversight over this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding daarop specifiek toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht “Raadsleden samenwerkende gemeenten ontevreden: clubs van wethouders bepalen alles”

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a survey showing council members want more influence over inter-municipal bodies, and about democratic oversight of such bodies, including mergers and reform of the Wgr. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Wgr would be amended to improve political accountability, and committed to a policy letter in spring 2018 and an action plan in summer 2018.
Decision-making in a joint arrangement must be transparent and the councils involved must be able to better carry out their supervisory role and intervene where necessary.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Paternotte over het bericht 'Medewerkers maken zwartboek discriminatie'

MPs Den Boer and Paternotte asked the Justice Minister about reports of discrimination within the police, including by supervisors, and what measures, diversity efforts and monitoring are in place. The minister acknowledged that such conduct occurs, described leadership training, diversity recruitment and the Medewerkersmonitor, and promised an exit-interview exploration and an update in spring 2018 but declined to commission broader new research.
There is no legal basis for the police to register ethnicity.
Voor registratie van etniciteit door de politie is geen wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Den Boer en Van Raak over zwangere volksvertegenwoordigers

MPs Özütok, Den Boer and Van Raak asked whether a Nijmegen councillor's resignation, forced by the rule barring temporary replacement in the last 16 weeks of a term, amounts to pregnancy discrimination and whether adoption leave can be covered. Minister Ollongren said there is no discrimination, but she will prepare a bill to allow temporary replacement throughout the term, while refusing a constitutional amendment for adoption.
I am willing to prepare a separate bill for this purpose and will aim to present the bill to your House shortly.
Ik ben bereid daartoe een separaat wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding te nemen en zal ernaar streven het wetsvoorstel op korte termijn aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Den Boer en Sneller over de beïnvloeding door buitenlandse entiteiten van democratische verkiezingen

Three D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister about foreign influence on elections via social media, including Russian political ads on Facebook, data protection against microtargeting, and advertiser transparency. The government replied by referring to a separate letter on covert influence of public opinion by state actors, without answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Verhoeven, Den Boer and Sneller (all D66), question number 2017Z15194, have been answered by means of the letter 'Covert influence on public opinion by state actors'.

Amendement van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over extra geld voor gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand
Moves 46.7 million euros within the justice budget from unspent funds to legal aid, to raise fees for social lawyers.
This amendment ensures that for the rest of 2019 €46.7 million extra is freed up for article 32 Legal Procedure and Legal Aid, specifically for fees of social lawyers.

Met dit amendement wordt bewerkstelligd dat voor het restant van 2019 € 46,7 mln. extra vrij wordt gemaakt voor artikel 32 Rechtspleging en Rechtsbijstand, specifiek voor de vergoedingen van sociaal advocaten.
Amendement van de leden Hijink en Alkaya over geld voor jeugdhulp
Earmarks 400 million euros of youth care funds in the departmental budget so municipalities must spend them on youth care.
Municipalities are therefore free to use these funds for purposes other than youth care.
Gemeenten zijn daardoor vrij om deze middelen voor andere zaken dan jeugdzorg in te zetten.
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over uitbreiding naar bestuurders van alle banken
Extends a requirement that systemically important banks obtain Finance Minister consent for fixed pay of bank directors to all banks.
This bill introduces a duty for specifically systemically relevant banks to submit a proposed fixed pay decision for a new director or increase to the Minister of Finance for consent first.

Dit wetsvoorstel introduceert een plicht voor specifiek systeemrelevante banken om een voorgenomen vaststelling van de vaste beloning van een nieuwe bestuurder of een verhoging van de vaste beloning van een zittende bestuurder eerst ter instemming aan de Minister van Financiën voor te leggen.
Motie van het lid Alkaya over het herzien van de Nota Deelnemingenbeleid Rijksoverheid 2013
Asks the government to revise the 2013 state shareholdings policy note quickly and send it to parliament before summer, since criteria for taking stakes need updating.
requests the government to revise the Nota Deelnemingenbeleid rijksoverheid 2013 as soon as possible and send it to the House before summer
verzoekt de regering, ten spoedigste de Nota Deelnemingenbeleid rijksoverheid 2013 te herzien en voor de zomer naar de Kamer te zenden
Motie van het lid Alkaya over het voorkómen van verdere privatiseringen van staatsdeelnemingen
Asks the government to prevent further privatisation of state holdings to protect the public interest.
requests the government to prevent further privatisations of state holdings
verzoekt de regering, verdere privatiseringen van staatsdeelnemingen te voorkomen
Motie van het lid Alkaya over een parlementair onderzoek naar het samengaan van KLM met Air France
Asks the presidium to propose the design of a parliamentary inquiry into the 2003 KLM-Air France merger and the roles of ministers and private actors.
expresses that a parliamentary inquiry into the merger of KLM with Air France should take place
spreekt uit dat een parlementair onderzoek naar het samengaan van KLM met Air France dient plaats te vinden
Motie van het lid Alkaya over extra middelen voor speur- en ontwikkelingswerk ook ten bate van het mkb
Asks the government to use extra R&D wage-tax relief funds so that all small and medium-sized businesses can benefit.
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over duidelijkheid inzake de betreffende persoonsgegevens
Amendment requires the payment services decree to specify how users can clearly see which personal data is shared and with which other payment providers.
that for every payment service user it is clear which personal data is concerned and which other payment service providers can gain access to it
dat voor iedere betaaldienstgebruiker duidelijk is welke persoonsgegevens het betreft en welke andere betaaldienstverleners daar toegang toe kunnen krijgen
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over de intrekking van toestemming voor toegang tot persoonsgegevens
Requires that payment service users can withdraw consent to access their personal data at any time, with providers notifying others and deleting data within 30 days.
that the payment service user can withdraw consent for access to his personal data at any time
dat de betaaldienstgebruiker op elk moment de toestemming voor toegang tot zijn persoonsgegevens kan intrekken
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over een informatiedocument
Adds a requirement that payment service providers give users an information document before consent to access personal data is granted.

In any case it is regulated that the payment service provider provides the payment service user with an information document about the payment service before the user can consent to access to his personal data.

Daarbij wordt in elk geval geregeld dat de betaaldienstverlener een informatiedocument over de betaaldienst overlegt aan de betaaldienstgebruiker alvorens hij toestemming kan geven voor toegang tot zijn persoonsgegevens.
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over een jaaroverzicht
Requires payment service providers to send customers an annual overview of the personal data accessed, processed and stored about them.
the payment service provider annually sends the payment service user an overview of the personal data accessed, processed and stored within that period
de betaaldienstverlener jaarlijks aan de betaaldienstgebruiker een overzicht doet toekomen met daarin de persoonsgegevens die binnen dat tijdvak zijn ingezien, verwerkt en bewaard
Amendement van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op praktijkleren
Asks to reverse a proposed cut of 7 million euros to workplace learning places in vocational education (MBO) by adding the same amount to the education budget, funded from the budget surplus.
The government proposes in the spring memorandum to cut 7 million euros from workplace learning places in MBO.
De regering stelt in de voorjaarsnota voor om € 7 miljoen te bezuinigen op leerwerkplekken in het MBO
Amendement van het lid Alkaya c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op praktijkleren
Moves 7 million euro from a planned cut on practical training places in MBO vocational education back into the education budget, funded from underspending.
That is why we propose to reverse this cut on practical learning, so that young people in MBO get the quality education they deserve.
Daarom stellen wij voor deze bezuiniging op praktijkleren terug te draaien, zodat jongeren in het MBO het kwaliteitsonderwijs krijgen dat ze verdienen.
Motie van de leden Alkaya en Diks over het opzeggen van het investeringsverdrag met Burkina Faso
Asks the government to terminate the bilateral investment treaty with Burkina Faso before it renews automatically.
requests the government to terminate the investment treaty with Burkina Faso before 1 July
verzoekt de regering om het investeringsverdrag met Burkina Faso op te zeggen voor 1 juli
Motie van de leden Alkaya en Snels over de evaluatie van de financieringswijze
Asks the government to evaluate whether and how the change in financing of financial-sector supervision has altered supervision and enforcement.
requests the government, in the evaluation of the change in financing, to explicitly include whether and how the financing method has changed supervision of the financial sector
verzoekt de regering, in de evaluatie van de financieringswijziging uitdrukkelijk mee te nemen of en zo ja hoe de financieringswijze het toezicht op de financiële sector heeft veranderd
Motie van het lid Alkaya over niet laten neerslaan van de kosten bij de consument
Motion asks the government to examine how to prevent higher financial supervision costs from being passed on to consumers.
requests the government to examine options to keep higher supervision costs from falling on consumers
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om hogere kosten van toezicht niet te laten neerslaan bij de consument
Motie van het lid Alkaya over zorgaanbieders aanwijzen als aanbieder van essentiële diensten
Asks the government to designate healthcare providers as providers of essential services in the general administrative order under the Cybersecurity Act.
