requests the government, in the general administrative order, also to designate healthcare providers as providers of essential services
verzoekt de regering, in de algemene maatregel van bestuur ook zorgaanbieders aan te wijzen als aanbieder van essentiële diensten
Amendement van het lid Alkaya ter vervanging van nr. 7 over een voorhangbepaling

Delays the drafting of an algemene maatregel van bestuur on access to payment-account data until four weeks after the draft is submitted to both chambers, creating a voorhang procedure for parliament.
This amendment introduces a pre-submission procedure (voorhang) for the general administrative order implementing article 94(2) of the revised payment services directive.
Dit amendement introduceert een voorhangprocedure ten aanzien van de amvb waarin artikel 94, tweede lid, van de herziene richtlijn betaaldiensten wordt geïmplementeerd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Alkaya ter vervanging van nr. 11 over expliciet verwijzen naar Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders voor invulling algemeen belang
Clarifies that the general interest in the trade secrets law includes the public-interest definition of a suspected wrongdoing in the Whistleblower Authority Act, protecting disclosures.
This amendment makes explicit that the general interest is to be understood, among other things, as in article 1, part d, of the Whistleblower Authority Act
Met dit amendement wordt expliciet gemaakt dat het algemeen belang onder andere dient te worden opgevat als in artikel 1, onderdeel d, van de Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Alkaya ter vervanging van nr. 8 over expliciet verwijzen naar Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders voor invulling algemeen belang

Clarifies that the public interest in whistleblower rules includes the public interest as defined in the Dutch Whistleblowers Authority Act, including suspected misconduct endangering public health, safety, environment or public service.
is added at the end of part b, as meant among others in article 1, part d, subpart 2, of the Whistleblowers Authority Act
wordt aan het slot van onderdeel b toegevoegd «, zoals onder andere bedoeld in artikel 1, onderdeel d, subonderdeel 2, van de Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders»
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over geen sprake van bedrijfsgeheim ingeval van informatie die wangedrag, fouten of illegale activiteiten betreft
Excludes information about misconduct, errors or illegal activities from the trade secret definition, giving whistleblowers and journalists more protection and removing an exception.
it does not concern misconduct, errors or illegal activities
zij betreft geen wangedrag, fouten of illegale activiteiten
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over het uitsluiten van journalisten en klokkenluiders van het begrip inbreukmaker en bewijslastomkering
Amendment exempts journalists and whistleblowers from the definition of trade secret infringer and shifts the burden of proof to the company in court disputes.
is presumed, unless proven otherwise, not to be an infringer
wordt, behoudens tegenbewijs, vermoed geen inbreukmaker te zijn
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over expliciet verwijzen naar Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders voor invulling algemeen belang
Amends the general-interest definition in a whistleblower provision by explicitly referring to the Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders definition of a suspected misconduct.
it is made explicit that the general interest must be understood as in article 1, part d, of the House for Whistleblowers Act
expliciet wordt gemaakt dat het algemeen belang dient te worden opgevat als in artikel 1, onderdeel d, van de Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders
Amendement van het lid Alkaya over een voorhangbepaling
Introduces a four-week pre-submission waiting period (voorhang) before an general administrative order implementing payment services rules is made, giving parliament a prior view.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under the seventh paragraph will not be made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het zevende lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Teunissen, Alkaya, Dassen en Thijssen over fossiele subsidies

MPs asked the government about a report estimating fossil fuel subsidies at 37.5 billion euro per year, the reconciliation with the Miljoenennota annex, EU constraints, revenue use, and effects on competitiveness and the budget. The minister answered that the annex gives a range of 39.7 to 46.4 billion euro, that concrete tax measures were proposed in Belastingplan 2024, and that further proposals await a cabinet with full powers.
Given its caretaker status, the cabinet will not make further proposals for phasing out fossil fuel advantages.
Het kabinet zal, gezien zijn demissionaire status, geen verdere voorstellen doen voor afbouw van fossiele voordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat schippers vrezen voor een tekort aan ontgassingsinstallaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about industry fears of a shortage of degassing installations ahead of the 1 July 2024 ban on onboard degassing of tank barges. The minister answers that responsibility is shared among government bodies, industry and provinces, that a stakeholder roadmap is being prepared with a Kamer update after a November meeting, and that provinces grant permits and the ILT is assessing enforceability.
It is not for the national government to intervene in the competences of other authorities or to carry out actions that the market must take to prepare for the ban.
Het is niet aan de Rijksoverheid om in de bevoegdheid te treden van andere overheden of om acties uit te voeren die de markt moet nemen om zich voor te bereiden op het verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over treinen tussen Groningen en Zwolle

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would block extra NS intercity trains between Groningen and Zwolle, and whether open-access operators such as Arriva are a 'test ground' for the North. The State Secretary answered that the new concession will stay within financial limits and that the volume is still being specified in a draft to be sent in August, and denied any test-lab intent while listing ACM access notifications.
By August 2023 at the latest, I will present the draft concession to the House.
Uiterlijk in augustus 2023 bied ik de ontwerpconcessie aan uw Kamer aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de omvangrijke onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan de Velsertraverse

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the large maintenance works on the Velsertraverse, their traffic impact, communication with local authorities, and the refusal to reopen the locks route more widely. The minister acknowledged the impact, described the consultation and Hinderaanpak measures, explained the locks route's safety limits, and committed to a pilot and a joint study with the municipality of Velsen.
Rijkswaterstaat is working on a pilot to use the locks route during incidents lasting longer than one hour on the main road network.
Rijkswaterstaat werkt aan een proef om de sluizenroute in te zetten bij incidenten van langer dan 1 uur op het Hoofdwegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat de provinciale staten van Utrecht zich heeft uitgesproken tegen de voorgestelde nieuwe aanvliegroute naar Schiphol

Mr Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she would respond to the Utrecht provincial council's motion opposing a fourth Schiphol approach route, and how stakeholders were engaged in the airspace redesign. Minister Harbers answered that the redesign aims at sustainability and military training space, that consultation with provinces and residents continues, that a fuller implementation decision follows after the summer recess, and that the government will decide on further elaboration after reviewing effect analyses and participation.
After the summer recess, the Integrale Programma Beslissing (IPB) will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Na het zomerreces wordt de Integrale Programma Beslissing (IPB) naar de Kamer verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het schrappen van de Amsterdamse beurs van notering van 6 bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether six companies were delisted from Euronext Amsterdam only because they could not find an auditor, and what this means for investors and the market. The minister confirmed the planned delisting for failing to deposit an audited annual report, said the reasons are unknown to her, and pointed to a planned auditor-designation power for the NBA as a partial remedy.
I am not familiar with the specific circumstances of the companies concerned.
Ik ben niet bekend met de precieze omstandigheden van de betreffende bedrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de berichten van NOS Nieuws  ‘Vliegtuigmaatschappijen versus de staat: mag Schiphol krimpen?’ en ‘Rechter fluit kabinet terug: Schiphol hoeft dit jaar niet te krimpen’ en het be

An MP asks about the court ruling that the state cannot end anticipatory enforcement at Schiphol without following the EU balanced approach procedure, and about Schiphol's readiness, staffing, hazardous emissions and capacity reduction. The minister answers that an appeal is pending, the procedure is being pursued, staffing and emissions reports are being monitored, and reduction requires a regulatory change.
An appeal has been lodged against the judgment of the interim relief judge.
Er is hoger beroep aangetekend tegen het vonnis van de voorzieningenrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over Nederlandse banken die in de vuurlinie liggen door problemen in Silicon Valley

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the exposure of Dutch banks to the problems at Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank, including rate-rise risks and buffers. The minister answered that direct exposure is small, that US failures stemmed from atypical business models and deregulation, that Dutch banks are well capitalised and supervised under EU rules, and that no new measures are needed.
I am confident that European laws and regulations and our good supervision are adequate to address these risks appropriately.
Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat de Europese wet- en regelgeving en ons goede toezicht adequaat zijn om deze risico's op een passende wijze te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat geld voor ontwikkelingshulp in belastingparadijzen belandt

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development aid routed through PIDG, its Mauritius-based trust and the Guernsey-managed EAIF fund, could end up in tax havens, and how that fits Dutch anti-avoidance policy. Minister Schreinemacher answered that PIDG's trust is fiscally resident in the UK, that the fund manager was selected in 2016 under older tax rules, that PIDG now applies EDFI responsible tax principles, and that the ministry will explore a tax guideline and discuss a structure analysis with donors.
I am examining the possibilities for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Finance to draw up a guideline for this.
Ik ben aan het bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Financiën een richtlijn hiervoor op te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat vijftienhonderd bushaltes zijn verdwenen in de afgelopen vijf jaar

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the disappearance of about 1,500 bus stops, regional differences, market competition in public transport, and whether norms for accessibility should be set. The secretary says reasons vary by region, alternatives like flexible transport are being developed, the sector faces cost and revenue pressures, and norms will be discussed after the mobility vision is sent to parliament.
In March the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management and I will send the main lines of the Mobility Vision to the House of Representatives.
In maart versturen de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en ik de hoofdlijnen van de Mobiliteitsvisie aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat er een vijfdaagse staking plaatsvindt in het openbaar vervoer

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the state secretary how he views a five-day strike in public transport over pay, recognition and workload, and whether the government will fund pay rises, verify employers' finances, ban profit distribution by commercial operators, or appoint a mediator. The state secretary largely deflected, stating that labour conflicts and staff policy are the responsibility of operators, employers and concession authorities, while pointing to extra transition aid of up to 150 million euros this year and rejecting a profit ban.
Within this labour conflict between employers and employee representatives, I exercise restraint.
Binnen dit arbeidsconflict tussen werkgevers en (de vertegenwoordiging van) werknemers past mij terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het achterhouden van fiscale informatie voor de rechter

An MP asked whether the tax authority's withholding of fiscal documents from courts, reported by RTL, is regular and what the consequences are for taxpayers. The State Secretary answered that such cases are rare among over 23,000 procedures, that secrecy claims are reviewed by an independent court chamber, and that the tax authority has internal consultation rules and ongoing attention to the issue.
In my letter of 8 February 2023, responding to the request from the Finance Committee, I did, however, deny the picture that this would be commonplace.
In mijn brief van 8 februari 2023 in reactie op het verzoek van de Vaste Kamercommissie voor Financiën heb ik echter het beeld tegengesproken dat dit schering en inslag zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Omtzigt over de marktconsultatie voor de schaderegeling voor ex-partners

MPs Leijten, Alkaya and Omtzigt asked why the government ran a market consultation on outsourcing the ex-partner compensation scheme to a commercial party, when it was decided and whether the UHT agency's own view was tested. The State Secretary answered that UHT and CWS lack capacity, the consultation tests market interest and feasibility before a tender, the Ministry of Finance would be the client, and the government regrets the delay but considers the consultation essential.
The market consultation is used to sound out whether market parties are interested in and able to carry out the compensation scheme.
Met de marktconsultatie wordt gepolst of marktpartijen geïnteresseerd en in staat zijn om de schaderegeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Alkaya en Van der Plas over het bericht dat sluiting dreigt voor groen vmbo in Noord-Brabant wegens nieuwe aanbesteding van het openbaar vervoer

Three MPs asked whether the threatened closure of a green vocational school in Andel, linked to a provincial public transport tender cutting pupil buses, is acceptable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the closure threat is premature, that the province guarantees accessibility in its draft programme of requirements, and that it is for decentralised authorities to decide, so the government declines to intervene.
Since both municipalities and the province have their own democratically elected checks, the government exercises restraint here.
Aangezien zowel gemeenten als de provincie hun eigen democratisch verkozen controles hebben past de regering hier terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat er grote verschillen worden gemeten in overlast van vliegverkeer

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why noise complaints and noise measurements about aircraft over the Leiden region differ between Schiphol/LVNL and the Omgevingsdienst/BAS, and what the government's data basis is. The minister attributes the differences to different measurement methods (radar tracks versus noise monitors) and the rising complaints to wind conditions favouring the Kaagbaan, and says the enforcement and policy basis is calculated noise.
The differences can be explained by the different methods used by the Omgevingsdienst and LVNL and their purposes of use.
De verschillen zijn te verklaren uit de verschillende methoden die de Omgevingsdienst en LNVL gebruiken en de gebruiksdoelen ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht ‘20 euro subsidie per container die van weg naar water gaat’

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the minister about reports of a 20 euro subsidy per container moving from road to water, and about the risk that small inland vessels disappear, including questions on the study of expiring transitional rules, bridge operation, CO2 effects and subsidy scope. The minister answered that modal shift is promoted, that a study due spring 2023 will assess the effects on small vessels and related business, that no broader Modal Shift scope is planned, and that CO2 effects cannot yet be estimated.
In spring 2023 the House will be informed about the results of the study.
In het voorjaar van 2023 wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over werkinstructies over de compensatie O/GS en non-response

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about new work instructions for the O/GS compensation and non-response cases, including why compensation is now calculated on the amount actually repaid and why the changes apply only to new decisions. The State Secretary replied that the calculation was adjusted to match the legislator's intent, that compensation still covers the full recovered amount, that past decisions are not reopened, and that the non-response instruction now relies more on the parent's account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over maatregelen tegen de hoge uitval in het treinvervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management what short-term measures would address train cancellations, shortened trains and overcrowding caused by staff shortages at rail operators, including whether first-class seats should be opened to all passengers. The State Secretary answered that operators are primarily responsible, that he is pressing NS in talks and expects it to tackle staffing, and that conductors may already open first class when crowding justifies it, without committing to a general change.
Rail operators are in principle themselves responsible for managing operational risks, including the staff shortage.
Spoorvervoerders zijn in beginsel zelf verantwoordelijk voor de beheersing van operationele risico's, waaronder het personeelstekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht “Forse verhoging prijzen bus, trein- en metrokaartjes dreigt volgend jaar”

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about reported fare rises for buses, trains and metro in 2023, the end of a transition safety net, and whether fares should be frozen or VAT removed. The State Secretary answered that fares are a decentralised responsibility under a fixed indexation system, that NS fares rise 4.3% on average, that a 150 million euro transition safety net was agreed, and that KiM research on fare incentives will be discussed with the NOVB, with a report expected by summer 2023.
I am not responsible for the fares; fare authority lies with decentralised governments and NS.
Ik ga echter niet over de tarieven, de tariefbevoegdheid ligt bij decentrale overheden en NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door vervoersbedrijven

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether anonymous international train travel is practically impossible, who is responsible for processing passenger data, and why ticket counters are closing. The state secretary answered that anonymous travel is still possible to about 200 destinations, that there is no general legal duty on carriers to prevent anonymous travel, that the GDPR governs data processing with controllers identified per ticket sale, and that the number of international ticket counters fell from 10 to 5 with personal assistance offered elsewhere.
Providing personal data when travelling is not unusual.
Het afgeven van persoonsgegevens bij vervoer is niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en De Hoop over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden bij bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

MPs Alkaya and De Hoop asked ministers whether baggage staff at Schiphol had for years been required to lift beyond health limits despite a 2009 inspection demand, and what the government would do. The ministers answered that the employers are primarily responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has launched inspections and will report, and that Schiphol and the ministries are pressing for structural improvements including limiting the number of handlers, though no independent new investigation will be set up.
The Minister of SZW sees no reason to set up a new independent investigation on top of everything already underway.
De Minister van SZW ziet geen aanleiding om naast alles wat nu al loopt een nieuw onafhankelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het PAX rapport betreffende foute investeringen van de ING en andere grote banken in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a PAX report finding that major European banks, including ING, financed arms producers supplying states with high risk of using weapons against civilians, such as Saudi Arabia. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UNGP, that exporters with valid licences operate within legal frameworks, and that it sees no reason to meet ING, while pointing to forthcoming due diligence legislation.

The government expects Dutch banks such as ING, in line with the OECD Guidelines and the UN Guiding Principles, to map risks to people and the environment in their value chain for their investments in the defence industry.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse banken zoals ING dat zij, conform de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's), voor hun investeringen in de defensie-industrie de risico's voor mens en milieu in hun waardeketen in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van der Molen over de problemen met de invoering van ERTMS

MPs Alkaya and Van der Molen asked the state secretary about problems with the ERTMS rail signalling rollout on the Merwede-Lingelijn, including the cost-effectiveness of retrofitting existing trains and the planned provincial decision. The state secretary answered that retrofitting is not cost-effective, offered a lump-sum contribution toward new trains as an alternative, and said talks with Zuid-Holland are ongoing with a decision expected from the province on 12 October.
Together with the ERTMS Programme Directorate I am in continuous talks with the province of Zuid-Holland about the ERTMS implementation in the rolling stock on the Merwede-Lingelijn.
Ik ben samen met de Programmadirectie ERTMS continu in gesprek met de provincie Zuid-Holland over de ERTMS-implementatie in het materieel op de MerwedeLingeLijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Het uitkopen van boeren is wéér een bail-out voor banken’

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether banks such as Rabobank, which hold large food and agri loans, share responsibility for the nitrogen crisis and whether buy-out schemes for farmers amount to a bail-out for banks. The minister answered that banks share a joint responsibility, that the buy-out schemes are financed from state funds and may be used to repay bank loans, and that the government will inform parliament further on expecting a non-voluntary contribution from banks.
It is not for the government to intervene in the settlement of these financial obligations between private parties.
Het is niet aan de overheid om in de afhandeling van deze financiële verplichtingen tussen private partijen te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het artikel ‘Lidstaten saboteren toezicht op de honderden miljarden van het Europese coronaherstelfonds’ van Follow the Money

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether EU recovery fund (RRF) beneficiaries can be made public, given reports that member states resist transparency and oversight of the funds. The minister replied that EU rules require member states to collect beneficiary data accessible to EU audit bodies, that publication is for national governments to decide, and that a privacy-related review of publishing beneficiary data is due in Q3 2022.
The cabinet wants to carefully weigh the public disclosure of the data.
Het kabinet wil een zorgvuldige afweging maken voor wat betreft de publieke openbaring van de gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de stakingen van NS-medewerkers

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister, as shareholder, what she could do about the NS strike, whether she supports the staff's pay demands, and whether state participations should guarantee a 15 euro minimum hourly wage and disclose wage data. The minister replied that CAO negotiations are a matter for NS management and unions, that she expects good employer conduct and monitors NS finances, but declined to provide hourly wage data citing commercial confidentiality.
As a shareholder I do not have information on the hourly wages of the participations' employees. Moreover, this often concerns (business) confidential information.
Als aandeelhouder beschik ik niet over informatie over het uurloon van medewerkers van de deelnemingen. Dit betreft bovendien vaak (bedrijfs)vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst de regels schond om Uber te helpen

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Belastingdienst officials broke rules to favour Uber, including withholding foreign information requests and leaking confidential information. The State Secretary declined most substantive detail citing the tax secrecy duty (art. 67 AWR), said an internal investigation with external expert review is underway with results expected in September, and offered a confidential briefing to parliament.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Financiën naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister what measures the Finance Ministry took after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh outcomes of rules and on information management. The minister answered that inventories of harsh rules are underway across departments, that results will be sent later, and that chat-message retention guidance for ministers will be clarified.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de hoge werkdruk voor medewerkers in de burgerluchtvaart

MPs Alkaya (SP) asked ministers about high workload for air sector staff, the VNC's call for a baseline measurement, division of inspection responsibilities, under-reporting of incidents by cabin crew, and Schiphol congestion. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Arbeidsinspectie and ILT share oversight, that it will discuss concerns in the aviation safety and social issues platform and with Schiphol, and that existing EU rules already allow cabin crew to report safety risks.
Of course I consider it important that employers adhere to good employership.
Ik vind het uiteraard belangrijk dat werkgevers zich houden aan goed werkgeverschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat werknemers in het streekvervoer gaan staken voor fatsoenlijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en een lagere werkdruk

An SP MP asked the Staatssecretaris about announced strikes in regional public transport over pay, workload and staff shortages, and whether the government would intervene or act on driver recruitment, scheduling cuts and tendering. The Staatssecretaris expressed regret about strikes, said the labour dispute is for employers and unions to resolve and declined to intervene, and defended partial market competition while saying working conditions are the operators' responsibility.
Because this is a labour dispute between employers and employee representatives, I exercise restraint.
Omdat er hier sprake is van een arbeidsconflict tussen werkgevers en (vertegenwoordiging van) werknemers past mij terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over verplichte winstdeling door bedrijven in de strijd tegen inflatie

The SP MP Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about mandatory profit-sharing by companies as a response to inflation, citing a CNV proposal, and asked why the Netherlands has fewer such schemes, whether tax rules discourage them, and what could be learned from the UK, France and Germany. The State Secretary answered that wages and profit-sharing are primarily matters for employers and employees, noted risks of profit-sharing, stated the government is not currently planning tax incentives, and pointed to a pending bill on stock option tax rules.
The offer and use of employee participation is, as said, primarily a matter between employers and employees.
Het aanbod en gebruik van werknemersparticipaties is, zoals gezegd, primair een zaak tussen werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over ongelijkheid en herverdeling via het belastingstelsel

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about inequality and redistribution through the tax system, citing a CPB study showing top incomes pay relatively low tax rates and questioning the shift from direct to indirect taxes. The government answered that the tax system does reduce inequality, that the top 1% face a lower burden due to capital income treatment, that it will consider measures before Prinsjesdag, and that it stands by its planned tax measures on capital income.
In the run-up to Budget Day the cabinet will look at how the balance between burdens on wealth and on labour can be brought more into balance.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag kijken naar de wijze waarop de verhouding tussen lasten op vermogen en arbeid meer in balans kan worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het voornemen van de NS om de boa-bevoegdheid weg te halen bij hoofdconducteurs

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the government about NS's plan to remove the boa (special investigating officer) powers from its 2,800 head conductors, including the role of cost savings, staff shortages, safety impacts and consultation with staff. The state secretary answered that NS is responsible for safety and the decision, that the change saves about 5.7 million euro a year with little boa use, that safety is preserved through Veiligheid & Service staff, and that NS is exploring keeping boa powers for willing conductors.
NS is responsible for the safety of its passengers and staff. It is up to NS to decide on the necessary safety measures, such as the deployment of boas, in consultation with the works council.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van haar reizigers en personeel. Het is aan NS om over de benodigde veiligheidsmaatregelen, zoals de inzet van boa's, te besluiten in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over “het gebrek aan handhaving op bedrijven buiten de EU die ook in Nederland diensten met cryptomunten aanbieden”

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister why DNB does not enforce against foreign crypto service providers serving the Dutch market without registration, despite many signals and complaints from Dutch firms. The minister answers that DNB has received signals on 36 possible unregistered providers, started cases against 18, and taken formal enforcement in only two, and defends the process as time-consuming while declining to name the parties under enforcement.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, DNB cannot share details about which parties are currently subject to enforcement or which enforcement measures are being applied.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van het toezicht kan DNB geen details delen tegen welke partijen op dit moment handhaving loopt of welke handhavingsmaatregelen daarbij precies ingezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het BTW-tarief op openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure whether VAT on public transport should be abolished to attract passengers, compensate consumers and fight transport poverty, and what this would cost. The government declined to commit to abolition for now, pointing to pending analyses (KIM study, evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, the EU proposal), gave cost estimates of 300-400 million euros for full abolition and 100-133 million for a return to 6%, and noted that a 6% rate is technically impossible before 2026.
The cabinet wants to help people who find it difficult to absorb short-term cost increases with its package of purchasing power measures.
Het kabinet wil met het pakket aan koopkrachtmaatregelen mensen tegemoetkomen die kostenstijgingen op korte termijn moeilijk kunnen opvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Volgend jaar mogelijk 30 procent minder metro’s, bussen en trams'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether a possible 20-30% cut in public transport service for 2023 is acceptable and what the government will do about it, including whether the availability compensation (BVOV) will continue into 2023. The State Secretary answered that the BVOV is extended to end-2022, that the KiM forecasts 97% ridership recovery for 2023 with an update due in June, and that regional timetables are the responsibility of provinces and transport regions, while the government will keep monitoring and consulting the sector.
Responsibility for drawing up regional timetables lies with the provinces and transport regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het opstellen van regionale dienstregelingen ligt bij de provincies en vervoerregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Kent en Alkaya over de compensatie voor de gestegen energie- en brandstofprijzen

SP MPs asked why the 120% of social minimum income test for the one-off energy allowance counts the single-parent supplement of the child-related budget as income while excluding the child budget itself, and questioned how income is defined and applied across municipalities. The minister explained that the child budget including the single-parent supplement is excluded from income under the Participatiewet, acknowledged that the concept of income is hard for citizens to grasp, and said municipalities have discretion in specialist assistance while the wage increase was not feasible in time.
For social assistance benefits, a supplement under the child-related budget is a benefit within the meaning of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes.
Voor bijstandsuitkeringen geldt dat een toeslag in het kader van het kindgebonden budget een tegemoetkoming is in de zin van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de bonus van 3,3 miljoen euro voor Air France-KLM topman Ben Smith

An SP MP asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the EUR 3.3 million bonus paid to Air France-KLM CEO Ben Smith despite state support, and what the government had done to prevent it. The ministers said the bonus is unacceptable, that they lobbied the company and the European Commission, but that the final decision lies with shareholders where the Netherlands holds 9.3% and is unlikely to block it.
Ultimately, the final decision on awarding the bonus rests with the general meeting of shareholders.
Uiteindelijk ligt het definitieve besluit over het toekennen van de bonus bij de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de aanwezigheid van Gazprom in Nederland

MPs from the SP asked the government about Gazprom's presence in the Netherlands, including its asset holdings via shell companies, Dutch investment ties with Russia, tax avoidance, tax rulings for state-owned firms, and frozen Russian assets. The State Secretary answered that sanctions freezes apply, the cabinet opposes facilitating Russian-linked shells and is banning certain trust services, tax secrecy limits detailed answers on individual taxpayers, and a rulings termination clause exists for sanctioned entities.
Under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de kamerbrief Stand van Zaken Ring Utrecht

An SP MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management what became of the coalition agreement's intention to explore an alternative for the A27/Amelisweerd Ring Utrecht project, and why the Tracébesluit procedure continues before the regional alternative exists. The minister answers that talks with the region are ongoing, no concrete alternative exists yet, no deadline has been set, and the Raad van State appeal proceeds, so the procedure cannot be paused.
When the region has this ready, we would gladly enter into consultation with them.
Als de regio dit gereed heeft, treden wij graag met hen in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Tuchtraad Banken het onderzoek naar de voormalig topman van ING noodgedwongen heeft moeten stopzetten

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the Finance Minister whether the Banking Disciplinary Board's halted investigation into former ING chief Ralph Hamers, caused by bank non-cooperation, shows the banking disciplinary system is failing and should be anchored in law with enforcement powers. The minister said the system works through sector self-regulation under DNB supervision, that banks are obliged to cooperate, and that she will stress active cooperation with the sector without proposing legislative changes.
It is primarily up to the supervisor to judge compliance with the norms of the Wft
Het is primair aan de toezichthouder om een oordeel te vellen over de naleving van de normen uit de Wft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over dubbele belasting op energie en brandstof

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance why VAT is charged on excise and energy tax, arguing this double taxation is unfair, and asked for an analysis of abolishing it. The government replied that VAT on these taxes follows from the EU VAT Directive, that abolishing it is not possible, and that it is only temporarily lowering fuel excise and energy VAT rates to cushion price rises.
The cabinet does not intend to consider such a policy change and will therefore not investigate it.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens een dergelijke beleidswijziging te overwegen, en zal dit daarom ook niet onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de gewijzigde definitief van royalty’s, waardoor het voor multinationals makkelijk is om onder de Wet bronbelasting uit te komen

MPs Alkaya asked whether AmCham lobbied to change the definition of royalties in the Dutch withholding tax act and why the definition was chosen, including its relation to the OECD model treaty and transfer pricing guidelines. The State Secretary replied that a consultation with AmCham touched on the royalty definition but did not shape the law, that the definition follows OECD Model Treaty Article 12 to target passive income flows, and that the Tax Authority assesses mixed contracts case by case.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de afwijzing van inzageverzoek in FSV

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rejection of a data access request concerning registration in the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including why citizens are denied the specific grounds for refusal. The government answered that exceptions such as investigation interests and tips apply, that numbers of requests and timeliness are reported, that the grounds for refusal are assessed case by case without disclosing details, and that a compensation scheme is being developed for early 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Alkaya over het nieuws dat medewerkers van Schiphol ernstige gezondheidsrisico’s lopen als gevolg van blootstelling aan ultrafijnstof

MPs asked the minister about reports that Schiphol workers face serious health risks from ultrafine particles, including inspection history, research, employer responsibility, and compensation. The minister answered that the Labour Inspectorate has two investigations ongoing, that employers bear primary responsibility, and that a sector taskforce and independent committee are being set up while several requests are deferred.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Alkaya over de uitvoering van motie Alkaya/Van der Plas over het zo spoedig mogelijk beëindigen van tolheffing voor de Westerscheldetunnel

MPs Van der Plas and Alkaya asked the minister how the motion to make the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free as soon as possible is being implemented, and why the toll-free date, road-traffic effects, and funding are unclear. The minister answered that toll removal requires funding first, which has not been found, that the timeline depends on the coalition plan for a pay-per-use system around 2030, and that the Draaiboek and internal advice are being shared.
I agree with that, provided the condition of funding the costs of abolishing the toll can be met.
Daar ben ik het mee eens, mits aan de voorwaarde voor dekking van de kosten van afschaffing van de tol kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Grinwis en Van der Plas over de mogelijkheid dat de nachttrein Brussel/Amsterdam-Berlijn/Dresden/Praag ook in Hengelo stopt

MPs asked why the new European Sleeper night train from Brussels/Amsterdam to Berlin/Dresden/Prague does not stop in Hengelo despite earlier investment in the Hengelo-Bad Bentheim link and overnight travel gaps. The State Secretary explained that the stop is commercially and timetable-constrained for European Sleeper, that a stop in 2022 is unlikely, and that the government will explore whether a 2023 stop is feasible and talk with the operator.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Alkaya en Dassen over het bericht ‘Belasting besparen: zo doen Zuidas-partners dat’

MPs asked whether Zuidas partners' use of BV structures and DGA arrangements lets them pay less tax than employees, whether the Tax Authority's agreements on reasonable salaries are acceptable, and whether a 20-partner BV constructions should be banned. The State Secretary acknowledges a possible gap, describes the excessive-lending bill and the reasonable-salary rules, says new policy options are unnecessary, and states that ministers' business interests were disclosed under a motion.
The Tax Authority does not address individual cases because of its statutory duty of confidentiality.
De Belastingdienst gaat in verband met zijn wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar veiligheid grondafhandeling Schiphol tegengewerkt’

MPs De Hoop and Alkaya asked why a survey of ground-handling workers was replaced by a data analysis in the NLR study on safety at Schiphol, and whether the data and safety-culture findings are reliable. The minister defends the study's conclusions, says the survey was dropped by the researchers themselves, and rejects a new survey while pointing to a sector CAO and other measures without committing to social establishment requirements.
It is up to the contractor to determine how the research is set up.
Het is aan de opdrachtnemer om te bepalen hoe het onderzoek wordt opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het nieuwsbericht ‘Kabinet polst Kamer over afschaffen dividendbelasting na besluit Shell’

Two SP MPs asked whether the cabinet sought parliamentary support for abolishing the dividend tax after Shell's announced departure, and about the costs, jobs and the verhuurderheffing. The government replied that it informed some parliamentary groups informally, that abolition costs about EUR 2 billion a year and is not currently on the agenda, that it cannot disclose Shell's tax position under tax secrecy, and that it cannot judge the verhuurderheffing as a caretaker cabinet.
No insight can be given into the tax position of a specific company because of the statutory tax secrecy obligation.
Er kan geen inzicht worden gegeven in de belastingpositie van een specifiek bedrijf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het stopzetten van ondernemerskrediet door ABN AMRO

MP Alkaya asks the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO can unilaterally end its business credit product during the coronavirus crisis, whether shareholders including the state were involved in the strategy, and whether customers are guaranteed tailored options. The minister answers that the bank decides its own product range, he has no role in the commercial strategy due to ACM measures, and he has asked the bank for good communication, while disputes are for Kifid or the courts.
I cannot get involved in assessing agreements between an individual financial institution and its customers.
Ik kan niet treden in de beoordeling van overeenkomsten tussen een individuele financiële instelling en haar klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over ‘het nieuws dat de beveiliging van Schiphol zo lek is als een mandje’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister whether fake QR-code boarding passes allowing unauthorised access past Schiphol gates, and related security weaknesses, were known and whether they threaten passengers and staff. The minister answered that automated checks cannot fully exclude non-passengers, but that this is not a security gap since the separate weapons and explosives screening still applies, and that the airport is responsible for the access controls under KMar oversight.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about the form and frequency of testing of the access control systems.
Vanwege veiligheidsreden kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de vorm en frequentie van de testen van de toegangscontrolesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat spitstreinen niet rijden vanwege het tekort aan verkeersleiders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why peak-hour trains were cancelled on 2 November 2021 due to a shortage of train traffic controllers, why no replacement buses were arranged, whether crowding on diversion routes was safe, and what is being done to retain staff and prevent overcrowding during tighter COVID measures. The State Secretary answered that NS could not organise adequate replacement buses at short notice, described ProRail's notification schedule and staff recruitment, retention and pay measures, and said shareholder discussions on personnel policy took place without committing to new binding steps.
I will inform your House about the outcomes of the shareholder meeting in a separate letter.
Over de uitkomsten van de aandeelhoudersvergadering informeer ik uw Kamer via een separate brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het overschrijven van een voertuig op een andere naam na overlijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether a vehicle can be re-registered after the owner's death using only the registration card and code, without checks on how these were obtained, and whether a blockade requiring a certificate of inheritance should be introduced. Minister Visser answered that the RDW does not check how the card and code were obtained, that a certificate of inheritance is required only when the code cannot be shown, and that a blockade would not fully solve the problem and would impose costs and delays on heirs.
I am not in favour of introducing a block on re-registration after death.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van om een blokkade voor overschrijving op te werpen na overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de uitvoering van het onderzoek naar de mogelijke risico’s van biobrandstoffen voor scheepsmotoren in de binnenvaart

MPs Alkaya asked about criticism from the shipping association ASV of the NEN study on biofuel risks for inland shipping engines, and about the study's scope, schipper involvement, and reliance on desk research. The Staatssecretaris answered that the study covers practical experience via the Meldpunt Binnenvaart and a survey, that schippers were involved via their representative bodies, that time pressure limited data collection, and that the government will keep discussing findings with the sector.
NEN will state in its report which research questions remain open in order to reach safe application of biofuel in ship engines.
NEN zal aangeven in haar rapport welke onderzoeksvragen nog openstaan om tot veilige toepassing van biobrandstof in scheepsmotoren te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het toezicht op de cryptosector

MP Alkaya asked the Minister of Finance about a dispute between the ministry and DNB over supervising the crypto sector, the high costs charged to small crypto firms, the status of a motion on monitoring administrative burden, and how Dutch fees compare with France and the level playing field. The Minister denied a dispute, acknowledged that fees can cause unwanted effects and proposed a reserve for one-off costs, promised to inform the House on the motion by end of the year, and argued Dutch supervision costs are not decisive for FinTech location.
I will therefore, in line with the motion, inform the House no later than July 2022.
Ik zal de Kamer dan ook, conform de motie, uiterlijk in juli 2022 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat NS-medewerkers staken om de sluiting van servicestations te voorkomen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about NS plans to close 15 of 36 staffed ticket service counters and shorten service hours, and the resulting strike, including effects on safety, assistance for people with reduced mobility, calamity support, and jobs. The State Secretary answers that the decision is NS's operational responsibility, that safety is monitored via the concession with NS, that assistance disruptions are being covered by extra staff, and that he will not intervene as concession grantor.
The plan to adjust service at stations is an operational responsibility of NS.
Het voornemen voor het aanpassen van de dienstverlening op stations betreft een operationele verantwoordelijkheid van NS.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat TUI lege vliegtuigen laat overkomen tussen Schiphol en Eindhoven Airport

An SP MP asked the minister about TUI flying empty aircraft between Schiphol and Eindhoven Airport, questioning the noise and emissions impact and asking about structural nature, frequency, and whether operators would be pressed to stop it. The minister answered that such flights are undesirable, are not structural (aircraft expected back at Eindhoven for 2022), gave annual counts, and said the ministry will raise the issue with airlines and promote rail alternatives.
Carrying out flights with empty aircraft is undesirable from the standpoint of energy use (emissions) and nuisance (noise).
Het uitvoeren van vluchten met lege toestellen is vanuit het oogpunt van energiegebruik (emissies) en hinder (geluid) ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Alkaya over de gebrekkige compensatieregeling voor woekerrentes van ABN AMRO

Parliamentarian Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister of Finance why ABN AMRO's compensation scheme for usurious interest on consumer credit is inadequate, whether the state as major shareholder can intervene, and whether the final release clause should be dropped. The Minister answered that compensation is a matter for the bank and Kifid or the courts, that the state as certificate holder has no insight into individual client files, and that he welcomes the scheme agreed with the Consumentenbond Claimservice while leaving the choice to clients.
It is not for me to assess a compensation scheme.
Het is niet aan mij om een compensatieregeling te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over burgers die worden vermorzeld in de raderen van de fiscus

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about citizens crushed by the tax authority, including reports of people losing homes, the unobserved beslagvrije voet, fines making up most of debts, and legal protection gaps. The State Secretary apologised where errors were made, pointed to outreach channels and a review of cases, and said he would inform parliament further on several points.
I want to emphasise that in all cases where the Tax Authority has made mistakes, I would in any case like to apologise for the problems these people have ended up in partly due to the Tax Authority.

Ik wil benadrukken dat in alle gevallen waarin de Belastingdienst fouten heeft gemaakt ik in ieder geval excuses wil maken voor de problemen waarin deze mensen mede door toedoen van de Belastingdienst terecht zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onterechte brieven van het CAK aan gedupeerde ouders in het toeslagenschandaal

MP Alkaya asked whether parents affected by the childcare benefits scandal wrongly received CAK letters demanding premium payments, how many were affected, and how the error would be corrected. The State Secretary confirmed that four parents were wrongly sent letters, fourteen others were identified as victims, and the government will contact them and reverse any payments, while keeping the policy of resuming premium collection for parents not entitled to restoration.
Contact will be made with these parents and the erroneous action will be corrected.
Er zal contact opgenomen worden met deze ouders en de foutieve actie zal worden hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over toeslaggedupeerden met een zakelijke schuld

The SP MP Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about childcare-benefit victims who took business loans under the Bbz scheme to repay tax debts, and whether such business debts can be written off since municipalities lack the legal basis. The State Secretary said business debts will be addressed only up to the EU state-aid limit of 200,000 euro over three years, with write-offs for personally liable business forms and hardship clauses for municipalities, and that implementation is planned later this year.
I intend to offer a solution for business debts that can be recovered from the private assets of the affected parent or their partner
Ik ben voornemens een oplossing te bieden voor zakelijke schulden die op het privévermogen van de gedupeerde ouder dan wel zijn/haar toeslagpartner kunnen worden verhaald
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de positie van Nederland als financiële draaischijf in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch tax rules let major arms manufacturers route large sums through the Netherlands to avoid tax, and whether substance requirements and arms-export presumptions of denial should be tightened. The State Secretary of Finance acknowledged that the Dutch tax system has been used for avoidance structures, pointed to existing and planned anti-avoidance measures and a committee on conduit companies, but declined to comment on individual taxpayers and did not commit to tightening substance requirements.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot address the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de stijgende inflatie en de Europese Centrale Bank

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about rising eurozone inflation, the ECB's bond-buying and low-rate policy, and whether these push up Dutch house prices. The minister answered that the ECB decides its monetary policy independently, that energy prices drive much of the rise and may fade, and that low rates reflect structural factors alongside ECB policy.
It is for the ECB to determine independently which monetary policy measures are needed to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is verder aan de ECB om in onafhankelijkheid te bepalen welke monetaire beleidsmaatregelen nodig zijn om haar mandaat van prijsstabiliteit te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over de verkeersondersteuning bij wielerwegwedstrijden

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether police shortages threaten cycling road races, whether volunteer or certified motorcycle traffic marshals could replace police escorts, whether a legal status for the race caravan is being considered, and about the timeline for measures. The ministers answer that police are willing to help find solutions, that a package of no-regret measures is being implemented with evaluation by the end of 2022, and that a study into the tolerated practice of traffic rule violations will be started.
The preparations for the study into the tolerated situation regarding traffic rule violations during cycling races will be started as soon as possible.
De voorbereidingen voor het onderzoek naar de gedoogsituatie omtrent verkeersregels tijdens wielerwedstrijden zetten we zo spoedig mogelijk in gang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat het openbaar vervoer in Utrecht volgend jaar op peil blijft

Questions from SP MP Alkaya ask whether public transport in Utrecht will be maintained next year, and whether transition plans and possible schedule cuts reflect the COVID crisis. The state secretary answers that the availability payment continues, that 2022 plans will keep a service level comparable to 2021, that the plans are being updated, and that the Chamber will be informed in autumn.
The transition plans will be updated this summer, and the Chamber will be informed about this in the autumn.
Actualisatie van de transitieplannen vindt deze zomer plaats en de Kamer zal hier dit najaar over geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het essay van Pieter Hasekamp (CPB) in het FD over het in de ban doen van bitcoin

MP Alkaya asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a CPB director's essay calling for a ban on bitcoin, including whether it is appropriate, whether a national ban is feasible, and whether bitcoin is poor money. Minister Hoekstra answered that the CPB is independent and may publish opinions, that a national ban would be ineffective and only EU-level action could work, and that crypto's volatility, energy use, and money-laundering risks justify MiCA regulation rather than a ban.
The CPB is independent as a planning bureau in terms of content.
Het CPB is als planbureau inhoudelijk onafhankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het Meldpunt huurtoeslag van de Woonbond

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked about the Woonbond's housing benefit complaints line and the tax authority's handling of housing, care and child benefit cases, including wrongful intent/gross negligence labels. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, estimated about 500 affected citizens in comparable cases, and said a compensation scheme is being prepared, with acute cases able to apply for emergency support now.
These reports confirm the need for a restoration scheme.
Deze meldingen bevestigen de noodzaak van een herstelregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over belastingontwijking door Uber

The MP Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Uber through Dutch BVs, the use of the Netherlands as a conduit for profits, the arm's length principle in internal loans, APA/ruling practice, facilitators, and the non-filing of annual accounts. The government declined to discuss Uber's individual tax position under article 67 AWR, but described its anti-avoidance measures (conditional withholding tax, dividend measures from 2024, rulings policy, DAC6, the commission on conduit companies) and committed to a monitoring letter and a study of conduit companies.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Alkaya over ‘het oliebedrijf Pluspetrol dat belasting ontwijkt in Nederland en het milieu vervuilt en mensenrechten schendt in Peru’

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the minister about Pluspetrol, which allegedly avoids tax in the Netherlands, pollutes and violates human rights in Peru, and refused OECD National Contact Point mediation. The minister answered that tax matters of individual firms cannot be discussed, that the NCP has declared the complaint admissible while Pluspetrol declined mediation, and that the government is pursuing stronger IMVO due diligence legislation.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, the cabinet cannot comment on the tax position of an individual company.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de motie Alkaya, Kamerstuk 31066-827

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked how many dossiers and staff are involved in the pilots (Leeuwarden, Almere, Zaanstad) for handling childcare benefit reclamation cases in one day, given the minister's view that a nationwide rollout before September 2021 is unfeasible. The Staatssecretaris provided a table of pilot dossiers and staff numbers, stressing the pilots are small-scale and that rollout would require substantial logistical capacity.
Below you will find the requested information about the pilots.
Onderstaand treft u de gevraagde informatie over de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht 'NS schrapt 341 banen; station zonder personeel wordt de norm'

SP MPs asked the government about news that NS would cut 341 station staff jobs, questioning whether this conflicts with its stated view that staff are essential and whether volunteers or temporary agency workers are displacing paid work. The minister and state secretary answered that NS decides its own staffing, cites falling counter sales and online ticketing, says safety is covered by camera monitoring and concession obligations, and commits only to help affected staff find other work within NS.
It is up to NS to determine where NS can deploy its personnel most effectively, taking into account the changing needs of travellers.
Het is aan NS om te bepalen waar NS haar personeel het meest effectief kan inzetten, waarbij NS rekening houdt met de veranderende behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Alkaya over het bericht dat ProRail Spoorwerkers jarenlang heeft blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkend kwartsstof

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Infrastructure how ProRail and the labour inspectorate allowed rail workers to be exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for years, and what will be done about enforcement, compensation and immediate remedies. The ministers answered that the inspectorate was aware of the risk since 2008, that ProRail and contractors acknowledged duty-of-care failures, that an inspectorate investigation into ProRail is ongoing, and that a compensation scheme for occupational disease victims is being prepared.
The Inspectorate SZW has started an investigation into ProRail's compliance in its role as employer and client and is in discussion with ProRail about improvements in its safety and health policy.

De Inspectie SZW is een onderzoek gestart naar de naleving door ProRail in haar rol als werkgever en als opdrachtgever en is met ProRail in gesprek over verbeteringen in het veiligheids- en gezondheidsbeleid van ProRail.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat banken negatieve rente voor kleinere spaarders niet uitsluiten

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether he would act, cooperate with the ECB, or legislate a ban so that banks cannot impose negative interest on small savers after reports that they no longer exclude this. The minister answered that negative rates are not currently charged to ordinary savers, that the ECB is independent, and that a legal ban is not necessary or proportionate now, though he would revisit legislation if options for savers became significantly limited.
Should those options be significantly restricted in the future, I will take up the matter again and, where appropriate, consider legislation.
Mochten die mogelijkheden in de toekomst significant worden beperkt dan zal ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen, en indien opportuun ook wetgeving overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de aanslagen in Mozambique en de rol van de Nederlandse overheid bij gaswinningsprojecten in deze regio

SP MPs asked why the Dutch government still provides export credit insurance for a Mozambique gas project amid jihadist violence and human rights concerns, and whether it will withdraw. The government answered that the insurance was granted under international standards, that the situation is being monitored, and that the abuses were committed by insurgents rather than the project, so it will continue to monitor and act within policy conditions.
The State and Atradius DSB are closely monitoring the situation and will act appropriately within the terms of the policies, depending on what the situation requires.
De Staat en Atradius DSB volgen de situatie nauwgezet en zullen op passende wijze handelen binnen de voorwaarden van de polissen en al naargelang waar de situatie om vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het feit dat meerdere gedupeerde ouders een brief van Incassobureau GGN hebben ontvangen

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked why many affected parents received letters from debt collector GGN saying they were not victims, despite not yet having an integral assessment or compensation, and on what legal basis the Tax Authority shares victim status with collectors. The State Secretary apologises, explains that a faulty list of parents was shared with enforcement bodies under the statutory moratorium (art. 49i Awir), that the moratorium ends from 1 May for parents with no indication of entitlement, and that parents can verify their status via a code and register.
I therefore find it terrible that this incorrect list was shared and that these letters were subsequently sent out.
Ik vind het dan ook verschrikkelijk dat deze foute lijst gedeeld is en dat vervolgens deze brieven zijn uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat de topman van Air France-KLM een bonus van twee miljoen euro ontvangt

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about a 2 million euro share bonus for the Air France-KLM CEO, whether it fits the state aid conditions, and about dismissals, pay cuts and flexible staffing at KLM. The minister says the bonus is unacceptable in a crisis, that the aid conditions suspend bonuses at KLM but not the parent company, and that the government has conveyed its position to the company, while leaving the details of KLM's employment terms to its management and unions.
The support package stipulates that during the period of support the variable remuneration (bonus) for the board and top management of KLM is suspended.
In het steunpakket is bepaald dat gedurende de steun de variabele beloning (bonus) voor het bestuur en top management van KLM wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over onterecht verstuurde berekeningen Toeslagen

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked why the Tax Administration wrongly sent about 224 households demands to repay large childcare-benefit (toeslagen) amounts, including for 2014, and why the Chamber was not informed. The State Secretary apologised, explained the IND data processing error, said the Chamber was not proactively informed but will be in future, and described fixes plus a law change requiring a hearing before large repayment decisions from 2021.
However, I understand your need for information in order to properly carry out your supervisory task.
Ik heb echter begrip voor uw informatiebehoefte om uw controlerende taak goed uit te kunnen oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the statutory debt moratorium for childcare benefit scandal victims, expiring on 1 May 2021, would expose affected parents to renewed collection and whether it should be extended urgently. The State Secretary answered that the moratorium is extended by one year for parents found eligible for at least 30,000 euro in compensation, while parents not found eligible lose it on 1 May, with a nazorgteam and possible specific solutions for those harmed later.
Once it is established that victims qualify for the Catshuis scheme and thus at least 30,000 euro, the moratorium (the pause button) will be extended by one year from the moment of payment.

Zodra bij gedupeerden is vastgesteld dat ze in aanmerking komen voor de Catshuisregeling en daarmee minimaal € 30.000, wordt het moratorium (de pauzeknop) vanaf het moment van uitbetaling met 1 jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over één mondiaal minimumtarief voor winstbelasting

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether the US push for a global minimum corporate tax, the Yellen proposal, is a good tool against a race to the bottom, and what the government will do to avoid Dutch tax-haven reputation. The state secretary answered that Nederland supports the OECD Inclusive Framework Pillar 2 minimum tax and an agreement by mid-2021, distinguished it from the EU CCCTB, and pointed to existing anti-avoidance measures and commitment to promote the plan internationally.
The Netherlands will continue to work to reach agreements in the OECD Inclusive Framework by mid-2021.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten om halverwege 2021 tot afspraken te komen in het Inclusive Framework van de OESO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland nog steeds een claimparadijs is voor buitenlandse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked why the Netherlands remains a 'claim paradise' for foreign companies under investment treaties, why renegotiation has stalled, how many ISDS claims have been filed from the Netherlands, and whether investors should first exhaust domestic courts. Minister Kaag answered that renegotiations with six countries are slow due to COVID restrictions, reported 114 ISDS claims per UNCTAD without further monitoring, rejected mandatory exhaustion of domestic remedies, and committed to resuming renegotiations as soon as partners allow.
The cabinet does not have more information or more means to collect and report on ISDS claims than UNCTAD.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over meer informatie c.q. meer mogelijkheden om informatie te verzamelen en te rapporteren over ISDS claims dan de UNCTAD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat verzekeraars mogelijk meer dan 1 miljoen euro schade door de avondklokrellen gaan vergoeden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about estimated insured damage from the curfew riots, whether insurers pay out fairly rather than referring claimants to the government damage fund, and whether oversight or recovery of fund costs from insurers is possible. Minister Grapperhaus replied that insured damage is estimated at 1 million euro, that claims are primarily a matter between insurer and insured with no government role or steekproef planned, and that the government will monitor the split between insurers and the fund and speak to the insurers' association if complaints arise.
I see no role for the government in this and see no reason to carry out a sample-based check.
Ik zie hierin geen rol voor de overheid en zie geen aanleiding om een steekproefsgewijze controle uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Gerven over het rapport ‘The Sobering Truth: Incentivizing Alcohol Death and Disability’

MPs Alkaya and Van Gerven asked whether Dutch subsidies to development projects involving alcohol producers such as Heineken, which allegedly worsen alcohol harm and conflict with SDG 3.5, should be stopped. The minister replied that the projects support farmers' food and income security, that EUR 300,000 was added in 2018 with no new subsidies since, that additionality was met, and that the government will not exclude such partnerships.
Question 7: Are you willing to stop providing support to projects in developing countries involving Dutch alcohol producers and instead invest in projects reducing alcohol problems?
Vraag 7 Bent u bereid voortaan geen steun meer te verlenen aan projecten in ontwikkelingslanden waar Nederlandse alcoholproducenten bij betrokken zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het SchuldenLabNL

MPs asked why the government appointed former finance minister Zalm, who is under OM investigation for money laundering, as chair of SchuldenLabNL, and whether private creditors would cooperate on debts of parents in the childcare benefits affair. The state secretary replied that SchuldenLabNL is an independent foundation the cabinet had no role in appointing its board, that the board is unpaid, and that talks with public and private creditors are ongoing to give affected parents a fresh start.
The cabinet has no involvement whatsoever in appointing Mr Zalm as chair or in appointing the other board members of SchuldenLabNL.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele bemoeienis met het benoemen van de heer Zalm als voorzitter alsmede met de benoeming van andere leden van het bestuur van SchuldenlabNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over maatschappelijk verantwoord investeren en wapenproductie

SP MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about insurers investing in arms producers, the implementation of the insurance sector IMVO covenant, and whether the government will act on the Eerlijke Verzekeringswijzer findings. The minister replied that insurers bear individual responsibility under OECD guidelines, pointed to a themakader and webinar, said a follow-up meeting with insurers is planned, and stated that broader mandatory due diligence legislation is the direction of policy.
The cabinet shares the conclusion that the outcome of the covenants alone is not sufficient.
Het kabinet deelt de conclusie dat het resultaat van de convenanten alleen niet voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Afrika getroffen dreigt te worden door een tweede coronagolf

MP Alkaya asked the minister about reports of a second COVID-19 wave in Africa, whether extra funding would be provided for developing countries, how many vaccines Africa would receive via COVAX AMC, how the Netherlands would contribute to the additional USD 5 billion needed, and whether it would support suspending COVID vaccine patents. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing and additional funding (EUR 25 million for COVAX AMC plus earlier contributions), gave COVAX supply projections, and opposed patent suspension while supporting pragmatic EU and WTO discussion.
Apart from these contributions, and beyond the regular BHOS efforts already set out in the 2021 budget, no additional funds are currently foreseen.
Naast deze bijdragen zijn – naast de reguliere inspanningen van BHOS zoals ook vastgesteld met de begroting 2021 – momenteel geen aanvullende middelen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat slachtoffers van woekerrente in het MKB niet geholpen worden door het Kifid

Opposition MP Alkaya asked the Finance Minister why Kifid does not hear SME complaints about allegedly excessive interest (woekerrente) from before 1 July 2018, and what the government will do to recover such payments and prevent future abuses. The minister replied that Kifid's SME jurisdiction is limited by the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering to credit agreed or raised after 1 July 2018, that courts remain open, and that he cannot estimate bank costs or judge overcharging, leaving that to Kifid or the courts.
The assessment of whether a bank has charged an SME client excessive costs is, where that route is open, for Kifid or the courts.
De beoordeling of een bank te hoge kosten in rekening heeft gebracht aan een mkb-klant is indien deze weg open staat, aan het Kifid of aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over de uitzending van Zembla over de betrokkenheid van Shell-medewerkers bij het creëren van olielekkages in de Nigerdelta

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast alleging Shell staff paid youths to cause oil spills in the Niger Delta, whether the Dutch government knew, and related issues. The government answered that the allegations are a matter for Nigerian prosecutors, that the former ambassador was informed in 2018 but the matter was not passed on, and that no external inquiry is needed, while citing Shell's $900 million clean-up commitment.
An external inquiry into the relationship between the Dutch embassy and Shell would, in our view, produce no new relevant information and is therefore not desirable.
