Een extern onderzoek naar de relatie tussen de Nederlandse ambassade en Shell zal naar onze mening geen nieuwe relevante informatie opleveren en is om die reden niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat Oeganda 21 miljoen misloopt door Nederland

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the Netherlands-Uganda tax treaty lets companies such as Airtel and CNOOC avoid Ugandan tax, how much Uganda loses, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that individual taxpayers cannot be discussed, that the treaty lacks anti-abuse rules that the government wants to add quickly, and that renegotiation has been pursued since 2013 with Uganda slow to respond.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over schadevergoedingen door banken bij spoofing

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked ministers about bank compensation for spoofing victims, whether banks should be obliged to compensate as with phishing, and how police can trace stolen funds. The minister replied that banks are legally bound to compensate only bancaire fraude, that spoofing falls outside this, and that he is negotiating with banks and exploring legal changes with reports due in early 2021.
I will inform the House in the first quarter of 2021 on progress on both points.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 over de voortgang op beide punten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Canada de Europese voedselveiligheid verwatert

An SP MP asked the government to respond to a media report that Canada was weakening EU food safety standards through CETA, including claims about pesticide import tolerances and EU concessions. The minister rejected the claims, saying the import tolerance rules have been unchanged since 2005, CETA does not affect EU food safety standards, and any future EU proposals would be shared with parliament.
If EU proposals are submitted that concern food safety standards, your House will be informed of this in the usual ways, for example through BNC fiches.

Als er EU-wijzigingsvoorstellen worden ingediend die betrekking hebben op voedselveiligheidsstandaarden, dan wordt uw Kamer daar op de gebruikelijke manieren, bijvoorbeeld door middel van BNC-fiches, over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de brandbrief van cryptocurrencybedrijven in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about crypto firms' complaint that DNB registration demands are excessive, delayed approvals and the 21 November deadline. The minister answered that DNB is an independent supervisor applying the Sanctions Act uniformly, that firms can appeal, that DNB will try to finish near-complete applications quickly, and that an evaluation of the law will be considered in early 2021.
DNB, as supervisor, is independent and has a statutory mandate to give content, within the limits of the law, to the open norms in this legislation.
DNB is als toezichthouder onafhankelijk en heeft een wettelijk mandaat om, binnen de grenzen van de wet, invulling te geven aan (open) normen in deze wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over gedupeerde consumenten door wurgkredieten

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about consumers harmed by revolving credits with allegedly excessive interest, the slow compensation, Kifid's appeal rules and whether banks should be pressed to drop appeals and cover legal costs. The minister answered that compensation should be arranged accessibly, that appeals are part of a fair process, that he will not intervene in operational decisions, and that the AFM has taken steps on locked-up credits.
I therefore do not interfere in the choice of a party to a proceeding whether or not to appeal.
Ik meng mij daarom niet in de keuze van een procespartij om al dan niet in beroep te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat 80% van de witwasmeldingen bij Nederlandse toezichthouder Financial Intelligence Unit in een la verdwijnen

MPs Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a report that 80% of money-laundering reports at the FIU-Nederland are left unactioned, asking about backlogs, reliance on automated matching, digitalisation, and staffing relative to neighbouring countries. The Minister (Justice and Security) answers that FIU-Nederland screens all reports automatically against police and CJIB data, prioritises risk-based analysis, reports are held for five years, and staffing is being expanded by about 19 fte alongside technology investment.
FIU-Nederland has indicated, when asked, that it does not recognise the journalists' conclusion that 80% of unusual transaction reports from banks are not acted upon by FIU-Nederland.

FIU-Nederland heeft desgevraagd aangegeven zich niet te her- en erkennen in de conclusie van de journalisten dat op 80% van de meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties afkomstig van banken niet zou worden geacteerd door de FIU-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris Van Ark een compensatie voor de gedupeerden in de CAF-11 zaak blokkeerde in de Ministerraad

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked the state secretary to explain why a compensation plan for CAF-11 childcare-benefit victims was reportedly blocked in cabinet and why earlier documents showed the disproportionate recovery issue was known. The state secretary denies blocking any proposal, says the ministries cooperated, admits the strict enforcement and missed signals were regrettable, and says the parliamentary inquiry has been given the relevant documents.
From the moment the scale of the affair became clear to State Secretary Snel, the cabinet endorsed its commitment to do right by the affected parents.
Vanaf het moment dat de omvang van de affaire bij Staatssecretaris Snel duidelijk begon te worden, heeft het kabinet zijn inzet om de gedupeerde ouders recht te doen onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Laçin over de staatssteun aan KLM

MPs Alkaya and Laçin asked the Finance Minister whether the state will expand its influence in Air France-KLM as motioned, whether a capital injection is planned, and whether KLM may make lower-paid staff pay for the restructuring. The minister answered that state guarantees and a state agent give the state more influence, that a capital injection is not ruled out but cannot be discussed further for listed-company reasons, and that employment terms are part of the support conditions under assessment.
Because Air France-KLM is a listed company, I cannot share anything further on this at this moment.
Omdat Air France – KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming betreft, kan ik hier op dit moment verder niets over delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het bericht dat banken mogen discrimineren op leeftijd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked the Finance Minister whether banks may discriminate by age after a Kifid ruling upheld a bank's refusal of an overdraft facility to a customer aged 61-67 due to income uncertainty linked to retirement. The minister said discrimination is prohibited and the government opposes it, but declined to comment on individual Kifid rulings, excluded this case from the Kifid evaluation, and only appealed to banks to take a human-centred approach.
As Minister of Finance, I do not comment on rulings in individual cases of independent dispute resolution bodies, including this Kifid ruling.
Als Minister van Financiën spreek ik mij niet uit over uitspraken in individuele gevallen van onafhankelijke geschillenbeslechtingsinstanties, waaronder deze uitspraak van het Kifid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het bericht  dat honderden Nederlandse economen meer investeringen aanraden in sociale gelijkheid en verduurzaming

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked whether the government shares economists' call for more investment in social equality and sustainability, whether debt can safely rise, whether Groeifonds should prioritise jobs, and whether austerity is off the table. The ministers answered that existing support, investment acceleration and the Nationaal Groeifonds already address these goals, that debt must stay manageable, and that no choice is made between corporate tax and social security, while offering no new proposal.
The cabinet will submit a recovery plan for the RRF to the Commission in spring 2021.
Het kabinet zal in het voorjaar van 2021 een herstelplan voor de RRF bij de Commissie indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het nieuws dat gedupeerde ouders van de CAF 11-zaak al veel eerder compensatie hadden kunnen krijgen

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he blocked a compensation proposal for childcare benefit victims in June 2019, why earlier answers were evasive, and what he concretely did to resolve the affair. Rutte denied that any compensation proposal was blocked in the 7 June 2019 cabinet meeting, stated he was unaware of the Tax Authority's earlier warnings, and largely restated that the cabinet supported restitution, offering answers without new substance.
The questions wrongly assume that a compensation proposal by State Secretary Snel was blocked at the cabinet meeting of 7 June 2019.
In de vraagstelling wordt er ten onrechte van uitgegaan dat in de ministerraad van 7 juni 2019 een compensatievoorstel van Staatssecretaris Snel is tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kwint en Alkaya over het nieuws dat gedupeerde ouders van de CAF 11-zaak al veel eerder compensatie hadden kunnen krijgen

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked PM Rutte what role he played in blocking a June 2019 compensation proposal for CAF 11 childcare benefit parents, and whether he will apologise and why the former State Secretary who tried to compensate was lost while the one blocking it was promoted. Rutte answered briefly that the cabinet consistently supported making the affected parents whole from the moment the scale became clear, and that he has apologised for what happened.
From the moment the scale of the affair became clear to State Secretary Snel, the cabinet endorsed its commitment to do justice to the affected parents.
Vanaf het moment dat de omvang van de affaire bij Staatssecretaris Snel duidelijk begon te worden, heeft het kabinet zijn inzet om de gedupeerde ouders recht te doen onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris Van Ark een compensatie voor de gedupeerden in de CAF-11 zaak blokkeerde in de Ministerraad

Two SP MPs asked why former state secretary Van Ark allegedly blocked compensation for parents harmed in the CAF-11 childcare benefit case, and requested related memos and documents. The government's answers deny the framing, state that the ministry supported compensation, promise a ministry search for signals on the childcare contribution issue around 1 September 2020, and note that compensation was coordinated with the Finance ministry without fully disclosing internal deliberations.
I aim to inform the House around 1 September 2020 about the results found.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer rond 1 september 2020 te informeren over de gevonden resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris van Financiën (de heer Snel) de ouders in juni 2019 al wilde compenseren

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked why a 2019 timeline sent to the ADR and parliament omitted former state secretary Snel's June 2019 attempt to offer compensation to childcare-benefit victims, and about the handling of the Donner advisory commission and the cabinet. The state secretary answered that the timeline served a narrow ADR research question, declined to discuss individual officials' views or internal legal advice citing intra-cabinet deliberation, confirmed contact with the commission (100+ emails, meetings), and disputed that parliament was being deliberately kept uninformed.
However, it is standing cabinet-wide policy not to make personal policy views contained in (legal) documents prepared for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is echter staand kabinetsbreed beleid om persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen opgenomen in (juridische) documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad geen onderwerp te maken van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Van den Hul en Voordewind over de rapportering van de bedrijven aangesloten bij het textiel convenant

MPs Alkaya, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the minister about a SOMO and Schone Kleren Campagne report finding weak public CSR reporting by textile covenant firms, including on access to remedy and living wage. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, outlined steps via the SER secretariat and steering group, and largely deferred to the covenant's own monitoring.
Companies themselves are responsible for the content and form of their reporting.
Bedrijven zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en vorm van hun rapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de Voortgangsrapportage kinderopvangtoeslag en de verdwenen dossiers

MPs Alkaya and Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Finance (Toeslagen en Douane) about the childcare benefits scandal: who sits on the Strategic Crisis Team, whether its minutes can be shared, how the UHT handles parents' cases, the O/GS compensation, the CAF-11 group, the destroyed case files and the queries that included nationality. The State Secretary answered that the crisis team keeps only action and decision lists, that case handling and compensation are being rolled out with safeguards, that an external review of UHT is under way, and that the selection-list and nationality-query matters were disclosed or stopped after discovery.
Of these meetings, currently two per week, action and decision lists are recorded, not minutes.
Van deze bijeenkomsten, momenteel twee per week, worden actie- en besluitenlijsten vastgelegd, geen verslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het evaluatierapport van de schoonmaak van Ogoniland

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on the stalled clean-up of Ogoniland in the Niger Delta, including drinking water, complex sites, Shell's role in HYPREP, and whether Shell should be excluded from trade missions. The minister acknowledged the slow progress, pointed to Nigerian and UNEP responsibility, and said exclusion from trade missions is aimed at improving conduct rather than excluding firms, with no sector-wide IMVO plan yet delivered.
The assessment framework for trade missions is aimed at improving the situation and not at excluding companies.
Het toetsingskader voor handelsmissies is gericht op het verbeteren van de situatie en niet op het uitsluiten van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Van den Hul en Alkaya over het opstappen van de CEO van ontwikkelingsbank FMO

MPs asked the government about the reported toxic work culture at development bank FMO, the use of confidentiality agreements, and the departure of its CEO, including the selection of a successor. The minister replied that the state, as majority shareholder, has no direct supervisory role over FMO's work culture, that the supervisory board oversees the management board, and that the government is monitoring the situation closely while promising to follow up on the evaluation and the appointment process.
The government has no supervisory relationship with FMO and therefore also does not (directly) supervise a healthy work environment within FMO.
De regering heeft geen toezichtsrelatie met FMO en houdt dus ook geen (direct) toezicht op een gezonde werkomgeving binnen FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Nederlandse ambassadeur in Nigeria informatie lekte naar Shell

MPs asked whether the former Dutch ambassador to Nigeria leaked confidential information about a corruption investigation into Shell, and about the integrity investigation, handling and reasons for replacing him. The ministers refused to disclose the integrity findings and related documents citing privacy and integrity-reporting concerns, rejected the claim that he favoured Shell, and gave a limited account of the Niger Delta cleanup.
The answers to questions 1 through 7 and question 9 will be sent to your House on a confidential basis.
De antwoorden op vraag 1 t/m 7 en vraag 9 zullen uw Kamer vertrouwelijk toegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over de berichtgeving dat KLM-piloten aan belastingontwijking doen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether they would stop KLM pilots living abroad (reportedly Spain) from avoiding Dutch income tax, given state aid to KLM, and asked for data on how many such pilots there are and the revenue lost. The minister said he would raise the matter with KLM, that the data is not systematically available, and that state support will come with conditions on pay and bonuses, with details still to follow.
Conditions will be set, among other things, on working conditions and bonuses.
Er zullen o.a. voorwaarden worden gesteld op het gebied van arbeidsvoorwaarden en bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over ‘400 miljoen voor IHC’ 2020

Two SP MPs asked why IHC, a shipbuilder with losses predating COVID-19, received state support worth about 400 million euros, questioning market logic, the absence of a state stake, management accountability, and the use of emergency procedure. The minister answered that losses began in 2016, that the state's support consists of insurance, guarantees and a bridge loan rather than a direct 400 million, and that a private consortium is taking over with governance seats for the state, while declining to disclose several financial details.
It is not for the State to disclose the amounts these parties contribute.
Het is niet aan de Staat om de bedragen die deze partijen inbrengen bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over mkb’s die sluiten vanwege hoge toezichtkosten

MP Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether high DNB supervision costs forcing crypto small businesses to close are acceptable, and whether this conflicts with parliament's motion on small firms and what will be done to relieve the burden. The Minister replied that AML supervision of crypto services is necessary, that costs are spread across registered firms and based on proportionality, and that from 2021 costs will be allocated by turnover, with an earlier evaluation not yet warranted.
However, it is important that supervision is also exercised over this sector.
Het is echter wel belangrijk dat ook op deze sector toezicht wordt gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over de toepassing van werktijdverkorting en de economische gevolgen van de coronacrisis

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked about the uptake and processing of werktijdverkorting applications, UWV capacity, payment delays, and compensation for self-employed workers during the coronavirus crisis. Minister Koolmees answered that the wtv scheme was withdrawn in favour of the NOW scheme run by UWV, that 130,000+ employers had applied, that WW payments remain on time, and that self-employed workers are covered via the Tozo.
Therefore it was decided to withdraw the wtv scheme and to work on introducing and opening the new temporary Emergency Measure for Bridging Employment Retention (NOW).
Daarom is besloten om de wtv-regeling in te trekken, en te werken aan de invoering en openstelling van de nieuwe tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging voor Werkbehoud (NOW).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over de onderhandelingen over visserijsubsidies

Two MPs asked the government whether it would pause WTO fisheries subsidies negotiations after 150 NGOs requested a halt due to inclusiveness and transparency concerns during COVID-19. Minister Kaag answered that talks are stalled, the government does not consider the process non-transparent, supports resuming talks by end-2020, and does not back halting all trade and investment negotiations.
The cabinet does not agree with this claim.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over verzekeringen in de culturele sector

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked the ministers of Finance and OCW about insurers refusing payouts to festivals, artists and travel customers during the COVID-19 crisis, and about support for small cultural entrepreneurs and suppliers. The government answered that pandemic losses are often excluded from cover depending on policy terms, that insurers say they will pay event-cancellation claims, and that a support package and talks with insurers are underway, while travel-insurance refusals depend on policy type.
I have no signals that insurers are on a large scale failing to pay out where this is warranted.
Ik heb geen signalen dat verzekeraars op grote schaal niet uitkeren waar dit wel op zijn plaats is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over mogelijke bezuinigingen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether spending cuts would follow the coronavirus crisis, how large they would be, and whether they would hit public services, social schemes or businesses. The minister answered that cuts are not on the table during the crisis, that nothing can be excluded given uncertainty, and that the government will keep assessing fiscal sustainability.
It is still too early to assess how large the effect on public finances will be, and what is needed to reach sound public finances in the longer term.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen hoe groot het effect op de overheidsfinanciën zal zijn, en wat nodig is om te komen tot gezonde overheidsfinanciën op langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Alkaya over de geheimhoudingsclausules in IMVO-convenanten

An MP asked the minister about confidentiality clauses in IMVO covenants after a broadcast on forced labour in Italian tomato farms, including supermarkets' refusal to engage and whether the confidentiality protocol blocks publication of misconduct investigation results. The minister replied that the protocol protects competition and privacy law, that the steering group has agreed to share some documents for publication, and that the covenant's confidentiality does not prevent individual companies from reporting on risks.

The parties therefore commit to treat as confidential all information and documents exchanged within the framework of the activities and not to disclose them to any third party other than the Secretariat.

Partijen verbinden zich er daarom toe alle informatie en documenten die zijn of worden uitgewisseld in het kader van de activiteiten, vertrouwelijk te behandelen en niet aan een derde, niet zijnde het Secretariaat, te openbaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat er een bankrun gaande is binnen de financiële sector

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the Finance Minister about a reported bank run, the ECB's bond-buying and its effects on inequality, state aid reaching banks rather than households and firms, a temporary cap on overdraft rates, the role of private banks and a public money or digital central bank currency, and inequality from the crisis response. The minister answered that the ECB sets its own monetary instruments, that aid reaches firms via guarantees and direct schemes, that overdraft rates were urged down by banks, and that the government aims for balanced income distribution.
It is up to the ECB to decide independently on the most effective and efficient approach to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is aan de ECB om onafhankelijk te beslissen over de meest doeltreffende en doelmatige benadering om haar mandaat op prijsstabiliteit te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Futselaar en Alkaya over ondersteuning voor zelfstandigen en de culturele sector

MPs Kwint, Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about support for self-employed workers and the cultural sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including eligibility criteria, compensation for cancelled events, and a guarantee fund. The government answered that existing general measures apply, cited extra funding of 300 million euro for culture, and explained why certain sectors were included or excluded from the TOGS scheme.
On Tuesday 7 April the extension to non-food retail and a second extension were communicated to the House.
Op dinsdag 7 april jl. is de uitbreiding met non-food retail en nog een tweede uitbreiding aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Alkaya over de impact van coronavirus (COVID-19) op de internationale ontwikkelingssamenwerking

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the impact of COVID-19 on development cooperation, covering water and hygiene in refugee camps, debt relief, IMF SDR allocations, World Bank financing conditionality and supply-chain workers. The minister answered at length, describing Dutch funding of EUR 100 million, support for debt moratoria and World Bank crisis lending, while declining to commit to specific positions on SDR allocation and deferring to other bodies on some points.
Do you agree that World Bank financial injections into developing countries should currently be free of political and economic conditions?
Vraag 13 en 14 Deelt u de mening dat financiële injecties van de Wereldbank in ontwikkelingslanden momenteel vrij moeten zijn van politieke en economische voorwaarden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over noodhulp aan Syriërs

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the source and channels of extra humanitarian aid for north-west Syria, EU and member state efforts, Dutch diplomacy, and obstacles to aid for internally displaced people. The minister answered that the funds come from the BHOS aid budget, are spent via the Dutch Relief Alliance and the Syria Cross-Border Humanitarian Fund, and outlined diplomatic efforts and remaining aid obstacles.
The Netherlands is in active contact with the European Commission and other member states on this.
Nederland onderhoudt actief contact met de Europese Commissie en andere lidstaten hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over de gevolgen van het coronavirus en de dalende olieprijzen op de economie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs how the coronavirus and falling oil prices will affect the economy, whether governments should act themselves, and about stimulus plans in Germany, France, Italy and Spain, mortgage relief, the investment fund and support for small businesses. The minister answered that the impact is not yet predictable, that the government is taking measures such as short-time work and liquidity support, and that further measures will follow if needed.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation so requires.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over het bericht dat Oeigoeren worden tewerkgesteld in Westerse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports that Uyghurs are employed under forced-labour conditions in Western company supply chains, and whether Dutch firms are involved. The government confirmed awareness, said it cannot independently verify the ASPI findings, pointed to business information sessions and EU/UN diplomacy, and said firms failing IMVO conditions can be excluded from trade missions.
The cabinet cannot confirm the conclusions of the ASPI report on the basis of its own independent information.
Het kabinet kan de conclusies van het ASPI-rapport niet op basis van eigenstandige informatie bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen, Beckerman en Alkaya over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis op huishoudens

Three SP MPs asked the government how it monitors the economic effects of the coronavirus on households, and whether utilities, landlords, mortgage lenders, the Waarborgfonds and the NHG should suspend evictions, disconnections and payments. The minister answered that utilities will not disconnect for arrears, evictions are postponed during the crisis by agreement with landlords, existing income and rent support measures are pointed to, and emergency support for homeless people is being arranged with municipalities.
Landlords have agreed as a common line that evictions will be postponed for the time being during the crisis period, unless there are evident reasons such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance.

Er is met de verhuurders als gezamenlijke lijn afgesproken dat huisuitzettingen voorlopig worden uitgesteld gedurende de crisisperiode, tenzij er evidente redenen zijn, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

SP MP Alkaya asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks are squeezing SMEs through interest margin increases, asking about justification, legitimacy, the scope of the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering and AFM oversight. Minister Hoekstra answered that banks must communicate margin changes under the code, that margins can reflect generic or client-specific risk, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021 with possible tightening if information is inadequate.
I will ask the NVB to pay attention to including interest margins in the evaluation of the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering in 2021 mentioned above.
Ik zal bij de NVB aandacht vragen voor het meenemen van renteopslagen in de hierboven genoemde evaluatie van de Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het Oxfam rapport The EU Trust Fund for Africa

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the minister about an Oxfam report arguing that EU Trust Fund for Africa aid is increasingly used to pressure countries into stopping migrants and that it violates aid principles and human rights. The minister rejects the claims of coercion and rights violations, says the EUTF is being evaluated and will inform the next budget, and acknowledges some useful recommendations.
In 2019 an external evaluation of the EUTF instrument was started. It is expected to be published mid-2020.
In 2019 is een externe evaluatie van het instrument EUTF gestart. Naar verwachting zal deze medio 2020 uitkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsgeld van de Wereldbank deels bij belastingparadijzen belandt

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether World Bank aid to 22 highly aid-dependent countries is leaking to tax havens, how widespread this is, which countries and elites are involved, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledges concern, notes the study is preliminary and not causal, describes Dutch and World Bank anti-corruption measures, and says the findings will be used to push for stronger action, without announcing a policy change.
It does not lend itself to drawing conclusions about individual countries, specific persons or bilateral aid flows.
Het leent zich niet om conclusies te trekken over individuele landen, specifieke personen of bilaterale hulpstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Computer zegt nee. Hoe Saskia twintig jaar vastliep in het systeem'

An SP MP asked ministers about a case in which a citizen was wrongly treated by government bodies over many years and whether she would be compensated and apologised to. The Minister of the Interior replied that a last attempt at a total solution failed, that the police acknowledged fault and apologised, and that he expressed regret in person; no concrete compensation offer was disclosed, citing privacy.
Partly because of the privacy of the person concerned, I am not free to disclose the amount of damages claimed by her and the proposal offered to her.
Het staat mij, mede gelet op de privacy van betrokkene, niet vrij om mededelingen te doen over de omvang van de door mevrouw gevorderde schade en het aan haar aangeboden voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat duizenden families in Angola verjaagd zijn voor project van Nederlandse bedrijven

An SP MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that thousands of families in Angola were forcibly evicted for a Dutch-backed land reclamation project, questioning the state export credit guarantee, due diligence by Atradius, Van Oord and ING, and the effectiveness of the IMVO covenants. The minister defends the due diligence as adequate, says responsibility for criminal conduct lies with the Public Prosecution Service, promises continued dialogue and compensation efforts with the companies, and declines to exclude them from trade missions.
An assessment in individual cases of whether there may be criminally culpable conduct is not my responsibility but that of the Public Prosecution Service.
Een beoordeling in individuele gevallen of er mogelijk sprake is van strafrechtelijk verwijtbaar handelen, is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid maar die van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over mogelijke sluipende bevoegdheidsoverdracht door CETA

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade whether CETA's committees, which can amend certain annexes and protocols, pose a constitutional legitimacy problem as argued by Prof. Weiss. The Minister rejected this, arguing that amendments follow democratic procedures, are limited to technical matters, require consensus, and that Parliament approves the agreement.
The Cabinet does not share this assessment. Amendments to CETA follow procedures that contain sufficient democratic safeguards.
Het Kabinet deelt dit oordeel niet. Wijzigingen van CETA verlopen volgens procedures die voldoende democratische waarborgen bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Computer zegt nee. Hoe Saskia twintig jaar vastliep in het systeem'

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked why a woman whose car was stolen in 1998 was pursued for 20 years by the CJIB and tax authorities over insurance and road tax fines, and how she would be helped. The minister answered that the RDW only deregistered the car in 2011, that registry rules were recently relaxed to allow backdating, that coordination has been taken on personally, and that a central reporting point for registry errors will be set up.
I have looked further into this situation, which is a very unpleasant one for the woman, which has now been going on for 20 years.
Ik heb me nader in deze situatie verdiept, waar sprake is van een zeer vervelende situatie voor mevrouw, die inmiddels al 20 jaar loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten slavenarbeid verrichten op Italiaanse tomatenplantages

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of exploitative, near-slavery labour conditions for migrant workers on Italian tomato farms and whether such products reach Dutch shelves. The ministers answered that exploitation is condemned, that enforcement in Italy is for Italian authorities, that companies bear due diligence responsibility, and that sector parties under the food convenant will investigate and report back.
The steering group agreed that the sector parties that signed the convenant will investigate further the possible involvement of their members
In de stuurgroep is afgesproken dat de branchepartijen die het convenant hebben getekend nader onderzoek doen naar mogelijke betrokkenheid van hun leden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over het bericht dat AstroTV in 2020 van tv verdwijnt

MPs Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister about misuse of non-compete clauses, including the AstroTV case where Talpa ended broadcasting in 2020 and the producer continued via phone and app. The government answered that media companies decide their own programming without prior oversight, that consumer-protection rules still apply via the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie, and that it sees no need to act on the broadcast.
The ACM makes no statements about any ongoing investigations.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken doet de ACM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het artikel gepubliceerd door de NOS op 21 november ‘‘ABN AMRO was blind voor smeergeld van Braziliaanse Odebrecht’’

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the Finance Minister about NOS reporting that ABN AMRO failed to screen about 5 million clients for bribery money from Odebrecht, and whether shareholder action, a public alternative to commercial banks, and enforcement can prevent repeat failures. Minister Hoekstra declined to comment on the ongoing OM criminal investigation, pointed to DNB's supervisory role and enforcement tools, said NLFI would monitor the bank's measures at arm's length, and referred to the government's broader financial sector agenda.
I have asked NLFI to closely monitor the measures the bank is taking and to inform me about them.
Ik heb NLFI gevraagd de maatregelen die de bank gaat nemen nauwgezet te volgen en mij daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat FMO landroof en andere misstanden financiert

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Finance how FMO, the Dutch development bank, could finance projects linked to killings, land grabs and other abuses, which projects were investigated, and whether the exit strategy and due diligence are adequate. The minister answered that these projects are known and in dialogue with FMO, that existing standards and recent policy tightening apply, that the list of watch-list projects is confidential, and that the next five-yearly evaluation (2013-2018) is due in Q2 2020.
FMO closely monitors which projects may be experiencing problems.
FMO houdt intensief in de gaten bij welke projecten zich mogelijk problemen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over toezicht op crowdfundingplatforms zoals Dream or Donate

An SP MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether oversight of crowdfunding platforms like Dream or Donate was adequate after the site went offline with donations apparently lost. The government answered that donation-based crowdfunding falls outside AFM supervision, that the sector should self-regulate with CBF-related talks underway, and that fraud is for police and prosecutors.
Crowdfunding through donation is therefore comparable to donating to more traditional charitable institutions, for example via a collection box.
Crowdfunding door middel van donatie is daarom vergelijkbaar met doneren aan meer traditionele charitatieve instellingen, bijvoorbeeld via een collectebus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Raak over het bericht dat het CETA verdrag lokaal beleid bedreigt

MPs Alkaya and Van Raak asked whether CETA's investor-state arbitration could expose municipalities and Dutch residents to damages claims over local policy, and whether the government would protect them. The minister answered that no CETA claims are foreseen, that the treaty affirms governments' right to regulate and that damages are capped at actual loss, and declined to guarantee full protection beyond stating the existing legal position.
Individual municipalities cannot be directly sued under the CETA treaty.
Individuele gemeenten kunnen niet rechtstreeks worden aangesproken onder het CETA verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya , van den Hul, Ouwehand en Diks over de bosbranden in het Amazonewoud en het Mercosur-verdrag

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdA-adjacent PvdD and GroenLinks asked whether the Netherlands would side with France and Ireland in opposing ratification of the EU-Mercosur agreement while Amazon fires continue, and whether it would support G7 aid for the Amazon. The minister replied that the government will take a position only once all texts and the Sustainability Impact Assessment are available, expected late 2019, with the Commission expecting a Council decision no earlier than November 2020, and that it will press Brazil bilaterally and within the EU on sustainable forest policy and will report separately on a possible Dutch contribution.
The cabinet will take a position once all necessary texts on the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement are available.
Kabinet zal een standpunt innemen als alle daarvoor noodzakelijke teksten over het EU-Mercosur-Associatieverdrag beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het CETA-verdrag dat afbouw gaswinning in de weg staat

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether the CETA trade agreement could allow gas companies to claim compensation that burdens the Dutch state and hinders the Groningen gas phase-out and energy transition. The minister answered that no claims are expected, that CETA preserves the state's right to regulate in the public interest, and that the Netherlands cannot guarantee CETA's fate if it does not ratify.
The CETA treaty text explicitly confirms the right of governments to regulate in the public interest.
De verdragstekst van CETA bevestigt expliciet het recht voor overheden om te reguleren in het publieke belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de schaderegeling voor het derivatendrama handjeklap zou zijn met de banken

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether the compensation scheme for the interest rate derivatives scandal was negotiated too much in the banks' favour, including exclusion of large semi-public institutions and capping of goodwill payments. The minister rejects claims of undue bank influence, defends the independent expert committee's framework, and says the framework and its versions were already published.
In drawing up the Uniform Recovery Framework (UHK), both the banks and SME and claimant organisations were involved.
Bij het opstellen van het Uniform Herstelkader (UHK) zijn zowel de banken als MKB- en claimorganisaties betrokken geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat het witwasbeleid van ABN Amro volgens de toezichthouder faalt

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB found ABN Amro's anti-money-laundering policy deficient and ordered a re-screening of retail clients, and asked why DNB's instruments and the bank's treatment differ from ING's settlement. The minister answered that DNB cannot disclose supervisory-confidential directions or specific measures against ABN Amro, that enforcement responsibility lies with DNB and the Public Prosecution Service, and that he expects banks to comply and reports DNB's annual oversight accountability.
DNB itself cannot make public information about directions because it concerns supervisory-confidential information.
DNB kan zelf geen informatie naar buiten brengen over aanwijzingen omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de problemen bij Yarden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Finance about Yarden's weak solvency, the use of a clause to cut funeral-insurance policy terms, and whether policyholders would be protected in a bankruptcy. The minister explained the recovery plan approved by DNB, said a bail-in was not applicable under the interventieladder, and gave a partial answer on policyholder losses, referring to earlier documents.
It is up to the company itself to decide whether the policy terms will be restored to their 'old' form in better times.
Het is aan de onderneming zelf om te bepalen of de polisvoorwaarden in betere tijden weer worden hersteld in hun «oude» vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over digitaal Facebookgeld

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about Facebook's planned digital currency Libra, including whether it needs licences, risks to financial stability and consumers, data-protection and PSD2 implications, and tax payment. The minister answers that Libra's licensing status is still under examination with supervisors, that a DNB study on digital central bank money is pending, and that a range of risks will be assessed before any measures are taken.
I will investigate this in the coming period together with the supervisors.
Ik ga dit de komende tijd onderzoeken met de toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over leefbaar loon in de kledingindustrie

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Schone Kleren Campagne finding that major fashion brands cannot show their workers earn a living wage, whether the government is pushing living wages in producing countries, whether living wages are enforceable under the textile covenant, and how garment prices would be affected. The minister acknowledged the problem, described cooperation with the ILO and other partners and the textile covenant's living wage goal for 2020 with monitoring and a complaints mechanism, said the covenant evaluation will inform possible further measures, and noted that a living wage need not raise retail prices significantly.
The cabinet therefore currently sees no reason to change the course of its policy.
Het kabinet ziet daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om de koers van haar beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over een rapport over beleggingen in wapenproductie en wapenhandel

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the ministers whether Dutch banks ING, ABN AMRO and Van Lanschot Kempen investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt is compatible with Dutch arms export policy, and whether the IMVO banking covenant and the government should act. The government answered that banks are individually responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that export licensing is a national competence, and that it would not ban such investments or add covenant commitments.
The cabinet therefore does not consider it necessary to prohibit the said investments.
Het kabinet acht het verbieden van de genoemde investeringen daarom niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over het ontnemen van toegang van Huawei tot Google-software door de Verenigde Staten

MPs Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about the US decision to restrict Huawei's access to Google Android, its effects on Dutch users, the justification for it, and whether Dutch policy should shift. The government answered that the effects are not yet clear, that current Huawei phones keep working, that Dutch risks are assessed case by case, and that it rejects the need for a US strategy while pursuing multilateral trade reform.
The cabinet does not share this view and therefore sees no reason to draw up an American strategy.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet en ziet hierin derhalve geen aanleiding een Amerikastrategie op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over de middelen die het notariaat ter beschikking heeft om fraude te bestrijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether the notariat has enough tools to combat fraud, including BV fraud after the removal of preventive checks, EU digital incorporation, a VAT-number pre-check scheme and a central shareholder register. The minister acknowledges the notary's gatekeeper role, is in talks with the KNB, denies a clear causal link to simplified BV law, rejects the VAT pre-check idea because of the fiscal confidentiality duty, and says the government will prepare a position on the shareholder register initiative.
I am in discussion with the KNB about the instruments the notariat needs, given its gatekeeper role.
Ik ben in gesprek met de KNB over het instrumentarium dat voor het notariaat, vanwege diens poortwachtersrol, nodig en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het depositogarantiestelsel

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the deposit guarantee scheme (DGS) fund, reaching only 0.8% of guaranteed deposits by 2024, would suffice in a systemic bank crisis and who would ultimately pay. The minister replied that the DGS is adequate for most consumer savings, cited resolution tools, ex post levies, credit lines and planned EDIS, and rejected that taxpayers necessarily bear the costs, while acknowledging a government pre-financing role cannot be fully excluded.
Despite these lines of defence, it cannot be fully ruled out that in the extreme case recourse to the government may be made to provide pre-financing for a certain period.

Ondanks deze verdedigingslinies kan niet volledig worden uitgesloten dat in het uiterste geval een beroep op de overheid wordt gedaan om voorfinanciering te verstrekken gedurende een bepaalde periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over een mogelijk op handen zijnde fusie tussen ING en Commerzbank

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch and German governments discussed a possible ING-Commerzbank merger, how large the banks are, whether such a merger is desirable, and what the government will do about too-big-to-fail risks. The minister declined to discuss the content of contacts with German counterparts, said bank mergers are for banks and supervisors (ECB, DNB) to assess, and pointed to existing resolution and capital tools without committing to new action.
I cannot go into the content of individual conversations.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de inhoud van individuele gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onbetrouwbare geldautomaten en stortingen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how often cash deposits at ATMs go wrong to the customer's detriment, whether DNB supervises this and sets error norms, and whether the government will act on banks' handling of such claims. The minister answered that banks handle complaints first, escalating to Kifid or courts, that structural problems are not known, that DNB tests ATMs for counterfeit detection, and that he will raise the matter with the NVB.
Nevertheless, I will ask the NVB for its attention to this.
Desalniettemin zal ik de aandacht van de NVB hiervoor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nog steeds tekortschieten van het tuchtrecht voor banken

MP Alkaya asks whether the banking disciplinary system (Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken) is accessible, whether banks as organisations should fall under it, and whether it can change banking culture. Minister Hoekstra answers that the sector is responsible for public awareness, that a checklist and referral practice are in place, that bank-level liability is better handled by DNB, AFM and civil law, and that the oath has raised awareness though more is needed.

I therefore see no reason – and this would also deviate greatly from other disciplinary systems, such as medical disciplinary law – to extend the scope so that the bank as an organisation can also be held to account under disciplinary law.

Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding – en dit zou ook zeer afwijken van andere tuchtrechtelijke stelsels, zoals het medisch tuchtrecht – de reikwijdte uit te breiden zodat ook de bank als organisatie tuchtrechtelijk kan worden aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat de beantwoording van Kamervragen is afgestemd met het BKR

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ministry coordinated its answers to earlier parliamentary questions with the credit registration bureau BKR, and whether this undermined trust in politics. The minister replied that consulting BKR was necessary to check the feasibility of the measures it was asked to take, that the ministry has no control over the independent BKR, and that the BKR has since published a balancing-of-interests guideline, free access to personal data, and dispute-committee rulings.
The picture painted in the report is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat in het bericht wordt geschetst, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook weigert geld terug te betalen bij aankopen die op haar platform zijn gedaan door minderjarigen

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked the minister whether Facebook refuses refunds for in-game purchases made by minors without parental knowledge and what rules apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that such refunds can be claimed under Dutch civil law, that Facebook has a refund tool and reportedly grants valid claims, and that parents can secure accounts, while the minister raised the issue with Facebook.
If something unexpectedly goes wrong and a child makes payments without permission, I am assured that Facebook is accommodating in refunding them.
Als er onverhoopt toch iets mis gaat en een kind zonder toestemming betalingen verricht, is mij verzekerd dat Facebook coulant omgaat met terugbetalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de voortgang van het VN-verdrag over mensenrechten en bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the European Commission's withdrawal from negotiating a UN treaty on business and human rights is accurate, whether the EU should participate in the October round, and whether the Netherlands would participate independently. The Minister confirmed the Commission deferred the mandate decision to the next College, explained EU concerns about the process and chair Ecuador, and said the Netherlands is reluctant to negotiate independently while pursuing an EU position and an EU action plan.
The Netherlands is reluctant to participate independently in the negotiations because of the lack of clarity about the mandate of the intergovernmental working group.
Nederland is terughoudend met zelfstandige deelname aan de onderhandelingen vanwege de onduidelijkheid over het mandaat van de intergouvernementele werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de Minister van Financiën en de premier in het Catshuis overleggen met de top van de bancaire sector

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about a Catshuis dinner with bank executives, asking who attended, what was discussed, whether minutes exist, whether structural reforms like a public bank were raised, and whether banks have restored trust. The minister named the attendees, said the meeting focused on restoring trust, anti-money-laundering shortcomings and information sharing, declined to produce minutes as a matter of practice, and said the WRR report was not on the agenda.
No minutes are made of the informal meetings in the Catshuis.
Er worden geen verslagen gemaakt van de informele bijeenkomsten in het Catshuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de topman van ING mogelijk alsnog vervolgd wordt

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's top executive may still be prosecuted, and why he had not been prosecuted earlier. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service has referred complaints to the Court of Appeal, that a complaint has been filed against natural persons, and that the settlement with ING did not bar prosecution of individuals.
The Court of Appeal will rule on these complaints. I will not anticipate that.
Het Gerechtshof zal over deze klachten oordelen. Daar loop ik niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over maatschappelijk verantwoord investeren door levensverzekeraars en andere institutionele beleggers

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked whether Minister Kaag discussed the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights with insurers, whether she raised arms trade investment, and whether stricter monitoring is warranted. The minister answered that the talks covered controversial weapons within the IMVO insurance covenant, that a working group will develop due diligence questions, and that tightening the covenant is not currently warranted.
Additional agreements on monitoring the application of the UNGPs do not seem appropriate so soon after the covenant was signed.
Aanvullende afspraken met betrekking tot de monitoring van de toepassing van de UNGP's liggen zo kort na de ondertekening van het convenant niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Raak over het bericht dat de topman van ABN AMRO niet wil dat de overheid treuzelt met de verkoop

MPs Alkaya and Van Raak asked the Finance Minister to request that ABN AMRO publish any future scenarios it drew up in 2018, including ones assuming a sales halt, and whether the parliamentary information duty applies to state-majority companies. The minister said he is not aware of such scenarios, that a sales halt is not on the table under the coalition agreement, that publishing them is not opportune, and that the information duty applies only to ministers and state secretaries, not to companies in which the state holds a majority stake.
I therefore do not consider it opportune to ask ABN AMRO to make such scenarios public, should they exist.
Ik vind het dan ook niet opportuun om ABN AMRO te verzoeken dergelijke scenario’s, mochten deze al bestaan, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de één miljoen euro boete voor Rabobank vanwege gebrekkig witwastoezicht

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about a 1 million euro DNB fine on Rabobank for weak anti-money-laundering checks, including why DNB did not inform parliament, how many measures it has taken against banks, and whether informal enforcement is adequate. The minister said DNB is bound by confidentiality for pre-July 2018 sanctions, cited DNB's enforcement counts, and declined to comment on the individual case.
DNB is subject to a statutory duty of confidentiality in its integrity supervision, which also applies towards me and your House.
Op DNB rust in het kader van haar integriteitstoezicht een wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht, die ook richting mij en uw Kamer geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over Uber

The SP MPs asked the government about a series of accidents involving Uber drivers, driver age and insurance, and whether Uber's safety measures and competition rules are adequate. The state secretary answered that police investigations are ongoing, that SWOV research on taxi accidents was commissioned, that Uber's measures are a good first step, and that existing rules apply equally to all taxi operators.
The police are currently investigating the various accidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes of that.
De politie onderzoekt momenteel de verschillende ongevallen. Op de uitkomsten daarvan kunnen wij niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook tieners betaalde om hen te kunnen bespioneren

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether Dutch youths used Facebook Research's paid data app, whether it is desirable and lawful under the GDPR for minors to be paid to share all their data, and whether the Dutch DPA knew of it and has enough capacity to supervise. The minister answers that the app targeted only the US and India, so the GDPR likely did not apply, that consent from minors under 16 requires parental authorisation, and that complaints about Facebook fall to the Irish lead supervisor while Dutch citizens can complain to the AP.

I do not consider it desirable that Facebook asks people for all their data in return for payment, because it is impossible to foresee what possibilities this data provision offers or which combinations of data can be made.

Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat Facebook mensen tegen betaling om al hun gegevens vraagt, omdat niet is te overzien wat de mogelijkheden zijn die deze dataverstrekking biedt of welke combinaties van data er kunnen worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over het bericht dat via CETA er gemanipuleerd voedsel de markt op komt

SP MPs Alkaya and Futselaar asked whether gene-edited (CRISPR-Cas) apples from outside the EU can enter the European market while EU farmers are supposedly barred from using the method, and whether CETA guarantees that EU food standards are respected. The minister answers that imports must meet EU GMO and food safety rules, that the CJEU ruling applies GMO rules to new breeding techniques, that CETA does not change EU standards, and that import controls may be adapted with EU-level discussions ongoing.
All exports from Canada to the EU must comply with EU standards, including EU rules on genetic modification and food safety.
Alle export van Canada naar de EU moet voldoen aan EU-standaarden, waaronder EU-regelgeving op het terrein van genetische modificatie en voedselveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat het Duitse handelsministerie wetgeving voorbereidt die Duitse bedrijven tot gepaste zorgvuldigheid verplicht

An SP MP asked whether the government would prepare binding due diligence legislation like Germany's if voluntary IMVO covenants fail, and whether it would make covenants generally binding. The minister answered that the coalition agreement keeps the covenants, an evaluation starts in autumn 2019, and options including binding measures are being studied, while no legal basis yet exists for declaring covenants generally binding.
In the autumn of this year an evaluation of the covenant policy will be started.
In het najaar van dit jaar zal een evaluatie van het convenantenbeleid worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het mogelijk faillissement van SecurCash

MP Alkaya (SP) asked the Finance Minister about the handling of SecurCash's bankruptcy request, DNB's role beforehand, contacts with competitors, and worker protection. The minister said the bankruptcy process is for the courts and parties involved, described DNB's coordination with banks and cash-transport firms to bridge the wind-down, and outlined existing statutory protections for employees while promising to report back on systemic risks.
Once DNB has completed this analysis, I will come back to your House on it.
Nadat DNB deze analyse heeft afgerond, kom ik hier bij uw Kamer op terug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Alkaya, Snels en Bruins over het bericht dat banken financiering van fossiele energie niet hebben teruggebracht

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks and insurers still invest far more in fossil energy than in renewables, and about the transparency and comparability of financial institutions' climate investments. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to DNB monitoring, the sector's climate commitment within the Klimaatakkoord, and EU sustainability disclosure work, without committing to new mandatory reporting rules.
At the request of a motion by MPs Snels and Sneller, I have asked DNB to continue monitoring the Dutch financial sector's exposures to CO2-intensive sectors.
Ik heb DNB, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Snels en Sneller 3 , gevraagd de uitzettingen van de Nederlandse financiële sector op CO 2 -intensieve sectoren te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de kosten van crowdfunding bij Dream or Donate

MP Alkaya (SP) asked whether the fees charged by crowdfunding platform Dream or Donate for medical fundraising are proportionate, whether consumer and financial oversight should be tightened, and whether new rules on platform fees are planned. Staatssecretaris Keijzer replied that existing consumer protection rules and ACM oversight are adequate, the matter is for ACM and the courts, and no new regulation is needed.
The assessment of Dream or Donate's conduct is for the competent supervisor, the ACM, and ultimately for the courts.
De beoordeling van de handelwijze van Dream or Donate is aan de betrokken toezichthouder ACM en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het te grabbel gooien van onze bankgegevens door Brussel

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether fintech firms can access bank data of people who never consented (silent party data), whether banks and the AP can go to court over misuse, and whether PSD2 favours big tech and risks reversing the burden of proof for consumers. The minister replied that silent party data may only be used to perform the payment service, that the AP can enforce directly and parties can appeal to courts, and that he will monitor competition effects and report in spring.
I will inform you in the spring about the progress on the implementation of this and other commitments I made in the plenary debate on PSD2.
Ik informeer u in het voorjaar over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitvoering van deze en andere toezeggingen die ik heb gedaan in het plenaire debat over PSD2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat de topman van ABN-Amro niet wil dat de overheid treuzelt met de verkoop

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees with ABN AMRO's CEO that a sale of the state's stake must not be delayed, and whether ABN AMRO's scenarios on non-sale should be published. The minister replied that there is no sales stop, that timing depends on market factors, and that he is unaware of any such scenarios.
Further statements on the rationale for the timing of transactions cannot be made, as they could be price-sensitive.
Verdere mededelingen over de rationale van de timing van transacties kunnen niet gedaan worden, aangezien die koersgevoelig zouden kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de bankierseed

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the banker's oath, whether it is effective, what sanctions apply for not taking it, whether banks' conduct harms trust, and why supervision is left to banks. The minister replied that banks are responsible for administering the oath, that DNB and AFM supervise risk-based with fines or orders available, that the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken has clarified referral procedures with KiFiD, and that no change to supervision is planned.
I see no reason to change this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding hierin verandering te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over Astro TV

MPs Sneller and Alkaya asked whether the psychic programme 'Astro TV' and similar shows that promise financial good fortune to callers, aimed at vulnerable people, amount to misleading practice and whether the Authority for Consumers and Markets or other supervisors should act. The government answered that the programme cited is actually RTL's 'Dit is mijn toekomst', that responsibility for assessing misleading practices lies with the ACM and the courts, that the AFM and Commissariaat have no clear remit, and that RTL has agreed limits on advice and is reconsidering the programme.

Ultimately it is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the courts to determine whether the practices of Astro TV, 'Dit is mijn toekomst' and similar media are misleading in that context.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te bepalen of de praktijken van Astro TV, «Dit is mijn toekomst» en soortgelijke media in dat kader misleidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over voortdurende misstanden bij ABN Amro

Member Alkaya (SP) asked the Finance Minister about continuing misconduct allegations at ABN Amro, including whether the state would investigate integrity violations and whether the share sale should continue. The Minister answered that the matter is for the bank's management and supervisory board, that NLFI manages its stake adequately, and that the plan to fully privatise ABN Amro stands.
This is not a matter for the shareholder, but for the management board and the supervisory board.
Dit is geen zaak van de aandeelhouder, maar van de raad van bestuur en de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de beleggingen van banken in regenwoud vernietigende palmoliebedrijven zonder dat hun klanten hiervan op de hoogte zijn

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks investing clients' money in funds linked to palm oil companies that destroy rainforest, without clients' knowledge, is acceptable, and what will be done about transparency and stricter rules. The minister answered that banks should map client sustainability preferences and communicate fund policies clearly, that the EU sustainable finance proposals are supported, that the banking sector covenant on palm oil is being pursued, and that a financial sector agenda will follow.
I am of the view that greater clarity is necessary in applying the concept of sustainability.
Ik ben van mening dat meer eenduidigheid noodzakelijk is bij de toepassing van het begrip duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het 'uitrusten' van werknemers met microchips

An SP MP asked ministers whether employers may require or request workers to have microchips implanted, citing a UK case, and how such practices relate to GDPR, bodily integrity and the role of supervisors. The minister said such practices must respect privacy and bodily integrity, that the case is hypothetical for the Netherlands, that implanting microchips would likely be unlawful given the employer-employee relationship and biometric data rules, and that workers can complain to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie SZW.
Privacy, human dignity and protection of bodily integrity are fundamental rights that must also be protected in a rapidly digitalising work environment.
Privacy, menselijke waardigheid en de bescherming van de lichamelijke integriteit zijn fundamentele rechten die ook in een snel digitaliserende werkomgeving beschermd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de Nederlandse en de Europese inzet in het kader van het VN-verdrag over mensenrechten en het bedrijfsleven

An MP from the SP asked the minister about the Dutch and EU role in the fourth UN negotiating round on a binding business and human rights treaty, including whether the EU was absent when conclusions were adopted, the status of an EU non-paper, and the UNGPs as basis. The minister explained the EU spoke on behalf of member states, that the EU distanced itself from the chair's conclusions, declined to share the non-paper as internal and confidential, and criticised the zero draft's scope and vagueness.
The EEAS indicated it regards the non-paper as an internal and confidential document, for which reason it is not attached to this reply.
De EDEO heeft aangegeven het non-paper als een intern en vertrouwelijk stuk te zien, om die reden wordt het niet bijgevoegd in deze beantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over witwaspraktijken van Europese banken

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about money-laundering through Danske Bank and European banks, the supervision of anti-money-laundering rules in Denmark and the Netherlands, and whether the ING settlement and fine would be enough. The minister answered that the facts of the Danske case are not yet known, that DNB and AFM supervise under the Wwft, that ING's profits were disgorged, and that DNB and AFM's independence limits his involvement in individual cases.
As Minister of Finance I do not intervene in individual cases, but I do have regular contact with DNB to assess whether the supervisory system as a whole functions properly.
Als Minister van Financiën treed ik niet in individuele zaken 9 maar heb ik wel regulier contact met DNB om te bezien of het toezichtsysteem als geheel (d.w.z.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Tanzania het investeringsverdrag met Nederland opzegt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Tanzania's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, including the reasons, ISDS protection for public-interest regulation, a most-favoured-nation clause, and whether the treaty was mutually beneficial. The minister replied that Tanzania gave no reason for termination, that the right to regulate is protected in both developing and developed countries, that the new model BIT clarifies this, and that Tanzania has requested a modern treaty with formal negotiations pending EU authorisation.
No reason was given for the termination.
Voor de opzegging is geen reden opgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over eerdere witwaspraktijken van ING

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about ING's earlier money-laundering practices, the settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, whether natural persons were shielded from prosecution, and the minister's role given former ING counsel Grapperhaus. The minister answered that the Dutch prosecutor was not involved in the 2012 US settlement, that no agreement shielded individuals and prosecution remains possible if new facts emerge, and that the transaction was approved by the minister after the Justice minister recused himself.
It does not befit me to comment on any integrity violations that may have come to light in another investigation, not conducted by the Dutch Public Prosecution Service.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over eventuele integriteitschendingen die in het kader van een ander onderzoek, dat niet is verricht door het Nederlandse OM, aan het licht zouden zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over bedrijfsovernames en de stakingsgolf bij AkzoNobel

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked about strikes at AkzoNobel over wages and pensions while shareholders receive large payouts, the treatment of employees in the sale of the chemicals division (now Nouryon), tax on capital repayments, and private equity sales of Dutch firms. Minister Wiebes answered that wages and pensions are for social partners, that the Rijnlands governance model and works council rights apply, that the Corporate Governance Code does not bind Nouryon or foreign investors, and that a legislative cooling-off period for listed boards is being prepared.
The cabinet attaches great value to this Rhineland model.
Het kabinet hecht grote waarde aan dit Rijnlandse model.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook telefoonnummers gebruikt voor advertentiedoeleinden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether Facebook uses phone numbers given for account security for advertising, whether this is lawful under the GDPR, and whether non-users can be targeted via uploaded contact data. The minister said he lacks data, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority decides whether to investigate and that Ireland's authority may be the lead regulator, and that using security-provided data for advertising without consent is not permitted under the GDPR.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), as independent supervisor, to possibly investigate and make a judgment on the lawfulness of Facebook's conduct.
Het is aan de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder eventueel onderzoek te doen en een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van het handelen van Facebook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Alkaya over het stopzetten van het Bangladesh Akkoord voor Brand- en Gebouwveiligheid in Bangladesh

Two MPs asked the minister why the Bangladesh Accord on fire and building safety may end on 30 November 2018 despite the assumed continuation to 2020, and what Dutch government and industry can do to keep it running and protect union freedom. The minister says diplomatic pressure, a joint EU/US/Canada letter, a planned personal push in Bangladesh, ILO capacity support and a call on the textile sector to act are aimed at keeping the Accord operational.
I will personally push the government of Bangladesh on this, both before and during my trip to Bangladesh in November.
Ik zal mij hier persoonlijk voor inzetten bij de overheid van Bangladesh, zowel voorafgaand aan als tijdens mijn reis naar Bangladesh in november.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de stakingen van postbezorgers bij PostNL

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about PostNL strikes by postal workers over the introduction of the combibundel and reorganisations, and whether PostNL should be asked to postpone them. The State Secretary said workers may express their views through strikes, that employers must consult works councils and workers on work risks and changes, and that she will not interfere in PostNL's internal business decisions, citing the need for structural changes to finance the universal postal service.
It is not for me to interfere in the internal business processes of a market party and the choices it makes in doing so.
Het is niet aan mij om me te bemoeien met het interne bedrijfsproces van een marktpartij en de keuzes die deze daarbij maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat de Italiaanse bank UniCredito mogelijk ABN AMRO wil overnemen

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch state might sell its ABN AMRO shares, including via NLFI, given reports that UniCredit was interested in acquiring the bank, and how cross-border bank mergers and too-big-to-fail risks would be handled. The minister said he could not say in advance under what circumstances shares would be sold, that any transaction would be assessed when it arose, that he was unaware of other parties' interest, and pointed to existing EU measures on bank supervision, resolution and capital.
I cannot state in advance in which situation I would sell ABN AMRO shares via NLFI, because this could be disadvantageous to the state's position when selling a stake in ABN AMRO.
Ik kan op voorhand niet aangeven in welke situatie ik via NLFI aandelen in ABN AMRO verkoop, omdat dit nadelig kan zijn voor de positie van de staat bij de verkoop van een belang in ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de partijdigheid van de evaluatie van de netneutraliteitsverordening

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the consultancy Bird & Bird, which previously challenged Dutch net neutrality law, can impartially evaluate the net neutrality regulation, and how zero-rating concerns will be addressed.
