The State Secretary answered that the European Commission selects contractors under procurement rules, that conflicts of interest are contractually covered, that zero-rating is governed by BEREC guidelines, and that no action in Brussels is planned.
If the Commission considers that there is nevertheless a conflict of interests, it may terminate the contract.
Als de Commissie van oordeel is dat er desalniettemin sprake is van conflicterende belangen kan zij de overeenkomst beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de verhoging van de postzegelprijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the ACM allowed PostNL to raise stamp prices by 14.2%, and whether affordability, accessibility and shareholder payouts were considered. The State Secretary answered that the ACM applies statutory tariff rules, that the price is PostNL's decision, that accessibility and affordability are under pressure but guaranteed, and that the ACM should keep supervising prices.
I value this division of roles and am of the opinion that supervision by the ACM contributes to safeguarding the public interest of affordable universal postal service.
Ik hecht aan deze rolverdeling en ben van mening dat toezicht door de ACM bijdraagt aan het borgen van het publieke belang van een betaalbare UPD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over taxichauffeurs die geen verzekering kunnen afsluiten

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about taxi drivers struggling to obtain insurance from regular insurers, rising accident claims, and whether the taxi market liberalisation and Uber drivers contributed. The minister answered that only 5-10% of taxi drivers are insured with De Vereende, that over 90% of risks are still covered by the regular market, and that no evidence links new entrants to rising claims, with the regulator ACM monitoring competition and exam requirements being reviewed.
I have taken note of this report.
Van dit bericht heb ik kennisgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de aanstelling van Wouter Bos als bestuursvoorzitter van Invest-NL

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the appointment of Wouter Bos as CEO of Invest-NL, including whether his appointment was irreversible, how it fits the draft articles, how the selection was run, and whether his salary as an official exceeds the Prime Minister's. The government answered that the appointment is a temporary official post pending incorporation, that the state appoints the first board members, that a search agency selected from nine candidates by published criteria, and that his salary matches the future CEO pay scale.
The State is the entity that incorporates the company and thereby appoints the first board members and supervisory directors.
Het is de Staat die de vennootschap opricht en daarmee de eerste bestuurders en commissarissen benoemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht dat energiebedrijven met miljardenclaims klimaatbeleid tegenhouden

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that energy companies use multi-billion-euro claims under the Energy Charter Treaty to block climate policy, including whether Dutch letterbox firms exploit the treaty. Minister Kaag replied that the treaty gives investors limited protection, that the Netherlands opposes letterbox firms using it, and that renegotiation in 2019 will seek an explicit right for states to regulate in the public interest.
The cabinet will, among other things, advocate that letterbox companies be excluded from protection under the Energy Charter Treaty.
Het kabinet zal er daarbij onder meer voor pleiten dat brievenbusfirma’s worden uitgesloten van bescherming onder het Energiehandvestverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Italië weigert CETA te ratificeren

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade about Italy's reported refusal to ratify CETA over protection of Italian specialty products, why only 41 Italian products are protected under CETA versus 221 in the EU, and whether this shows unfair competition. The minister replied that the government awaits Italy's explanation, that many regional specialties are excluded in trade deals for negotiating reasons, that CETA protects 143 European regional specialties in Canada, and that the provisional application continues unaffected.
CETA offers additional protection to regional European specialties.
CETA biedt regionale Europese specialiteiten aanvullende bescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de lobby voor een hogere beloning voor bestuurder(s) van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether the AFM supervisory board chair lobbied for a higher pay for the AFM chair and a future board member, when pay was discussed, whether correspondence exists, and whether the pay issue affected the late reappointment of the chair. The Minister says pay was discussed in normal reappointment contact, the WNT exception for the chair was corrected to allow indexation, the correspondence is personnel-confidential and will not be shared, and the board's recruitment process was thorough.
Given the considerations above, I cannot provide these documents to your House.
Gegeven de bovenstaande overwegingen kan ik deze stukken niet aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de geheime EU-lijst van Amerikaanse producten waarop mogelijk importtarieven worden geïntroduceerd

MP Alkaya asked the minister about the secret EU list of US products that could face retaliatory import tariffs, its contents, the economic impact on the Netherlands, the Dutch role in the vote and steps to avoid the measures. The minister confirmed the draft list (cosmetics, spirits, tobacco, clothing, vessels, agricultural goods, steel), said the list was kept confidential pending US negotiations, estimated limited impact for most firms, and said the government is lobbying at high level for a permanent EU exemption.
This list is available for members of parliament to inspect in the reading room for confidential documents at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Deze lijst is voor Kamerleden in te zien in de leesruimte voor vertrouwelijke stukken op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onveilige telefoons van Samsung

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Samsung's refusal to provide security updates for phones older than two years, asking about scale, product safety under consumer law, and new legislation. The State Secretary said there is no data on how many citizens are affected, that product safety must be judged case by case, and pointed to the Roadmap Digitaal Veilige Hard- en Software, EU radio equipment and cybersecurity measures, and an EU digital content directive that would oblige sellers to provide security updates.
I will go into this further when answering the other questions.
Ik ga hier nader op in bij de beantwoording van de overige vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het gebruik van gegevens uit het handelsregister voor direct marketing aan ZZP’ers en kleine ondernemers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about KvK selling Trade Register data for direct marketing to self-employed persons, the share of KvK revenue from data sales, how many registrants have private addresses exposed, and whether the KvK should depend on data sales and how intrusion can be limited. The State Secretary answered that data sales have stayed around 25-30% of KvK income, that the register is public by law, that the Non Mailing Indicator exists and KvK is studying extending it to e-mail and phone, and that the questions would be addressed in the upcoming amendment of the Trade Register Act.
The KvK is currently examining the possibilities to extend the NMI to e-mail and telephone.
De KvK onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden om de NMI uit te breiden naar e-mail en telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het ontduiken van het minimumloon door Sandd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked whether postal company Sandd is evading the minimum wage by paying couriers on fixed norm hours rather than actual hours worked, and how the 80% employment norm was met. The minister answers that the minimum wage applies per hour worked, that the Inspectorate SZW is aware of the FNV complaint, that ACM found postal firms compliant with the 80% norm, and that a sector-wide collective agreement is for social partners to decide.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation at Sandd.
Over de specifieke situatie bij Sandd kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het bericht dat Rabobank haar zorgplicht voor bouwbedrijf Midreth schond

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister whether Rabobank breached its duty of care toward construction firm Midreth, whose house bank allegedly abused its position, and what the banking code and oversight of small-business lending mean for affected firms. The minister declined to judge the specific case, which is pending before the courts, pointed to the new small-business lending code and monitoring, and said the AFM's earlier review found no structural disadvantage, so no further steps were planned.
This specific case is still before the courts; an appeal in cassation is still open.
Deze specifieke zaak is nog onder de rechter; beroep in cassatie staat nog open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht ‘Kleine ondernemers in actie voor lagere pinkosten’

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether small businesses and SMEs are being used as cash cows through higher card-payment fees and what will be done to lower them. The minister answered that fee differences reflect volume-based pricing in a competitive market, that existing convenant arrangements freeze tariffs, and that no intervention is needed for now, though the parties will be asked to pay attention to small merchants in the 2018 evaluation.
I do not currently know which providers charge which costs to which customer segments.
Het is mij op dit moment niet bekend welke aanbieders precies welke kosten rekenen voor welke klantsegmenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat consumenten bot vangen bij Tuchtrecht Banken

An MP asked the Minister of Finance why consumen complaints to the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken are rarely heard, and whether banks as organisations should be subject to disciplinary law. The minister answered that disciplinary law targets individual employees, that most consumer complaints concern disputes better handled by KiFiD or civil courts, and that no change to bank disciplinary liability is planned, though a checklist and referral practice were introduced.
There are sufficient other options for holding the bank as an organisation to account.
Voor het aanspreken van de bank als organisatie bestaan voldoende andere mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de overplaatsing van een wegens corruptie verdachte topman van Heineken in Nigeria

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether a Heineken subsidiary director in Nigeria, implicated in a corruption case, was transferred to Singapore, and whether Heineken's anti-bribery policy and Dutch support to Heineken should change. The minister confirmed the transfer report, stated that corruption is criminal under Dutch law and that OECD guidelines apply, noted small Dutch support of EUR 1.4 million to a cassava partnership, and explained that prosecution of bribery abroad depends on the circumstances.
How companies shape their anti-corruption policy is, however, up to the companies themselves.
Hoe bedrijven hun anticorruptiebeleid vormgeven is echter aan bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Kuik en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Promotiemeisjes van Heineken verkopen bier met hun lichaam’

MPs Alkaya, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Heineken promotion girls in Africa are subjected to sexual harassment, and about the responsibility of parent companies, legal options, and Heineken subsidies. The minister said companies must address abuses throughout their supply chain under UN and OECD guidelines, that the government lacks legal powers to compel them, that a call with Heineken's CEO produced a commitment to prioritise the issue, and that a 2019 evaluation of the IMVO covenants will determine whether legislation is needed.
The government has no legal means to compel Dutch companies to take measures in such cases.
De overheid heeft geen juridische mogelijkheden om Nederlandse bedrijven te dwingen tot het nemen van maatregelen in dergelijke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de gevolgen van Kaderprogramma 9 voor het Meerjarig Financieel Kader

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate whether Council conclusions on industrial policy amount to a call to raise the EU budget (MFK), and why the minister said the MFK was not on the agenda. The State Secretary answered that the conclusions are not a call for a higher MFK, that the MFK was not discussed at the Competitiveness Council, and that the government will improve referencing of agenda documents in future.
As discussed in the General Committee on Information Provision of 12 April, the cabinet will give extra attention to proper referencing in the annotated agenda and cabinet letters.
Zoals besproken in het Algemeen Overleg Informatievoorziening van 12 april jl. zal er vanuit het kabinet extra aandacht zijn voor goede verwijzing in de geannoteerde agenda en kabinetsbrieven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Hoe mooi zou het zijn, een chip bij de geboorte'

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a news report on a 'digital identity chip at birth' and the VNG's Taskforce Samen Organiseren, including its membership, funding, pilots and privacy safeguards. The state secretary said the VNG had corrected the article, denied any plan to implant chips, described the Taskforce and its pilots, and stated the BRP modernisation is not directly linked to the Taskforce.
The article does not speak of implanting a chip at birth, but of assigning a digital identity at birth.
In het artikel wordt niet gesproken van het implanteren van een chip bij geboorte, maar van het toekennen van een digitale identiteit bij geboorte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over kloksystemen op basis van vingerafdrukken

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether employers may require employees to give fingerprints for clock systems, whether unpaid hours for refusers is unlawful, and whether private collection of fingerprints is acceptable. The state secretary answered that under the GDPR and the UAVG, biometric fingerprint processing is allowed only for authentication or security purposes, that refusers must be offered an alternative, and that the Data Protection Authority and courts assess specific cases.
In any case, the regulation in the GDPR and UAVG precludes using an employee's fingerprints for purposes other than authentication and security purposes.
In ieder geval verzet de regeling in de AVG en UAVG zich tegen het gebruiken van vingerafdrukken van een werknemer voor andere doelen dan authenticatie en beveiligingsdoeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de gevolgen van dalende postvolumes voor de postbezorging

MP Alkaya (SP) asked whether consolidation of postal companies is needed to guarantee postal continuity, employment and better jobs for postal workers, and asked about the number of postal operators, overlap, and weekly working hours. The Staatssecretaris answered that a Postdialoog will inform policy and that consolidation's pros and cons will be judged only after its results, while providing figures on operators (118) and average postal working hours (about 16 per week).

I attach importance to providing this space and to awaiting the results of the Postdialoog before drawing conclusions on the pros and cons of consolidation for the continuity of postal delivery and employment.

Ik hecht eraan om deze ruimte te bieden en de resultaten van de Postdialoog af te wachten alvorens ik conclusies trek over de voor- en nadelen van consolidatie voor de continuïteit van de postbezorging en de werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht ‘Geldspoor miljardenfraude met cryptomunten leidt naar ING’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that tether tokens and bitcoin price manipulation linked to Bitfinex led to an ING bank account, and whether ING should disclose if the backing exists and what rules govern banks' gatekeeping. The minister said the reports fit known crypto risks, that ING cannot disclose client details due to confidentiality, that banks must apply enhanced due diligence under the Wwft with DNB supervising, that the case assessment is not for the minister, and that he intends to bring crypto exchanges under a regulatory framework.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het subsidiëren van privaat onderwijs door gemeenten

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked whether municipal and national subsidies for international schools, aimed at attracting foreign investors and expats, are a responsible use of public money compared with regular schools. The minister replied that foreign investment mostly creates jobs for Dutch workers, that the subsidies were a one-off measure to reduce international school waiting lists, and that funds were not given directly to a private school group.
The central government did not provide any funds to the Amity Education Group. That was a decision of the municipality of Amsterdam.
Het Rijk heeft geen middelen beschikbaar gesteld aan de Amity Education Group. Dat betreft een besluit van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over DDoS-aanvallen op banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about economic damage, whether banks comply with legal resilience requirements, and whether a backup for digital payments is needed after DDoS attacks on Dutch banks. The government answered that damage is limited, that DNB supervises compliance with resilience norms, and that it sees no need for a decentralised backup for digital payments, while pointing to ongoing public-private cooperation.
DNB has set standards for the security and availability of payment traffic in the Netherlands, laid down in the Regulation on Oversight of the Proper Functioning of Payment Traffic.
DNB heeft normen gesteld voor de veiligheid en beschikbaarheid van het betalingsverkeer in Nederland, die in de Regeling Oversight goede werking betalingsverkeer zijn vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over misstanden in de Indiase kledingindustrie

An MP asked the minister about abuses against migrant women workers in Bangalore's garment industry, the slow pace of brand improvement plans, and whether the Dutch garment and textile covenant prevents such abuses. The minister answered that brands have taken steps under due diligence, that factory locations are now published, and that the covenant is being strengthened through international cooperation, while stressing its limited reach.
The cabinet expects participating companies, in line with the OECD guidelines, to start addressing the most urgent risks.
Het kabinet verwacht van de deelnemende bedrijven dat zij, conform de OESO- richtlijnen, starten met aanpak van de meest urgente risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het rapport '50 jaar ISDS'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report critical of investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS), including corporate claims via Dutch treaties, letterbox companies, and the EU-Canada/TTIP agreements. The Minister defended investment treaties as a stabilising tool, announced a modernised model BIT excluding letterbox companies and clarifying state regulatory rights, and said the government is exploring orderly termination of intra-EU BITs.
The government considers it desirable that only investors carrying out substantial business activities in the Netherlands can use Dutch investment agreements.
Het kabinet vindt het wenselijk dat enkel investeerders die substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten in Nederland verrichten, gebruik kunnen maken van Nederlandse investeringsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het aanstellen van “ambassadeurs” en toezichthouders

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked about how special envoys (StartupDelta and FinTech) and an AFM supervisory board member were appointed, their time commitment, pay, the plagiarism admitted by the FinTech envoy, and whether appointment procedures produce suitable people. The Minister answered that the envoys' roles and pay were set by agreements (partly via a foundation), the FinTech envoy's post had expired and was unpaid, and the AFM appointment followed a profile-based search and vetting, with pay caps under the WNT.

m: Motie van het lid Van der Werf over digitale alternatieven voor de fysieke verschijningsplicht bij het verlengen van paspoorten
Asks the government to inform the Chamber by Q1 2026 about digital and other alternatives to the in-person requirement when renewing passports.
requests the government to inform the Chamber by the first quarter of 2026 about which digital and other innovative alternatives are possible for the in-person requirement when renewing passports

verzoekt de regering om uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2026 de Kamer te informeren over welke digitale en andere innovatieve alternatieven mogelijk zijn voor de fysieke verschijningsplicht bij het verlengen van paspoorten
Motie van het lid Van der Werf over bij de augustusbesluitvorming eenmalig 5,6 miljoen euro voor het Centrum Seksueel Geweld beschikbaar stellen

Asks the government to provide a one-off 5.6 million euro for the Centrum Seksueel Geweld in the August budget decision, funded by reallocating money reserved for a constitutional court and Raad van State independence.
requests the government to make available a one-off 5.6 million for the CSG for 2026 during the August budget decision
verzoekt de regering bij de augustusbesluitvorming eenmalig 5,6 miljoen voor het CSG beschikbaar te stellen voor 2026
Motie van het lid Van der Werf over uniforme zorg en hulp door Centrum Seksueel Geweld in wet- en regelgeving vanaf 2027
Asks the government to secure uniform care and support by the Centrum Seksueel Geweld network for victims in law and regulation from 2027.
requests the government to adequately secure nationally uniform care and assistance by the CSG network for victims in laws and regulations from 2027
verzoekt de regering de landelijk uniforme zorg en hulp door het netwerk CSG aan slachtoffers adequaat te borgen in wet- en regelgeving vanaf 2027
Motie van het lid Six Dijkstra c.s. over jaarlijks rapporteren over de overheidsbrede samenwerking op soevereine AI
Asks the State Secretary to report at least annually on progress in government-wide cooperation on sovereign AI and use of European and open-source solutions.
requests the State Secretary to report at least annually to the House, via the NDS progress report, on how government-wide cooperation on sovereign AI is progressing
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris ten minste jaarlijks aan de Kamer te rapporteren, via de voortgangsrapportage van de NDS, hoe de overheidsbrede samenwerking op soevereine AI vordert
Motie van het lid Six Dijkstra c.s. over de principes van een mensgerichte digitale overheid wettelijk verankeren
Asks the government to legally anchor people-centred digital government principles, including uniform rules for postal addresses, staffed counters and accessible language and digital services.
requests the government to legally anchor the principles of a people-centred digital government
verzoekt de regering om de principes van een mensgerichte digitale overheid wettelijk te verankeren
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over afspraken voor mobieltjes op school aanscherpen naar "thuis of in de kluis"
Asks the government to tighten the national school rule on phones to keep them at home or locked away for the whole school day.
requests the government to tighten the current agreements on phones at school to home or in the locker
verzoekt de regering om de huidige afspraken voor mobieltjes op school aan te scherpen naar «thuis of in de kluis»

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bikker c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over de mogelijkheid onder voorwaarden ontheffing van het verbod te verlenen aan anderen dan personen met gespecialiseerde kennis
Allows the mayor to grant exemptions for carrying and selling category F2 fireworks to non-specialists for organised New Year's events under conditions set by general administrative order.
The mayor may grant exemption from the prohibitions in the first paragraph
De burgemeester kan ontheffing verlenen van de in het eerste lid gestelde verboden
Motie van het lid Six Dijkstra c.s. over een damage and impact assessment naar welke gegevens mogelijk gelekt zijn
Asks the government for a full damage and impact assessment of which data may have leaked from the NCTV and police CTER cluster and the potential consequences.
requests the government to carry out a full damage and impact assessment, mapping which data may have leaked from the NCTV and the police CTER cluster
verzoekt de regering te komen tot een volledige damage and impact assessment, waarbij in kaart gebracht wordt welke gegevens mogelijk gelekt zijn
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over boa's nationaal handelingsbevoegd maken onder de Wet seksuele misdrijven
Asks the government to give municipal enforcement officers (boa's) national authority to act under the Sexual Offences Act, beyond the pilot cities.
requests the government to make boa's nationally authorised to act under the Sexual Offences Act
verzoekt de regering boa's nationaal handelingsbevoegd te maken onder de Wet seksuele misdrijven
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over in aanloop naar of tijdens de NAVO-top in 2025 een zij-evenement organiseren dat zich richt op cybersecurity en hybride dreigingen
Motion asking the government to organise a side event at or before the 2025 NATO summit in The Hague on cybersecurity and hybrid threats.
requests the government to organise a side event in the run-up to or during the 2025 NATO summit focused on cybersecurity and hybrid threats
verzoekt de regering om in aanloop naar of tijdens de NAVO-top in 2025 een zij-evenement te organiseren dat zich richt op cybersecurity en hybride dreigingen
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over met Europese bondgenoten overleggen over duurzame meerjarige invulling van de militaire steun voor Oekraïne
Asks the government to consult European allies on a multi-year military support plan for Ukraine and propose funding in the Voorjaarsnota.
requests the government to consult with European allies on a sustainable multi-year form of military support for Ukraine
verzoekt de regering met Europese bondgenoten in overleg te treden over duurzame meerjarige invulling van de militaire steun voor Oekraïne
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over concrete scenario's uitwerken voor maatregelen op overheidsniveau en individueel niveau in het geval van hybride (cyber)aanvallen
Asks the government to develop concrete scenarios for government and individual measures during hybrid cyber attacks.
requests the government to develop concrete scenarios for measures to be taken at government and individual level
verzoekt de regering om concrete scenario's uit te werken voor de maatregelen die op overheidsniveau en individueel niveau genomen moeten worden
Motie van het lid Olger van Dijk c.s. over een voortrekkersrol blijven vervullen in de dialoog over kunstmatige intelligentie in het militaire domein en zo mogelijk tot internationale normering komen
Asks the government to keep leading international dialogue on military AI and seek international norms, reporting to the House in 2025.
requests the government to continue to play a leading role in the international dialogue on artificial intelligence in the military domain
verzoekt de regering om een voortrekkersrol te blijven vervullen in de internationale dialoog over kunstmatige intelligentie in het militaire domein
Motie van het lid Van der Wal c.s. over het vergroten van de weerbaarheid van Nederlanders door huis-aan-huisinformatie te verschaffen over noodsituaties
Asks the government to provide door-to-door information on emergencies and to explore municipal information points, with a report to the House in Q3 2025.
requests the government to provide door-to-door information on emergencies
verzoekt de regering huis-aan-huisinformatie te verstrekken over noodsituaties
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over de adviezen uit het rapport Drijfveren bij Defensie met prioriteit oppakken
Asks the government to prioritise the recommendations of the inspector-general report on Defence personnel motivation, involving mid-rank staff in HR reform.
requests the government to prioritise these recommendations
verzoekt de regering deze adviezen met prioriteit op te pakken
Motie van het lid Van der Wal c.s. over het in kaart brengen van de belangrijkste belemmeringen voor opschaling van de Europese defensiesamenwerking en productiecapaciteit
Asks the government with European partners to map the main obstacles to scaling up European defence cooperation and production capacity and report options to the House.
requests the government together with European partners to map the main obstacles to scaling up European defence cooperation and production capacity
verzoekt de regering om samen met Europese partners de belangrijkste belemmeringen voor opschaling van de Europese defensiesamenwerking en productiecapaciteit in kaart te brengen
Motie van het lid Van der Wal c.s. over met Europese landen inventariseren welke stappen nodig zijn om cruciale defensiecapaciteiten te kunnen leveren
Asks the government to work with European countries to identify steps needed to deliver critical defence capabilities currently supplied by the United States.
requests the government to survey with European countries which steps are needed to be able to deliver these critical defence capabilities
verzoekt de regering met Europese landen te inventariseren welke stappen nodig zijn om deze cruciale defensiecapaciteiten te kunnen leveren
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kathmann c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 56 over middelen voor de Informatiepunten Digitale Overheid
Adds €3 million to digital government information points (IDO) funding for citizens, financed by moving money from undivided reserves on article 13.
The Digital Government Information Points (IDOs) help people with complicated digital government services.
De Informatiepunten Digitale Overheid (IDO's) helpen mensen met ingewikkelde digitale dienstverlening van de overheid.
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over in kaart brengen in welke gemeenten waar ondermijning en uitbuiting veelvuldig voorkomen een interventieteam als het HEIT behulpzaam kan zijn
Asks the government to map which other municipalities with heavy undermining and exploitation could use an intervention team like HEIT and inform the House by mid 2025.
requests the government to map which other municipalities where undermining and sexual exploitation occur frequently could benefit from a similar intervention team
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen in welke andere gemeenten waar ondermijning en seksuele uitbuiting veelvuldig aan de orde zijn

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de brief van de staatsecretaris van Financiën aan de kamer Overstap kantoorautomatisering naar M365’.

An MP asks why European alternatives to Microsoft 365 were not seriously explored before the Tax Administration chose Microsoft, what the requirements for a European alternative are, what is being done to develop one, and whether prior payments influenced the decision. The government answers that no thorough European alternative review was done in 2021, that no suitable European option is available in the short term, that the choice was not influenced by an advance payment, and that contractual and technical measures limit US access to Dutch government data, while acknowledging that such access cannot be fully excluded.
At the time, no extensive exploration of European alternatives took place and the then-prevailing (market) standard of Microsoft Windows 11 and M365 was assumed.
Daarom heeft destijds geen uitgebreide verkenning naar Europese alternatieven plaatsgevonden en is er uitgegaan van de toen geldende (markt)standaard van Microsoft Windows 11 en M365.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Lanschot, Piri, Van der Werf, Belhirch, Van der Burg, Ceder en Dassen  over een gat in de steun aan Oekraïne

MPs from several parties asked whether part of the 2026 military support budget for Ukraine was brought forward into 2025, leaving a gap in 2026, and how the government will prevent unwanted gaps. The Minister confirms that €3.1 billion for 2026 was partly accelerated into 2025, that planned 2026 cash outlays now stand at about €2.1 billion, and that support will continue with further burden-sharing efforts, without committing to a specific new safeguard.
Part of this support has been accelerated into cash expenditure in 2025.
Een deel van deze steun is versneld in 2025 tot kasuitgaven gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Werf over de beveiliging van de Israëlische delegatie door een voormalig legerofficier met illegale wapens

MPs Paternotte and Van der Werf asked about an armed private security guard, a former Israeli army officer, who was caught at Schiphol with illegal pistols while guarding an Israeli delegation, and about checks, prior notification, and possible training of Dutch police by him. The minister answered that armed guards require prior government permission, that no request was received for this visit, that individual cases are not discussed publicly, that police and army used the guard's company for training in the past, and that no other similar incidents are known.
I never make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf, Mutluer en Bruyning over de beschikbaarheid van acute hulp voor vrouwen naar aanleiding van de femicide-campagne 'Waar Ben Je'?

MPs asked whether the 24/7 Veilig Thuis chat for femicide signals is available everywhere, how the campaign's effect is monitored, and whether the statutory task should be extended to 24-hour availability. The state secretary answered that Veilig Thuis already has a legal duty to be reachable in acute situations, no national monitoring of the campaign effect exists, a 24/7 chat is being developed, and no change to the statutory task is planned.
Veilig Thuis does have the statutory duty to be reachable and available at all times in situations where immediate performance of its legal tasks is required.
Wel heeft Veilig Thuis de wettelijke taak om te allen tijde bereikbaar en beschikbaar te zijn in situaties waarin onmiddellijk uitvoering van de wettelijke taken geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf ver het bericht ‘Steeds meer fouten in processen-verbaal, jaarlijks tienduizenden overtreders vrijuit’

MPs Sneller and Van der Werf asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that rising errors in police reports on offences (processen-verbaal) let tens of thousands of offenders go unpunished each year. The Minister said about 32% of reports on offences were rejected in 2024, with roughly 18% never approved, and outlined measures to reduce errors but gave no concrete figures on lost fines.
I cannot give an amount here because, as I indicated in my answer to question 3, we do not know what the prosecution decision would have been had these reports been approved.

Ik kan hier geen bedrag noemen omdat we, zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heb aangegeven, niet weten hoe de vervolgbeslissing van het OM zou zijn uitgevallen als deze processen-verbaal wel waren goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Becker en Van der Werf over erfrecht, levensverzekeringen en femicide

MPs Mutluer, Becker and Van der Werf asked whether a person declared fully non-accountable after killing a partner inherits by default, whether life insurance is paid out without checks, and whether the law should change. The State Secretary answered that such persons are not automatically disinherited without a criminal conviction, that courts can exclude them under reasonableness and fairness, that no legal change is considered opportune, and that insurers already contractually exclude payouts to beneficiaries involved in a crime.
I therefore do not consider a change in the law opportune, as my predecessor also informed the House earlier this year.
Een wetswijziging acht ik daarom niet opportuun, zoals ook mijn ambtsvoorganger eerder dit jaar aan uw Kamer heeft laten weten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Six Dijkstra, Kathmann en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘In de strijd tegen deepfakes krijgen Denen copyright op eigen gezicht en stem’

MPs asked whether the government will act on deepfake abuse, including whether big tech platforms should be held responsible and whether Denmark's copyright-on-likeness approach should be adopted. The government answers that existing Dutch law (AVG, DSA, criminal law, portrait rights) is sufficient, that platforms can already be held liable, and that it sees no reason to introduce a copyright on appearance or voice.
The State Secretary for Justice and Security therefore sees no reason to proceed with amending legislation.
De Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om over te gaan tot aanpassing van wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf en Mutluer over uitvoering van de maatregelen om femicide in Nederland aan te pakken

MPs Becker, Van der Werf and Mutluer asked the State Secretary about implementing measures against femicide, including the psychological violence bill, the Clare's Law study, the femicide monitor, a national coordinator, and police case coordination. The government answered that it is committed to the approach, gave timelines and status updates on most items, and deferred or pointed to other documents on several.
I expect this bill can go into consultation before summer 2026.
Ik verwacht dat dit wetsvoorstel voor de zomer van 2026 in consultatie kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Der Werf en Bamenga over de mobilisatie in Venezuela en de veiligheidsontwikkelingen nabij Curaçao, Aruba en Bonaire

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about US naval deployment near Venezuela, its implications for the ABC islands (Cooperative Security Location, Kustwacht, NOTAMs, travel advice, involvement of Aruba and Curaçao) and whether Parliament would be informed. The government answered that the US deployment is nationally directed and the Kingdom is not involved, that existing defence and aviation arrangements remain unchanged, and that it will inform Parliament promptly if the security situation changes.
If the situation in the region leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, the government will inform your House without delay.
Indien de situatie in de regio leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal de regering uw Kamer daarover onverwijld informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over het artikel ‘Opnieuw grenscontroles door groep burgers, dit keer bij  Groningse Sellingen’

MPs from D66 asked the Justice Minister whether citizen groups stopping cars at the border and intimidating people is acceptable, what the government thinks of the chat messages with racist and violent content, and whether the government's initial response was too lax. The minister answered that border controls are reserved to authorities such as the Marechaussee, that taking the law into one's own hands is not allowed, that one suspect has been arrested, and that prosecution decisions rest with the prosecutor and judge.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have been committed.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Podt over stikstofbelemmeringen op defensielocaties

MPs from D66 asked the government about nitrogen (stikstof) rules blocking expansion of Dutch military training sites and air bases, including the consequences for NATO readiness and the specific permit barriers at each location. The State Secretary for Defence answered that a TNO study finds the impact on operational readiness 'enormous', that defence sites mostly lack nature permits, that permit procedures are slow and complex with no generic defence exemption under the Habitat and Birds Directives, and that the ministerial commission and an EU defence readiness omnibus are being used to find solutions.
The management summary of the TNO study and the Haskoning research report were sent to your House on 3 July 2025.
Het managementuittreksel van het onderzoek van TNO en het onderzoeksrapport van Haskoning zijn op 3 juli 2025 aan uw Kamer verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Medische misstanden in Nederlandse gevangenissen. Ik kwam lopend binnen, en verliet de gevangenis in een rolstoel’

MPs Sneller and Van der Werf asked the Justice Minister about reports of medical failures in Dutch prisons, including delayed care, wrong medication, and reliance on untrained guards for medical matters. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems in principle, said the number of cases is unknown, and outlined existing procedures, on-call doctors, and planned reviews of women's detention, while disputing that cost considerations drive care decisions.
I take all signals, as described in the Misstandenboek, very seriously.
Ik neem alle signalen, zoals beschreven in het Misstandenboek, zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Pleegzorg ver onder de maat bij organisatie die Vlaardings meisje begeleidde’

An MP asked the state secretaries about a news report on poor foster care quality at the organisation Enver, which supervised a girl from Vlaardingen, and about safety measures for its foster children. The government answered that Enver must fix the deficiencies identified by the Inspectorate (IGJ) by end January 2026 under enhanced supervision, that the IGJ is running thematic supervision of the foster care sector with results due this autumn, and that the IGJ will review the foster care providers' safety oversight.
During the period of enhanced supervision, the inspectorate will closely monitor Enver, for example through announced or unannounced visits and by requesting progress reports.
In de periode van het verscherpt toezicht zal de inspectie Enver nauwlettend volgen, bijvoorbeeld met aangekondigd of onaangekondigd bezoek en het opvragen van voortgangsrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens: maak nu bezwaar als je niet wil dat Meta AI traint met jouw data’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary whether Meta's plan to train its AI on public posts of adult Dutch users without consent is lawful and what users can do. The government answered that the Irish DPC leads the matter, that Meta has postponed training and added transparency and opt-out measures, and that it has no role itself since supervision rests with the data protection authorities.
It is not for me to permit or prohibit this.
Het is niet aan mij om dit toe te staan of te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Werf en Boswijk over het samen met de Denen direct investeren in de Oekraïense defensie-industrie

MPs Paternotte, Van der Werf and Boswijk asked why the Netherlands did not join Denmark's mechanism for funding Ukrainian defence-industry investment, how much has been contracted, and how it ensures alignment with Ukraine's needs. The minister answered that the Dutch direct-procurement model gives the Netherlands control over the process, that over EUR 1.4 billion has been allocated, that contracts are still in negotiation with no amounts yet, and that answers to individual questions were not provided in time.
It is not yet possible to indicate which amounts are involved.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de BNN/VARA-documentaire ‘Hoe familievloggers zoals de Bellinga’s hun kinderen in gevaar kunnen brengen’

An MP asked the state secretaries about the BNNVARA documentary on family vloggers and children's exposure to commercial exploitation, including regulation, children's wellbeing, the Children's Ombudsman's concerns, and platform responsibility. The government acknowledges current law is not suited to 'kidfluencing', announces amending regulation and parents' awareness campaigns, but leaves platform and age-verification matters to EU-level coordination.
To better protect children from the harmful influence of this, I will amend the existing laws and regulations.
Om kinderen beter te beschermen tegen de nadelige invloed hiervan ga ik de bestaande de wet- regelgeving aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Boswijk over ‘Het traceren van militairen via fitness-apps

MPs Van der Werf and Boswijk asked whether Dutch soldiers can be traced via the Strava fitness app and what Defence is doing about the operational security risk. The government answers that the app is banned on defence devices, personnel receive cyber-awareness training and a handbook, a defence fitness app was introduced, and security protocols are reviewed as technology changes.
To mitigate this risk, the application in question, like comparable fitness applications, is not permitted on defence devices.
Om dit risico te mitigeren, is de betreffende applicatie, net als vergelijkbare fitness-applicaties, niet toegestaan op defensieapparaten.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Bonaire bezorgd om militaire dreiging vanuit Venezuela’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Bonaire fears a military threat from Venezuela, including whether activity was observed, threat levels, contacts with Venezuela and Bonaire, and protective measures. The minister answered that no recent Venezuelan military activity near Bonaire has been observed, that there is no reason to assume a heightened threat, that routine intelligence monitoring and regional Defence presence continue, and that Parliament will be informed if the situation changes.
If the situation in Venezuela leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, I will, also on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, inform your House about it.
Indien de situatie in Venezuela leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Afgesproken normen in zedenzaken niet gehaald’

MPs Van der Werf and Mutluer asked why agreed time-limit norms for sex-offence cases were again not met, and what the government will do about longer processing times, reduced victim willingness to report, understaffing and prioritisation. Minister Van Weel answered that some processing times slightly improved in 2024, that the action plan is extended to end 2025, that staffing shortfalls and new Sexual Offences Act capacity are being addressed, and that no additional measures are planned for now.

None of the trajectories meets the target norm, but the general picture is that the criminal justice chain organisations managed to handle more older cases and reduce backlogs without processing times increasing.

Op geen van de trajecten wordt de streefnorm gehaald, maar het algemene beeld is dat het de organisaties in de strafrechtketen is gelukt om meer oudere zaken af te handelen en de voorraden te verminderen zonder dat de doorlooptijden zijn opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf en Mutluer over de stand van zaken van de aanpak van femicide

MPs Becker, Van der Werf and Mutluer asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the progress of the femicide action plan, including implementation steps, criminalising psychological violence, a 24/7 reporting point, funding, police training, the EU rape-centre directive, stalking, police case coordination, and children's contact with perpetrators after partner killings. The government answered that much detail will follow in a June 2025 progress letter, gave timelines for the bill on psychological violence and the EU directive (delayed to early 2026), described how the 10 million euro is being spent, and defended the existing legal framework on contact after partner killings.
I cannot currently indicate point by point in detail how the implementation of the femicide action plan stands.
Ik kan op dit moment niet per punt in detail aangeven hoe het staat met de implementatie van het plan van aanpak «Stop femicide!».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Wal, Van der Werf, Nordkamp, Dassen en Olger Van Dijk over de (dreigende) afhankelijkheid van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht van Starlink

MPs asked whether the Dutch armed forces risk dependence on Starlink, whether alternative European satellite systems exist for command, communication, positioning and ISR, and whether the Netherlands will invest in autonomous capacity. The minister replied that Defence is not dependent on Starlink, that it spreads suppliers and is building sovereign ISR and PNT capacity over time, but withheld details of specific systems and command systems on operational and national security grounds.
No statements are made about specific alternatives for Defence in connection with operational interests and national security.
Over specifieke alternatieven voor Defensie worden geen uitspraken gedaan in verband met operationele belangen en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mutluer en Helder over het afluistersysteem van de politie

MPs Van Nispen, Mutluer, Helder and Van der Werf asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the police wiretap system from Elbit was delayed and that an upgrade was bought as a backup, including questions about the supplier's staff access, human rights risks and AI use. The Minister denies that a new system was secretly bought, says the upgrade was a precaution, states that the new system will only be used once it meets requirements, and gives no firm guarantee on the first-half 2025 rollout.
Furthermore, it is good to note that because of the confidential tender, I cannot make statements about the supplier of the current wiretap system.
Verder is het goed om aan te geven dat vanwege de aanbesteding onder geheimhouding ik geen uitspraken kan doen over de leverancier van het huidige tapsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Werf over de gevolgen voor veiligheid van de aangekondigde grenscontroles

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Migration, Defence and Justice how border controls would affect security, given KMar staff shortages, whether extra funding helps, and whether border municipalities were consulted. The government answered that controls run within existing KMar capacity, that funding is being worked out, that there was consultation with border regions, and that impacts on the economy will be kept to a minimum.
The internal border checks will be carried out on the basis of the KMar's existing capacity.
De uitvoering van de binnengrenscontroles zullen plaatsvinden op basis van de bestaande capaciteit van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over militairen die op missie niet worden doorbetaald in het weekend en over reservisten zonder verlof

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether deployed soldiers receive only a deployment allowance for weekend days without salary or hour compensation, why exercise and deployment pay differ, whether pay will be reconsidered in consultation with unions, and how reservists' leave and pension rules will be handled following a court ruling. The State Secretary defended the differing allowance structures as justified and agreed with unions, promised further work on a new regulation for deployments, and gave a limited answer on reservists' leave compensation and no information on other European countries' rules.
Defence and the unions are currently working out this regulation. This consultation is confidential.
Defensie en de vakbonden werken deze regeling momenteel uit. Dit overleg is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Werf over de aanval op Nederlandse apparaten door Chinese staatshackers

MPs Kathmann and Van der Werf asked the government about a Chinese state-linked hacking botnet that infected Dutch consumer devices, including its motives, consequences, affected parties and EU legislative remedies. The government answered that the botnet was untargeted, that no critical infrastructure or state secrets are known to have been affected, that NCSC and DTC issued general advice, and that the Cyber Resilience Act would strengthen device security.
As far as is known, the infected systems in the Netherlands were not part of the central government or vital infrastructure.
Voor zover bekend waren de in Nederland besmette systemen geen onderdeel van de Rijksoverheid of vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Mutluer, Michon-Derkzen, Van Nispen en Aardema over het bericht ‘Politiehack van 62.000 medewerkers is gevaarlijk: naam agent is handelswaar’

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police data breach exposing contact details of about 62,000 officers, including timing of notification, risks to officers and families, and safeguards against similar leaks. The minister answered that work contact details and occasionally private contact details were exposed, that a pass-the-cookie attack by likely state actors was used, that notification was delayed in part, and that measures are being taken but investigations are ongoing and the wider lessons for government systems are limited.
In the interest of the ongoing investigations, I cannot say anything about that.
In het belang van de lopende onderzoeken kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

Three D66 MPs asked the government about reports of systematic Russian espionage and sabotage preparation in the North Sea, including legal options, coordination, protection measures, AIS switch-offs and oversight. The government answered that the threat is current, cited new protection measures and international cooperation, but declined to share intelligence assessments, case numbers or diplomatic communications.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of the MIVD and AIVD.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD) en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van der Werf over gaten in de beveiliging van defensiecomplexen

MPs Van Kent and Van der Werf asked about security gaps at defence sites, including turnstiles that allowed intruders to slip onto bases, and what has been done about them. The State Secretary answered that emergency measures were in place before the broadcast, a permanent fix by the supplier would be complete by year end, and that the most sensitive assets are protected by stricter tiers, while withholding details of those measures as highly classified.
The supplier of the turnstiles was also immediately instructed to develop a lasting solution so that intrusion in this way is no longer possible.
Ook is direct aan de leverancier van de tourniquets opdracht gegeven een duurzame oplossing te ontwikkelen zodat insluipen op deze manier niet meer mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MPs Rooderkerk and Van der Werf asked whether misogyny should be treated as ideological extremism after a UK announcement, whether there are links to far-right ideology and violence against women, and whether security services monitor it. The government answered that misogyny is not classed as an extremist ideology by itself but appears in extremist narratives, that the NCTV will consult the UK, and that the AIVD cannot publicly detail how it investigates threats.
As stated in the answer to question 9, the AIVD cannot, under the Wiv 2017, publicly disclose how it investigates threats to national security.

Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 9 kan de AIVD, op basis van de Wiv 2017, geen uitspraken in het openbaar doen op welke wijze onderzoek wordt gedaan naar dreigingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over de verontreiniging met PFAS op Vliegbasis Gilze-Rijen en elf andere defensieterreinen

MPs Van der Werf and Bamenga asked ministers about severe PFAS contamination at Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites, including whether soil norms are exceeded, why 2019-2020 measurements were not published earlier, what remediation and prevention steps are planned, and whether health risks exist. The government answers that the contamination is known to the competent authority, that a risk-based remediation plan was approved in 2024, that no health risks have been identified so far, and that the Chamber will be kept informed periodically.
Yes, the reporting by Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is known.
Ja, de berichtgeving van Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Werf en Paternotte over het bericht dat producten van in Nederland gevestigde fabrikanten nog steeds worden aangetroffen in Russische wapens

MPs Boswijk, Van der Werf and Paternotte asked the government about reports that microchips from Dutch manufacturers such as NXP and Nexperia still appear in Russian weapons, and how this can happen despite sanctions. The minister confirms the scale of the problem, explains that diversion occurs through intermediaries in third countries, and outlines EU sanctions measures and Dutch enforcement efforts while withholding recent trade data for sensitivity reasons.
Because of the sensitivity, the cabinet makes no public statements about its current information position on Russian imports of sanctioned goods.
Omwille van de gevoeligheid doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de huidige informatiepositie rondom Russische import van gesanctioneerde goederen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over het eindrapport van de Commissie Schneiders, de overdracht van het dossier aan de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en de opvolging v

MPs asked whether the Schneiders Commission should continue monitoring implementation of its 20 recommendations on the Landelijke Eenheid, given union and works council concerns that the transition is unfinished and that oversight passes to the Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid. The Minister replied that oversight rests with the police leadership through an internal monitoring process, with Schneiders staying on as adviser and the Inspectie checking quality of task performance, and that no extension of the commission is planned.
Oversight of and direction for implementing the recommendations is the responsibility of the police leadership and, by extension, the leadership of the national units.
Toezicht op en sturing geven aan de opvolging van de gedane aanbevelingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de korpsleiding en in het verlengde daarvan de leidingen van de landelijke eenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het falend arrestantenvervoer in de Achterhoek

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the failing prisoner transport service in the Achterhoek, the closure of the Doetinchem detention complex, police capacity shortfalls in Oost-Nederland, and a fair police staffing allocation key. The minister replied that the transport service was of limited added value, was being dissolved with its staff redirected to local police teams, that a new staffing allocation system is being developed with results expected at year-end, and that police capacity is under pressure nationwide.
The local authority, on the police's proposal, decided to dissolve the prisoner transport service.
Het lokale gezag heeft op voorstel van de politie daarop besloten om de vervoersdienst voor arrestanten op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Werf over een fiscaal neutraal pensioenkader in de tweede en derde pijler

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why pension saving in the second and third pillars is treated differently for the earned income tax credit and other rules, and whether this should be removed for a work-form-neutral pension framework. The State Secretary confirms the differences (e.g. the earned income definition, the company car, high-low pensions and bridging payments), acknowledges that harmonising the earned income definition would cost about 110 million euros per year and require major system changes, and leaves the decision on any change to a future Cabinet.
I leave it to a future Cabinet whether such a legislative amendment should take place and how it should be funded.
Ik laat het aan een volgend Kabinet of een dergelijke wetswijziging plaats dient te vinden en hoe deze gedekt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Sahla over weren van drugscriminelen uit het zorgdomein

MPs Sneller, Van der Werf and Sahla asked whether drug criminals who own care and staffing agencies (e.g. Ultracare, supplying youth care in Friesland) can be kept out of the care sector, and about Bibob screening and oversight by Justis. The Minister acknowledges the risk, reports that about 5,750 care providers nationwide are owned by persons with convictions, says individual cases cannot be discussed, and points to ongoing Bibob reforms, a planned evaluation from early 2024 and talks with RIEC's and VNG on stronger anti-fraud action.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het toenemend wantrouwen in de overheid onder jongeren

An MP asks several ministers about growing distrust of government among young people, its link to conspiracy theories and anti-institutional extremism, and how prevention of polarisation and radicalisation is organised. The Minister answers that youth distrust is a concern, outlines existing prevention efforts and coordination between ministries, and announces ongoing work such as a new training on anti-institutional extremism.
It is part of a healthy democracy that people can voice criticism of the government.
Het hoort bij een gezonde democratie dat mensen kritiek kunnen uiten op de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Warmerdam en Van der Werf over het NOS artikel 'Met steun van Nederland wankelt nieuwe EU-wet voor vrouwenrechten'

MPs Warmerdam and Van der Werf asked the government whether the Netherlands opposed parts of the EU directive on violence against women, including the rape harmonisation article, and why. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports the directive overall, opposed article 5 on rape harmonisation on legal-basis grounds following the Council Legal Service advice, and that the Dutch Wet seksuele misdrijven offers broader protection.
To protect the confidentiality of the negotiations, it is not customary to go into the individual positions of other member states in the negotiations.
Om de vertrouwelijkheid van de onderhandelingen te beschermen is het niet gebruikelijk om in te gaan op de individuele posities van andere lidstaten in de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Der Werf over het bericht ‘integriteit is bij de politie geen prioriteit, blijkt uit onderzoek’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how she views research suggesting integrity has low priority within the police and how this relates to recent integrity violations. The minister answered that integrity is a core value, describes existing instruments and recent measures such as the new screening act and an integrity portfolio holder, but gave only general responses without committing to new concrete steps.
Integrity is one of the four core values of the police and the police leadership takes various measures to promote an ethical work climate.
Integriteit is één van de vier kernwaarden van de politie en de korpsleiding neemt diverse maatregelen ter bevordering van een ethisch werkklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het persbericht van het Openbaar Ministerie ‘Nieuw college, nieuwe accenten‘

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's announcement that it will focus less on crime prevention, asking about its reasons, effects on prevention programmes, and the coalition agreement. The minister said the OM remains committed to prevention, that the shift is about focusing on core enforcement and faster case handling, and that the coalition agreement commitments will be implemented.
The OM has assured me that the agreements made in the context of the Coalition Agreement are simply being implemented.
Het OM heeft mij verzekerd dat de afspraken die in het kader van het Coalitieakkoord zijn gemaakt gewoon worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de petitie van Yezidi-vrouwen

MPs Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg (D66) asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about justice and support for the Yezidi community, including aid in camps, missing Yezidis, evidence gathering with UNITAD, a Joint Investigation Team and the petition by Yezidi women. The government answered that it funds psychosocial aid, the Yezidi Survivors Law implementation and UNITAD, that it cannot verify figures or conditions in Al Hol, and that cooperation agreements and expertise contributions are still being explored.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine how many Yezidis are staying in the Al Hol camp.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoeveel Yezidi’s verblijven in kamp Al Hol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Wuite over het niet tenuitvoerleggen van gevangenisstraffen op Sint Maarten

Dutch MPs asked why at least 136 convicted persons on Sint Maarten were not serving prison sentences due to lack of detention capacity, and about the effects on rule of law, investment imbalance and a new prison. The government answered that prison administration is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, outlined Dutch funding and the UNOPS new-prison project (target 2028), and described temporary transfers of detainees to the Netherlands while declining to give the size of the shortage.
Prison administration is a matter for the constituent country.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Mutluer over ‘Het schrijnende tekort aan forensisch artsen’

MPs asked the ministers about the severe shortage of forensic doctors, including how often shifts went unfilled, whether child abuse evidence was lost, and what structural solutions exist. The government reported recurring unfilled shifts in some regions, no known cases of lost child-abuse evidence, a temporary arrangement through 2023 with a sustainable solution still being developed, and that more funding is still being sought.
This despite many forensic doctors already working more shifts than desired.
Dit ondanks dat veel forensisch artsen al meer diensten draaien dan gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat er Chinese politiebureaus in Nederland zijn

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about reports of Chinese 'overseas police service stations' in the Netherlands, including their financing, legality, and protection of the Chinese diaspora. The minister answered that the stations were closed after the Chinese ambassador was summoned, that the financing and activities were still under investigation, and that the investigation results would be shared with the House if necessary.
When the investigation is concluded, the House will be informed about it (if necessary confidentially).
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond zal de Kamer hierover (indien noodzakelijk vertrouwelijk) worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het verbieden van deepfake pornografie

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about banning deepfake pornography, including whether misuse of identity falls under criminal law and what measures are taken. The minister acknowledged the harm, said the law already covers making and distributing such material, and deferred the policy response on enforcement and a WODC recommendation to a later reaction, while noting platform takedown arrangements and a forthcoming letter on provider liability.
The cabinet response to the WODC report on regulating deepfakes will further address the criminal liability and criminal-law approach to deepfake sexual imagery.
In de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van het WODC over de regulering van deepfakes zal nader worden ingegaan op de strafbaarheid en strafrechtelijke aanpak van deepfake seksueel beeldmateriaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over de internationale aanpak van georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit en criminele geldstromen

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the international approach to organised drug crime and criminal money flows, including Dutch-Belgian cooperation, joint investigation teams, liaison officers, cannabis legalisation, and tackling criminal finances such as non-conviction based confiscation. The Minister answered in detail that cooperation is being intensified through existing structures and instruments, that the approach to criminal money flows is a priority, and that a bill on non-conviction based confiscation is in preparation, while declining to set up a new joint police and customs centre and to commit to cannabis legalisation at EU level.
I therefore see the criminal business model as an essential starting point for tackling organised crime.
Het crimineel verdienmodel zie ik dan ook als een essentieel aanknopingspunt voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over onthechtingsproblematiek bij uit Syrië teruggekeerde kinderen

An MP asked the government about the attachment problems of children returning from Syria who are separated from their mothers on arrival, citing a report on integration risks. The minister answered that separation is necessary for security given terrorism suspicions, describes the child protection observation, foster placement and limited mother-child contact arrangements, and says maintaining contact is the starting point within security limits.
The cabinet regards the children as victims who are not responsible for the actions of their parents.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen als slachtoffers, die niet verantwoordelijk zijn voor het handelen van hun ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de gevaren die boeren op snelwegen veroorzaken

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about dangers caused by farmers blocking motorways during a June 2022 protest and why police did not enforce more strictly, including how many fines and arrests occurred. The minister acknowledged accidents and dangers, explained police discretion and that offences are pursued afterwards, reported roughly 700 extra fines and over a hundred arrests, and set out advisory principles for local authorities, while admitting Rijkswaterstaat and police do not track the number of tractors or drivers involved.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have a system in place to collect that information.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft namelijk geen systeem waarmee die informatie wordt verzameld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bikker over de situatie van Nederlandse kinderen in Syrische kampen

Two MPs asked the government about the situation of Dutch children in Syrian Kurdish camps, including their numbers, access to education, radicalisation prevention and repatriation. The government answered that about 60 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that the Netherlands supports humanitarian aid without direct control over services, and that repatriated children are placed in youth care facilities.
I cannot make statements about individual cases, the numbers per camp and the ages.
Over individuele gevallen, de aantallen per kamp en leeftijden kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de oproep om Rusland uit te sluiten van INTERPOL

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government supports calls to exclude Russia from INTERPOL over fears of misuse of its systems against critics. The Minister of Justice and Security confirmed awareness of the calls, explained INTERPOL's corrective measures against Russia's National Central Bureau, and said the Netherlands requested a review, noting that measures were adopted and apply until the next Executive Committee meeting.
The Minister of Justice and Security on 4 March sent a letter asking the Secretary General of INTERPOL to assess the need for corrective measures against the Russian Federation.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heeft op 4 maart jl. per brief de Secretaris Generaal van INTERPOL verzocht de noodzaak tot het opleggen van corrigerende maatregelen ten aanzien van de Russische Federatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Van Ginneken over kindermisbruik

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about child sexual abuse networks, police capacity and psychological support, the removal of abuse imagery online, and legal options under the Digital Services Act. The minister declined to discuss individual prosecutions and operational methods, pointed to existing takedown practices, the planned ATKM oversight authority and EU proposals, and did not commit to new capacity.
Because of operational interests, no further detail is given on specific investigative methods or investigations.
Vanwege het operationeel belang wordt niet nader ingegaan op specifieke opsporingsmethoden of -onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het bericht 'Ombudsman waarschuwt: Als het OM zelf straft, komen slachtofferrechten in het geding' en de brief over positie slachtoffers bij strafbeschikking O

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked about reports that the Public Prosecution Service imposes penal orders (strafbeschikking) even in serious cases where victims want to speak, and about the Ombudsman's warning on victims' rights. The Minister acknowledges that in 4 cases, including one sexual offence, penal orders were used despite the victim wishing to speak, says the OM will re-emphasise the contra-indication and that an evaluation of the new legal aid scheme and a fifth PG study are pending.
In 4 cases it turned out to be so. This involved 1 sexual offence case.
In 4 zaken bleek dat het geval. Het betrof daarbij 1 zedenzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de zorgelijke toestand van INTERPOL

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked ministers about the election of UAE general Al-Raisi as Interpol president, alleged human rights abuse, misuse of red notices and possible measures against Interpol and its members. The ministers answered that Interpol's rules prevent undue country influence, that the election followed the formal procedure, that reforms and corrective measures against misuse are ongoing, and that suspending funds or reconsidering membership is not currently warranted.
I condemn any attempt to misuse Interpol instruments.
Ik keur elke poging tot misbruik van Interpol-instrumenten af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Werf en Van der Plas over het bericht dat er nieuw beleid is voor gezinshereniging waar de Kamer niet over geïnformeerd is

MPs Ceder, Van der Werf and Van der Plas asked whether the IND had quietly changed family reunification rules for unaccompanied minors, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether the change is compatible with EU law. The State Secretary replied that the IND's practice was an interpretation of 'alleenstaand' rather than a policy change, that the change was dropped after an inventory, and that affected cases will be re-examined individually.
Question 10: Are you willing to reverse the introduced policy immediately? If not, why not?
Vraag 10 Bent u bereid om het ingevoerde beleid per direct terug te draaien? Zo nee, waarom niet?
