MPs Maatoug and Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on working while on welfare benefits (bijstand) and the risk of income falling below the welfare level. The Secretary answered that about 40,000 cases a year are affected, that most municipalities are adjusting their practice while some systems are still being changed, and that she is working with VNG, Divosa and the G4 and on the Simpel Switchen project, but declined to adopt a 50% generic income disregard.
Welfare recipients whose benefit has been terminated since the CRvB ruling and who believe the termination was wrongful can turn to their municipality.
Bijstandsgerechtigden van wie de bijstandsuitkering sinds de uitspraak van de CRvB is beëindigd en die het idee hebben dat de beëindiging onterecht is, kunnen zich richten tot hun gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in de pakketbezorging

An MP asked the government about misconduct in parcel delivery, including high complaint volumes, pressure on couriers, subcontracting, enforcement by the labour inspectorate and ACM, and whether directors could be held liable. The state secretary largely defended the market and existing rules, pointed to ongoing inspection and evaluation work, and committed to an evaluation and further information without accepting new sector-specific measures.
It is important that work is carried out in line with the legal framework within which the employment contract falls.
Het is van belang dat conform het wettelijk kader wordt gewerkt waarbinnen de arbeidsovereenkomst valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "de Regeling dienstverlening aan huis"

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the household-services scheme (Regeling dienstverlening aan huis) is limited to private employers, whether large intermediaries use it to cut costs, and what working conditions and measures apply. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is for private households, that employees have fewer entitlements than standard contracts, that intermediaries misusing it would in fact be direct employers, and that alternatives are for a future cabinet to decide.
I consider it undesirable, as previously stated, if companies try to use the household services scheme while there is in fact a direct employment relationship with the company.

Ik vind het, zoals eerder aangegeven, niet wenselijk als bedrijven de Regeling dienstverlening aan huis proberen te gebruiken, terwijl feitelijk sprake is van een directe dienstbetrekking met het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over minder geld voor Texel, Bergen, Castricum, Heerhugowaard, Beemster en Den Helder uit gemeentefonds

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior why Texel, Bergen, Castricum, Heerhugowaard, Beemster and Den Helder lose Municipal Fund money under the revised distribution, citing island costs, working poverty and fears of cuts to housing and schools. The reply refers the MPs to the separate letter answering the committee's questions on the revised Municipal Fund distribution proposal, so the substance is not answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over "ongelijke toeslagen voor studenten met een beperking"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked why students with disabilities still receive less individual study allowance than promised, what steps were taken to get municipalities to pay 300 euro, which municipalities underpay, and whether funding or the Breed Offensief bill should be split to fix this. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the authority and responsibility for setting the allowance, urged them to pay 300 euro from age 21 within current law, said national government lacks municipal-level data, and declined to split the controversial bill or grant extra funds, saying municipalities have sufficient budget.
The national government does not have information on the level of the individual study allowance in individual municipalities.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over informatie over de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag in afzonderlijke gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misleidende praktijken van Multi-level Marketing (MLM)-bedrijven

An MP asked the government about misleading practices of multi-level marketing companies, including unrealistic income promises, medical claims, possible pyramid schemes, bogus self-employment and lack of transparency. The minister answered that MLM is a lawful sales method subject to consumer protection rules enforced by the ACM and NVWA, that existing law suffices and no amendment of the gambling law or new disclosure duties are planned.
I currently see no reason for additional information obligations.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende informatieverplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Gijs van Dijk over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

MPs Sneller and Van Dijk asked the government about the tendering of photography contracts, including the administrative burden on photographers, a bureau-based model, tariffs, market power and legal grounds for the new approach. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the new framework will be published around late October/early November, that the hourly rate will be about 109 euros versus 117 now, and that the earlier multi-supplier framework was dropped partly for legal reasons.
The hourly rate in the new framework agreement will in all likelihood be 109 euros, for every hour a photographer takes photos on location.
Het uurtarief in de nieuwe raamovereenkomst zal naar alle waarschijnlijkheid € 109 bedragen, voor elk uur dat een fotograaf op locatie foto’s neemt.
Antwoord van de leden Kathmann, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over kleinschalige evenementen die niet door kunnen gaan wegens corona

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why restaurants with a terrace permit may not organise small events under the COVID-19 rules, and about the economic harm and possible support. The Minister confirmed the rule (article 4.4 of the Trm) is tied to the epidemiological situation, acknowledged the business impact, said the loss of revenue from events is unclear, and pointed to the TVL support scheme and a planned supplementary scheme for night-time hospitality.
For entrepreneurs in sectors including hospitality who lose more than 30% of their income due to the corona measures, the TVL scheme is open among others.
Voor ondernemers uit onder andere de horeca die meer dan 30% van hun inkomsten missen door de coronamaatregelen staat onder meer de TVL regeling open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het (mogelijke) stopzetten van het National Agriculture Edcuation College

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the possible termination of Dutch funding for the National Agriculture Education College in Kabul, citing its track record, student numbers, and role for women. The minister confirmed the funding would be extended one year instead of ending, but stated that all aid to Afghanistan is now on hold and that the future of the project is uncertain.
The cabinet therefore decided to extend the expiring contract by another year.
Het kabinet heeft hierom besloten het aflopende contract met nog een jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken COVID-19> (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1422 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Schiermonnikoog vreest een blijvend litteken van de windstroomleiding'

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about the proposed wind power cable route under Schiermonnikoog in the Wadden Sea UNESCO area, its ecological risks, and alternatives. The state secretary defended the western route as the preferred option, said the eastern route is constrained, and committed to further research and regional consultation without irreversible steps.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd zet ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de fotografie-aanbesteding Rijksoverheid

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the upcoming central government photography tender, its status, and whether it would keep freelance photographers' rates from being pressured and give them a fairer chance to compete, as the Vos/Mulder motion requested. The Prime Minister answered that the tender is in preparation with a pre-announcement published, that a single agency will select a pool of photographers under a framework with fixed hourly rates, and that the design is intended to respect the motion's intent.
In my judgement, the new design does justice to the spirit of the Vos/Mulder motion.
Met de nieuwe opzet wordt naar mijn oordeel recht gedaan aan de geest van de motie Vos/Mulder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Temper

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Inspectorate SZW treats Temper as a temporary-work agency while the Tax Authority treats it as a client, and whether the Tax Authority's position undermines the Inspectorate and leaves vulnerable workers unprotected. The minister answered that the two bodies have different purposes and methods, that individual cases and inspection reports cannot be disclosed, and that workers can bring civil claims or register-based enforcement remains available.
I cannot make any statements about individual cases and investigations of the Inspectorate SZW.
Over individuele zaken en onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Gijs van Dijk, en Van Kent, over het artikel “Mensen in financiële nood door achterstand bij UWV”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV backlogs in WIA disability claims, forcing people into advance payments they must repay, and about hardship, shortages of insurance physicians and debt recovery rules. The minister answered with figures on advance payments and repayments, explained the causes of delays and the lack of a reimbursable-advance alternative, and committed to further talks with UWV and a letter setting out a solution.
I will engage further with VNG and UWV to assess whether this framework is adequate.
Ik ga nader in gesprek met VNG en UWV om te bezien of dit kader toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over extra steun voor afgelaste festivals en evenementen

Opposition MPs from the PvdA asked the government about financial support for festivals and events cancelled during COVID-19, including gaps in the guarantee scheme, NOW and TVL, and eligibility for non-EU artists. The state secretary answered that support was being extended and a supplementary allowance introduced, but gave no overview of losses and deferred some questions.
There is no overview of the precise losses you ask about.
Er is geen overzicht over de precieze verliezen waar u naar vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over ook extra steun voor toeleveranciers van festivals en evenementen

An MP asked whether suppliers to cancelled festivals, who lack contracts for the guarantee scheme and have hit the TVL subsidy ceiling, can be helped with a higher ceiling or other measures. The State Secretary answered that the TVL ceiling is tied to the EU state aid limit of 1.8 million euro and cannot be raised, and that no additional measures are currently on the table beyond the broadened guarantee scheme.
Raising the TVL subsidy ceiling is not possible due to its dependence on the European state aid limit.
Een verhoging van het subsidieplafond voor de TVL is vanwege de afhankelijkheid van de Europese staatssteungrens niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over grootontvangers betalen onterecht ontvangen loonsteun niet terug

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether large NOW wage-subsidy recipients that paid dividends or bonuses would repay the subsidy, which companies were involved, and whether the ABU staffing association would be urged to make its members repay. The minister answered that the NOW1 dividend and bonus ban applied only at subsidiary level so the requested per-company data is not available, that accountant checks apply to later tranches, and that the government will not recover lawfully granted subsidy or contact companies directly.
The requested data is therefore not available for NOW1.
De gevraagde gegevens zijn derhalve niet beschikbaar voor NOW1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht “miljoenen liters diesel liggen bij de ’groene’ datacenters van Microsoft en Google in Hollands Kroon”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of millions of litres of diesel stored at Microsoft and Google data centres in Hollands Kroon, including who decides on permits, noise and smell nuisance, fire safety information and siting criteria. The minister answered that the competent authority (the province of Noord-Holland and the municipality are disputing this) assesses permits under law, that nuisance and safety are weighed in those permits, and that siting is primarily a matter for decentralised governments under the national environmental vision, without committing to new national siting rules.
I am not the competent authority for permit granting, and therefore I also do not know the substantive specifications of such cases.
Ik ben geen bevoegd gezag voor de vergunningverlening, en ken dus ook de inhoudelijke specificaties van dergelijke gevallen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat werknemers kunnen fluiten naar hun vakantiecenten

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would act to ensure workers receive holiday pay that employers may delay or withhold during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether NOW subsidies and WW benefits are affected. The minister said workers can claim holiday pay through civil courts and the Labour Inspectorate, that delayed payment is possible only by written agreement and cannot become non-payment, and that the WW benefit calculation reserves holiday pay so non-payment does not reduce benefits.
Employees can claim their holiday pay through the civil court if the employer refuses to pay.
Werknemers kunnen bij de burgerlijke rechter hun vakantiebijslag vorderen als de werkgever weigert uit te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Bonden: minister moet cao uitzendsector blokkeren’

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a collective agreement signed by the employers' associations ABU and NBBU with the small union LBV, which he considered a non-independent 'fake union', should be stopped by withholding acknowledgment of receipt, and whether pension waiting-time rules for temporary agency workers should be scrapped by law. The minister answered that he takes no position on the agreement, found no grounds to deny acknowledgment (the agreements entered into force on 1 June), will not reverse them, and that the pension waiting-time reduction is already in the pension bill with sector parties responsible for the timing.
I have no reason to assume that LBV does not meet the requirements set out in the Collective Labour Agreements Act for trade unions that conclude a collective agreement.
Ik heb geen redenen om aan te nemen dat LBV niet aan de vereisten voldoet die in de Wet op de collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst gesteld worden aan vakbonden die een cao afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Ruim 10.000 ontvangers bijstand de dupe van fout bij gemeenten'

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs about bijstand recipients who were underpaid their protected income (beslagvrije voet) because some municipalities report holiday allowance annually rather than monthly, and about remedies and responsibility of bailiffs. The Minister answered that no municipal error was involved, that municipalities raise the protected amount manually, bailiffs recalculate and refund, and that a structural solution and possible simplification are being studied.
There is no question of an error by the municipalities.
Er is geen sprake van een fout van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over de ontbossing van het Amazonegebied door soja-invoer van Nederland

MPs Thijssen and Gijs van Dijk asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch soy imports drive deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon, including whether soy from post-2008 cleared land is imported and whether importers will be held to account. The ministers answered that about 5% of Brazil's soy exports go to the Netherlands, most Dutch-bound soy is covered by sustainability certificates, and the government will push for EU-level measures such as legislation, with a proposal expected in summer 2021.

The cabinet expects companies established in the Netherlands that operate internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van in Nederland gevestigde bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principle's on Business and Human Rights naleven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het artikel 'Tozo-uitkering is halve sigaar uit eigen doos'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the State Secretary of Finance about how child maintenance is treated as income under the Participatiewet and tax law, the legal basis for Belastingdienst tax assessments on Tozo benefits paid to partners, and whether those assessments should be scrapped. The minister defended the current treatment, said the Tozo is a household benefit with a legal basis for the tax assessments, and declined to offer a general solution, citing the lack of a legal basis for waiving the assessments.
There is no legal basis for waiving that levy.
Voor het achterwege laten van die heffing bestaat geen wettelijke basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Bromet, Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een grote aanjager is van wereldwijde ontbossing

MPs asked the ministers whether the Netherlands is a major driver of global deforestation per a WNF report, and about its links to nitrogen, climate, EU trade deals (Mercosur) and import tariffs. The ministers largely contest the report's attribution to the Netherlands, cite certification schemes and EU-level measures, and promise continued EU engagement on deforestation-free supply chains.
The Netherlands faces a major task in reducing nitrogen deposition.
Nederland heeft een stevige opgave om de neerslag van stikstof terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over het bericht “Schip verliest containers bij Ameland”

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of containers from the Baltic Tern near Ameland, including whether the Coast Guard advised against the northern route and whether the government will strengthen intervention powers. The minister answered that containers were recovered, that the Coast Guard does not warn ships from German waters, that 12 of 14 large container ships followed the northern-route advice, and that further steps on IMO measures and intervention powers will be discussed in a progress report.
I have also spoken personally with my German and Danish colleagues.
Ik heb ook zelf met mijn Duitse en Deense collega gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Gronings restaurant met eigen bezorgdienst krijgt minder steun

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether restaurants delivering their own food receive less TVL support than restaurants using delivery platforms, and whether this is unfair. The State Secretary answered that TVL uses gross turnover, that the outcome depends on contract terms and can go either way, that RVO does not track such cases, and that the scheme already moves with each business's turnover loss, so no change is planned.
For the TVL it does not matter whether you use an own or an external delivery service.
Voor de TVL maakt het niet uit of je gebruik maakt van een eigen of een externe bezorgdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de rechtbank opnieuw bevestigt dat Deliveroo-bezorgers gewoon werknemers zijn

An MP asked the minister whether the court ruling confirming Deliveroo couriers are employees would lead to enforcement against platform companies, and how the Tax Authority would act. The minister answered that the ruling is civil, workers can claim employment contracts, a legal presumption for platform workers is being prepared, and the Tax Authority assesses cases individually and cannot disclose information about individual taxpayers.
The Tax Authority does not make statements about individual taxpayers on the basis of its duty of confidentiality (article 67 of the General State Taxes Act).
De Belastingdienst doet over individuele belastingplichtigen geen uitspraak op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Nederlandse zonnepanelen gebouwd door Oeigoerse dwangarbeiders'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Dutch solar panels were made with forced Uyghur labour, including whether public procurement and the solar sector's supply chains are adequately checked. The government says it lacks independent verification, points to existing due diligence and procurement measures and planned revisions, and rules out a temporary suspension of solar panel sales as disproportionate.
It must be stated at the outset that the cabinet does not have data on the extent to which the panels used in the Netherlands contain polysilicon processed in Xinjiang.
Vooropgesteld staat dat het kabinet niet over gegevens beschikt in hoeverre de in Nederland gebruikte panelen polysilicium uit Xinjiang is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in de kledingindustrie

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the expiring binding Bangladesh Accord, fatal factory incidents in Morocco and Egypt, supply-chain responsibility, transparency and mandatory due diligence legislation. The Minister answers that the government is not a party to the Accord negotiations, supports a binding successor agreement and due diligence rules at EU level, but does not plan separate import transparency legislation.
The Netherlands is working to increase awareness among Dutch companies of risks in the garment industry and their responsibility in this regard.
Nederland spant zich in om het bewustzijn onder Nederlandse bedrijven op risico's in de kledingindustrie en hun verantwoordelijkheid daarbij te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de provincie ingrijpt bij een datacenter in Middenmeer (Hollands Kroon)

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the dispute between the province of Noord-Holland and the municipality of Hollands Kroon over competence for data centre permits, and the wider sprawl of large warehouses and data centres, should prompt national rules or intervention. The minister answered that the province and municipality are in consultation, that the provincial executive considers itself competent, that spatial choices lie primarily with municipalities, and that further national rules are not currently on the table, with a first step being to develop and monitor siting policy with other authorities.
It is always preferable that governments reach a shared view through good mutual consultation.
Het heeft altijd de voorkeur dat overheden in goed onderling overleg tot een gezamenlijk inzicht komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Pensioenfonds Levensmiddelen wil af van dreigende korting'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a planned pension cut at the Levensmiddelen sector pension fund for supermarket workers, arguing it is hard to justify alongside corporate profits, executive bonuses and state aid. The minister answered that the cut is about 0.85% per year, that the fund's own estimate puts most retirees at about 2 euro per month or less, that the 90% coverage floor under the temporary exemption is a limit he will not loosen, and that a specific fund exemption would need DNB review.
I consider it undesirable to amend the exemption scheme I published at the end of last year.
Ik vind het onwenselijk de vrijstellingsregeling die ik eind vorig jaar heb gepubliceerd aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Datacenters brengen levering drinkwater Noord-Holland in gevaar’.

An MP asked the minister whether data centres using drinking water for cooling endanger water supply and pollute water in North Holland, and whether an environmental impact assessment should be required for them. The minister replied that the share of drinking water used for cooling is small (0.6%), that the regional water board regulates discharges with permit limits, and that existing environmental assessment rules are sufficient without amendment.
Regarding the discharge of chemicals by data centres, I currently see no reason for additional research.
Voor wat betreft de lozing van chemicaliën door datacenters, zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor extra onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over door NOW gratis overwerken

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers may force workers to make up hours lost to COVID closures, whether this is permitted, whether the Labour Inspectorate will act, and whether NOW wage subsidies should be tightened retroactively. The minister replied that employers bear the wage risk and generally cannot compel make-up hours unless a collective agreement provides otherwise, that enforcement is for social partners or courts, and that tightening NOW retroactively is neither possible nor desirable.
It is not possible and not desirable to tighten the scheme on this point with retroactive effect.
Het is niet mogelijk en niet wenselijk om de regeling op dit punt met terugwerkende kracht aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Union busting in de polder’

An MP from the Labour party asked the minister whether unilateral 2.5 percent wage increases agreed among supermarket employers, bypassing unions and stalled collective agreements, conflict with ILO conventions and competition law. The minister answered that wage-setting is for social partners under freedom of contract, that ILO oversight and court review are the relevant avenues, and that the competition authority ACM has started an exploratory investigation whose outcome it will await.
I am not aware to what extent the supermarket employers or employer organisations concerned agreed on this among themselves.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeverre de betreffende supermarktwerkgevers dan wel werkgeversorganisaties daar onderling afspraken over hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Tozo-uitkering is halve sigaar uit eigen doos'

An MP asks whether the Tozo self-employment benefit, by counting toward a partner's income, forces families to repay tax credits and loonheffing and whether child maintenance should be excluded. The Minister replies that partner income was not counted in Tozo 1 for speed, that repayments are limited to the partner's share, that the Tozo is calculated under the Participatiewet and no changes are planned.
I therefore see no reason to change this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over sociale ondernemingen die niet alle coronasteun ontvangen

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether social enterprises such as De Oude Keuken, which may have an incorrect SBI code, are excluded from COVID support and whether extra aid will be given. The State Secretary replied that TVL support is now open to all sectors regardless of SBI code, that the HVA surcharge applies only to SBI code 56, and that businesses can appeal to RVO.nl, while noting ongoing consultation with Social Enterprise Nederland.
From the fourth quarter of 2020, all sectors can use the TVL (except financial institutions) regardless of the SBI code.
Vanaf het vierde kwartaal 2020 kunnen alle sectoren gebruik maken van de TVL (met uitzondering van de financiële instellingen) ongeacht de SBI-code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de gewijzigde vliegroute van straaljagers boven Vliehors

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the changed fighter-jet flight route over the Vliehors range, the legal challenge by Texel organisations, consultation of Texel municipality, noise impact, and whether the Wadden area is being designated a NATO exercise area. The government answered that the change responds to a 2013 safety incident, noise stays within permit limits, Texel's alternative route was rejected for safety reasons, and the court ruling is pending.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de steunmaatregelen voor schoonheidsspecialisten

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will give extra COVID support to beauty specialists, many of whom face bankruptcy, and whether the partner test in the Tozo excludes self-employed beauticians from aid, and asked to meet their trade body Anbos. The government replied that the sector benefits from the TVL and NOW expansions, that self-employed beauticians may apply for Tozo, that the new TONK may help those excluded by the partner test, and that it is willing to talk with Anbos.
I am of course willing to talk with Anbos about the support and recovery package and the specific situation of beauty specialists within it.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om met de Anbos in gesprek te gaan over het steun- en herstelpakket en de specifieke situatie van de schoonheidsspecialisten daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers in Groningen en Fryslân die knel komen te zitten

MPs Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked whether start-up businesses hit by COVID-19 measures, such as hairdressers and hospitality firms without a reference turnover, are adequately compensated and whether the schemes could be changed. The State Secretary replied that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover start-ups' fixed costs, that monthly turnover calculations are not feasible, and that fully closed sectors get up to 85% fixed-cost subsidy.
With the new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme, the cabinet wants to give these entrepreneurs a reasonable subsidy for their fixed costs.
Met de nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters wil het kabinet deze ondernemers een redelijke subsidie bieden voor hun vaste lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over opslag van nucleair afval net over de grens

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would raise with Germany the concerns of residents near the border about possible nuclear waste storage in salt caverns in Emsland, and how Dutch citizens and authorities can take part in German siting decisions. The state secretary answered that Germany has no concrete plans yet, that Dutch citizens would be informed and have participation rights under the Espoo Convention if a border-near site is considered, and that a Rathenau-led participatory process is underway in the Netherlands.
I consider it important that Dutch citizens also have a say in decision-making on a German final repository if it were to be located near the Dutch border.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook Nederlandse burgers inspraak hebben bij besluitvorming over een Duitse eindberging als die in de buurt van de grens met Nederland zou komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over extra (financiële) steun voor de Waddeneilanden

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would provide extra financial support for the Wadden islands, including after the rejection of their regional deal and the impact of COVID-19 on tourism. The Minister answered that existing corona compensation and support schemes apply, that no additional islands-specific measures or funds are planned, and that no budget remains for new Regio Deals this cabinet period.
The cabinet currently sees no reason to take specific additional measures for the Wadden islands on top of this package.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding om bovenop dit pakket specifiek voor de Waddeneilanden extra maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Renkema over het bericht dat een vrouw 7.000 euro plus een boete moet terugbetalen omdat zij boodschappen kreeg van haar moeder

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Renkema asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a case where a woman on welfare was ordered to repay 7,000 euro plus a fine after receiving groceries from her mother, and about related rules on gifts, recovery and sanctions. The minister acknowledged concerns about hardship and promised general frameworks on gifts and talks with municipalities, but declined to comment on the individual case and gave no figures on frequency or on municipal use of discretion.
No figures are available on that.
Daar zijn geen cijfers over beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over beslaglegging op compensatie door de Belastingdienst

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether debt-relief trustees can seize compensation paid to childcare-benefit scandal victims after a WSNP debt-rescheduling period ends, and whether a seizure ban will be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged the undesirable effect, said talks with public and private creditors are ongoing, committed to public creditors waiving claims, and promised certificates clearing victims of past fraud or intent labels.
That is why I am in talks with creditors and other parties to reach a solution that does justice to the various interests.
Daarom ben ik in gesprek met schuldeisers en betrokken partijen om te komen tot een oplossing die recht doet aan de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over payrollbedrijven die misbruik maken van de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging voor Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the minister whether payroll firms are abusing the NOW wage-subsidy scheme despite revenue losses unrelated to COVID-19, and whether the state will recover such funds. The minister answered that firms qualify with 20% revenue loss versus 2019 without needing to prove COVID causation, that no distinction by firm type is possible, that unlawful subsidies would be recovered, and that the ABU was urged to remind members of responsible use, but declined to rule out further checks or answer within a week.
Such a distinction cannot be made within the NOW applications.
Dergelijk onderscheid kan niet worden gemaakt binnen de aanvragen voor NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Ondanks 55,8 miljoen aan staatssteun toch gedwongen ontslagen bij Holland Casino'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Holland Casino, state-owned and receiving NOW wage subsidies, should avoid forced layoffs, guarantee work for dismissed staff, and how it would be helped back to work. The minister replied that the NOW scheme discourages layoffs, that NOW-3 imposes a best-efforts obligation on employers to help staff find new work without a job guarantee, and that existing mobility measures and temporary corona jobs are available.
Because of the broader possibilities to reduce the wage bill, NOW-3 contains an obligation of effort for employers to actively work on move-to-work guidance.
Vanwege de ruimere mogelijkheden om de loonsom te laten dalen, zit in de NOW-3 een inspanningsverplichting voor werkgevers om zich actief in te zetten voor van werk naar werk begeleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV schendt privacy cliënten‘

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV's SONAR system exposes clients' personal data, including former clients, to many officials and about possible unauthorised access. The minister acknowledged the privacy and information-security shortcomings, said logging does not allow unauthorised access to be ruled out, and committed to deleting data of clients inactive for five years or more in Q1 2021, improving logging and monitoring, and phased replacement of SONAR.
Due to the technically limited logging and monitoring of the SONAR system, it cannot be determined which employees viewed which data at what time.
Door de technisch beperkte logging en monitoring op het systeem SONAR, kan niet achterhaald worden welke medewerkers op welk moment welke gegevens hebben ingezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het onbereikbaar maken van Nederlanderschap

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why raising the naturalisation language requirement to B1 would make citizenship unreachable for many newcomers, including low-literate refugees, and what the consequences would be for voting rights and daily life. The State Secretary defended the B1 requirement as the crown on successful integration, pointed to the Z-route and the option procedure, and said the draft naturalisation test decree was still under review after consultation.
The coalition agreement states that the language requirement for both integration and naturalisation will be raised to B1 of the Common European Framework.
In het regeerakkoord is opgenomen dat zowel voor inburgering als voor naturalisatie de taaleis wordt verhoogd naar B1 van het Referentiekader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over bezuinigingen op kinderen in armoede

An MP from the PvdA asks the state secretary about reported cuts in municipal child-poverty budgets, including Súdwest-Fryslân's proposed €100,000 reduction, and about the government's response to rising poverty forecasts. The government points to existing national funding, the evaluation of municipal spending, and passes municipal matters to the VNG and municipal councils, without committing to new funds beyond those already announced.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to request accountability from individual municipalities for how they spend the funds.
Het past het kabinet niet om verantwoording te vragen van individuele gemeenten over de besteding van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatiearmoede in Nederland

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government whether it would provide free menstrual products in public places and follow Scotland's example to tackle period poverty. The state secretary answered that most women do not face cost problems, pointed to general poverty measures and local municipal responsibility, and declined to introduce free provision.
I do not share that view. Circumstances and needs of women differ, but for most women the cost of menstrual products is not a problem.
Die mening deel ik niet. Omstandigheden en behoeften van vrouwen verschillen, maar voor de meeste vrouwen vormen de kosten van menstruatieproducten geen probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Stel je voor dat je op kantoor werkt, eet én slaapt: dat is wat een chauffeur door corona elke dag moet doen'

MPs Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that truck drivers, due to COVID restrictions, cannot get a warm meal or proper sanitary facilities and must live in their cabs. The minister said extended cab stays are undesirable, rejected reopening roadside restaurants for drivers as unwise now, and pointed to ongoing dialogue with the petition initiators and unions and to campaigns on sanitation.
As I indicated above, relaxing the rules by opening roadside restaurants to professional drivers is currently not sensible.
Zoals ik hierboven aangeef, is een versoepeling in de vorm van het openstellen van wegrestaurants voor beroepschauffeurs momenteel niet verstandig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Stoffer en Van Raan over stikstofberekeningen

MPs asked the minister about a 2014 review by Arcadis and NLR of nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport, including the review's findings, its commissioning, and the NLR role, with documents to be shared within a week. The minister answered that the concept memo was attached, that flagged points were corrected in a June 2014 addendum, that the commissioning contract is withheld as commercially confidential, and that new project-specific assessments will be done with updated models.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over opnieuw containers in de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported container losses from the Munich Maersk into the Wadden Sea, including cargo, the shipping company's disclosure to the coastguard, and warnings to fishers and island mayors. The minister answered that the Dutch and German coastguards were informed, the German coastguard found no containers, the shipper reported no losses, and a warning to mariners was issued, while declining to say what the ship was carrying because it did not sail in Dutch waters.
Since the ship did not sail in Dutch waters, I have no information about the cargo loading of the ship.
Aangezien het schip niet in Nederlandse wateren heeft gevaren, heb ik geen informatie over de belading van het schip.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over geweld en agressie tegenover arbeidsmigranten en vakbondsmedewerkers

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a violent assault on a FNV union employee at a bungalow park housing migrant workers, whether the incident would be investigated, and how union and inspection access to such housing can be guaranteed. The minister condemned the violence, said the police handle the criminal complaint, stated that the Labour Inspectorate has access to migrant housing and can be threatened or refused access in isolated cases, and pointed to ongoing government programmes on migrant worker protection.
I cannot comment on this specific case. It is up to the police to investigate this matter following the complaint of assault.
Over dit specifieke geval kan ik geen uitspraken doen. Het is aan de politie om deze zaak, naar aanleiding van de aangifte van mishandeling, te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over het bericht 'Misstanden bij koeriers zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering'

MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about reports of widespread abuses at parcel and courier firms, including WW recipients working as couriers, workers without valid residence papers and sham constructions, and how these can persist. The minister acknowledged the serious findings from Inspectie SZW, described its sector programme and enforcement, and said the Inspectorate will confront major clients and evaluate in 2022 whether further measures are needed.
I attach great importance to fair, healthy and safe work for all employees.
Ik hecht groot belang aan eerlijk, gezond en veilig werk voor alle werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de overstap naar de Wajong 2010

An MP asked why the deadline for switching from the old Wajong to Wajong 2010 was set at 30 November 2020, what benefits switching offers, when people were informed, and how the old and new regimes differ, including the obligation to accept suitable work. The State Secretary explained that switching can raise benefits for some working people, that UWV informed beneficiaries and stakeholders in September and October and accepted applications until 30 November, and that the general suitable-work obligation in Wajong 2010 lapses from 1 January 2021 and may become part of re-integration agreements.
UWV, in consultation with me and following the client consultation by LCR, decided to process applications for switching submitted until 30 November 2020.
UWV heeft in overleg met mij, naar aanleiding van de cliëntentoets van LCR besloten om aanvragen voor overstap ingediend tot 30 november 2020 in behandeling te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Gijs van Dijk en Ploumen over het recente onderzoek van het College voor de Rechten van de mens over zwangerschapsdiscriminatie

Two PvdA MPs asked the government how it will respond to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens study finding that 43% of working women who gave birth 2016-2019 experienced pregnancy discrimination, and what enforcement, sanctions and reporting measures it will take. The State Secretary answers that a Labour Market Discrimination Action Plan, a bill giving the Inspectie SZW enforcement powers over recruitment, awareness campaigns and a planned meeting with stakeholders are underway, but gives no figures on fines issued and does not commit to new binding measures.
I consider it very important that women are aware that they can turn to someone if they suspect discrimination and that they can proceed to report it.
Ik acht het van groot belang aan dat vrouwen zich ervan bewust zijn dat zij bij een vermoeden van discriminatie ergens terecht kunnen en dat zij over kunnen gaan tot melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'FrieslandCampina schrapt duizend banen vanwege coronacrisis. Mogelijk ontslagen op locaties Bedum, Marum en Noordwijk'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that FrieslandCampina may cut 1,000 jobs during the coronavirus crisis, including possible dismissals, and asked about NOW support, rapid job placement, retraining and budget. The minister replied that FrieslandCampina does not appear in the NOW registers, that the company hopes to absorb job losses through attrition and redeployment though forced dismissals cannot be excluded, and listed existing reemployment, retraining and mobility-team measures and budgets.
To answer this question I checked the public registers of NOW recipients.
Voor het beantwoorden van deze vraag heb ik de openbare registers met NOW-ontvangers bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over onderbetaling bij de RVO

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether USG Legal's contracting arrangement with RVO amounts to unlawful temporary labour hire under the WAADI, whether workers should receive equal pay, why RVO refused to share pay data, and whether other agencies are affected. The minister answered that contracting is legitimate, that the Inspectorate found the pay-ratio norm was breached but courts must decide civil claims, and that departments are themselves responsible for their contracting, with the matter raised with colleagues.
It is up to the court to judge whether the pay-ratio norm was in fact complied with.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen of er feitelijk al dan niet sprake was van naleving van de loonverhoudingsnorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over onderbetaling bij de RVO

MPs Van Dijk and Moorlag asked why externally hired staff at RVO, via detacher USG Legal, receive lower pay than colleagues doing the same work, and what the government will do about it. The minister says RVO is not the formal employer, the contractor's own terms apply under a results-based contract, the Inspectie SZW found the wage-ratio norm was breached, and that the government will respond to the advisory team's recommendations on temporary work agencies.
However, article 27 of the General Government Terms for Services (ARVODI), which apply to the framework agreement, provides that the staffing agencies as formal employers must act as good employers.

Wel is in artikel 27 van de Algemene Rijksvoorwaarden voor Diensten (ARVODI) die van toepassing zijn op de raamovereenkomst bepaald dat de detacheringsbureaus als de formele werkgevers zich als goed werkgever gedragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht het bericht 'Provincie vreest subsidie kwijt te raken'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Gelderland risks losing an EU subsidy for hydrogen buses due to ministry delays and whether the DKTI 3 scheme will open in time. The state secretary said the provinces withdrew earlier, the DKTI 3 scheme is planned to open in January 2021 with a budget of EUR 36.62 million, and Gelderland can apply on the same terms as other parties.
Opening of DKTI 3 is, after processing the responses to the internet consultation closed on 5 November, planned for January 2021.
Openstelling van de DKTI 3 is, na verwerking van de reacties op de internetconsultatie die op 5 november is gesloten, voorzien in januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht '181.000 banen weg bij bedrijven die coronasteun kregen'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about job losses at firms that received NOW corona wage subsidies, the adequacy of the NOW1 and TOFA schemes for flex workers, and whether the sector is being checked for misuse. The minister defends the design of the schemes, reports UWV figures on terminated employment relationships and dismissal requests, says no fines have yet been imposed, and declines a separate investigation into the temp-agency sector.
That is more than one in three workers in the Netherlands.
Dat is meer dan één op de drie werkenden in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over "tempo maken bij aanpak jeugdwerkloosheid"

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the slow pace of tackling youth unemployment during the coronavirus crisis, including stages, apprenticeships, municipal job-search waiting periods and youth organisations' involvement. The minister answered that extra funds and regional approaches are in place, that the four-week waiting period is relaxed and extended to July 2021 with exemptions, and that municipalities have discretion over individual cases.
No information is available on that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over 1 miljoen verzakkende huizen door bodemdaling

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and of Infrastructure about the risk that up to a million homes sink due to land subsidence, the costs, who bears them, and what policy exists. The government answered that owners bear foundation repair costs, that municipalities and water boards manage groundwater with limited ability to prevent further sinking, and listed existing funding and support programmes without committing to new measures.
Enquiries with the provincial, water board and municipal associations show that it is not possible to provide this overview in full detail within the set deadline.
Uit navraag bij de koepels van provincies, waterschappen en gemeenten blijkt dat het niet mogelijk is om dit overzicht op de gestelde termijn «en detail» te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de voorzieningen voor beroepschauffeurs

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the closure of road-side restaurant kitchens during the COVID-19 measures had been weighed against the impact on professional truck drivers, who may lack hot meals and toilets. The minister answered that takeaway service is an exception to the closure, that restaurants and fuel stations are urged to keep sanitary facilities open, and that the ministry is in contact with the sector and will act on any signals.
I am keeping a close eye on the goods transport sector, so that action can be taken if there are signals that drivers can no longer carry out their work responsibly.
Ik houd een vinger aan de pols bij de goederenvervoersector, om actie te kunnen ondernemen bij eventuele signalen dat chauffeurs hun werk niet meer op een verantwoorde manier kunnen uitvoeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over “verbod op blootstellen jongeren aan coronavirus".

An MP asked whether SARS-CoV-2 falls under biological agent category 3 and whether Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit article 4.105 bars minors from exposure, asking about protections for young delivery and supermarket workers and inspectorate enforcement. The state secretary confirmed category 3 and the minors' prohibition applies to work specifically involving the agent, said general duty of care covers other jobs, and described the Inspectorate's existing powers and a temporary Arbowet change allowing work to be halted.
The Labour Inspectorate supervises this. It does so on a risk-based and programmatic basis.
De Inspectie SZW houdt daar toezicht op. Dit doet zij risicogericht en programmatisch.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over de loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked the government how it responds to the European Committee of Social Rights finding that the Netherlands falls short on closing the gender pay gap, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answers that the ECSR found shortcomings on pay transparency and effective measures, that the gap is narrowing only slowly, points to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, the diversity-in-top measures and a forthcoming study on public-sector pay gaps, and says a certification scheme and other transparency measures are still being studied.

The cabinet will come with a position on the private member's bill this autumn, now that the proposal and the response to the Council of State's advice have been submitted to the House of Representatives.
Het kabinet zal dit najaar met een standpunt komen over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel nu het voorstel en de reactie op het advies van de Raad van State is ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "flexibele premie"

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the minister whether a flexible pension premium proposed by PGGM experts fits the pension agreement, and whether it would ease employer transitions, build support for collective schemes, or lead employers to DC plans. The minister answered that such a flexible premium is permitted within the agreement, is left to decentral social partners, and does not make transitioning easier, while declining to commission new studies.
The PGGM research confirms the long-standing economic theory that any increase in risk-bearing capacity, for example through a flexible premium, makes a positive contribution and raises welfare.

Het PGGM-onderzoek bevestigt de al langer bestaande economische theorie dat iedere vergroting van het risicodraagvlak, bijvoorbeeld door een flexibele premie, hieraan een positieve bijdrage levert en welvaartsverhogend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over geen airco’s in snikhete vrachtwagencabines

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether it is acceptable that truck drivers must sleep in extremely hot cabins without air conditioning, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the problem but says air conditioning is primarily a matter for employers and employees, points to an energy investment deduction and to ILT enforcement of rest-time rules, and does not commit to new measures.
It is up to the employer to ensure that drivers can rest under the right conditions.
Het is aan de werkgever om ervoor te zorgen dat chauffeurs onder de juiste omstandigheden kunnen rusten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over merendeel werknemers ervaart discriminatie

An MP from the Labour party asked the state secretary about widespread discrimination in hiring and at work, the pace of the anti-discrimination bill and action plan, a pilot on anonymous applications, and enforcement by the labour inspectorate against discriminating employers and temp agencies. The state secretary acknowledged discrimination persists, said the bill is with the Council of State and will be submitted this autumn, admitted the anonymous-application pilot cannot run this year, declined a licensing requirement for temp agencies, and said the inspectorate had only carried out exploratory inspections without fines so far.
I am convinced that when it is implemented we can take important steps in combating labour market discrimination.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat we bij implementatie ervan belangrijke stappen kunnen zetten in het tegengaan van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de van de leden Kröger, Laçin, van Raan, Gijs van Dijk van Brenk over reizigers die vanuit Nederland met het vliegtuig naar gebieden vertrekken waarvoor een oranje reisadvies geldt

MPs asked how many travellers fly from the Netherlands to orange-advice destinations, how many are non-essential, and whether low fares undermine the advice. The minister reported about 39,928 non-transfer passengers from Schiphol in one week, said travel purpose is not recorded, and wrote to airlines and travel associations urging them not to promote such trips.
Under privacy regulations, transport companies do not record the intention or purpose of the traveller's journey.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving registreren vervoersbedrijven niet de intentie dan wel het doel van de reis van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over geen beroeps- en bezwaarprocedure compensatie eigen bijdrage kinderopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary why parents receiving the childcare fee compensation may be under-compensated, whether there is a hardship clause or appeal route, and how the group of parents not covered by any scheme will be compensated. The State Secretary acknowledged the approximation, said objections remain possible within normal deadlines, admitted that a website statement wrongly implied otherwise, and said a compensation scheme for uncovered parents is being developed.
Parents can always object within the usual time limits if they disagree with the compensation.
Ouders kunnen binnen de gebruikelijke termijnen altijd in bezwaar gaan als zij het niet eens zijn met de vergoeding.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over werknemers die buiten het vangnet voor flexwerkers vallen

An MP asked whether UWV reconsiders TOFA applications only for workers whose holiday pay was paid out or included in an all-in wage, not for those excluded despite too-low income, and whether UWV would act more leniently for them. The minister confirmed that objections lead to reassessment, that only one known case exists, and that the coarse TOFA selection cannot be made more flexible without losing workability.
I indicated then that the selection based on data in the payroll records of those eligible can produce rather arbitrary outcomes.
Ik heb toen aangegeven dat de selectie op basis van gegevens in de polisadministratie van de mensen die in aanmerking komen tamelijk willekeurige uitkomsten kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen in Brabant

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about hazardous-goods trains through Brabant, including tanker volumes exceeding agreed risk ceilings and why routing powers were not used. The State Secretary acknowledged ceiling exceedances, argued there is no unsafe situation since statutory safety norms are met, and pointed to the Robust Basisnet programme, the Betuweroute third track and existing quarterly public data.
Exceeding these risk ceilings does not in itself mean there is an unsafe situation.
Het overschrijden van deze risicoplafonds betekent alleen niet dat er sprake is van een onveilige situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het kwijtschelden van schulden in Arnhem

An MP asked the state secretary about municipal debt write-offs for welfare recipients, fines and surcharges on unpaid health premiums, and stacking of penalties across agencies. The government answered that it does not know how many municipalities use the arrangement, defended the existing penalty regime while promising personalised debt support, rejected using the penalty to repay health debts and automatic deduction of other fixed costs, and committed to a report on surcharges due in autumn 2020.
It is not known how many municipalities together with health insurers use the exit scheme for welfare recipients.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten samen met zorgverzekeraars gebruikmaken van de uitstroomregeling bijstandsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "het vereenvoudigen van betaling pensioenpremie bij faillissement"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether workers losing jobs through bankruptcy must themselves request unpaid pension premiums from UWV, and whether pension funds should be allowed to file such claims on their behalf. The minister confirmed that workers must apply via UWV, which checks for unpaid premiums in the same claim, but declined for now to allow pension funds to file directly, citing unclear need and effects on UWV practice.
I of course remain willing to discuss the problem identified by the Pensioenfederatie and a targeted and appropriate solution where necessary.
Ik blijf uiteraard graag in gesprek over het door de Pensioenfederatie geconstateerde probleem en een gerichte en gepaste oplossing daarvoor waar noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs Van Dijk en Kerstens over een vlucht van twee Apache gevechtshelikopters boven Texel

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the Defence Minister about Apache helicopters flying low over Texel on 17 June 2020 for the TV programme Hunted, including noise and nesting-bird disturbance, and whether the mayor was informed in time. The minister said the flights respected legal minimum altitudes, that Defence joined the filming to recruit and train, and that the mayor should have been involved earlier, but denied the event fell under the emergency ordinance.
These evaluation talks show that, given the specific environment, the training and the filming, it would have been better to involve and inform the municipality and the mayor earlier.
Uit deze evaluatiegesprekken blijkt dat vanwege de specifieke omgeving, de training én opnames het beter was geweest om de gemeente en de burgemeester eerder te betrekken en te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over werknemers die buiten het flexvangnet vallen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about flex workers excluded from the TOFA emergency income scheme because of timing of pay (holiday pay in April, late February salary payments) and whether UWV could let them prove exceptions. The Minister acknowledged arbitrary outcomes, agreed UWV would handle objections coulantly, extended the application period and said the scheme was sufficiently publicised.
For the situation where holiday pay raises the social insurance wage above 550 euros in the policy administration, I agreed with UWV that UWV will act leniently.
Over de situatie waarin door uitbetaling van vakantiegeld een sv-loon hoger dan 550 euro in de polisadministratie staat, heb ik met UWV afgesproken dat UWV coulant handelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over corona onder het personeel van het vleesbedrijf Vion in Boxtel

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether measures at Vion's Boxtel meat plant are effective after new COVID-19 cases among staff, whether labour and food inspectorates oversee the plant and temporary agency workers, and why the plant stayed open when Vion's Apeldoorn site was closed. The government answered that the new cases were found at health checks at the gate, that the Inspectorate SZW enforces the Working Conditions Act and has started inspections of slaughterhouses, and that the NVWA and safety region monitor the measures, while noting the causes of infections are still under study.
The Inspectorate SZW will deploy additional inspections at slaughterhouses in the coming period.
De Inspectie SZW zal de komende tijd extra inzetten op inspecties bij slachthuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over beperkingen opgelegd aan studenten in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Van den Hul asked the Secretary of State for Infrastructure and Water Management about restrictions on students using public transport during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether students were being barred from peak hours, consultation with student unions, and alternatives for students. The government answered that no specific restrictions apply to students, that a general call to avoid peak hours applies to all travellers, and that agreements on school and university start and end times were made with education bodies and carriers, while promising to consider involving student unions in future agreements.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, no restrictions apply to students in public transport.
Zoals in antwoord op vraag 3 is aangegeven gelden geen beperkingen voor studenten in het OV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over uitbuiting van Uber-chauffeurs

MP Gijs van Dijk asks the ministers whether Uber drivers are exploited, whether they are employees entitled to labour law and the taxi CAO, whether the Tax Authority has examined bogus self-employment in taxis, and whether municipalities can limit the number of taxis. The government answers that employment status is for courts to decide case by case, that the Tax Authority does not publish sector-specific findings or disclose individual cases, and that municipalities have existing instruments; it commits to a pilot giving municipal enforcers some Wp2000 powers and to further talks, but declines to comment on individual cases.
Whether in individual cases such as those described in the question there is entrepreneurship, I cannot assess; that is for the courts.
Of in individuele gevallen zoals in de vraag wordt geschetst, sprake is van ondernemerschap, kan ik niet beoordelen, dat is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld,Kwint, Gijs van Dijk, Bruins en Postma over het bericht 'Grootste Nederlandse kinderopvangbedrijf zit fiscaal op de Kaaimaneilanden'

MPs from five parties asked whether the largest Dutch childcare company, owned via investment funds in the Cayman Islands, is permissible, whether public money leaks to tax havens, and whether ownership rules should change. The Secretary of State answered that childcare quality rules apply regardless of ownership, cited existing anti-avoidance measures, declined to confirm specific dividend flows citing tax secrecy, and rejected extra ownership restrictions.
To the extent information is known to the Tax Authority, the cabinet cannot, under the statutory tax confidentiality duty, confirm or deny which payments an individual taxpayer makes and to whom.

Voor zover hierover informatie bij de Belastingdienst bekend is, kan het kabinet op grond van de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht bevestigen noch ontkennen welke betalingen door een individuele belastingplichtige worden gedaan en aan wie dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de schuldenaanpak in Purmerend

An MP asked the state secretary about the Purmerend debt-prevention approach, whether debt becomes problematic when third parties profit, whether a new debt offensive and waiver of collection surcharges is needed during the corona crisis, whether commercial trustees and bailiffs should be regulated, and about a national debt fund. The government answered that early-warning debt policy is supported, that collection should be responsible, that a study on surcharge waivers and trustee fee rules is underway, and that no national debt fund exists though several initiatives are being explored.
There is no national debt fund.
Er is geen sprake van een Nationaal Schuldenfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht “Schuldhulp Eindhoven faalt" in het Eindhovens Dagblad van 28 mei 2020

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that debt assistance in Eindhoven was failing, citizens' right to timely and consistent debt help, funding, a national debt fund, incassо practices and access to the Wsnp debt-relief procedure. The government answered that the Eindhoven evaluation was municipally initiated, pointed to statutory standards and existing and planned initiatives, and promised further information to parliament on Wsnp access.
The cabinet will inform the House this summer about the outcomes of the investigations and the steps taken to improve the link between voluntary debt assistance and the Wsnp.
Wij zullen uw Kamer deze zomer informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en de stappen die genomen worden om de aansluiting tussen de minnelijke schuldhulpverlening en de Wsnp te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers die tussen wal en schip vallen bij het aanvragen van de NOW-regeling

MPs asked whether entrepreneurs who changed legal form, took over a business or started in early 2020 fall through the cracks of the NOW wage-subsidy scheme, and whether affected firms can be compensated and included in a second package. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the scheme cannot be adapted to every case, refuses to quantify affected firms, and declines to extend eligibility to businesses without a full reference month of turnover.
I am aware of the problem of businesses that had not yet generated a full month of turnover before March.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de problematiek van bedrijven die voor maart nog geen hele maand omzet hebben gedraaid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "een garantietermijn van twee jaar bij de nieuwe Wajong".

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary how the adopted motion on temporary crisis measures would be implemented, whether the Wajong guarantee period should be extended for people with work disabilities given COVID-19 labour market effects, and whether stakeholder organisations would be consulted. The state secretary answered that the two-year extension would be considered within the Stienen motion, that effects will be monitored with a letter to the Senate in summer 2020, and that the ministry and UWV keep in contact with the target group and interest organisations, without committing to an extension now.

In line with the Stienen motion, I will inform the Senate in summer 2020 about how I will monitor the effects of the crisis and in 2021 will work to strengthen the crisis resilience of the guarantee amount.

Conform de motie Stienen c.s. zal ik de Eerste Kamer in de zomer van 2020 informeren over hoe ik de gevolgen van de crisis ga monitoren en in 2021 zal inzetten op het versterken van de crisisbestendigheid van het garantiebedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over Een noodfonds voor de Wadden

An MP asked the minister whether a dedicated emergency fund for the Wadden islands should be created to protect jobs and invest in the region's future, given tourism's collapse during the COVID-19 crisis. The state secretary declined a separate Wadden fund, pointing to a second national support package, a fixed-cost allowance, and a government taskforce on the hospitality economy that could cover the region.
The cabinet therefore does not consider a separate emergency fund for the Wadden to be expedient.
Een apart noodfonds voor de Wadden acht het kabinet daarom niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over "arbeidsmigranten met corona"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the ministers about COVID-19 risks for migrant workers, including dismissals, working while sick, Labour Inspectorate complaints and returns home. The minister replied that employers must keep workers safe, reported 1,210 corona complaints (169 about migrant workers) with 109 investigated, and described an interdepartmental taskforce and EU guidance on free movement.
The Labour Inspectorate supervises compliance with the Working Conditions Act.
De Inspectie SZW houdt toezicht op de Arbowet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over “uitsluiting van studenten en jongeren voor de Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers”

An MP asked why young self-employed people under 21 receive only the youth benchmark under the Tozo and why students are excluded entirely. The state secretary explained that the youth norms follow the Participatiewet and parental maintenance duty, and that students are excluded because studiefinanciering counts as a prior provision, while committing to no retroactive change.
Due to the decentralised implementation of the Tozo, I do not have the requested data.
Vanwege de gedecentraliseerde uitvoering van de Tozo beschik ik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over gedupeerde studenten van niet-erkende beroepsopleidingen in de zorg

MPs asked why UWV referred students to non-accredited care training run by Quadrant, whether UWV and the government will prevent this and whether they will help affected students. The minister answered that UWV only checked accreditation and that the contract was ended, promised tighter voucher rules and periodic talks with trainers, but said no diploma can be issued outside accredited schools and offered only a conversation with affected students.
UWV is working on an adjustment of the procurement framework that sets out the contractual obligations of a trainer.
UWV werkt aan een aanpassing van het inkoopkader waarin de contractuele verplichtingen van een opleider zijn opgenomen.
