Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de armoede en schulden onder jongeren als gevolg van de Participatiewet

An MP asked the state secretary whether young people on welfare or minimum youth wages can live independently, how many young people are affected, and whether the rules should change (cost-sharing norm, youth norm, four-week search period, debt administration costs). The secretary defended the youth norm and parental maintenance duty, pointed to case-by-case supplementary assistance by municipalities, gave cost estimates for possible changes, and declined to scrap the four-week search period except temporarily during the coronavirus crisis.
The cabinet considers it important that young people do not provide for their living costs through a benefit, but work on their labour market prospects through study or work experience.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat jongeren niet door middel van een uitkering voorzien in hun bestaanskosten, maar werken aan hun perspectief op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over de voorwaarden voor steun aan bedrijven

MPs Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether Booking.com's dividends and share buybacks should bar it from state support, whether NOW wage subsidies allow dismissals, what conditions apply to support, and whether it uses tax schemes. The state secretary answered that companies are responsible for their dividends, that support will generally exclude dividends, bonuses and buybacks, and that tax secrecy prevents comment on Booking.com's tax position, while promising further anti-avoidance work.
Due to the statutory tax secrecy obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer such as Booking.com.
Door de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige als Booking.com.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over formule 1 wil coureurs door zeehondenreservaat laten pendelen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether F1 teams should be shuttled over the beach past a seal reserve, questioning the nature, safety and municipal regulation of the plan. The minister replied that the Grand Prix was postponed due to Covid-19 and the beach route dropped, so no negative effects are expected, and said the province is the competent authority for nature.
The organiser has also announced that the Formula 1 teams will not drive over the beach from Noordwijk to the circuit in Zandvoort during the Grand Prix.
Ook heeft de organisator bekendgemaakt dat de Formule 1-teams tijdens de Grand Prix niet over het strand van Noordwijk naar het circuit in Zandvoort gaan rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht in The Guardian ‘Heathrow third runway ruled illegal over climate change’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the UK Court of Appeal ruling that Heathrow's third runway plan was unlawful under climate commitments affects Dutch aviation policy, including CO2 assessment in environmental impact reports for Schiphol and Lelystad Airport and progress on the sector's emissions targets. The minister answered that the Netherlands is bound by the Paris Agreement, that the UK ruling concerns UK law and is not for the Dutch government to judge, that CO2 from landing and take-off cycles is assessed in the Lelystad and Schiphol reports, and that the sector's targets and the Sustainable Aviation Roundtable process are still being developed.
It is not for me to form a judgement on the ruling of the British judge and on whether it is appropriate and desirable.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vormen over de uitspraak van de Britse rechter en in hoeverre deze al dan niet passend en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten onvoldoende beschermd tegen het coronavirus

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether migrant workers in vital sectors are adequately protected against coronavirus given crowded housing, transport and dependence of housing on employment. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to shared responsibilities of employers and agencies, promised communication in multiple languages and referred enforcement of safety rules to the Labour Inspectorate and municipalities, without committing to new binding measures.

Yes. Cooperation is taking place with employers' organisations, trade unions, municipalities and embassies to address as well as possible the problems now arising for migrant workers and employers, and to enforce where possible.

Ja. Er wordt samengewerkt met werkgeversorganisaties, vakbonden, gemeenten en ambassades om de problemen die nu ontstaan voor arbeidsmigranten en werkgevers, zo goed mogelijk aan te pakken en waar mogelijk te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over gevolgen van de coronacrisis

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs how municipalities handle reintegration duties, sanctions and the work obligation under the Participatiewet during the COVID-19 crisis, and about safety at workplaces and the risk to thrift shops. The State Secretary answered that municipalities apply case-by-case discretion and safety rules, declined a categorical suspension of obligations, and said no specific signals of thrift-shop bankruptcy were known.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over antisemitische uitingen tijdens Ajax-PSV

MPs Kerstens, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Health ministers about antisemitic chants at the Ajax-PSV match, whether they are punishable, why the match was not stopped, whether stadium bans will follow, and the status of the anti-racism action plan. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the chants were condemned, PSV stewards intervened, one person was handed to police and the public prosecutor is reviewing the file, and that the KNVB and partners are implementing the action plan including a persoonsgerichte aanpak and a smart-technology challenge.
No report is known to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Er is geen aangifte bekend bij het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over “menstruatie-armoede in Nederland”

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will tackle period poverty, including by providing free menstrual products as Scotland does. The state secretary answered that the government favours an integrated poverty approach with municipalities responsible, mentioned school sexuality education and a few municipalities exploring stadspas access, and declined to commit to free provision.
Zie hiervoor het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over schadelijke effecten voor werknemers in kantoortuinen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about harmful effects of open-plan office landscapes on workers' concentration and health, and whether research, norms and works council involvement should be pursued. The State Secretary answered that existing Arbo rules already cover workplace design, that monitoring will be added to the National Working Conditions Survey, and that the NEN norm for office workplaces will be reviewed.
I want to gain more insight into the situation in the Netherlands and am therefore willing to conduct further research.
Ik wil meer zicht krijgen op de situatie in Nederland en ben dus bereid tot nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over Belastingdienst en UWV verliezen miljoenen door faillissement payrollbedrijf

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about tax and UWV losses from the bankruptcy of payroll firm Stipt, including worker losses, detection failures, the SNA quality mark and whether licensing for temp agencies should be introduced. The minister answered that individual tax debts are confidential, outlined UWV wage guarantee rules, said the SNA mark and its tax indemnity will remain while public-private cooperation is extended, and that licensing is not currently under consideration.
No statements can be made about individual tax debtors on the basis of the duty of confidentiality.
Over individuele belastingschuldigen kunnen op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Consumentenorganisaties: hef 25 cent per vliegticket voor garantiefonds'

MPs Paternotte and Gijs van Dijk asked whether Dutch consumers have legal guarantees when buying flight tickets compared with package holidays, and whether a Danish-style guarantee fund should be introduced. The minister answered that package travel is legally protected against insolvency while loose flight tickets are not, pointed to private protections such as credit cards, insurance and rescue fares, and declined for now to investigate a guarantee fund.
I see no reason for now to examine a guarantee fund for flight tickets in the Netherlands further.
Zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een garantiefonds vliegtickets in Nederland nader te onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over een containerschip dat 5 containers boven Ameland verliest en een containerschip dat tijdens de storm Ciara de risicovolle route boven de Waddeneilanden vaart

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about a container ship that lost seven containers above Ameland and a container ship that took the risky southern route past the Wadden islands during storm Ciara, asking about recovery, damage, the Kustwacht's warnings, the permanent closure motion and possible IMO proposals. The minister answered that the owner is responsible for recovery with Rijkswaterstaat as fallback, that the captain has final route authority, that a permanent closure cannot be imposed unilaterally and needs an IMO proposal with Germany, and that consultations with Germany will follow the OVV report.
The choice of route is ultimately the responsibility of the captain.
De keuze voor de route is uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de kapitein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het initiatief van scholen en ondernemers op Terschelling en Vlieland om een veerdienst tussen beide eilanden te onderzoeken

MPs asked the minister whether she knows of and will support an initiative for a direct ferry between Terschelling and Vlieland, including via the concession for the West Frisian ferries. The minister acknowledged the initiative and the travel-time benefits, but said the ferry is a matter for local parties and that she has no role beyond the concession for mainland links, which the current operator also partly serves.
These parties are currently investigating the feasibility. I have no role in this.
Deze partijen onderzoeken momenteel de haalbaarheid. Ik heb hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Marktgerichte kinderopvang is schadelijk voor jonge kinderen'

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary about a newspaper opinion piece claiming market-oriented childcare harms young children, including group instability, quality shortfalls, and low response to a quality monitor. The State Secretary rejected the picture of poor quality, pointed to GGD inspections and the Landelijke Kwaliteitsmonitor showing generally good quality, and declined to start new research.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the opinion piece.
Het beeld dat in het opinieartikel wordt geschetst, herken ik dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister houdt poot stijf: Zonder nieuwe vluchten geen Lelystad'

MPs asked the minister whether she was right that Lelystad Airport could never take over all flights from Schiphol, and why she only acknowledged unavoidable autonomous growth in December 2019 after earlier stating growth would be prevented. The minister replied that the European Commission's objections to the original scheme were known, that she withdrew the notification in December 2018 and resubmitted a more selective scheme, and that she informed parliament of the independent analysis on growth in December 2019.
From the very beginning it was clear that approval from the European Commission was necessary before a VVR could be deployed.
Vanaf het begin af aan is duidelijk geweest dat goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie (EC) noodzakelijk was alvorens een VVR in te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over supermarkt Picnic weigert werknemers volgens de cao te betalen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the supermarket Picnic's refusal to apply the supermarket collective agreement (cao) through separate subsidiaries, upheld by a court, is acceptable, and what can prevent such evasion via algemeen verbindend verklaring (avv). The minister says he does not judge court rulings, sees splitting companies to evade a cao as undesirable, but notes the scope of a cao is set by the social partners and that he cannot act as mediator unless all parties request it.
Splitting up a company merely to avoid applying a sector cao is not something I consider a good thing.
Het enkel opknippen van een bedrijf om zodoende de toepassing van een bedrijfstak-cao te voorkomen vind ik geen goede zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over de stevige impact van armoede op leerlingen in het basisonderwijs

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister, with the social affairs state secretary, how poverty affects primary school pupils and whether schools should take specific measures, such as referring parents to helpers and creating funds for school trips. The minister agreed equal opportunities matter and described existing municipal poverty funding, a school handbook and a forthcoming handreiking for schools, while stating schools cannot solve poverty alone.
Together with the state secretary of SZW, I am focusing on supporting schools in dealing with poverty at schools.
Met de Staatssecretaris van SZW zet ik in op ondersteuning van scholen in het omgaan met armoede op scholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over tekortschietende aanpak van armoede in Nederland

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs why poverty has not fallen despite a booming economy and budget surpluses, and what measures would reduce child poverty. The government answered that poverty stagnated mainly because wages rose little and more status holders entered welfare, pointed to income-support measures, child poverty ambitions with municipalities, and a planned SER exploration, while declining to quantify individual measures' effects.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het korten op de Wajong-uitkering bij het krijgen van een eindejaarsuitkering

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether Wajong benefit recipients who receive year-end bonuses should be exempt from benefit reductions, and how the government will implement the Van Brenk motion and treat similar bonuses under the Participatiewet. The state secretary answered that a full exemption is not feasible under current law, that a planned harmonised income rule will keep at least 30 percent of extras for Wajong recipients, and that Participatiewet bonuses already fall under a partial exemption with no further change planned.
With the proposed harmonised income scheme, Wajong recipients will retain at least 30 percent of extras received above their monthly income.
Met de voorgestelde geharmoniseerde inkomensregeling behouden Wajongers bij het ontvangen van extra's boven het maandinkomen in ieder geval minimaal 30 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over korten op de bijstand vanwege zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether returns from home solar panels count as means under the Participatiewet and could lead to benefit reductions, and whether municipalities differ in applying this. The State Secretary answered that such returns for private use are a saving on energy use, not income, so they do not affect benefit entitlement, while noting the ministry does not know whether municipalities take them into account.
Whether, and if so to what extent and in which municipalities, the return from solar panels is taken into account when assessing entitlement to benefit is not known to the Ministry of SZW.

Of en zo ja, in welke mate en bij welke gemeenten er bij de beoordeling van het recht op bijstand wél rekening wordt gehouden met de opbrengst van zonnepanelen is bij het Ministerie van SZW niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Kidsplus onder verscherpt toezicht'

MP Gijs van Dijk asks the state secretary why Kidsplus childcare locations remain open despite poor inspection reports, whether oversight is fragmented across municipalities and GGDs, and whether the government will act or create a legal basis for intervention. The state secretary replies that municipalities and GGDs are responsible for enforcement, that several problem locations were closed or face heavy enforcement, that information exchange between municipalities is being improved with VNG and GGD GHOR, and that no national intervention power is needed.
Municipalities are responsible for supervision and enforcement in childcare. I do not consider it desirable to step into this responsibility.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor toezicht en handhaving in de kinderopvang. Ik vind het niet wenselijk om in deze verantwoordelijkheid te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat vrouwen meer kans hebben om bij een auto-ongeluk te overlijden

Labour MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a US study showing women face higher injury risk in car crashes applies to the Netherlands, and whether crash tests should be adapted to women. The minister answered that the US study cannot be directly applied to the Dutch situation, that existing tests already represent average women and smaller persons, and that the RDW is involved in regulation and dummy development.
The study is based on accident figures from the United States. That the conclusions are directly applicable to the Dutch situation cannot be said on the basis of this single American study.

Het onderzoek is gebaseerd op ongevalscijfers uit de Verenigde Staten. Dat de conclusies één op één toepasbaar zijn voor de Nederlandse situatie kan op basis van dit enkele Amerikaanse onderzoek niet worden gezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over oneigenlijk gebruik van het non-concurrentiebeding

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about misuse of non-compete clauses in employment contracts, including how many lawsuits and settlements occur, their economic effects, and whether the rules should be modernised or abolished. The minister gave data on lawsuits and prevalence, defended the possibility of non-competes with safeguards, and promised further research into conditions for their use and possible compensation.
Following the motion by you and MP Van Weyenberg adopted during the SZW budget debate, I will investigate the desirability of setting further conditions on the use of the non-compete clause.

Naar aanleiding van de motie van u en het lid Van Weyenberg die is aangenomen bij de begrotingsbehandeling SZW zal ik onderzoek doen naar de wenselijkheid van het stellen van nadere voorwaarden aan het gebruik van het concurrentiebeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het niet handhaven van het verbod op slapen in de vrachtwagen

An MP asks why the inspectorate (ILT) does not enforce the ban on truck drivers spending their weekly rest in the cabin, and asks about inspections, fines, staking orders and cabin standards. The minister answers that enforcement is structural since February 2018 but limited by evidence requirements, that no staking order can be issued for weekly rest in the cabin, and that cabin standards are not individually checked.
The ILT is exploring options to tackle the problem together with other parties.
De ILT verkent de mogelijkheden om het probleem samen met andere partijen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het Gijs van Dijk over de vertraging van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet

An MP asks why the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, which protects the subsistence minimum, is delayed again and what the government will do to protect debtors meanwhile. The state secretary answers that implementation is still targeted for 1 January 2021, that interim measures are in force, and that further steps will depend on clarity expected in early 2020.
I have promised to inform your House about this at the beginning of 2020.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd u hierover begin 2020 te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de onaangekondigde korting van 3 miljoen op de begroting van Emmen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why Emmen was not informed in time of a surprise cut of about 3 million euro to its social assistance budget, and whether the change in allocation key is justified. The state secretary replied that the budget shift reflects annual model updates and labour market changes, that no improper administration occurred, that the municipality can use the safety-net scheme if a shortfall arises, and that no reason to revise the budget is seen.
Of course, the ministry is willing to explain the budget change.
Uiteraard is het ministerie bereid om de budgetmutatie toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about period poverty in the Netherlands, citing research by De Bovengrondse and Plan International and asking whether women should have access to good menstrual products and whether free products for pupils and students, as in Scotland, will be introduced. The minister agrees women should have access, points to school sexual education and a planned handreiking on poverty for schools, and concludes existing policy is sufficient without new measures specific to menstrual poverty.
The research gives no reason to take policy measures specifically aimed at this sub-aspect of poverty beyond the cabinet's current efforts.
Het onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om bovenop de huidige inzet van het kabinet beleidsmaatregelen te nemen specifiek gericht op dit deelaspect van armoede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Medewerkers onbeschermd blootgesteld aan landbouwgif'

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked about a broadcast report showing farm workers exposed to pesticides without protection, including inspection and enforcement figures, health studies, and whether the Labour Inspectorate has acted. The minister answers that the situation is unacceptable, cites NVWA inspection data for 2018, notes the Labour Inspectorate cannot establish violations from footage alone, and promises a Health Council advice on residents' health risks expected in summer 2020.
I have no information on whether the health of the workers involved in this case has been examined.
Ik heb geen informatie over het feit of de gezondheid van betrokken medewerkers in dit geval is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het schrappen van de korting in de avondspits door de NS

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether NS may unilaterally scrap the evening-peak discount on its off-peak subscription, and why rewards rather than penalties are not used to encourage off-peak travel. The minister replied that NS is responsible under the main rail concession for offering subscriptions suited to different traveller groups, that the change is offset by weekend and off-peak discounts, and that the minister sees no need to speak with NS again.
Given the commercial confidentiality of the relevant data, it is not possible to provide a numerical basis for the number of travellers.
Het is, gelet op de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van de betreffende gegevens, niet mogelijk om een cijfermatige onderbouwing van de hoeveelheid reizigers te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over WAO-aanvullingsprogramma’s

An MP asked the minister about private WAO supplementary disability insurance products that end at age 65 despite the raised AOW age, asking how many people are affected and whether the risk should be borne by insurers. The minister replied that these private products fall outside government responsibility, data is largely unavailable, the statutory WAO runs to the AOW age, and no intervention in the private market is planned.
These supplementary products are concluded in the private sphere and I do not concern myself with that.
Deze aanvullingsproducten worden in de private sfeer afgesloten en daar ga ik niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘verzekeraar MSC Zoe weigert vervolgschade te betalen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the insurer of shipping company MSC refuses to pay for later-washed-ashore debris from the MSC Zoe, whether Rijkswaterstaat is closing its claims desk, and why its claims were reduced. The minister denied that MSC is frustrating settlement, said the company was already told it is liable, said the claims desk stays open until adequate agreements exist, and explained that a EUR 483,000 claim reduction followed an error over the Arca vessel's costs.
Yes, I informed the shipowner of this shortly after the disaster.
Ja, ik heb de reder dit kort na de ramp al laten weten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Uitzendkracht komt amper rond’

The MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about temp workers struggling to make ends meet, their income insecurity, agency profits, the use of temp work only for peaks and sick-replacement, and whether to restrict the maximum term and introduce a licensing regime. The Minister answers that agency profit is legitimate, points to on-call rights from 1 January 2020, and says the temp-regime evaluation, licensing dialogue and proposals on term limits will be reported before summer 2020 without committing to specific changes now.
At national level there are no recent figures on whether temp workers can make ends meet.
Op nationaal niveau zijn er geen recente cijfers bekend over of uitzendkrachten kunnen rondkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de inkomensachteruitgang voor mensen met een Wajong-uitkering

A PvdA MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs to calculate the income and Wajong support for hypothetical cases of persons with a disability benefit under the old and proposed new Wajong rules, including after job loss. The State Secretary provided detailed calculations showing the proposed scheme yields similar or higher total income in the examples and committed to answering before the vote on the bill.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over incasso-Cowboys die geld verdienen aan de handel in schulden

An MP asked the State Secretary about debt collectors charging excessive fees and reselling debts, and whether government collection practices worsen debt problems. The government says collection costs are bound by statutory rules (WIK), a new collection register and a bill are in preparation, and it is studying debt sales and offering more tailored payment arrangements.
The bill including the establishment of this collection register is in preparation.
Het wetsvoorstel tot onder meer het instellen van dit incassoregister is in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de verdubbeling van het aantal daklozen

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about the reported doubling of the number of homeless people in the Netherlands, including the state's duty to provide housing, the causes, the adequacy of social assistance, shelter capacity and broader societal effects. The state secretary answered that housing and health are constitutional social rights shared with municipalities and housing corporations, that the government will present an additional plan this autumn, and that CBS research on the rise is pending.
That is why the Cabinet, together with other (local) parties, will come this autumn with an additional plan to significantly reduce the number of homeless people in the coming years.
Daarom komt het Kabinet dit najaar samen met andere (lokale) partijen met een aanvullend plan om het aantal dak- en thuislozen de komende jaren fors terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de berichten dat er opnieuw chroom-6 is gevonden op trams in Amsterdam en Utrecht

An MP asked the state secretary about chromium-6 found on trams in Amsterdam and Utrecht, including whether inspectors were sent, workers' protection, risk inventories and record-keeping duties. The state secretary answered that the Labour Inspectorate started inspections at the transport companies with results expected by year end, referred questions on worker numbers and protective measures to the employers, and confirmed that employers must keep records of exposed workers.
Following reports of possible exposure to chromium-6 during maintenance of trams and metro, inspections were started at the transport companies in Amsterdam, The Hague, Rotterdam and Utrecht.

Naar aanleiding van de berichten over de mogelijke blootstelling aan chroom-6 bij onderhoud aan trams en metro zijn inspecties gestart bij de vervoersbedrijven in Amsterdam, Den Haag, Rotterdam en Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het verband tussen landbouwgif en de ziekte van Parkinson

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether pesticide risks for Parkinson's disease are adequately assessed, whether moratoria, reporting duties, inspection checks and occupational-disease recognition should apply. The minister answered that EU approval procedures already test neurotoxicity, that the EU will be asked to strengthen procedures for neurological effects, and that a moratorium or reporting duty is unnecessary, while the inspectorate monitors risk-based and Parkinson's is not a recognised occupational disease in the Netherlands.
I support this recommendation and will ask the European Commission to take this up promptly.
Ik ondersteun deze aanbeveling en zal de Europese Commissie vragen dit voortvarend op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over absurde uitzendtarieven in het onderwijs

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about excessive temp-agency rates in education, how much school staffing money goes to agencies, and whether the government will ban such agencies or engage the sector. The minister says the spending is undesirable, DUO is piloting better data on non-employed staff, schools are making collective agreements, and a ban on high rates is not possible since agencies set their own tariffs.
I do not know the exact spending on temp agencies in primary education.
De exacte uitgaven aan uitzendbureaus in het primair onderwijs ken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Gijs van Dijk over een spoortunnel naar Ameland

An MP asked the minister whether a rail tunnel to Ameland is a serious option, why it is considered, and how residents and nature groups can influence ferry access, and whether a separate fast link for pedestrians and cyclists or baggage handling research is planned. The minister replied that a long-term vision after 2029 is being developed with regional parties, a first elaboration of three directions is due end 2019, a preferred scenario may be chosen around 2024, and no separate pedestrian link or baggage study is currently needed.
At the end of 2019 I will be presented with the first elaboration of the mentioned directions.
Eind 2019 wordt mij de eerste uitwerking van de genoemde denkrichtingen aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over meer vaart maken met de veiligheid van industriecomplex Chemelot

An MP asked the minister why the Safety Board's 2018 recommendations on Chemelot industrial site safety had not yet been adopted and whether they would be implemented with a timeline. The government answered that it takes the recommendations seriously, has been in talks with the Safety Board, and will determine with the Board what legal changes are needed, linked to the Omgevingswet, without giving a firm date.
The recommendations of the Safety Board are very important to me and I certainly take them seriously.
De aanbevelingen van de Onderzoeksraad zijn voor mij zeer belangrijk en neem ik zeker serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de verbetering van de spoorlijn naar Zandvoort

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the rail upgrade to Zandvoort would proceed without the Formula 1 race, how it fits with the Council of State's PAS nitrogen ruling, whether nitrogen can be offset or an ADC-test applied, and who pays for the upgrade and nearby residents' noise concerns. The Secretary of State answered that the upgrade responds to a motion and is partly co-financed by the Rijk, that nitrogen permitting will be assessed only once a request is filed, that noise stays within existing limits, and that the Grand Prix organiser pays only event-specific costs.
Nitrogen deposition on rail mainly occurs during the construction of a project, such as from incoming freight traffic.
Stikstofdepositie komt bij spoor vooral voor bij de aanleg van een project, zoals door aanvoerend vrachtverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Deliveroo zijn medewerkers pensioen moet betalen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that Deliveroo must pay pension contributions for its workers, and whether the government would act on platform worker status and pension rights. The minister declined to comment on individual companies or pending cases, said the ruling concerns the scope of a pension obligation rather than employment classification, and pointed to ongoing appeals, existing rules and planned measures on self-employment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen door Chemours

An MP asked the state secretary about Chemours' emissions of GenX, including whether permits should reflect the company's pledged 99 percent cut, whether residents can be blood-tested, whether Chemours should pay investigation costs, and whether national standards are needed to transport contaminated soil. The government answered that the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority and has already lowered permitted GenX emissions, that blood testing was offered after a parliamentary motion, and that interim national soil standards were set in July 2019.
The competent authority for this company, the province of Zuid-Holland, has already lowered the permitted GenX emissions several times since 2017.
Het bevoegd gezag voor dit bedrijf, de provincie Zuid-Holland, heeft de vergunde uitstoot van GenX sinds 2017 al meerdere keren verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de race naar de bodem van beveiligers op Schiphol

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Schiphol's security tender, split among seven companies and excluding the sector CAO, risks a race to the bottom on security guards' pay and whether the state as shareholder should intervene. The minister replied that Schiphol's management is responsible for operations and labour conditions, that he will not pressure Schiphol, and gave Schiphol's reasons for multiple contractors and quality-based awarding.
It is not for me to call Schiphol to account on this.
Het is niet aan mij om Schiphol hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de toenemende armoede onder mensen met schulden

MP Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about rising poverty among people with debts, including whether basic costs have outpaced net income and whether minimum-income levels and special assistance are adequate. The State Secretary answered that the government is working on debt prevention, points to income-support measures and a CBS study due in spring 2020, and says individual municipalities decide on special assistance.
Based on the research carried out by Zelf, in my view such a general statement about the income position of the clients concerned cannot be made.
Op basis van het onderzoek dat «Zelf» heeft uitgevoerd kan naar mijn mening een dergelijke algemene uitspraak over de inkomenspositie van betrokken cliënten niet gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Gemeenten geven vervuilde compost gratis weg aan bewoners’

MPs Kröger and Gijs van Dijk asked whether municipalities gave away plastic-contaminated compost and whether compost rules are adequate. The State Secretary answered that the compost was certified Keurcompost meeting stricter-than-legal standards, that plastics cannot be fully filtered out, and that the government is pursuing a source-based action plan for garden waste rather than tightening rules.

That is why I have asked Rijkswaterstaat, the NVRD and the Vereniging Afvalbedrijven to implement the garden waste action plan to reduce the presence of foreign materials through a source-based approach.

Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat, de NVRD en de Vereniging Afvalbedrijven gevraagd uitvoering te geven aan het Aanvalsplan gft-afval om via een brongerichte aanpak onder andere de aanwezigheid van bodemvreemde materialen te verminderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van een harde Brexit voor de Nederlandse werkgelegenheid.

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would take extra measures, such as short-time work, to cushion a hard Brexit's job losses, after a KU Leuven study estimated 73,200 Dutch jobs at risk. The ministers replied that existing contingency measures, support tools and social security are sufficient, that the study has important caveats, and that the government will not intervene in UK policy.
For these reasons, the cabinet currently sees no reason to deploy additional instruments to absorb the negative consequences of a no-deal Brexit.
Het kabinet ziet om die redenen op dit moment geen aanleiding voor de inzet van additionele instrumenten om de negatieve gevolgen van een no deal Brexit op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Ploumen over stank- en vliegenoverlast in Brunssum en Stein

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Ploumen asked the state secretary about odour and fly nuisance from plastic waste recyclers in Brunssum and Stein, and whether such firms may operate close to homes. The state secretary sympathised, explained that the province is the licensing authority and has started enforcement because the firm has not met preventive obligations, and said she is discussing an integrated sector approach with the industry.
The province is of the view that the provisions are not being sufficiently complied with by the company concerned and has therefore started an enforcement procedure.
De provincie is van mening dat deze bepalingen door het bedrijf in kwestie niet in voldoende mate worden nagekomen en heeft daarom een handhavingstraject in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit babybedjes onder de maat’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a TU Eindhoven study finding poor air quality around and in cot beds in childcare, and whether GGD inspections address this and whether cot-numbers and CO2 rules should be reviewed. The State Secretary said childcare must be safe and healthy, that inspections can cover air quality under existing rules, that GGDs and VNG will discuss the study, and that the sector is primarily responsible, offering to raise it with sector bodies.
Given the importance of the subject, I am therefore pleased to commit to discussing with the VNG and GGD GHOR Nederland the TU Eindhoven study and its significance for supervision and enforcement.

Gezien het belang van het onderwerp, zeg ik daarom graag toe om met de VNG en GGD GHOR Nederland in gesprek te gaan over het onderzoek door de TU Eindhoven en de betekenis daarvan voor het toezicht en de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over duizenden gedupeerden door het faillissement van de Zoetermeerse verkeersschool Aalbregt

An MP asked the minister about thousands of pupils left out of pocket by the bankruptcy of a Zoetermeer driving school, whether a guarantee fund exists, whether exams can proceed, and whether driving school quality rules should be tightened. The minister said bankruptcy is a private matter with a curator handling refunds, no guarantee fund exists, exams proceed where capacity allows, and quality measures are under discussion with the sector and CBR.
A bankruptcy is first and foremost a matter of private law. The government has no role in it.
Een faillissement is eerst en vooral een privaatrechtelijke aangelegenheid. De overheid heeft hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘De voorzitter van moskeekoepel CMO houdt er alweer mee op’

MPs Van Dam and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government engages with the Contactorgaan Moslims en Overheid (CMO), its membership, representativeness and agenda, after reports that its chairman was stepping down. The ministers answered that the CMO is the government's contact body for Muslim communities, lists its member organisations, and state that the government has no specific agenda with the CMO and that representation is up to the organisations themselves.
The cabinet has no specific agenda in advance for contact with the CMO.
Het kabinet heeft op voorhand geen specifieke agenda voor het contact met de CMO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked how much of the earlier co-financing budget for drug waste clean-up remained unspent, whether private owners should be compensated for clean-up costs, and what the government will do to provide structural funding. The government answered that EUR 1.2 million remained unspent and is available to provinces, that EUR 1 million per year is now structurally reserved for 2019-2024, and that responsibility for clean-up lies with regional and local authorities, with private owners to be compensated where they bear no fault.
The cabinet now makes available structurally another EUR 1 million per year for 2019 to 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked whether innocent private landowners should not have to pay for clearing drug waste dumped on their land, following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences the government draws. The Staatssecretaris replied that regional and local authorities are primarily responsible, notes provincial subsidy schemes, and announces a structural 1 million euro per year from 2019 to 2024 so that private owners are fully compensated for direct clean-up costs and municipalities partly compensated.

The cabinet now makes available structurally another 1 million euro per year for 2019 through 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat gemeenten de stekker uit sociaal werkbedrijf Soweco trekken

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities closing the sheltered work company Soweco, with 1,150 employees, would leave those workers without suitable jobs and lose its expertise. The secretary answered that municipalities are free to decide on such organisations, that employees receive a job guarantee, and that a letter on the wider trend will follow.
It is up to municipalities, which own the social development companies including Soweco, to decide what role these companies can play in the future.
Het is aan gemeenten, die de eigenaren zijn van de sociale ontwikkelbedrijven, waaronder Soweco, om te bepalen welke rol deze bedrijven in de toekomst kunnen spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het voortijdig stoppen van de berging na de containerramp op de Waddenzee

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the salvage of containers lost from the MSC Zoe in the Wadden Sea was reportedly halted early, whether the operation is complete, and whether the shipping company is taking adequate responsibility, among other points. The minister answers that the operation is not yet finished, describes the survey and salvage method, says MSC remains responsible and that aftercare agreements are being negotiated, and declines to fully disclose some cargo information beyond what the Freedom of Information Act permits.
The salvage operation is not yet completed.
De bergingsoperatie is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Stop verplichte zoekperiode voor bijstand’

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the state secretary whether the four-week mandatory job-search period for young welfare applicants should be scrapped, and how many young people find work or education during it and why some do not return to municipalities. The state secretary said municipalities should keep track of young people, that they do not report how many start work or education in the period, and that the mandatory search period will not be abolished or shortened categorically, though an exemption for young people with work disabilities is planned in a forthcoming bill.
Municipalities do not report how many young people start work or education during the search period.
Gemeenten rapporteren niet hoeveel jongeren starten met werk of onderwijs tijdens de zoekperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het dreigende faillissement van Utrechts Centrum voor de Kunsten en gevolgen voor diens medewerkers

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the Utrecht municipality is deliberately steering the Utrecht Centre for the Arts toward bankruptcy, leaving about 200 staff without transition pay, and whether the government will act on this. The ministers answered that the municipality has the power to end subsidies, that the courts rather than the government should judge bankruptcy motives and any disguised self-employment, and that they would not intervene in the municipality's decision.

The municipality of Utrecht has the authority to end subsidies. It is not for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Education, Culture and Science to judge practical situations like this.

De gemeente Utrecht heeft de bevoegdheid subsidies te beëindigen. Het is niet aan ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap te oordelen over praktijksituaties als deze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether period poverty, the inability to afford menstrual products, occurs in the Netherlands and whether the government would investigate it. The state secretary replied that there is no evidence yet, that the feminist platform De Bovengrondse is researching it with results due in August, and that the government will decide on further steps after those results.
On the basis of the outcomes we will determine whether and which further steps are necessary or desirable.
Op basis van de uitkomsten zullen wij bepalen of en welke verdere stappen nodig dan wel wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Bedrijven maken al plannen om de payrollwet te omzeilen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he finds it worrying that companies are already devising schemes to circumvent the new payroll law, and how he will monitor such constructions. The minister answered that the law's boundary between payrolling and temp work is sufficiently clear, that enforcement rests mainly with firms, clients, unions and courts, and that he will keep a close watch and has already written to parliament on contracting.
Of course I always want to keep a finger on the pulse to prevent new constructions involving unfair competition on employment conditions.
Natuurlijk wil ik altijd vinger aan de pols houden om nieuwe constructies waarbij sprake is van oneigenlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring 'blazers' (emission flares) at the ESD factory in Groningen, including carcinogenic particle emissions, public health risks, unclear public information, and what will be done to reduce blazers and stop illegal emissions. The government answered that the province of Groningen, as competent authority, is responsible for enforcement, that health risks from SiC fibres are still under investigation, that a dwangsom (penalty) was imposed for SiC emissions, and that communication was handled by the Veiligheidsregio and municipality.
In this case, the province of Groningen is responsible for enforcement as the competent authority.
In dit geval is de provincie Groningen als bevoegd gezag verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked about a RIVM advice on silicon carbide fibres and emissions from ESD-SIC near Farsum, and whether a risk limit for air will be set quickly. The state secretary confirmed SiC fibres should be treated as carcinogenic (ZZS), said the company and province must minimise emissions, and explained that RIVM found too little data for an air limit, so amphibole asbestos is used as a worst-case screening value, with a full standard depending on further information and a timeline not given.
RIVM indicated in its advice that there is currently too little data to derive an MTR for SiC fibres.
Het RIVM heeft in haar advies aangegeven dat er op dit moment te weinig gegevens zijn om een MTR voor SiC-vezels af te kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Rover wil langere treinen naar Noorden'

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary whether passenger numbers to the north are surging and whether more trains are needed, after reports of overcrowding. The State Secretary answered that growth is in line with the rest of the country, that NS keeps seats available in over 99% of Intercity trips, and listed measures such as longer trains during holidays and a seat-finder app.
I assess NS's performance on the basis of the agreements laid down in the concession for the main rail network 2015–2025.
Ik beoordeel de prestaties van NS op basis van de afspraken die zijn vastgelegd in de concessie voor het hoofrailnet 2015 – 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het rondetafelgesprek inzake MSC Zoe

MPs Kröger, Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister about inspection of container ships, cargo securing, confidentiality of cargo manifests, shipping routes and container tracing after the MSC Zoe incident. The minister answered that inspections led to few detentions, that extra cargo-securing checks shift inspection effort from other topics, that certain cargo data is confidential under the Wob, and that international rule changes depend on investigation outcomes.
There has been contact between the Dutch police and Port of Sines in Portugal. This was the last port the MSC Zoe called at before the accident occurred.
Er is contact geweest tussen de Nederlandse politie en Port of Sines in Portugal. Dit was de laatste haven die de MSC Zoe aandeed voor het ongeval plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Breed moratorium schulden 'dode letter'

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the statutory broad debt moratorium is a dead letter, why municipalities cannot apply it at intake, and whether the 22 conditions and other criteria should be loosened. The State Secretary answered that the broad moratorium is an ultimum remedium still little tested, prefers voluntary settlements, will evaluate the decree after more experience, and will wait for national agreements before deciding whether municipalities may put overheidsschuldeisers on hold.
I would like, as also announced in the explanatory memorandum, to evaluate the Decree on the broad moratorium.
Ik wil graag, zoals ook aangekondigd is in de nota van toelichting, het besluit Breed moratorium evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over elke week een maaltijdbezorger gewond naar het ziekenhuis

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the frequent serious accidents involving meal delivery workers, their piece-rate pay, uninsured status, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The State Secretary said worker safety is a SZW concern, that minimum wage law still applies to platform workers, that the Inspectorate runs risk-based oversight and a meal-delivery project, and that accident notification duties exist but the Inspectorate has not launched a dedicated sector investigation.

The Labour Inspectorate exercises risk-based supervision of compliance with labour legislation and uses instruments such as information campaigns, sector influencing, client approaches and inspections.

De Inspectie SZW houdt risicogericht toezicht op de naleving van de arbeidswetgeving en gebruikt instrumenten als voorlichtingen, branchebeïnvloeding, opdrachtgeversaanpak en het uitvoeren van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over jonge maaltijdkoeriers die op grote schaal ’s avonds werken

An MP asked the state secretary about 15-year-old meal couriers working late evenings despite the legal ban, tight time pressure, traffic risks, pay-per-piece bonuses, and inspection capacity. The answer acknowledges that working until 22:00 breaches the rules, describes a 2018 inspection project targeting delivery restaurants with about 100 interventions, and states that light work is assessed case by case with no blanket ban.
The Inspectorate SZW saw reason to actively monitor this sector in the Takeaway & Delivery Restaurants project.
De Inspectie SZW heeft aanleiding gezien om deze sector actief te gaan volgen in het project Afhaal- & Bezorgrestaurants.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de schrijnende werkwijze van de sociale dienst Laborijn

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked how the state views social services whose conduct frightens benefit recipients, whether the legal framework should be tightened, what training staff receive, and whether the state will follow up a pending investigation into Laborijn. The Secretary of State answered that recipients must be treated respectfully and privacy protected under existing law, that no national register of training exists, and that the Laborijn investigation is a local matter outside national involvement.
The announced investigation is primarily a local matter, in which involvement from central government is not at issue.
Het aangekondigde onderzoek is primair een lokale aangelegenheid, waarbij bemoeienis vanuit het Rijk niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Kinderdagverblijf Montessori Bilthoven op slot: onveilig, vies en ongezond'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a childcare centre in Bilthoven reported as unsafe and unhygienic, its prior violations, and whether investment-backed operators should be restricted. The State Secretary answers that municipalities and GGDs enforce childcare rules, the centre was closed for 7 days and has reopened, and that existing rules apply to all operators without a legislative ban on profit-driven investors.
The municipality indicated that if a future inspection again shows one or more serious violations, the location will be permanently closed.
Daarbij heeft de gemeente aangegeven dat wanneer uit een toekomstige inspectie blijkt dat er opnieuw sprake is van één of meerdere ernstige overtredingen, de opvanglocatie definitief gesloten wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over mogelijke geluidsoverlast van een transformatorstation van TenneT

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers whether a TenneT transformer station in the IJmond industrial area could cause noise nuisance in Wijk aan Zee and whether a fully enclosed box should be required. The minister acknowledged concerns, stated the noise contribution is under 2 percent of cumulative noise, and said TenneT will take extra noise-reducing measures including enclosing the transformers with walls and a roof, while the compensation coils remain open at the top.
In these talks the commitment was made to noise-reducing measures, including placing the transformers in a "box".
In deze gesprekken is de toezegging gedaan tot geluidreducerende maatregelen, waaronder het plaatsen van de transformatoren in een «box».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over bezorgdheid vanwege komst Uber Freight naar Nederland

An MP asked the minister how the arrival of Uber Freight in the Netherlands would be assessed, how a level playing field, road safety and driver exploitation would be ensured, and whether talks with Uber would take place beforehand. The minister answered that Uber Freight must comply with all rules and that the minister will talk with Uber Freight to verify sufficient safeguards before launch.
I will talk with Uber Freight to satisfy myself that the service builds in sufficient safeguards in advance so that carriers comply with laws and regulations.
Ik ga met Uber Freight in gesprek om mij ervan te vergewissen dat de dienst vooraf voldoende waarborgen inbouwt dat vervoerders zich houden aan wet en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over kinderen in armoede naar nul

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the government would join the Alliance Child Poverty's goal of ending child poverty by 2030 and whether a poverty action plan would be started. The State Secretary welcomed the alliance, said the government shares the goal, and referred to ambitions letter of 1 April 2019 with biennial reporting, without committing to a new concrete plan.
I refer you to the child poverty ambitions that I sent to your House on 1 April, in which the ambitions and what is needed to realise them are set out.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar de ambities kinderarmoede die ik op 1 april aan uw Kamer heb verstuurd, waarin de ambities en wat nodig is voor het realiseren daarvan, zijn uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over jongeren moeten volwassenloon krijgen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the European Committee of Social Rights' criticism that youth minimum wages are unfair should be accepted, and whether 18-year-olds should be treated as adults for wages, and whether a study on abolishing the youth wage would be done. The minister defended the phased youth minimum wage (full wage from 21 from July 2019), citing employment and schooling effects, and refused to abolish the youth wage.
I therefore do not intend to abolish the youth minimum wage entirely now.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens om het minimumjeugdloon nu volledig af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over zich ADO-supporters noemende personen die onder ander het monument De Dokwerker in Amsterdam hebben beklad

MPs Kuiken, Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about ADO Den Haag supporters who defaced the De Dokwerker monument in Amsterdam, including criminal investigation, camera footage, administrative measures, stadium bans and antisemitism in sport. The government answered that a report was filed and is with the Public Prosecution Service, declined to discuss the investigation or evidence, pointed to the mayor's powers and the KNVB's private-law stadium bans, and described existing anti-discrimination policy in football.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van het faillissement van Intertoys

MPs Moorlag, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that the owner of bankrupt Intertoys, as a pledge-holding creditor, would be paid ahead of other creditors, whether this shifts business risk onto the tax authority, UWV and staff, and how workers would be helped. The minister said the specific case is for the curator and courts, explained generally how pledges give priority, said the matter is being examined in the bankruptcy law review, and described UWV information sessions and support for workers.
It is not for me to comment on a specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op een specifieke praktijksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het schrappen van tolheffing Westerscheldetunnel voor een betere bereikbaarheid Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister whether toll charges on the Westerscheldetunnel should be abolished to improve accessibility for Zeeuws-Vlaanderen, raising costs for commuters, competition concerns and population decline. The minister answered that the tunnel replaced ferries, tolls are needed to finance it, Zeeland province has agreed to cut tariffs about 20% from 2020, and the province is responsible for the foot-and-bicycle ferry.
I have no insight into that.
Ik heb daar geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over de grafietregen bij Wijk aan Zee

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked the state secretary and ministers about graphite dust nuisance from Tata Steel and Harsco near Wijk aan Zee, the status of the criminal investigation, and what could be done to end the nuisance. The government answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority with enforcement instruments, that Harsco was ordered under a penalty to stop the emissions, that it will not comment on ongoing criminal investigations, and that it will send a letter to parliament around May.
As you know, the cabinet does not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Zoals u bekend is doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over opnieuw geen treinen vanwege storing Maaslijn

An MP asks the state secretary about recurring train disruptions on the Maaslijn, overcrowding, staff safety concerns, financial shortfalls for electrification and doubling, and passenger compensation. The secretary acknowledges unreliable service, says the Rijk will take over project leadership from Limburg, and commits to letters and joint measures with the province and operator, while deferring compensation to the concession grantor.
The Maaslijn project has been subject to various changes that led to delays and additional costs of approximately €55 million.
Het project Maaslijn heeft te maken gehad met diverse wijzigingen binnen het project, die hebben geleid tot vertraging en meerkosten van circa € 55 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het vervangen van asbestdaken voor zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether projects like Essent's 'Dakvrienden', where an energy company funds asbestos roof removal in exchange for solar panels, should be encouraged and extended to farms and private homeowners. Minister Wiebes replied that the government supports combining asbestos removal with sustainability, will examine whether support is needed, and that such private-homeowner models are for energy companies to consider, noting solar is not profitable on every roof.
Initiatives that combine the removal of asbestos roofs with sustainability are shared as good examples within the programmatic approach, and it is being examined whether support is needed.

Initiatieven die het saneren van asbestdaken combineren met verduurzaming worden in het kader van de programmatische aanpak gedeeld als goed voorbeeld en er wordt onderzocht of ondersteuning nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over treinstop Thialf bij schaatswedstrijden

An MP asked why Heerenveen station does not stop for skating events at Thialf, whether bus links for people with disabilities are adequate, and whether the minister will convene a meeting with NS, ProRail, the municipality and the province. The minister replied that transport to Thialf is the province's responsibility, that NS dropped the event stop in 2015 for commercial reasons, and that NS is willing to join a possible meeting convened by regional authorities.
Ensuring accessibility of Thialf during skating events is the responsibility of the province of Fryslân and the municipality of Heerenveen.
Het zorgdragen voor de bereikbaarheid van Thialf tijdens schaatswedstrijden is de verantwoordelijkheid van provincie Fryslân en de gemeente Heerenveen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over schrijnende werkwijze van de sociale dienst Laborijn

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the state secretary about reports that the Laborijn social services agency in the Achterhoek intrudes excessively on benefit recipients, including checking fridges and shower times, and about its costs. The state secretary replied that enforcement is a municipal responsibility subject to objection and appeal, that no national intervention is warranted, and that Laborijn's board has commissioned an independent external investigation.

Within its decentralised context, it is primarily the municipal executive's responsibility to ensure the correct implementation of the Participation Act and to account for it to the municipal council.

Binnen haar gedecentraliseerde context, is het primair aan het college van B&W om zorg te dragen voor een juiste uitvoering van de Participatiewet en om daarover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over minimumleeftijd voor taxichauffeurs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether taxi drivers under 23 with little driving experience cause more accidents and whether a minimum age of 23 should be introduced. The government answered that no research yet shows this specifically, that SWOV is analysing taxi accidents, and that it sees no reason to change the minimum age for the professional exam for now.
But following the recent accidents, I have asked the SWOV to further analyse the number of accidents involving taxis.

Maar naar aanleiding van de ongevallen die recent hebben plaats gevonden, heb ik de Stichting Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek Verkeersveiligheid (SWOV) gevraagd om het aantal ongevallen met taxi's nader te analyseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over landelijk meldpunt en onderzoek naar giftig chroom-6

An MP asked whether chromium-6 is used in more sectors than known, whether a national reporting point and investigation should be set up, and whether a claims assessment body should be created for victims. The government said the Inspectorate SZW works risk-based and will inventory known risky uses, that complaints can go to the Inspectorate and a central reporting point is under discussion with social partners, and that a commission will be set up to facilitate future compensation for occupational diseases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over meer treinen naar Deventer, minder naar Amsterdam

An MP asked the state secretary about a new timetable that adds trains between Harderwijk and Amersfoort but removes the Utrecht connection for northern travellers to The Hague, and whether a third track near Harderwijk could help. The state secretary answered that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that the Hanzelijn is the preferred alternative for most northern travellers, and that a third track would not undo the lost connection, with further insight to come in a later phase of the Toekomstbeeld OV.
The drafting of the timetable is up to NS.
De totstandkoming van de dienstregeling is aan de NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over schimmige handel in Uber-accounts

An MP asked the state secretary about the trade in Uber driver accounts exposed by a TV report, including the risk to passengers, whether the ILT inspectorate would act and expand capacity, and whether Amsterdam's wish for stricter rules on on-call taxis would be granted. The secretary said Uber bears primary responsibility, the ILT is already requesting data and focusing on Amsterdam within its risk-based capacity, Uber has added a driver-app break lock and is considering face verification, and a joint analysis with Amsterdam is underway.
Following the report, the ILT has demanded data from Uber that allows it to establish which accounts are being misused and whether legal norms are being breached.
Naar aanleiding van de reportage heeft de ILT bij Uber de gegevens gevorderd op grond waarvan vastgesteld kan worden welke accounts misbruikt worden en of daarmee wettelijke normen worden geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in nagelsalons

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about abuses in nail salons, including the National Rapporteur's call for more investigation, victims' reluctance to report, and police and Inspectorate capacity. The government answered by listing the 'Samen tegen mensenhandel' programme measures, reduced reporting barriers, and additional funding for the Inspectorate, while noting few signals have reached the authorities.
In addition, the Inspectorate SZW will receive a national human trafficking expert who will form the link between the investigative service and chain partners.
Bovendien krijgt de Inspectie SZW een landelijke expert mensenhandel die de verbinding vormt tussen de opsporingsdienst en ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht "IND huurt onderbetaalde krachten in"

Two PvdA MPs asked why temporary staff hired via agencies at the IND are paid less than permanent colleagues doing the same work, and whether this will be remedied and enforced in future tenders. The minister answered that the Waadi equal-pay rule applies but can be set aside by collective agreement, that pay is a matter between the agency and the worker, that the IND requires compliance via the framework contract, and that no extra conditions are considered necessary.
In case of underpayment, the employee can of course claim the back pay from the employer (in this case the staffing agency).
In geval van onderbetaling kan de werknemer uiteraard bij de werkgever (in dit geval het detacheringsbureau) dat achterstallig loon vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over grensoverschrijdende oefening in verband met een kernongeval

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether cross-border exercises with Germany were needed after a fire at a fuel fabrication plant near the Emsland nuclear plant, whether information to residents was adequate, and whether border crisis plans address cross-border issues. The state secretary answered that the fire posed no risk to the nuclear plant or the Dutch population, that cross-border exercises take place regularly with a major GEDEX exercise planned for 2020, and that the crisis plan is being updated with cross-border liaisons.
Both good information provision and cross-border exercises by emergency services and other involved bodies are of great importance.
Zowel goede informatievoorziening als ook grensoverschrijdende oefening van hulpdiensten en andere betrokken instanties is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Smeulders, Renkema en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de distributiecentra van Picnic niet veilig zijn

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of high workload, unsafe equipment and poor pay at online supermarket Picnic, including whether the Inspectorate SZW would investigate, whether its risk assessment was in order, and whether it should fall under the supermarket collective agreement. The Minister answered that employers are responsible for safe work and workload, that the Inspectorate acts on complaints and risk-based priorities without commenting on specific investigations, that no company collective agreement is registered for Picnic and interpreting the scope of sector agreements is for the social partners, and that the government is taking measures against competition on labour conditions.
No statements are made about whether the Inspectorate SZW is conducting an investigation or not.
Er worden geen uitlatingen gedaan of de Inspectie SZW al dan niet onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht dat 270 containers overboord geslagen zijn bij de Waddeneilanden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked ministers about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, including causes, health and environmental risks, liability of the shipowner, cooperation, lashing rules, container tracking and crisis coordination. The minister answered that causes are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service and foreign authorities, that the shipowner has been held liable and must clean up, that regional safety authorities coordinate the response, and that container chipping would need international agreement.
The cause of the containers going overboard is not yet known and is the subject of investigation by, among others, the Public Prosecution Service.
