De oorzaak van het overboord slaan van de containers is nog niet bekend en onderwerp van onderzoek door o.a. het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het Oxfam rapport over vluchtelingenopvangkampen in Griekenland

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked about the Oxfam report on Greek refugee camps, including a death from cold, the lack of medical screening of vulnerable people, and contacts with EU partners. The State Secretary answered that Greece remains responsible, that the Netherlands repeatedly raises the issue with Greece and the Commission, and that it will be on the agenda of his next visit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Uber opnieuw in opspraak: 'Het is wachten op de volgende dode''

An MP asks the state secretary about a fatal accident involving an Uber driver, whether Uber should be held responsible for driver rest times, whether ILT enforcement will be increased, and whether municipalities can limit taxi numbers. The government says the criminal investigation is ongoing, Uber has introduced a 10-hour offline rule and age/experience measures, ILT will run a taxi oversight programme in 2019, and it will study municipal volume-control options with municipalities.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the criminal investigation into the accident.
Op de uitkomsten van het strafrechtelijke onderzoek naar het ongeluk kan ik niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gijs van Dijk over uitbuiting van Roemenen in Nederland

MPs Jasper and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of labour exploitation of Romanian workers in the Netherlands, including complaint figures, the reasons victims do not report, estimates of the scale, food safety risks, and enforcement. The minister answered that exploitation is unacceptable, described the Inspectorate's handling of complaints and the extra funding and programmes to intensify enforcement, but gave no nationality-specific figures and no new prevalence estimate.
The estimates of the National Rapporteur are not broken down by nationality.
De schattingen van de Nationaal Rapporteur zijn niet uitgesplitst naar nationaliteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over onvoldoende bescherming voor leden van cliëntenraden vanuit de Participatiewet

Two PvdA MPs asked whether members of client councils under the Participation Act can be dismissed by municipal boards for being too political, and whether the law protects them adequately. The state secretary said the matter is for the municipality and gemeenteraad, that the law sufficiently anchors client participation, and that no legislative change is planned, pointing instead to a Movisie project and the evaluation due end 2019.
I do not intend to amend the Participation Act.
Ik ben niet voornemens de Participatiewet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Bodem zakt meer dan verwacht door droogte’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a report that Dutch soil is subsiding faster than expected because of drought, its causes, the expected costs, and who is liable for damage. The minister answered that drought and groundwater management cause the subsidence, that owners bear their own responsibility, that municipalities and water boards have a duty to weigh interests, and that insurers' coverage depends on policy terms.
If the damage is caused by unlawful action by the government, the injured party can hold the relevant government body liable through civil law.
Als de schade wordt veroorzaakt door onrechtmatig handelen door de overheid, dan kan de benadeelde het betreffende overheidsorgaan aansprakelijk stellen via de civielrechtelijke weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over onderzoek van Sociaal Werk Nederland waaruit blijkt dat meer ouders peuters thuishouden

Two MPs asked whether administrative burden of the childcare allowance application is causing parents to keep toddlers out of playgroup-type care, with consequences for language delay, and proposed free preschool. The state secretary answered that research shows no national trend of parents dropping out, that a verbetertraject for the allowance and a new study are underway, and that a precise cost estimate for free preschool is difficult but a rough figure of about 850 million euro was given.
That is why I will again examine at the beginning of 2019 what the effects of the harmonisation are.
Daarom zal ik begin 2019 opnieuw onderzoeken wat de effecten van de harmonisatie zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het stuklopen van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the collapse of the pension agreement, its contents (including RVU levy cuts, a contribution of about 7 billion euros, reduced AOW-age increase, and easier pension saving for self-employed), and whether memos were shared with MPs. The minister answered that no agreement was reached, describes the proposed package and its costs in general terms, and states that the government shared no separate memos beyond coalition-internal consultation.
Therefore there is no pension agreement.
Er is dan ook geen pensioenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het mislukken van een pensioenakkoord

Opposition MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the failed pension agreement, including whether the government was ready to decouple AOW age from life expectancy, the effect on fiscal sustainability, RVU-levy cuts and support for self-employed pension building. Minister Koolmees answered that the decoupling would have been studied by an external commission, that the measures would weaken the sustainability balance, that the RVU cut was only an ultimate offer, and that no mandatory pension for self-employed had political support because no total package was agreed.
Since it was not possible to reach agreements on this within a total package, it is not opportune to go further into possible coverage measures.
Aangezien het niet is gelukt om binnen een totaalpakket hierover afspraken te maken, is het niet opportuun om verder in te gaan op mogelijke dekkingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over Ryanair die basis Eindhoven sluit

An MP asked the government whether it would enforce Dutch labour and social security law on Ryanair after its Eindhoven base closure, including preventing an unlawful collective dismissal or transfer. The minister answered that Dutch courts decide when Dutch employment law applies, that the government has written to Ryanair asking it to apply home-country labour law, and that the Labour Inspectorate has no supervisory role here.
It is therefore for the Dutch judge to determine under which circumstances Dutch employment law applies, and not for the Dutch government.
Het is dus aan de Nederlandse rechter om te bepalen onder welke omstandigheden het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht van toepassing is, en niet aan de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over toename van werkende armen

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about the rising number of working poor, including the SCP findings, self-employed low-rate workers, flexible and on-call contracts, and municipal outreach. The government acknowledged the concern, pointed to planned measures such as the ALT contract and the Arbeidsmarkt in balans bill, and committed to talks with municipalities and the VNG.
The cabinet will discuss the report with the VNG to examine how municipalities can better reach and support working people with low incomes.
Het kabinet gaat met de VNG over het rapport in gesprek, om te bezien hoe gemeenten werkenden met een laag inkomen beter kunnen bereiken en ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in het Europese wegtransport

An MP asks the ministers about abuses in European road haulage, including the ease of obtaining driver certificates in other EU states, Polish control capacity, poor living conditions and low pay of non-EU drivers, enforcement of rest times, supply-chain liability, and applying the Posted Workers Directive to transport. The government answers that it lacks comparative data, cites enforcement figures (165 fine reports), explains existing supply-chain liability rules, and says it is pursuing equal pay for equal work through the EU Mobility Package.
As far as I have been able to ascertain, no comparative research has been carried out into the requirements that different member states impose on applications for certificates.
Er is, voor zover ik heb kunnen nagaan, geen vergelijkend onderzoek gedaan naar de eisen die in de verschillende lidstaten worden gesteld aan aanvragen van attesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "de oproep van Belgische minister Peeters aan Ryanair om te voldoen aan Belgisch arbeidsrecht"

An MP asks the government about a Belgian minister's letter to Ryanair demanding compliance with Belgian labour law, precarious self-employment of pilots, and whether Dutch labour and social security law applies to Dutch-based crew. The minister answers that Dutch courts decide on applicable law, Dutch social security applies to Dutch-based crew, and a joint letter to Ryanair is being prepared with other EU states.
It is therefore for the Dutch court to determine under which circumstances Dutch labour law applies, and not for the Dutch government.
Het is dus aan de Nederlandse rechter om te bepalen onder welke omstandigheden het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht van toepassing is, en niet aan de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het recht op onbereikbaarheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the right to disconnect (onbereikbaarheid) after reports that Lidl restricted after-hours emailing, and whether the government would promote similar arrangements, discuss them with social partners, and continue the work-stress awareness campaign. The State Secretary replied that work stress is a matter for tailored solutions reached through dialogue between employers and employees on the shop floor, that causal links between constant connectivity and burnout are not yet established, and that the ministry will keep supporting activities but will not pursue a legal right to disconnect or discuss it with social partners.
An approach to work stress is tailor-made.
Een aanpak tegen werkstress is maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Smeulders en Van Kent over onderbetaling journalisten door payrolling

MPs Van Dijk, Smeulders and Van Kent asked the ministers about public broadcasting journalists being underpaid through payrolling, including questions on pensions, the regeringsakkoord, zzp collective bargaining and flex allowances. The ministers answered that the Wab bill will extend equal pay and adequate pensions to payroll workers, that broadcasters must set their own budgets and wage terms under the cao, and declined to research the effects on journalistic quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over toegang tot de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening

An MP asked the state secretary about the Nationale ombudsman's follow-up report on access to municipal debt assistance, including low intake rates, missing registration data, and limited access for self-employed people. The state secretary replied that municipalities are responsible for access, that improvements are underway through the debt-reduction agenda and benchmarks, and committed to further knowledge-sharing and talks with municipalities.
Municipalities are responsible for access to and the quality of debt assistance for their residents.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de toegang en de kwaliteit van de schuldhulpverlening aan hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over hoge bonussen bij pensioenuitvoerders

An MP asked the minister about high bonuses at pension administrators and whether pension funds should be allowed to pay them while pensions are not indexed, and whether participants can influence those bonuses. The minister answered that pension fund boards are responsible for outsourcing and remuneration choices, that participants already have voice through representative bodies, and that it is not for the minister to call boards to account.
It is not for me to call pension fund boards to account for the management of the pension fund and the execution of their work.
Het is niet aan mij om pensioenfondsbesturen aan te spreken op hun beheer van het pensioenfonds en de uitvoering van hun werkzaamheden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het filmpje op Twitter inzake Achmea Rechtsbijstand

Two MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Twitter video showing the minister endorsing Achmea legal insurance, asking about commercial interest, sponsorship, and the link to reform of subsidised legal aid. The minister denied any Achmea involvement or advertising, said the visit was to inform himself, and promised to inform parliament soon on the reform of legal aid.
As Minister for Legal Protection, I attach great importance to being broadly informed on various fields by different parties.
Als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming hecht ik groot belang aan het mij breed laten informeren op diverse terreinen door verschillende partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over verplichte bijscholing voor ervaren chauffeurs

An MP asks why experienced older truck drivers must now take retraining to keep code 95 on their licence, what the costs are, and why the government does not allow automatic recording. The minister explains that the EU Commission required ending the exemption and automatic entry under the Driver Qualification Directive, promises consultation with the sector on costs and targeted information, and says the government has no facts on forged code 95 licences.
To prevent an infringement procedure at the Court of Justice of the European Union, a legislative process is being started to end the validity of these codes before then.
Om een infractieprocedure bij het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie te voorkomen wordt een wetgevingstraject ingezet teneinde de geldigheid van deze codes voor die tijd te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de treinchaos rondom Amsterdam

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the August 2018 train chaos around Amsterdam caused by a software fault, why NS did not deploy replacement bus transport, and whether ProRail and NS would be held to account and agreements made to prevent such disruptions. The State Secretary explained the software fault and the reasons replacement transport was limited, and committed to including the incident in the 2018 disruption report and reviewing whether additional measures are needed.
As part of the 2018 disruption report, I will consider whether additional measures are necessary.
In het kader van de verstoringenrapportage 2018 zal ik bezien of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Duizenden minima dreigen voordelige zorgverzekering kwijt te raken’

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister whether Menzis's plan to end collective health insurance for low-income groups outside its core regions, and the resulting possible loss of cheaper cover, was acceptable and how it affects trust in insurers. The minister answered that it is primarily up to municipalities and insurers to shape cooperation, that Menzis extends some contracts to 2020, that alternatives exist, and that the matter will be discussed with insurers and municipalities without committing to concrete new measures.
It is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and insurers themselves to shape cooperation for specific target groups.
Het is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en verzekeraars zelf om samenwerking voor specifieke doelgroepen vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "Maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo ronselt minderjarigen"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Deliveroo recruits minors as couriers, whether this is tolerable, whether Deliveroo breaches OECD guidelines, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that child delivery work is prohibited under the Working Hours Act, placed primary responsibility on companies, declined to comment on concrete cases, and said the Inspectorate will focus on the platform economy without confirming any investigation.
I do not comment on any ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Trillende handen aan het bed’ (uitbuiting in de thuiszorg)

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about exploitation of Bulgarian live-in home-care workers by Care4You and related firms, and about municipal underpayment for home care. The ministers said inspections are ongoing, enforcement rests with labour and care inspectorates, and reviews of the reasonable-price decree are underway with results due in 2019.
I have asked the care offices to further investigate the roughly ten cases in this case in which PGB care is purchased.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren gevraagd om het tiental zaken waarin in deze casus pgb-zorg wordt ingekocht nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over minder snelle stijging van de AOW-leeftijd

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the speed of the AOW pension age increase, citing actuarial and CPB views that it may be rising too fast and questioning budget savings on the AOW. The minister answered that the AOW age will rise to 67 and is linked to life expectancy, that the lower projected AOW spending is partly due to temporary lower beneficiary numbers and revised estimates, and that the IOW unemployment scheme for older workers will be extended by four years.
I am in favour of a solid and solidary AOW for current and future generations.
Ik ben voor een solide en solidaire AOW voor huidige én toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over de terugkeer van het alcoholslot

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether the government will reconsider reintroducing the alcohol lock after the Council of State and Supreme Court rulings, and whether it will amend the law to do so. The ministers answered that the alcohol lock under administrative law is no longer feasible, that placing it in criminal law was examined and found costly and rarely applicable, and that they will not re-investigate or legislate now but await the results of the Alcoholmeter pilot.
The rulings mean that the alcohol lock programme as it was arranged is no longer possible, and that any new programme must take these rulings into account.
De uitspraken betekenen dat het ASP zoals dat was geregeld niet meer mogelijk is en dat bij het ontwerp van een nieuw ASP rekening met deze uitspraken moet worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag op de werkvloer van artsen

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government views a Medisch Contact survey finding that many doctors and medical students experienced sexual boundary-crossing behaviour at work, and why it persists, and what consequences it draws. The minister replied that such behaviour is unacceptable, that employers must have policies and complaint procedures, that few victims take further steps, and that the government will work with the sector on additional measures.
I will discuss with the sector further steps to address and prevent unwanted behaviour.
Ik ga met de sector nader in gesprek over aanvullende stappen om ongewenst gedrag tegen te gaan en te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Gijs van Dijk over reclame door verplichtgestelde pensioenfondsen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Gijs van Dijk asked whether a mandatory pension fund's national TV advertising campaign (EUR 1.3 million in 2018) is appropriate, how it is supervised and reported, and whether targeted letters would be cheaper. The minister confirmed no specific advertising rules exist beyond AFM supervision of information duties, said communication costs are not separately reported, and left the choice of media to the fund's board and works council.
In PFZW's annual report, communication costs are not listed separately.
In het jaarverslag van PFZW worden de communicatiekosten niet apart vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over “de pakketsorteerders die via een schijnconstructie worden ingehuurd bij PostNL”

MPs Van Kent and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about PostNL using a contracting scheme to hire parcel sorters outside the post CAO, heavy lifting limits, sick-leave practices and their call to ban parcels over 23 kg. The government answered that enforcement of CAOs is primarily for social partners, that the Labour Inspectorate can only report findings, that the Arbowet and NIOSH method govern lifting, and that the motion was rejected.
It is therefore not for the Labour Inspectorate to take further steps, even if in an investigation under article 8 of the Waadi it has established that the wage-ratio provision was not complied with.

Het is dus niet aan de Inspectie SZW om nadere stappen te nemen, ook niet als zij bij een onderzoek op grond van artikel 8 van de Waadi heeft vastgesteld dat het loonverhoudingsvoorschrift zoals vastgelegd in de Waadi niet is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over het uitsluiten van vrachtwagenchauffeurs van gelijk loon voor gelijk werk en de verkeersveiligheid op de Nederlandse wegen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the EU Transport Committee's position excluding truck drivers from the posted workers directive and allowing longer driving-time flexibility threatens equal pay and road safety, and whether the Netherlands can still enforce posting rules. The minister answered that the exemption should be limited, that flexibilisation may endanger road safety, that the European Parliament had rejected the committee report as a negotiating basis, and that the Dutch enforcement position is unaffected.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has consistently pointed out that too much flexibilisation can endanger road safety.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft steeds gewezen op het feit dat te veel flexibilisering de verkeersveiligheid in gevaar kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over de inwerkingtreding van de handhaving op schijnzelfstandigheid per 1 juli aanstaande

MPs Van Kent and Gijs van Dijk asked how the Tax Authority and Inspectorate SZW would enforce against sham self-employment from 1 July 2018, including evident bad-faith employers such as Deliveroo. The minister answered that enforcement continues only against the most serious cases within existing capacity, outlined a supervision plan with at least 100 client visits, and noted the heavy burden of proof and the lengthy appeal and criminal route.
Supervision and enforcement of the DBA Act take place within existing capacity.
Toezicht en handhaving van de wet DBA vindt plaats binnen de bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Beroerde arbeidsomstandigheden in kraamzorg’

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the minister about reports of poor working conditions in midwifery care, including structural overtime and inability to take holidays or sick leave. The minister said the monitor's findings are important signals if representative, that employers must follow existing rules, and that the sector is working on workload reduction, workforce planning, and an academy, with a subsidy for workforce planning.
There are no detailed projections known about the expected shortages of midwifery care staff.
Er zijn geen gedetailleerde ramingen bekend over de (te verwachten) tekorten aan kraamverzorgenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Onacceptabel risico' op instorten bruggen en viaducten in Noord-Holland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about media reports of unacceptable risks and deferred maintenance on bridges and viaducts in Noord-Holland, and whether the situation is national and financed adequately. The minister answered that there is no collapse danger, that flagged risks were addressed, that some works are deferred within allowed bandwidths, and that the Kamer is informed annually through the budget and MIRT overview.
There is no danger of collapse for bridges and viaducts.
Er is geen sprake van instortingsgevaar bij bruggen en viaducten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de ongevallenverzekering voor Deliveroo bezorgers

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Deliveroo's free accident insurance for couriers signals employer status and disguised self-employment, whether the Tax Authority will enforce, and whether clarity is needed to prevent a race to the bottom. The minister answered that employer status is for courts to decide case by case, that tax confidentiality bars comments on individuals, that the government will tackle disguised self-employment through new rules, and that enforcement against the most serious bad-faith cases continues, with a broader scope from 1 July 2018.
No statements can be made about individual taxpayers under article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over individuele belastingplichtigen kunnen op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk, Gijs van Dijk en Van Raan over geluidsnormen op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether the Schiphol noise criteria (the 'huizennorm' of 10,000 severely affected homes) were stretched to about 12,300 homes without justification, and whether enforcement uses flown routes. The minister acknowledges the criteria were actualised in 2007/2008 and 2013 after new insights, says enforcement now uses flown routes, and rejects the claim that the original limits were breached, while not fully explaining why the figure rose.
If an actualisation is carried out, the House of Representatives will be informed of it.
Indien een actualisatie wordt uitgevoerd, wordt Uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het falen van de renovatie van de Julianabrug in Urmond

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water why maintenance on the Julianabrug in Urmond was halted and delayed, why residents bear the social and economic costs of a long partial closure, and whether the funding and timetable would be reconsidered. The minister answered that the bridge remains in service with restrictions, that the scope and closure period will be determined in a planning phase, that funding comes from the Infrastructure Fund, and that consultations with Rijkswaterstaat and the municipality have already taken place.
The bridge remains in operation, albeit with restrictions, until replacement or renovation.
De brug blijft, hetzij met beperkingen, tot vervanging/renovatie in bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de Britse ambitie om binnen zeven jaar van overbodig plastic verpakkingsmateriaal af te zijn

An MP asks the government about a UK pledge by over forty companies to eliminate unnecessary plastic packaging within seven years, whether it is realistic, and whether it fits the motion on reducing packaging. The state secretary welcomes the initiative, explains Dutch recycling targets and EU packaging policy, and says the goals are broadly aligned with the motion without committing to new concrete targets.
I have committed to inform your House during the year about the ambition on this point.
Ik heb toegezegd uw Kamer in de loop van het jaar te informeren over de ambitie op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over stress veroorzakende klantbeoordelingssystemen

An MP asks the minister whether customer rating systems that pressure workers, feed personnel files and dismissal dossiers, and carry bias risks are acceptable, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate. The minister says the systems are not inherently unacceptable, that employers must manage privacy and workplace-stress risks, and that the Inspectorate supervises employers' policies generally rather than these systems specifically, while bias should be tackled directly.
The system itself does not lead to this behaviour.
Het systeem zelf leidt niet tot dit gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over asbestverwijdering door middel van “Minicontainment”

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the Minicontainment asbestos-removal method, reportedly used in residents' presence, is proven safe, whether it should be suspended, and whether independent research will be done. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate has no reason to doubt its safety when used correctly, that residents' exposure stays below the limit value, and that the method will not be suspended, while promising a broader policy response on the asbestos system.
For now, however, the Inspectorate has no reason to assume that doubts about safety are warranted when the method is used correctly.
Vooralsnog heeft de Inspectie evenwel geen reden om aan te nemen dat bij correct gebruik getwijfeld zou moeten worden aan de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over "werken zonder loon in de vijf gemeenten in de Hoeksche Waard"

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether municipalities in the Hoeksche Waard may require welfare recipients to take part in unpaid work placements, whether this displaces paid jobs, and how the region performs on the jobs agreement and sheltered work. The State Secretary answered that the Dove trajectory is a work-experience step with supervision and a maximum of three months, not a tegenprestatie, that no unlawful coercion or underpayment is evident, that the municipality is responsible for preventing displacement within legal limits, and that the region is on track for its targets.
Based on the information from WIHW, I see no reason to assume that there is unlawful coercion or underpayment here.
Op basis van de informatie van WIHW zie ik geen reden om aan te nemen dat hier sprake is van ongeoorloofde dwang of onderbetaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Opleiden 55-plusser is plicht’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV staff cuts, the shortage of insurance physicians, and whether sick workers must always be seen by one, plus whether employers should be obliged to hire older long-term unemployed. The minister replied that cuts are managed through workforce planning, that task delegation keeps physician oversight, that sick workers need not always see an insurance physician, and that planned measures will continue pending a feasibility check.
For now, the shortage of insurance physicians is no reason not to carry out the measures.
Vooralsnog vormt het tekort aan verzekeringsartsen geen reden om maatregelen niet uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Van den Hul en Dijksma over pensioenfondsen die beleggen in Aurobindo, het omstreden geneesmiddelenbedrijf, dat mensenrechten en milieuregels aan zijn laars lapt

MPs Van Dijk, Van den Hul and Dijksma asked whether pension funds investing in Aurobindo, a pharmaceutical company accused of human rights and environmental violations, should take steps, and what the government would do about ABP's investment. The minister answered that funds should follow OECD guidelines through engagement, that ABP decides its own investments and is accountable for them, and that the government is pursuing IMVO covenants with the financial sector.
No, I do not have that information, and furthermore ABP itself is responsible for its investment policy and investment choices.
Nee, die informatie heb ik niet en verder geldt dat het ABP zelf verantwoordelijk is voor het beleggingsbeleid en de beleggingskeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Özdil en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat flexwerk verder oprukt, vooral onder jongeren

MPs Van Kent, Özdil and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that insecure contracts are spreading, especially among young people, and about the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans. Minister Koolmees acknowledged the trend, said he shares concerns about its consequences for housing and family formation, and said the government will send the Wab bill to parliament in Q3 2018.
To tackle the growing divide on the labour market, I want to make it more attractive and less risky for employers to offer people a permanent contract.
Om de groeiende tweedeling op de arbeidsmarkt aan te pakken, wil ik het voor werkgevers aantrekkelijker en minder risicovol maken om mensen een vast contract aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Poolse vrouwen geïntimideerd op Nederlandse werkvloer’

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about FairWork research on sexual intimidation of Polish women in Dutch workplaces, including what steps will follow its recommendations, whether recruitment agencies will be held responsible, and whether large-scale research is needed. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to employer duties under the Working Conditions Act, Inspectorate SZW oversight, support for migrant-language information, and a forthcoming letter and study on confidential advisers, while rejecting large-scale research for now.
The Ministry of SZW will consult with FairWork to explore how a network of organisations supporting migrant workers in their own language can also give more attention to sexual intimidation.

Het Ministerie van SZW zal in overleg treden met FairWork om te kijken hoe een netwerk van organisaties die arbeidsmigranten ondersteunen in de eigen taal ook meer aandacht kan geven aan het onderwerp seksuele intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de nieuwe spoorbrug bij Weener

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about delays to the Friesenbrücke rail bridge at Weener, including whether repairs could last until 2030 and what the cross-border travel burden is. The state secretary replied that German partners report the project is on schedule for 2024, that the Dutch side keeps pressing for speedy repair at official level, that about 255,000 cross-border travellers are affected by a bus substitute adding roughly 20 minutes, and that delays stem from German planning procedures.
In various high-level official contacts, the German partners are urged to speed up the repair.
In diverse hoogambtelijke contacten wordt richting de Duitse partners aangedrongen op spoedig herstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zieke werknemers zorgaanbieder Carinova moeten werk inhalen’

Two MPs asked the minister whether employees at care provider Carinova being required to make up work missed due to sickness is acceptable, whether this amounts to sickness-absence manipulation contrary to law, and whether the minister will contact Carinova. The minister answered that sick workers must not be pressured, that employers must pay wages during illness, and that the matter is for the parties to resolve; the employer has since withdrawn the disputed protocol, and individual cases are for the courts.
It is up to the parties to engage in dialogue about the situation described in the news report.
Het ligt op de weg van partijen om over de in het nieuwsbericht geschetste situatie het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Luchtwassers werken veel slechter dan gedacht'

Two PvdA MPs asked the government whether odour and air scrubbers perform worse than assumed, why the research report had not been published, and whether it would be released immediately. The government confirmed the study was finished, said single scrubbers met regulatory values while combination scrubbers performed considerably lower, and stated the report and a policy response had been sent to parliament on 3 April 2018.
The performance of the single-stage air scrubbers was in line with the values set out in the regulations.
De prestaties van de enkelvoudige luchtwassers kwamen overeen met de in de regelgeving opgenomen waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de onafhankelijkheid van de bedrijfsarts

An MP asked the minister about the independence of company doctors (bedrijfsartsen) paid by employers, citing a Radar report on pressure on sick workers and confusion about arbo-artsen. The state secretary replied that the legal protections are adequate, that the 2017 Arbowet amendment strengthened the company doctor's position through the basiscontract, that no further measures on funding are planned, and that the effects will be evaluated in 2020.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over dat de fiscus zelden antwoord geeft op zzp vragen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why the tax authority rarely answers freelancer (zzp) questions on sham self-employment, as the Bovib claimed 85% go unanswered. The State Secretary replied that the Tax Authority does not track questions per association, that approved model agreements give legal certainty, and that of 8,026 model-agreement requests, 1,808 were approved and 2,810 rejected, with 3,207 closed for non-response.
It is not always simple to give a judgment (self-employed or sham self-employed) based on the information available in an agreement.
Het is niet eenvoudig om altijd aan de hand van de in een overeenkomst beschikbare informatie een oordeel (zelfstandige/schijnzelfstandige) te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Vertrouwenspersonen #metoo-slachtoffers gedwarsboomd door werkgevers'

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that employers obstruct workplace confidential advisers (vertrouwenspersonen) supporting #metoo victims, and how the government will strengthen their position. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, stressed adviser independence under the Arbowet, and pointed to a forthcoming study and policy response before summer.
A confidential adviser must indeed be sufficiently independent to be able to support victims of unwanted behaviour in confidence.
Een vertrouwenspersoon moet immers in voldoende mate onafhankelijk zijn om in vertrouwen slachtoffers van ongewenst gedrag bij te kunnen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Schiphol Deliveroo inzet voor bezorging aan de gate

An MP asked the government whether Schiphol's partnership with Deliveroo for gate food delivery is desirable given concerns about Deliveroo's worker constructions, and what consequences follow if Deliveroo must abandon its self-employed model. The minister answered that Schiphol's board is responsible for operations and the state as shareholder sees no reason to intervene, and declined to comment on individual taxpayers.
As shareholder, I am not involved in the operational management of Schiphol.
Ik ben als aandeelhouder niet betrokken bij de operationele bedrijfsvoering van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over ‘milieu-overtredende bedrijven die hiermee wegkomen’

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the state secretary whether polluting companies escape accountability and influence government, and whether the ministry consults convicted firms on environmental law. The state secretary rejected the documentary's picture, said prosecutions followed in nearly all major incidents, defended consultation practice without a registration policy, and promised stricter checks that invited firms hold valid environmental permits.
The cabinet has no policy line for dealing with convicted (directors of) companies in consultations on policy and legislation.
Het kabinet kent geen beleidslijn voor het omgaan met veroordeelde (bestuurders van) bedrijven bij consultaties voor beleid en wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Laçin over de toegankelijkheid van het station in Winsum

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why ProRail reversed its earlier plan for a ramp at Winsum station, which was presented in June 2017, and whether the higher cost estimate was credible. The state secretary replied that detailed design showed a ramp needed a costly new foundation (about €2 million), so ProRail chose a new lift (about €500,000) with similar accessibility, and that the cost estimate followed a standard, checked procedure.
ProRail therefore decided in September 2017 to improve accessibility at Winsum station by installing a new lift.
ProRail heeft daarom in september 2017 besloten om de toegankelijkheid van station Winsum te verbeteren door het plaatsen van een nieuwe lift.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de heffing van tol op de Westerscheldetunnel van en naar Zeeuws Vlaanderen

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Zeeuws-Vlaanderen residents must pay toll on the Westerscheldetunnel and whether the toll will be reconsidered. The minister answers that the toll was needed to finance the tunnel, that the province of Zeeland as manager sets the tariffs, and refuses to reconsider, pointing to other regional investments.
This concerns an existing connection for which, as usual, agreements on financing were made.
Het gaat hier om een bestaande verbinding waarover zoals gebruikelijk afspraken zijn gemaakt over de financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het mogelijk schrappen van de belangrijke afslag Goudse Poort op de A12 bij Gouda

An MP asked the minister whether the Goudse Poort exit on the A12 near Gouda, which may be closed as an option in the A20 widening project, would harm Gouda's accessibility, and asked how affected parties would be involved. The minister confirmed the closure is an alternative under study for road-safety and traffic-flow reasons, not yet decided, and said Gouda and business representatives take part in the consultation process.
These concerns are known to both Rijkswaterstaat and the province of Zuid-Holland.
Deze zorgen zijn bekend bij zowel Rijkswaterstaat als de provincie Zuid-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘voorbereiding kernramp kan beter’

MPs Ploumen and Van Dijk asked whether the government accepts the Safety Board's findings that the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany are inadequately prepared for a nuclear disaster, and how it will improve information to the public and cross-border cooperation. The state secretary accepts the Board's recommendations, promises a cabinet response with specific measures, says the ANVS will make incident information more accessible, and says cross-border issues will be raised in bilateral talks.
I endorse the recommendations of the OVV.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen van de OVV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie dat Uber een taxibedrijf is

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the EU Court of Justice ruling that Uber is a taxi company means Uber must follow Dutch taxi rules, whether Uber acts as an employer of its drivers, and whether the government will enforce against disguised self-employment. The minister answered that the ruling changes nothing for Dutch taxi regulation, that enforcement targets individual licensed drivers, that independent research on the gig economy is underway, and that tax authorities do not comment on individual cases.
It is for the tax inspector, and if disagreement persists for a judge, to assess the facts and circumstances of an individual case.
Het is aan de belastinginspecteur en bij blijvend verschil van mening aan een rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van een individueel geval te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de enorme vertraging van de ombouw van de Hoekse Lijn tot lightrail

An MP asked the state secretary why the conversion of the Hoekse Lijn to light rail was delayed beyond the promised September 2017 opening, who is accountable, and about secrecy and cost overruns. The secretary answered that the regional authority MRDH is responsible for the line, that the new target is Q4 2018 due to late software and cable delays, and that the MRDH, not the ministry, bears the extra costs (up to 90 million euro).
I have no special responsibility for the Hoekse Lijn.
Ik heb geen bijzondere verantwoordelijkheid voor de Hoekse Lijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 21 december 2017 over honderden oudere leerkrachten die graag nog  voor de klas hadden willen staan, maar die werkloos thu

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education whether older teachers forced into unemployment via settlement agreements contributed to primary-school staff shortages and whether the 2012-era dismissals and policy were sensible. The minister answered that no data exist to verify the claim, that school boards are responsible for staffing decisions, and that measures such as a return-to-work subsidy and a Participatiefonds plan to reintegrate the unemployed teachers are being pursued.
There is no data available on the basis of which this question can be answered.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar op grond waarvan deze vraag kan worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het bericht dat een huiseigenaar alleen wil verhuren aan ‘mensen van Nederlandse afkomst'

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether a landlord refusing to rent to people not of Dutch origin is discrimination, what victims can do, and what measures will prevent it, including whether estate agents should refuse such requests and whether the sector will be engaged. The minister answered that discrimination is prohibited, pointed to the Equal Treatment Act, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and local anti-discrimination services, noted the brokerage associations' codes of conduct, and said the issue will be raised in upcoming consultations with the sector.

In the upcoming consultations with the brokerage associations and the umbrella organisations of private landlords I will discuss whether enough attention is being paid in practice to preventing discrimination.

In de eerstvolgende overleggen met de brancheverenigingen voor makelaars en de koepelorganisaties van particuliere verhuurders zal ik in gesprek gaan over of er in de praktijk voldoende aandacht is om discriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Nog altijd kindhuwelijken in Nederland’

Two Labour MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that child marriages persist in the Netherlands despite the ban, and what measures were taken, including outreach to community key figures, an integrated action plan, and support for girls trapped in marriages. The minister answered that prior measures were implemented (a handbook, training, the LKHA knowledge centre, criminalisation of forced marriage, shelters) and that no new action plan would be started, while confirming outreach to boys follows the same chain.
Therefore no new action plan will be started.
Er zal derhalve geen nieuw actieplan worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gijs van Dijk over het rekruteren van arbeidsgehandicapten voor sekswerk

MPs Jasper and Gijs van Dijk asked why 2016 questions about the website werkenmetwajong.nl, which recruits Wajong beneficiaries with disabilities for sex work, were never answered, and asked what was done to prevent abuse and where complaints can be filed. The State Secretary says the earlier questions were not answered by agreement with the MPs to avoid drawing more attention to the site, now answers them, and says he knows of no complaints, directing people to UWV and private complaint platforms.
My predecessor, in consultation with the questioners, decided not to answer the parliamentary questions.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in overleg met de vragenstellers besloten de Kamervragen niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de bezuiniging op mensen met een handicap

MP Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary whether the coalition's replacement of wage-cost subsidies with wage-dispensation for disabled workers, reported as a 500 million euro cut, should be scrapped and whether it is budget-driven. The state secretary denied it is a cut, described it as reallocation of funds, and stated that new employees will earn above the social minimum and that the regulation will be detailed later.
There is no question of a cut but of a reallocation of funds for people with work disabilities.
Er is geen sprake van een bezuiniging maar van herallocatie van middelen voor mensen met arbeidsbeperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Gijs van Dijk over de "carve out van gepensioneerden".

MPs Lodders and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension funds considering a carve-out for pensioners are blocked by the Pensioenwet, and whether the law should be changed now. The minister answered that no funds are known to be seriously considering a carve-out, that it could bring advantages but also risks such as broken solidarity, and that its fate should be decided together with the wider pension reform, so the legal barriers are not lifted immediately.

Distinguishing between the pension assets and the investment policy of the active and deferred participants and of the pensioner group is an interesting route that is also being examined in the context of renewing the pension system.

Het onderscheid maken tussen het pensioenvermogen en het beleggingsbeleid van de groep actieve en gewezen deelnemers en van de groep gepensioneerden is een interessante route die ook in het kader van vernieuwing van het pensioenstelsel wordt bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraken van de president-directeur van ProRail over spoorlopers

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary whether ProRail's chief executive's remarks that train drivers should brake less quickly for track trespassers were irresponsible, whether he would ask the CEO to retract them, and what measures would reduce trespassing. The state secretary said safety comes first, that driver instructions are the responsibility of operators, that ProRail alone must decide on retracting its CEO's statements, and pointed to existing enforcement and anti-trespass measures.
The chief executive of ProRail decides for himself whether or not to retract his statements.
De president-directeur van ProRail gaat zelf over het al dan niet terugnemen van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de voorgenomen sluiting van een grote truckparking bij Venlo en het gebrek aan goede alternatieven

An MP asked the minister about the planned closure of the De Keulse Barrière truck parking near Venlo and the lack of free or affordable alternatives for drivers, which may push drivers toward rest-time violations. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is working with municipalities and others under a 2015 convenant, a private paid truck park has opened in Venlo, a court ruling requires partial weekday opening of De Keulse Barrière, and the ILT can read rest times from tachographs, while committing to talks and a programme approach on corridor parking.
Whether and to what extent Eastern European drivers receive a reimbursement to use paid facilities is not known to me.
Of en in welke mate Oost-Europese chauffeurs een vergoeding krijgen om gebruik te maken van betaalde voorzieningen is bij mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse truckers die niet meer naar Engeland rijden vanwege agressie door verstekelingen

MPs Gijs and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch truckers have stopped driving to England because of violence by stowaways and what the government is doing about it. The minister says there is no general picture of companies halting England routes, cites ongoing EU-level cooperation, secure parking funding via CEF and joint anti-crime work with industry, and reports contact with transport associations.
According to the information currently available to me, there is no general picture of transport companies in the Netherlands no longer driving to England because of aggression by stowaways.

Volgens de mij op dit moment beschikbare informatie is er geen sprake van een algemeen beeld dat transportondernemingen in Nederland niet meer naar Engeland rijden vanwege agressie door verstekelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het mogelijke baanverlies bij Tata Steel

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about job losses and the independence of Tata Steel Nederland after its planned merger with ThyssenKrupp, including whether the merger should be blocked if it involves forced layoffs. The minister said the government supported a strong IJmuiden position and would monitor developments closely, but would not block the merger, relying on a workforce pact and natural attrition to limit layoffs.
Banning the merger is not on the table, but I will bring Dutch interests to the attention of the Tata Group management where necessary.
De fusie verbieden is niet aan de orde, maar ik zal waar nodig de Nederlandse belangen onder de aandacht brengen van de directie van Tata Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdamse werkgevers hun neus ophalen voor MBO’ers

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about a report that Amsterdam employers demand too high qualifications from MBO graduates, and whether this disadvantages low-educated and other groups. Minister Asscher answered that the labour market is improving, that the evidence on higher requirements is qualitative and contested, and pointed to existing policy instruments without committing to a new concrete step.
The UWV gives no quantitative substantiation here, so there is no indication of the size of this difference.
Het UWV geeft hierbij geen cijfermatige onderbouwing, waardoor er geen indicatie voorhanden is van de omvang van dit verschil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over drempels bij het gebruik van de blijverslening

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the blijverslening (a municipal-backed loan for home adaptations for seniors) is excluding people with only a small AOW or pension who have home equity, and how many municipalities use the scheme. The minister answered that loan limits are set by income norms and that 59 municipalities offer the loan, and that the SVn is developing a new product for low-income seniors expected in mid-2018.
This product is expected to be offered to municipalities around mid-2018.
Dit product zal naar verwachting medio 2018 aangeboden worden aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het beëindigen van de collectieve zorgverzekering voor minima door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether Zilveren Kruis ending its collective health insurance contracts for low-income people in three municipalities undermines solidarity and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary answered that contracts are extended one year where no alternative exists, that insurers must accept everyone but need not offer collectives, that municipalities choose their own instruments, and that VWS is not a party to negotiations but has spoken with the insurer.
Health insurers have the social duty to insure all Dutch residents, but not the obligation to accept everyone for all collectives.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben de maatschappelijke taak om alle Nederlanders te verzekeren, maar niet de verplichting om iedereen voor alle collectiviteiten te accepteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Beckerman en Gijs van Dijk over werkbezoek aan de Reede van Texel waar historische scheepswrakken uit de 16e, 17e en 18e eeuw in de zeebodem dreigen te vergaan en over het congres ‘SO

MPs from CDA, SP and PvdA asked whether the government will act on the erosion of historic shipwrecks in Dutch coastal waters, including a programmatic approach requested by coastal provinces, a bigger role for volunteer divers, adjusted working-conditions rules for diving, and a national maritime archaeology museum. The minister acknowledged the erosion problem, said talks with the provinces aim for initial agreements by end 2017 and a proposal in spring 2018, committed to consulting amateur diving associations on an exemption, said the working-conditions rules will be examined with the Social Affairs minister, and argued that maritime heritage is already displayed across several museums.
We have agreed to reach initial agreements by the end of 2017.
We hebben afgesproken om voor het einde van 2017 tot eerste afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over een buitensporige ontslagvergoeding voor een ziekenhuisdirecteur en beloningen van medisch specialisten in het Noorden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked about a severance payment of over a quarter million euros to a hospital department head at Nij Smellinghe, whether the WNT pay cap allows buying out waiting-benefit entitlements, and why medical specialists in the north earn above the Balkende norm. The minister answered that the individual severance cases fall to the accountant and the WNT supervisor (CIBG), that no change to the WNT is planned, and that medical specialists were removed from the WNT's scope from 1 July 2017, so their pay is no longer published.
A severance payment to a non-top official is not capped under the WNT, because the WNT only caps the pay and severance of top officials.
Een ontslagvergoeding aan een niet-topfunctionaris wordt niet genormeerd in het kader van de WNT, omdat de WNT alleen de bezoldiging en ontslagvergoedingen van topfunctionarissen normeert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de rol van een ondernemingsraad na een doorstart bij faillissement

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice Minister whether a Supreme Court ruling extends works council advisory rights to bankruptcy sales and going-concern takeovers, and whether it requires advice before a doorstart and helps prevent abusive dismissals. The minister confirmed the ruling applies WOR advisory rights to continuation or doorstart of bankrupt businesses where jobs may be preserved, but not to liquidation by the curator, and said the topic will be addressed in the faillissementsrecht reform programme with a fuller update due in September.
I will inform you further on this subject in mid-September, in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law renewal programme.
Ik zal u medio september, in de volgende voortgangsbrief van het programma herijking faillissementsrecht, nader over dit onderwerp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de matige loongroei en flexibilisering

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Social Affairs about moderate wage growth, whether labour market flexibilisation explains it, and whether research and action on flexibility, pensions and insurance for self-employed workers are warranted. The minister said wage growth is moderate mainly because of unused labour supply and that there is no one-to-one proof linking flexibility to wages, and promised to consult the CPB and DNB on whether additional research is needed.
I will discuss this with the CPB and DNB and examine whether additional research is needed.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met het CPB en DNB en bezien of aanvullend onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over fraude met reiskostenvergoedingen voor Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten in de scheepsbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about large travel-cost allowances on payslips of Eastern European agency workers in shipbuilding, suspected of evading social premiums, and whether payslips meet WAS transparency and language requirements. The minister answered that allowances must be specified and that the Inspectorate can fine violations and pass signals to the Tax Authority, but declined to comment on ongoing investigations and did not commit to a new inquiry.
As is customary, I do not comment on any ongoing investigations by the Labour Inspectorate.
Zoals gebruikelijk doe ik geen uitspraken over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de bezorgplannen van McDonald’s en Uber Eats

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about McDonald's partnership with Uber Eats for food delivery, including whether delivery workers, who are self-employed, are adequately insured and whether the government will talk to the companies and prepare a plan for a new cabinet. The minister said companies are responsible for their own arrangements within existing law, noted that self-employed workers can choose to insure themselves, referred to a minimum wage change from 2018 and existing studies, and left the policy choices to a new cabinet.
It is not for the government to prescribe to companies how they should organise their business processes.
Het is niet aan de overheid om bedrijven voor te schrijven hoe zij hun bedrijfsprocessen dienen in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat accountants willen stoppen met de controle van topinkomens

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior whether the complexity of auditing top public-sector salaries under the WNT could reduce oversight or weaken the norm, whether non-top officials and interims should be capped at a minister's salary, and whether non-accountants should perform the checks. The minister agreed oversight must not be lost or the norm weakened, said he would explore with the profession ways to reduce audit burden, left the WNT-3 extension decision to the next cabinet, and rejected replacing accountants as auditors.
I share the view that the complexity of the audit must not deprive oversight of top incomes in the (semi-)public sector.
Ik deel de mening dat de complexiteit van de controle het zicht niet mag ontnemen op de topinkomens in de (semi-)publieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over inwerkperiodes tegen nultarieven voor zelfstandigen bij Rijkswaterstaat

An MP asked the ministers whether Rijkswaterstaat's contracts with intermediaries that impose zero-cost onboarding periods on self-employed workers shift onboarding costs onto them, and whether the government will stop such arrangements. The ministers answered that the contract places replacement and onboarding costs on the contractor, that the intermediary's zero-tariff wording was a mistranslation it has acknowledged, and that the ministry raised the matter with the contractor, which is reconsidering its approach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over particuliere verhuurders die massaal van vaste huurcontracten af willen ten gunste van tijdelijke huurcontracten en de huren fors verhogen

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the Minister of the Interior whether private landlords in Amsterdam are using temporary contracts and periodic rent increases to push out tenants with fixed contracts, and whether this misuses the 2015 temporary-lease law and was promised against. Minister Plasterk answered that fixed contracts cannot simply be terminated, that rent can be harmonised at re-letting, that the government will monitor temporary lease use and report in the autumn State of the Housing Market, and that he is willing to talk with Amsterdam.
It is therefore not possible for a landlord to terminate the rent of a dwelling in order to then only conclude temporary contracts.
Het is dus voor een verhuurder niet mogelijk om de huur van een woning te beëindigen teneinde vervolgens alleen nog maar tijdelijke contracten af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over 5 mei als verplichte vrije dag

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Prime Minister whether 5 May (Liberation Day) should be a mandatory day off, given that it is not a standard day off for most Dutch workers while other public holidays are. The minister replied that collective agreements between social partners decide paid holidays, that the government itself made 5 May a day off for civil servants in 1982, and that it will not legislate or negotiate with social partners to make it mandatory.
My ministry has no insight into the costs to the Dutch economy if all employees were given Liberation Day off.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen zicht op de kosten voor de Nederlandse economie wanneer alle werknemers op Bevrijdingsdag vrij krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de inzet van Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten bij sociale werkplaatsen

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary whether Eastern European temporary agency workers are being deployed at sheltered workplaces, displacing people with disabilities, and what action will be taken. The state secretary answered that use is only incidental, that it does not displace regular workers, that gemeenten are responsible, and that no measures are considered necessary, while pointing to existing programmes to help people reach the labour market.
As the answers above show, I see no need to take measures.
Zoals uit de beantwoording van bovenstaande vragen blijkt, zie ik geen noodzaak tot het treffen van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden bij Damen Shiprepair

An MP asked the minister about alleged abuses at Damen Shiprepair, including dismissal of permanent staff replaced by cheaper flex workers, poor housing of foreign workers, union access, and an integrated enforcement approach. The minister answered that dismissals replacing staff with cheaper workers would be refused by UWV, pointed to existing housing rules and inspection fines, affirmed union access rights subject to rules, and said existing cooperation among agencies is working.
That permission will not be granted if the intention is to replace permanent employees with cheaper and/or flexible workers while the work in nature and scope does not change at all.
Die toestemming wordt niet verleend als het de bedoeling is vaste werknemers te vervangen door goedkopere en/of flexibele werknemers terwijl het werk naar aard en omvang in het geheel niet wijzigt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over ontwikkelingen rondom het Road Package van de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers about the European Commission's Road Package on road transport, including fears of social dumping, worse working conditions for truck drivers, and whether the Netherlands will press for tighter cabotage rules and action against letterbox companies. The minister replied that the Commission's proposals were not yet published (expected 31 May), so their content could not yet be assessed, and pointed to a 2014 joint ministerial declaration calling for better implementation of EU law; the answer to the cabotage and Road Alliance questions is largely pending.
Only then will it be possible for me to assess the content of the proposals.
Het is voor mij dan pas mogelijk om de inhoud van de voorstellen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij Rotterdam The Hague Airport discrimineert

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Defence about an Ombudsman finding that the Marechaussee at Rotterdam The Hague Airport discriminates, asking whether there are more signals, what is done to prevent ethnic profiling, and whether objective criteria for checks are needed. The government reports ten complaints since 2014, sees no reason for further investigation, states non-discrimination is the starting point and profiles are used with objective indicators, and says the KMar continually reviews its criteria.
These profiles are confidential and are used internally.
Deze profielen zijn vertrouwelijk en worden intern gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal in Rusland in 2018

Two MPs asked the government about reports of forced labour and modern slavery among North Korean workers building a World Cup stadium in Russia, whether this breaches sanctions, and what Dutch action is possible. The minister said the reports are serious, that FIFA should investigate and that the Netherlands will press for action in EU and UN settings, while noting the sanctions do not ban such employment.
The cabinet expects FIFA to investigate this matter thoroughly and to take the results of the investigation seriously.
Het kabinet verwacht van de FIFA dat het deze zaak grondig onderzoekt en de resultaten van het onderzoek serieus neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "het WIA-stelsel waarbij hoge inkomens eerder een volledige arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering krijgen dan lage inkomens".

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether under the WIA disability scheme identical health complaints can lead to different disability classes depending on income, and whether this is unfair. Minister Asscher answered that income loss is the basis by design, so a higher earner with the same residual earning capacity can receive a higher percentage, and he sees no reason to change this.
I therefore see no reason to change this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het bedrijf moet blijven. FNV voert actie: Ziegler aan de ketting’ van RTV-Noord

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the planned relocation of part of Ziegler's fire-engine production from Winschoten to Croatia, its effect on fire-service readiness, union negotiations, jobs and procurement criteria. The minister answered that fire-service procurement and negotiations are matters for the safety regions and employers and unions, that no signals of reduced readiness exist, that about twenty of roughly 75 jobs are affected, and that general employment policy and UWV support apply.
Negotiations over whether to relocate business activities are a matter for employers and employees.
Onderhandelingen over het al dan niet verplaatsen van bedrijfsactiviteiten zijn een zaak van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat er binnen de gehele overheid informatieveiligheid nodig is

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government as a whole needs investment in information security, faster adoption of modern security standards and a legal obligation for them, following reports on 700 critical vulnerabilities in Rotterdam's systems. The minister answered that the government will consider the Digital Commissioner's study group advice, cites ongoing standardisation efforts and a planned GDI bill, and says no overall data exists on municipal security incidents.
There is therefore no comprehensive overview with the depth of a local audit office investigation.
Er is dus geen allesomvattend overzicht met de diepte van een lokaal rekenkameronderzoek.

m: Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over de taakomschrijving van de NZa in aanvullende samenwerkingsafspraken uitwerken
Asks the government to elaborate the NZa's early-warning task in supplementary cooperation agreements, including a defined timeframe for warning parties about risks to youth care supply.
requests the government to elaborate the NZa's task description in supplementary cooperation agreements
verzoekt de regering de taakomschrijving van de NZa in aanvullende samenwerkingsafspraken uit te werken
Motie van het lid Van den Hil over een consultatiefunctie ggz voor de jeugdzorg
Asks the government to examine whether the consultation function for mental health care can be extended to youth care and whether clearer agreements can be made.
asks the government to examine as soon as possible whether the existing possibilities for a mental health consultation function for youth care can be broadened
verzoekt de regering om zo snel mogelijk te onderzoeken of de bestaande mogelijkheden voor een consultatiefunctie ggz voor de jeugdzorg kunnen worden verbreed

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Stoffer en Van den Hil ter vervanging van nr. 31 over een minimum van vijfentwintig jeugdhulpverleners voordat een ambulante jeugdhulpaanbieder een toezichthoudende s

Amendment raising the threshold for youth care providers offering only ambulatory care to need an internal supervisory body from more than ten to more than twenty-five staff, keeping ten for residential care.
Signatories however believe the government's proposal is disproportionate given the regulatory burden
Ondergetekenden menen echter dat het voorstel van de regering disproportioneel is gelet op de regeldruk
Motie van het lid Van den Hil over de nadruk in de jeugdzorg verschuiven naar collectieve voorzieningen
Asks the government to map how the Youth Act can shift emphasis from individual provisions to collective provisions and to inform municipalities.
requests the government to map how the Youth Act can place more emphasis on collective provisions
verzoekt de regering om in kaart te brengen op welke manier binnen de Jeugdwet de nadruk meer kan komen te liggen op collectieve voorzieningen
Motie van het lid Crijns c.s. over elke twee jaar een rapport opstellen over de verplichte regionale samenwerking
Asks the government to report to the House every two years on how the mandatory regional cooperation in youth care is working.
requests the government to prepare a report every two years after entry into force on the functioning of the mandatory regional cooperation, and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering om elke twee jaar na inwerkingtreding een rapport op te stellen over de werking van de verplichte regionale samenwerking, en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid Van den Hil c.s. over een consult jeugdhulp zonder indicatie binnen twee jaar
Motion asking the government to allow young people to receive a youth care consultation without a new referral within two years after ending youth care.
requests the government to make it possible for young people to receive a youth care consultation without a referral within two years after their youth care relationship ends
verzoekt de regering om mogelijk te maken dat jongeren binnen twee jaar nadat hun jeugdhulprelatie eindigt, zonder indicatie weer een consult jeugdhulp kunnen ontvangen

Amendement van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hil ter vervanging van nr. 11 over een voorhangprocedure bij de amvb-grondslag die bepaalt welke onderwerpen in ieder geval in de regiovisie moeten worden
Requires that the AMvB determining which topics must be included in the regional vision under the Youth Act be submitted to parliament in advance (voorhang).
must be submitted to parliament in advance
Amendement van het lid Van den Hil over een evaluatie van het wetsvoorstel en alle onderliggende regelingen
Extends the planned evaluation of the act to cover the underlying regulations (algemene maatregelen van bestuur and ministerial rules) that the act provides a basis for.
ensures that all underlying regulations for which this bill provides a basis are also included in the evaluation
regelt dat alle onderliggende regelingen waar dit wetsvoorstel een grondslag voor biedt, ook worden meegenomen in de evaluatie
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 117 over middelen voor de KNWU ten behoeve van een landelijke richtlijn burgermotorverkeersregelaars bij wielerkoersen
Shifts 215,000 euro within the sport budget to fund a national KNWU guideline for civilian traffic marshals at cycling races.
The coverage for this amendment is found within the funds still available for spending under article 6, sport and exercise.
De dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden binnen de nog vrij te besteden middelen op artikel 6, sport en bewegen.

The State Secretary disputes the amounts, says fraud cannot be reliably measured, outlines municipal responsibilities and tools, and points to forthcoming legislation (Wbsrz, Wmo amendment) and a stimulation programme.

I am currently preparing an amendment to the Wmo that sets out further frameworks for the organisation of Wmo supervision, the independent functioning of the supervisor and transparency in supervision, such as publication of supervisory reports.

Momenteel bereid ik een wijziging van de Wmo voor waarin nadere kaders worden gesteld voor de inrichting van het Wmo-toezicht, het onafhankelijk functioneren van de toezichthouder en transparantie in het toezicht, zoals de openbaarmaking van toezichtrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel ‘GGz Breburg wil verder met mentale gezondheidscentra, maar het systeem stokt’

MP Van den Hil asked the Minister of Health about reports that mental health centres' 'verkennend gesprek' (exploratory conversation) model is stalling for lack of funding, and whether IZA transition funds can bridge 2024. The Minister agrees the model is valuable, says 2024 funding runs via an existing facultative performance and a 2025 separate performance is being pursued, notes transition funds cannot cover patient-bound care, and commits to pushing for a solution.
To arrange funding from 2025, I aim to submit a directive to the NZa to both chambers as soon as possible.
Om de bekostiging per 2025 te regelen streef ik ernaar om zo snel mogelijk een aanwijzing aan de NZa voor te hangen bij beide Kamers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over “Ik bied u mijn oudere handen aan het bed. Maar waarom moet ik dan opnieuw leren rekenen.”

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the health minister about barriers facing older career changers entering care work, including repeated language and maths requirements for mbo training.
