The minister agreed that entry should be low-threshold, pointed to certificate modules, exemption rules and TAZ programme steps, and promised a progress report before summer.
It is important that entry into care is as low-threshold as possible, while the quality of care is guaranteed.
Het is van belang dat de (zij)instroom in de zorg zo laagdrempelig mogelijk is, waarbij de kwaliteit van zorg gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over de brief van Stichting Zeeuwse Zorgschakels aangaande casemanagement dementie die is gestuurd aan alle relaties

An MP asks the minister about a letter from a Zeeland care foundation warning that independent dementia case management may be absorbed into large home-care organisations, raising concerns about independence and loss of shared expertise. The minister answers that independence is guaranteed by the Zorgstandaard Dementie regardless of employer, that shared knowledge should be kept, and commits to commissioning a costing study of dementia case management.
I assume that dementia case management is provided independently in accordance with the Zorgstandaard Dementie 2020.
Ik ga ervan uit dat casemanagement dementie onafhankelijk wordt geleverd conform de Zorgstandaard Dementie 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Veel agressie tegen artsen op spoedeisende hulp: ‘We willen hulp van de politie én de politiek’'

An MP asks the health minister how the government will tackle rising aggression against hospital emergency staff, including proposals on screening, training, ending treatment relationships, mandatory anti-aggression courses, prison sentences and employer reporting. The minister answers that prevention and reporting policy is primarily the employer's responsibility, lists ongoing measures and motions, and says several points are still under review or to be discussed with other ministers.
I will raise this again at the labour market administrative consultation on 7 March.
Ik zal dit tijdens het bestuurlijk overleg arbeidsmarkt van 7 maart aanstaande (nogmaals) bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Kinderdagverblijven en bso's gebruiken vaker trucs om omzet te verhogen’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare providers are increasingly using tricks such as package changes, extended opening hours and billing for closures, and how this is monitored and how parents can complain. The minister answered that no overview of the scale or financial effects exists because these are private contracts, promised a sample study, dialogue with the complaints committee, clarification of the public holiday rule, and sector transparency measures.
There is no overview of the scale at which the practices described in the article are applied.
Er is geen overzicht op welke schaal de praktijken uit het artikel worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht Agressie tegen huisartsen steeds heftiger, soms zelfs permanente bewaking nodig'

An MP asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport about rising aggression against GPs, incident figures per sector, prevention measures, use of an amendment earmarking funds for first-line care, the professional secrecy obstacle to filing police reports, and how to increase reporting willingness. The minister said there is no national incident count, that survey data show no clear trend, that VWS supports sector-specific approaches and a first-line study, that professional secrecy does not prevent reporting crimes, and that regional meetings and a podcast or webinar will be organised.
Care organisations themselves record how many incidents occur in their organisation, provided these are reported by their employees.
Zorgorganisaties houden zelf bij hoeveel incidenten er plaats vinden in hun organisatie, mits deze gemeld worden door hun werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Smals over het artikel 'Zorgmedewerker in verkapte loondienst aangepakt: 'Enorm probleem'; 'Bureaus agressief aan het werven''

MPs Van den Hil and Smals asked the Minister for Long-term Care about bogus self-employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) in healthcare, agency recruitment, a proposed quota and a conduct code for intermediaries, the new professional control law, and collective agreement flexibility. The minister answered that no data exist on involuntary self-employment, that a sector control model and a conduct code are being developed, and that the Wkkgz amendment on staff influence is being implemented.
No figures are available on this specific question.
Over deze specifieke vraag zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel “Zorgen om kinderdagverblijven en bso’s: ‘Ernstige incidenten zijn topje van ijsberg'"

A Member of Parliament asks about high-risk profiles (oranje/rood) for childcare locations, regional differences, and the causes including staff shortages, and whether risk profiles should be public. The minister responds that risk profiles are estimates rather than inspection verdicts, describes ongoing studies, planned incident reporting duties, a new quality monitor, and staffing measures, and states that publication of risk profiles is up to the GGDs and municipalities.
It is up to the GGDs and municipalities to assess whether it is desirable to make the risk profiles public.
Het is aan de GGD’en en gemeenten om te beoordelen of het wenselijk is om de risicoprofielen openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Bespuugd, gebeten, uitgescholden. In Drenthe, Groningen en Friesland heeft 80 procent van zorgmedewerkers te maken met geweld op de werkvloer’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about violence against care workers in the northern provinces, including duties on care employers to report incidents to police, training orders for aggressors, the status of a motion on prison sentences, a central reporting point, and whether care workers can terminate treatment agreements with aggressive patients. The minister answered each question, committing to regional meetings, a learning network, a central reporting point under discussion, and further analysis of a sentencing ban, while declining to introduce new statutory duties beyond existing rules.
I have raised the employer filing reports issue at the cabinet committee on the labour market on 31 May.
Ik heb het doen van aangifte door werkgever onder de aandacht gebracht tijdens het BO Arbeidsmarkt van 31 mei jl.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over de berichten 'Jongeren stellen eigen diagnoses via TikTok: ‘Als je dit herkent heb je ADHD’' en 'De TikTok psycholoog is in opkomst: ‘Als je deze vie

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about news reports on young people self-diagnosing mental health conditions via TikTok and on unreliable 'TikTok psychologist' advice, asking for research on consultations, action against medical misinformation and clearer mental health information for youth. The State Secretary said no data are kept on such consultations and that collecting it would burden professionals, pointed to Digital Services Act obligations on platforms, and announced a study this autumn into a more coherent, findable mental health information offer.
In the RTL Nieuws article, the vice-chair of the NIP states that it is not recorded whether young people more often report to the GP as a result of such videos.
In het artikel van RTL nieuws geeft de vicevoorzitter van het NIP aan dat niet wordt bijgehouden of jongeren zich vaker melden bij de huisarts als gevolg van dergelijke video’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht 'Zorgwekkend aniossentekort in ziekenhuizen'

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the government about reported shortages of residents-in-training (aniossen) in hospitals, their working hours, employer responsibilities, and the role of physician assistants and nurse specialists. The minister answered that the Capaciteitsorgaan is researching the issue, that intake of PAs and VSs will be expanded from 2025–2026, and that working conditions and employer responsibility are mainly matters between employers and employees, with initiatives under the TAZ programme.

The Capaciteitsorgaan is currently researching the concrete composition of various groups of basic doctors as well as the reasons why basic doctors do or do not progress to certain postgraduate medical training programmes.

Het Capaciteitsorgaan doet op dit moment onderzoek naar de concrete samenstelling van verschillende groepen basisartsen alsmede de redenen voor het wel of niet doorstromen van basisartsen naar bepaalde geneeskundige vervolgopleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Miljoenen voor actieplan dakloosheid dreigen niet juist te worden uitgegeven: ‘Schandalig’

MPs Van den Hil and Verkuijlen asked the state secretary about a report that municipalities plan to spend the national homelessness action plan funds mainly on prevention rather than housing and financial security, and about youth transition between the Youth Act and Wmo. The state secretary disputed that the report proves misuse, noted that other funding streams and the housing ministry are involved, cited a dashboard and existing policy on youth transition, and committed to ongoing dialogue without a concrete new measure.
Care is needed when drawing conclusions about how municipalities spend the funds and whether this is in line with the National Action Plan on Homelessness or not.
Er is zorgvuldigheid geboden bij het trekken van conclusies over hoe gemeenten de middelen besteden en of dat wel of niet in lijn is met het Nationaal Actieplan Dakloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van den Hil over het treinvervangend busvervoer in Zeeland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about replacement bus service in Zeeland that failed stranded travellers, asking how NS oversees it, why app information was wrong, and how it will be improved. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, said NS is responsible under the concession and will be held to account, and committed to lessons learned and a check before Roze Zaterdag, which went well.
In such cases I expect NS to learn from the situation and apply these lessons to improve replacement rail transport in the future.
In dergelijke gevallen verwacht ik van NS dat zij lering trekt uit de situatie en deze lessen meeneemt om het treinvervangend vervoer in de toekomst te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Van den Hil, Van der Plas en Stoffer over het bericht dat Meander opvanglocaties voor schipperskinderen sluit in Maasbracht, Nieuwegein, Lemmer en Terneuzen

MPs asked whether the government will prevent the closure of four boarding houses for bargee children run by Stichting Meander and whether the economic claim right on the buildings blocks relocation. The State Secretary answered that closures are a business decision for the boarding houses, that talks are ongoing and the KPMG study will be shared before summer, and that Meander is not blocked from moving to smaller locations.
The Ministry of VWS is currently in talks with the Meander bargee boarding house, so we cannot agree with the term 'stuck in the Ministry of Health's procedures'.

Het Ministerie van VWS is momenteel in gesprek met schippersinternaat Meander, dus in de term «vastlopen in de procedures van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport » kunnen wij ons niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hil en Ellian over het bericht ‘Geef crisisdienst direct toegang tot hoger beveiligde bedden’

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government will give crisis services direct access to high-security psychiatric beds, how many such beds exist per province, and what it will do about shortages. The minister rejected direct access, citing the need for proper assessment and placement, reported 1737 secured beds in 2022 and pointed to a dashboard, a coordination point, regional inventories and a joint evaluation as measures.
We do not consider it desirable to give crisis services direct access to high-security care.
We vinden het niet wenselijk om crisisdiensten direct toegang te geven tot de (hoog) beveiligde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kwaliteit kinderopvang Caribisch Nederland moet omhoog, zegt Onderwijsinspectie'

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the minister about the Education Inspectorate's finding that childcare quality in the Caribbean Netherlands must improve, the sanctions imposed, how the findings feed into the pending childcare bill, and whether expanding capacity risks quality. The minister fully endorses the inspectorate's findings, explains the historical causes and the ongoing improvement programme, states that enforcement lies with the island authorities and no sanctions were needed so far, and says the bill will not be changed but will consult island authorities on a 'strict at the gate' approach.
If it is clear in advance that a childcare organisation cannot meet these requirements, it is undesirable to admit the organisation to the childcare system.
Als op voorhand duidelijk is dat een kinderopvangorganisatie niet in staat is om aan deze eisen te voldoen dan is het onwenselijk om de organisatie toe te laten tot het kinderopvangstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Opinie: "We moeten meer tandartsen opleiden, maar hoe dan?"'

MPs Van den Hil and Van der Woude asked the ministers of Education and of Health about the shortage of dentists, regional disparities, the status of motions on shortening training and task-shifting, and whether ministries will make firm agreements on training. The ministers replied that a joint policy response to the Capacity Council advice will be sent to Parliament this spring, and that the task-shifting experiment evaluation is expected at end 2023, but they did not give concrete numbers or commitments on specific training expansions.
This spring a joint policy response by VWS and OCW to the Capacity Council advice will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Dit voorjaar zal een gezamenlijke beleidsreactie van VWS en OCW op het advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan aan de Kamer worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van Campen en Sahla over het bericht “Veel vraag naar kinderopvang bij boer, maar regels belemmeren uitbreiding”

MPs Van den Hil, Van Campen and Sahla asked about reports that rules hinder agricultural childcare on farms, and about the obstacles raised by sector bodies, municipal zoning tied to farm turnover, staffing, health effects and next steps. The ministers answered that a 'Life event' regulatory review with VNG, LTO and the Chamber of Commerce is underway, that the Multifunctional Agriculture and Spatial Planning guidance is being updated, and that they see no evidence that agricultural childcare is disadvantaged on quality or staffing.
We are in discussion with the parties involved about the obstacles that have been raised.
Met de betrokken partijen zijn we in gesprek over de belemmeringen die zijn aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Westerveld en Van den Hil  over het sluiten van Emergis

MPs Van den Berg, Westerveld and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the closure of the autism clinic at Emergis, the availability of ggz beds and outpatient places, definitions of crucial mental health care, GP practice support staff and the zorgprestatiemodel tariffs. The minister answered that regional overviews and an inventory of crucial ggz are being compiled, that bed-level data per patient group is not available, and that remaining patients will be placed at Emergis or in their own region.
Meanwhile the IZA parties are working to map the match between supply and demand of care in the regional pictures.
Wel werken de IZA-partijen aan het in beeld krijgen van de aansluiting van vraag en aanbod van zorg in de regiobeelden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van den Hil over het bericht dat de sluiting van rijtestlocaties definitief is

MPs Koerhuis and Van den Hil asked the minister about the definitive closure of driving-test locations, including Terneuzen, and why only Winschoten was reopened. The minister replied that the 2016 CBR evaluation and 2018 client survey justified concentrating tests in 30 locations, that Goes now takes Terneuzen's tests, and that there is no reason to reconsider the decision.
The CBR does not know how many residents of Zuid- and Noord-Beveland take a driving test in Goes.
Het is bij het CBR niet bekend hoeveel inwoners uit Zuid- en Noord-Beveland een rijtest afnemen in Goes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim nadert hoogst gemeten niveau ooit, vooral in de zorg’

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about rising sickness absence in care, its costs, the role of employer good practice, aggression, and the Veerkracht en Zeggenschap subsidy. The minister said costs data are not held, outlined the TAZ programme and employer-focused measures, and promised an update to Parliament before the summer recess.
I do not have figures on the costs of sickness absence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over de kosten van het ziekteverzuim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over verscheidene berichten met betrekking tot de GGZ-tarieven

MPs Van den Berg and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports on GGZ (mental health) tariffs, including retroactive NZa review, insurers paying below the maximum tariff, access to severe care, shortage of intramural beds, and ANW on-call duty by self-employed workers. The Minister answered most questions in substance, stating that the NZa will not review 2022-2023 tariffs retroactively, that cost studies are underway for 2024 and 2026, and that regional inventories of crucial mental health care and sector agreements on on-call duty are being pursued.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) does not look retroactively at the tariffs for the years 2022 and 2023.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) kijkt niet met terugwerkende kracht naar de tarieven voor de jaren 2022 en 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van Strien over het bericht ‘Zeeland wil dat geschenkwoningen rijksmonument worden: “Ze maken het verhaal van de Watersnoodramp zichtbaar”’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the Watersnood gift houses, donated after the 1953 flood, meet the criteria for national monument status and whether the government would act on a request from the provinces. The state secretary agreed the houses are valuable heritage, said a request from Noord-Brabant, Zeeland and Zuid-Holland has been received, and intends to start an investigation soon and decide on a designation programme this year.
I have now received a request from the provinces of Noord-Brabant, Zeeland and Zuid-Holland to examine the designation.
Ik heb inmiddels een verzoek van de provincies Noord-Brabant, Zeeland en Zuid-Holland ontvangen om de aanwijzing te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bevers en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Acht diplomafraudeurs in zorg voor de rechter, aantal meldingen verdubbeld’

MPs Bevers and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports of diploma fraud in care, the doubling of reports to the IGJ, and how to ensure employers check diplomas and VOGs. The minister answered that care providers bear final responsibility for checks, that the IGJ and DUO are raising awareness, that fraud is prosecuted criminally, and that making DUO extracts mandatory in hiring is not desirable.
It is not possible to find out how many care diplomas have been downloaded from DUO, because that specific information is not kept.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel zorgdiploma's er gedownload zijn bij DUO, omdat die specifieke informatie niet wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Ellian en Chris Simons over het artikel ‘Claims Conference reageert op kritiek’

MPs Van den Hil, Ellian and Simons asked the state secretary about a Nieuw Israëlitisch Weekblad article on Claims Conference criticism, concerning declining Holocaust knowledge and support for the annual Nationale Kinderherdenking in Madurodam. The state secretary agreed the trends are worrying, said he is in talks with organisations including the Kinderherdenking and is funding a pilot, but ruled out structural subsidy for the Kinderherdenking for now.
However, I have indicated that structural subsidisation of the Nationale Kinderherdenking by the Ministry of VWS is not on the table for now.
Wel heb ik aangeven dat structurele subsidiering van de Nationale Kinderherdenking vanuit het Ministerie van VWS voor nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Ik heb je data nodig, want ik wil weten hoe duur je bent’

MPs Rajkowski and Van den Hil asked, after press reports, about the legal basis for the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit's mandatory one-off collection of patient-level mental health data, who can see the data, why it is needed, and whether patients can access logs. The minister answered that the NZa's powers rest on the Wmg and AVG, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found the collection lawful with conditions, data are stored securely with logging and a non-linkage guarantee, but patients cannot ask the NZa who viewed their data and must ask their provider instead.
It is not always known to clients and patients which data are shared with whom.
Het is niet altijd bekend bij cliënten en patiënten welke gegevens met wie worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Vaak dakloos na verlaten jeugdzorg'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary how youths leaving youth care are supported to avoid homelessness at 18, whether data exist on youth becoming homeless, how they are prepared for independence and the transition to the Wmo, how they are informed of options, and whether eligibility for extended youth care can be harmonised with municipalities. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Big Five planning approach, the national homelessness action plan and a pending housing bill, said no figures exist for youth homeless at 18, promised a policy-information study due around summer and talks with the VNG.
No figures are available on the number of young people who become homeless or without a permanent home on their eighteenth birthday.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat dak- of thuisloos wordt op hun achttiende verjaardag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Kennis in kinderopvang over wat te doen na misbruik en mishandeling schiet tekort’

An MP asked the minister how the sector and the Inspectorate can raise awareness of the duty to report, consult and report to police (MOA) in childcare, including among trainees and volunteers, and whether training covers abuse situations. The minister answered that an inspectorate flyer was distributed, GGD and sector cooperation is being strengthened, and targeted information for specific groups will be produced this year.
I will therefore have these produced and distributed this year.
Ik ga deze dan ook dit jaar laten maken en verspreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Smals, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sahla over het bericht ‘Werkgevers niet happig om mensen meer in te zetten, ondanks personeelstekort’

Four MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Long-Term Care about a news report that employers are reluctant to offer more hours despite staff shortages, and about measures to reduce involuntary part-time work. The government answered that it urges employers to talk with staff, points to the Flexible Working Act while saying it cannot oblige employers to offer full-time contracts, and describes ongoing studies and pilots on a multi-hours bonus and combination jobs.
The cabinet cannot, however, oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts or more working hours when employees ask for them, and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten of meer uren werk aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Buiten het ziekenhuis dreigt een nijpend tekort aan artsen'

An MP asked the health minister about reports of shortages of doctors outside hospitals, including unfilled training places, regional gaps, retraining and attractiveness of professions. The minister explained the Capacity Body advice, budget-neutral shifting of training places, retraining schemes and the sector's responsibility, and committed to informing parliament next spring.
Parliament will be further informed about this next spring.
De Kamer zal hierover komend voorjaar nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van den Hil en Paulusma over een gesprek met de Eilandsraad van Sint Eustatius

MPs asked about referral arrangements in a pilot for Sint Eustatius health care, including whether patients are sent only to Sint Maarten, lost medical records, reported deaths, inspectorate complaints and dialysis availability. The minister answered that referrals go to Sint Maarten Medical Center, referrals elsewhere remain specialist-initiated, records-sharing is being studied, the inspectorate received 13 reports over five years, and peritoneal dialysis talks are ongoing.
To improve digital data exchange, I am examining the possibilities for a (regional) electronic patient record.
Ter verbetering van de digitale gegevensuitwisseling onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden van een (regionaal) elektronisch patiënten dossier

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds meer meldingen verwarde personen, maar aanpak moeilijk door privacywet: ‘Je weet niet met wie je te maken hebt.’’

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about rising reports of persons with confused behaviour, data-sharing barriers under privacy law, and whether the national reporting line tracks outcomes. The ministers answered that the national line only forwards callers to regional bodies, that cooperation and data-sharing frameworks are being developed, and that they will keep consulting field partners and the EU on the GDPR.
No, no data is centrally collected on this.
Nee, hierover wordt centraal geen data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kinderopvang fors duurder in 2023, ouders betalen tot 40 procent meer'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news reports that childcare costs would rise sharply in 2023, covering the indexation of maximum hourly rates, tracking of tariff increases, causes of cost increases and steps to address supply shortages. The minister explained the indexation method, committed to a Q1 2023 report on tariff development from microdata, and announced an extra price compensation of 0.94 percentage points for 2023 due to exceptional 2022 inflation.
I will send your House a report in the first quarter of 2023 on tariff developments in the sector, based on Toeslagen microdata.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2023 een rapportage sturen met de tariefontwikkeling in de sector, op basis van de microdata van Toeslagen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Losser testbeleid in ziekenhuizen’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that some hospitals let staff with mild COVID symptoms keep working, and about the reliability of self-tests and the role of care workers and works councils. The minister answered that hospitals may deviate from the RIVM advice under the FMS guideline when care continuity is at risk, that the IGJ can ask boards to justify such decisions, and that the DB advises relaxing testing for care staff.
If there are signals that employers are not acting in line with the guideline, care workers can report this to the IGJ.
Indien er signalen zijn dat werkgevers niet handelen conform de leidraad, dan kunnen zorgmedewerkers een melding doen bij de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen Van den Hil en Van Campen over het artikel ‘Populaire kinderopvang bij de boer gehinderd door starre regels’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rules hinder agricultural childcare (kinderopvang bij de boer), including limits on the side branch, fine-particulate norms, procedures, and relaxed staffing rules. The ministers answered that they are in talks with LTO, VAK and VNG about local permitting obstacles, but gave no concrete list of rules or a coulance scheme.
Unfortunately it was not possible to send the answers before the committee debate, because coordination with the various parties took more time.
Het is helaas niet gelukt de antwoorden voor het commissiedebat te versturen, omdat de afstemming met de verschillende partijen meer tijd vergde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Richardson, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Tientallen klachten van misbruik en mishandeling in Gelders jeugddorp’

MPs asked the state secretary about reports of abuse and mistreatment at the Glind youth village, including whether inspectors had prior signals and what is being done about the care provider and former foster children. The government answered that the IGJ received several signals and reports since 2018 and will handle them, that Pluryn set up a helpline and is commissioning research, and that existing complaint channels exist, while declining to disclose details of individual reports citing confidentiality and privacy.
The IGJ never makes statements about the precise content of reports and how they are handled.
Over de precieze inhoud van meldingen en de afhandeling doet de IGJ nooit mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Cliënt heeft GGZ vaak niet nodig'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a newspaper report claiming many GGZ clients do not need mental health care, and about addressing underlying social problems to reduce waiting lists. The minister answered that a broader multidisciplinary approach with the social domain, new mental health centres and a national network of low-threshold support points is planned, while noting monitoring under the Integraal Zorgakkoord and existing initiatives on debt, work and mental health.
As I informed your House in my letter of 21 October, I support an approach in which problems people face are considered multidisciplinarily.
Zoals ik uw Kamer in mijn brief van 21 oktober jongstleden heb bericht 2 , ondersteun ik een werkwijze waarin multidisciplinair wordt gekeken naar problemen die mensen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel 'Minister: ‘Versoepelingen kinderopvang gelden pas in 2024’, personeelstekort groeit'

An MP asks why loosening of childcare staffing rules only takes effect in 2024 and what obstacles exist, and asks for quicker measures, a temporary coulance scheme and faster work on modular training. The minister replies that most changes need a formal amendment procedure so cannot start before 1 January 2024, though two changes may start on 1 July 2023, and that a coulance scheme is not possible under current law, offering instead an agreement on inspection leniency and promised letters to parliament.
For that reason, most of the adjustments cannot take effect before 1 January 2024.
Om die reden kunnen de meeste aanpassingen niet eerder ingaan dan per 1 januari 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kwart Zeeuwse waterkeringen voldoet niet aan veiligheidsnorm'

MPs Minhas and Van den Hil asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that a quarter of Zeeland's flood defences fail the safety standard, the expected 1.5 billion euro reinforcement cost, cost sharing between the state and water boards, and how completion by 2050 and sea-level rise will be ensured. The minister confirmed the assessments are still ongoing, with results due end 2023, cost estimates are not yet firm, cost sharing follows the Water Act, and the programme and Water Act evaluation will address funding adequacy.
The House will, in line with the law and earlier commitments, be informed at the end of 2023 about the national results of these assessments.
De Kamer wordt, conform de wet en eerdere toezeggingen, eind 2023 over de landelijke uitkomsten van deze beoordelingen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en De Kort over het artikel 'Minister Schouten wil terugkeer schooltandarts'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of health and of education about a news report that the minister wanted to bring back the school dentist, and about dentist shortages and the plans for children's dental care. The government answered that it is consulting dental organisations on a plan to increase children's dental visits, that preventive measures beyond school dentists are also being considered, and that a letter on dental care will follow by early October 2022.

I will explain the proposals for measures to encourage visits to the dental care provider in my letter on dental care, which I will send to the House of Representatives by early October 2022 at the latest.
Ik zal de voorstellen voor maatregelen om het bezoek aan de mondzorgverlener te stimuleren, toelichten in mijn brief over mondzorg die ik uiterlijk begin oktober 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Agressie aan de balie leidt tot uitstroom apotheekpersoneel'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports that aggression at pharmacy counters is driving pharmacy staff out, and about measures to address aggression against first-line care workers. The minister acknowledged the problem, described ongoing branch-based approaches and talks with professional bodies, and said further measures are being explored without committing to specific new steps.
I consider it important that pharmacists, pharmacy assistants and all other first-line care workers can carry out their work in a good and safe manner.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat apothekers, apothekersassistenten en alle andere zorgverleners in de eerstelijnszorg hun werk op een goede en veilige manier kunnen uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van der Woude over het artikel 'Onprofessionele geneeskundestudent moet makkelijker weggestuurd kunnen worden'

Two VVD MPs asked why medical schools cannot more easily expel students who repeatedly behave unprofessionally, and whether the Iudicium Abeundi rules should be changed. The minister answered that the IA is reserved for exceptional cases involving patient safety, that institutions can adapt their rules themselves, and that amending the statute is not desirable.
Amending the statutory provisions is not something I consider desirable.
Aanpassing van de wettelijke bepalingen acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bevers over het bericht 'Fraude met valse diploma’s in zorg neemt toe: cashen over de rug van kwetsbare patiënten'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the inspectorate has enough tools and capacity to combat fraud with fake care diplomas, what consequences and patient-safety effects have occurred, and what is being done about malicious staffing agencies, online sellers and the upcoming integrity law. The minister answered that the inspectorate's powers are limited for sole traders and agencies outside its supervision, that criminal enforcement depends on reports, and that a DUO diploma extract will be required in hiring, while the integrity bill does not cover this fraud.
The intervention options for the IGJ are limited in these cases.
De interventie-mogelijkheden voor de IGJ zijn in deze gevallen beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over Het bericht: ‘LangeLand sluit SEH tijdelijk om tekort SEH-artsen’

An MP asks the health minister about a temporary closure of a hospital emergency department due to a shortage of emergency physicians, and about training numbers, triage, and the recognition of emergency medicine as a specialty. The minister replies that training capacity is set by the Capaciteitsorgaan, that staffing is up to providers within quality norms, and that the specialty recognition decision is still in consultation and will be decided later.
Anticipating the final decision, I will not yet respond.
Vooruitlopend op het definitieve besluit zal ik nog niet reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht dat statushouders en nieuwkomers van buiten de EU het personeelstekort in de hartzorg verkleinen

MPs Van den Hil and Becker asked about reports that refugees and non-EU newcomers are easing health-care staffing shortages, and how to speed up BIG registration and link newcomers with care jobs. The minister answered that the government supports win-win approaches, cites a pilot mentoring project and the TAZ programme, and says no overview of municipal arrangements exists nationally.
An overview of all ongoing agreements between municipalities and care institutions on job placement and work experience places does not exist at national level.
Een overzicht van alle lopende afspraken van gemeenten met zorginstellingen bij de bemiddeling naar werk en/of werkervaringsplekken is er niet op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Niet alleen maar specialisten in het ziekenhuis'

MPs Tielen and Van den Hil asked the health minister about a newspaper report on hospital doctors treating patients outside their specialism, the case for generalist hospital doctors, and funding for that training. The minister said no data exist on multimorbidity cases or on specialists leaving the profession, and that the evaluation did not justify structural funding for the hospital doctor training from the availability contribution.
I do not have data on how often this occurs.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoe vaak dit zich voordoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht 'Medisch toerisme in de lift, maar ingrepen niet zonder risico: Deel van mijn wangen voel ik niet meer

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the health minister about reports of risky cosmetic surgery abroad, including whether intermediary agencies misinforming consumers can be tackled, registration of complications, and consumer information. The minister answered that such agencies fall under IGJ supervision only when they deliver care under the Wkkgz, that civil courts remain open otherwise, that no national registry of foreign complications exists, and that consumers bear responsibility while the government refers them to an online information website.
Travel brokerage and offering websites showing which operations are possible abroad are not care within the meaning of the Wkkgz and therefore also do not fall under IGJ supervision.

Reisbemiddeling en het aanbieden van websites waarop te zien is welke operaties in het buitenland mogelijk zijn, zijn geen zorg in de zin van de Wkkgz en vallen daarom ook niet onder toezicht van de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kinderopvang in 'permanente crisis': 'Overal waar jonge gezinnen wonen, is het een probleem''

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a permanent crisis in childcare, including staff shortages, extending trainee staffing, relaxing the child-staff ratio, and the impact of the planned system reform and the Wet IKK evaluation. The minister answered that the trainee-staffing rule is extended to July 2024, that the IKK evaluation will be followed by a review of quality requirements, and that a labour market approach and a parliamentary letter are forthcoming.
This has already led to it being possible since 1 January 2022 for 50 percent (instead of 33 percent) of the staffing to consist of trainee childcare workers.
Dit heeft er reeds toe geleid dat het sinds 1 januari 2022 mogelijk is om 50 procent (in plaats van 33 procent) van de formatieve inzet te laten bestaan uit beroepskrachten in opleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het artikel 'Problemen bij kinderzedenzaken: schrijnend tekort aan forensisch artsen'

MPs Van den Hil and Michon-Derkzen asked about a reported shortage of forensic doctors that delays examinations of minors in sex-crime cases, and about measures to address it. The Minister replies that the shortage is serious, that an interim fix via NFI hiring of FMO covers the 0-12 age group, and that task redistribution pilots, a recruitment campaign and a study on physician assistants are underway, though structural solutions and timelines remain uncertain.
It is very serious that forensic evidence examination of minor victims of sex offences is under pressure due to the shortage of forensic doctors.
Het is zeer ernstig dat het sporenonderzoek bij minderjarige slachtoffers van zedendelicten onder druk staat door het tekort aan forensische artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Door uitblijven coronastrategie komt lockdown weer in beeld’

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about a risk of a lockdown from a lack of a corona strategy, the National Care Reserve, sick-leave prevention, workforce efficiency and labour-saving innovation. The minister answered that the reserve is still being developed, that the government will update parliament in summer, and listed existing measures and programmes without giving firm new deadlines or commitments on the substance.
At present the legal, implementation and financial questions of the National Care Reserve (as a public task) are being further worked out.
Op dit moment worden de juridische, de uitvoeringstechnische en de financiële vraagstukken van de Nationale Zorgreserve (als een publieke taak) nader uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Ambulanceverpleegkundige Laura (39): 'Hij greep me bij mijn nek''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about reports that an ambulance nurse was assaulted, that police initially did not want to take her report, and whether the ELA agreements on violence against public-service workers were followed. The minister says police and prosecutors apply the ELA agreements, that the next evaluation is due in 2024, and that some reporting issues will be discussed with the sector, but declines to comment on the individual case and disputes the claimed doubling of incidents.
As is known, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Acta biedt medewerkers 1000 euro bonus voor het aandragen van een tandartsdocent'

MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam dental academy (ACTA) had to scale back master's teaching due to a shortage of dental teachers, and about the reliance on foreign-trained dentists and regional distribution of dental programmes. The minister confirmed the teaching cutback was temporary and largely restored, and gave partial answers, promising to raise regional distribution with the Capaciteitsorgaan in its autumn advice.
In consultation with the Capaciteitsorgaan, extra attention will be requested for this aspect in the new advice due to appear in the autumn.
In het overleg met het Capaciteitsorgaan zal extra aandacht gevraagd worden voor dit aspect in het nieuwe advies dat in het najaar zal verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht dat zorgbestuurders amper gecheckt worden op hun dubieuze verleden

An MP asks why none of the 1,270 new care providers registered in 2022 had a certificate of good conduct (VOG) or integrity check, and whether small care providers can be effectively checked for fraud under the Wtza. The minister replies that the notification duty is risk-based by design, that the application form already asks about management's past, that the overall fraud scale is unknown, and that an evaluation and further measures (Wbsrz, Wibz, a letter before summer) are planned.
The total extent of healthcare fraud in the Netherlands is not known.
De totale omvang van zorgfraude in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Kamminga over de berichten ‘Er vallen doden door slechte gezondheidszorg Sint Eustatius’ en ‘Het ene Nederland is het andere niet’

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the State Secretaries about reports of deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including the hospitainer's equipment, staffing, appointment of a hospital director and stakeholder involvement. The government denied the hospitainer was inadequate or unstaffed, said no new director was appointed but a temporary CMO was added, and committed to a study of healthcare in Caribbean Netherlands and to a letter for the budget debate.
I will send your House a letter before the 2022 budget debate in response to question 9.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de begrotingsbehandeling 2022 als antwoord op vraag 9 een brief sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bevers over berichten omtrent de ineffectieve besteding van coronagerelateerde opleidingssubsidies

MPs Van den Hil and Bevers asked why COVID-era retraining subsidies were allocated first-come-first-served or by lottery rather than by assessed need, why shortage sectors like care had limited access, and how future subsidies such as STAP will reach those most in need. Minister Van Gennip explained the crisis-speed rationale for the allocation method, argued the broad regulation was open to shortage sectors, reported that most completed short courses were at lower vocational levels, and pointed to the STAP budget, evaluation and broader labour-market measures.
No substantive assessment of the applications was chosen at the time, because experience shows this takes a lot of time.
Voor een inhoudelijke beoordeling van de aanvragen is destijds niet gekozen, omdat de ervaring leert dat dit veel tijd kost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over berichten dat geld voor gerichte salarisverhogingen in de zorg niet goed terecht komt

MP Van den Hil asked whether the 675 million euro for targeted care-sector salary increases is reaching the intended workers, how the minister supervises this, and whether she agrees the funds should target specific pay scales. The minister denies receiving such signals, says social partners hold primacy over pay, notes an agreement with employers to narrow middle-scale pay gaps, and agrees the funds are meant for specific pay scales.
I follow the collective agreement developments closely, including on the basis of the agreement made on 27 September with the care employers.
Ik volg de cao-ontwikkelingen op de voet, ook vanuit de afspraak zoals die is gemaakt op 27 september jl. met de zorgwerkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het artikel 'Een rol bij de lijkschouw'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked whether task reallocation could let PAs and nurse specialists perform death inspections, easing shortages of elderly-care physicians and municipal inspectors. The minister replies that a careful study starting spring 2022 will assess whether such task shifting adds value, with results shared with the House around summer, and that temporary emergency solutions for municipal inspections are being discussed.
In spring 2022 the study will start, and around the summer the results will be shared with your House.
Voorjaar 2022 wordt gestart met het onderzoek en rond de zomer zullen de resultaten hiervan met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van den Hil over de weigering van gemeenten om onderzoek te doen naar roofhandel Joods vastgoed

MPs Ellian and Van den Hil asked the State Secretary about reports that 35 municipalities refuse to investigate the looting of Jewish property in WWII and whether they should be pressed to do so. The State Secretary said municipalities played no role in the centrally directed confiscations, encouraged voluntary research, and will consult the Ministry of BZK and VNG on encouraging municipalities.
I will check with the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the VNG what is possible in this regard.
Ik zal met het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) en de VNG nagaan wat daarin mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht dat zorgpersoneel met een coronabesmetting ingezet wordt

An MP asked whether hospitals and care institutions plan to deploy COVID-positive staff, whether occupational health and staff representatives were involved, and how patients and colleagues are protected. The minister answered that institutions may deviate from national guidance under a RIVM framework when care continuity is seriously threatened, that such decisions are the institution's responsibility, that institutions need not inform the ministry, and that the Inspectorate supervises the safety of such decisions.
Hospitals and other care institutions planning to deploy infected care staff are not obliged to inform me about this.
Ziekenhuizen en andere zorginstellingen die van plan zijn besmet zorgpersoneel te laten werken, zijn niet gehouden mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het bericht 'Tekort aan lijkschouwers dreigt: ‘Weinig geneeskundestudenten kiezen ervoor’'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked about a reported shortage of forensic doctors who perform death inspections (lijkschouw), including timelines for a new capacity forecast, a recruitment campaign, IGJ roundtable and the appointment procedure. The minister answered each question with expected timelines (forecast end 2022, campaign start Q2 2022, Wlb bill end 2022) and described regional measures including temporary emergency solutions.
To this end, a round-table meeting will be organised in spring 2022.
Hiertoe wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 een rondetafelbijeenkomst georganiseerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Smals over de berichtgeving in de media t.a.v. het tekort aan behandelaren waardoor er lange wachtlijsten zijn in de GGZ en instellingen zich genoodzaakt voelen tot een pati

Two VVD MPs asked about media reports of a shortage of GGZ practitioners causing long waiting lists and patient intake stops, and about the 2020 use of unfilled clinical psychologist training places to train extra GZ-psychologists. The State Secretary answered that the Capacity Body's projections should remain the guideline, that the shifted funding was a political choice rather than freed-up money, that master-psychologists already work in care, and that waiting lists are only loosely linked to the vacancy rate used in projections.

I would like to invite the parties to have investigated and substantiated how the clinical psychologist training can be made more attractive and how inflow into the KP training places can best be stimulated.

Ik zou de partijen willen uitnodigen om te laten onderzoeken en onderbouwen hoe de opleiding tot KP aantrekkelijker gemaakt kan worden en hoe de instroom in de KP opleidingsplaatsen het beste kan worden gestimuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Hil over het bericht dat de IGJ neptherapeuten te vaak ongemoeid laat

An MP asks the Health Minister about a report that the health inspectorate IGJ leaves fake therapists unpursued too often, and asks how many title-misuse reports were received and acted upon. The minister answers that about 700 reports were received in five years, 90 warnings or fines were issued, and that IGJ investigates reports on a case-by-case basis while stressing the importance of protecting the BIG register.
The IGJ has received approximately 700 reports regarding alleged title misuse over the past five years.
Er zijn door de IGJ de afgelopen vijf jaar circa 700 meldingen ontvangen in relatie tot vermeend titelmisbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Neef en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Juvent kan niet wegblijven uit Zeeuws-Vlaanderen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about Juvent's relocation of youth care from Zeeuws-Vlaanderen to Middelburg due to staffing shortages. The State Secretary said three youths stay at the Anker location, four moved to Middelburg with about 35 minutes' travel, and listed eleven contracted youth care providers in the region while pointing to municipalities' responsibility and broader reforms.
When children and parents need help, it is important that good help is available in a timely manner.
Wanneer kinderen en ouders hulp nodig hebben, is het van belang dat goede hulp tijdig beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Hulp aan duikslachtoffers in gevaar: behandelcentrum in Goes heeft geld nodig’

MPs Van den Hil and Aukje de Vries asked about a diving-victim treatment centre in Goes facing financial pressure and its role in navy and offshore work. The minister replied that the centre has no financial problems per the NZa, that a 24/7 funding question remains open between the centre and insurers, and that insurers bear the duty of care.
It is therefore not for me to form an opinion on the future of care for diving casualties or the position of the treatment centre in Goes.
Het is dus niet aan mij om een mening te vormen over de toekomst van de zorg voor duikslachtoffers of de positie van het behandelcentrum in Goes.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over berichtgeving in de media t.a.v. het tekort aan behandelaren waardoor er lange wachtlijsten zijn in de GGZ en instellingen zich genoodzaakt voelen tot een patiëntenstop

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports of a shortage of mental health treatment staff, long waiting lists and patient admission stops, and whether more GZ-psychologist training places should be funded. The state secretary said he follows the Capaciteitsorgaan's advice on training places, sees no reason to add places now, and that a decision on funding orthopedagogue training is for the next cabinet.
I therefore see no reason to make more training places available.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om meer opleidingsplaatsen beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van den Hil over het bericht dat de derde ronde Woningbouwimpuls opent in september 2021

MPs Koerhuis and Van den Hil asked whether small and medium municipalities face high minimum project sizes (200 and 500 homes) under the Woningbouwimpuls and whether they may pool projects regionally. The minister answered that no such signals reached her beyond Noord- and Midden-Limburg, that joint applications are already possible if one municipality applies, and that the third round's funds are exhausted.
After the third tranche the financial resources for the Woningbouwimpuls are exhausted, so municipalities cannot submit an application for the Woningbouwimpuls after all.
Na de derde tranche zijn de financiële middelen voor de Woningbouwimpuls uitgeput, waardoor gemeenten niet alsnog een aanvraag voor de woningbouwimpuls kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Druk op de geboortezorg: met moeite bemannen we de bedden'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about strain on maternity care, the regional capacity shortages, causes such as staff shortages and a birth peak, and what the government will do. The minister answered that shortages exist in several regions, pointed to regional cooperation and a NICU bed-tracking initiative, referred to a planned intensification of measures and the labour-market programme, and agreed to answer before the labour-market debate.
An up-to-date overall overview does not exist.
Een actueel totaaloverzicht is er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Spoedeisende hulp ook in Friesland vaker even op slot vanwege tekort aan personeel

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that emergency departments in Friesland, Groningen and Drenthe increasingly close temporarily ('time-outs') due to staff shortages, asking about hours, patient effects, rules, and solutions. The minister answered that time-outs do not mean closure, that life-threatening cases are always accepted, that the NZa sees no harm to patients, and that regional measures and workforce initiatives are underway.
The NZa has informed me that it is not aware of any signals of adverse consequences or negative health effects for patients as a result of time-outs.
De NZa heeft mij laten weten geen signalen te kennen over nadelige gevolgen of negatieve gezondheidseffecten voor patiënten als gevolg van time-outs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Meldingen eergerelateerd geweld stijgen, opvang vol’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that honour-related violence notifications are rising while shelter places are full, including shelter capacity, perpetrator removal, early recognition and a multi-year action programme. The government answered that notifications rose only slightly in 2020, that shelter demand peaked and was temporarily solved, that criminal law tools exist, and that work on prevention and a follow-up exploration is ongoing.
Talks are now taking place between the VNG, municipalities and care providers on the availability, occupancy and financing of this specialised shelter, with the aim of reaching a structural solution.

Er vinden nu gesprekken plaats tussen VNG, gemeenten en betrokken zorgaanbieders over de beschikbaarheid, bezetting en financiering van deze specialistische vorm van opvang, met als doel om tot een structurele oplossing te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en Aukje de Vries over het artikel 'Noodkreet: tandarts gezocht voor Rotterdam, laat meer studenten toe' en de beantwoording van de Minister voor Medische Zorg o

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a newspaper report on a shortage of dentists in the Rotterdam and Zeeland region and whether more dentistry training places would be created. The government answered that funding for 100 extra places (EUR 26.3 million structurally) is not in the budget, so the decision is left to a new cabinet.
Expanding by 100 training places requires a structural amount of EUR 26.3 million. No funding for this amount has been found in the OCW budget.
Voor een uitbreiding met 100 opleidingsplaatsen is een structureel bedrag noodzakelijk van € 26,3 mln. Op de begroting van OCW is geen dekking voor dit bedrag gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Van den Hil over "het bericht dat uitkeringen van psychiatrische patiënten zijn stopgezet na een gedwongen opname"

MPs De Kort and Van den Hil asked whether social assistance benefits of psychiatric patients are stopped entirely after a compulsory admission, and how many cases and which municipalities are involved. The minister answers that the right to general assistance is not wholly lost, that the data on cases is not registered, and that an amendment restoring general assistance after compulsory admission is being prepared for entry into force by 1 January 2022.
It is not known in which municipalities benefits under general assistance are stopped upon compulsory admission.
Het is ook niet bekend in welke gemeenten uitkeringen op grond van algemene bijstand bij een gedwongen opname worden stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Statushouders komen amper aan de bak in de zorgsector’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why refugees with recognised status (statushouders) rarely find work in the care sector, asking how diploma recognition works, how many have care backgrounds, why Germany's process is faster, and how the sector can use this potential. The Minister explained the recognition procedure and costs, said data on refugees with care backgrounds is not available, acknowledged Germany's process differs, and committed to inform the House in autumn on streamlining the procedure.
I am not aware how many refugees with recognised status have a care background.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel statushouders een zorgachtergrond hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Plannen voor daklozenwoningen belanden te vaak in ijskast’

MPs Van den Hil and Koerhuis asked whether homelessness housing plans are stalling, how many of the 10,000 supported housing places have been realised, and whether temporary housing, prioritisation and municipal data are adequate. The State Secretary answered that municipalities report about 2,200 places realised by end 2020 (on track by their own measure), with overlapping figures from housing associations and the BZK fund, acknowledged delays due to COVID, and deferred further prioritisation and additional measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to determine how the follow-up is shaped.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te bepalen hoe het vervolg vorm wordt gegeven.

m: Motie van het lid Verhoeven c.s. over verlagen van de voorgenomen bezuiniging op de regionale omroepen

Asks the government to reduce the planned cut to regional broadcasters by 8 million euros and to allocate the remaining 42 million to the national public broadcaster with a earmark for Dutch cultural content.
requests the government, when implementing the cut, to reduce the planned cut to regional broadcasters of 25 million euros by 8 million euros
verzoekt de regering, bij de invulling van de bezuiniging de voorgenomen bezuiniging op de regionale omroepen van 25 miljoen euro te verlagen met 8 miljoen euro

Amendement van het lid Verhoeven c.s. dat in het kader van de begrotingsafspraken 2014 zorgt voor een halvering van de structurele bezuiniging op de publieke omroep van € 100 miljoen naar € 50 miljoen
Amendment halves the structural budget cut to the public broadcaster from €100 million to €50 million by reducing the cut amounts in the bill.
Motie van de leden Van Dam en Huizing over een evaluatie van de uitwerking van bezuinigingsopties

Asks the government to work out savings and revenue options for the public broadcaster (distribution, copyright fees, Ster commercial income) and to send parliament an evaluation before the 2016 and 2017 media budgets.
requests the government to ensure these options are implemented in 2014 where possible and to send the House an evaluation before the media budgets for 2016 and 2017 are debated

verzoekt de regering tevens, om ervoor zorg te dragen dat deze opties waar mogelijk al in 2014 worden geïmplementeerd en de Kamer in elk geval voor de behandeling van de mediabegrotingen voor 2016 en 2017 een evaluatie te doen toekomen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Huizing en Van Dam ter vervanging van nr. 21 dat voorziet in een verlengde aspirant status voor de omroepen PowNed en WNL.

Lets PowNed and WNL, two broadcasters in aspirant status, request a temporary recognition for the 2016-2020 period despite the general rule allowing only one such status, altering rules for broadcasters rather than executive power.
The broadcasting associations PowNed and WNL may opt out of the procedure for granting recognitions
De omroepverenigingen PowNed en WNL kunnen afzien van deelname aan de procedure tot verlening van de erkenningen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Dam en Huizing ter vervanging van nr. 38 over het integraal doorgeven van het signaal van diensten als onderdeel van de programmakanalen.
Allows the minister to designate by ministerial regulation services whose signal must be passed on integrally as part of programme channels, and to set further rules for that transmission.
By ministerial regulation, services may be designated whose signal must be passed on as an integral part of the programme channels.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen diensten worden aangewezen waarvan het signaal als integraal onderdeel van de programmakanalen moet worden doorgegeven
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Dam en Huizing ter vervanging van nr. 33 over het integraal doorgeven van het signaal van diensten als onderdeel van de programmakanalen
Amendment lets a ministerial regulation designate services whose signal must be passed on integrally as part of broadcast channels, and set rules for that carriage.
By ministerial regulation services can be designated whose signal must be passed on as an integral part of the programme channels
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen diensten worden aangewezen waarvan het signaal als integraal onderdeel van de programmakanalen moet worden doorgegeven
Amendement van de leden Huizing en Van Dam dat voorziet in een verlengde aspirant status voor de omroepen PowNed en WNL
Lets the minister grant PowNed and WNL a temporary recognition in the 2016-2020 period, departing from the one-time limit.
grant a provisional recognition under article 2.23(2) to one or both broadcasting associations PowNed and WNL.
een voorlopige erkenning als bedoeld in artikel 2.23, tweede lid, verlenen aan een of beide van de omroepverenigingen PowNed en WNL.
Motie van de leden Van Dam en Huizing over de doorgifte van interactieve diensten

Motion asks the government to pursue agreement with broadcasters and package providers on carrying interactive broadcast services, report to parliament by year end, and if no agreement, secure carriage by ministerial regulation.
report to this House by year end whether this consultation has led to agreement
voor het eind van het jaar aan deze Kamer te rapporteren of dit overleg heeft geleid tot overeenstemming
Motie van de leden Segers en Huizing over het verkennen van de mogelijkheid van een à la cartemenu
Asks the government to explore an à la carte option letting consumers buy smaller television channel packages.
requests the government to explicitly include in the future exploration the possibility of purchasing smaller packages or individual channels, the so-called à la carte menu
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheid voor het afnemen van kleinere pakketten dan wel van individuele zenders, het zogeheten à-la-cartemenu, expliciet mee te nemen in de toekomstverkenning
Motie van de leden Van Dam en Huizing over financiering van het Metropole Orkest tot 1 januari 2017
Asks the government to provide additional one-off funding of up to 3.5 million euro from two budgets to the Metropole Orkest, with conditions on future claims.
make available a one-off maximum of 3.5 million euro from the General Media Reserve and a one-off maximum of 3.5 million euro from the culture budget
eenmalig maximaal 3,5 miljoen euro uit de Algemene Mediareserve en eenmalig maximaal 3,5 miljoen euro uit de cultuurbegroting ter beschikking te stellen
Amendement van het lid Huizing c.s. om de Nederlandse sport op Olympisch niveau te brengen
Shifts 800 thousand euros within the sport budget toward top sport, funded by cutting research budget after dropping the Olympic Games bid.
The funding is found by lowering the budget for research and studies
De dekking wordt gevonden in het verlagen van het budget voor onderzoeken en studies
Amendement van het lid Bruins Slot c.s. over het verhogen van het budget voor dopingbestrijding
Raises the anti-doping budget by moving funds from the Olympic ambition subsidy within the sport budget.
Developments at home and abroad have shown that the fight against doping deserves more attention.
Ontwikkelingen in binnen- en buitenland hebben laten zien dat de strijd tegen doping meer aandacht verdient.
Motie van het lid Van Dekken c.s. over De Youth Olimpic Games 2018
Asks the government to work to bring the 2018 Youth Olympic Games to Rotterdam and to use the 2028 Olympics study budget to support that bid.
also requests the government to use the budget for studies related to the 2028 Olympics as a contribution to organising the 2018 Youth Olympic Games in Rotterdam

verzoekt de regering tevens, het budget voor onderzoeken en studies in verband met de Olympische Spelen in 2028 in te zetten als bijdrage aan de organisatie van de Youth Olympic Games 2018 in Rotterdam
Amendement van de leden Vermeij en Huizing over het schrappen van de wijzigingen op de Algemene Kinderbijslagwet
Deletes the proposed simplifications to the General Child Benefit Act from a bill, arguing they increase spending rather than save.
The simplification has been removed because it leads to higher spending instead of savings.
De vereenvoudiging is eruit gehaald, omdat deze leidt tot meer uitgaven in plaats van besparingen.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Huizing c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over de uitzondering van beheerders van pensioenpoolingstructuren
Clarifies in the AIFM implementation bill that managers of pension pooling vehicles owned solely by pension funds are excluded from the directive.
Therefore it is necessary to clarify in the bill that managers of common funds in which only pension funds participate are exempt from the directive.

Daarom is het nodig in het wetsvoorstel te verduidelijken dat de beheerders van fondsen voor gemene rekening waarin uitsluitend pensioenfondsen participeren zijn vrijgesteld van de toepassing van de richtlijn.
Amendement van het lid Huizing C.S. over de uitzondering van beheerders van pensioenpoolingstructuren
Clarifies that managers of collective investment funds held solely by pension funds (pension pooling structures) are exempt from the AIFM directive as implemented in the bill.
That is why the bill needs to clarify that managers of common-account funds in which only pension funds participate are exempt from the application of the directive.

Daarom is het nodig in het wetsvoorstel te verduidelijken dat de beheerders van fondsen voor gemene rekening waarin uitsluitend pensioenfondsen participeren zijn vrijgesteld van de toepassing van de richtlijn.
Motie van de leden Huizing en Hijum over het oprekken van de loonsomgrens voor kleine werkgevers
Asks government to raise the payroll threshold for premium liability for small employers to ten times average payroll, rather than five.
requests the government to raise the payroll threshold for premium liability for small employers to at least ten times average payroll
verzoekt de regering, de loonsomgrens voor premiestelling voor kleine werkgevers in ieder geval op te rekken tot tien keer de gemiddelde loonsom
Motie van het lid Huizing over een anticumulatieregeling voor Ziektewet- en WW-uitkeringen
Asks the government to propose an anti-cumulation rule for combining sickness benefit and unemployment benefit payments.
requests the government to make proposals for introducing an anti-cumulation scheme for sickness and unemployment benefits
verzoekt de regering, voorstellen te doen over het invoeren van een anticumulatieregeling voor Ziektewet- en WW-uitkeringen
Amendement van het lid Van Vliet c.s. over het uitbreiden van het bonusverbod naar deelondernemingen die onderdeel uitmaken van een staatsgesteunde groep
Amendment extending the bonus ban to subsidiaries in a group where another company receives state support, until the state begins selling its stake.
This amendment provides that, through an equivalence rule, the bonus ban is extended to undertakings
Dit amendement regelt dat middels een gelijkstelling het bonusverbod wordt uitgebreid naar ondernemingen
Amendement van het lid Van Vliet c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het uitbreiden van het bonusverbod naar deelondernemingen die onderdeel uitmaken van een staatsgesteunde groep
Amends the bonus ban to cover subsidiaries of groups in which the state holds a stake for financial-stability reasons.
For the application of article 1:112, first paragraph, state support to a financial company is treated as equivalent
Met steun aan een financiële onderneming wordt voor de toepassing van artikel 1:112, eerste lid, gelijkgesteld
Motie Huizing/Van Vliet over ontneming anbi-status strafrechtelijk veroordeelden
Asks the government to tighten the rules so that organisations, or their board members, who are finally convicted of breaking Dutch law lose their anbi tax-status for five years.
requests the government to come up with a proposal tightening the current rules
verzoekt de regering te komen tot een voorstel waarbij de huidige regelgeving wordt aangescherpt
Motion asking the government to further define the term cultural institution as used in the Geefwet tax-deduction rules.
requests the government to arrive at a further definition of the term cultural institution
verzoekt de regering te komen tot nadere definitie van het begrip «culturele instelling»
Amendement van de leden Huizing en Koolmees over het voor nieuwe gevallen terugbrengen naar ten hoogste 8 jaar van de looptijd van de bewijsregel van de zogenoemde 30%-regeling
Limits the wage-tax 30% ruling's evidentiary period to eight years for new cases, with transitional rules and related salary-norm changes implemented by general administrative order.
This amendment aims to reduce the evidentiary period of the so-called 30% ruling from a maximum of 10 years to a maximum of 8 years.
met dit amendement wordt beoogd de looptijd van de bewijsregel van de zogenoemde 30%-regeling terug te brengen van ten hoogste 10 jaar naar ten hoogste 8 jaar.
Amendement van het lid Huizing c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 42 over het voor nieuwe gevallen terugbrengen naar ten hoogste 8 jaar van de loopttijd van de bewijsregel van de zogenoemde 30%-regeling
Amends the tax law to shorten the maximum period of the 30% ruling's evidentiary rule from ten to eight years for new cases.
to reduce the duration of the evidentiary rule of the so-called 30% ruling from a maximum of 10 years to a maximum of 8 years
de looptijd van de bewijsregel van de zogenoemde 30%-regeling terug te brengen van ten hoogste 10 jaar naar ten hoogste 8 jaar
Amendement van de leden Huizing en Omtzigt over bijtelling 7% vanaf 2014 plus groengas in 4 stappen ipv 2
Amendment raising the car benefit rate for zero-emission-type cars registered from 2014 and phasing in higher LPG and CNG excise and energy tax rates over four steps.
Parts I to VI of this amendment provide that the so-called zero benefit does not apply to cars first registered on or after 1 January 2014.
Met de onderdelen I tot en met VI van dit amendement wordt geregeld dat de zogenoemde nihilbijtelling niet geldt voor auto's
Motie Huizing en Van Hijum over integratie van dienstverlening
Motion asking the government to further integrate service delivery of UWV and municipalities at regional work centres and bundle back-office ICT.
requests the government, in consultation with municipalities, UWV and SVB, to achieve further integration of service delivery
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met gemeenten, het UWV en de SVB te komen tot verdergaande integratie van dienstverlening
Motie Blanksma-van den Heuvel c.s. over het communiceren met betrokkenen over criteria voor herbeoordeling

Asks the government to have UWV clearly explain to all affected persons, including those already re-assessed, which criteria were applied and why, and to set up an independent advisory committee of jurists to advise UWV on objections.
requests the government to instruct UWV to make clear in communication to all those involved, including those already re-assessed, which criteria are applied
verzoekt de regering het UWV de aanwijzing te geven om in de communicatie aan alle betrokkenen, ook hen die reeds herbeoordeeld zijn, concreet te maken welke criteria worden toegepast
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Huizing en Van Dekken over betaling van spelersmakelaars

MPs Huizing and Van Dekken asked whether football players rather than clubs should pay player agents, and whether agent intermediation falls under the WAADI labour-intermediary law. The minister answered that only pure labour-contract brokerage falls under WAADI, that the cost ban applies only to those brokerage costs, and that parties may agree who pays other agent services, so no exemption is planned.
To protect the employee, WAADI prohibits charging the costs of labour intermediation to the employee.
Ter bescherming van de werknemer is in de Waadi een verbod opgenomen om de kosten van arbeidsmiddeling in rekening te brengen bij de werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Huizing en Bruins Slot over kickboksen door kinderen

Three MPs asked the health minister about children's kickboxing with head strikes allowed, the need for binding rules across fragmented kickboxing federations, and the quality of instructors. The minister agreed head contact is undesirable, said NOC*NSF will lead a plan for sector-wide rules expected by summer 2014, and said she would advise parents against such training while not yet ruling out a legal fallback.
For this, an impulse from outside is needed.
Daartoe is een impuls van buitenaf nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Huizing over het bericht “NPO 1 wordt nieuwe naam voor Nederland 1”

MP Huizing (VVD) asked the state secretary about reports that Nederland 1 would be renamed NPO 1, the premature timing given pending media law and the public broadcaster's future, a reported one-million-euro payment for the npo1.nl domain, and whether the marketing budget would be frozen. The state secretary confirmed the renaming is the broadcaster's own decision, said politics does not govern brand names for independence reasons, referred back to the earlier answer on the domain and noted a 2013 marketing budget of about 6.4 million euro subject to Commissariaat oversight, and declined to commit to freezing marketing spending.
It concerns the independence of the public broadcaster; it is not desirable for politics to have influence over this.
Het gaat hier om de onafhankelijkheid van de publieke omroep; het is niet wenselijk dat de politiek hier invloed op heeft.

Vragen van het lid Huizing (VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de vraag of de normen van de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG) dan wel de normen van de nieuwe Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering (GHF) leidend zijn

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance whether the NHG mortgage guarantee norms or the stricter new GHF conduct code are binding for mortgage lending, and how this affects the housing market and starters. The minister answered that both are acceptable interpretations of the open norm for responsible lending, that the only material difference is a stricter maximum LTV ratio under GHF (106% versus 108% under NHG at 2% transfer tax), and that CPB analysis shows limited housing market effects.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Huizing (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), De Jong (PVV), Ulenbelt (SP) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Financiën over het oproep

MPs asked the state secretary about employers, including Connexxion as self-insurer, summoning former employees with WGA 35-80% disability for medical reassessments, and about the rights, procedures and re-integration duties involved. The state secretary answered that assessment of incapacity is reserved to the UWV, that self-insuring employers may request reassessment but cannot set the percentage themselves, and that he sees no reason for new rules or talks with Connexxion.
The UWV or the self-insuring employer have the possibility to summon a WGA beneficiary.
Het UWV of de eigenrisicodrager hebben de mogelijkheid om een WGA-gerechtigde op te roepen.
Vragen van de leden Huizing en De Boer (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over particuliere erfpacht en hypotheekverstrekking (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Huizing and De Boer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks refuse mortgages on privately leased land (particuliere erfpacht) and whether they treat these differently from municipal leasehold. The minister said banks are hesitant due to unclear contract terms and future canon levels, that he has raised concerns with the NVB, and that the AFM will talk with stakeholders about a possible facilitating role.
I have discussed this with the NVB and conveyed my concerns to the NVB.
Ik heb hierover contact gehad met de NVB en heb mijn zorgen bij de NVB neergelegd.

Vragen van het lid Huizing (VVD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het verbod om ’s nachts snel te varen met motorboten in de hoofdvaarwaters tussen het vaste land en de Waddeneilanden en of tussen de Wad

An MP asks the minister why night-time high-speed travel by water taxis to the Wadden islands is restricted while Rotterdam water taxis are exempt, and asks for regulatory change or enforcement relief. The minister answers that the rules apply to all fast motorboats, that the minister will study allowing commercial fast vessels including water taxis to sail faster at night subject to nature protection and safety, but refuses an interim exemption or suspension of enforcement.
I am willing to examine in the short term how and under which conditions fast sailing with water taxis and other fast commercial vessels during night hours can be made possible.
Ik ben bereid om op korte termijn te onderzoeken, hoe en onder welke voorwaarden het snel varen met watertaxi's en andere snelle bedrijfsvaartuigen in de nachtelijke uren mogelijk gemaakt kan worden.

m: Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Van Dekken over verbreding van het Beter Leven keurmerk
Asks the government to extend the Beter Leven label to dairy products and to environmental aspects.
requests the government to contribute to extending the Beter Leven label to dairy products
verzoekt de regering, bij te dragen aan de verbreding van het Beter Leven keurmerk naar zuivelproducten
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Maij over het wegduiken van lidstaten bij gevoelige kwesties in Europa

MPs Van der Velde and Maij asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about member states avoiding contentious EU decisions on GMOs and pesticides, and whether the Commission's proposal to shift comitology responsibility to member states is adequate. Minister Koenders answered that impasses arise over health and safety questions, Dutch positions follow stated policy, the appraisal of the proposal is still being formed, and the next steps are not yet known.
That is why he announced that he wanted to present the proposals now on the table to place political responsibility for decisions on implementing acts more with the member states.

Daarom kondigde hij aan met de nu voorliggende voorstellen te willen komen om de politieke verantwoordelijkheid voor besluitvorming over uitvoeringshandelingen in grotere mate bij de lidstaten neer te leggen.
